By default, it uses the AWS managed key for Amazon S3, and a customer-managed KMS key can be configured when the company needs greater control over access, rotation, or compliance. See [Encrypt build outputs using a customer managed key](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-kms.html).

Thus, D addresses both requirements with the least ongoing infrastructure administration.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Systems Manager patching and EBS encryption

Systems Manager could automate some EC2 patching, but the company would still operate Jenkins and its EC2 build servers. Automation reduces effort but does not eliminate the self-managed build platform.

Additionally, EBS encryption protects data at rest on attached volumes, data moving between the volume and instance, and derived snapshots. It does not establish an artifact-management and encryption solution for artifacts after they are copied to another repository or delivery location. See [How Amazon EBS encryption works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/how-ebs-encryption-works.html).

Therefore, A is less maintainable and does not directly provide lifecycle-wide build artifact storage and encryption.

### B. Run Jenkins on ECS and store artifacts in encrypted S3

The S3 portion is valid: new objects stored in S3 are encrypted automatically with SSE-S3 by default, and SSE-KMS can be selected when greater key control is required. See [Configuring default encryption](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html).

However, moving Jenkins into a container does not eliminate Jenkins administration, plugin maintenance, configuration upgrades, backups, or security patching of the Jenkins application. Moreover, simply saying “an ECS cluster” does not identify its capacity type. ECS can use serverless Fargate, AWS-managed instances, or customer-managed EC2 capacity; with customer-managed EC2 capacity, the company remains responsible for the underlying instances. See [Amazon ECS clusters—Choosing the right cluster type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html).

B could be a lower-migration-effort solution, but the question asks for the **most maintainable** solution, not the solution requiring the fewest initial changes. CodeBuild removes more ongoing administration than containerized Jenkins.

### C. CodePipeline and Secrets Manager

CodePipeline can orchestrate a build action, but AWS Secrets Manager is designed to manage, retrieve, and rotate credentials, OAuth tokens, API keys, and similar secrets—not to encrypt build artifact files. AWS recommends AWS KMS for encryption keys. See [What is AWS Secrets Manager?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html).

CodePipeline artifacts are actually stored in S3 and encrypted with an AWS managed or customer-managed KMS key. See [Data protection in AWS CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/data-protection.html). Therefore, the option identifies the wrong service for artifact encryption and does not clearly eliminate the existing Jenkins build-server burden.

zh.question: 一家公司已将其所有内部质量控制应用程序容器化。该公司正在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行 Jenkins，这些实例需要修补和升级。合规官要求一名 DevOps 工程师开始加密构建工件，因为其中包含公司的知识产权。DevOps 工程师应如何以最易于维护的方式实现这一目标？

options.A: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 自动执行 EC2 实例的修补和升级，并默认加密 Amazon EBS 卷。
options.B: 将 Jenkins 部署到 Amazon ECS 集群，并将构建工件复制到启用了默认加密的 Amazon S3 存储桶。
options.C: 利用 AWS CodePipeline 以及构建操作，并使用 AWS Secrets Manager 加密工件。
options.D: 使用具有工件加密功能的 AWS CodeBuild 替换运行在 EC2 实例上的 Jenkins 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 题目所问内容

公司需要解决两个运营问题：

1. 消除或尽量减少与 EC2 上的 Jenkins 构建服务器相关的修补和升级负担。
2. 加密包含知识产权的构建工件。

由于题目要求选择**最易于维护**的解决方案，首选设计应使用托管构建服务替代自主管理的构建基础设施，同时提供原生工件加密。

## 正确答案：D

**使用具有工件加密功能的 AWS CodeBuild 替换运行在 EC2 实例上的 Jenkins 实例。**

AWS CodeBuild 是一项完全托管的构建服务。AWS 明确指出，CodeBuild 无需预置、管理、扩展、修补或更新构建服务器。这直接消除了场景中描述的 EC2/Jenkins 基础设施维护负担。CodeBuild 还可以使用自定义构建环境，适合容器化构建需求。请参阅 [什么是 AWS CodeBuild？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/welcome.html)。

CodeBuild 还会原生加密构建输出工件。默认情况下，它使用 Amazon S3 的 AWS 托管密钥；当公司需要对访问、轮换或合规性进行更强控制时，可以配置客户自主管理的 KMS 密钥。请参阅 [使用客户自主管理的密钥加密构建输出](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-kms.html)。

因此，D 以最少的持续基础设施管理工作同时满足了这两项要求。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. Systems Manager 修补和 EBS 加密

Systems Manager 可以自动执行部分 EC2 修补，但公司仍需运营 Jenkins 及其 EC2 构建服务器。自动化能够减少工作量，但不能消除自主管理的构建平台。

此外，EBS 加密可保护附加卷上的静态数据、在卷与实例之间移动的数据，以及派生快照。它并不能为工件在复制到其他存储库或交付位置后的管理和加密提供解决方案。请参阅 [Amazon EBS 加密的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/how-ebs-encryption-works.html)。

因此，A 的可维护性较低，并且不能直接为构建工件提供贯穿整个生命周期的存储和加密。

### B. 在 ECS 上运行 Jenkins 并将工件存储在加密的 S3 中

S3 部分是有效的：默认情况下，存储在 S3 中的新对象会自动使用 SSE-S3 加密；当需要更强的密钥控制时，可以选择 SSE-KMS。请参阅 [配置默认加密](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/default-bucket-encryption.html)。

但是，将 Jenkins 移入容器并不能消除 Jenkins 管理、插件维护、配置升级、备份或 Jenkins 应用程序的安全修补工作。此外，仅说明“一个 ECS 集群”并未指明其容量类型。ECS 可以使用无服务器 Fargate、AWS 托管实例或客户自主管理的 EC2 容量；如果使用客户自主管理的 EC2 容量，公司仍需负责底层实例。请参阅 [Amazon ECS 集群—选择合适的集群类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/clusters.html)。

B 可能是一种迁移工作量较低的解决方案，但题目要求的是**最易于维护**的解决方案，而不是初始改动最少的解决方案。与容器化 Jenkins 相比，CodeBuild 消除了更多持续性的管理工作。

### C. CodePipeline 和 Secrets Manager

CodePipeline 可以编排构建操作，但 AWS Secrets Manager 的设计用途是管理、检索和轮换凭证、OAuth 令牌、API 密钥及类似机密，而不是加密构建工件文件。AWS 建议使用 AWS KMS 管理加密密钥。请参阅 [什么是 AWS Secrets Manager？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/intro.html)。

CodePipeline 工件实际上存储在 S3 中，并使用 AWS 托管或客户自主管理的 KMS 密钥进行加密。请参阅 [AWS CodePipeline 中的数据保护](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/data-protection.html)。因此，该选项为工件加密指定了错误的服务，并且没有明确消除现有 Jenkins 构建服务器的负担。

en.question: An IT team has built an AWS CloudFormation template so others in the company can quickly and reliably deploy and terminate an application. The template creates an Amazon EC2 instance with a user data script to install the application and an Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to serve static webpages while it is running. All resources should be removed when the CloudFormation stack is deleted. However, the team observes that CloudFormation reports an error during stack deletion, and the S3 bucket created by the stack is not deleted. How can the team resolve the error in the MOST efficient manner to ensure that all resources are deleted without errors?

options.A: Add a DelelionPolicy attribute to the S3 bucket resource, with the value Delete forcing the bucket to be removed when the stack is deleted.
options.B: Add a custom resource with an AWS Lambda function with the DependsOn attribute specifying the S3 bucket, and an IAM role. Write the Lambda function to delete all objects from the bucket when RequestType is Delete.
options.C: Identify the resource that was not deleted. Manually empty the S3 bucket and then delete it.
options.D: Replace the EC2 and S3 bucket resources with a single AWS OpsWorks Stacks resource. Define a custom recipe for the stack to create and delete the EC2 instance and the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The stack deletion fails because the application has placed objects in the CloudFormation-created S3 bucket. CloudFormation cannot delete a non-empty S3 bucket, so the template needs automated cleanup logic that empties the bucket before CloudFormation attempts to delete the bucket itself.

## Correct answer: B

Add a Lambda-backed custom resource that empties the bucket when it receives a CloudFormation `Delete` request. Grant the Lambda execution role the required S3 listing and deletion permissions.

This works because:

- During stack deletion, CloudFormation sends a custom resource provider a request whose `RequestType` is `Delete`, allowing the Lambda function to run cleanup logic at exactly the required point in the lifecycle. See the [custom resource request object documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/crpg-ref.html).
- The custom resource depends on the S3 bucket, so CloudFormation creates the bucket before the custom resource and reverses that order during deletion: the custom resource is deleted—and therefore invokes its cleanup handler—before the bucket. AWS documents that if resource A depends on resource B, **A is deleted before B**. See [`DependsOn` behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-attribute-dependson.html).
- After the function removes the bucket contents, CloudFormation can successfully delete the now-empty bucket. If bucket versioning is enabled, the function must also remove all object versions and delete markers.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Add `DeletionPolicy: Delete`

This does not solve the problem. `Delete` is already CloudFormation's default behavior when no `DeletionPolicy` is specified. More importantly, AWS explicitly states that all objects in an S3 bucket must be deleted for bucket deletion to succeed. `DeletionPolicy: Delete` does not force-delete a non-empty bucket. See the [CloudFormation `DeletionPolicy` documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html).

### C. Manually empty and delete the bucket

Manual cleanup could recover the currently failed stack deletion, but it is not the most efficient or reliable solution for a reusable template. Every future deployment could encounter the same failure and require operator intervention. The requirement is to let users reliably deploy and terminate the application, so cleanup should be incorporated into the stack lifecycle.

### D. Replace the resources with an OpsWorks stack

Replacing the architecture with OpsWorks is unnecessary and does not inherently solve the S3 rule that a bucket must be empty before deletion. The EC2 instance and S3 bucket are valid CloudFormation resources; only automated bucket-content cleanup is missing.

Therefore, **B** is the most efficient reusable solution.

zh.question: 某 IT 团队构建了一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，以便公司中的其他人员能够快速且可靠地部署和终止一个应用程序。该模板创建一个 Amazon EC2 实例，并使用用户数据脚本安装该应用程序；同时还创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶，应用程序在运行期间使用该存储桶来提供静态网页。删除 CloudFormation 堆栈时，应删除所有资源。但是，该团队发现 CloudFormation 在删除堆栈期间报告错误，并且由该堆栈创建的 S3 存储桶未被删除。团队如何才能以最高效的方式解决该错误，确保所有资源均能无错误地删除？

options.A: 向 S3 存储桶资源添加 `DelelionPolicy` 属性，并将值设为 `Delete`，以强制在删除堆栈时删除该存储桶。
options.B: 添加一个自定义资源，其中包含一个 AWS Lambda 函数、一个通过 `DependsOn` 属性指定 S3 存储桶的依赖关系，以及一个 IAM 角色。编写 Lambda 函数，以便在 `RequestType` 为 `Delete` 时删除存储桶中的所有对象。
options.C: 识别未被删除的资源。手动清空 S3 存储桶，然后将其删除。
options.D: 使用单个 AWS OpsWorks Stacks 资源替换 EC2 和 S3 存储桶资源。为该堆栈定义一个自定义配方，以创建和删除 EC2 实例及 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查内容

堆栈删除失败，是因为应用程序已在由 CloudFormation 创建的 S3 存储桶中放置了对象。CloudFormation 无法删除非空的 S3 存储桶，因此模板需要自动化清理逻辑，在 CloudFormation 尝试删除存储桶本身之前清空该存储桶。

## 正确答案：B

添加一个由 Lambda 支持的自定义资源，使其在收到 CloudFormation `Delete` 请求时清空存储桶。向 Lambda 执行角色授予所需的 S3 列表和删除权限。

此方法有效，原因如下：

- 在堆栈删除期间，CloudFormation 会向自定义资源提供程序发送请求，其 `RequestType` 为 `Delete`，从而使 Lambda 函数能在生命周期中恰当的时机运行清理逻辑。请参阅[自定义资源请求对象文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/crpg-ref.html)。
- 自定义资源依赖于 S3 存储桶，因此 CloudFormation 会先创建存储桶，再创建自定义资源；而删除时则会反转该顺序：自定义资源会先被删除——因此调用其清理处理程序——然后才删除存储桶。AWS 文档指出，如果资源 A 依赖于资源 B，**A 会先于 B 被删除**。请参阅[`DependsOn` 行为](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-attribute-dependson.html)。
- 函数移除存储桶内容后，CloudFormation 即可成功删除已清空的存储桶。如果启用了存储桶版本控制，函数还必须删除所有对象版本和删除标记。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 添加 `DeletionPolicy: Delete`

这无法解决问题。未指定 `DeletionPolicy` 时，`Delete` 已是 CloudFormation 的默认行为。更重要的是，AWS 明确说明，必须删除 S3 存储桶中的所有对象，存储桶删除才能成功。`DeletionPolicy: Delete` 不会强制删除非空存储桶。请参阅 [CloudFormation `DeletionPolicy` 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html)。

### C. 手动清空并删除存储桶

手动清理可以补救当前失败的堆栈删除，但对于可重用模板而言，这不是最高效或最可靠的解决方案。未来每次部署都可能遇到相同的失败，并需要运维人员介入。要求是让用户能够可靠地部署和终止应用程序，因此清理操作应纳入堆栈生命周期。

### D. 使用 OpsWorks 堆栈替换资源

使用 OpsWorks 替换架构没有必要，而且也无法从根本上解决 S3 在删除前必须清空存储桶的规则。EC2 实例和 S3 存储桶都是有效的 CloudFormation 资源；缺少的仅是自动化的存储桶内容清理。

因此，**B** 是最高效且可复用的解决方案。

en.question: A company has an AWS CodePipeline pipeline that is configured with an Amazon S3 bucket in the eu-west-1 Region. The pipeline deploys an AWS Lambda application to the same Region. The pipeline consists of an AWS CodeBuild project build action and an AWS CloudFormation deploy action. The CodeBuild project uses the aws cloudformation package AWS CLI command to build an artifact that contains the Lambda function code’s .zip file and the CloudFormation template. The CloudFormation deploy action references the CloudFormation template from the output artifact of the CodeBuild project’s build action. The company wants to also deploy the Lambda application to the us-east-1 Region by using the pipeline in eu-west-1. A DevOps engineer has already updated the CodeBuild project to use the aws cloudformation package command to produce an additional output artifact for us-east-1. Which combination of additional steps should the DevOps engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Modify the CloudFormation template to include a parameter for the Lambda function code’s zip file location. Create a new CloudFormation deploy action for us-east-1 in the pipeline. Configure the new deploy action to pass in the us-east-1 artifact location as a parameter override.
options.B: Create a new CloudFormation deploy action for us-east-1 in the pipeline. Configure the new deploy action to use the CloudFormation template from the us-east-1 output artifact.
options.C: Create an S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow CodePipeline to have read and write access.
options.D: Create an S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the S3 bucket in eu-west-1 to the S3 bucket in us-east-1.
options.E: Modify the pipeline to include the S3 bucket for us-east-1 as an artifact store. Create a new CloudFormation deploy action for us-east-1 in the pipeline. Configure the new deploy action to use the CloudFormation template from the us-east-1 output artifact.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The existing pipeline is in `eu-west-1`, but the new CloudFormation deploy action will run in `us-east-1`. This makes the new deploy action a **CodePipeline cross-Region action**. The key requirements are therefore:

1. An S3 artifact bucket in every Region where pipeline actions execute.
2. An `artifactStores` mapping that associates each Region with its regional bucket.
3. A CloudFormation deploy action whose `region` is `us-east-1` and whose input is the packaged template produced for that Region.

AWS states that a pipeline must have an artifact bucket in the pipeline Region and one artifact bucket per Region containing an action. For cross-Region pipelines, `artifactStores` replaces the single `artifactStore`. CodePipeline then handles copying the required input artifacts between Regions; manual S3 replication is not required. See [Add a cross-Region action in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-create-cross-region.html) and [CodePipeline artifactStore or artifactStores](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipeline-requirements.html).

## Correct answers: C and E

### C. Create an S3 bucket in us-east-1 and allow CodePipeline access

The `us-east-1` CloudFormation action needs a regional CodePipeline artifact bucket. AWS explicitly requires an artifact bucket in the same Region as each cross-Region action. CodePipeline must also have the S3 permissions needed to read and write pipeline artifacts. The documented CodePipeline service-role permissions include operations such as `s3:GetObject`, `s3:GetObjectVersion`, and `s3:PutObject`; a suitable bucket policy can grant the required access described by this option. See [CodePipeline service role policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/how-to-custom-role.html).

### E. Add the us-east-1 bucket as an artifact store and create the regional deploy action

The pipeline must be changed from a single `artifactStore` configuration to an `artifactStores` mapping containing both `eu-west-1` and `us-east-1`. The new CloudFormation deploy action must target `us-east-1` and consume the CloudFormation template from the output artifact packaged for `us-east-1`.

The `aws cloudformation package` command uploads local artifacts and generates a transformed template containing the corresponding S3 references. Therefore, the deploy action should use the packaged template generated specifically for `us-east-1`. See [Package and deploy a template with local artifacts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-cli-package.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

A parameter override for the Lambda ZIP location is unnecessary because `aws cloudformation package` already uploads the local Lambda artifact and rewrites the output template with its S3 location. More importantly, this option does not add the required `us-east-1` regional artifact store to the pipeline.

### B. Incorrect

Creating the `us-east-1` CloudFormation deploy action and selecting the regional packaged template is necessary, but this option is incomplete by itself. A cross-Region action also requires an S3 artifact bucket in `us-east-1` and an `artifactStores` entry for that Region. Option E includes both the action and the required pipeline artifact-store configuration.

### D. Incorrect

S3 Cross-Region Replication is not the mechanism required for CodePipeline cross-Region actions. AWS documents that **CodePipeline handles copying the input artifacts** to the action's Region. CRR would add unnecessary configuration and would not replace the required regional `artifactStores` mapping.

Thus, the required combination is **C and E**.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道，该管道配置了位于 eu-west-1 区域的 Amazon S3 存储桶。该管道将一个 AWS Lambda 应用程序部署到同一地区。该管道由一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目构建操作和一个 AWS CloudFormation 部署操作组成。CodeBuild 项目使用 `aws cloudformation package` AWS CLI 命令来构建一个工件，其中包含 Lambda 函数代码的 `.zip` 文件和 CloudFormation 模板。CloudFormation 部署操作引用 CodeBuild 项目构建操作输出工件中的 CloudFormation 模板。公司还希望使用位于 eu-west-1 的管道将 Lambda 应用程序部署到 us-east-1 区域。DevOps 工程师已经更新了 CodeBuild 项目，以使用 `aws cloudformation package` 命令为 us-east-1 生成额外的输出工件。DevOps 工程师还应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 修改 CloudFormation 模板，为 Lambda 函数代码的 zip 文件位置添加一个参数。在管道中为 us-east-1 创建新的 CloudFormation 部署操作。将新的部署操作配置为通过参数覆盖传入 us-east-1 工件位置。
options.B: 在管道中为 us-east-1 创建新的 CloudFormation 部署操作。将新的部署操作配置为使用 us-east-1 输出工件中的 CloudFormation 模板。
options.C: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 S3 存储桶。配置 S3 存储桶策略以允许 CodePipeline 具有读取和写入访问权限。
options.D: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 S3 存储桶。配置从 eu-west-1 中的 S3 存储桶到 us-east-1 中的 S3 存储桶的 S3 跨区域复制（CRR）。
options.E: 修改管道，将 us-east-1 的 S3 存储桶作为工件存储。为 us-east-1 在管道中创建新的 CloudFormation 部署操作。将新的部署操作配置为使用 us-east-1 输出工件中的 CloudFormation 模板。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查的内容

现有管道位于 `eu-west-1`，但新的 CloudFormation 部署操作将在 `us-east-1` 中运行。这使新的部署操作成为一个 **CodePipeline 跨区域操作**。因此，关键要求如下：

1. 每个执行管道操作的区域中都需要有一个 S3 工件存储桶。
2. 需要有一个 `artifactStores` 映射，将每个区域与其区域存储桶关联起来。
3. 需要有一个 CloudFormation 部署操作，其 `region` 为 `us-east-1`，且输入为专门针对该区域生成的已打包模板。

AWS 说明，管道必须在管道所在区域中有一个工件存储桶，并且在包含操作的每个区域中各有一个工件存储桶。对于跨区域管道，`artifactStores` 将取代单一的 `artifactStore`。随后，CodePipeline 会处理跨区域复制所需输入工件的工作；不需要手动进行 S3 复制。请参阅 [在 CodePipeline 中添加跨区域操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-create-cross-region.html) 和 [CodePipeline artifactStore 或 artifactStores](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipeline-requirements.html)。

## 正确答案：C 和 E

### C. 在 us-east-1 中创建 S3 存储桶，并允许 CodePipeline 访问

`us-east-1` 中的 CloudFormation 操作需要一个区域性的 CodePipeline 工件存储桶。AWS 明确要求，每个跨区域操作必须在与该操作相同的区域中拥有工件存储桶。CodePipeline 还必须具有读取和写入管道工件所需的 S3 权限。文档中列出的 CodePipeline 服务角色权限包含 `s3:GetObject`、`s3:GetObjectVersion` 和 `s3:PutObject` 等操作；适当的存储桶策略可以授予该选项所述的必要访问权限。请参阅 [CodePipeline 服务角色策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/how-to-custom-role.html)。

### E. 将 us-east-1 存储桶添加为工件存储，并创建区域部署操作

必须将管道从单一的 `artifactStore` 配置改为 `artifactStores` 映射，其中同时包含 `eu-west-1` 和 `us-east-1`。新的 CloudFormation 部署操作必须以 `us-east-1` 为目标，并使用为 `us-east-1` 打包的输出工件中的 CloudFormation 模板。

`aws cloudformation package` 命令会上传本地工件，并生成一个包含相应 S3 引用的转换后模板。因此，部署操作应使用专门为 `us-east-1` 生成的已打包模板。请参阅 [使用本地工件打包和部署模板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-cli-package.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 错误

不需要对 Lambda ZIP 位置进行参数覆盖，因为 `aws cloudformation package` 已经会上传本地 Lambda 工件，并用其 S3 位置重写输出模板。更重要的是，该选项没有将必需的 `us-east-1` 区域工件存储添加到管道中。

### B. 错误

创建 `us-east-1` CloudFormation 部署操作并选择区域已打包模板是必要的，但单独使用该选项并不完整。跨区域操作还需要在 `us-east-1` 中拥有 S3 工件存储桶，并为该区域添加 `artifactStores` 条目。选项 E 同时包含了该操作以及所需的管道工件存储配置。

### D. 错误

S3 跨区域复制并不是 CodePipeline 跨区域操作所需的机制。AWS 文档说明，**CodePipeline 会处理输入工件的复制**，将其复制到操作所在区域。CRR 会增加不必要的配置，也无法替代必需的区域 `artifactStores` 映射。

因此，所需的组合是 **C 和 E**。

en.question: A company runs an application on one Amazon EC2 instance. Application metadata is stored in Amazon S3 and must be retrieved if the instance is restarted. The instance must restart or relaunch automatically if the instance becomes unresponsive. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the StatusCheckFailed metric. Use the recover action to stop and start the instance. Use an S3 event notification to push the metadata to the instance when the instance is back up and running.
options.B: Configure AWS OpsWorks, and use the auto healing feature to stop and start the instance. Use a lifecycle event in OpsWorks to pull the metadata from Amazon S3 and update it on the instance.
options.C: Use EC2 Auto Recovery to automatically stop and start the instance in case of a failure. Use an S3 event notification to push the metadata to the instance when the instance is back up and running.
options.D: Use AWS CloudFormation to create an EC2 instance that includes the UserData property for the EC2 resource. Add a command in UserData to retrieve the application metadata from Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The solution must satisfy **both** requirements:

1. Detect an unresponsive or failed EC2 instance and automatically restore it.
2. After recovery, actively retrieve the application metadata from Amazon S3.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Configure AWS OpsWorks, use auto healing, and use an OpsWorks lifecycle event to pull the metadata from S3.**

This is the only option that combines instance remediation with configuration automation that can restore the required metadata.

AWS documentation describes OpsWorks **auto healing** as detecting failed resources and restarting them. For example, if an OpsWorks-managed EC2 instance is terminated outside OpsWorks, auto healing categorizes the instance as failed and restarts it. OpsWorks also uses custom Chef cookbooks for configuration tasks, so a lifecycle recipe can retrieve the metadata from S3 and update the recovered instance. See [AWS documentation describing OpsWorks auto healing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/checklistforunwantedcharges.html) and [OpsWorks configuration with custom Chef cookbooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/integrations-action-type.html).

Thus, OpsWorks provides both parts of the workflow: **auto healing** for the instance and **custom configuration logic** to pull persistent metadata from S3.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. CloudWatch recovery plus an S3 event notification

This option has two problems:

- The EC2 **recover** alarm action recovers an instance onto new hardware after an underlying **system impairment**; it is not a generic stop-and-start action for every cause of application or operating-system unresponsiveness. AWS associates recovery with system status check failures. See [Create alarms that stop, terminate, reboot, or recover an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/UsingAlarmActions.html).
- An S3 event notification cannot directly “push the metadata to the EC2 instance.” Supported S3 event destinations are SNS, SQS, Lambda, and EventBridge. S3 notifications are also generated by S3 object events, not merely because an EC2 instance restarted. See [S3 supported event destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html).

### C. EC2 Auto Recovery plus an S3 event notification

EC2 recovery can address eligible underlying infrastructure failures, but the metadata-restoration mechanism is invalid. Restarting or recovering EC2 does not produce an S3 object event, and Amazon S3 does not directly deliver an object to an EC2 instance as an event-notification destination. The instance or another automation component must explicitly **pull** the object from S3.

### D. CloudFormation with EC2 user data

User data can retrieve metadata during instance initialization, but this option provides **no monitoring or automatic healing mechanism** for an existing instance that becomes unresponsive. In addition, EC2 user data scripts run only during the initial launch by default unless explicitly configured otherwise. See [Run commands when you launch an EC2 instance with user data input](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html).

Therefore, user data alone does not meet the automatic restart or relaunch requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在一台 Amazon EC2 实例上运行一个应用程序。应用程序元数据存储在 Amazon S3 中，并且必须在实例重启后检索这些元数据。如果实例变得无响应，实例必须自动重启或重新启动。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 StatusCheckFailed 指标创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。使用 recover 操作停止并启动该实例。当实例恢复正常运行后，使用 S3 事件通知将元数据推送到该实例。
options.B: 配置 AWS OpsWorks，并使用 auto healing 功能停止和启动该实例。使用 OpsWorks 中的生命周期事件从 Amazon S3 拉取元数据并在实例上更新它。
options.C: 使用 EC2 Auto Recovery 在发生故障时自动停止和启动该实例。当实例恢复正常运行后，使用 S3 事件通知将元数据推送到该实例。
options.D: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 创建一个 EC2 实例，并为 EC2 资源包含 UserData 属性。在 UserData 中添加一条命令，以从 Amazon S3 检索应用程序元数据。

zh.explanation:
## 该题考查的内容

该解决方案必须同时满足 **两项** 要求：

1. 检测无响应或故障的 EC2 实例，并自动将其恢复。
2. 恢复后，主动从 Amazon S3 检索应用程序元数据。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 配置 AWS OpsWorks，使用 auto healing，并使用 OpsWorks 生命周期事件从 S3 拉取元数据。**

这是唯一将实例修复与配置自动化相结合、能够恢复所需元数据的选项。

AWS 文档将 OpsWorks **auto healing** 描述为检测故障资源并重启它们。例如，如果由 OpsWorks 管理的 EC2 实例在 OpsWorks 之外被终止，auto healing 会将该实例归类为故障实例并重启它。OpsWorks 还使用自定义 Chef cookbook 执行配置任务，因此生命周期 recipe 可以从 S3 检索元数据并更新恢复后的实例。请参阅[描述 OpsWorks auto healing 的 AWS 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awsaccountbilling/latest/aboutv2/checklistforunwantedcharges.html)和[使用自定义 Chef cookbook 进行 OpsWorks 配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/integrations-action-type.html)。

因此，OpsWorks 提供了工作流程的两个部分：用于实例的 **auto healing**，以及用于从 S3 拉取持久元数据的 **自定义配置逻辑**。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. CloudWatch 恢复加 S3 事件通知

此选项有两个问题：

- EC2 的 **recover** 警报操作会在底层发生 **系统损坏** 后将实例恢复到新硬件上；它并不是针对应用程序或操作系统无响应等所有原因的通用停止并启动操作。AWS 将恢复操作与系统状态检查失败关联。请参阅[创建停止、终止、重启或恢复实例的警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/UsingAlarmActions.html)。
- S3 事件通知不能直接将“元数据推送到 EC2 实例”。受支持的 S3 事件目标为 SNS、SQS、Lambda 和 EventBridge。S3 通知也由 S3 对象事件生成，而不是仅因为 EC2 实例重启。请参阅[S3 支持的事件目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html)。

### C. EC2 Auto Recovery 加 S3 事件通知

EC2 恢复可以处理符合条件的底层基础设施故障，但元数据恢复机制无效。重启或恢复 EC2 不会产生 S3 对象事件，并且 Amazon S3 不会将对象直接投递到 EC2 实例作为事件通知目标。实例或其他自动化组件必须显式从 S3 **拉取** 对象。

### D. 使用 EC2 user data 的 CloudFormation

user data 可以在实例初始化期间检索元数据，但此选项没有为变得无响应的现有实例提供任何 **监控或自动修复机制**。此外，除非进行了显式配置，否则 EC2 user data 脚本默认仅在首次启动期间运行。请参阅[使用 user data 输入在启动 EC2 实例时运行命令](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)。

因此，仅使用 user data 无法满足自动重启或重新启动的要求。

en.question: A company has multiple AWS accounts. The company uses AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) that is integrated with AWS Toolkit for Microsoft Azure DevOps. The attributes for access control feature is enabled in IAM Identity Center. The attribute mapping list contains two entries. The department key is mapped to ${path:enterprise.department}. The costCenter key is mapped to ${path:enterprise.costCenter}. All existing Amazon EC2 instances have a department tag that corresponds to three company departments (d1, d2, d3). A DevOps engineer must create policies based on the matching attributes. The policies must minimize administrative effort and must grant each Azure AD user access to only the EC2 instances that are tagged with the user’s respective department name. Which condition key should the DevOps engineer include in the custom permissions policies to meet these requirements?

zh.question: 某公司拥有多个 AWS 账户。该公司使用与 AWS Toolkit for Microsoft Azure DevOps 集成的 AWS IAM Identity Center（AWS Single Sign-On）。IAM Identity Center 中已启用访问控制属性（attributes for access control）功能。属性映射列表包含两个条目：department 键映射到 ${path:enterprise.department}，costCenter 键映射到 ${path:enterprise.costCenter}。所有现有的 Amazon EC2 实例都带有与公司三个部门（d1、d2、d3）相对应的 department 标签。一位 DevOps 工程师必须基于匹配属性创建策略。这些策略必须最大限度减少管理工作量，并且必须仅授予每个 Azure AD 用户访问带有该用户所属部门名称标签的 EC2 实例的权限。为满足这些要求，DevOps 工程师应在自定义权限策略中包含哪个条件键？

en.question: A company hosts a security auditing application in an AWS account. The auditing application uses an IAM role to access other AWS accounts. All the accounts are in the same organization in AWS Organizations. A recent security audit revealed that users in the audited AWS accounts could modify or delete the auditing application's IAM role. The company needs to prevent any modification to the auditing application's IAM role by any entity other than a trusted administrator IAM role. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an SCP that includes a Deny statement for changes to the auditing application's IAM role. Include a condition that allows the trusted administrator IAM role to make changes. Attach the SCP to the root of the organization.
options.B: Create an SCP that includes an Allow statement for changes to the auditing application's IAM role by the trusted administrator IAM role. Include a Deny statement for changes by all other IAM principals. Attach the SCP to the IAM service in each AWS account where the auditing application has an IAM role.
options.C: Create an IAM permissions boundary that includes a Deny statement for changes to the auditing application's IAM role. Include a condition that allows the trusted administrator IAM role to make changes. Attach the permissions boundary to the audited AWS accounts.
options.D: Create an IAM permissions boundary that includes a Deny statement for changes to the auditing application’s IAM role. Include a condition that allows the trusted administrator IAM role to make changes. Attach the permissions boundary to the auditing application's IAM role in the AWS accounts.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an organization-wide preventive control that blocks principals in the audited member accounts from modifying or deleting a specific auditing IAM role, while exempting one trusted administrator role.

## Correct answer: A

Create an SCP with an explicit `Deny` for IAM role-management actions against the auditing role's ARN, and scope that deny with a condition that excludes the trusted administrator role—for example, using `ArnNotLike` or `ArnNotEquals` with `aws:PrincipalArn`. Attach the SCP to the organization root so that it applies to all member accounts beneath that root.

The important nuance is that the condition does not independently **grant** permission. It makes the `Deny` apply only when the caller is not the trusted administrator. The trusted administrator must still receive the necessary IAM permissions through an identity-based policy. AWS states that SCPs define the maximum permissions available to principals in member accounts and never grant permissions themselves. An explicit SCP deny remains effective even if a principal has an IAM administrator policy. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

AWS also provides an SCP example specifically for preventing modifications to a designated IAM role by denying actions such as `iam:DeleteRole`, `iam:AttachRolePolicy`, `iam:PutRolePolicy`, and `iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy` against that role ARN. See [SCP-AMS-033: Prevent modifications to specific IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/managedservices/latest/userguide/scp-library-compliance.html).

Attaching the SCP at the root affects IAM users and roles in all member accounts under that root. AWS documents that SCP attachment targets are roots, OUs, or accounts. See [Attach policies with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

This option is invalid because an SCP cannot be attached to the **IAM service** in an account. SCPs are attached only to an AWS Organizations root, OU, or account. Additionally, an SCP `Allow` statement does not grant the trusted administrator permission; the administrator still needs an IAM identity-based policy. The valid design is to conditionally exclude the trusted administrator from the explicit deny, as in option A.

### C

A permissions boundary cannot be attached to an AWS account. AWS supports permissions boundaries only for IAM entities—specifically IAM users and roles. A boundary limits the maximum permissions of the identity to which it is attached; it is not an account-wide guardrail. See [Permissions boundaries for IAM entities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html).

### D

Attaching a permissions boundary to the auditing application's IAM role would limit what the **auditing role itself** can do. It would not restrict other users and roles from calling IAM APIs such as `DeleteRole`, `UpdateAssumeRolePolicy`, or `AttachRolePolicy` against that role. Protecting the role from other principals requires restricting those callers, which the organization-level SCP accomplishes.

Therefore, **A** is the solution that meets the requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 AWS 账户中托管安全审计应用程序。该审计应用程序使用 IAM role 访问其他 AWS 账户。所有账户都位于 AWS Organizations 中的同一个组织内。最近的一次安全审计发现，被审计 AWS 账户中的用户可以修改或删除该审计应用程序的 IAM role。该公司需要防止除受信任的管理员 IAM role 之外的任何实体修改该审计应用程序的 IAM role。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 SCP，其中包含用于拒绝更改审计应用程序 IAM role 的 Deny 语句。添加一个条件，允许受信任的管理员 IAM role 进行更改。将该 SCP 附加到组织的根目录。
options.B: 创建一个 SCP，其中包含允许受信任管理员 IAM role 更改审计应用程序 IAM role 的 Allow 语句。添加一个 Deny 语句，拒绝所有其他 IAM principal 进行更改。将该 SCP 附加到审计应用程序具有 IAM role 的每个 AWS 账户中的 IAM 服务。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM permissions boundary，其中包含用于拒绝更改审计应用程序 IAM role 的 Deny 语句。添加一个条件，允许受信任的管理员 IAM role 进行更改。将该 permissions boundary 附加到被审计的 AWS 账户。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM permissions boundary，其中包含用于拒绝更改审计应用程序 IAM role 的 Deny 语句。添加一个条件，允许受信任的管理员 IAM role 进行更改。将该 permissions boundary 附加到 AWS 账户中审计应用程序的 IAM role。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

公司需要一项组织范围的预防性控制措施，阻止被审计成员账户中的 principal 修改或删除特定的审计 IAM role，同时豁免一个受信任的管理员 role。

## 正确答案：A

创建一个 SCP，其中包含针对审计 role ARN 的 IAM role 管理操作的显式 `Deny`，并使用条件限定该 deny，以排除受信任的管理员 role——例如，使用带有 `aws:PrincipalArn` 的 `ArnNotLike` 或 `ArnNotEquals`。将 SCP 附加到组织根目录，以便它适用于该根目录下的所有成员账户。

重要的细微差别是，该条件不会独立**授予**权限。它使 `Deny` 仅在调用方不是受信任管理员时生效。受信任管理员仍必须通过基于身份的策略获得所需的 IAM 权限。AWS 指出，SCP 定义成员账户中 principal 可获得的最大权限，且自身永远不会授予权限。即使 principal 拥有 IAM administrator policy，显式 SCP deny 仍然有效。请参阅 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

AWS 还提供了一个专门用于防止修改指定 IAM role 的 SCP 示例，该示例会针对该 role ARN 拒绝诸如 `iam:DeleteRole`、`iam:AttachRolePolicy`、`iam:PutRolePolicy` 和 `iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy` 等操作。请参阅 [SCP-AMS-033：防止修改特定 IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/managedservices/latest/userguide/scp-library-compliance.html)。

在根目录附加 SCP 会影响该根目录下所有成员账户中的 IAM 用户和角色。AWS 文档指出，SCP 的附加目标可以是根目录、OU 或账户。请参阅 [使用 AWS Organizations 附加策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B

该选项无效，因为不能将 SCP 附加到账户中的 **IAM service**。SCP 只能附加到 AWS Organizations 的根目录、OU 或账户。此外，SCP `Allow` 语句不会授予受信任管理员权限；管理员仍需要 IAM 基于身份的策略。有效的设计是如选项 A 所示，通过条件将受信任管理员排除在显式 deny 之外。

### C

不能将 permissions boundary 附加到 AWS 账户。AWS 仅支持将 permissions boundary 用于 IAM 实体，具体为 IAM 用户和角色。boundary 限制其所附加身份的最大权限；它不是账户范围的防护措施。请参阅 [IAM 实体的 permissions boundary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html)。

### D

将 permissions boundary 附加到审计应用程序的 IAM role，会限制**审计 role 本身**可以执行的操作。它不会限制其他用户和角色对该 role 调用 IAM API，例如 `DeleteRole`、`UpdateAssumeRolePolicy` 或 `AttachRolePolicy`。要保护 role 免受其他 principal 的修改，需要限制这些调用方，而组织级 SCP 可以实现这一点。

因此，**A** 是满足该要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company has an on-premises application that is written in Go. A DevOps engineer must move the application to AWS. The company's development team wants to enable blue/green deployments and perform A/B testing. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Deploy the application on an Amazon EC2 instance, and create an AMI of the instance. Use the AMI to create an automatic scaling launch configuration that is used in an Auto Scaling group. Use Elastic Load Balancing to distribute traffic. When changes are made to the application, a new AMI will be created, which will initiate an EC2 instance refresh.
options.B: Use Amazon Lightsail to deploy the application. Store the application in a zipped format in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use this zipped version to deploy new versions of the application to Lightsail. Use Lightsail deployment options to manage the deployment.
options.C: Use AWS CodeArtifact to store the application code. Use AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the application to a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. Use Elastic Load Balancing to distribute the traffic to the EC2 instances. When making changes to the application, upload a new version to CodeArtifact and create a new CodeDeploy deployment.
options.D: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to host the application. Store a zipped version of the application in Amazon S3. Use that location to deploy new versions of the application. Use Elastic Beanstalk to manage the deployment options.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a managed AWS hosting solution for a **Go web application** that can support both:

- **Blue/green deployment**: Run the current and new versions in separate environments, test the new environment, and then switch production traffic.
- **A/B or canary-style testing**: Send a controlled percentage of client traffic to the new version while the old version continues serving traffic.

## Correct answer: D

**AWS Elastic Beanstalk** is the best fit because it provides a managed **Go platform**, manages application versions/source bundles stored in Amazon S3, and has deployment mechanisms that directly satisfy the traffic-management requirements.

Elastic Beanstalk supports blue/green deployments by deploying the new application version to a **separate environment**, testing it, and then swapping the environments' CNAMEs to redirect production traffic. This avoids modifying the existing production environment in place. See [Blue/Green deployments with Elastic Beanstalk](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html).

For A/B or canary-style validation, Elastic Beanstalk provides a **traffic-splitting deployment policy**. It creates a new set of instances and sends a configurable percentage of incoming traffic to the new application version for an evaluation period. If the new version remains healthy, Elastic Beanstalk shifts the remaining traffic; otherwise, it can return traffic to the old version. See [Elastic Beanstalk deployment policies and traffic splitting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html).

Elastic Beanstalk also supports a managed [Go platform](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/platforms/platforms-supported.html), and its application source bundles are stored in Amazon S3 and represented as deployable application versions. See [Managing Elastic Beanstalk application versions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/applications-versions.html).

A complete implementation would normally use **two Elastic Beanstalk environments for the blue/green cutover** and the traffic-splitting deployment policy when percentage-based testing is required.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EC2 AMI, one Auto Scaling group, and instance refresh

An instance refresh replaces instances in an Auto Scaling group with instances based on the new launch configuration or template. The option describes only one Auto Scaling group and one load-balanced fleet; it does not define separate blue and green environments, separate target groups, or weighted traffic routing between application versions.

Although a custom EC2 architecture could be built using two Auto Scaling groups and appropriate traffic-routing controls, the architecture in this option does not provide the required blue/green and A/B workflow as stated.

### B. Amazon Lightsail

Lightsail can host applications, but the proposed solution does not provide the managed blue/green environment swap and percentage-based traffic-splitting deployment policies required here. Merely uploading a ZIP file to S3 and deploying versions to Lightsail does not establish simultaneous blue and green environments or A/B traffic routing.

### C. CodeArtifact and CodeDeploy

This option is invalid as described because **CodeArtifact is not a supported CodeDeploy application revision repository**. For EC2/on-premises CodeDeploy deployments, supported revision repository types include Amazon S3 and GitHub; CodeArtifact is intended for software package repositories rather than CodeDeploy revision bundles. See [Choose a CodeDeploy repository type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/application-revisions-repository-type.html).

CodeDeploy can perform EC2 blue/green deployments when a deployment group, replacement environment, and load balancer are configured appropriately. However, this option neither specifies that blue/green configuration nor a valid revision repository, and it does not describe percentage-based A/B traffic handling.

Therefore, **D** is the only option that directly and correctly meets all the requirements with managed AWS deployment capabilities.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个使用 Go 编写的本地部署应用程序。一名 DevOps 工程师必须将该应用程序迁移到 AWS。公司的开发团队希望启用蓝绿部署并执行 A/B 测试。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将应用程序部署在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并为该实例创建 AMI。使用该 AMI 创建一个自动扩缩启动配置，该配置由一个 Auto Scaling 组使用。使用 Elastic Load Balancing 分配流量。当对应用程序进行更改时，将创建新的 AMI，这会启动 EC2 实例刷新。
options.B: 使用 Amazon Lightsail 部署应用程序。将应用程序以压缩格式存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用此压缩版本将应用程序的新版本部署到 Lightsail。使用 Lightsail 部署选项管理部署。
options.C: 使用 AWS CodeArtifact 存储应用程序代码。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 将应用程序部署到一组 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Elastic Load Balancing 将流量分配到 EC2 实例。在对应用程序进行更改时，将新版本上传到 CodeArtifact 并创建新的 CodeDeploy 部署。
options.D: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 托管应用程序。将应用程序的压缩版本存储在 Amazon S3 中。使用该位置部署应用程序的新版本。使用 Elastic Beanstalk 管理部署选项。

zh.explanation:
## 问题要求

公司需要一个用于 **Go Web 应用程序** 的托管 AWS 托管解决方案，并且该方案能够同时支持：

- **蓝/绿部署**：在不同环境中运行当前版本和新版本，测试新环境，然后切换生产流量。
- **A/B 或金丝雀式测试**：在旧版本继续提供流量服务的同时，将受控百分比的客户端流量发送到新版本。

## 正确答案：D

**AWS Elastic Beanstalk** 是最佳选择，因为它提供托管的 **Go 平台**，管理存储在 Amazon S3 中的应用程序版本/源代码包，并且具备可直接满足流量管理要求的部署机制。

Elastic Beanstalk 通过将新应用程序版本部署到**单独的环境**中、对其进行测试，然后交换环境的 CNAME 以重定向生产流量，来支持蓝/绿部署。这避免了直接修改现有生产环境。请参阅 [使用 Elastic Beanstalk 的蓝/绿部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.CNAMESwap.html)。

对于 A/B 或金丝雀式验证，Elastic Beanstalk 提供了**流量拆分部署策略**。它会创建一组新实例，并在评估期间将可配置百分比的传入流量发送到新应用程序版本。如果新版本保持正常运行，Elastic Beanstalk 会转移剩余流量；否则，它可以将流量恢复到旧版本。请参阅 [Elastic Beanstalk 部署策略和流量拆分](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/using-features.rolling-version-deploy.html)。

Elastic Beanstalk 还支持托管的 [Go 平台](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/platforms/platforms-supported.html)，其应用程序源代码包存储在 Amazon S3 中，并表示为可部署的应用程序版本。请参阅 [管理 Elastic Beanstalk 应用程序版本](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticbeanstalk/latest/dg/applications-versions.html)。

完整的实施通常会使用**两个 Elastic Beanstalk 环境来进行蓝/绿切换**，并在需要基于百分比的测试时使用流量拆分部署策略。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. EC2 AMI、一个 Auto Scaling 组和实例刷新

实例刷新会使用基于新启动配置或模板的实例，替换 Auto Scaling 组中的实例。该选项仅描述了一个 Auto Scaling 组和一个负载均衡的实例集；它没有定义独立的蓝色和绿色环境、独立的目标组，或应用程序版本之间的加权流量路由。

虽然可以使用两个 Auto Scaling 组和适当的流量路由控制来构建自定义 EC2 架构，但该选项中的架构并未按所述提供所需的蓝/绿和 A/B 工作流程。

### B. Amazon Lightsail

Lightsail 可以托管应用程序，但所提出的解决方案不提供这里所需的托管蓝/绿环境交换和基于百分比的流量拆分部署策略。仅将 ZIP 文件上传到 S3 并将版本部署到 Lightsail，无法建立同时运行的蓝色和绿色环境或 A/B 流量路由。

### C. CodeArtifact 和 CodeDeploy

此选项按描述是无效的，因为 **CodeArtifact 不是受支持的 CodeDeploy 应用程序修订版本存储库**。对于 EC2/本地 CodeDeploy 部署，受支持的修订版本存储库类型包括 Amazon S3 和 GitHub；CodeArtifact 用于软件包存储库，而不是 CodeDeploy 修订版本包。请参阅 [选择 CodeDeploy 存储库类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/application-revisions-repository-type.html)。

当适当配置部署组、替换环境和负载均衡器时，CodeDeploy 可以执行 EC2 蓝/绿部署。但是，此选项既没有指定这种蓝/绿配置，也没有指定有效的修订版本存储库，并且没有描述基于百分比的 A/B 流量处理。

因此，**D** 是唯一一个能够通过托管 AWS 部署功能，直接且正确地满足所有要求的选项。

en.question: A developer is maintaining a fleet of 50 Amazon EC2 Linux servers. The servers are part of an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group, and also use Elastic Load Balancing for load balancing. Occasionally, some application servers are being terminated after failing ELB HTTP health checks. The developer would like to perform a root cause analysis on the issue, but before being able to access application logs, the server is terminated. How can log collection be automated?

options.A: Use Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to put instances in a Pending:Wait state. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for EC2 Instance Terminate Successful and trigger an AWS Lambda function that invokes an SSM Run Command script to collect logs, push them to Amazon S3, and complete the lifecycle action once logs are collected.
options.B: Use Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to put instances in a Terminating:Wait state. Create an AWS Config rule for EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action and trigger a step function that invokes a script to collect logs, push them to Amazon S3, and complete the lifecycle action once logs are collected.
options.C: Use Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to put instances in a Terminating:Wait state. Create an Amazon CloudWatch subscription filter for EC2 Instance Terminate Successful and trigger a CloudWatch agent that invokes a script to collect logs, push them to Amazon S3, and complete the lifecycle action once logs are collected.
options.D: Use Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to put instances in a Terminating:Wait state. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action and trigger an AWS Lambda function that invokes an SSM Run Command script to collect logs, push them to Amazon S3, and complete the lifecycle action once logs are collected.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The Auto Scaling group terminates instances that fail the load balancer health checks. The automation therefore must **pause an instance after it has been selected for termination but before it is actually terminated**, collect its local application logs, store those logs durably, and then allow termination to continue.

## Correct answer: D

A **termination lifecycle hook** moves the selected instance into `Terminating:Wait`. AWS documents that this extends the life of an instance already selected for termination and that Auto Scaling waits for `CompleteLifecycleAction` or for the hook timeout before terminating it. This creates the required log-collection window. See [Termination lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/gracefully-handle-instance-termination.html).

When the instance enters the wait state, EC2 Auto Scaling emits an **`EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action`** event to EventBridge. The event includes the instance ID, lifecycle hook name, Auto Scaling group name, and lifecycle action token. See [EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle action events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-event-reference.html).

An EventBridge rule can then invoke Lambda. AWS explicitly recommends EventBridge for lifecycle-hook notifications and documents configuring an EventBridge rule to invoke Lambda when an instance enters a lifecycle wait state. See [Configure a notification target for lifecycle notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/prepare-for-lifecycle-notifications.html).

Lambda can use the instance ID from the event to call Systems Manager Run Command. Run Command remotely executes the log-collection script on the still-running managed instance; AWS specifically lists capturing log files when an instance is removed from an Auto Scaling group as a Run Command use case. The script can copy the logs to S3, after which Lambda completes the lifecycle action. See [AWS Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html).

Thus, **D provides the correct sequence**:

1. Place the instance in `Terminating:Wait`.
2. Match the termination lifecycle event with EventBridge.
3. Invoke Lambda.
4. Use SSM Run Command to collect and upload logs to S3.
5. Complete the lifecycle action so termination can continue.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

`Pending:Wait` is associated with an **instance launch** lifecycle hook, not termination. The Auto Scaling event reference distinguishes `Pending:Wait` for scale-out from `Terminating:Wait` for scale-in. Additionally, waiting for an “Instance Terminate Successful” indication would be too late because the instance and its local logs would already be unavailable. The automation must react to the pre-termination lifecycle action event, not successful completion of termination.

### B

Although `Terminating:Wait` is the correct state, an **AWS Config rule** is not the appropriate event source for an Auto Scaling lifecycle action. AWS Config rules evaluate resource configurations for compliance; they are not the documented mechanism for receiving `EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action` notifications. Auto Scaling lifecycle-hook notifications should be routed through EventBridge, SNS, SQS, or Lambda, with EventBridge recommended. See [How AWS Config Rules Work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_components.html) and the lifecycle notification documentation linked above.

### C

A CloudWatch Logs subscription filter processes matching **log events already present in a CloudWatch Logs log group** and forwards them to destinations such as Lambda. It is not the source for Auto Scaling lifecycle-action events, and a CloudWatch agent is not a subscription-filter target that is triggered to run an arbitrary host-side collection script. See [CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html). The canonical source for the pre-termination notification is EventBridge, and SSM Run Command is the appropriate mechanism for remotely running the collection script on the instance.

zh.question: 一名开发人员正在维护一个由 50 台 Amazon EC2 Linux 服务器组成的集群。这些服务器属于一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组，并且还使用 Elastic Load Balancing 进行负载均衡。偶尔，一些应用程序服务器在未通过 ELB HTTP 健康检查后会被终止。开发人员希望对此问题进行根本原因分析，但在能够访问应用程序日志之前，服务器就已被终止。如何自动化日志收集？

options.A: 使用 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩将实例置于 Pending:Wait 状态。为 EC2 Instance Terminate Successful 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，并触发一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数调用 SSM Run Command 脚本来收集日志、将其推送到 Amazon S3，并在收集日志后完成生命周期操作。
options.B: 使用 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩将实例置于 Terminating:Wait 状态。为 EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action 创建一个 AWS Config 规则，并触发一个 Step Functions 工作流，该工作流调用脚本来收集日志、将其推送到 Amazon S3，并在收集日志后完成生命周期操作。
options.C: 使用 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩将实例置于 Terminating:Wait 状态。为 EC2 Instance Terminate Successful 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 订阅筛选器，并触发一个 CloudWatch agent，该 agent 调用脚本来收集日志、将其推送到 Amazon S3，并在收集日志后完成生命周期操作。
options.D: 使用 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩将实例置于 Terminating:Wait 状态。为 EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，并触发一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数调用 SSM Run Command 脚本来收集日志、将其推送到 Amazon S3，并在收集日志后完成生命周期操作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

Auto Scaling 组会终止未通过负载均衡器健康检查的实例。因此，自动化必须**在实例被选定终止之后、实际终止之前暂停该实例**，收集其本地应用程序日志，持久化存储这些日志，然后允许终止继续。

## 正确答案：D

**终止生命周期挂钩**会将选定的实例移入 `Terminating:Wait`。AWS 文档说明，这会延长已被选定终止的实例的存活时间，并且 Auto Scaling 会等待 `CompleteLifecycleAction` 或挂钩超时后才终止它。这就创建了所需的日志收集时间窗口。请参阅 [终止生命周期挂钩](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/gracefully-handle-instance-termination.html)。

当实例进入等待状态时，EC2 Auto Scaling 会向 EventBridge 发出 **`EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action`** 事件。该事件包含实例 ID、生命周期挂钩名称、Auto Scaling 组名称和生命周期操作令牌。请参阅 [EC2 Auto Scaling 生命周期操作事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-event-reference.html)。

随后，EventBridge 规则可以调用 Lambda。AWS 明确建议将 EventBridge 用于生命周期挂钩通知，并说明了如何配置 EventBridge 规则，以便在实例进入生命周期等待状态时调用 Lambda。请参阅 [为生命周期通知配置通知目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/prepare-for-lifecycle-notifications.html)。

Lambda 可以使用事件中的实例 ID 来调用 Systems Manager Run Command。Run Command 会在仍在运行的受管实例上远程执行日志收集脚本；AWS 特别将实例从 Auto Scaling 组中移除时捕获日志文件列为 Run Command 的一个使用场景。该脚本可以将日志复制到 S3，随后 Lambda 完成生命周期操作。请参阅 [AWS Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html)。

因此，**D 提供了正确的顺序**：

1. 将实例置于 `Terminating:Wait`。
2. 使用 EventBridge 匹配终止生命周期事件。
3. 调用 Lambda。
4. 使用 SSM Run Command 收集日志并将其上传到 S3。
5. 完成生命周期操作，使终止可以继续。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A

`Pending:Wait` 与**实例启动**生命周期挂钩相关，而不是终止。Auto Scaling 事件参考资料区分了用于扩容的 `Pending:Wait` 和用于缩容的 `Terminating:Wait`。此外，等待“Instance Terminate Successful”指示会太晚，因为实例及其本地日志届时已经不可用。自动化必须响应终止前的生命周期操作事件，而不是终止成功完成的事件。

### B

尽管 `Terminating:Wait` 是正确的状态，但 **AWS Config 规则**不是适用于 Auto Scaling 生命周期操作的事件源。AWS Config 规则用于评估资源配置是否合规；它们不是接收 `EC2 Instance-terminate Lifecycle Action` 通知的文档化机制。Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩通知应通过 EventBridge、SNS、SQS 或 Lambda 路由，其中建议使用 EventBridge。请参阅 [AWS Config Rules 的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_components.html) 以及上文链接的生命周期通知文档。

### C

CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器会处理**已存在于 CloudWatch Logs 日志组中的日志事件**，并将其转发到 Lambda 等目标。它不是 Auto Scaling 生命周期操作事件的来源，而且 CloudWatch agent 也不是会被触发来运行任意主机端收集脚本的订阅筛选器目标。请参阅 [CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)。终止前通知的标准来源是 EventBridge，而 SSM Run Command 是在实例上远程运行收集脚本的适当机制。

en.question: A company has an organization in AWS Organizations. The organization includes workload accounts that contain enterprise applications. The company centrally manages users from an operations account. No users can be created in the workload accounts. The company recently added an operations team and must provide the operations team members with administrator access to each workload account. Which combination of actions will provide this access? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a SysAdmin role in the operations account. Attach the AdministratorAccess policy to the role. Modify the trust relationship to allow the sts:AssumeRole action from the workload accounts.
options.B: Create a SysAdmin role in each workload account. Attach the AdministratorAccess policy to the role. Modify the trust relationship to allow the sts:AssumeRole action from the operations account.
options.C: Create an Amazon Cognito identity pool in the operations account. Attach the SysAdmin role as an authenticated role.
options.D: In the operations account, create an IAM user for each operations team member.
options.E: In the operations account, create an IAM user group that is named SysAdmins. Add an IAM policy that allows the sts:AssumeRole action for the SysAdmin role in each workload account. Add all operations team members to the group.
options.F: Create an Amazon Cognito user pool in the operations account. Create an Amazon Cognito user for each operations team member.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The operations team members are centrally managed in the **operations account**, but they need administrator permissions in multiple **workload accounts** without creating users in those workload accounts. This is the standard IAM cross-account role pattern:

1. Create a privileged role in each destination/workload account.
2. Make that role trust the originating/operations account.
3. Give identities in the operations account permission to call `sts:AssumeRole` on those roles.

AWS documents this pattern as creating the role in the **destination account**, trusting the **originating account**, and granting originating identities permission to assume the destination role. No users are required in the destination account. See [IAM tutorial: Delegate access across AWS accounts using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html).

## Correct answers: B, D, and E

### B. Create a SysAdmin role in each workload account

This places the role in the accounts where administrative access is required. Attaching `AdministratorAccess` defines the permissions available after the role is assumed, while the role trust policy identifies the operations account as a trusted principal.

This corresponds to the destination-account role in AWS's documented cross-account access model.

### D. Create an IAM user for each operations team member in the operations account

The question states that users are centrally managed from the operations account and that no users can be created in workload accounts. Therefore, each team member needs an identity in the operations account from which to assume the workload-account roles.

Although AWS currently recommends workforce federation and temporary credentials instead of long-term IAM users where possible, IAM users are the applicable identity mechanism among the provided options. The AWS cross-account tutorial similarly uses identities in the originating account and explicitly states that users do not need to be created in the destination account.

### E. Create the SysAdmins group and permit it to assume the workload roles

The group policy must allow:

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
  "Resource": [
    "arn:aws:iam::<workload-account-1>:role/SysAdmin",
    "arn:aws:iam::<workload-account-2>:role/SysAdmin"
  ]
}
```

Adding the operations team users to this group gives them the identity-based permission required to assume each trusted workload-account role. AWS states that a policy permitting role switching must allow `sts:AssumeRole` on the target role ARN and that users can receive this permission through group membership. See [Grant permissions to switch roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_permissions-to-switch.html).

Both sides are necessary: the workload role's trust policy permits the operations account, and the operations-account group policy permits the users to invoke `sts:AssumeRole` on that role.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create the SysAdmin role in the operations account

This reverses the trust direction. The administrator role must exist in each **workload account**, because the permissions attached to an assumed role apply in the account that owns that role. A role in the operations account that trusts workload accounts would allow workload-account principals to enter the operations account, which is the opposite of the requirement.

### C. Create a Cognito identity pool and attach the SysAdmin role

Amazon Cognito identity pools are intended to issue temporary AWS credentials to **application users** through web identity federation. Cognito assumes roles using `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`, and its role trust policy uses the `cognito-identity.amazonaws.com` federated principal. That is not the IAM cross-account administration pattern described in the question. Additionally, in the enhanced Cognito authentication flow, the role must be in the same account as the identity pool. See [IAM roles for Amazon Cognito identity pools](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/iam-roles.html).

### F. Create a Cognito user pool and Cognito users

A Cognito user pool is an application user directory. Creating user-pool users does not, by itself, grant AWS IAM permissions or authorize `sts:AssumeRole` into workload accounts. Cognito identity pools would be needed to exchange application identities for AWS credentials, but that would still be a different and unnecessarily complex design from the required IAM user/group and cross-account role solution.

Therefore, the complete combination is **B + D + E**.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中拥有一个组织。该组织包括包含企业应用程序的工作负载账户。该公司从一个运营账户集中管理用户。不能在工作负载账户中创建用户。该公司最近新增了一个运营团队，必须向运营团队成员提供对每个工作负载账户的管理员访问权限。哪种操作组合可以提供此访问权限？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在运营账户中创建一个 SysAdmin 角色。将 AdministratorAccess 策略附加到该角色。修改信任关系，以允许来自工作负载账户的 sts:AssumeRole 操作。
options.B: 在每个工作负载账户中创建一个 SysAdmin 角色。将 AdministratorAccess 策略附加到该角色。修改信任关系，以允许来自运营账户的 sts:AssumeRole 操作。
options.C: 在运营账户中创建一个 Amazon Cognito 身份池。将 SysAdmin 角色附加为已验证角色。
options.D: 在运营账户中，为每位运营团队成员创建一个 IAM 用户。
options.E: 在运营账户中，创建一个名为 SysAdmins 的 IAM 用户组。添加一项 IAM 策略，该策略允许对每个工作负载账户中的 SysAdmin 角色执行 sts:AssumeRole 操作。将所有运营团队成员添加到该组。
options.F: 在运营账户中创建一个 Amazon Cognito 用户池。为每位运营团队成员创建一个 Amazon Cognito 用户。

zh.explanation:
## 问题在问什么

运营团队成员在**运营账户**中集中管理，但他们需要在多个**工作负载账户**中拥有管理员权限，且无需在这些工作负载账户中创建用户。这是标准的 IAM 跨账户角色模式：

1. 在每个目标/工作负载账户中创建一个特权角色。
2. 使该角色信任源/运营账户。
3. 授予运营账户中的身份对这些角色调用 `sts:AssumeRole` 的权限。

AWS 将此模式描述为：在**目标账户**中创建角色，信任**源账户**，并授予源身份担任目标角色的权限。无需在目标账户中创建用户。请参阅 [IAM 教程：使用 IAM 角色在 AWS 账户之间委派访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/tutorial_cross-account-with-roles.html)。

## 正确答案：B、D 和 E

### B. 在每个工作负载账户中创建一个 SysAdmin 角色

这会将角色置于需要管理访问权限的账户中。附加 `AdministratorAccess` 定义角色被担任后可用的权限，而角色信任策略会将运营账户识别为受信任主体。

这对应于 AWS 文档化跨账户访问模型中的目标账户角色。

### D. 在运营账户中，为每位运营团队成员创建一个 IAM 用户

题目说明用户由运营账户集中管理，且不能在工作负载账户中创建用户。因此，每个团队成员都需要在运营账户中拥有一个身份，以便从该身份担任工作负载账户中的角色。

尽管 AWS 当前建议尽可能使用员工联合身份验证和临时凭证，而不是长期 IAM 用户，但在提供的选项中，IAM 用户是适用的身份机制。AWS 跨账户教程同样使用源账户中的身份，并明确说明无需在目标账户中创建用户。

### E. 创建 SysAdmins 组并允许其担任工作负载角色

组策略必须允许：

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
  "Resource": [
    "arn:aws:iam::<workload-account-1>:role/SysAdmin",
    "arn:aws:iam::<workload-account-2>:role/SysAdmin"
  ]
}
```

将运营团队用户添加到此组，会授予他们担任每个受信任工作负载账户角色所需的基于身份的权限。AWS 指出，允许角色切换的策略必须允许对目标角色 ARN 执行 `sts:AssumeRole`，并且用户可以通过组成员资格获得此权限。请参阅 [授予切换角色的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_use_permissions-to-switch.html)。

两方面都必不可少：工作负载角色的信任策略允许运营账户，而运营账户的组策略允许用户对该角色调用 `sts:AssumeRole`。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 在运营账户中创建 SysAdmin 角色

这颠倒了信任方向。管理员角色必须存在于每个**工作负载账户**中，因为附加到所担任角色的权限适用于拥有该角色的账户。运营账户中的角色若信任工作负载账户，将允许工作负载账户主体进入运营账户，这与需求相反。

### C. 创建 Cognito 身份池并附加 SysAdmin 角色

Amazon Cognito 身份池旨在通过 Web 身份联合向**应用程序用户**发放临时 AWS 凭证。Cognito 使用 `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` 担任角色，其角色信任策略使用 `cognito-identity.amazonaws.com` 联合主体。这不是题目所描述的 IAM 跨账户管理模式。此外，在增强型 Cognito 身份验证流程中，角色必须与身份池位于同一个账户中。请参阅 [Amazon Cognito 身份池的 IAM 角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/iam-roles.html)。

### F. 创建 Cognito 用户池和 Cognito 用户

Cognito 用户池是一个应用程序用户目录。仅创建用户池用户本身不会授予 AWS IAM 权限，也不会授权通过 `sts:AssumeRole` 进入工作负载账户。需要 Cognito 身份池才能将应用程序身份交换为 AWS 凭证，但这仍然不同于所需的 IAM 用户/组和跨账户角色解决方案，并且会造成不必要的复杂设计。

因此，完整的组合是 **B + D + E**。

en.question: A company has multiple accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company's SecOps team needs to receive an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification if any account in the organization turns off the Block Public Access feature on an Amazon S3 bucket. A DevOps engineer must implement this change without affecting the operation of any AWS accounts. The implementation must ensure that individual member accounts in the organization cannot turn off the notification. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Designate an account to be the delegated Amazon GuardDuty administrator account. Turn on GuardDuty for all accounts across the organization. In the GuardDuty administrator account, create an SNS topic. Subscribe the SecOps team's email address to the SNS topic. In the same account, create an Amazon EventBridge rule that uses an event pattern for GuardDuty findings and a target of the SNS topic.
options.B: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that creates an SNS topic and subscribes the SecOps team’s email address to the SNS topic. In the template, include an Amazon EventBridge rule that uses an event pattern of CloudTrail activity for s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock and a target of the SNS topic. Deploy the stack to every account in the organization by using CloudFormation StackSets.
options.C: Turn on AWS Config across the organization. In the delegated administrator account, create an SNS topic. Subscribe the SecOps team's email address to the SNS topic. Deploy a conformance pack that uses the s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited AWS Config managed rule in each account and uses an AWS Systems Manager document to publish an event to the SNS topic to notify the SecOps team.
options.D: Turn on Amazon Inspector across the organization. In the Amazon Inspector delegated administrator account, create an SNS topic. Subscribe the SecOps team’s email address to the SNS topic. In the same account, create an Amazon EventBridge rule that uses an event pattern for public network exposure of the S3 bucket and publishes an event to the SNS topic to notify the SecOps team.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The company needs a **centralized, organization-wide, detective control** that sends an SNS notification when bucket-level S3 Block Public Access is disabled. The notification mechanism must remain outside the control of administrators in individual member accounts and must not prevent or otherwise disrupt account operations.

### Why A is correct

Amazon GuardDuty provides a finding specifically for this event: **`Policy:S3/BucketBlockPublicAccessDisabled`**. GuardDuty generates this finding when an IAM entity invokes an API that disables Block Public Access for an S3 bucket. The finding is based on **CloudTrail management events**, so it does **not** require GuardDuty S3 Protection, which is relevant to findings that depend on S3 data events. See [GuardDuty S3 finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_finding-types-s3.html).

Designating a GuardDuty delegated administrator and enabling GuardDuty across the organization provides the required centralized control:

- In a multi-account GuardDuty environment, an EventBridge rule in the delegated administrator account can process applicable findings generated for member accounts. The rule can send those findings to an SNS topic in the same administrator account. See [Using EventBridge with GuardDuty findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_findings_eventbridge.html).
- Under an AWS Organizations-managed administrator/member relationship, member accounts cannot suspend or disable GuardDuty or control the administrator account's EventBridge and SNS resources. See [GuardDuty administrator and member account relationships](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/administrator_member_relationships.html).
- GuardDuty is detective: it reports the disabling action but does not block the API operation, so it does not affect the normal operation of member accounts.

Option A describes a general EventBridge pattern for GuardDuty findings. That pattern includes the required finding, although in a production implementation it should be narrowed to **`Policy:S3/BucketBlockPublicAccessDisabled`** to avoid unrelated notifications.

### Why B is incorrect

This option deploys the EventBridge rule and SNS topic **inside every member account**. Although CloudFormation StackSets can deploy those resources centrally, administrators in the target accounts can still disable, alter, or delete the local EventBridge rule, SNS topic, subscription, or permissions, causing drift and silencing the notification.

It therefore does not satisfy the requirement that individual member accounts must be unable to turn off notifications. It is also unnecessarily decentralized compared with maintaining one protected notification path in the security administrator account.

### Why C is incorrect

The `s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited` AWS Config managed rule can evaluate whether an S3 bucket has the required bucket-level public-access-block settings. Organization conformance packs also protect their underlying Config rules and remediation actions from modification by member accounts. See [organization conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-pack-organization-apis.html) and [`s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited.html).

However, this option does not provide the same end-to-end protection as A:

- The Config rule evaluates the bucket's resulting compliance state, whereas GuardDuty has a finding specifically for the action of disabling bucket-level Block Public Access.
- Protecting the conformance pack does not inherently prevent a member-account administrator from stopping a customer-managed AWS Config configuration recorder. If recording is stopped, evaluations and the resulting notification can be interrupted. See [stopping an AWS Config recorder](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/managing-recorder_console-stop.html).
- A Systems Manager Automation execution in a member account would also need permission, including an appropriate cross-account SNS topic policy, to publish to a topic in the delegated administrator account. The option does not include that configuration. Systems Manager does provide an [`AWS-PublishSNSNotification` runbook](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-publishsnsnotification.html), but the runbook alone does not close these governance and permissions gaps.

Thus, C is a viable compliance-monitoring pattern, but it does not guarantee that a member account cannot interrupt the complete detection and notification path.

### Why D is incorrect

Amazon Inspector does not monitor S3 Block Public Access configuration changes. Inspector scans supported compute and software resources such as EC2 instances, ECR container images, and Lambda functions; it does not generate S3 bucket findings for disabling Block Public Access. See [Amazon Inspector resource scanning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-resources.html).

Therefore, an Inspector EventBridge rule cannot detect the required S3 configuration change.

## Conclusion

**A** meets all requirements: GuardDuty detects the exact bucket-level Block Public Access disabling action, findings from member accounts can be handled centrally through EventBridge and SNS in the delegated administrator account, member accounts cannot disable that centralized notification path, and the solution is non-disruptive.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织内拥有多个账户。如果组织中的任何账户关闭 Amazon S3 存储桶上的 Block Public Access 功能，该公司的 SecOps 团队需要收到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。DevOps 工程师必须实施此变更，且不能影响任何 AWS 账户的运行。实施必须确保组织中的各个成员账户无法关闭该通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 指定一个账户作为委派的 Amazon GuardDuty 管理员账户。为整个组织中的所有账户启用 GuardDuty。在 GuardDuty 管理员账户中，创建一个 SNS 主题。将 SecOps 团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该 SNS 主题。在同一账户中，创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，该规则使用针对 GuardDuty 发现结果的事件模式，并将 SNS 主题设为目标。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于创建 SNS 主题并将 SecOps 团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该 SNS 主题。在模板中，包含一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，该规则使用针对 `s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock` 的 CloudTrail 活动事件模式，并将 SNS 主题设为目标。使用 CloudFormation StackSets 将堆栈部署到组织中的每个账户。
options.C: 在整个组织中启用 AWS Config。在委派管理员账户中，创建一个 SNS 主题。将 SecOps 团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该 SNS 主题。在每个账户中部署一个合规性包，该合规性包使用 `s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited` AWS Config 托管规则，并使用 AWS Systems Manager 文档将事件发布到 SNS 主题，以通知 SecOps 团队。
options.D: 在整个组织中启用 Amazon Inspector。在 Amazon Inspector 委派管理员账户中，创建一个 SNS 主题。将 SecOps 团队的电子邮件地址订阅到该 SNS 主题。在同一账户中，创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，该规则使用针对 S3 存储桶公共网络暴露的事件模式，并将事件发布到 SNS 主题以通知 SecOps 团队。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

公司需要一个**集中式、组织范围的检测性控制措施**：当禁用存储桶级别的 S3 Block Public Access 时发送 SNS 通知。通知机制必须处于各成员账户管理员的控制范围之外，并且不得阻止或以其他方式干扰账户操作。

### 为什么 A 正确

Amazon GuardDuty 专门针对此事件提供了一项发现结果：**`Policy:S3/BucketBlockPublicAccessDisabled`**。当某个 IAM 实体调用 API 禁用某个 S3 存储桶的 Block Public Access 时，GuardDuty 会生成此发现结果。该发现结果基于 **CloudTrail 管理事件**，因此它**不**需要 GuardDuty S3 Protection；后者适用于依赖 S3 数据事件的发现结果。请参阅 [GuardDuty S3 finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_finding-types-s3.html)。

指定 GuardDuty 委派管理员并在整个组织中启用 GuardDuty，可提供所需的集中式控制：

- 在多账户 GuardDuty 环境中，委派管理员账户中的 EventBridge 规则可以处理为成员账户生成的适用发现结果。该规则可以将这些发现结果发送至同一管理员账户中的 SNS 主题。请参阅 [Using EventBridge with GuardDuty findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_findings_eventbridge.html)。
- 在由 AWS Organizations 管理的管理员/成员关系下，成员账户无法暂停或禁用 GuardDuty，也无法控制管理员账户的 EventBridge 和 SNS 资源。请参阅 [GuardDuty administrator and member account relationships](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/administrator_member_relationships.html)。
- GuardDuty 是检测性的：它报告禁用操作，但不会阻止 API 操作，因此不会影响成员账户的正常运行。

选项 A 描述了 GuardDuty 发现结果的通用 EventBridge 模式。该模式包含所需的发现结果，但在生产实施中，应将其缩小到 **`Policy:S3/BucketBlockPublicAccessDisabled`**，以避免无关通知。

### 为什么 B 不正确

该选项在**每个成员账户内**部署 EventBridge 规则和 SNS 主题。尽管 CloudFormation StackSets 可以集中部署这些资源，目标账户中的管理员仍然可以禁用、更改或删除本地 EventBridge 规则、SNS 主题、订阅或权限，从而造成漂移并使通知静默。

因此，它不满足各个成员账户必须无法关闭通知这一要求。与在安全管理员账户中维护一个受保护的通知路径相比，它也造成了不必要的分散化。

### 为什么 C 不正确

`s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited` AWS Config 托管规则可以评估 S3 存储桶是否具有所需的存储桶级别 public-access-block 设置。组织合规性包还能防止成员账户修改其底层 Config 规则和修复操作。请参阅 [organization conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-pack-organization-apis.html) 和 [`s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-level-public-access-prohibited.html)。

但是，该选项并未提供与 A 相同的端到端保护：

- Config 规则评估的是存储桶最终的合规状态，而 GuardDuty 针对禁用存储桶级别 Block Public Access 的操作有专门的发现结果。
- 保护合规性包本身并不能阻止成员账户管理员停止客户管理的 AWS Config 配置记录器。如果停止记录，评估和后续通知可能会中断。请参阅 [stopping an AWS Config recorder](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/managing-recorder_console-stop.html)。
- 成员账户中的 Systems Manager Automation 执行还需要获得权限（包括适当的跨账户 SNS 主题策略），才能向委派管理员账户中的主题发布消息。该选项未包含此配置。Systems Manager 确实提供 [`AWS-PublishSNSNotification` runbook](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-publishsnsnotification.html)，但仅有该运行手册并不能弥补这些治理和权限方面的缺口。

因此，C 是一种可行的合规性监控模式，但它不能保证成员账户无法中断完整的检测和通知路径。

### 为什么 D 不正确

Amazon Inspector 不监控 S3 Block Public Access 配置变更。Inspector 扫描支持的计算和软件资源，例如 EC2 实例、ECR 容器镜像和 Lambda 函数；它不会针对禁用 Block Public Access 生成 S3 存储桶发现结果。请参阅 [Amazon Inspector resource scanning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/scanning-resources.html)。

因此，Inspector EventBridge 规则无法检测所需的 S3 配置变更。

## 结论

**A** 满足所有要求：GuardDuty 可检测确切的存储桶级别 Block Public Access 禁用操作；成员账户的发现结果可以通过委派管理员账户中的 EventBridge 和 SNS 集中处理；成员账户无法禁用该集中式通知路径；并且该解决方案不会造成干扰。

en.question: A company has migrated its container-based applications to Amazon EKS and want to establish automated email notifications. The notifications sent to each email address are for specific activities related to EKS components. The solution will include Amazon SNS topics and an AWS Lambda function to evaluate incoming log events and publish messages to the correct SNS topic. Which logging solution will support these requirements?

options.A: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Logs to log the EKS components. Create a CloudWatch subscription filter for each component with Lambda as the subscription feed destination.
options.B: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Logs to log the EKS components. Create CloudWatch Logs Insights queries linked to Amazon EventBridge events that invoke Lambda.
options.C: Enable Amazon S3 logging for the EKS components. Configure an Amazon CloudWatch subscription filter for each component with Lambda as the subscription feed destination.
options.D: Enable Amazon S3 logging for the EKS components. Configure S3 PUT Object event notifications with AWS Lambda as the destination.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an event-driven logging pipeline that can:

1. Collect activity logs for Amazon EKS components.
2. Forward matching log events to a Lambda function.
3. Let Lambda inspect the events and publish each notification to the appropriate SNS topic/email subscription.

## Correct answer: A

Amazon EKS control plane logging sends the selected component log types—API server, audit, authenticator, controller manager, and scheduler—to CloudWatch Logs. AWS explicitly states that CloudWatch Logs subscription filters can be used for real-time analysis or to forward these EKS logs to other services. See [Send control plane logs to CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/control-plane-logs.html).

A CloudWatch Logs subscription filter can use a Lambda function as its destination. Matching log events are delivered to Lambda in an `awslogs` payload, where the function can decompress and evaluate the records, determine the relevant EKS activity/component, and publish to the correct SNS topic. AWS provides this exact integration pattern in [Subscription filters with AWS Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html).

Therefore, **A provides the direct, event-driven path required: EKS logs → CloudWatch Logs subscription filtering → Lambda → SNS**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. CloudWatch Logs Insights queries linked to EventBridge

CloudWatch Logs Insights is primarily a query and analysis mechanism. Although current CloudWatch Logs functionality supports **scheduled queries** whose results can be delivered to destinations such as an EventBridge event bus, these queries execute on a schedule and send query results rather than providing the direct stream of incoming log events described in the question. See [Automating log analysis with scheduled queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/ScheduledQueries.html).

A subscription filter is the purpose-built mechanism for continuously forwarding matching CloudWatch log events to Lambda, so B is unnecessarily indirect and does not match the requested incoming-log-event processing design.

### C. S3 logging with a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter

A CloudWatch Logs subscription filter is configured on a **CloudWatch Logs log group**, not on objects or logs stored in Amazon S3. Moreover, native EKS control plane logging sends enabled component logs directly to CloudWatch Logs, not to an S3 logging facility. Thus, the proposed S3 source cannot be connected to Lambda through a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter as described.

### D. S3 PUT Object notifications to Lambda

Amazon S3 can invoke Lambda for object creation events, but the option assumes a native “Amazon S3 logging for EKS components” capability. EKS control plane logging instead exports the enabled EKS component logs to CloudWatch Logs. An S3 object-created architecture would also process files after they are written rather than use the direct CloudWatch Logs event subscription designed for this requirement.

**Answer: A**

zh.question: 一家公司已将其基于容器的应用程序迁移到 Amazon EKS，并且希望建立自动化电子邮件通知。发送到每个电子邮件地址的通知针对与 EKS 组件相关的特定活动。该解决方案将包括 Amazon SNS 主题和一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于评估传入的日志事件并将消息发布到正确的 SNS 主题。哪种日志记录解决方案能够支持这些要求？
