See [cfn-init](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cfn-init.html) and [`AWS::CloudFormation::Init`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-init.html).

For running instances, configure `cfn-hup` with a hook that monitors the relevant resource metadata and reruns `cfn-init` after a metadata update. AWS states that `cfn-hup` is a daemon that detects resource metadata changes and runs user-specified actions, allowing configuration updates to running EC2 instances through a CloudFormation stack update. Its polling interval is configurable and defaults to 15 minutes. See [cfn-hup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cfn-hup.html).

Thus, **D** provides both initial configuration and automatic propagation of subsequent CloudFormation metadata changes.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. AWS Config rule plus Systems Manager Resource Data Sync

AWS Config rules evaluate whether AWS resource configurations comply with specified conditions; they do not install or distribute application configuration files to EC2 instances. Systems Manager Resource Data Sync sends collected Inventory data to a centralized S3 bucket; it does not poll CloudFormation templates and deploy files to instances. Therefore, neither component performs the required instance configuration workflow. See [AWS Config rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html) and [Systems Manager resource data sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-create-resource-data-sync.html).

### B. Put the file content in the launch template

A launch template can provide user data that invokes `cfn-init`, but `cfn-init` obtains its managed configuration from the resource's `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` metadata. Likewise, `cfn-hup` is specifically designed to detect changes in CloudFormation resource metadata. Merely placing the application file content in the launch template does not establish the required metadata-based update path for existing running instances. Launch template changes principally affect instances launched with the new template version unless another replacement or refresh mechanism is used.

### C. Launch template plus Systems Manager Resource Data Sync

This has the same launch-template limitation as B and substitutes Resource Data Sync for `cfn-hup`. Resource Data Sync aggregates Inventory data into S3; it does not detect a changed application file in a CloudFormation template and push that file to running EC2 instances. Consequently, it cannot meet the minimal-delay update requirement.

zh.question: 在 Auto Scaling 组中的一组 Amazon EC2 实例上运行的应用程序需要一个配置文件才能运行。这些实例通过 AWS CloudFormation 创建和维护。一名 DevOps 工程师希望实例在启动时拥有最新的配置文件，并且希望在更新 CloudFormation 模板时，配置文件的更改能够以最短延迟反映到所有实例上。公司策略要求应用程序配置文件与 AWS 基础设施配置文件一起在源代码控制中维护。哪种解决方案可以实现这一目标？

options.A: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，添加一个 AWS Config 规则。将配置文件内容放入该规则的 InputParameters 属性中，并将 Scope 属性设置为 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。在模板中添加一个 AWS Systems Manager Resource Data Sync 资源，以轮询配置更新。
options.B: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，添加一个 EC2 启动模板资源。将配置文件内容放入启动模板中。将 cfn-init 脚本配置为在实例启动时运行，并将 cfn-hup 脚本配置为轮询配置更新。
options.C: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，添加一个 EC2 启动模板资源。将配置文件内容放入启动模板中。在模板中添加一个 AWS Systems Manager Resource Data Sync 资源，以轮询配置更新。
options.D: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，添加 CloudFormation init 元数据。将配置文件内容放入元数据中。将 cfn-init 脚本配置为在实例启动时运行，并将 cfn-hup 脚本配置为轮询配置更新。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该解决方案必须满足三个要求：

1. 新的 Auto Scaling 实例必须在启动时获得当前的应用程序配置。
2. 现有实例必须在 CloudFormation 堆栈更新后不久获得配置更改。
3. 应用程序配置必须与 CloudFormation 基础设施定义一起存储在源代码控制中。

## 正确答案：D

将文件定义存储在 CloudFormation 模板的 `Metadata` → `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` 下。`files` 部分可以内联包含配置文件内容，因此应用程序配置会与基础设施模板一起在源代码控制中进行版本管理。

在实例启动时，用户数据可以调用 `cfn-init`。AWS 文档说明，`cfn-init` 从 `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` 键读取元数据，并且可以将文件写入磁盘。它通常从 EC2 或启动模板用户数据中调用。请参阅 [cfn-init](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cfn-init.html) 和 [`AWS::CloudFormation::Init`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-init.html)。

对于正在运行的实例，配置带有 hook 的 `cfn-hup`，使其监控相关资源元数据，并在元数据更新后重新运行 `cfn-init`。AWS 表示，`cfn-hup` 是一种守护进程，可检测资源元数据更改并运行用户指定的操作，从而能够通过 CloudFormation 堆栈更新来更新正在运行的 EC2 实例上的配置。其轮询间隔可配置，默认为 15 分钟。请参阅 [cfn-hup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cfn-hup.html)。

因此，**D** 同时提供初始配置以及对后续 CloudFormation 元数据更改的自动传播。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. AWS Config rule 加 Systems Manager Resource Data Sync

AWS Config 规则评估 AWS 资源配置是否符合指定条件；它们不会向 EC2 实例安装或分发应用程序配置文件。Systems Manager Resource Data Sync 将收集到的 Inventory 数据发送到集中式 S3 存储桶；它不会轮询 CloudFormation 模板或将文件部署到实例。因此，这两个组件都无法执行所需的实例配置工作流。请参阅 [AWS Config rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html) 和 [Systems Manager resource data sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-create-resource-data-sync.html)。

### B. 将文件内容放入启动模板

启动模板可以提供调用 `cfn-init` 的用户数据，但 `cfn-init` 从资源的 `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` 元数据获取其受管配置。同样，`cfn-hup` 专门用于检测 CloudFormation 资源元数据的更改。仅将应用程序文件内容放入启动模板，无法为现有运行实例建立所需的基于元数据的更新路径。除非使用其他替换或刷新机制，否则启动模板更改主要影响使用新模板版本启动的实例。

### C. 启动模板加 Systems Manager Resource Data Sync

该选项与 B 存在相同的启动模板限制，并使用 Resource Data Sync 替代 `cfn-hup`。Resource Data Sync 将 Inventory 数据聚合到 S3；它不会检测 CloudFormation 模板中已更改的应用程序文件并将该文件推送到正在运行的 EC2 实例。因此，它无法满足最短延迟的更新要求。

en.question: A company manages an application that stores logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The company wants to archive the logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. Logs are rarely accessed after 90 days and must be retained for 10 years. Which combination of steps should a DevOps engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to use AWS Glue to transfer all logs to an S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream all logs to an S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to stream all logs to an S3 bucket.
options.D: Configure the S3 bucket lifecycle policy to transition logs to S3 Glacier after 90 days and to expire logs after 3.650 days.
options.E: Configure the S3 bucket lifecycle policy to transition logs to Reduced Redundancy after 90 days and to expire logs after 3.650 days.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs two capabilities:

1. **Continuously archive incoming CloudWatch Logs data to Amazon S3.**
2. **Move the archived objects to low-cost archival storage after 90 days and delete them after the required 10-year retention period.**

## Correct answers: B and D

### B. Use a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter with Amazon Data Firehose

CloudWatch Logs subscription filters support destinations such as Amazon Data Firehose, Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, and OpenSearch Service. Amazon S3 is not a direct subscription-filter destination. AWS specifically documents creating a subscription filter that sends incoming log events to a Firehose delivery stream, which then writes the data to an S3 bucket. The subscription begins forwarding matching real-time log data after it is configured. See [CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html).

Therefore, **B** provides the required ongoing CloudWatch Logs-to-S3 archival pipeline.

### D. Transition the objects to S3 Glacier after 90 days and expire them after 3,650 days

S3 Lifecycle rules can transition objects to lower-cost archive storage and later expire them. AWS documents S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive as supported Lifecycle transition targets, and Lifecycle expiration can delete objects at the end of their required lifetime. See [Managing the complete lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html) and [Supported S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html).

Thus, transitioning the logs to a Glacier archival class after 90 days aligns with their rare-access pattern, and expiration after **3,650 days** provides the stated 10-year retention period.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. AWS Glue is not a CloudWatch Logs subscription-filter destination

AWS Glue is an integration, ETL, and data-catalog service. It is not one of the supported destinations for a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter. The supported destinations documented by CloudWatch Logs include Firehose, Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, and OpenSearch Service. Therefore, this subscription-filter configuration cannot be created as described.

### C. A subscription filter cannot stream directly to Amazon S3

CloudWatch Logs can export data directly to S3 by using an **export task**, but that is different from a subscription filter. An export task operates over a bounded interval specified by required `from` and `to` timestamps, as described in [CloudWatch Logs export concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/S3Export.html). For continuous delivery through a subscription filter, S3 must be reached through a supported service such as Amazon Data Firehose. Therefore, **C** describes an unsupported direct subscription destination.

### E. Reduced Redundancy Storage is not the appropriate Lifecycle archive target

Reduced Redundancy Storage is not listed among the supported S3 Lifecycle transition targets. More importantly, it is not an archival class designed for rarely accessed data that must be retained for ten years. The supported archive-oriented targets include S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval and S3 Glacier Deep Archive. Therefore, **D**, not **E**, satisfies the long-term archival requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司管理着一个将日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的应用程序。该公司希望将日志归档到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。日志在 90 天后很少被访问，并且必须保留 10 年。DevOps 工程师应采取哪种步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 配置 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器，以使用 AWS Glue 将所有日志传输到 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 配置 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器，以使用 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 将所有日志流式传输到 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 配置 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器，将所有日志流式传输到 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 配置 S3 存储桶生命周期策略，在 90 天后将日志转换到 S3 Glacier，并在 3,650 天后使日志过期。
options.E: 配置 S3 存储桶生命周期策略，在 90 天后将日志转换到 Reduced Redundancy，并在 3,650 天后使日志过期。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要两项能力：

1. **持续将传入的 CloudWatch Logs 数据归档到 Amazon S3。**
2. **在 90 天后将已归档的对象转移到低成本归档存储，并在所需的 10 年保留期后删除它们。**

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B. 将 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器与 Amazon Data Firehose 配合使用

CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器支持 Amazon Data Firehose、Kinesis Data Streams、Lambda 和 OpenSearch Service 等目标。Amazon S3 不是订阅筛选器的直接目标。AWS 专门说明了如何创建一个订阅筛选器，将传入的日志事件发送到 Firehose 传输流，后者随后将数据写入 S3 存储桶。配置完成后，订阅会开始转发匹配的实时日志数据。请参阅 [CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)。

因此，**B** 提供了所需的持续 CloudWatch Logs 到 S3 的归档管道。

### D. 在 90 天后将对象转换到 S3 Glacier，并在 3,650 天后使其过期

S3 Lifecycle 规则可以将对象转换到成本更低的归档存储，并在之后使其过期。AWS 文档说明，S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 和 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 是受支持的 Lifecycle 转换目标，并且 Lifecycle 过期操作可以在对象所需生命周期结束时将其删除。请参阅 [Managing the complete lifecycle of objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html) 和 [Supported S3 Lifecycle transitions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/lifecycle-transition-general-considerations.html)。

因此，在 90 天后将日志转换到 Glacier 归档存储类别符合其低访问频率的模式，而在 **3,650 天**后使其过期则提供了题目所述的 10 年保留期。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. AWS Glue 不是 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器的目标

AWS Glue 是一项集成、ETL 和数据目录服务。它不是 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器支持的目标之一。CloudWatch Logs 文档中列出的支持目标包括 Firehose、Kinesis Data Streams、Lambda 和 OpenSearch Service。因此，无法按所述方式创建此订阅筛选器配置。

### C. 订阅筛选器不能直接流式传输到 Amazon S3

CloudWatch Logs 可以使用 **export task** 将数据直接导出到 S3，但这与订阅筛选器不同。export task 会在由必需的 `from` 和 `to` 时间戳指定的有限时间范围内运行，如 [CloudWatch Logs export concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/S3Export.html) 中所述。若要通过订阅筛选器进行持续传输，必须通过 Amazon Data Firehose 等受支持的服务访问 S3。因此，**C** 描述了不受支持的直接订阅目标。

### E. Reduced Redundancy Storage 不是合适的 Lifecycle 归档目标

Reduced Redundancy Storage 未列在受支持的 S3 Lifecycle 转换目标中。更重要的是，它并非专为必须保留十年且很少访问的数据而设计的归档存储类别。受支持的面向归档的目标包括 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 和 S3 Glacier Deep Archive。因此，满足长期归档要求的是 **D**，而不是 **E**。

en.question: A company is developing a new application. The application uses AWS Lambda functions for its compute tier. The company must use a canary deployment for any changes to the Lambda functions. Automated rollback must occur if any failures are reported. The company’s DevOps team needs to create the infrastructure as code (IaC) and the CI/CD pipeline for this solution. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS CloudFormation template for the application. Define each Lambda function in the template by using the AWS::Lambda::Function resource type. In the template, include a version for the Lambda function by using the AWS::Lambda::Version resource type. Declare the CodeSha256 property. Configure an AWS::Lambda::Alias resource that references the latest version of the Lambda function.
options.B: Create an AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template for the application. Define each Lambda function in the template by using the AWS::Serverless::Function resource type. For each function, include configurations for the AutoPublishAlias property and the DeploymentPreference property. Configure the deployment configuration type to LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes.
options.C: Create an AWS CodeCommit repository. Create an AWS CodePipeline pipeline. Use the CodeCommit repository in a new source stage that starts the pipeline. Create an AWS CodeBuild project to deploy the AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) template. Upload the template and source code to the CodeCommit repository. In the CodeCommit repository, create a buildspec.yml file that includes the commands to build and deploy the SAM application.
options.D: Create an AWS CodeCommit repository. Create an AWS CodePipeline pipeline. Use the CodeCommit repository in a new source stage that starts the pipeline. Create an AWS CodeDeploy deployment group that is configured for canary deployments with a DeploymentPreference type of Canary10Percent10Minutes. Upload the AWS CloudFormation template and source code to the CodeCommit repository. In the CodeCommit repository, create an appspec.yml file that includes the commands to deploy the CloudFormation template.
options.E: Create an Amazon CloudWatch composite alarm for all the Lambda functions. Configure an evaluation period and dimensions for Lambda. Configure the alarm to enter the ALARM state if any errors are detected or if there is insufficient data.
options.F: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for each Lambda function. Configure the alarms to enter the ALARM state if any errors are detected. Configure an evaluation period, dimensions for each Lambda function and version, and the namespace as AWS/Lambda on the Errors metric.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The solution needs three coordinated parts:

1. **IaC that creates versioned Lambda deployments and shifts traffic by canary**.
2. **A CI/CD pipeline that builds and deploys that IaC and the function code**.
3. **CloudWatch metric alarms that CodeDeploy can use to initiate an automatic rollback**.

## Correct answers: B, C, and F

### B — Use AWS SAM with `AutoPublishAlias` and `DeploymentPreference`

This is the intended IaC mechanism for safe Lambda deployments. `AutoPublishAlias` publishes a new function version and manages an alias. `DeploymentPreference` causes AWS SAM to create the necessary CodeDeploy resources and implement gradual traffic shifting. AWS states that SAM can automatically roll back a deployment when a configured CloudWatch alarm is triggered. A 10%-for-10-minutes canary sends 10% of traffic to the new version and then shifts the remaining traffic after 10 minutes if the deployment remains healthy.

See [Deploying serverless applications gradually with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/automating-updates-to-serverless-apps.html) and [Lambda rolling deployments with weighted aliases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html).

**Terminology caveat:** The current AWS SAM value is `Canary10Percent10Minutes`, not `LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes`. The corresponding native CodeDeploy configuration is `CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes`, as documented in [CodeDeploy deployment configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-configurations.html). Thus, B is correct by clear architectural intent, but its literal property value is imprecise.

### C — Use CodePipeline and CodeBuild to build and deploy the SAM application

The repository provides the source artifact and starts the pipeline. CodeBuild can run the SAM CLI commands in `buildspec.yml` to build and deploy the application. AWS's documented pattern specifically shows `sam build` and `sam deploy` in a CodeBuild build specification for a CodePipeline-based SAM deployment.

See [Using AWS CodePipeline to deploy with AWS SAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/deploying-using-codepipeline.html).

### F — Create Lambda `Errors` metric alarms at the required function/version scope

Lambda publishes metrics in the `AWS/Lambda` namespace. The `Errors` metric counts invocations that result in function or runtime errors. Lambda metrics can be scoped by function, resource such as a version or alias, or executed version. The `ExecutedVersion` dimension is particularly useful when comparing error rates between versions behind a weighted alias.

These metric alarms can be referenced by the SAM `DeploymentPreference.Alarms` configuration. When an alarm breaches during traffic shifting, CodeDeploy rolls the deployment back.

See [Types of metrics for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-metrics-types.html) and [Viewing metrics for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-metrics-view.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A — A normal alias pointing only to the latest version does not implement a canary

An `AWS::Lambda::Version` and an alias are useful building blocks, but the described alias simply points to the latest version. Canary routing requires a **weighted alias containing two published versions and an additional-version traffic weight**, or orchestration through CodeDeploy/SAM. A also provides no CodeDeploy deployment group, traffic-shifting schedule, monitored alarms, or rollback configuration.

The weighted-alias requirements are shown in [Lambda rolling deployments with weighted aliases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html).

### D — It mixes SAM terminology with native CodeDeploy and misuses the AppSpec file

Native CodeDeploy does support Lambda canary deployment configurations, but a CodeDeploy deployment group does not use a SAM `DeploymentPreference` property. It uses a deployment configuration such as `CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes`.

More importantly, a Lambda AppSpec file does **not** contain commands that deploy a CloudFormation template. It identifies the Lambda function version to deploy and optional validation hooks. Native CodeDeploy would also require the appropriate application revision and rollback/alarm configuration. The option therefore does not describe a valid end-to-end IaC deployment process.

See [Deployments on an AWS Lambda compute platform](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-steps-lambda.html) and [AppSpec file structure for AWS Lambda deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure.html).

### E — A composite alarm cannot directly monitor Lambda metric dimensions

A composite alarm determines its state from the states of **other alarms** by using Boolean rules. It does not directly configure an evaluation period, Lambda dimensions, and the `Errors` metric as described. The underlying per-function or per-version metric alarms are still required. In addition, treating insufficient data as a deployment failure can cause rollbacks when a low-traffic canary simply has no data.

See [CloudWatch composite alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html).

## Final answer

**B, C, F** — with B understood to use the valid AWS SAM type `Canary10Percent10Minutes` and with the alarms from F referenced in `DeploymentPreference.Alarms`.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个新应用程序。该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数作为其计算层。公司必须对 Lambda 函数的任何更改使用金丝雀部署。如果报告任何故障，必须自动回滚。公司的 DevOps 团队需要为此解决方案创建基础设施即代码（IaC）和 CI/CD 管道。哪种步骤组合将满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为应用程序创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板。使用 AWS::Lambda::Function 资源类型在模板中定义每个 Lambda 函数。在模板中，使用 AWS::Lambda::Version 资源类型为 Lambda 函数包含一个版本。声明 CodeSha256 属性。配置一个引用 Lambda 函数最新版本的 AWS::Lambda::Alias 资源。
options.B: 为应用程序创建一个 AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) 模板。使用 AWS::Serverless::Function 资源类型在模板中定义每个 Lambda 函数。对于每个函数，包含 AutoPublishAlias 属性和 DeploymentPreference 属性的配置。将部署配置类型设置为 LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 存储库。创建一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道。在一个启动该管道的新源阶段中使用 CodeCommit 存储库。创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目来部署 AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) 模板。将模板和源代码上传到 CodeCommit 存储库。在 CodeCommit 存储库中，创建一个包含用于构建和部署 SAM 应用程序命令的 buildspec.yml 文件。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 存储库。创建一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道。在一个启动该管道的新源阶段中使用 CodeCommit 存储库。创建一个 AWS CodeDeploy 部署组，并将其配置为使用 DeploymentPreference 类型为 Canary10Percent10Minutes 的金丝雀部署。将 AWS CloudFormation 模板和源代码上传到 CodeCommit 存储库。在 CodeCommit 存储库中，创建一个包含用于部署 CloudFormation 模板命令的 appspec.yml 文件。
options.E: 为所有 Lambda 函数创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 复合告警。为 Lambda 配置评估周期和维度。如果检测到任何错误或数据不足，则将告警配置为进入 ALARM 状态。
options.F: 为每个 Lambda 函数创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 告警。将告警配置为在检测到任何错误时进入 ALARM 状态。为每个 Lambda 函数和版本配置评估周期、维度，并将 Errors 指标的命名空间配置为 AWS/Lambda。

zh.explanation:
## 问题要求

该解决方案需要三个协同部分：

1. **创建带版本 Lambda 部署并通过金丝雀方式转移流量的 IaC**。
2. **用于构建和部署该 IaC 及函数代码的 CI/CD 管道**。
3. **CodeDeploy 可用于启动自动回滚的 CloudWatch 指标告警**。

## 正确答案：B、C 和 F

### B — 使用带有 `AutoPublishAlias` 和 `DeploymentPreference` 的 AWS SAM

这是实现安全 Lambda 部署的预期 IaC 机制。`AutoPublishAlias` 会发布新的函数版本并管理别名。`DeploymentPreference` 会使 AWS SAM 创建所需的 CodeDeploy 资源并实施渐进式流量转移。AWS 表示，在配置的 CloudWatch 告警被触发时，SAM 可以自动回滚部署。10%-持续 10 分钟的金丝雀部署会将 10% 的流量发送到新版本；如果部署保持正常，则在 10 分钟后转移剩余流量。

请参阅 [使用 AWS SAM 逐步部署无服务器应用程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/automating-updates-to-serverless-apps.html) 和 [使用加权别名进行 Lambda 滚动部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html)。

**术语注意事项：**当前 AWS SAM 值为 `Canary10Percent10Minutes`，而不是 `LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes`。如 [CodeDeploy 部署配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-configurations.html) 所述，对应的原生 CodeDeploy 配置为 `CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes`。因此，B 在清晰的架构意图上是正确的，但其字面属性值不够准确。

### C — 使用 CodePipeline 和 CodeBuild 构建及部署 SAM 应用程序

该存储库提供源构件并启动管道。CodeBuild 可以在 `buildspec.yml` 中运行 SAM CLI 命令，以构建和部署应用程序。AWS 的文档化模式专门展示了在基于 CodePipeline 的 SAM 部署中，在 CodeBuild 构建规范内使用 `sam build` 和 `sam deploy`。

请参阅 [使用 AWS CodePipeline 通过 AWS SAM 部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/serverless-application-model/latest/developerguide/deploying-using-codepipeline.html)。

### F — 在所需的函数/版本范围创建 Lambda `Errors` 指标告警

Lambda 会在 `AWS/Lambda` 命名空间中发布指标。`Errors` 指标统计导致函数或运行时错误的调用。Lambda 指标可以按函数、版本或别名等资源，或者按已执行版本划分范围。在比较加权别名后各版本之间的错误率时，`ExecutedVersion` 维度尤其有用。

可以在 SAM 的 `DeploymentPreference.Alarms` 配置中引用这些指标告警。当流量转移期间发生告警违规时，CodeDeploy 会回滚部署。

请参阅 [Lambda 函数的指标类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-metrics-types.html) 和 [查看 Lambda 函数的指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/monitoring-metrics-view.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A — 仅指向最新版本的普通别名不能实现金丝雀部署

`AWS::Lambda::Version` 和别名是有用的构建模块，但所描述的别名仅指向最新版本。金丝雀路由需要一个**包含两个已发布版本以及额外版本流量权重的加权别名**，或者通过 CodeDeploy/SAM 进行编排。A 也未提供 CodeDeploy 部署组、流量转移计划、监控告警或回滚配置。

[使用加权别名进行 Lambda 滚动部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuring-alias-routing.html) 中展示了加权别名的要求。

### D — 它混合了 SAM 术语和原生 CodeDeploy，并且错误使用了 AppSpec 文件

原生 CodeDeploy 确实支持 Lambda 金丝雀部署配置，但 CodeDeploy 部署组不使用 SAM 的 `DeploymentPreference` 属性。它使用诸如 `CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent10Minutes` 的部署配置。

更重要的是，Lambda AppSpec 文件并不包含用于部署 CloudFormation 模板的命令。它用于标识要部署的 Lambda 函数版本以及可选的验证挂钩。原生 CodeDeploy 还需要适当的应用程序修订版本以及回滚/告警配置。因此，该选项没有描述有效的端到端 IaC 部署流程。

请参阅 [在 AWS Lambda 计算平台上进行部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-steps-lambda.html) 和 [AWS Lambda 部署的 AppSpec 文件结构](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure.html)。

### E — 复合告警无法直接监控 Lambda 指标维度

复合告警通过使用布尔规则，根据**其他告警**的状态确定自身状态。它无法像描述中那样直接配置评估周期、Lambda 维度和 `Errors` 指标。仍然需要底层的每函数或每版本指标告警。此外，将数据不足视为部署失败，可能会在低流量金丝雀部署仅仅没有数据时导致回滚。

请参阅 [CloudWatch 复合告警](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html)。

## 最终答案

**B、C、F** — 其中 B 应理解为使用有效的 AWS SAM 类型 `Canary10Percent10Minutes`，并且 F 中的告警应在 `DeploymentPreference.Alarms` 中被引用。

en.question: A DevOps engineer is deploying a new version of a company’s application in an AWS CodeDeploy deployment group associated with its Amazon EC2 instances. After some time, the deployment fails. The engineer realizes that all the events associated with the specific deployment ID are in a Skipped status, and code was not deployed in the instances associated with the deployment group. What are valid reasons for this failure? (Choose two.)

options.A: The networking configuration does not allow the EC2 instances to reach the internet via a NAT gateway or internet gateway, and the CodeDeploy endpoint cannot be reached.
options.B: The IAM user who triggered the application deployment does not have permission to interact with the CodeDeploy endpoint.
options.C: The target EC2 instances were not properly registered with the CodeDeploy endpoint.
options.D: An instance profile with proper permissions was not attached to the target EC2 instances.
options.E: The appspec.yml file was not included in the application revision.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The key symptom is not merely a generic deployment failure: **all lifecycle events for the EC2 deployment are shown as `Skipped`**, and none of the target instances receives the revision. This points to a problem that prevents the CodeDeploy agent from communicating with CodeDeploy or obtaining the credentials/resources needed to begin processing the deployment.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. The instances cannot reach the CodeDeploy endpoint

This is a documented cause of all lifecycle events being skipped. The CodeDeploy agent on each target instance must be able to communicate with the regional CodeDeploy endpoint over HTTPS. AWS specifically recommends internet access through a public IP/internet gateway for a public subnet or a NAT gateway for an instance in a private subnet. If the endpoint cannot be reached, the agent cannot receive and process deployment commands, so the lifecycle events can all remain skipped.

AWS lists inability to reach the CodeDeploy or Amazon S3 public endpoint on port 443 as a possible cause in [Troubleshooting all lifecycle events skipped errors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html).

### D. The required IAM instance profile is missing or improperly configured

The target EC2 instances need an attached IAM instance profile with the permissions required to retrieve the application revision and participate in the deployment. AWS explicitly lists both of these conditions as causes of all lifecycle events being skipped:

- No IAM instance profile is attached.
- An instance profile is attached but lacks the required permissions.

This is also documented in [Troubleshooting all lifecycle events skipped errors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. The initiating IAM user lacks CodeDeploy permissions

An IAM identity needs permissions such as `codedeploy:CreateDeployment` to create a deployment, as shown in the [CodeDeploy permissions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/auth-and-access-control-permissions-reference.html). However, if the caller lacked permission to invoke the required CodeDeploy API, the request would be rejected during authorization. It would not normally create a deployment ID that later shows every instance lifecycle event as skipped. The observed symptom concerns the target instances and their agents, not authorization of the original caller.

### C. The EC2 instances were not registered with the CodeDeploy endpoint

EC2 instances are not manually registered with CodeDeploy in the manner implied by this option. CodeDeploy identifies EC2 deployment targets through EC2 tags or named Auto Scaling groups. The [CodeDeploy instance-tagging documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/instances-tagging.html) states that instances matching the deployment group's tag criteria receive the application revision. Manual CodeDeploy registration is relevant to on-premises instances, not normal EC2 deployment targets.

A missing or stopped **CodeDeploy agent** could produce this symptom, but that is different from saying the EC2 instance was not registered with a CodeDeploy endpoint.

### E. The `appspec.yml` file was omitted

An EC2/On-Premises revision does require an AppSpec file. Without it, CodeDeploy cannot map revision files to destinations or execute deployment scripts, as explained in [Add an AppSpec file for an EC2/On-Premises deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/application-revisions-appspec-file.html). That is an invalid application revision/deployment-content problem, however, rather than either of the documented target-instance causes represented by the specific **all lifecycle events skipped** troubleshooting pattern. Options A and D directly match AWS's documented causes for that symptom.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在与公司 Amazon EC2 实例关联的 AWS CodeDeploy 部署组中部署公司应用程序的新版本。一段时间后，部署失败。该工程师发现，与特定部署 ID 关联的所有事件均处于 `Skipped` 状态，并且代码未部署到与该部署组关联的实例中。此失败的有效原因是什么？（选择两项。）

options.A: 网络配置不允许 EC2 实例通过 NAT gateway 或 internet gateway 访问互联网，并且无法访问 CodeDeploy endpoint。
options.B: 触发应用程序部署的 IAM 用户没有与 CodeDeploy endpoint 交互的权限。
options.C: 目标 EC2 实例未正确注册到 CodeDeploy endpoint。
options.D: 未将具有适当权限的 instance profile 附加到目标 EC2 实例。
options.E: 应用程序修订版本中未包含 appspec.yml 文件。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查内容

关键症状并不只是一般性的部署失败：**EC2 部署的所有生命周期事件均显示为 `Skipped`**，并且没有任何目标实例收到修订版本。这表明存在某个问题，导致 CodeDeploy agent 无法与 CodeDeploy 通信，或无法获取开始处理部署所需的凭证/资源。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 实例无法访问 CodeDeploy endpoint

这是所有生命周期事件被跳过的一个已记录原因。每个目标实例上的 CodeDeploy agent 必须能够通过 HTTPS 与区域性 CodeDeploy endpoint 通信。AWS 特别建议：对于公有子网，通过 public IP/internet gateway 访问互联网；对于私有子网中的实例，则通过 NAT gateway 访问互联网。如果无法访问 endpoint，agent 就无法接收和处理部署命令，因此所有生命周期事件都可能保持为 skipped。

AWS 在 [Troubleshooting all lifecycle events skipped errors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html) 中将无法通过端口 443 访问 CodeDeploy 或 Amazon S3 public endpoint 列为可能原因。

### D. 缺少必需的 IAM instance profile，或者其配置不正确

目标 EC2 实例需要附加 IAM instance profile，并具有检索应用程序修订版本和参与部署所需的权限。AWS 明确将以下两种情况列为所有生命周期事件被跳过的原因：

- 未附加 IAM instance profile。
- 已附加 instance profile，但缺少所需权限。

这同样记录在 [Troubleshooting all lifecycle events skipped errors](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html) 中。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 发起部署的 IAM 用户缺少 CodeDeploy 权限

IAM 身份需要 `codedeploy:CreateDeployment` 等权限才能创建部署，如 [CodeDeploy permissions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/auth-and-access-control-permissions-reference.html) 所示。但是，如果调用者没有调用所需 CodeDeploy API 的权限，请求会在授权期间被拒绝。通常不会创建一个部署 ID，然后其每个实例生命周期事件均显示为 skipped。观察到的症状涉及目标实例及其 agent，而不是原始调用者的授权问题。

### C. EC2 实例未注册到 CodeDeploy endpoint

EC2 实例不会以此选项暗示的方式手动注册到 CodeDeploy。CodeDeploy 通过 EC2 tags 或指定的 Auto Scaling groups 识别 EC2 部署目标。[CodeDeploy instance-tagging documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/instances-tagging.html) 指出，符合部署组标签条件的实例会接收应用程序修订版本。手动 CodeDeploy 注册与 on-premises 实例有关，而不适用于普通 EC2 部署目标。

未安装或已停止的 **CodeDeploy agent** 可能产生此症状，但这不同于说 EC2 实例未注册到 CodeDeploy endpoint。

### E. 未包含 `appspec.yml` 文件

EC2/On-Premises 修订版本确实需要 AppSpec 文件。没有该文件，CodeDeploy 无法将修订版本文件映射到目标位置，也无法执行部署脚本，如 [Add an AppSpec file for an EC2/On-Premises deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/application-revisions-appspec-file.html) 所述。但是，这是无效应用程序修订版本/部署内容的问题，而不是由特定的 **all lifecycle events skipped** 故障排查模式所代表的两种已记录目标实例原因。选项 A 和 D 直接对应 AWS 为该症状记录的原因。

en.question: A company has a guideline that every Amazon EC2 instance must be launched from an AMI that the company’s security team produces. Every month, the security team sends an email message with the latest approved AMIs to all the development teams. The development teams use AWS CloudFormation to deploy their applications. When developers launch a new service, they have to search their email for the latest AMIs that the security department sent. A DevOps engineer wants to automate the process that the security team uses to provide the AMI IDs to the development teams. What is the MOST scalable solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Direct the security team to use CloudFormation to create new versions of the AMIs and to list the AMI ARNs in an encrypted Amazon S3 object as part of the stack’s Outputs section. Instruct the developers to use a cross-stack reference to load the encrypted S3 object and obtain the most recent AMI ARNs.
options.B: Direct the security team to use a CloudFormation stack to create an AWS CodePipeline pipeline that builds new AMIs and places the latest AMI ARNs in an encrypted Amazon S3 object as part of the pipeline output. Instruct the developers to use a cross-stack reference within their own CloudFormation template to obtain the S3 object location and the most recent AMI ARNs.
options.C: Direct the security team to use Amazon EC2 Image Builder to create new AMIs and to place the AMI ARNs as parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Instruct the developers to specify a parameter of type SSM in their CloudFormation stack to obtain the most recent AMI ARNs from Parameter Store.
options.D: Direct the security team to use Amazon EC2 Image Builder to create new AMIs and to create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic so that every development team can receive notifications. When the development teams receive a notification, instruct them to write an AWS Lambda function that will update their CloudFormation stack with the most recent AMI ARNs.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs a centralized, automated way to publish the current security-approved AMI so that every development team can consume it directly from CloudFormation without searching email or maintaining team-specific automation.

## Correct answer: C

**Amazon EC2 Image Builder + Systems Manager Parameter Store + a CloudFormation SSM parameter type** is the most scalable solution.

EC2 Image Builder is purpose-built to automate the creation and distribution of standardized AMIs. Its distribution configuration can store the output AMI ID directly in an SSM Parameter Store parameter and update that parameter when a new image is produced. AWS documents an `ssmParameterConfigurations` setting specifically for storing the output AMI ID, including the `aws:ec2:image` data type for validation: [Create an AMI distribution configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/cr-upd-ami-distribution-settings.html).

Development teams can then define a CloudFormation parameter such as:

```yaml
Parameters:
  ApprovedAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /company/approved-ami
```

CloudFormation resolves the Parameter Store key to its AMI ID when a stack is created or updated. AWS provides this exact AMI lookup pattern in the CloudFormation documentation: [CloudFormation-supplied parameter types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cloudformation-supplied-parameter-types.html).

This establishes one centrally managed parameter name for all teams. Image Builder updates its value, and developers continue referencing the same key. CloudFormation retrieves the latest stored value during subsequent stack creation or update operations. The option says “AMI ARNs,” but the value used for an EC2 resource's `ImageId` is an **AMI ID** such as `ami-...`; the intended architecture in C is nevertheless clear.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

CloudFormation cross-stack references import exported **output values**; they do not read and parse the contents of an encrypted S3 object. At most, a stack could export the bucket/key location, after which additional custom processing would be required to retrieve the AMI ID.

Cross-stack exports also introduce tight coupling: after another stack imports an exported value, the exporting stack cannot modify that value until all imports are removed. They are also limited by account and Region constraints. These restrictions make frequently changing approved-AMI values a poor fit for cross-stack exports: [CloudFormation cross-stack reference considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-exports.html).

Additionally, CloudFormation is not itself the specialized managed image-pipeline service that Image Builder is.

### B

Although CodePipeline could orchestrate a custom AMI-building workflow, this option is unnecessarily complex compared with EC2 Image Builder's native image pipeline and native SSM output parameter support.

It also has the same architectural error as A: a cross-stack reference can import the exported S3 object location, but it cannot retrieve or parse the latest AMI ID from the object's contents. Extra Lambda/custom-resource logic and S3 permissions would be required. That is less scalable and more operationally burdensome than publishing the AMI ID directly to Parameter Store.

### D

SNS is useful for notifications, but notification delivery does not provide CloudFormation with a centrally resolvable AMI ID. Requiring every development team to create and maintain a Lambda function that updates its stacks duplicates automation across teams, increases permissions and operational overhead, and tightly couples image publication to numerous stack-update workflows.

By contrast, C lets all teams use the same stable Parameter Store key, with Image Builder updating the value centrally. Teams obtain the current value whenever they create or update their CloudFormation stacks.

zh.question: 一家公司规定，每个 Amazon EC2 实例都必须从该公司安全团队制作的 AMI 启动。每个月，安全团队都会向所有开发团队发送一封电子邮件，其中包含最新获批的 AMI。开发团队使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署其应用程序。当开发人员启动一项新服务时，他们必须在电子邮件中搜索安全部门发送的最新 AMI。一名 DevOps 工程师希望自动化安全团队向开发团队提供 AMI ID 的流程。哪种解决方案最具可扩展性并且满足这些要求？

options.A: 要求安全团队使用 CloudFormation 创建 AMI 的新版本，并在堆栈的 Outputs 部分中将 AMI ARN 列在加密的 Amazon S3 对象中。指示开发人员使用跨堆栈引用加载加密的 S3 对象，并获取最新的 AMI ARN。
options.B: 要求安全团队使用 CloudFormation 堆栈创建一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道，该管道构建新的 AMI，并将最新 AMI ARN 作为管道输出的一部分放入加密的 Amazon S3 对象中。指示开发人员在其自己的 CloudFormation 模板中使用跨堆栈引用，以获取 S3 对象位置和最新的 AMI ARN。
options.C: 要求安全团队使用 Amazon EC2 Image Builder 创建新的 AMI，并将 AMI ARN 作为参数存储在 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中。指示开发人员在其 CloudFormation 堆栈中指定类型为 SSM 的参数，以从 Parameter Store 获取最新的 AMI ARN。
options.D: 要求安全团队使用 Amazon EC2 Image Builder 创建新的 AMI，并创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便每个开发团队都能收到通知。当开发团队收到通知时，指示他们编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用最新的 AMI ARN 更新其 CloudFormation 堆栈。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

公司需要一种集中式、自动化的方法来发布当前经安全批准的 AMI，以便每个开发团队都可以直接从 CloudFormation 使用它，而无需搜索电子邮件或维护特定于团队的自动化流程。

## 正确答案：C

**Amazon EC2 Image Builder + Systems Manager Parameter Store + CloudFormation SSM 参数类型** 是最具可扩展性的解决方案。

EC2 Image Builder 专门用于自动创建和分发标准化 AMI。其分发配置可以将输出 AMI ID 直接存储到 SSM Parameter Store 参数中，并在生成新镜像时更新该参数。AWS 在文档中专门提供了用于存储输出 AMI ID 的 `ssmParameterConfigurations` 设置，其中包括用于验证的 `aws:ec2:image` 数据类型：[创建 AMI 分发配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/cr-upd-ami-distribution-settings.html)。

随后，开发团队可以定义如下 CloudFormation 参数：

```yaml
Parameters:
  ApprovedAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /company/approved-ami
```

在创建或更新堆栈时，CloudFormation 会将 Parameter Store 键解析为其 AMI ID。AWS 在 CloudFormation 文档中提供了这一完全相同的 AMI 查找模式：[CloudFormation 提供的参数类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/cloudformation-supplied-parameter-types.html)。

这为所有团队建立了一个集中管理的参数名称。Image Builder 更新其值，而开发人员持续引用相同的键。CloudFormation 会在后续创建或更新堆栈的操作期间检索最新存储的值。选项中写的是“AMI ARN”，但 EC2 资源的 `ImageId` 所使用的值是类似 `ami-...` 的 **AMI ID**；不过，C 中预期的架构仍然很明确。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A

CloudFormation 跨堆栈引用导入的是已导出的**输出值**；它们不会读取和解析加密 S3 对象的内容。堆栈最多只能导出存储桶/键位置，之后还需要额外的自定义处理来检索 AMI ID。

跨堆栈导出还会引入紧密耦合：当另一个堆栈导入某个导出的值后，在移除所有导入之前，导出该值的堆栈无法修改这个值。它们还受账户和 Region 限制。由于这些限制，频繁更改的获批 AMI 值并不适合使用跨堆栈导出：[CloudFormation 跨堆栈引用注意事项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-exports.html)。

此外，CloudFormation 本身并不是像 Image Builder 那样专门的托管镜像管道服务。

### B

尽管 CodePipeline 可以编排自定义 AMI 构建工作流，但与 EC2 Image Builder 的原生镜像管道和原生 SSM 输出参数支持相比，该选项过于复杂。

它还存在与 A 相同的架构错误：跨堆栈引用可以导入已导出的 S3 对象位置，但无法从对象内容中检索或解析最新 AMI ID。需要额外的 Lambda/自定义资源逻辑和 S3 权限。这比直接将 AMI ID 发布到 Parameter Store 的可扩展性更差，运维负担也更重。

### D

SNS 可用于发送通知，但通知投递并不会为 CloudFormation 提供可集中解析的 AMI ID。要求每个开发团队创建和维护用于更新其堆栈的 Lambda 函数，会在团队之间重复自动化工作，增加权限与运维开销，并使镜像发布与大量堆栈更新工作流紧密耦合。

相比之下，C 让所有团队使用相同且稳定的 Parameter Store 键，并由 Image Builder 集中更新其值。团队在创建或更新其 CloudFormation 堆栈时即可获取当前值。

en.question: An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A DevOps engineer is using AWS CodeDeploy to release a new version. The deployment fails during the AllowTraffic lifecycle event, but a cause for the failure is not indicated in the deployment logs. What would cause this?

options.A: The appspec.yml file contains an invalid script that runs in the AllowTraffic lifecycle hook.
options.B: The user who initiated the deployment does not have the necessary permissions to interact with the ALB.
options.C: The health checks specified for the ALB target group are misconfigured.
options.D: The CodeDeploy agent was not installed in the EC2 instances that are part of the ALB target group.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The deployment reaches the CodeDeploy-managed `AllowTraffic` event, where the newly deployed EC2 instances are registered with the load balancer and made available to receive traffic. The key diagnostic detail is that the deployment fails specifically at `AllowTraffic` **without an error in the deployment logs**.

## Correct answer: C. The health checks specified for the ALB target group are misconfigured.

AWS documents this exact symptom: when an EC2 blue/green deployment fails during `AllowTraffic` and the deployment logs do not report the cause, the failure is typically caused by incorrectly configured Elastic Load Balancing health checks. For an ALB, these are the health checks configured on the target group. If the replacement instances do not pass them, CodeDeploy cannot successfully complete traffic routing. See [Troubleshooting CodeDeploy deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. The AppSpec file contains an invalid script that runs in the `AllowTraffic` lifecycle hook.**  
  `AllowTraffic` is reserved for CodeDeploy operations and **cannot be used to run an AppSpec script**. User scripts can instead be associated with hooks such as `BeforeAllowTraffic` or `AfterAllowTraffic`. Therefore, an invalid user script cannot run in `AllowTraffic` as the option describes. See [AppSpec hooks for EC2/On-Premises deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-hooks.html).

- **B. The user who initiated the deployment does not have the necessary permissions to interact with the ALB.**  
  CodeDeploy uses its **service role** to perform operations on Elastic Load Balancing resources. The initiating principal needs permission to request the CodeDeploy operation, but CodeDeploy's load-balancer interactions during the deployment are performed through the configured service role. Also, the deployment has already started and reached `AllowTraffic`, making missing initiator permission inconsistent with this specific documented symptom. See [CodeDeploy service role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/primary-components.html).

- **D. The CodeDeploy agent was not installed on the EC2 instances in the target group.**  
  A missing or stopped agent generally prevents instance-level deployment lifecycle processing and can result in skipped lifecycle events or health-constraint failures; it does not match the specific documented pattern of reaching `AllowTraffic` and failing there without a logged cause. AWS identifies load-balancer health-check configuration as the typical cause for this exact symptom. See [Troubleshooting CodeDeploy deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html).

zh.question: 一个应用程序运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。一名 DevOps 工程师正在使用 AWS CodeDeploy 发布新版本。部署在 AllowTraffic 生命周期事件期间失败，但部署日志中未指出失败原因。这可能是什么原因导致的？

options.A: appspec.yml 文件包含一个无效脚本，该脚本在 AllowTraffic 生命周期挂钩中运行。
options.B: 发起部署的用户没有与 ALB 交互所需的权限。
options.C: 为 ALB 目标组指定的运行状况检查配置错误。
options.D: 属于 ALB 目标组的 EC2 实例上未安装 CodeDeploy agent。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

部署到达由 CodeDeploy 管理的 `AllowTraffic` 事件，在此事件中，新部署的 EC2 实例会注册到负载均衡器并可开始接收流量。关键诊断细节是，部署恰好在 `AllowTraffic` 期间失败，且**部署日志中没有错误信息**。

## 正确答案：C. 为 ALB 目标组指定的运行状况检查配置错误。

AWS 对这一确切症状有文档说明：当 EC2 蓝绿部署在 `AllowTraffic` 期间失败，并且部署日志未报告原因时，失败通常是由 Elastic Load Balancing 运行状况检查配置不正确导致的。对于 ALB，这些是在目标组上配置的运行状况检查。如果替换实例未能通过这些检查，CodeDeploy 就无法成功完成流量路由。请参阅 [Troubleshooting CodeDeploy deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. AppSpec 文件包含一个在 `AllowTraffic` 生命周期挂钩中运行的无效脚本。**  
  `AllowTraffic` 保留用于 CodeDeploy 操作，**不能用于运行 AppSpec 脚本**。用户脚本可以改为关联到 `BeforeAllowTraffic` 或 `AfterAllowTraffic` 等挂钩。因此，无效的用户脚本无法像该选项所述那样在 `AllowTraffic` 中运行。请参阅 [AppSpec hooks for EC2/On-Premises deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-hooks.html)。

- **B. 发起部署的用户没有与 ALB 交互所需的权限。**  
  CodeDeploy 使用其**服务角色**对 Elastic Load Balancing 资源执行操作。发起主体需要具有请求 CodeDeploy 操作的权限，但 CodeDeploy 在部署期间与负载均衡器的交互是通过配置的服务角色执行的。此外，部署已经启动并到达 `AllowTraffic`，因此发起者权限缺失与这一特定的文档化症状不一致。请参阅 [CodeDeploy service role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/primary-components.html)。

- **D. 目标组中的 EC2 实例上未安装 CodeDeploy agent。**  
  agent 缺失或停止通常会阻止实例级部署生命周期处理，并可能导致生命周期事件被跳过或出现运行状况约束失败；这不符合已到达 `AllowTraffic`、在此处失败且没有记录原因这一特定的文档化模式。AWS 将负载均衡器运行状况检查配置确定为这一确切症状的典型原因。请参阅 [Troubleshooting CodeDeploy deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/troubleshooting-deployments.html)。

en.question: A company has 20 service teams. Each service team is responsible for its own microservice. Each service team uses a separate AWS account for its microservice and a VPC with the 192.168.0.0/22 CIDR block. The company manages the AWS accounts with AWS Organizations. Each service team hosts its microservice on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The microservices communicate with each other across the public internet. The company’s security team has issued a new guideline that all communication between microservices must use HTTPS over private network connections and cannot traverse the public internet. A DevOps engineer must implement a solution that fulfills these obligations and minimizes the number of changes for each service team. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new AWS account in AWS Organizations. Create a VPC in this account, and use AWS Resource Access Manager to share the private subnets of this VPC with the organization. Instruct the service teams to launch a new Network Load Balancer (NLB) and EC2 instances that use the shared private subnets. Use the NLB DNS names for communication between microservices.
options.B: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the microservice VPCs. Use AWS PrivateLink to create VPC endpoints in each AWS account for the NLBs. Create subscriptions to each VPC endpoint in each of the other AWS accounts. Use the VPC endpoint DNS names for communication between microservices.
options.C: Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the microservice VPCs. Create VPC peering connections between each of the microservice VPCs. Update the route tables for each VPC to use the peering links. Use the NLB DNS names for communication between microservices.
options.D: Create a new AWS account in AWS Organizations. Create a transit gateway in this account, and use AWS Resource Access Manager to share the transit gateway with the organization. In each of the microservice VPCs, create a transit gateway attachment to the shared transit gateway. Update the route tables of each VPC to use the transit gateway. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the microservice VPCs. Use the NLB DNS names for communication between microservices.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

All 20 VPCs use the **same `192.168.0.0/22` CIDR block**. Therefore, the solution cannot depend on normal IP routing between those VPC CIDRs. It must also keep service-to-service traffic off the public internet and require HTTPS while minimizing disruption to the existing EC2-and-ALB deployments.

## Correct answer: B

Create an NLB-backed endpoint service for each microservice and let the other accounts consume it through **AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoints**.

AWS PrivateLink allows clients in one VPC to access services in another VPC by using private IP addresses. Traffic between the interface endpoint and the endpoint service remains on the AWS network and does not traverse the public internet. Consumers access an interface endpoint through its DNS name, so direct routing between the overlapping VPC CIDR blocks is not required. AWS also documents that a custom PrivateLink endpoint service is exposed through a Network Load Balancer and that access can be granted to principals in other AWS accounts ([AWS PrivateLink concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html), [Create a service powered by AWS PrivateLink](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)).

This approach can preserve the existing Application Load Balancers and EC2 deployments. An NLB can use an ALB as its target, combining ALB Layer 7 routing with NLB-supported endpoint services. The NLB can use a TCP listener on port 443 and pass the encrypted connection to the ALB's HTTPS listener; an ALB HTTPS listener uses a certificate and security policy to establish HTTPS with clients ([Use an Application Load Balancer as a target of a Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/application-load-balancer-target.html), [Create an HTTPS listener for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/create-https-listener.html)).

PrivateLink itself provides the private network path; it does **not by itself mean HTTPS**. HTTPS must still be configured on the load-balancer listener path.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Shared VPC subnets

This requires every service team to redeploy its EC2 instances and load-balancing resources into a newly shared VPC. That is a substantial migration and does not minimize changes to the existing independent microservice environments. Merely using an NLB DNS name also does not inherently ensure HTTPS; the listeners must be configured appropriately.

### C. VPC peering

VPC peering cannot be created between VPCs with matching or overlapping IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR blocks. Every VPC here uses exactly the same `192.168.0.0/22` block, so this architecture is invalid. In addition, peering is one-to-one and non-transitive, which would create a large full-mesh design for 20 VPCs ([How VPC peering connections work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/invalid-peering-configurations.html)).

### D. Transit Gateway

A transit gateway does not support routing between attached VPCs with identical or overlapping CIDRs. AWS specifically states that when a newly attached VPC has an identical or overlapping CIDR, its routes are not propagated to the transit gateway route table. Therefore, the proposed route-table updates cannot provide connectivity among these 20 identical VPC address spaces ([Amazon VPC attachments in AWS Transit Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpc-attachments.html)).

Therefore, **B** is the only option that provides private cross-account connectivity despite the overlapping CIDRs while allowing the existing application architecture to remain largely intact.

zh.question: 一家公司有 20 个服务团队。每个服务团队负责自己的微服务。每个服务团队为其微服务使用一个单独的 AWS 账户，以及一个 CIDR 块为 `192.168.0.0/22` 的 VPC。该公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理 AWS 账户。每个服务团队在 Application Load Balancer 后面的多个 Amazon EC2 实例上托管其微服务。微服务之间通过公共互联网进行通信。公司的安全团队发布了一项新准则：所有微服务之间的通信都必须通过私有网络连接使用 HTTPS，且不得经过公共互联网。DevOps 工程师必须实施一种满足这些要求且尽可能减少每个服务团队变更数量的解决方案。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个新的 AWS 账户。在该账户中创建一个 VPC，并使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 将此 VPC 的私有子网共享给组织。指示服务团队启动使用这些共享私有子网的新的 Network Load Balancer (NLB) 和 EC2 实例。使用 NLB DNS 名称在微服务之间进行通信。
options.B: 在每个微服务 VPC 中创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。使用 AWS PrivateLink 为这些 NLB 在每个 AWS 账户中创建 VPC 终端节点。在每个其他 AWS 账户中为每个 VPC 终端节点创建订阅。使用 VPC 终端节点 DNS 名称在微服务之间进行通信。
options.C: 在每个微服务 VPC 中创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。在每个微服务 VPC 之间创建 VPC 对等连接。更新每个 VPC 的路由表以使用对等连接。使用 NLB DNS 名称在微服务之间进行通信。
options.D: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个新的 AWS 账户。在该账户中创建一个 transit gateway，并使用 AWS Resource Access Manager 将该 transit gateway 共享给组织。在每个微服务 VPC 中，创建到共享 transit gateway 的 transit gateway attachment。更新每个 VPC 的路由表以使用 transit gateway。在每个微服务 VPC 中创建一个 Network Load Balancer (NLB)。使用 NLB DNS 名称在微服务之间进行通信。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查的内容

所有 20 个 VPC 都使用**相同的 `192.168.0.0/22` CIDR 块**。因此，该解决方案不能依赖这些 VPC CIDR 之间的常规 IP 路由。它还必须使服务间流量不经过公共互联网、要求使用 HTTPS，同时尽可能减少对现有 EC2 和 ALB 部署的影响。

## 正确答案：B

为每个微服务创建由 NLB 支持的 endpoint service，并让其他账户通过 **AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoints** 使用该服务。

AWS PrivateLink 允许一个 VPC 中的客户端通过私有 IP 地址访问另一个 VPC 中的服务。interface endpoint 与 endpoint service 之间的流量始终在 AWS 网络内传输，不会经过公共互联网。使用方通过其 DNS 名称访问 interface endpoint，因此不需要在具有重叠 CIDR 块的 VPC 之间进行直接路由。AWS 还说明，自定义 PrivateLink endpoint service 通过 Network Load Balancer 公开，并且可以向其他 AWS 账户中的主体授予访问权限（[AWS PrivateLink 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/concepts.html)，[创建由 AWS PrivateLink 支持的服务](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/privatelink/create-endpoint-service.html)）。

这种方法可以保留现有的 Application Load Balancers 和 EC2 部署。NLB 可以将 ALB 用作目标，从而结合 ALB 的 Layer 7 路由与 NLB 支持 endpoint services 的能力。NLB 可以在端口 443 上使用 TCP listener，并将加密连接传递给 ALB 的 HTTPS listener；ALB HTTPS listener 使用证书和安全策略与客户端建立 HTTPS 连接（[将 Application Load Balancer 用作 Network Load Balancer 的目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/application-load-balancer-target.html)，[为 Application Load Balancer 创建 HTTPS listener](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/create-https-listener.html)）。

PrivateLink 本身提供私有网络路径；它**本身并不代表 HTTPS**。仍必须在负载均衡器 listener 路径上配置 HTTPS。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. Shared VPC 子网

这要求每个服务团队将其 EC2 实例和负载均衡资源重新部署到新共享的 VPC 中。这是一项重大迁移，不能最大限度地减少对现有独立微服务环境的变更。仅使用 NLB DNS 名称也不能自然确保 HTTPS；必须适当地配置 listeners。

### C. VPC peering

无法在 IPv4 或 IPv6 CIDR 块相同或重叠的 VPC 之间创建 VPC peering。这里每个 VPC 都使用完全相同的 `192.168.0.0/22` 块，因此此架构无效。此外，peering 是一对一且不可传递的，这会为 20 个 VPC 创建一个大型全网状设计（[VPC peering connections 的工作方式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/peering/invalid-peering-configurations.html)）。

### D. Transit Gateway

transit gateway 不支持在已连接且 CIDR 相同或重叠的 VPC 之间进行路由。AWS 明确指出，当新连接的 VPC 具有相同或重叠的 CIDR 时，其路由不会传播到 transit gateway 路由表。因此，所提议的路由表更新无法在这 20 个使用相同地址空间的 VPC 之间提供连接（[AWS Transit Gateway 中的 Amazon VPC attachments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/tgw/tgw-vpc-attachments.html)）。

因此，**B** 是唯一能够在 CIDR 重叠的情况下提供私有跨账户连接，同时使现有应用程序架构基本保持不变的选项。

en.question: An Amazon EC2 instance is running in a VPC and needs to download an object from a restricted Amazon S3 bucket. When the DevOps engineer tries to download the object, an AccessDenied error is received. What are the possible causes for this error? (Choose two.)

options.A: The S3 bucket default encryption is enabled.
options.B: There is an error in the S3 bucket policy.
options.C: The object has been moved to S3 Glacier.
options.D: There is an error in the IAM role configuration.
options.E: S3 Versioning is enabled.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The EC2 instance accesses Amazon S3 using the AWS identity available to it—normally an IAM role through an instance profile. The question asks which configuration problems can cause an S3 `AccessDenied` response when the instance attempts `GetObject` against a restricted bucket.

## Correct answers: B and D

### B. There is an error in the S3 bucket policy

An S3 bucket policy is a resource-based policy and can prevent object access through an explicit `Deny`, incorrect principal, incorrect object ARN, unmet condition, or missing cross-account allow. AWS states that object requests can receive `403 Access Denied` because of bucket-policy or IAM-policy evaluation. For cross-account access, both the requester’s identity policy and the bucket policy generally need the required explicit allows, with no applicable explicit deny. See [Troubleshoot access denied errors in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-403-errors.html).

### D. There is an error in the IAM role configuration

The EC2 instance's IAM role must authorize the required S3 operation and object resource. For a normal download of the current object version, `s3:GetObject` is required. A missing permission, an incorrect resource ARN, an explicit deny, or use of the wrong role can therefore result in `AccessDenied`. If the object is encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key, the role and KMS key policy must also permit `kms:Decrypt`. The relevant permissions are documented in the [S3 GetObject API reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html) and the [S3 403 troubleshooting guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-403-errors.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. The S3 bucket default encryption is enabled

Default encryption by itself does not prevent downloads. All S3 buckets now have default SSE-S3 encryption, and Amazon S3 automatically decrypts SSE-S3 objects when they are downloaded. SSE-S3 requires no additional permissions. SSE-KMS objects can require `kms:Decrypt`, but in that situation the cause is missing IAM/KMS authorization—not simply that default encryption is enabled. See [Setting default server-side encryption behavior for S3 buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html) and [S3 encryption permissions requirements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-403-errors.html).

### C. The object has been moved to S3 Glacier

An object archived in S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval, S3 Glacier Deep Archive, or an S3 Intelligent-Tiering archive tier must be restored before retrieval. Without restoration, `GetObject` returns `InvalidObjectState`, not an authorization-based `AccessDenied` error. See the [GetObject storage-class behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html).

### E. S3 Versioning is enabled

Enabling versioning does not inherently deny a download. A normal `GetObject` request without a `versionId` retrieves the current version and requires `s3:GetObject`. Retrieving a specifically identified older version requires `s3:GetObjectVersion`, but versioning being enabled alone is not a cause of `AccessDenied`. See [Retrieving objects from versioning-suspended buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/RetrievingObjectsfromVersioningSuspendedBuckets.html) and the [GetObject permissions documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html).

zh.question: 一个 Amazon EC2 实例正在 VPC 中运行，并且需要从受限的 Amazon S3 存储桶下载一个对象。当 DevOps 工程师尝试下载该对象时，收到 AccessDenied 错误。此错误可能的原因是什么？（选择两个。）

options.A: 已启用 S3 存储桶默认加密。
options.B: S3 存储桶策略中存在错误。
options.C: 该对象已移至 S3 Glacier。
options.D: IAM 角色配置中存在错误。
options.E: 已启用 S3 Versioning。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

EC2 实例使用可供其使用的 AWS 身份访问 Amazon S3——通常是通过实例配置文件关联的 IAM 角色。题目询问：当实例尝试对受限存储桶执行 `GetObject` 时，哪些配置问题可能导致 S3 返回 `AccessDenied` 响应。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B. S3 存储桶策略中存在错误

S3 存储桶策略是一种基于资源的策略，可能通过显式 `Deny`、不正确的主体、不正确的对象 ARN、未满足的条件或缺少跨账户允许来阻止对象访问。AWS 指出，由于存储桶策略或 IAM 策略评估，对象请求可能收到 `403 Access Denied`。对于跨账户访问，请求方的身份策略和存储桶策略通常都需要所需的显式允许，并且不能存在适用的显式拒绝。请参阅 [排查 Amazon S3 中的访问被拒绝错误](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-403-errors.html)。

### D. IAM 角色配置中存在错误

EC2 实例的 IAM 角色必须授权所需的 S3 操作和对象资源。对于正常下载对象的当前版本，需要 `s3:GetObject` 权限。因此，缺少权限、不正确的资源 ARN、显式拒绝或使用了错误的角色，都可能导致 `AccessDenied`。如果对象使用客户管理的 KMS 密钥加密，角色和 KMS 密钥策略还必须允许 `kms:Decrypt`。相关权限说明请参阅 [S3 GetObject API 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html) 和 [S3 403 故障排查指南](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-403-errors.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 已启用 S3 存储桶默认加密

默认加密本身不会阻止下载。现在所有 S3 存储桶都默认使用 SSE-S3 加密，Amazon S3 会在下载 SSE-S3 对象时自动将其解密。SSE-S3 不需要额外权限。SSE-KMS 对象可能需要 `kms:Decrypt`，但在这种情况下，原因是缺少 IAM/KMS 授权，而不只是启用了默认加密。请参阅 [为 S3 存储桶设置默认服务器端加密行为](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/bucket-encryption.html) 和 [S3 加密权限要求](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/troubleshoot-403-errors.html)。

### C. 该对象已移至 S3 Glacier

存档在 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval、S3 Glacier Deep Archive 或 S3 Intelligent-Tiering 存档层中的对象，必须先还原才能检索。未还原时，`GetObject` 返回的是 `InvalidObjectState`，而不是基于授权的 `AccessDenied` 错误。请参阅 [GetObject 存储类别行为](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html)。

### E. 已启用 S3 Versioning

启用版本控制不会天然地拒绝下载。不带 `versionId` 的普通 `GetObject` 请求会检索当前版本，并且需要 `s3:GetObject`。检索特定标识的旧版本需要 `s3:GetObjectVersion`，但仅启用版本控制并不是导致 `AccessDenied` 的原因。请参阅 [从版本控制已暂停的存储桶中检索对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/RetrievingObjectsfromVersioningSuspendedBuckets.html) 以及 [GetObject 权限文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_GetObject.html)。

en.question: A company wants to use a grid system for a proprietary enterprise in-memory data store on top of AWS. This system can run in multiple server nodes in any Linux-based distribution. The system must be able to reconfigure the entire cluster every time a node is added or removed. When adding or removing nodes, an /etc/cluster/nodes.config file must be updated, listing the IP addresses of the current node members of that cluster. The company wants to automate the task of adding new nodes to a cluster. What can a DevOps engineer do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS OpsWorks Stacks to layer the server nodes of that cluster. Create a Chef recipe that populates the content of the /etc/cluster/nodes.config file and restarts the service by using the current members of the layer. Assign that recipe to the Configure lifecycle event.
options.B: Put the file nodes.config in version control. Create an AWS CodeDeploy deployment configuration and deployment group based on an Amazon EC2 tag value for the cluster nodes. When adding a new node to the cluster, update the file with all tagged instances, and make a commit in version control. Deploy the new file and restart the services.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket and upload a version of the /etc/cluster/nodes.config file. Create a crontab script that will poll for that S3 file and download it frequently. Use a process manager, such as Monit or systemd, to restart the cluster services when it detects that the new file was modified. When adding a node to the cluster, edit the file’s most recent members. Upload the new file to the S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a user data script that lists all members of the current security group of the cluster and automatically updates the /etc/cluster/nodes.config file whenever a new instance is added to the cluster.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The cluster configuration on **every node** must be regenerated whenever cluster membership changes. Therefore, the best solution needs both:

1. A configuration-management mechanism that can render `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` from the current node inventory and restart the service.
2. An event that runs that configuration across the layer whenever an instance joins or leaves.

## Correct answer: A

**Use AWS OpsWorks Stacks, place the cluster nodes in a layer, and assign a Chef recipe to the Configure lifecycle event.**

An OpsWorks layer represents the configuration and resources for a set of instances, as described in the [OpsWorks deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-OpsWorks.html). OpsWorks layers support lifecycle-specific custom recipes, including Configure recipes, through the layer's `CustomRecipes` configuration; see [`AWS::OpsWorks::Layer`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-opsworks-layer.html) and its [`Recipes` property](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-opsworks-layer-recipes.html).

The **Configure** lifecycle event is the appropriate event because OpsWorks invokes it across the stack when relevant instance membership/configuration changes occur, including an instance entering or leaving the online state. The Chef recipe can use the current layer instance metadata to:

- Build the complete list of member IP addresses.
- Render `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` on each node.
- Restart the proprietary data-store service when the rendered configuration changes.

This provides automatic, cluster-wide convergence when nodes are added or removed.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. CodeDeploy with a version-controlled static file

CodeDeploy can select deployment targets by EC2 tags, but tags only determine which instances receive a revision when a deployment is created. The documentation states that matching instances receive the latest revision **when a deployment to the deployment group is created**; see [Tagging instances for deployment groups in CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/instances-tagging.html).

This option still requires someone or another unspecified process to discover membership, edit and commit the file, and initiate a deployment. It therefore does not automatically reconfigure the entire cluster in response to every join or removal.

### C. Poll a file in Amazon S3

This is a polling-based distribution mechanism, not an automated cluster-membership solution. The membership file must still be manually edited and uploaded whenever nodes change. It also introduces propagation delay based on the cron interval and lacks the lifecycle-aware inventory and convergence behavior provided by OpsWorks.

### D. Use an EC2 user data script and security-group membership

EC2 user data is primarily a launch-time bootstrap mechanism. By default, user data scripts and cloud-init directives run only during the first instance boot cycle, not whenever another instance joins or leaves; see [EC2 user data for Linux instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html).

Additionally, a security group is a set of traffic-control rules associated with network interfaces; it is not itself a reliable cluster-membership registry or an event that causes scripts to run on all existing nodes. Thus, adding a new instance would not automatically update the configuration on every already-running cluster node.

**Answer: A**

zh.question: 一家公司希望在 AWS 之上为专有企业级内存数据存储使用网格系统。该系统可以在任何基于 Linux 的发行版中的多个服务器节点上运行。每当添加或删除节点时，该系统必须能够重新配置整个集群。添加或删除节点时，必须更新 `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` 文件，其中列出该集群当前节点成员的 IP 地址。公司希望自动执行向集群添加新节点的任务。DevOps 工程师应如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS OpsWorks Stacks 对该集群的服务器节点进行分层。创建一个 Chef 配方，使用该层的当前成员填充 `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` 文件内容并重启服务。将该配方分配给 Configure 生命周期事件。
options.B: 将 `nodes.config` 文件置于版本控制中。根据集群节点的 Amazon EC2 标签值创建 AWS CodeDeploy 部署配置和部署组。向集群添加新节点时，使用所有带标签的实例更新该文件，并在版本控制中提交。部署新文件并重启服务。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶并上传一个版本的 `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` 文件。创建一个 crontab 脚本，频繁轮询该 S3 文件并下载它。使用进程管理器（如 Monit 或 systemd），在检测到新文件被修改时重启集群服务。向集群添加节点时，编辑文件中最新的成员列表。将新文件上传到 S3 存储桶。
options.D: 创建一个用户数据脚本，列出集群当前安全组的所有成员，并在向集群添加新实例时自动更新 `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` 文件。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

每当集群成员发生变化时，必须在**每个节点**上重新生成集群配置。因此，最佳解决方案需要同时具备：

1. 一种配置管理机制，能够根据当前节点清单渲染 `/etc/cluster/nodes.config` 并重启服务。
2. 当实例加入或离开时，在整个层中运行该配置的事件。

## 正确答案：A

**使用 AWS OpsWorks Stacks，将集群节点置于一个层中，并将 Chef 配方分配给 Configure 生命周期事件。**

如 [OpsWorks deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-OpsWorks.html) 所述，OpsWorks 层表示一组实例的配置和资源。OpsWorks 层通过该层的 `CustomRecipes` 配置支持特定于生命周期的自定义配方（包括 Configure 配方）；请参阅 [`AWS::OpsWorks::Layer`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-opsworks-layer.html) 及其 [`Recipes` property](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-opsworks-layer-recipes.html)。

**Configure** 生命周期事件是合适的事件，因为当发生相关实例成员资格或配置变化时，OpsWorks 会在整个 Stack 中调用它，包括实例进入或离开在线状态。Chef 配方可以使用当前层的实例元数据来：

- 构建完整的成员 IP 地址列表。
- 在每个节点上渲染 `/etc/cluster/nodes.config`。
- 当渲染后的配置发生变化时，重启专有数据存储服务。

这可在添加或删除节点时提供自动的、集群范围的趋同。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 使用版本控制的静态文件配合 CodeDeploy

CodeDeploy 可以通过 EC2 标签选择部署目标，但标签仅决定在创建部署时哪些实例会接收修订版本。文档说明，在**创建对部署组的部署时**，匹配的实例会接收最新修订版本；请参阅 [Tagging instances for deployment groups in CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/instances-tagging.html)。

此选项仍需要某个人或其他未指定的流程来发现成员、编辑并提交文件，以及启动部署。因此，它无法针对每次加入或移除自动重新配置整个集群。

### C. 轮询 Amazon S3 中的文件

这是一种基于轮询的分发机制，而不是自动化的集群成员管理解决方案。每当节点发生变化时，仍必须手动编辑并上传成员文件。它还会根据 cron 间隔引入传播延迟，并且缺少 OpsWorks 提供的、感知生命周期的清单和趋同行为。

### D. 使用 EC2 用户数据脚本和安全组成员资格

EC2 用户数据主要是一种启动时引导机制。默认情况下，用户数据脚本和 cloud-init 指令仅在实例的首次启动周期内运行，而不会在其他实例加入或离开时运行；请参阅 [EC2 user data for Linux instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)。

此外，安全组是一组与网络接口关联的流量控制规则；它本身并不是可靠的集群成员注册表，也不是会使脚本在所有现有节点上运行的事件。因此，添加新实例不会自动更新每个已运行集群节点上的配置。

**答案：A**

en.question: A DevOps engineer is working on a data archival project that requires the migration of on-premises data to an Amazon S3 bucket. The DevOps engineer develops a script that incrementally archives on-premises data that is older than 1 month to Amazon S3. Data that is transferred to Amazon S3 is deleted from the on-premises location. The script uses the S3 PutObject operation. During a code review, the DevOps engineer notices that the script does not verify whether the data was successfully copied to Amazon S3. The DevOps engineer must update the script to ensure that data is not corrupted during transmission. The script must use MD5 checksums to verify data integrity before the on-premises data is deleted. Which solutions for the script will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Check the returned response for the VersionId. Compare the returned VersionId against the MD5 checksum.
options.B: Include the MD5 checksum within the Content-MD5 parameter. Check the operation call’s return status to find out if an error was returned.
options.C: Include the checksum digest within the tagging parameter as a URL query parameter.
options.D: Check the returned response for the ETag. Compare the returned ETag against the MD5 checksum.
options.E: Include the checksum digest within the Metadata parameter as a name-value pair. After upload, use the S3 HeadObject operation to retrieve metadata from the object.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The script must verify that each object reached Amazon S3 without transmission corruption **before** deleting the source data. Because the upload uses `PutObject` and the requirement specifically calls for MD5, there are two applicable integrity-checking patterns: have S3 validate a supplied MD5 during the request, or compare the returned ETag with the locally calculated MD5 when the ETag represents the object's MD5.

## Correct answers: B and D

### B. Include the MD5 checksum in `Content-MD5` and check whether the operation returned an error

This is the strongest in-request validation mechanism. The script calculates the object's MD5 digest and supplies it in the `Content-MD5` header/parameter. Amazon S3 independently calculates the MD5 digest of the received object and compares it with the supplied value. The `PutObject` request succeeds only when the values match; otherwise, S3 returns an error. Therefore, the script should delete the on-premises file only after a successful response.

AWS documents that when `Content-MD5` is supplied, S3 calculates and compares the digest and that the request succeeds only if the digests match: [Using Content-MD5 when uploading objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/checking-object-integrity-upload.html).

### D. Compare the returned ETag with the locally calculated MD5 checksum

For an object created by `PutObject`, the ETag is the MD5 digest of the object data when the object is plaintext or encrypted with SSE-S3. The script can therefore compare the returned ETag with the locally calculated MD5 and delete the local data only after they match.

AWS describes when an ETag is the object's MD5 and explicitly states that, for such objects, the ETag can be compared with a calculated `Content-MD5` digest: [Using Content-MD5 and the ETag to verify uploaded objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/checking-object-integrity-upload.html).

A practical implementation must normalize the representations before comparison—for example, remove quotation marks from the ETag and account for the checksum encoding used by the API.

> **ETag caveat:** An ETag is not the object's MD5 for multipart uploads or objects encrypted with SSE-KMS or SSE-C. The question specifies `PutObject` and does not introduce one of these exceptions, so D is the intended valid solution.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Compare `VersionId` with the MD5 checksum

A version ID identifies a particular version of an object in a versioning-enabled bucket. It is not a content checksum and has no mathematical relationship to the object's MD5 digest. It therefore cannot verify transmission integrity.

### C. Store the digest as an object tag

An object tag is application-supplied metadata. Storing a locally calculated digest in a tag does not cause S3 to calculate an MD5 digest of the uploaded payload or compare the supplied value with the received data. Both the object and its tag could be accepted without establishing that their contents correspond.

### E. Store the digest in user-defined metadata and retrieve it with `HeadObject`

This only confirms that S3 stored and returned the checksum value that the client supplied as metadata. `HeadObject` would return that same client-provided value; it would not independently calculate the object's MD5 and validate the uploaded bytes against it. Thus, this approach does not detect corruption during transmission.

Therefore, the solutions that meet the requirement are **B and D**.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在开展一个数据归档项目，该项目要求将本地数据迁移到 Amazon S3 存储桶。该 DevOps 工程师开发了一个脚本，将超过 1 个月的本地数据增量归档到 Amazon S3。传输到 Amazon S3 的数据会从本地位置删除。该脚本使用 S3 PutObject 操作。在代码审查期间，该 DevOps 工程师发现脚本未验证数据是否已成功复制到 Amazon S3。该 DevOps 工程师必须更新脚本，以确保数据在传输期间未损坏。脚本必须使用 MD5 校验和在删除本地数据之前验证数据完整性。脚本采用哪些解决方案能够满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 检查返回响应中的 VersionId。将返回的 VersionId 与 MD5 校验和进行比较。
options.B: 在 Content-MD5 参数中包含 MD5 校验和。检查操作调用的返回状态，以确定是否返回了错误。
options.C: 将校验和摘要作为 URL 查询参数包含在 tagging 参数中。
options.D: 检查返回响应中的 ETag。将返回的 ETag 与 MD5 校验和进行比较。
options.E: 将校验和摘要作为名称-值对包含在 Metadata 参数中。上传后，使用 S3 HeadObject 操作从对象中检索元数据。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

脚本必须在删除源数据**之前**验证每个对象均已到达 Amazon S3，且在传输过程中未发生损坏。由于上传使用 `PutObject`，并且要求明确指定 MD5，因此有两种适用的完整性检查模式：让 S3 在请求期间验证所提供的 MD5，或在 ETag 表示对象的 MD5 时，将返回的 ETag 与本地计算的 MD5 进行比较。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B. 在 `Content-MD5` 中包含 MD5 校验和，并检查操作是否返回错误

这是最强的请求内验证机制。脚本计算对象的 MD5 摘要，并在 `Content-MD5` 标头/参数中提供该摘要。Amazon S3 会独立计算接收到的对象的 MD5 摘要，并将其与提供的值进行比较。仅当这些值匹配时，`PutObject` 请求才会成功；否则，S3 会返回错误。因此，脚本应仅在收到成功响应后删除本地文件。

AWS 文档说明，当提供 `Content-MD5` 时，S3 会计算并比较摘要，并且仅当摘要匹配时请求才会成功：[上传对象时使用 Content-MD5](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/checking-object-integrity-upload.html)。

### D. 将返回的 ETag 与本地计算的 MD5 校验和进行比较

对于通过 `PutObject` 创建的对象，当对象为纯文本或使用 SSE-S3 加密时，ETag 是对象数据的 MD5 摘要。因此，脚本可以将返回的 ETag 与本地计算的 MD5 进行比较，并且仅在两者匹配后删除本地数据。

AWS 说明了 ETag 在何种情况下是对象的 MD5，并明确指出，对于此类对象，可以将 ETag 与计算得出的 `Content-MD5` 摘要进行比较：[使用 Content-MD5 和 ETag 验证上传的对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/checking-object-integrity-upload.html)。

实际实现时，必须在比较前规范化表示形式——例如，移除 ETag 中的引号，并考虑 API 使用的校验和编码。

> **ETag 注意事项：**对于多部分上传，或使用 SSE-KMS 或 SSE-C 加密的对象，ETag 不是对象的 MD5。题目指定使用 `PutObject`，且未引入这些例外情况之一，因此 D 是预期的有效解决方案。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 将 `VersionId` 与 MD5 校验和进行比较

版本 ID 用于标识启用了版本控制的存储桶中对象的特定版本。它不是内容校验和，与对象的 MD5 摘要没有数学关系。因此，它无法验证传输完整性。

### C. 将摘要存储为对象标签

对象标签是由应用程序提供的元数据。将本地计算的摘要存储在标签中，并不会使 S3 计算上传有效负载的 MD5 摘要，也不会使其将所提供的值与接收到的数据进行比较。对象及其标签都可能被接受，但无法证明其内容相对应。

### E. 将摘要存储在用户定义的元数据中，并通过 `HeadObject` 检索

这只能确认 S3 已存储并返回客户端作为元数据提供的校验和值。`HeadObject` 会返回同一个客户端提供的值；它不会独立计算对象的 MD5，也不会根据该值验证上传的字节。因此，这种方法无法检测传输过程中的损坏。

因此，满足要求的解决方案是 **B 和 D**。

en.question: A company deploys updates to its Amazon API Gateway API several times a week by using an AWS CodePipeline pipeline. As part of the update process, the company exports the JavaScript SDK for the API from the API Gateway console and uploads the SDK to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has configured an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the S3 bucket as an origin. Web clients then download the SDK by using the CloudFront distribution’s endpoint. A DevOps engineer needs to implement a solution to make the new SDK available automatically during new API deployments. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a CodePipeline action immediately after the deployment stage of the API. Configure the action to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to download the SDK from API Gateway, upload the SDK to the S3 bucket, and create a CloudFront invalidation for the SDK path.
options.B: Create a CodePipeline action immediately after the deployment stage of the API. Configure the action to use the CodePipeline integration with API Gateway to export the SDK to Amazon S3. Create another action that uses the CodePipeline integration with Amazon S3 to invalidate the cache for the SDK path.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to UpdateStage events from aws.apigateway. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to download the SDK from API Gateway, upload the SDK to the S3 bucket, and call the CloudFront API to create an invalidation for the SDK path.
