AWS documents this explicitly for pulling packages from CodeArtifact: create the gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 with the `create-vpc-endpoint` command, and when creating the endpoint you **must select the route tables for your VPC** so the S3 prefix-list routes are installed for the subnets that run the job. See [Create the Amazon S3 gateway endpoint for CodeArtifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/create-s3-gateway-endpoint.html).

This is why simply having created the CodeArtifact endpoints (as the team did — see [Create VPC endpoints for CodeArtifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/create-vpc-endpoints.html)) is not enough: the endpoint set for a fully isolated build environment also includes the S3 gateway endpoint plus the associated route-table entries.

## Why D is correct

**D. Update the role that the CodeBuild project uses so that the role has sufficient permissions to use the CodeArtifact repository.**

A CodeArtifact repository policy is a **resource-based** policy. Access to CodeArtifact is evaluated against both the resource policy and the calling principal's **identity-based** policy, so a permissive repository policy alone never authorizes the CodeBuild service role — the role must carry its own `Allow` statements. See [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html).

AWS states the concrete permission set that a CodeBuild project role must have to consume Python packages from CodeArtifact:

- `codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken`
- `codeartifact:GetRepositoryEndpoint`
- `codeartifact:ReadFromRepository`
- `sts:GetServiceBearerToken`, with the condition `sts:AWSServiceName = codeartifact.amazonaws.com`

Without these, the `aws codeartifact login` / `get-authorization-token` step in the buildspec fails and `pip` cannot install from the repository. See [Using CodeArtifact with Python packages in CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/using-python-packages-in-codebuild.html).

Because the repository lives in a different account from the build, the token retrieval is also governed at the **domain** level: `codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken` is authorized on the domain, so cross-account consumers must be permitted for that action through the domain policy in addition to holding the identity-based permissions above. See [CodeArtifact domain policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/domain-policies.html).

---

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Update the repository policy's `Principal` statement to include the CodeBuild role ARN — Incorrect

The existing repository policy already uses `"Principal": "*"` narrowed by the `aws:PrincipalOrgID` condition key, which matches **every** principal in accounts that belong to the specified organization — including the development team's CodeBuild service role. Naming the role ARN explicitly grants nothing that the policy does not already grant, so it cannot be the missing step. Furthermore, a repository resource policy can never supply the role's own identity-based permissions, nor the domain-level `GetAuthorizationToken` authorization. See [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html) and [CodeArtifact domain policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/domain-policies.html).

### C. Share the CodeArtifact repository with the organization by using AWS RAM — Incorrect

CodeArtifact cross-account access is implemented with CodeArtifact domain and repository resource policies combined with IAM identity policies — not with AWS Resource Access Manager. CodeArtifact repositories and domains are not among the resource types that AWS RAM can share, so creating a resource share is not a valid mechanism here. See [Shareable AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html) and [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html).

### E. Specify the repository's account as the delegated administrator for CodeArtifact in the organization — Incorrect

A delegated administrator designation is an AWS Organizations administrative construct; it does not create network reachability from an isolated VPC and it does not grant a CodeBuild service role permission to fetch an authorization token or read packages. CodeArtifact package access is determined solely by the caller's IAM policy plus the applicable domain and repository resource policies. See [Using CodeArtifact with Python packages in CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/using-python-packages-in-codebuild.html) and [CodeArtifact domain policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/domain-policies.html).

---

## Summary

The failure has both a **networking** cause and a **permissions** cause. Adding the Amazon S3 gateway endpoint and the corresponding subnet route-table entries (**A**) completes the private download path for package assets in an internet-isolated VPC, and granting the CodeBuild role the CodeArtifact plus `sts:GetServiceBearerToken` permissions (**D**) lets the build authenticate and read from the repository. The repository policy already covers organization principals, AWS RAM does not share CodeArtifact repositories, and delegated administration grants no package access.

options.A: 创建 Amazon S3 网关终端节点。更新运行 CodeBuild 作业的子网的路由表。
options.B: 更新存储库策略的 Principal 语句，加入 CodeBuild 项目所使用角色的 ARN。
options.C: 使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 将该 CodeArtifact 存储库共享给该组织。
options.D: 更新 CodeBuild 项目所使用的角色，使该角色具有足够的权限来使用 CodeArtifact 存储库。
options.E: 将托管该存储库的账户指定为该组织中 CodeArtifact 的委托管理员。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A 和 D

### 场景

某公司将 Python 包集中存储在一个 AWS CodeArtifact 存储库中，其资源策略允许任何满足该组织 `aws:PrincipalOrgID` 条件的主体（`"Principal": "*"`）执行读取操作。同一组织中某个成员账户的开发团队使用 AWS CodePipeline 和 AWS CodeBuild 构建应用程序。CodeBuild 项目在一个 VPC 内运行，出于合规原因，该 VPC **没有互联网连接**。团队已经创建了 CodeArtifact VPC 终端节点并更新了 `buildspec.yaml`，但包下载仍然失败。

因此仍缺少两样东西：(1) 包下载路径的完整私有网络可达性；(2) CodeBuild 服务角色上的基于身份的 IAM 权限，使其能够向 CodeArtifact 进行身份验证并从存储库读取。

---

## 为什么 A 正确

**A. 创建 Amazon S3 网关终端节点，并更新运行 CodeBuild 作业的子网的路由表。**

CodeArtifact 使用 Amazon S3 存储包资产。CodeArtifact 接口终端节点（`com.amazonaws.region.codeartifact.api` 和 `com.amazonaws.region.codeartifact.repositories`）使构建能够访问 CodeArtifact 控制平面和存储库终端节点，以获取身份验证令牌和包**元数据**，但下载包**资产**需要能够访问 Amazon S3。在没有互联网网关也没有 NAT 的 VPC 中，这类流量只能通过 Amazon S3 **网关**终端节点传输。

AWS 针对从 CodeArtifact 拉取包的场景明确记录了这一点：使用 `create-vpc-endpoint` 命令为 Amazon S3 创建网关终端节点，并且在创建终端节点时，你**必须选择 VPC 的路由表**，这样 S3 前缀列表路由才会被安装到运行该作业的子网上。请参阅 [Create the Amazon S3 gateway endpoint for CodeArtifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/create-s3-gateway-endpoint.html)。

这就是为什么仅仅创建了 CodeArtifact 终端节点（团队已经这样做了——参见 [Create VPC endpoints for CodeArtifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/create-vpc-endpoints.html)）还不够：对于完全隔离的构建环境，所需的终端节点集合还包括 S3 网关终端节点以及相关的路由表条目。

## 为什么 D 正确

**D. 更新 CodeBuild 项目所使用的角色，使该角色具有足够的权限来使用 CodeArtifact 存储库。**

CodeArtifact 存储库策略是一种**基于资源的**策略。对 CodeArtifact 的访问会同时基于资源策略和调用方主体的**基于身份的**策略进行评估，因此仅有宽松的存储库策略永远无法授权 CodeBuild 服务角色——该角色必须拥有自己的 `Allow` 语句。请参阅 [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html)。

AWS 明确说明了 CodeBuild 项目角色从 CodeArtifact 消费 Python 包所必须具备的具体权限集：

- `codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken`
- `codeartifact:GetRepositoryEndpoint`
- `codeartifact:ReadFromRepository`
- `sts:GetServiceBearerToken`，带有条件 `sts:AWSServiceName = codeartifact.amazonaws.com`

没有这些权限，buildspec 中的 `aws codeartifact login` / `get-authorization-token` 步骤就会失败，`pip` 也无法从存储库安装包。请参阅 [Using CodeArtifact with Python packages in CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/using-python-packages-in-codebuild.html)。

由于存储库与构建位于不同账户中，令牌获取还在**域**级别受到约束：`codeartifact:GetAuthorizationToken` 是在域上授权的，因此跨账户使用者除了拥有上述基于身份的权限外，还必须通过域策略被允许执行该操作。请参阅 [CodeArtifact domain policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/domain-policies.html)。

---

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 更新存储库策略的 `Principal` 语句以加入 CodeBuild 角色 ARN —— 不正确

现有存储库策略已经使用 `"Principal": "*"` 并通过 `aws:PrincipalOrgID` 条件键加以限定，这会匹配属于指定组织的账户中的**每一个**主体——包括开发团队的 CodeBuild 服务角色。显式指定角色 ARN 并不会授予该策略尚未授予的任何权限，因此它不可能是缺失的步骤。此外，存储库资源策略永远无法提供该角色自身基于身份的权限，也无法提供域级别的 `GetAuthorizationToken` 授权。请参阅 [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html) 和 [CodeArtifact domain policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/domain-policies.html)。

### C. 使用 AWS RAM 将 CodeArtifact 存储库共享给组织 —— 不正确

CodeArtifact 的跨账户访问是通过 CodeArtifact 域和存储库资源策略结合 IAM 身份策略实现的，而不是通过 AWS Resource Access Manager。CodeArtifact 存储库和域并不在 AWS RAM 可共享的资源类型之列，因此创建资源共享在此并不是一种有效机制。请参阅 [Shareable AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html) 和 [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html)。

### E. 将存储库所在账户指定为组织中 CodeArtifact 的委托管理员 —— 不正确

委托管理员的指定是 AWS Organizations 的管理性构造；它既不会为隔离的 VPC 创建网络可达性，也不会授予 CodeBuild 服务角色获取授权令牌或读取包的权限。CodeArtifact 的包访问权限完全由调用方的 IAM 策略以及适用的域和存储库资源策略决定。请参阅 [Using CodeArtifact with Python packages in CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/using-python-packages-in-codebuild.html) 和 [CodeArtifact domain policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/domain-policies.html)。

---

## 小结

此次失败同时存在**网络**原因和**权限**原因。添加 Amazon S3 网关终端节点及相应的子网路由表条目（**A**）为互联网隔离的 VPC 中的包资产补全了私有下载路径；而为 CodeBuild 角色授予 CodeArtifact 权限以及 `sts:GetServiceBearerToken` 权限（**D**）则使构建能够进行身份验证并从存储库读取。存储库策略已经涵盖了组织内的主体，AWS RAM 无法共享 CodeArtifact 存储库，委托管理也不会授予任何包访问权限。

en.question: A company uses a series of individual Amazon CloudFormation templates to deploy its multi-Region applications. These templates must be deployed in a specific order. The company is making more changes to the templates than previously expected and wants to deploy new templates more efficiently. Additionally, the data engineering team must be notified of all changes to the templates. What should the company do to accomplish these goals?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to deploy the CloudFormation templates in the required order. Use stack policies to alert the data engineering team.
options.B: Host the CloudFormation templates in Amazon S3. Use Amazon S3 events to directly trigger CloudFormation updates and Amazon SNS notifications.
options.C: Implement CloudFormation StackSets and use drift detection to trigger update alerts to the data engineering team.
options.D: Leverage CloudFormation nested stacks and stack sets for deployments. Use Amazon SNS to notify the data engineering team.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a solution that addresses three requirements together:

1. Coordinate several interdependent CloudFormation templates in a required deployment order.
2. Deploy and update the application efficiently across multiple AWS Regions.
3. Notify the data engineering team about CloudFormation changes/deployment events.

## Correct answer: D

**Leverage CloudFormation nested stacks and StackSets for deployments, and use Amazon SNS to notify the data engineering team.**

- **Nested stacks** let a root CloudFormation template reference other templates as `AWS::CloudFormation::Stack` resources. This converts the collection of individual templates into a centrally managed hierarchy. Dependencies can enforce ordering; the AWS nested-stack example explicitly shows a second nested stack with `DependsOn: MyFirstNestedStack`. Updates are initiated from the root stack, and CloudFormation updates only nested stacks whose templates changed. See [Split a template into reusable pieces using nested stacks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-nested-stacks.html).
- **StackSets** provide the multi-Region deployment mechanism. AWS states that StackSets can create, update, or delete stacks across multiple accounts and Regions in a single operation. StackSet operations can also use sequential Region deployment and a specified Region deployment order. See [CloudFormation best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html) and [StackSets concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-concepts.html).
- **Amazon SNS** can be associated with CloudFormation stacks to deliver stack notifications to subscribed team members or endpoints. AWS provides a runbook specifically for enabling SNS notifications on a CloudFormation stack. See [`AWS-EnableCloudFormationSNSNotification`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/AWS-EnableCloudFormationStackSNSNotification.html).

Therefore, D is the only option that combines template orchestration, multi-Region deployment, and team notifications.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Lambda deployment orchestration and stack policies

A Lambda function could be custom-built to invoke CloudFormation operations in sequence, but this unnecessarily recreates orchestration capabilities available through nested stacks and does not directly solve efficient multi-Region deployment like StackSets does.

More importantly, **stack policies are not an alerting feature**. They protect stack resources from specified update actions; they do not notify a team. Amazon SNS is the appropriate notification mechanism.

### B. S3 events directly triggering CloudFormation updates

Hosting nested templates in Amazon S3 is common, but an **S3 event notification cannot directly execute a CloudFormation stack update**. S3 event destinations include services such as Lambda, SNS, SQS, and EventBridge; an intermediary workflow would still be needed to invoke CloudFormation safely.

This option also does not provide a CloudFormation-native mechanism for enforcing dependency order across the templates or managing coordinated multi-Region deployments.

### C. StackSets with drift detection

StackSets address the multi-Region requirement, but **drift detection is not a template-change notification mechanism**. Drift detection compares the actual configuration of deployed resources with the expected configuration recorded in the CloudFormation template. It is primarily for identifying changes made outside CloudFormation. See [Detect unmanaged configuration changes with drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html).

Drift detection also does not orchestrate the required order among the company's individual templates, and this option does not specify SNS or another mechanism for sending notifications to the data engineering team.

zh.question: 一家公司使用一系列独立的 Amazon CloudFormation 模板来部署其多区域应用程序。这些模板必须按照特定顺序部署。该公司对模板所做的更改比之前预期的更多，并且希望更高效地部署新模板。此外，数据工程团队必须收到有关模板所有更改的通知。公司应如何实现这些目标？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，以所需顺序部署 CloudFormation 模板。使用堆栈策略向数据工程团队发出警报。
options.B: 将 CloudFormation 模板托管在 Amazon S3 中。使用 Amazon S3 事件直接触发 CloudFormation 更新和 Amazon SNS 通知。
options.C: 实施 CloudFormation StackSets，并使用漂移检测触发向数据工程团队发送更新警报。
options.D: 利用 CloudFormation 嵌套堆栈和 StackSets 进行部署。使用 Amazon SNS 通知数据工程团队。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一个能够同时满足以下三个要求的解决方案：

1. 按照所需部署顺序协调多个相互依赖的 CloudFormation 模板。
2. 高效地在多个 AWS 区域部署和更新应用程序。
3. 通知数据工程团队有关 CloudFormation 更改/部署事件的信息。

## 正确答案：D

**利用 CloudFormation 嵌套堆栈和 StackSets 进行部署，并使用 Amazon SNS 通知数据工程团队。**

- **嵌套堆栈**允许根 CloudFormation 模板将其他模板作为 `AWS::CloudFormation::Stack` 资源进行引用。这样可将独立模板的集合转换为集中管理的层次结构。依赖关系可以强制执行顺序；AWS 的嵌套堆栈示例明确展示了第二个嵌套堆栈具有 `DependsOn: MyFirstNestedStack`。从根堆栈发起更新，并且 CloudFormation 仅更新模板发生更改的嵌套堆栈。请参阅[使用嵌套堆栈将模板拆分为可重用的部分](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-nested-stacks.html)。
- **StackSets** 提供多区域部署机制。AWS 指出，StackSets 可以通过一次操作在多个账户和区域中创建、更新或删除堆栈。StackSet 操作还可以使用按顺序进行的区域部署以及指定的区域部署顺序。请参阅[CloudFormation 最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)和 [StackSets 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-concepts.html)。
- **Amazon SNS** 可以与 CloudFormation 堆栈关联，以便向已订阅的团队成员或终端节点发送堆栈通知。AWS 提供了专门用于在 CloudFormation 堆栈上启用 SNS 通知的运行手册。请参阅 [`AWS-EnableCloudFormationSNSNotification`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/AWS-EnableCloudFormationStackSNSNotification.html)。

因此，D 是唯一结合了模板编排、多区域部署和团队通知的选项。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. Lambda 部署编排和堆栈策略

可以自定义构建 Lambda 函数，以按顺序调用 CloudFormation 操作，但这不必要地重新实现了嵌套堆栈已提供的编排功能，也不像 StackSets 那样直接解决高效多区域部署的问题。

更重要的是，**堆栈策略不是警报功能**。它们可保护堆栈资源免受指定更新操作的影响；不会通知团队。Amazon SNS 才是适当的通知机制。

### B. S3 事件直接触发 CloudFormation 更新

在 Amazon S3 中托管嵌套模板很常见，但 **S3 事件通知无法直接执行 CloudFormation 堆栈更新**。S3 事件目标包括 Lambda、SNS、SQS 和 EventBridge 等服务；仍需要一个中间工作流才能安全地调用 CloudFormation。

此选项也未提供 CloudFormation 原生机制来强制模板之间的依赖顺序，或管理协调一致的多区域部署。

### C. 使用漂移检测的 StackSets

StackSets 可满足多区域要求，但 **漂移检测不是模板更改通知机制**。漂移检测会将已部署资源的实际配置与 CloudFormation 模板中记录的预期配置进行比较。它主要用于识别在 CloudFormation 外部进行的更改。请参阅[使用漂移检测发现未经管理的配置更改](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)。

漂移检测同样无法编排公司独立模板之间所需的顺序，并且此选项未指定 SNS 或其他向数据工程团队发送通知的机制。

en.question: A DevOps engineer has implemented a CI/CD pipeline to deploy an AWS CloudFormation template that provisions a web application. The web application consists of an Application Load Balancer (ALB), a target group, a launch template that uses an Amazon Linux 2 AMI, an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances, a security group, and an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. The launch template includes user data that specifies a script to install and start the application. The initial deployment of the application was successful. The DevOps engineer made changes to update the version of the application with the user data. The CI/CD pipeline has deployed a new version of the template. However, the health checks on the ALB are now failing. The health checks have marked all targets as unhealthy. During investigation, the DevOps engineer notices that the CloudFormation stack has a status of UPDATE_COMPLETE. However, when the DevOps engineer connects to one of the EC2 instances and checks /var/log/messages, the DevOps engineer notices that the Apache web server failed to start successfully because of a configuration error. How can the DevOps engineer ensure that the CloudFormation deployment will fail if the user data fails to successfully finish running?

options.A: Use the cfn-signal helper script to signal success or failure to CloudFormation. Use the WaitOnResourceSignals update policy within the CloudFormation template. Set an appropriate timeout for the update policy.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for the UnhealthyHostCount metric. Include an appropriate alarm threshold for the target group. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the target to signal success or failure to CloudFormation.
options.C: Create a lifecycle hook on the Auto Scaling group by using the AWS::AutoScaling::LifecycleHook resource. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the target to signal success or failure to CloudFormation. Set an appropriate timeout on the lifecycle hook.
options.D: Use the Amazon CloudWatch agent to stream the cloud-init logs. Create a subscription filter that includes an AWS Lambda function with an appropriate invocation timeout. Configure the Lambda function to use the SignalResource API operation to signal success or failure to CloudFormation.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

CloudFormation reports `UPDATE_COMPLETE` because creating or replacing an EC2 instance does not, by itself, prove that the instance's user-data bootstrap completed successfully or that Apache started correctly. The deployment must explicitly report bootstrap success or failure back to CloudFormation, and CloudFormation must be configured to wait for that report during the Auto Scaling group update.

## Correct answer: A

Configure the Auto Scaling group's rolling `UpdatePolicy` with `WaitOnResourceSignals: true` and an appropriate `PauseTime`, then invoke `cfn-signal` at the end of the user-data workflow with the bootstrap command's exit status, for example:

```bash
# Install/configure/start the application and verify Apache
/path/to/bootstrap-script
rc=$?

/opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal -e "$rc" \
  --stack "${AWS::StackName}" \
  --resource WebAutoScalingGroup \
  --region "${AWS::Region}"
```

AWS documents that `cfn-signal` indicates whether EC2 instances were successfully created or updated and is used with an Auto Scaling group `UpdatePolicy` whose `WaitOnResourceSignals` property is enabled. The `-e` option derives success or failure from the supplied process exit code. CloudFormation then suspends the stack update until it receives the required signals or the timeout expires ([cfn-signal documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/cfn-signal.html)).

For `AutoScalingRollingUpdate`, `WaitOnResourceSignals` makes CloudFormation wait for success signals from new instances. When it is enabled, `PauseTime` acts as the timeout; if the expected signals are not received before that time expires, the update fails. `MinSuccessfulInstancesPercent` can also specify the percentage of updated instances that must signal successfully ([UpdatePolicy documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-updatepolicy.html)). AWS's Auto Scaling CloudFormation example likewise states that each new instance must signal within `PauseTime` before the update continues ([Auto Scaling template example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/quickref-ec2-auto-scaling.html)).

The user-data script must ensure that its reported exit status reflects the complete installation, configuration, service-start, and validation workflow. For example, it should explicitly check `systemctl start httpd` and/or `systemctl is-active httpd` before signaling success.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B:** A CloudWatch alarm with an SNS action can notify operators or automation about unhealthy targets, but an SNS notification does not inherently satisfy or fail a CloudFormation resource signal. This option also does not configure CloudFormation to wait for resource signals during the Auto Scaling group update.

- **C:** An Auto Scaling lifecycle hook pauses an instance during a launch or termination transition so that custom actions can run. Publishing hook notifications to SNS does not directly report the user-data script's result to CloudFormation. The option lacks the CloudFormation resource-signal mechanism and the rolling update's `WaitOnResourceSignals` configuration.

- **D:** Streaming logs and invoking Lambda is an unnecessarily indirect and unreliable way to infer bootstrap completion. A log subscription might detect selected error messages but does not reliably prove successful completion. More importantly, calling `SignalResource` is useful only when the relevant CloudFormation resource has a signaling policy that makes CloudFormation wait; this option does not add `WaitOnResourceSignals` or its deployment timeout. The Lambda invocation timeout is also not the CloudFormation resource-signal timeout.

Therefore, **A** is the direct, CloudFormation-native solution.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师实施了一个 CI/CD 管道，用于部署一个预置 Web 应用程序的 AWS CloudFormation 模板。该 Web 应用程序包括一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)、一个目标组、一个使用 Amazon Linux 2 AMI 的启动模板、一个由 Amazon EC2 实例组成的 Auto Scaling 组、一个安全组，以及一个 Amazon RDS for MySQL 数据库。启动模板包含用户数据，其中指定了用于安装和启动应用程序的脚本。应用程序的初始部署成功。DevOps 工程师对用户数据进行了更改，以更新应用程序版本。CI/CD 管道已部署新版本的模板。但是，ALB 上的运行状况检查现在失败了。运行状况检查已将所有目标标记为不正常。在调查期间，DevOps 工程师注意到 CloudFormation 堆栈的状态为 UPDATE_COMPLETE。但是，当 DevOps 工程师连接到其中一个 EC2 实例并检查 /var/log/messages 时，发现由于配置错误，Apache Web 服务器未能成功启动。DevOps 工程师如何确保如果用户数据未能成功完成运行，CloudFormation 部署将失败？

options.A: 使用 cfn-signal 帮助脚本向 CloudFormation 发送成功或失败信号。在 CloudFormation 模板中使用 WaitOnResourceSignals 更新策略。为更新策略设置适当的超时时间。
options.B: 为 UnhealthyHostCount 指标创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。为目标组设置适当的警报阈值。创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题作为目标，以向 CloudFormation 发送成功或失败信号。
options.C: 使用 AWS::AutoScaling::LifecycleHook 资源在 Auto Scaling 组上创建生命周期挂钩。创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题作为目标，以向 CloudFormation 发送成功或失败信号。为生命周期挂钩设置适当的超时时间。
options.D: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch agent 流式传输 cloud-init 日志。创建一个包含具有适当调用超时时间的 AWS Lambda 函数的订阅筛选器。将 Lambda 函数配置为使用 SignalResource API 操作向 CloudFormation 发送成功或失败信号。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

CloudFormation 报告 `UPDATE_COMPLETE`，因为仅创建或替换 EC2 实例本身并不能证明该实例的用户数据引导流程已成功完成，也不能证明 Apache 已正确启动。部署必须将引导流程的成功或失败显式报告回 CloudFormation，并且必须将 CloudFormation 配置为在 Auto Scaling 组更新期间等待该报告。

## 正确答案：A

使用 `WaitOnResourceSignals: true` 和适当的 `PauseTime` 配置 Auto Scaling 组的滚动 `UpdatePolicy`，然后在用户数据工作流程结束时，以引导命令的退出状态调用 `cfn-signal`，例如：

```bash
# Install/configure/start the application and verify Apache
/path/to/bootstrap-script
rc=$?

/opt/aws/bin/cfn-signal -e "$rc" \
  --stack "${AWS::StackName}" \
  --resource WebAutoScalingGroup \
  --region "${AWS::Region}"
```

AWS 文档说明，`cfn-signal` 表示 EC2 实例是否已成功创建或更新，并且与 Auto Scaling 组的 `UpdatePolicy` 配合使用，后者的 `WaitOnResourceSignals` 属性已启用。`-e` 选项根据所提供的进程退出代码确定成功或失败。随后，CloudFormation 会暂停堆栈更新，直到收到所需的信号或超时到期（[cfn-signal 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/cfn-signal.html)）。

对于 `AutoScalingRollingUpdate`，`WaitOnResourceSignals` 会使 CloudFormation 等待来自新实例的成功信号。启用后，`PauseTime` 将作为超时时间；如果在该时间到期前未收到预期信号，更新将失败。`MinSuccessfulInstancesPercent` 还可以指定必须成功发送信号的已更新实例百分比（[UpdatePolicy 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-updatepolicy.html)）。AWS 的 Auto Scaling CloudFormation 示例同样指出，每个新实例都必须在 `PauseTime` 内发送信号，更新才能继续（[Auto Scaling 模板示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/quickref-ec2-auto-scaling.html)）。

用户数据脚本必须确保其报告的退出状态能够反映完整的安装、配置、服务启动和验证工作流程。例如，在发送成功信号之前，它应显式检查 `systemctl start httpd` 和/或 `systemctl is-active httpd`。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **B：** 配置了 SNS 操作的 CloudWatch 警报可以通知运维人员或自动化程序目标不正常，但 SNS 通知本身并不会满足或导致 CloudFormation 资源信号失败。此选项也没有将 CloudFormation 配置为在 Auto Scaling 组更新期间等待资源信号。

- **C：** Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩会在实例启动或终止转换期间暂停实例，以便执行自定义操作。将挂钩通知发布到 SNS 不会直接向 CloudFormation 报告用户数据脚本的结果。该选项缺少 CloudFormation 资源信号机制以及滚动更新的 `WaitOnResourceSignals` 配置。

- **D：** 流式传输日志并调用 Lambda 是一种不必要地间接且不可靠的方法，用于推断引导流程是否完成。日志订阅可能会检测到选定的错误消息，但无法可靠地证明已成功完成。更重要的是，只有当相关 CloudFormation 资源具有使 CloudFormation 等待的信号策略时，调用 `SignalResource` 才有用；此选项没有添加 `WaitOnResourceSignals` 或其部署超时时间。Lambda 调用超时时间也不是 CloudFormation 资源信号超时时间。

因此，**A** 是直接且原生的 CloudFormation 解决方案。

en.question: A company has a data ingestion application that runs across multiple AWS accounts. The accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. The company needs to monitor the application and consolidate access to the application. Currently, the company is running the application on Amazon EC2 instances from several Auto Scaling groups. The EC2 instances have no access to the internet because the data is sensitive. Engineers have deployed the necessary VPC endpoints. The EC2 instances run a custom AMI that is built specifically for the application. To maintain and troubleshoot the application, system administrators need the ability to log in to the EC2 instances. This access must be automated and controlled centrally. The company’s security team must receive a notification whenever the instances are accessed. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to send notifications to the security team whenever a user logs in to an EC2 instance. Use EC2 Instance Connect to log in to the instances. Deploy Auto Scaling groups by using AWS CloudFormation. Use the cfn-init helper script to deploy appropriate VPC routes for external access. Rebuild the custom AMI so that the custom AMI includes AWS Systems Manager Agent.
options.B: Deploy a NAT gateway and a bastion host that has internet access. Create a security group that allows incoming traffic on all the EC2 instances from the bastion host. Install AWS Systems Manager Agent on all the EC2 instances. Use Auto Scaling group lifecycle hooks for monitoring and auditing access. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to log in to the instances. Send logs to a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export data to Amazon S3 for auditing. Send notifications to the security team by using S3 event notifications.
options.C: Use EC2 Image Builder to rebuild the custom AMI. Include the most recent version of AWS Systems Manager Agent in the image. Configure the Auto Scaling group to attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore role to all the EC2 instances. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to log in to the instances. Enable logging of session details to Amazon S3. Create an S3 event notification for new file uploads to send a message to the security team through an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager Automation to build Systems Manager Agent into the custom AMI. Configure AWS Config to attach an SCP to the root organization account to allow the EC2 instances to connect to Systems Manager. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to log in to the instances. Enable logging of session details to Amazon S3. Create an S3 event notification for new file uploads to send a message to the security team through an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a centrally controlled administrative-access method for EC2 instances that:

- Works without public internet access or a bastion host.
- Can be applied consistently to instances launched by Auto Scaling groups from a custom AMI.
- Provides auditable session records.
- Notifies the security team when an access-session log is created.

## Correct answer: C

**AWS Systems Manager Session Manager** is the appropriate access mechanism. Session Manager requires SSM Agent on the managed node, connectivity to the Systems Manager endpoints, and suitable instance permissions. The question states that the necessary VPC endpoints are already deployed, so the instances do not need internet access. AWS recommends keeping SSM Agent current, and confirms that Session Manager requires SSM Agent on each managed node ([Session Manager prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-prerequisites.html)).

Option C supplies the remaining components correctly:

1. **EC2 Image Builder rebuilds the custom AMI with SSM Agent.** This makes the agent part of the repeatable Auto Scaling deployment rather than relying on a post-launch manual installation. Image Builder automates image build pipelines and helps maintain compliant, up-to-date images ([EC2 Image Builder features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/what-is-image-builder.html)).
2. **The EC2 instances receive Systems Manager permissions.** In practice, the Auto Scaling launch template should reference an IAM instance profile whose role includes `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`. AWS states that this managed policy provides the required instance permissions for Session Manager ([Session Manager instance permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-getting-started-instance-profile.html)).
3. **Administrators connect through Session Manager.** This avoids inbound SSH exposure, public IP addresses, NAT gateways, and bastion hosts.
4. **Session data is written to Amazon S3.** Session Manager supports configuring an S3 bucket for session log data ([Session Manager S3 logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-logging-s3.html)).
5. **S3 sends an object-created event to an SNS topic.** S3 supports SNS topics as event-notification destinations and supports `s3:ObjectCreated:*` events, allowing subscribed security personnel or systems to receive notifications when session log objects are uploaded ([S3 event types and destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html)).

This satisfies private connectivity, repeatable Auto Scaling deployment, centralized controlled access, auditing, and security notification requirements.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

- EC2 Instance Connect still requires SSH network connectivity. Depending on the connection method, the instance needs public connectivity, private network reachability, or an EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint, and inbound SSH must be permitted ([EC2 Instance Connect prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-connect-prerequisites.html)).
- Adding routes for external access conflicts with the requirement that the sensitive instances have no internet access.
- An EventBridge rule does not inherently detect every operating-system login merely because EC2 Instance Connect is used.
- Although the option eventually adds SSM Agent to the AMI, it does not use Session Manager or provide the specified S3-to-SNS auditing and notification workflow.

### B

- A NAT gateway and internet-accessible bastion host are unnecessary and increase the attack surface. The existing VPC endpoints allow Session Manager to work without internet access.
- Installing SSM Agent individually on running instances is less reliable for an Auto Scaling fleet than building it into the custom AMI; replacement instances could launch without the required configuration unless additional automation were provided.
- Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks apply to instance **launching and terminating** transitions, not administrator login or Session Manager access events ([Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)).
- S3 event notifications need a supported destination such as SNS, SQS, Lambda, or EventBridge. The option merely says to send notifications using S3 event notifications and does not specify an SNS topic or another mechanism that actually delivers the notification to the security team.

### D

- The solution omits the necessary EC2 IAM instance profile/role permissions for the instances to communicate with Systems Manager.
- An SCP cannot grant those permissions. SCPs only define the maximum permissions available to IAM users and roles; permissions must still be granted through appropriate IAM policies. AWS explicitly states that an SCP **never grants permissions** ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).
- AWS Config is a configuration-assessment and compliance service; it is not the mechanism for attaching an SCP to provide instance connectivity.
- Therefore, even though the proposed Session Manager logging and S3-to-SNS notification pattern is reasonable, the stated authorization design would not make the EC2 instances valid Systems Manager managed nodes.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个数据摄取应用程序，该应用程序跨多个 AWS 账户运行。这些账户位于 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织内。该公司需要监控该应用程序并集中管理对该应用程序的访问。目前，公司正在使用来自多个 Auto Scaling 组的 Amazon EC2 实例运行该应用程序。由于数据敏感，EC2 实例无法访问互联网。工程师已部署必要的 VPC 终端节点。EC2 实例运行专为该应用程序构建的自定义 AMI。为了维护和排查该应用程序，系统管理员需要能够登录 EC2 实例。此访问必须自动化并进行集中控制。每当有人访问这些实例时，公司的安全团队必须收到通知。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在用户登录 EC2 实例时向安全团队发送通知。使用 EC2 Instance Connect 登录实例。使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署 Auto Scaling 组。使用 cfn-init 帮助脚本部署适当的 VPC 路由以实现外部访问。重新构建自定义 AMI，使该自定义 AMI 包含 AWS Systems Manager Agent。
options.B: 部署一个具有互联网访问权限的 NAT 网关和堡垒主机。创建一个安全组，允许来自堡垒主机的传入流量访问所有 EC2 实例。在所有 EC2 实例上安装 AWS Systems Manager Agent。使用 Auto Scaling 组生命周期挂钩来监控和审计访问。使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 登录实例。将日志发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中的日志组。将数据导出到 Amazon S3 以进行审计。使用 S3 事件通知向安全团队发送通知。
options.C: 使用 EC2 Image Builder 重新构建自定义 AMI。在映像中包含最新版本的 AWS Systems Manager Agent。配置 Auto Scaling 组，以便将 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 角色附加到所有 EC2 实例。使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 登录实例。启用将会话详细信息记录到 Amazon S3。为新文件上传创建 S3 事件通知，以便通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题向安全团队发送消息。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 将 Systems Manager Agent 构建到自定义 AMI 中。配置 AWS Config 以将 SCP 附加到根组织账户，从而允许 EC2 实例连接到 Systems Manager。使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 登录实例。启用将会话详细信息记录到 Amazon S3。为新文件上传创建 S3 事件通知，以便通过 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题向安全团队发送消息。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

公司需要一种集中控制的 EC2 实例管理访问方法，该方法必须：

- 无需公共互联网访问或堡垒主机即可运行。
- 能够一致地应用于由 Auto Scaling 组根据自定义 AMI 启动的实例。
- 提供可审计的会话记录。
- 在创建访问会话日志时通知安全团队。

## 正确答案：C

**AWS Systems Manager Session Manager** 是适当的访问机制。Session Manager 要求受管节点上安装 SSM Agent、能够连接到 Systems Manager 终端节点，并具有适当的实例权限。题目说明必要的 VPC 终端节点已部署，因此实例无需互联网访问。AWS 建议保持 SSM Agent 为最新版本，并确认 Session Manager 要求每个受管节点上都安装 SSM Agent（[Session Manager prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-prerequisites.html)）。

选项 C 正确提供了其余组件：

1. **EC2 Image Builder 使用 SSM Agent 重新构建自定义 AMI。** 这使 agent 成为可重复的 Auto Scaling 部署的一部分，而不是依赖启动后的手动安装。Image Builder 可自动化映像构建管道，并帮助维护合规且最新的映像（[EC2 Image Builder features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/what-is-image-builder.html)）。
2. **EC2 实例获得 Systems Manager 权限。** 实际上，Auto Scaling 启动模板应引用一个 IAM 实例配置文件，其角色包含 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`。AWS 指出，该托管策略提供 Session Manager 所需的实例权限（[Session Manager instance permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-getting-started-instance-profile.html)）。
3. **管理员通过 Session Manager 进行连接。** 这避免了入站 SSH 暴露、公有 IP 地址、NAT 网关和堡垒主机。
4. **会话数据写入 Amazon S3。** Session Manager 支持配置用于存储会话日志数据的 S3 存储桶（[Session Manager S3 logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/session-manager-logging-s3.html)）。
5. **S3 将对象创建事件发送到 SNS 主题。** S3 支持将 SNS 主题作为事件通知目标，并支持 `s3:ObjectCreated:*` 事件，因此在上传会话日志对象时，订阅的安全人员或系统可以收到通知（[S3 event types and destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html)）。

这满足了私有连接、可重复的 Auto Scaling 部署、集中受控访问、审计和安全通知要求。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A

- EC2 Instance Connect 仍需要 SSH 网络连接。根据连接方式的不同，实例需要公共连接、私有网络可达性或 EC2 Instance Connect Endpoint，并且必须允许入站 SSH（[EC2 Instance Connect prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-connect-prerequisites.html)）。
- 添加用于外部访问的路由与敏感实例不得访问互联网的要求相冲突。
- 仅因使用 EC2 Instance Connect，EventBridge 规则并不会自动检测每次操作系统登录。
- 虽然该选项最终会将 SSM Agent 添加到 AMI，但它没有使用 Session Manager，也未提供指定的 S3 到 SNS 审计和通知工作流程。

### B

- NAT 网关和可访问互联网的堡垒主机并非必要，还会增加攻击面。现有的 VPC 终端节点使 Session Manager 无需互联网即可工作。
- 与将 SSM Agent 内置到自定义 AMI 相比，在运行中的实例上逐一安装 SSM Agent 对 Auto Scaling 实例组而言可靠性较低；除非提供额外自动化，否则替换实例可能会在缺少所需配置的情况下启动。
- Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩适用于实例**启动和终止**转换，而不适用于管理员登录或 Session Manager 访问事件（[Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/lifecycle-hooks.html)）。
- S3 事件通知需要受支持的目标，例如 SNS、SQS、Lambda 或 EventBridge。该选项仅表示使用 S3 事件通知发送通知，并未指定 SNS 主题或其他能实际将通知传送给安全团队的机制。

### D

- 该解决方案缺少 EC2 实例与 Systems Manager 通信所需的 EC2 IAM 实例配置文件/角色权限。
- SCP 无法授予这些权限。SCP 仅定义 IAM 用户和角色可拥有的最大权限；仍必须通过适当的 IAM 策略授予权限。AWS 明确指出，SCP **永远不会授予权限**（[SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。
- AWS Config 是一项配置评估和合规服务；它并非用于附加 SCP 以提供实例连接的机制。
- 因此，尽管所提议的 Session Manager 日志记录和 S3 到 SNS 通知模式是合理的，但所述授权设计无法使 EC2 实例成为有效的 Systems Manager 受管节点。

en.question: A company uses Amazon S3 to store proprietary information. The development team creates buckets for new projects on a daily basis. The security team wants to ensure that all existing and future buckets have encryption, logging, and versioning enabled. Additionally, no buckets should ever be publicly read or write accessible. What should a DevOps engineer do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS CloudTrail and configure automatic remediation using AWS Lambda.
options.B: Enable AWS Config rules and configure automatic remediation using AWS Systems Manager documents.
options.C: Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and configure automatic remediation using Amazon EventBridge.
options.D: Enable AWS Systems Manager and configure automatic remediation using Systems Manager documents.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a **continuous compliance and automatic remediation** solution for a frequently changing population of S3 buckets. The solution must evaluate both existing and newly created buckets for encryption, server access logging, versioning, and public read/write access, and then correct noncompliant configurations.

## Correct answer: B

**Enable AWS Config rules and configure automatic remediation using AWS Systems Manager documents.**

AWS Config provides managed rules for all the required S3 controls:

- [`S3_BUCKET_SERVER_SIDE_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled.html) detects buckets without the required server-side encryption configuration.
- [`S3_BUCKET_LOGGING_ENABLED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-logging-enabled.html) detects buckets without server access logging.
- [`S3_BUCKET_VERSIONING_ENABLED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-versioning-enabled.html) checks whether versioning is enabled.
- [`S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited.html) evaluates Block Public Access settings, bucket policies, and ACLs for public read access.
- [`S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_WRITE_PROHIBITED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-public-write-prohibited.html) performs the corresponding evaluation for public write access.

AWS Config can associate remediation actions with these rules and automatically remediate resources identified as noncompliant. AWS states that Config remediation uses **Systems Manager Automation documents**, which can be AWS-managed or custom documents ([AWS Config remediation documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)). This provides the desired evaluation-and-correction workflow for existing buckets and future configuration changes.

For example, AWS supplies the Systems Manager Automation runbook [`AWSConfigRemediation-ConfigureS3BucketPublicAccessBlock`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-block-public-s3-bucket.html), which configures all four bucket-level S3 Block Public Access settings.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Enable AWS CloudTrail and configure automatic remediation using AWS Lambda

CloudTrail records AWS API activity for auditing. Although CloudTrail events, EventBridge, and Lambda could be assembled into a custom remediation solution, this would require custom logic to identify every relevant configuration state and evaluate existing resources. It does not provide the native desired-state compliance rules and remediation association that AWS Config provides.

### C. Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and configure automatic remediation using Amazon EventBridge

Trusted Advisor provides recommendations and checks, but it is not the appropriate continuous configuration-compliance engine for enforcing all five listed S3 controls. EventBridge routes events; it does not by itself change the bucket configuration. This option also omits a remediation executor such as Systems Manager Automation or Lambda.

### D. Enable AWS Systems Manager and configure automatic remediation using Systems Manager documents

Systems Manager Automation can execute remediation actions, but Systems Manager alone does not continuously evaluate every S3 bucket against the required compliance rules. AWS Config supplies the resource evaluation, compliance status, and automatic trigger; Systems Manager Automation performs the corrective action. Therefore, Config and Systems Manager must be used together as described in option B.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon S3 存储专有信息。开发团队每天都会为新项目创建存储桶。安全团队希望确保所有现有和未来的存储桶都启用加密、日志记录和版本控制。此外，任何存储桶都不得具有公开读或写访问权限。DevOps 工程师应如何做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 启用 AWS CloudTrail 并使用 AWS Lambda 配置自动修复。
options.B: 启用 AWS Config 规则并使用 AWS Systems Manager 文档配置自动修复。
options.C: 启用 AWS Trusted Advisor 并使用 Amazon EventBridge 配置自动修复。
options.D: 启用 AWS Systems Manager 并使用 Systems Manager 文档配置自动修复。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该公司需要为频繁变化的 S3 存储桶群体提供**持续合规性评估和自动修复**解决方案。该解决方案必须针对现有及新创建的存储桶，评估加密、服务器访问日志记录、版本控制以及公开读/写访问，并修正不合规配置。

## 正确答案：B

**启用 AWS Config 规则并使用 AWS Systems Manager 文档配置自动修复。**

AWS Config 为所有必需的 S3 控制项提供托管规则：

- [`S3_BUCKET_SERVER_SIDE_ENCRYPTION_ENABLED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-server-side-encryption-enabled.html) 可检测未配置所需服务器端加密的存储桶。
- [`S3_BUCKET_LOGGING_ENABLED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-logging-enabled.html) 可检测未启用服务器访问日志记录的存储桶。
- [`S3_BUCKET_VERSIONING_ENABLED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-versioning-enabled.html) 检查是否启用了版本控制。
- [`S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_READ_PROHIBITED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited.html) 会评估 Block Public Access 设置、存储桶策略和 ACL，以确定是否存在公开读取访问。
- [`S3_BUCKET_PUBLIC_WRITE_PROHIBITED`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-public-write-prohibited.html) 对公开写入访问执行相应的评估。

AWS Config 可以将修复操作与这些规则关联，并自动修复识别为不合规的资源。AWS 指出，Config 修复使用 **Systems Manager Automation 文档**，这些文档可以是 AWS 托管文档或自定义文档（[AWS Config 修复文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)）。这为现有存储桶和未来配置更改提供了所需的评估与纠正工作流。

例如，AWS 提供了 Systems Manager Automation runbook [`AWSConfigRemediation-ConfigureS3BucketPublicAccessBlock`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-block-public-s3-bucket.html)，用于配置全部四项存储桶级别的 S3 Block Public Access 设置。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 启用 AWS CloudTrail 并使用 AWS Lambda 配置自动修复

CloudTrail 记录 AWS API 活动以用于审计。虽然可以将 CloudTrail 事件、EventBridge 和 Lambda 组合成自定义修复解决方案，但这需要自定义逻辑来识别每一种相关配置状态并评估现有资源。它不提供 AWS Config 所提供的原生目标状态合规规则和修复关联功能。

### C. 启用 AWS Trusted Advisor 并使用 Amazon EventBridge 配置自动修复

Trusted Advisor 提供建议和检查，但它并非用于强制实施所列全部五项 S3 控制措施的适当持续配置合规性引擎。EventBridge 用于路由事件；它本身不会更改存储桶配置。此选项还缺少 Systems Manager Automation 或 Lambda 等修复执行器。

### D. 启用 AWS Systems Manager 并使用 Systems Manager 文档配置自动修复

Systems Manager Automation 可以执行修复操作，但仅使用 Systems Manager 无法持续根据所需合规规则评估每个 S3 存储桶。AWS Config 提供资源评估、合规状态和自动触发机制；Systems Manager Automation 执行纠正操作。因此，必须如选项 B 所述结合使用 Config 和 Systems Manager。

en.question: A DevOps engineer is researching the least expensive way to implement an image batch processing cluster on AWS. The application cannot run in Docker containers and must run on Amazon EC2. The batch job stores checkpoint data on an NFS volume and can tolerate interruptions. Configuring the cluster software from a generic EC2 Linux image takes 30 minutes. What is the MOST cost-effective solution?

options.A: Use Amazon EFS for checkpoint data. To complete the job, use an EC2 Auto Scaling group and an On-Demand pricing model to provision EC2 instances temporarily.
options.B: Use GlusterFS on EC2 instances for checkpoint data. To run the batch job, configure EC2 instances manually. When the job completes, shut down the instances manually.
options.C: Use Amazon EFS for checkpoint data. Use EC2 Fleet to launch EC2 Spot Instances, and utilize user data to configure the EC2 Linux instance on startup.
options.D: Use Amazon EFS for checkpoint data. Use EC2 Fleet to launch EC2 Spot Instances. Create a custom AMI for the cluster and use the latest AMI when creating instances.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The workload must run directly on EC2, requires shared NFS storage for checkpoint data, and can recover from compute interruptions. The key optimization detail is that configuring every generic Linux instance takes **30 minutes**. The most cost-effective design must therefore minimize both the EC2 purchase price and repeated paid configuration time.

## Correct answer: D

**Use Amazon EFS for checkpoint data, launch EC2 Spot Instances through EC2 Fleet, and use a custom AMI with the cluster software already installed.**

- **Amazon EFS** is appropriate for the checkpoint volume because it provides shared, scalable file storage for multiple EC2 Linux instances and is mounted using NFS. Checkpoints remain available when individual Spot Instances are interrupted or replaced. See [Use Amazon EFS with Amazon EC2 Linux instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AmazonEFS.html).
- **EC2 Spot Instances** are appropriate because the batch job explicitly tolerates interruptions. EC2 Fleet can use Spot capacity to optimize costs and can automatically request replacement Spot capacity after interruptions. See [EC2 Fleet features and benefits](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Fleets.html).
- A **custom AMI** can be created from a configured EC2 instance and reused to launch multiple instances with the same software configuration. See [Amazon Machine Images in Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AMIs.html). This avoids repeating the 30-minute cluster installation for every worker launch and every Spot replacement.

Although storing the AMI's backing snapshots has a cost, the AMI is built once and reused. That is more cost-effective for a cluster than paying for 30 minutes of nonproductive initialization on every instance, especially when Spot interruptions can cause replacement instances to be launched repeatedly.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EFS with an Auto Scaling group using On-Demand Instances

EFS is suitable, but **On-Demand pricing is unnecessarily expensive** for an interruption-tolerant batch workload. Spot capacity through EC2 Fleet provides the lower-cost compute model and supports automated replacement of interrupted Spot Instances.

### B. GlusterFS on EC2 with manual provisioning and shutdown

This introduces additional EC2 instances, software management, and operational effort to operate a self-managed distributed file system when managed EFS already meets the shared NFS requirement. It also relies on manual instance configuration and shutdown and does not take advantage of lower-cost Spot capacity. It is neither the least expensive nor the most operationally efficient option.

### C. EFS with EC2 Fleet Spot Instances and user data configuration

This option correctly selects EFS and Spot Instances, but it runs the full cluster configuration during every instance launch. AWS documents that adding installation and configuration tasks through EC2 user data **increases instance boot time**. See [EC2 user data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html).

Given the stated 30-minute configuration duration, each worker—and each replacement after a Spot interruption—would incur approximately 30 minutes of paid EC2 runtime before becoming productive. Preinstalling the software in a reusable custom AMI, as in option D, avoids this repeated cost and is therefore more cost-effective.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在研究在 AWS 上实施图像批处理集群的成本最低方案。该应用程序无法在 Docker 容器中运行，必须在 Amazon EC2 上运行。批处理作业将检查点数据存储在 NFS 卷上，并且可以容忍中断。从通用 EC2 Linux 映像配置集群软件需要 30 分钟。哪种解决方案的成本效益最高？

options.A: 将 Amazon EFS 用于检查点数据。为完成作业，使用 EC2 Auto Scaling 组和 On-Demand 定价模型临时预置 EC2 实例。
options.B: 在 EC2 实例上使用 GlusterFS 存储检查点数据。手动配置 EC2 实例以运行批处理作业。作业完成后，手动关闭实例。
options.C: 将 Amazon EFS 用于检查点数据。使用 EC2 Fleet 启动 EC2 Spot Instances，并利用用户数据在启动时配置 EC2 Linux 实例。
options.D: 将 Amazon EFS 用于检查点数据。使用 EC2 Fleet 启动 EC2 Spot Instances。为集群创建自定义 AMI，并在创建实例时使用最新的 AMI。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该工作负载必须直接在 EC2 上运行，需要用于检查点数据的共享 NFS 存储，并且能够从计算中断中恢复。关键优化细节是，配置每个通用 Linux 实例需要 **30 分钟**。因此，成本效益最高的设计必须同时尽量降低 EC2 购买价格和反复发生的付费配置时间。

## 正确答案：D

**将 Amazon EFS 用于检查点数据，通过 EC2 Fleet 启动 EC2 Spot Instances，并使用已预装集群软件的自定义 AMI。**

- **Amazon EFS** 适合作为检查点卷，因为它为多个 EC2 Linux 实例提供共享、可扩展的文件存储，并且通过 NFS 挂载。当单个 Spot Instances 被中断或替换时，检查点仍然可用。请参阅 [将 Amazon EFS 与 Amazon EC2 Linux 实例结合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AmazonEFS.html)。
- **EC2 Spot Instances** 很适合，因为批处理作业明确能够容忍中断。EC2 Fleet 可以使用 Spot 容量来优化成本，并且可以在中断后自动请求替代 Spot 容量。请参阅 [EC2 Fleet 功能和优势](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/Fleets.html)。
- 可以从已配置的 EC2 实例创建 **自定义 AMI**，并重复用于启动具有相同软件配置的多个实例。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 中的 Amazon Machine Images](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/AMIs.html)。这样可以避免在每次启动工作节点以及每次替换 Spot 实例时，重复进行 30 分钟的集群安装。

尽管存储 AMI 的后备快照会产生费用，但 AMI 只需构建一次即可重复使用。与为每次实例启动支付 30 分钟无生产力初始化的费用相比，这对于集群更具成本效益，特别是在 Spot 中断可能导致反复启动替代实例时。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 使用 On-Demand Instances 的 EFS 和 Auto Scaling 组

EFS 是合适的，但对于可容忍中断的批处理工作负载，**On-Demand 定价的费用没有必要地更高**。通过 EC2 Fleet 使用 Spot 容量可提供成本更低的计算模式，并支持自动替换被中断的 Spot Instances。

### B. 在 EC2 上使用 GlusterFS 并手动预置和关闭

当托管式 EFS 已满足共享 NFS 要求时，此选项还会引入额外的 EC2 实例、软件管理和运维工作，以运行自我管理的分布式文件系统。它还依赖手动配置和关闭实例，且没有利用成本更低的 Spot 容量。它既不是成本最低的选项，也不是运维效率最高的选项。

### C. 使用 EFS、EC2 Fleet Spot Instances 和用户数据配置

此选项正确地选择了 EFS 和 Spot Instances，但它会在每次实例启动期间运行完整的集群配置。AWS 文档指出，通过 EC2 用户数据添加安装和配置任务会**增加实例启动时间**。请参阅 [EC2 用户数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)。

鉴于题目所述的 30 分钟配置时长，每个工作节点以及每个 Spot 中断后的替代实例，在开始产生效益之前都会产生约 30 分钟的付费 EC2 运行时间。与此相比，选项 D 通过在可重用的自定义 AMI 中预安装软件，避免了这项重复成本，因此更具成本效益。

en.question: A company recently migrated its legacy application from on-premises to AWS. The application is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer, which is behind Amazon API Gateway. The company wants to ensure users experience minimal disruptions during any deployment of a new version of the application. The company also wants to ensure it can quickly roll back updates if there is an issue. Which solution will meet these requirements with MINIMAL changes to the application?

options.A: Introduce changes as a separate environment parallel to the existing one. Configure API Gateway to use a canary release deployment to send a small subset of user traffic to the new environment.
options.B: Introduce changes as a separate environment parallel to the existing one. Update the application’s DNS alias records to point to the new environment.
options.C: Introduce changes as a separate target group behind the existing Application Load Balancer. Configure API Gateway to route user traffic to the new target group in steps.
options.D: Introduce changes as a separate target group behind the existing Application Load Balancer. Configure API Gateway to route all traffic to the Application Load Balancer, which then sends the traffic to the new target group.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application currently follows this request path:

`Users → API Gateway → Application Load Balancer → EC2 instances`

The company needs a deployment strategy that:

1. Exposes only a small portion of users to the new application version initially.
2. Keeps the existing version available during validation.
3. Allows traffic to be returned quickly to the existing version if the new version has problems.
4. Requires minimal application-code changes.

## Correct answer: A

**Deploy the new version into a parallel environment and use an API Gateway canary release to send a small percentage of traffic to it.**

API Gateway canary settings support a configurable `percentTraffic`, so only a selected percentage of API requests is sent through the canary deployment. Canary-specific stage-variable overrides are also supported. AWS documents that stage variables can specify different HTTP backend endpoints, allowing the production path to reference the existing environment while the canary path references the new environment. This is infrastructure and API configuration rather than an application redesign.

The company can begin with a small percentage, monitor the canary-specific logs and metrics, and gradually increase or decrease the request distribution. If an issue occurs, it can reduce the canary percentage to 0 or discard the canary while the existing production environment remains available. API Gateway explicitly permits increasing or decreasing canary request distribution between 0% and 100%.

See:

- [Canary release deployment in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)
- [Use cases for API Gateway stage variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/stage-variables.html)
- [Updating an API Gateway canary release](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/update-canary-deployment.html)

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Switch the DNS alias to the new environment

This is primarily an all-at-once blue/green cutover rather than a canary rollout. It would expose the entire user population to the new version without first limiting risk to a small subset. Rollback is also less immediate and deterministic because DNS recursive resolvers cache records according to their TTL; AWS notes that record changes take longer to take effect while resolvers continue using cached values. Therefore, this does not provide the same controlled rollout and rapid traffic reversal as API Gateway canary settings.

See [Route 53 TTL behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-basic.html).

### C. Create a new ALB target group and configure API Gateway to route traffic to that target group in steps

API Gateway integrates with the ALB endpoint; it does not directly choose one of the ALB's target groups. Target-group selection and weighted distribution are configured in the **ALB listener's forward action**, not in API Gateway. AWS documents that an ALB forward action can distribute traffic across multiple target groups by assigning weights. Thus, a valid target-group-based design would require configuring weighted forwarding on the ALB, but that is not what option C says.

See [Application Load Balancer forward actions and weighted target groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html).

### D. Route all traffic through the ALB to the new target group

This performs an all-at-once cutover to the new version. Although changing the ALB listener back to the old target group could provide rollback, every user would be exposed immediately if the new version were defective. It therefore does not minimize user disruption as effectively as a canary rollout. The ALB can perform gradual weighted routing between target groups, but option D explicitly sends traffic to the new target group rather than describing a weighted, incremental shift.

Therefore, **A** most directly satisfies limited initial exposure, rapid rollback, and minimal application changes.

zh.question: 一家公司最近将其旧版应用程序从本地迁移到 AWS。该应用程序托管在 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上，而 Application Load Balancer 位于 Amazon API Gateway 后面。公司希望确保用户在部署任何新版本应用程序期间受到的干扰最小。公司还希望确保在出现问题时能够快速回滚更新。哪种解决方案能以对应用程序进行最少更改的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 将更改作为与现有环境并行的独立环境引入。配置 API Gateway 使用金丝雀发布部署，将一小部分用户流量发送到新环境。
options.B: 将更改作为与现有环境并行的独立环境引入。更新应用程序的 DNS 别名记录，使其指向新环境。
options.C: 将更改作为现有 Application Load Balancer 后面的独立目标组引入。配置 API Gateway 分阶段将用户流量路由到新目标组。
options.D: 将更改作为现有 Application Load Balancer 后面的独立目标组引入。配置 API Gateway 将所有流量路由到 Application Load Balancer，然后由其将流量发送到新目标组。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

应用程序当前遵循以下请求路径：

`Users → API Gateway → Application Load Balancer → EC2 instances`

公司需要一种部署策略，该策略应：

1. 初始时仅让一小部分用户接触新版本应用程序。
2. 在验证期间保持现有版本可用。
3. 如果新版本出现问题，能够迅速将流量恢复至现有版本。
4. 只需要对应用程序代码进行最少更改。

## 正确答案：A

**将新版本部署到并行环境，并使用 API Gateway 金丝雀发布将一小部分流量发送到该环境。**

API Gateway 金丝雀设置支持可配置的 `percentTraffic`，因此只有选定比例的 API 请求会通过金丝雀部署发送。还支持金丝雀专用的阶段变量覆盖。AWS 文档说明，阶段变量可以指定不同的 HTTP 后端端点，从而使生产路径引用现有环境，而金丝雀路径引用新环境。这属于基础设施和 API 配置，而不是重新设计应用程序。

公司可以从较小比例开始，监控金丝雀专用的日志和指标，并逐步增加或减少请求分配。如果出现问题，可以将金丝雀比例降至 0，或弃用金丝雀，而现有生产环境仍保持可用。API Gateway 明确允许在 0% 到 100% 之间增加或减少金丝雀请求分配比例。

请参阅：

- [API Gateway 中的金丝雀发布部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/canary-release.html)
- [API Gateway 阶段变量的使用案例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/stage-variables.html)
- [更新 API Gateway 金丝雀发布](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/update-canary-deployment.html)

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 将 DNS 别名切换到新环境

这主要是一次性蓝绿切换，而非金丝雀发布。它会让全部用户直接接触新版本，而不会先将风险限制在一小部分用户范围内。由于 DNS 递归解析器会根据其 TTL 缓存记录，回滚也不够即时和确定；AWS 指出，当解析器继续使用缓存值时，记录更改需要较长时间才能生效。因此，它无法像 API Gateway 金丝雀设置一样提供受控发布和快速流量恢复。

请参阅 [Route 53 TTL 行为](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-basic.html)。

### C. 创建新的 ALB 目标组，并配置 API Gateway 分阶段将流量路由到该目标组

API Gateway 集成的是 ALB 端点；它不会直接选择 ALB 的某个目标组。目标组选择和加权分配是在 **ALB 侦听器的转发操作** 中配置的，而不是在 API Gateway 中。AWS 文档说明，ALB 转发操作可以通过分配权重，在多个目标组之间分配流量。因此，一个有效的基于目标组的设计需要在 ALB 上配置加权转发，但这并不是选项 C 所描述的内容。

请参阅 [Application Load Balancer 转发操作和加权目标组](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)。

### D. 通过 ALB 将所有流量路由到新目标组

这会将流量一次性切换到新版本。尽管将 ALB 侦听器切回旧目标组可以实现回滚，但如果新版本存在缺陷，所有用户都会立即受到影响。因此，与金丝雀发布相比，它不能同样有效地将对用户的干扰降到最低。ALB 可以在目标组之间执行渐进式加权路由，但选项 D 明确表示将流量发送到新目标组，而没有描述加权的增量流量迁移。

因此，**A** 最直接地满足有限的初始暴露范围、快速回滚和最少应用程序更改的要求。

en.question: A company is storing 100 GB of log data in .csv format in an Amazon S3 bucket. SQL developers want to query this data and generate graphs to visualize it. The SQL developers also need an efficient, automated way to store metadata from the .csv file. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of effort? (Choose three.)

options.A: Filter the data through AWS X-Ray to visualize the data.
options.B: Filter the data through Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
options.C: Query the data with Amazon Athena.
options.D: Query the data with Amazon Redshift.
options.E: Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog as the persistent metadata store.
options.F: Use Amazon DynamoDB as the persistent metadata store.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs a low-operations analytics pipeline for CSV log files that already reside in Amazon S3:

1. Query the S3 data with SQL.
2. Build graphs and visualizations from the queryable data.
3. Persist the dataset's schema and other metadata, ideally with automated schema discovery.

## Correct answers: B, C, and E

- **C. Query the data with Amazon Athena.** Athena can analyze data directly in Amazon S3 by using standard SQL. It is serverless, so there is no infrastructure to provision or manage, making it the least-effort query service for this scenario. See [What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html).

- **E. Use the AWS Glue Data Catalog as the persistent metadata store.** The Glue Data Catalog is AWS Glue's persistent metadata store. A Glue crawler can inspect the CSV files, infer their schema, and create metadata tables in the catalog. Athena uses the Glue Data Catalog for metadata such as databases, tables, columns, and views associated with data in S3. See [AWS Glue terminology](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/components-key-concepts.html), [AWS Glue crawler workflow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-crawler.html), and [Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to connect to your data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/data-sources-glue.html).

- **B. Filter the data through Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.** Although “filter” is imprecise wording, QuickSight is the appropriate visualization service. QuickSight can create a dataset from Athena, use an Athena table or custom SQL, and then visualize the resulting data in analyses and dashboards. See [Creating a dataset using Amazon Athena data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/create-a-data-set-athena.html).

Together, the least-effort architecture is **S3 → Glue crawler/Data Catalog → Athena → QuickSight**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Filter the data through AWS X-Ray to visualize the data — Incorrect.** X-Ray is a distributed tracing service for analyzing requests handled by instrumented applications, including downstream calls, latency, and service dependencies. It is not a general-purpose BI tool for graphing arbitrary CSV datasets stored in S3. See [What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html).

- **D. Query the data with Amazon Redshift — Incorrect.** Redshift can support analytics and can access S3 data in some architectures, but it is unnecessary for this requirement. Athena queries the existing S3 files directly with SQL and is serverless, requiring less setup and administration. Therefore, Athena is the better choice when the question prioritizes the least effort.

- **F. Use Amazon DynamoDB as the persistent metadata store — Incorrect.** DynamoDB could technically hold custom application records, but it is not the integrated schema catalog for Athena's S3 tables. Using it would require a custom metadata design and automation. The Glue Data Catalog is specifically designed as a persistent metadata store, and Glue crawlers can automatically populate it from S3 data.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon S3 存储桶中以 .csv 格式存储了 100 GB 的日志数据。SQL 开发人员希望查询这些数据并生成图表以将其可视化。SQL 开发人员还需要一种高效、自动化的方法来存储 .csv 文件中的元数据。以下哪种步骤组合能以最少的工作量满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 通过 AWS X-Ray 筛选数据以将数据可视化。
options.B: 通过 Amazon QuickSight 筛选数据以将数据可视化。
options.C: 使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Redshift 查询数据。
options.E: 使用 AWS Glue Data Catalog 作为持久性元数据存储。
options.F: 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为持久性元数据存储。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要为已位于 Amazon S3 中的 CSV 日志文件构建一个低运维的分析管道：

1. 使用 SQL 查询 S3 数据。
2. 基于可查询的数据构建图表和可视化内容。
3. 持久化数据集的架构及其他元数据，最好能够自动发现架构。

## 正确答案：B、C 和 E

- **C. 使用 Amazon Athena 查询数据。** Athena 可以使用标准 SQL 直接分析 Amazon S3 中的数据。它是无服务器的，因此无需预置或管理基础设施，使其成为此场景下最省力的查询服务。请参阅 [What is Amazon Athena?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/what-is.html)。

- **E. 使用 AWS Glue Data Catalog 作为持久性元数据存储。** Glue Data Catalog 是 AWS Glue 的持久性元数据存储。Glue 爬虫可以检查 CSV 文件、推断其架构，并在目录中创建元数据表。Athena 使用 Glue Data Catalog 来获取与 S3 中数据关联的数据库、表、列和视图等元数据。请参阅 [AWS Glue terminology](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/components-key-concepts.html)、[AWS Glue crawler workflow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/add-crawler.html) 和 [Use AWS Glue Data Catalog to connect to your data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/data-sources-glue.html)。

- **B. 通过 Amazon QuickSight 筛选数据以将数据可视化。** 尽管“筛选”这一措辞并不准确，但 QuickSight 是合适的可视化服务。QuickSight 可以从 Athena 创建数据集，使用 Athena 表或自定义 SQL，然后在分析和控制面板中将生成的数据可视化。请参阅 [Creating a dataset using Amazon Athena data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/create-a-data-set-athena.html)。

综上，最省力的架构是 **S3 → Glue crawler/Data Catalog → Athena → QuickSight**。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 通过 AWS X-Ray 筛选数据以将数据可视化 — 错误。** X-Ray 是一种分布式追踪服务，用于分析由已埋点的应用程序处理的请求，包括下游调用、延迟和服务依赖关系。它并不是用于为存储在 S3 中的任意 CSV 数据集绘制图表的通用 BI 工具。请参阅 [What is AWS X-Ray?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/aws-xray.html)。

- **D. 使用 Amazon Redshift 查询数据 — 错误。** Redshift 可以支持分析，并且在某些架构中可以访问 S3 数据，但对于此要求而言并非必要。Athena 使用 SQL 直接查询现有的 S3 文件，并且是无服务器的，需要更少的设置和管理。因此，当题目优先考虑最少工作量时，Athena 是更好的选择。

- **F. 使用 Amazon DynamoDB 作为持久性元数据存储 — 错误。** DynamoDB 从技术上可以保存自定义应用程序记录，但它不是 Athena S3 表所集成的架构目录。使用它需要自定义元数据设计和自动化流程。Glue Data Catalog 专门设计为持久性元数据存储，并且 Glue 爬虫可以从 S3 数据自动填充该目录。

en.question: A company deploys its corporate infrastructure on AWS across multiple AWS Regions and Availability Zones. The infrastructure is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances and connects with AWS IoT Greengrass devices. The company deploys additional resources on on-premises servers that are located in the corporate headquarters. The company wants to reduce the overhead involved in maintaining and updating its resources. The company’s DevOps team plans to use AWS Systems Manager to implement automated management and application of patches. The DevOps team confirms that Systems Manager is available in the Regions that the resources are deployed in. Systems Manager also is available in a Region near the corporate headquarters. Which combination of steps must the DevOps team take to implement automated patch and configuration management across the company’s EC2 instances, IoT devices, and on-premises infrastructure? (Choose three.)

options.A: Apply tags to all the EC2 instances, AWS IoT Greengrass devices, and on-premises servers. Use Systems Manager Session Manager to push patches to all the tagged devices.
options.B: Use Systems Manager Run Command to schedule patching for the EC2 instances, AWS IoT Greengrass devices, and on-premises servers.
options.C: Use Systems Manager Patch Manager to schedule patching for the EC2 instances, AWS IoT Greengrass devices, and on-premises servers as a Systems Manager maintenance window task.
options.D: Configure Amazon EventBridge to monitor Systems Manager Patch Manager for updates to patch baselines. Associate Systems Manager Run Command with the event to initiate a patch action for all EC2 instances, AWS IoT Greengrass devices, and on-premises servers.
options.E: Create an IAM instance profile for Systems Manager. Attach the instance profile to all the EC2 instances in the AWS account. For the AWS IoT Greengrass devices and on-premises servers, create an IAM service role for Systems Manager.
options.F: Generate a managed-instance activation. Use the Activation Code and Activation ID to install Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) on each server in the on-premises environment. Update the AWS IoT Greengrass IAM token exchange role. Use the role to deploy SSM Agent on all the IoT devices.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company wants one Systems Manager-based solution that can **onboard and authorize three node types**—EC2 instances, AWS IoT Greengrass core devices, and on-premises servers—and then **automatically schedule patching** across them.

## Correct answers: C, E, and F

### C. Use Patch Manager with a Systems Manager maintenance window

Patch Manager is the Systems Manager capability designed to automate operating system and application patching. AWS explicitly states that Patch Manager can patch fleets of **EC2 instances, edge devices, and on-premises servers**. Maintenance windows are a supported method for scheduling recurring patch operations. In a maintenance window, the patch task runs the `AWS-RunPatchBaseline` document against the registered managed-node targets.

- [AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)
- [Create a maintenance window for patching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-window-tutorial-patching.html)

Therefore, C provides the required automated patch schedule after the resources have become Systems Manager managed nodes.

### E. Provide the required IAM permissions

Systems Manager needs credentials through which each managed node can communicate with the service:

- For EC2 instances, an IAM instance profile with Systems Manager permissions such as `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` is a valid configuration. AWS now also supports Default Host Management Configuration, but the instance-profile method described in E remains valid.
- Non-EC2 machines in hybrid environments use an IAM service role rather than an EC2 instance profile.
- AWS IoT Greengrass core devices also require a Systems Manager IAM service role; the role is supplied as the registration role when deploying the Systems Manager Agent component.

AWS also notes that an existing hybrid-environment Systems Manager service role can be reused for edge devices, which supports the service-role approach in E.

- [Configure instance permissions required for Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/setup-instance-permissions.html)
- [Create the IAM service role required for hybrid and multicloud environments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/hybrid-multicloud-service-role.html)
- [Set up AWS IoT Greengrass edge devices for Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-setting-up-edge-devices.html)

### F. Register the on-premises servers and deploy SSM Agent to Greengrass devices

For on-premises servers, the team must create a **hybrid activation**. Systems Manager returns an Activation Code and Activation ID, which are used while installing and registering SSM Agent on the non-EC2 machines.

AWS documents a separate onboarding flow for Greengrass core devices: update the Greengrass **token exchange role** with the permissions needed to pass the Systems Manager service role and register the managed node, and then deploy the `aws.greengrass.SystemsManagerAgent` component. Deployment of that component automatically registers the core device with Systems Manager.

- [AWS Systems Manager Hybrid Activations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/activations.html)
- [Install the Systems Manager Agent component on Greengrass core devices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/greengrass/v2/developerguide/install-systems-manager-agent.html)

Thus, F performs the required agent installation and managed-node registration for the non-EC2 infrastructure.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Session Manager does not push or schedule patches

Tags can be useful for selecting maintenance-window targets, but Session Manager is intended for secure interactive or controlled access to managed nodes. It is not the Systems Manager patch scheduling service. Patch Manager is the appropriate capability, so tagging resources and attempting to push patches through Session Manager is incorrect.

### B. Run Command alone is not the patch scheduling solution

Run Command remotely executes commands and performs one-time or automated administrative changes on managed nodes. Although a Patch Manager maintenance-window task is technically registered as a **Run Command task** that invokes `AWS-RunPatchBaseline`, Run Command by itself does not define the recurring patch-management workflow stated in this option. The required solution is Patch Manager plus a maintenance-window schedule, as described in C.

- [AWS Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html)

Selecting B would also omit one of the essential onboarding or IAM steps represented by E and F.

### D. Patch-baseline updates are not the required scheduling trigger

EventBridge can react to Systems Manager events and can invoke Run Command, but monitoring for patch-baseline updates is not the standard or required mechanism for recurring patch deployment. A baseline defines which patches are approved; a maintenance window or patch policy defines when patch scanning and installation occur. This option also does not onboard the on-premises servers or Greengrass devices and does not provide their required IAM permissions.

## Final answer

**C, E, F**

zh.question: 一家公司在多个 AWS Regions 和 Availability Zones 中的 AWS 上部署其企业基础设施。该基础设施部署在 Amazon EC2 instances 上，并与 AWS IoT Greengrass devices 连接。该公司还在位于公司总部的 on-premises servers 上部署了额外资源。公司希望减少维护和更新其资源所涉及的开销。公司的 DevOps 团队计划使用 AWS Systems Manager 实施补丁的自动化管理和应用。DevOps 团队确认，Systems Manager 在部署这些资源的 Regions 中可用。Systems Manager 在公司总部附近的一个 Region 中也可用。DevOps 团队必须采取哪种步骤组合，才能在公司的 EC2 instances、IoT devices 和 on-premises infrastructure 中实施自动化补丁和配置管理？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为所有 EC2 instances、AWS IoT Greengrass devices 和 on-premises servers 应用标签。使用 Systems Manager Session Manager 向所有带标签的设备推送补丁。
options.B: 使用 Systems Manager Run Command 为 EC2 instances、AWS IoT Greengrass devices 和 on-premises servers 安排补丁任务。
options.C: 使用 Systems Manager Patch Manager，将 EC2 instances、AWS IoT Greengrass devices 和 on-premises servers 的补丁任务安排为 Systems Manager maintenance window task。
options.D: 配置 Amazon EventBridge 监控 Systems Manager Patch Manager 的 patch baselines 更新。将 Systems Manager Run Command 与该事件关联，以便对所有 EC2 instances、AWS IoT Greengrass devices 和 on-premises servers 启动补丁操作。
options.E: 为 Systems Manager 创建 IAM instance profile。将该 instance profile 附加到 AWS account 中的所有 EC2 instances。对于 AWS IoT Greengrass devices 和 on-premises servers，请为 Systems Manager 创建 IAM service role。
options.F: 生成 managed-instance activation。使用 Activation Code 和 Activation ID 在 on-premises environment 中的每台服务器上安装 Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent)。更新 AWS IoT Greengrass IAM token exchange role。使用该 role 在所有 IoT devices 上部署 SSM Agent。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

公司希望采用一个基于 Systems Manager 的解决方案，对三类节点进行**接入和授权**——EC2 instances、AWS IoT Greengrass core devices 和 on-premises servers——然后在这些节点上**自动安排补丁任务**。

## 正确答案：C、E 和 F

### C. 使用 Patch Manager 和 Systems Manager maintenance window

Patch Manager 是 Systems Manager 中专为自动化操作系统和应用程序补丁而设计的功能。AWS 明确指出，Patch Manager 可以为 **EC2 instances、edge devices 和 on-premises servers** 的资源组打补丁。Maintenance windows 是安排周期性补丁操作的受支持方法。在 maintenance window 中，补丁任务会针对已注册的 managed-node targets 运行 `AWS-RunPatchBaseline` document。

- [AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager.html)
- [Create a maintenance window for patching](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-window-tutorial-patching.html)

因此，在资源成为 Systems Manager managed nodes 后，C 提供了所需的自动化补丁计划。

### E. 提供所需的 IAM 权限

Systems Manager 需要凭证，以便每个 managed node 能够与该服务通信：

- 对于 EC2 instances，使用具有 Systems Manager 权限（如 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`）的 IAM instance profile 是一种有效配置。AWS 现在也支持 Default Host Management Configuration，但 E 中描述的 instance-profile 方法仍然有效。
- hybrid environments 中的非 EC2 计算机使用 IAM service role，而不是 EC2 instance profile。
- AWS IoT Greengrass core devices 同样需要 Systems Manager IAM service role；在部署 Systems Manager Agent component 时，该 role 会作为 registration role 提供。

AWS 还指出，现有的 hybrid-environment Systems Manager service role 可复用于 edge devices，这支持了 E 中采用 service-role 的方式。

- [Configure instance permissions required for Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/setup-instance-permissions.html)
- [Create the IAM service role required for hybrid and multicloud environments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/hybrid-multicloud-service-role.html)
- [Set up AWS IoT Greengrass edge devices for Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-setting-up-edge-devices.html)

### F. 注册 on-premises servers 并向 Greengrass devices 部署 SSM Agent

对于 on-premises servers，团队必须创建 **hybrid activation**。Systems Manager 会返回 Activation Code 和 Activation ID，这些值会在非 EC2 machines 上安装和注册 SSM Agent 时使用。

AWS 为 Greengrass core devices 提供了单独的接入流程：更新 Greengrass **token exchange role**，使其具有传递 Systems Manager service role 和注册 managed node 所需的权限，然后部署 `aws.greengrass.SystemsManagerAgent` component。部署该 component 会自动向 Systems Manager 注册 core device。

- [AWS Systems Manager Hybrid Activations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/activations.html)
- [Install the Systems Manager Agent component on Greengrass core devices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/greengrass/v2/developerguide/install-systems-manager-agent.html)

因此，F 为非 EC2 infrastructure 执行了所需的 agent 安装和 managed-node 注册。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. Session Manager 不会推送或安排补丁

标签可用于选择 maintenance-window targets，但 Session Manager 的用途是对 managed nodes 进行安全的交互式访问或受控访问。它不是 Systems Manager 的补丁计划服务。Patch Manager 才是适当的功能，因此，对资源添加标签并尝试通过 Session Manager 推送补丁是不正确的。

### B. Run Command 本身不是补丁计划解决方案

Run Command 可在 managed nodes 上远程执行命令，并执行一次性或自动化的管理变更。虽然 Patch Manager maintenance-window task 在技术上会注册为调用 `AWS-RunPatchBaseline` 的 **Run Command task**，但 Run Command 本身并未定义该选项所述的周期性补丁管理工作流程。所需的解决方案是 Patch Manager 加上 maintenance-window schedule，如 C 所述。
