- [AWS Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html)

选择 B 还会遗漏 E 和 F 所代表的一项必要接入或 IAM 步骤。

### D. Patch-baseline 更新不是所需的计划触发器

EventBridge 可以响应 Systems Manager events 并调用 Run Command，但监控 patch-baseline updates 并不是执行周期性补丁部署的标准或必需机制。baseline 定义哪些补丁获得批准；maintenance window 或 patch policy 则定义何时执行补丁扫描和安装。此选项还没有接入 on-premises servers 或 Greengrass devices，也没有提供其所需的 IAM 权限。

## 最终答案

**C、E、F**

en.question: A company is testing a web application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The company uses a blue/green deployment process with immutable instances when deploying new software. During testing, users are being automatically logged out of the application at random times. Testers also report that, when a new version of the application is deployed, all users are logged out. The development team needs a solution to ensure users remain logged in across scaling events and application deployments. What is the MOST operationally efficient way to ensure users remain logged in?

options.A: Enable smart sessions on the load balancer and modify the application to check for an existing session.
options.B: Enable session sharing on the load balancer and modify the application to read from the session store.
options.C: Store user session information in an Amazon S3 bucket and modify the application to read session information from the bucket.
options.D: Modify the application to store user session information in an Amazon ElastiCache cluster.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

The EC2 instances are immutable and are replaced during scaling and blue/green deployments. The symptoms indicate that session state is stored locally on individual instances:

- A user can be routed to a different instance and lose the local session.
- When the old application fleet is replaced during deployment, all locally stored sessions disappear.

The application tier therefore needs to be stateless, with session state stored in a shared external data store that every instance and every application version can access. AWS documentation describes this pattern explicitly: the application stores a session identifier in a cookie and uses it as a key to save and retrieve user context from an external cache; Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS is listed as a suitable session-state store. This enables a request to run on any healthy instance, including newly launched instances after scaling or replacement ([AWS documentation: Statelessness and session handling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/m2/latest/userguide/ba-shared-architecture.html)).

## Correct answer: D

**D. Modify the application to store user session information in an Amazon ElastiCache cluster.**

ElastiCache provides a shared, managed, in-memory key-value store that all application instances can access. Session records can be keyed by a session ID held in the user's cookie, decoupling sessions from the lifecycle of any EC2 instance. Consequently, Auto Scaling events, target replacement, and blue/green deployments do not inherently invalidate active sessions.

This is also operationally efficient because ElastiCache is purpose-built for fast key-value access; AWS documents submillisecond latency for its in-memory data-store use case ([ElastiCache in-memory data store](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Enable smart sessions on the load balancer and modify the application to check for an existing session.**  
  Application Load Balancers do not provide a feature named **smart sessions**. ALB supports cookie-based **sticky sessions**, which bind a client to a target; they do not provide a shared application-session database. Furthermore, if the selected target is deregistered or becomes unhealthy, ALB selects another healthy target. Any session stored only on the removed instance would still be unavailable ([ALB sticky sessions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)).

- **B. Enable session sharing on the load balancer and modify the application to read from the session store.**  
  ALB has no managed **session sharing** or application session-store feature. It can use load-balancer-generated or application-based cookies for routing affinity, but the application must provide and access the external shared state itself. Therefore, this option proposes a nonexistent load-balancer capability and does not identify an actual session store.

- **C. Store user session information in an Amazon S3 bucket and modify the application to read session information from the bucket.**  
  S3 could technically persist serialized session objects, but it is an object storage service organized around buckets, objects, and object keys—not a purpose-built, in-memory session store ([How Amazon S3 works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)). Using object API operations for every session lookup and update would be less suitable and require more application-level session management than using ElastiCache. It is not the most operationally efficient choice for frequently accessed, latency-sensitive session state.

zh.question: 一家公司正在测试一个 Web 应用程序，该应用程序运行在 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些实例在多个 Availability Zone 中的一个 Auto Scaling 组内运行。该公司在部署新软件时，使用具有不可变实例的蓝绿部署流程。在测试期间，用户会在随机时间被自动登出应用程序。测试人员还报告称，部署新版本的应用程序时，所有用户都会被登出。开发团队需要一种解决方案，确保用户在扩缩容事件和应用程序部署期间保持登录状态。确保用户保持登录状态的最具运营效率的方法是什么？

options.A: 在负载均衡器上启用智能会话，并修改应用程序以检查是否存在现有会话。
options.B: 在负载均衡器上启用会话共享，并修改应用程序以从会话存储中读取。
options.C: 将用户会话信息存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并修改应用程序以从该存储桶读取会话信息。
options.D: 修改应用程序，将用户会话信息存储在 Amazon ElastiCache 集群中。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

EC2 实例是不可变的，并且会在扩缩容和蓝绿部署期间被替换。这些症状表明，会话状态存储在各个实例本地：

- 用户可能被路由到另一个实例，从而丢失本地会话。
- 在部署期间旧应用程序实例组被替换时，所有本地存储的会话都会消失。

因此，应用程序层需要是无状态的，并将会话状态存储在每个实例和每个应用程序版本均可访问的外部共享数据存储中。AWS 文档明确描述了此模式：应用程序将会话标识符存储在 Cookie 中，并将其作为键从外部缓存保存和检索用户上下文；Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS 被列为适合的会话状态存储。这样，任何请求都可以在任何运行正常的实例上运行，包括扩缩容或替换后新启动的实例（[AWS 文档：无状态性和会话处理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/m2/latest/userguide/ba-shared-architecture.html)）。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 修改应用程序，将用户会话信息存储在 Amazon ElastiCache 集群中。**

ElastiCache 提供了一个由 AWS 托管的共享内存键值存储，所有应用程序实例均可访问。会话记录可以通过用户 Cookie 中保存的会话 ID 作为键，从而使会话与任何 EC2 实例的生命周期解耦。因此，Auto Scaling 事件、目标替换和蓝绿部署不会天然导致活动会话失效。

这也具有很高的运营效率，因为 ElastiCache 专为快速键值访问而设计；AWS 为其内存数据存储使用案例记录了亚毫秒级延迟（[ElastiCache 内存数据存储](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/elasticache-use-cases.html)）。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 在负载均衡器上启用智能会话，并修改应用程序以检查是否存在现有会话。**  
  Application Load Balancer 不提供名为 **智能会话** 的功能。ALB 支持基于 Cookie 的 **粘性会话**，可将客户端绑定到某个目标；但它不提供共享的应用程序会话数据库。此外，如果所选目标被取消注册或变得不正常，ALB 会选择另一个正常目标。任何仅存储在被移除实例上的会话仍然无法访问（[ALB 粘性会话](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)）。

- **B. 在负载均衡器上启用会话共享，并修改应用程序以从会话存储中读取。**  
  ALB 没有托管的 **会话共享** 或应用程序会话存储功能。它可以使用由负载均衡器生成的 Cookie 或基于应用程序的 Cookie 实现路由亲和性，但应用程序本身必须提供并访问外部共享状态。因此，此选项提出了一种不存在的负载均衡器功能，也未指定实际的会话存储。

- **C. 将用户会话信息存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，并修改应用程序以从该存储桶读取会话信息。**  
  S3 在技术上可以持久化序列化的会话对象，但它是一种围绕存储桶、对象和对象键组织的对象存储服务，而不是专门构建的内存会话存储（[Amazon S3 的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html)）。对每次会话查找和更新都使用对象 API 操作，适用性较低，而且与使用 ElastiCache 相比，需要更多应用程序级别的会话管理。对于频繁访问且对延迟敏感的会话状态而言，这不是最具运营效率的选择。

en.question: A DevOps engineer needs to configure a blue/green deployment for an existing three-tier application. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon RDS database. The EC2 instances run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and are in an Auto Scaling group. The DevOps engineer has created a launch template and an Auto Scaling group for the blue environment. The DevOps engineer also has created a launch template and an Auto Scaling group for the green environment. Each Auto Scaling group deploys to a matching blue or green target group. The target group also specifies which software, blue or green, gets loaded on the EC2 instances. The ALB can be configured to send traffic to the blue environment’s target group or the green environment’s target group. An Amazon Route 53 record for www.example.com points to the ALB. The deployment must move traffic all at once between the software on the blue environment’s EC2 instances to the newly deployed software on the green environment’s EC2 instances. What should the DevOps engineer do to meet these requirements?

options.A: Start a rolling restart of the Auto Scaling group for the green environment to deploy the new software on the green environment’s EC2 instances. When the rolling restart is complete, use an AWS CLI command to update the ALB to send traffic to the green environment’s target group.
options.B: Use an AWS CLI command to update the ALB to send traffic to the green environment’s target group. Then start a rolling restart of the Auto Scaling group for the green environment to deploy the new software on the green environment’s EC2 instances.
options.C: Update the launch template to deploy the green environment’s software on the blue environment’s EC2 instances. Keep the target groups and Auto Scaling groups unchanged in both environments. Perform a rolling restart of the blue environment’s EC2 instances.
options.D: Start a rolling restart of the Auto Scaling group for the green environment to deploy the new software on the green environment’s EC2 instances. When the rolling restart is complete, update the Route 53 DNS to point to the green environment’s endpoint on the ALB.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application already has the key components for a blue/green deployment:

- One **blue Auto Scaling group** registered with a blue target group
- One **green Auto Scaling group** registered with a green target group
- One **Application Load Balancer** that can forward traffic to either target group
- One Route 53 record that already points clients to that ALB

The requirement is to deploy the new software to the green fleet first and then move production traffic from blue to green **all at once**.

## Correct answer: A

Start the rolling restart/instance refresh of the green Auto Scaling group and wait for it to complete. This replaces the green instances with instances that use the desired launch-template/software configuration. Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling instance refresh supports rolling replacement and waits for health checks and instance warmup as configured before proceeding, which allows the green fleet to become ready before it receives production traffic. See [Instance refresh core concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-refresh-overview.html).

After the green deployment is complete, modify the ALB listener's forwarding action so that it sends traffic to the green target group. AWS documents that `modify-listener` can replace the target group used by a listener's default forward action:

```bash
aws elbv2 modify-listener \
  --listener-arn listener-arn \
  --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=green-target-group-arn
```

This changes the ALB's forwarding destination from blue to green rather than gradually weighting traffic between the two groups, satisfying the all-at-once traffic-switch requirement. See [Modify the default action for an Application Load Balancer listener](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-rule.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

This uses the wrong sequence. It sends production traffic to the green target group **before** the green Auto Scaling group has completed deploying the new software. Users could therefore reach old, unavailable, or partially refreshed green instances during the rolling operation. The green fleet must be deployed and made healthy before the ALB is switched to it.

### C

This is an in-place rolling deployment to the blue Auto Scaling group, not a blue/green deployment. It would mix old and new software versions within the production blue fleet during the refresh and would not perform an all-at-once cutover between the separate blue and green environments. It also leaves the prepared green environment unused.

### D

There is only one ALB in the scenario, and the existing Route 53 record already points to that ALB. The blue/green selection occurs inside the ALB by changing which target group its listener forwards to; there is no separately identified “green endpoint on the ALB” for Route 53 to target.

Additionally, DNS changes are not a reliable all-at-once cutover mechanism because DNS resolvers can continue returning a previously cached value until its TTL expires. AWS documents this caching behavior in [Troubleshooting Route 53 DNS changes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/troubleshooting-new-dns-settings-not-in-effect.html).

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师需要为现有的三层应用程序配置蓝/绿部署。该应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并使用 Amazon RDS 数据库。EC2 实例运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面，并且位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。DevOps 工程师已为蓝色环境创建了启动模板和 Auto Scaling 组。DevOps 工程师还为绿色环境创建了启动模板和 Auto Scaling 组。每个 Auto Scaling 组都部署到相匹配的蓝色或绿色目标组。目标组还指定在 EC2 实例上加载蓝色还是绿色软件。可以将 ALB 配置为向蓝色环境的目标组或绿色环境的目标组发送流量。www.example.com 的 Amazon Route 53 记录指向该 ALB。部署必须将流量一次性从蓝色环境 EC2 实例上的软件切换到绿色环境 EC2 实例上新部署的软件。DevOps 工程师应如何做才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 启动绿色环境 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启，以便在绿色环境的 EC2 实例上部署新软件。滚动重启完成后，使用 AWS CLI 命令更新 ALB，使其将流量发送到绿色环境的目标组。
options.B: 使用 AWS CLI 命令更新 ALB，使其将流量发送到绿色环境的目标组。然后启动绿色环境 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启，以便在绿色环境的 EC2 实例上部署新软件。
options.C: 更新启动模板，以便在蓝色环境的 EC2 实例上部署绿色环境的软件。保持两个环境中的目标组和 Auto Scaling 组不变。对蓝色环境的 EC2 实例执行滚动重启。
options.D: 启动绿色环境 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启，以便在绿色环境的 EC2 实例上部署新软件。滚动重启完成后，更新 Route 53 DNS，使其指向 ALB 上绿色环境的终端节点。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序已经具备蓝/绿部署所需的关键组件：

- 一个已注册到蓝色目标组的**蓝色 Auto Scaling 组**
- 一个已注册到绿色目标组的**绿色 Auto Scaling 组**
- 一个可以将流量转发到任一目标组的 **Application Load Balancer**
- 一条已经将客户端指向该 ALB 的 Route 53 记录

要求是先将新软件部署到绿色实例群，然后将生产流量从蓝色环境**一次性**切换到绿色环境。

## 正确答案：A

启动绿色 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启/实例刷新，并等待其完成。这会使用所需的启动模板/软件配置来替换绿色实例。Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 实例刷新支持滚动替换，并会在继续操作前根据配置等待运行状况检查和实例预热完成，因此绿色实例群可在接收生产流量前准备就绪。请参阅 [实例刷新核心概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-refresh-overview.html)。

绿色部署完成后，修改 ALB 侦听器的转发操作，使其将流量发送到绿色目标组。AWS 文档说明，`modify-listener` 可以替换侦听器默认转发操作所使用的目标组：

```bash
aws elbv2 modify-listener \
  --listener-arn listener-arn \
  --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=green-target-group-arn
```

此操作会将 ALB 的转发目标从蓝色切换为绿色，而不是在两个组之间逐步加权分配流量，因此满足一次性流量切换的要求。请参阅 [修改 Application Load Balancer 侦听器的默认操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-rule.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B

该选项使用了错误的顺序。它在绿色 Auto Scaling 组完成新软件部署**之前**，就将生产流量发送到绿色目标组。因此，用户可能会在滚动操作期间访问旧的、不可用的或仅部分完成刷新的绿色实例。必须先部署绿色实例群并确保其处于健康状态，然后才能将 ALB 切换到该实例群。

### C

这是对蓝色 Auto Scaling 组进行的就地滚动部署，而不是蓝/绿部署。在刷新期间，它会在生产蓝色实例群中混合旧版和新版软件，也不会在独立的蓝色和绿色环境之间执行一次性切换。此外，它还会使已准备好的绿色环境闲置不用。

### D

该场景中只有一个 ALB，且现有的 Route 53 记录已经指向该 ALB。蓝色或绿色环境的选择是在 ALB 内部通过更改其侦听器所转发的目标组来完成的；并不存在供 Route 53 定位的、单独标识的“ALB 上绿色环境终端节点”。

此外，DNS 更改并不是可靠的一次性切换机制，因为 DNS 解析器可能会在 TTL 到期前持续返回先前缓存的值。AWS 在 [排查 Route 53 DNS 更改未生效的问题](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/troubleshooting-new-dns-settings-not-in-effect.html) 中记录了这种缓存行为。

en.question: A company is building a new pipeline by using AWS CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild in a build account. The pipeline consists of two stages. The first stage is a CodeBuild job to build and package an AWS Lambda function. The second stage consists of deployment actions that operate on two different AWS accounts: a development environment account and a production environment account. The deployment stages use the AWS CloudFormation action that CodePipeline invokes to deploy the infrastructure that the Lambda function requires. A DevOps engineer creates the CodePipeline pipeline and configures the pipeline to encrypt build artifacts by using the AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS managed key for Amazon S3 (the aws/s3 key). The artifacts are stored in an S3 bucket. When the pipeline runs, the CloudFormation actions fail with an access denied error. Which combination of actions must the DevOps engineer perform to resolve this error? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an S3 bucket in each AWS account for the artifacts. Allow the pipeline to write to the S3 buckets. Create a CodePipeline S3 action to copy the artifacts to the S3 bucket in each AWS account. Update the CloudFormation actions to reference the artifacts S3 bucket in the production account.
options.B: Create a customer managed KMS key. Configure the KMS key policy to allow the IAM roles used by the CloudFormation action to perform decrypt operations. Modify the pipeline to use the customer managed KMS key to encrypt artifacts.
options.C: Create an AWS managed KMS key. Configure the KMS key policy to allow the development account and the production account to perform decrypt operations. Modify the pipeline to use the KMS key to encrypt artifacts.
options.D: In the development account and in the production account, create an IAM role for CodePipeline. Configure the roles with permissions to perform CloudFormation operations and with permissions to retrieve and decrypt objects from the artifacts S3 bucket. In the CodePipeline account, configure the CodePipeline CloudFormation action to use the roles.
options.E: In the development account and in the production account, create an IAM role for CodePipeline. Configure the roles with permissions to perform CloudFormation operations and with permissions to retrieve and decrypt objects from the artifacts S3 bucket. In the CodePipeline account, modify the artifacts S3 bucket policy to allow the roles access. Configure the CodePipeline CloudFormation action to use the roles.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The pipeline is in the build account, but both deployment actions run under roles in other AWS accounts. Those cross-account action roles must be able to retrieve the pipeline artifacts from the build account's S3 bucket and decrypt them.

The current artifacts are encrypted with the Amazon S3 AWS managed KMS key (`aws/s3`). AWS states that S3 objects encrypted with an AWS managed KMS key cannot be shared cross-account; cross-account access requires a customer managed KMS key whose policy can grant the external principals access. CodePipeline's cross-account setup also requires a bucket policy granting the external account or roles access to the artifact bucket.

**Correct answers: B and E.**

### B. Create and use a customer managed KMS key

This resolves the encryption side of the failure. The DevOps engineer must replace `aws/s3` with a customer managed KMS key and grant the development and production action roles permission to use the key, including `kms:Decrypt`. The pipeline must then be configured to encrypt its artifacts with that customer managed key.

AWS explicitly states that objects encrypted with AWS managed KMS keys cannot be shared cross-account and that a customer managed key is required for cross-account S3 object access. The CodePipeline cross-account procedure likewise directs customers to create a customer managed key, grant the external account permission to use it, and configure the pipeline artifact store with that key: [Using SSE-KMS encryption in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html) and [Create a pipeline that uses resources from another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-create-cross-account.html).

### E. Create cross-account action roles and update the artifact bucket policy

Each target account needs a role that CodePipeline can assume for the CloudFormation action. That role needs permissions to perform the required CloudFormation operations and retrieve and decrypt the input artifact. Because the artifact bucket is owned by a different account, the bucket-owning build account must also add an S3 bucket policy granting those roles access. Finally, each CloudFormation action must be configured with the corresponding cross-account role.

AWS's CodePipeline cross-account procedure requires both sides of this authorization model: permissions on the external role and an artifact bucket policy in the pipeline account granting cross-account access: [Create a pipeline that uses resources from another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-create-cross-account.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A:** Separate artifact buckets and copy actions are unnecessary. CodePipeline supports cross-account actions using the pipeline account's central artifact bucket when the S3 bucket policy, cross-account roles, and customer managed KMS key are configured correctly. The option also references only the production bucket despite deployments to both development and production.
- **C:** Customers do not create an AWS managed key or edit its key policy to grant arbitrary cross-account access. More importantly, S3 objects encrypted with an AWS managed KMS key such as `aws/s3` cannot be shared cross-account. A **customer managed** KMS key is required.
- **D:** The roles' identity-based S3 permissions alone do not complete cross-account authorization. The artifact bucket belongs to the build account, so its bucket policy must also grant the development and production roles access. Option E includes this required resource-based permission; D does not.

zh.question: 一家公司正在构建一个新管道，该管道在构建账户中使用 AWS CodePipeline 和 AWS CodeBuild。该管道包含两个阶段。第一个阶段是一个 CodeBuild 作业，用于构建和打包 AWS Lambda 函数。第二个阶段由部署操作组成，这些操作在两个不同的 AWS 账户中运行：开发环境账户和生产环境账户。部署阶段使用由 CodePipeline 调用的 AWS CloudFormation 操作来部署 Lambda 函数所需的基础设施。DevOps 工程师创建了 CodePipeline 管道，并将该管道配置为使用 Amazon S3 的 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) AWS 托管密钥（`aws/s3` 密钥）加密构建工件。工件存储在一个 S3 存储桶中。当管道运行时，CloudFormation 操作因访问被拒绝错误而失败。DevOps 工程师必须执行以下哪些操作组合来解决此错误？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在每个 AWS 账户中为工件创建一个 S3 存储桶。允许管道写入这些 S3 存储桶。创建一个 CodePipeline S3 操作，将工件复制到每个 AWS 账户中的 S3 存储桶。更新 CloudFormation 操作以引用生产账户中的工件 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 创建一个客户托管 KMS 密钥。配置 KMS 密钥策略，以允许 CloudFormation 操作使用的 IAM 角色执行解密操作。修改管道以使用该客户托管 KMS 密钥加密工件。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥。配置 KMS 密钥策略，以允许开发账户和生产账户执行解密操作。修改管道以使用该 KMS 密钥加密工件。
options.D: 在开发账户和生产账户中，为 CodePipeline 创建一个 IAM 角色。为这些角色配置执行 CloudFormation 操作的权限，以及从工件 S3 存储桶检索和解密对象的权限。在 CodePipeline 账户中，将 CodePipeline CloudFormation 操作配置为使用这些角色。
options.E: 在开发账户和生产账户中，为 CodePipeline 创建一个 IAM 角色。为这些角色配置执行 CloudFormation 操作的权限，以及从工件 S3 存储桶检索和解密对象的权限。在 CodePipeline 账户中，修改工件 S3 存储桶策略以允许这些角色访问。将 CodePipeline CloudFormation 操作配置为使用这些角色。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

管道位于构建账户中，但两个部署操作均在其他 AWS 账户中的角色下运行。这些跨账户操作角色必须能够从构建账户的 S3 存储桶中检索管道工件并对其解密。

当前工件使用 Amazon S3 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥（`aws/s3`）加密。AWS 指出，使用 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥加密的 S3 对象无法跨账户共享；跨账户访问需要客户托管 KMS 密钥，其策略可以向外部主体授予访问权限。CodePipeline 的跨账户设置还要求使用存储桶策略，向外部账户或角色授予对工件存储桶的访问权限。

**正确答案：B 和 E。**

### B. 创建并使用客户托管 KMS 密钥

这解决了失败中与加密相关的部分。DevOps 工程师必须将 `aws/s3` 替换为客户托管 KMS 密钥，并授予开发和生产操作角色使用该密钥的权限，其中包括 `kms:Decrypt`。然后，必须将管道配置为使用该客户托管密钥加密其工件。

AWS 明确指出，使用 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥加密的对象无法跨账户共享，并且跨账户 S3 对象访问需要客户托管密钥。CodePipeline 跨账户流程同样要求客户创建客户托管密钥，授予外部账户使用该密钥的权限，并使用该密钥配置管道工件存储：[Using SSE-KMS encryption in Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html) 和 [Create a pipeline that uses resources from another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-create-cross-account.html)。

### E. 创建跨账户操作角色并更新工件存储桶策略

每个目标账户都需要一个 CodePipeline 可以为 CloudFormation 操作承担的角色。该角色需要具备执行所需 CloudFormation 操作以及检索和解密输入工件的权限。由于工件存储桶归属于不同账户，拥有存储桶的构建账户还必须添加 S3 存储桶策略，以授予这些角色访问权限。最后，必须将每个 CloudFormation 操作配置为使用对应的跨账户角色。

AWS 的 CodePipeline 跨账户流程要求此授权模型的两方面：外部角色上的权限，以及在管道账户中的工件存储桶策略，该策略授予跨账户访问权限：[Create a pipeline that uses resources from another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-create-cross-account.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **A：** 无需使用单独的工件存储桶和复制操作。正确配置 S3 存储桶策略、跨账户角色和客户托管 KMS 密钥后，CodePipeline 支持使用管道账户的中央工件存储桶执行跨账户操作。该选项也仅引用生产账户中的存储桶，尽管部署目标同时包括开发和生产账户。
- **C：** 客户无法创建 AWS 托管密钥，也无法编辑其密钥策略以授予任意跨账户访问权限。更重要的是，使用诸如 `aws/s3` 的 AWS 托管 KMS 密钥加密的 S3 对象无法跨账户共享。必须使用**客户托管** KMS 密钥。
- **D：** 角色基于身份的 S3 权限本身并不能完成跨账户授权。工件存储桶属于构建账户，因此其存储桶策略也必须向开发和生产角色授予访问权限。选项 E 包含此必需的基于资源的权限，而 D 没有。

en.question: A company is using an organization in AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. The company’s development team wants to use AWS Lambda functions to meet resiliency requirements and is rewriting all applications to work with Lambda functions that are deployed in a VPC. The development team is using Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) as shared storage in Account A in the organization. The company wants to continue to use Amazon EFS with Lambda. Company policy requires all serverless projects to be deployed in Account B. A DevOps engineer needs to reconfigure an existing EFS file system to allow Lambda functions to access the data through an existing EFS access point. Which combination of steps should the DevOps engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Update the EFS file system policy to provide Account B with access to mount and write to the EFS file system in Account A.
options.B: Create SCPs to set permission guardrails with fine-grained control for Amazon EFS.
options.C: Create a new EFS file system in Account B. Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to keep data from Account A and Account B synchronized.
options.D: Update the Lambda execution roles with permission to access the VPC and the EFS file system.
options.E: Create a VPC peering connection to connect Account A to Account B.
options.F: Configure the Lambda functions in Account B to assume an existing IAM role in Account A.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The Lambda functions must run in **Account B**, while continuing to mount the existing EFS file system and access point in **Account A**. Therefore, the solution needs all three layers required for cross-account EFS access:

1. **Resource authorization** on the EFS file system in Account A.
2. **Identity permissions** on the Lambda execution role in Account B.
3. **Private network connectivity** between the Lambda VPC and the EFS mount targets' VPC.

## Correct answers: A, D, and E

### A. Update the EFS file system policy

An EFS file system policy is a resource-based policy and can authorize a principal from another account. The policy should grant the relevant Account B Lambda execution role permissions such as `elasticfilesystem:ClientMount` and, because write access is required, `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite`. AWS provides examples of EFS file system policies that grant these client actions to a specified IAM role: [Resource-based policy examples for Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/security_iam_resource-based-policy-examples.html).

Thus, Account A must update the existing file system's policy to authorize the Account B principal.

### D. Update the Lambda execution roles with VPC and EFS permissions

When an EFS file system has a customer-configured IAM policy, the Lambda function's execution role must have `elasticfilesystem:ClientMount` and, for writable access, `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite`. The execution role also needs the EC2 permissions required for Lambda to create and manage its VPC network interfaces. AWS explicitly documents both requirements in [Configuring file system access for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html).

For the VPC portion, the `AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole` managed policy supplies permissions such as `ec2:CreateNetworkInterface`, `ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces`, and `ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface`, as described in [Connecting Lambda functions to your VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html).

Cross-account access does not eliminate these execution-role requirements. Authorization is evaluated using the Account B Lambda execution role together with the Account A EFS resource policy.

### E. Create a VPC peering connection between the accounts' VPCs

EFS is mounted through mount targets in a VPC over NFS. The Lambda function's VPC therefore needs private network reachability to the VPC containing the EFS mount targets. AWS's cross-account Lambda networking guidance uses a VPC peering connection and requires the corresponding routes, security-group rules, and DNS settings: [Giving Lambda functions access to a resource in a VPC in another account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-cross-account.html).

AWS also documents that clients can access an EFS file system in another VPC or account when the VPCs are connected by VPC peering or a transit gateway: [Mount an EFS file system in another VPC using IAM or an access point](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-fs-different-vpc.html). Because VPC peering is the available connectivity option in the answers, **E** is required.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create SCPs for fine-grained EFS control

An SCP does not grant access. It only defines the maximum permissions available to IAM principals in organization member accounts. The Lambda role and EFS file system policy must still explicitly grant the required permissions. AWS states that an SCP “never grants permissions” in [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

SCPs could impose organization-wide guardrails, but they do not establish this cross-account EFS mount.

### C. Create another EFS file system and synchronize it with AWS DMS

The requirement is to reconfigure and continue using the existing EFS file system and access point, not create a duplicate file system. Additionally, AWS DMS migrates between supported database and data-store endpoints; Amazon EFS is not a supported DMS source or target endpoint. See the official [AWS DMS source endpoint list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Sources.html) and [AWS DMS target endpoint list](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Targets.html).

### F. Have the Lambda functions assume a role in Account A

The cross-account EFS design authorizes the **Account B Lambda execution role** in the Account A EFS file system policy. The function does not need to assume a role in Account A. More importantly, the EFS mount is established as part of the Lambda environment setup; credentials obtained by function code through `sts:AssumeRole` are not the mechanism Lambda uses to authorize that mount. The required EFS client and VPC permissions belong on the function's execution role, as documented in the Lambda EFS guidance.

Therefore, the required combination is **A, D, and E**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Organizations 中的组织来管理多个 AWS 账户。该公司的开发团队希望使用 AWS Lambda 函数来满足弹性要求，并且正在重写所有应用程序，使其能够与部署在 VPC 中的 Lambda 函数配合使用。开发团队正在使用组织中账户 A 的 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 作为共享存储。公司希望继续将 Amazon EFS 与 Lambda 配合使用。公司策略要求所有无服务器项目均部署在账户 B 中。DevOps 工程师需要重新配置现有的 EFS 文件系统，以允许 Lambda 函数通过现有的 EFS 接入点访问数据。DevOps 工程师应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 更新 EFS 文件系统策略，为账户 B 提供挂载和写入账户 A 中 EFS 文件系统的访问权限。
options.B: 创建 SCP，以便为 Amazon EFS 设置具有精细控制的权限防护栏。
options.C: 在账户 B 中创建新的 EFS 文件系统。使用 AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) 保持账户 A 和账户 B 中的数据同步。
options.D: 更新 Lambda 执行角色，使其具有访问 VPC 和 EFS 文件系统的权限。
options.E: 创建 VPC 对等连接，以连接账户 A 和账户 B。
options.F: 将账户 B 中的 Lambda 函数配置为代入账户 A 中的现有 IAM 角色。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

Lambda 函数必须在**账户 B**中运行，同时继续挂载**账户 A**中现有的 EFS 文件系统和接入点。因此，该解决方案需要跨账户 EFS 访问所需的全部三个层面：

1. 账户 A 中 EFS 文件系统上的**资源授权**。
2. 账户 B 中 Lambda 执行角色上的**身份权限**。
3. Lambda VPC 与 EFS 挂载目标 VPC 之间的**私有网络连接**。

## 正确答案：A、D 和 E

### A. 更新 EFS 文件系统策略

EFS 文件系统策略是一种基于资源的策略，可以授权来自其他账户的主体。该策略应向相关的账户 B Lambda 执行角色授予 `elasticfilesystem:ClientMount` 等权限；由于需要写入访问权限，还应授予 `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite`。AWS 提供了向指定 IAM 角色授予这些客户端操作权限的 EFS 文件系统策略示例：[Amazon EFS 的基于资源的策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/security_iam_resource-based-policy-examples.html)。

因此，账户 A 必须更新现有文件系统的策略，以授权账户 B 主体。

### D. 使用 VPC 和 EFS 权限更新 Lambda 执行角色

当 EFS 文件系统具有客户配置的 IAM 策略时，Lambda 函数的执行角色必须拥有 `elasticfilesystem:ClientMount`，并且对于可写访问，还必须拥有 `elasticfilesystem:ClientWrite`。执行角色还需要 Lambda 创建和管理其 VPC 网络接口所需的 EC2 权限。AWS 在[为 Lambda 函数配置文件系统访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-filesystem-efs.html)中明确记录了这两项要求。

对于 VPC 部分，`AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole` 托管策略提供了 `ec2:CreateNetworkInterface`、`ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces` 和 `ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface` 等权限，如[将 Lambda 函数连接到 VPC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc.html)中所述。

跨账户访问并不会消除这些执行角色要求。授权将结合账户 B Lambda 执行角色和账户 A EFS 资源策略进行评估。

### E. 在账户的 VPC 之间创建 VPC 对等连接

EFS 通过 VPC 中的挂载目标经由 NFS 进行挂载。因此，Lambda 函数的 VPC 需要能够通过私有网络访问包含 EFS 挂载目标的 VPC。AWS 的跨账户 Lambda 网络指南使用 VPC 对等连接，并要求配置相应的路由、安全组规则和 DNS 设置：[授予 Lambda 函数访问另一个账户中 VPC 内资源的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-vpc-cross-account.html)。

AWS 还说明，当 VPC 通过 VPC 对等连接或 Transit Gateway 连接时，客户端可以访问位于其他 VPC 或账户中的 EFS 文件系统：[使用 IAM 或接入点在另一个 VPC 中挂载 EFS 文件系统](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mount-fs-different-vpc.html)。由于 VPC 对等连接是答案中提供的连接选项，因此必须选择 **E**。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 创建用于精细 EFS 控制的 SCP

SCP 不授予访问权限。它仅定义组织成员账户中 IAM 主体可获得的最大权限。Lambda 角色和 EFS 文件系统策略仍必须明确授予所需权限。AWS 在[SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)中指出，SCP“永远不会授予权限”。

SCP 可以施加组织范围的防护栏，但不能建立此跨账户 EFS 挂载。

### C. 创建另一个 EFS 文件系统并与 AWS DMS 同步

要求是重新配置并继续使用现有的 EFS 文件系统和接入点，而不是创建一个重复的文件系统。此外，AWS DMS 在受支持的数据库和数据存储终端节点之间进行迁移；Amazon EFS 并不是受支持的 DMS 源或目标终端节点。请参阅官方 [AWS DMS 源终端节点列表](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Sources.html)和 [AWS DMS 目标终端节点列表](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dms/latest/userguide/CHAP_Introduction.Targets.html)。

### F. 让 Lambda 函数代入账户 A 中的角色

跨账户 EFS 设计是在账户 A 的 EFS 文件系统策略中授权**账户 B Lambda 执行角色**。该函数无需代入账户 A 中的角色。更重要的是，EFS 挂载是在 Lambda 环境设置过程中建立的；函数代码通过 `sts:AssumeRole` 获取的凭证并不是 Lambda 用于授权该挂载的机制。所需的 EFS 客户端和 VPC 权限应属于函数的执行角色，正如 Lambda EFS 指南中所述。

因此，所需的组合是 **A、D 和 E**。

en.question: A media company has several thousand Amazon EC2 instances in an AWS account. The company is using Slack and a shared email inbox for team communications and important updates. A DevOps engineer needs to send all AWS-scheduled EC2 maintenance notifications to the Slack channel and the shared inbox. The solution must include the instances’ Name and Owner tags. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Integrate AWS Trusted Advisor with AWS Config. Configure a custom AWS Config rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to publish notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe a Slack channel endpoint and the shared inbox to the topic.
options.B: Use Amazon EventBridge to monitor for AWS Health events. Configure the maintenance events to target an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the SNS topic to send notifications to the Slack channel and the shared inbox.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function that sends EC2 maintenance notifications to the Slack channel and the shared inbox. Monitor EC2 health events by using Amazon CloudWatch metrics. Configure a CloudWatch alarm that invokes the Lambda function when a maintenance notification is received.
options.D: Configure AWS Support integration with AWS CloudTrail. Create a CloudTrail lookup event to invoke an AWS Lambda function to pass EC2 maintenance notifications to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Configure Amazon SNS to target the Slack channel and the shared inbox.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs an event-driven solution that captures **AWS-scheduled EC2 maintenance events**, identifies the affected instances, enriches each notification with the instances' **Name** and **Owner** tags, and sends the result to Slack and a shared email inbox.

## Correct answer: B

**Use Amazon EventBridge to monitor AWS Health events, route matching maintenance events to Amazon SNS, and invoke a Lambda subscriber that enriches and delivers the notifications.**

AWS Health publishes account-specific scheduled-change events to EventBridge. AWS explicitly documents that EventBridge can detect AWS Health events, invoke targets such as SNS topics and Lambda functions, and notify customers about EC2 instances scheduled for updates. It also gives sending AWS Health notifications to Slack through Lambda as an example: [Monitoring events in AWS Health with Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/cloudwatch-events-health.html).

The Lambda function can perform the required enrichment as follows:

1. Read the affected EC2 instance ARN/ID from the AWS Health event's `affectedEntities` field. The AWS Health schema for a scheduled EC2 instance retirement includes the affected instance ARN in this field: [AWS Health EventBridge schema](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/aws-health-events-eventbridge-schema.html).
2. Call the EC2 `DescribeTags` operation for the affected instance ID and extract the `Name` and `Owner` tag values. AWS documents filtering `DescribeTags` by `resource-id`: [Use `DescribeTags` with a CLI](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/devguide/example_ec2_DescribeTags_section.html).
3. Format the enriched message and send it to the Slack channel and shared inbox.

SNS can invoke the subscribed Lambda function with the published message payload, which the function can then manipulate and forward: [Fanout Amazon SNS notifications to Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-lambda-as-subscriber.html).

Therefore, **B** provides the correct event source and the processing layer needed to add the EC2 tags before delivery.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** AWS Trusted Advisor and AWS Config are not the event source for AWS-scheduled EC2 maintenance. Config evaluates resource configurations and compliance, while scheduled maintenance affecting account resources is communicated through AWS Health. A custom Config rule would therefore be an inappropriate and indirect trigger. Additionally, a Slack channel is not generally a native SNS subscription endpoint; processing through Lambda is appropriate for formatting and Slack delivery.

- **C — Incorrect.** CloudWatch metric alarms evaluate metric values against thresholds. An EC2 scheduled-maintenance notification is an AWS Health event, not a CloudWatch metric datapoint that causes a metric alarm to enter an alarm state. EventBridge is the documented mechanism for detecting and reacting to these AWS Health events.

- **D — Incorrect.** CloudTrail records AWS API activity and related audit events; it is not the source for AWS-generated EC2 maintenance schedules. Moreover, a CloudTrail event-history lookup is a query operation, not an event mechanism that invokes Lambda when AWS schedules maintenance. AWS Support integration does not correct this mismatch.

zh.question: 一家媒体公司在一个 AWS 账户中拥有数千个 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司使用 Slack 和一个共享电子邮件收件箱进行团队沟通和重要更新。DevOps 工程师需要将所有 AWS 计划的 EC2 维护通知发送到 Slack 频道和共享收件箱。该解决方案必须包含实例的 Name 和 Owner 标签。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS Trusted Advisor 与 AWS Config 集成。配置自定义 AWS Config 规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将通知发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。为该主题订阅 Slack 频道端点和共享收件箱。
options.B: 使用 Amazon EventBridge 监控 AWS Health 事件。将维护事件配置为以 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题为目标。为 SNS 主题订阅 AWS Lambda 函数，以便向 Slack 频道和共享收件箱发送通知。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将 EC2 维护通知发送到 Slack 频道和共享收件箱。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 指标监控 EC2 健康事件。配置一个 CloudWatch 警报，以便在收到维护通知时调用 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 配置 AWS Support 与 AWS CloudTrail 集成。创建一个 CloudTrail 查找事件以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将 EC2 维护通知传递给 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS)。配置 Amazon SNS 以 Slack 频道和共享收件箱为目标。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

公司需要一个事件驱动的解决方案，用于捕获 **AWS 计划的 EC2 维护事件**、识别受影响的实例、使用实例的 **Name** 和 **Owner** 标签丰富每条通知，并将结果发送到 Slack 和共享电子邮件收件箱。

## 正确答案：B

**使用 Amazon EventBridge 监控 AWS Health 事件，将匹配的维护事件路由到 Amazon SNS，并调用 Lambda 订阅者来丰富和传递通知。**

AWS Health 会将账户特定的计划变更事件发布到 EventBridge。AWS 明确说明，EventBridge 可以检测 AWS Health 事件、调用 SNS 主题和 Lambda 函数等目标，并通知客户计划更新的 EC2 实例。它还以通过 Lambda 将 AWS Health 通知发送到 Slack 为例：[使用 Amazon EventBridge 监控 AWS Health 中的事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/cloudwatch-events-health.html)。

Lambda 函数可以按如下方式执行所需的数据丰富：

1. 从 AWS Health 事件的 `affectedEntities` 字段中读取受影响 EC2 实例的 ARN/ID。计划进行 EC2 实例停用的 AWS Health 架构在此字段中包含受影响实例的 ARN：[AWS Health EventBridge 架构](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/aws-health-events-eventbridge-schema.html)。
2. 对受影响的实例 ID 调用 EC2 `DescribeTags` 操作，并提取 `Name` 和 `Owner` 标签值。AWS 记录了如何按 `resource-id` 筛选 `DescribeTags`：[通过 CLI 使用 `DescribeTags`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ec2/latest/devguide/example_ec2_DescribeTags_section.html)。
3. 格式化丰富后的消息，并将其发送到 Slack 频道和共享收件箱。

SNS 可以使用已发布的消息负载调用订阅的 Lambda 函数，随后函数可以处理并转发该消息：[将 Amazon SNS 通知扇出到 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-lambda-as-subscriber.html)。

因此，**B** 提供了正确的事件源以及在传递前添加 EC2 标签所需的处理层。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A — 不正确。** AWS Trusted Advisor 和 AWS Config 不是 AWS 计划 EC2 维护的事件源。Config 评估资源配置和合规性，而影响账户资源的计划维护通过 AWS Health 进行传达。因此，自定义 Config 规则是不恰当且间接的触发器。此外，Slack 频道通常不是原生 SNS 订阅端点；通过 Lambda 进行处理适合消息格式化和 Slack 传递。

- **C — 不正确。** CloudWatch 指标警报会根据阈值评估指标值。EC2 计划维护通知是 AWS Health 事件，而不是会导致指标警报进入警报状态的 CloudWatch 指标数据点。EventBridge 是用于检测和响应这些 AWS Health 事件的文档化机制。

- **D — 不正确。** CloudTrail 记录 AWS API 活动及相关审计事件；它不是 AWS 生成的 EC2 维护计划的来源。此外，CloudTrail 事件历史记录查找是一项查询操作，而不是当 AWS 计划维护时调用 Lambda 的事件机制。AWS Support 集成无法纠正这种不匹配。

en.question: An AWS CodePipeline pipeline has implemented a code release process. The pipeline is integrated with AWS CodeDeploy to deploy versions of an application to multiple Amazon EC2 instances for each CodePipeline stage. During a recent deployment, the pipeline failed due to a CodeDeploy issue. The DevOps team wants to improve monitoring and notifications during deployment to decrease resolution times. What should the DevOps engineer do to create notifications when issues are discovered?

options.A: Implement Amazon CloudWatch Logs for CodePipeline and CodeDeploy, create an AWS Config rule to evaluate code deployment issues, and create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to notify stakeholders of deployment issues.
options.B: Implement Amazon EventBridge for CodePipeline and CodeDeploy, create an AWS Lambda function to evaluate code deployment issues, and create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to notify stakeholders of deployment issues.
options.C: Implement AWS CloudTrail to record CodePipeline and CodeDeploy API call information, create an AWS Lambda function to evaluate code deployment issues, and create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to notify stakeholders of deployment issues.
options.D: Implement Amazon EventBridge for CodePipeline and CodeDeploy, create an Amazon Inspector assessment target to evaluate code deployment issues, and create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to notify stakeholders of deployment issues.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The team needs timely monitoring and notifications for **CodePipeline and CodeDeploy execution/deployment failures** so that responders can investigate issues quickly. The solution should react to deployment state-change events, optionally apply custom evaluation logic, and notify stakeholders.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Implement Amazon EventBridge for CodePipeline and CodeDeploy, create an AWS Lambda function to evaluate code deployment issues, and create an Amazon SNS topic to notify stakeholders of deployment issues.**

CodePipeline emits state-change events for pipelines, stages, and actions. EventBridge rules can match failure states, including failed deploy actions. AWS documents an event pattern that matches `FAILED` actions whose category is `Deploy`, and also documents sending matched pipeline events to an SNS topic. See [Monitoring CodePipeline events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html).

CodeDeploy likewise emits deployment and instance state-change events. Rules can match statuses such as `FAILURE`, and supported targets include **Lambda functions** and **SNS topics**. AWS specifically lists using Lambda when deployments fail as a notification use case. See [Monitoring deployments with Amazon CloudWatch Events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/monitoring-cloudwatch-events.html). CloudWatch Events is the predecessor and underlying event model now represented by Amazon EventBridge.

Therefore, EventBridge provides event-driven detection of failures, Lambda can perform custom evaluation, enrichment, filtering, or routing, and SNS distributes the resulting notifications. Although a simple rule could target SNS directly, **B is the only option built around the appropriate deployment state-change event mechanism**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. CloudWatch Logs + AWS Config + SNS

AWS Config rules evaluate whether AWS resource **configurations** comply with desired settings. They run in response to configuration changes, periodically, or proactively against proposed resource properties. They are not intended to detect and analyze CodePipeline or CodeDeploy execution failures. See [AWS Config concepts and rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html).

CloudWatch Logs can assist with troubleshooting detailed logs, but combining logs with an AWS Config rule does not provide the appropriate deployment-state event workflow requested here.

### C. CloudTrail + Lambda + SNS

CloudTrail is primarily an audit record of API and account activity. For CodePipeline, it records actions such as `CreatePipeline`, `GetPipelineExecution`, and `UpdatePipeline`, including information about who generated each request. See [CodePipeline information in CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/monitoring-cloudtrail-logs.html).

That is valuable for auditing and forensic investigation, but native CodePipeline and CodeDeploy state-change events in EventBridge are the more direct mechanism for detecting deployment failures and responding promptly. The option also does not specify an event mechanism that invokes Lambda when relevant deployment states occur.

### D. EventBridge + Amazon Inspector + SNS

EventBridge is appropriate, but Amazon Inspector is not a deployment-issue evaluator. Inspector continuously scans eligible compute resources for **software vulnerabilities and network exposure** and produces security findings. See [Features of Amazon Inspector](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html).

A CodeDeploy failure is an operational deployment event, not an Inspector vulnerability assessment. Lambda is the appropriate service among the options for custom deployment-event evaluation.

## Conclusion

**B** provides the correct event-driven architecture: **CodePipeline/CodeDeploy state changes → EventBridge rules → Lambda evaluation → SNS notifications**.

zh.question: 一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道已实施代码发布流程。该管道与 AWS CodeDeploy 集成，可在每个 CodePipeline 阶段将应用程序版本部署到多个 Amazon EC2 实例。最近一次部署期间，管道因 CodeDeploy 问题而失败。DevOps 团队希望改进部署期间的监控和通知，以缩短问题解决时间。DevOps 工程师应如何在发现问题时创建通知？

options.A: 为 CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy 实施 Amazon CloudWatch Logs，创建 AWS Config 规则来评估代码部署问题，并创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题来通知利益相关者部署问题。
options.B: 为 CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy 实施 Amazon EventBridge，创建 AWS Lambda 函数来评估代码部署问题，并创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题来通知利益相关者部署问题。
options.C: 实施 AWS CloudTrail 来记录 CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy API 调用信息，创建 AWS Lambda 函数来评估代码部署问题，并创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题来通知利益相关者部署问题。
options.D: 为 CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy 实施 Amazon EventBridge，创建 Amazon Inspector 评估目标来评估代码部署问题，并创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题来通知利益相关者部署问题。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

团队需要对 **CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy 执行/部署失败**进行及时监控和通知，以便响应人员能够迅速调查问题。该解决方案应对部署状态变更事件作出响应，可选择性地应用自定义评估逻辑，并通知利益相关者。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 为 CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy 实施 Amazon EventBridge，创建 AWS Lambda 函数来评估代码部署问题，并创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题来通知利益相关者部署问题。**

CodePipeline 会为管道、阶段和操作发出状态变更事件。EventBridge 规则可以匹配失败状态，包括失败的部署操作。AWS 提供了一个事件模式，可匹配类别为 `Deploy` 的 `FAILED` 操作，还说明了如何将匹配的管道事件发送至 SNS 主题。请参阅 [监控 CodePipeline 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html)。

CodeDeploy 同样会发出部署和实例状态变更事件。规则可匹配如 `FAILURE` 等状态，支持的目标包括 **Lambda 函数**和 **SNS 主题**。AWS 明确列出了在部署失败时使用 Lambda 进行通知的使用案例。请参阅 [使用 Amazon CloudWatch Events 监控部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/monitoring-cloudwatch-events.html)。CloudWatch Events 是目前由 Amazon EventBridge 表示的前身和底层事件模型。

因此，EventBridge 提供由事件驱动的失败检测，Lambda 可以执行自定义评估、信息扩充、筛选或路由，而 SNS 则分发最终通知。尽管简单规则可以直接以 SNS 为目标，但 **B 是唯一基于适当部署状态变更事件机制的选项**。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. CloudWatch Logs + AWS Config + SNS

AWS Config 规则评估 AWS 资源**配置**是否符合预期设置。它们会响应配置变更、定期运行，或针对建议的资源属性主动运行。它们并不用于检测和分析 CodePipeline 或 CodeDeploy 执行失败。请参阅 [AWS Config 概念和规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html)。

CloudWatch Logs 可以协助排查详细日志，但将日志与 AWS Config 规则结合，并不能提供本题所要求的适当部署状态事件工作流程。

### C. CloudTrail + Lambda + SNS

CloudTrail 主要是 API 和账户活动的审计记录。对于 CodePipeline，它会记录如 `CreatePipeline`、`GetPipelineExecution` 和 `UpdatePipeline` 等操作，包括生成每个请求的人员信息。请参阅 [CloudTrail 中的 CodePipeline 信息](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/monitoring-cloudtrail-logs.html)。

这对于审计和取证调查很有价值，但 EventBridge 中原生的 CodePipeline 和 CodeDeploy 状态变更事件，是检测部署失败并迅速响应的更直接机制。该选项也未指定在相关部署状态发生时调用 Lambda 的事件机制。

### D. EventBridge + Amazon Inspector + SNS

EventBridge 是合适的，但 Amazon Inspector 并不是部署问题评估器。Inspector 会持续扫描符合条件的计算资源，以发现**软件漏洞和网络暴露**，并生成安全发现结果。请参阅 [Amazon Inspector 的功能](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)。

CodeDeploy 失败是运维部署事件，而不是 Inspector 漏洞评估。在这些选项中，Lambda 是用于自定义部署事件评估的适当服务。

## 结论

**B** 提供了正确的事件驱动架构：**CodePipeline/CodeDeploy 状态变更 → EventBridge 规则 → Lambda 评估 → SNS 通知**。

en.question: A global company manages multiple AWS accounts by using AWS Control Tower. The company hosts internal applications and public applications. Each application team in the company has its own AWS account for application hosting. The accounts are consolidated in an organization in AWS Organizations. One of the AWS Control Tower member accounts serves as a centralized DevOps account with CI/CD pipelines that application teams use to deploy applications to their respective target AWS accounts. An IAM role for deployment exists in the centralized DevOps account. An application team is attempting to deploy its application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster in an application AWS account. An IAM role for deployment exists in the application AWS account. The deployment is through an AWS CodeBuild project that is set up in the centralized DevOps account. The CodeBuild project uses an IAM service role for CodeBuild. The deployment is failing with an Unauthorized error during attempts to connect to the cross-account EKS cluster from CodeBuild. Which solution will resolve this error?

options.A: Configure the application account’s deployment IAM role to have a trust relationship with the centralized DevOps account. Configure the trust relationship to allow the sts:AssumeRole action. Configure the application account’s deployment IAM role to have the required access to the EKS cluster. Configure the EKS cluster aws-auth ConfigMap to map the role to the appropriate system permissions.
options.B: Configure the centralized DevOps account’s deployment IAM role to have a trust relationship with the application account. Configure the trust relationship to allow the sts:AssumeRole action. Configure the centralized DevOps account’s deployment IAM role to allow the required access to CodeBuild.
options.C: Configure the centralized DevOps account’s deployment IAM role to have a trust relationship with the application account. Configure the trust relationship to allow the sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML action. Configure the centralized DevOps account’s deployment IAM role to allow the required access to CodeBuild.
options.D: Configure the application account’s deployment IAM role to have a trust relationship with the AWS Control Tower management account. Configure the trust relationship to allow the sts:AssumeRole action. Configure the application account’s deployment IAM role to have the required access to the EKS cluster. Configure the EKS cluster aws-auth ConfigMap to map the role to the appropriate system permissions.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The CodeBuild build runs in the centralized DevOps account but must authenticate to, and then receive Kubernetes authorization in, an EKS cluster in the application account. This requires two distinct permission layers:

1. **Cross-account AWS authorization** — the workload in the DevOps account must assume a role in the application account through `sts:AssumeRole`.
2. **EKS/Kubernetes authorization** — the assumed application-account role must be mapped to Kubernetes permissions for the target cluster.

## Correct answer: A

The deployment role in the **application account**, which is the target account, must trust the appropriate principal from the centralized DevOps account and allow `sts:AssumeRole`. AWS documents that a cross-account role is created in the account containing the target resources, and its trust policy allows a principal in the other account to assume it. After STS returns temporary credentials, the caller operates with the permissions assigned to the assumed target role. See [Cross-account access using roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html).

The application-account role must therefore have the IAM permissions needed for the EKS deployment. It must also be authorized inside Kubernetes. The `aws-auth` ConfigMap can map an IAM role to a Kubernetes username and groups, which are then associated with `RoleBinding` or `ClusterRoleBinding` permissions. See [Add IAM principals to your Amazon EKS cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/auth-configmap.html).

CodeBuild performs AWS operations using its service role, so in a complete implementation the CodeBuild service role—or a centralized deployment role that CodeBuild first assumes—must also have an identity policy allowing `sts:AssumeRole` on the application-account deployment role. AWS notes that the target role's trust policy is only one half of cross-account authorization; the calling principal must also be granted `sts:AssumeRole`. See [Updating a role trust policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_update-role-trust-policy.html) and [Allow CodeBuild to interact with other AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-service-role.html).

Although AWS now recommends EKS access entries for supported clusters, `aws-auth` remains a valid mechanism for clusters using that authentication method, and it is the mechanism explicitly presented in the answer choices.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B — Incorrect.** The trust direction is reversed. The role being assumed must be in the application account, where the target EKS cluster resides, and that role must trust the DevOps-side principal. Making a centralized DevOps role trust the application account does not enable CodeBuild to assume the application-account deployment role or authorize access to the EKS cluster. Granting that centralized role access to CodeBuild also does not establish EKS Kubernetes authorization.

- **C — Incorrect.** It has the same reversed trust direction as B. In addition, `sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML` is for principals authenticated through a SAML 2.0 identity provider, not ordinary role-to-role cross-account delegation from CodeBuild. This scenario requires `sts:AssumeRole`.

- **D — Incorrect.** The AWS Control Tower management account is not the caller that needs access. The CodeBuild workload originates in the centralized DevOps member account, so the application-account role must trust the relevant DevOps-side principal. Trusting the Control Tower management account does not authorize the CodeBuild service role in the DevOps account to assume the deployment role.

Therefore, **A** provides the correct cross-account trust direction and the required EKS/Kubernetes authorization configuration.

zh.question: 一家全球性公司使用 AWS Control Tower 管理多个 AWS 账户。该公司托管内部应用程序和公共应用程序。公司中的每个应用程序团队都拥有自己的 AWS 账户用于托管应用程序。这些账户已在 AWS Organizations 中合并到一个组织内。其中一个 AWS Control Tower 成员账户用作集中式 DevOps 账户，其中包含应用程序团队用于将应用程序部署到各自目标 AWS 账户的 CI/CD 管道。集中式 DevOps 账户中存在一个用于部署的 IAM 角色。某个应用程序团队正尝试将其应用程序部署到应用程序 AWS 账户中的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。应用程序 AWS 账户中存在一个用于部署的 IAM 角色。部署通过在集中式 DevOps 账户中设置的 AWS CodeBuild 项目进行。该 CodeBuild 项目使用 CodeBuild 的 IAM 服务角色。在 CodeBuild 尝试连接跨账户 EKS 集群期间，部署因 Unauthorized 错误而失败。哪种解决方案可以解决此错误？

options.A: 将应用程序账户的部署 IAM 角色配置为与集中式 DevOps 账户建立信任关系。将信任关系配置为允许 `sts:AssumeRole` 操作。为应用程序账户的部署 IAM 角色配置访问 EKS 集群所需的权限。配置 EKS 集群的 aws-auth ConfigMap，以将该角色映射到适当的系统权限。
options.B: 将集中式 DevOps 账户的部署 IAM 角色配置为与应用程序账户建立信任关系。将信任关系配置为允许 `sts:AssumeRole` 操作。配置集中式 DevOps 账户的部署 IAM 角色，以允许对 CodeBuild 进行所需的访问。
options.C: 将集中式 DevOps 账户的部署 IAM 角色配置为与应用程序账户建立信任关系。将信任关系配置为允许 `sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML` 操作。配置集中式 DevOps 账户的部署 IAM 角色，以允许对 CodeBuild 进行所需的访问。
options.D: 将应用程序账户的部署 IAM 角色配置为与 AWS Control Tower 管理账户建立信任关系。将信任关系配置为允许 `sts:AssumeRole` 操作。为应用程序账户的部署 IAM 角色配置访问 EKS 集群所需的权限。配置 EKS 集群的 aws-auth ConfigMap，以将该角色映射到适当的系统权限。

zh.explanation:
## 此题考查的内容

CodeBuild 构建在集中式 DevOps 账户中运行，但必须先向应用程序账户中的 EKS 集群进行身份验证，然后获得 Kubernetes 授权。这需要两个不同的权限层：

1. **跨账户 AWS 授权** — DevOps 账户中的工作负载必须通过 `sts:AssumeRole` 承担应用程序账户中的角色。
2. **EKS/Kubernetes 授权** — 所承担的应用程序账户角色必须映射到目标集群的 Kubernetes 权限。

## 正确答案：A

作为目标账户的**应用程序账户**中的部署角色，必须信任集中式 DevOps 账户中的适当主体并允许 `sts:AssumeRole`。AWS 文档说明，跨账户角色创建于包含目标资源的账户中，其信任策略允许另一个账户中的主体承担该角色。在 STS 返回临时凭证后，调用方将使用所承担目标角色的权限进行操作。请参阅 [使用角色进行跨账户访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies-cross-account-resource-access.html)。

因此，应用程序账户角色必须具有执行 EKS 部署所需的 IAM 权限。它还必须在 Kubernetes 内获得授权。`aws-auth` ConfigMap 可以将 IAM 角色映射到 Kubernetes 用户名和组，随后这些用户名和组会关联到 `RoleBinding` 或 `ClusterRoleBinding` 权限。请参阅 [将 IAM 主体添加到您的 Amazon EKS 集群](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/auth-configmap.html)。

CodeBuild 使用其服务角色执行 AWS 操作，因此在完整实现中，CodeBuild 服务角色（或 CodeBuild 首先承担的集中式部署角色）还必须具有身份策略，以允许对应用程序账户部署角色执行 `sts:AssumeRole`。AWS 指出，目标角色的信任策略只是跨账户授权的一半；调用主体也必须被授予 `sts:AssumeRole`。请参阅 [更新角色信任策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_update-role-trust-policy.html) 和 [允许 CodeBuild 与其他 AWS 服务交互](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-service-role.html)。

尽管 AWS 现在建议对受支持的集群使用 EKS 访问条目，但对于使用该身份验证方法的集群，`aws-auth` 仍然是有效机制，并且它是答案选项中明确给出的机制。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **B — 不正确。** 信任方向反了。被承担的角色必须位于应用程序账户中，即目标 EKS 集群所在的账户，并且该角色必须信任 DevOps 端主体。让集中式 DevOps 角色信任应用程序账户，无法使 CodeBuild 承担应用程序账户部署角色，也无法授权其访问 EKS 集群。为该集中式角色授予访问 CodeBuild 的权限同样无法建立 EKS Kubernetes 授权。

- **C — 不正确。** 它与 B 一样采用了相反的信任方向。此外，`sts:AssumeRoleWithSAML` 用于经由 SAML 2.0 身份提供商认证的主体，而非来自 CodeBuild 的普通角色到角色跨账户委派。此场景需要 `sts:AssumeRole`。

- **D — 不正确。** AWS Control Tower 管理账户不是需要访问权限的调用方。CodeBuild 工作负载源自集中式 DevOps 成员账户，因此应用程序账户角色必须信任相关的 DevOps 端主体。信任 Control Tower 管理账户并不能授权 DevOps 账户中的 CodeBuild 服务角色承担部署角色。

因此，**A** 提供了正确的跨账户信任方向以及所需的 EKS/Kubernetes 授权配置。

en.question: A highly regulated company has a policy that DevOps engineers should not log in to their Amazon EC2 instances except in emergencies. If a DevOps engineer does log in, the security team must be notified within 15 minutes of the occurrence. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Install the Amazon Inspector agent on each EC2 instance. Subscribe to Amazon EventBridge notifications. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to check if a message is about user logins. If it is, send a notification to the security team using Amazon SNS.
options.B: Install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on each EC2 instance. Configure the agent to push all logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs and set up a CloudWatch metric filter that searches for user logins. If a login is found, send a notification to the security team using Amazon SNS.
options.C: Set up AWS CloudTrail with Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Subscribe CloudWatch Logs to Amazon Kinesis. Attach AWS Lambda to Kinesis to parse and determine if a log contains a user login. If it does, send a notification to the security team using Amazon SNS.
options.D: Set up a script on each Amazon EC2 instance to push all logs to Amazon S3. Set up an S3 event to invoke an AWS Lambda function, which invokes an Amazon Athena query to run. The Athena query checks for logins and sends the output to the security team using Amazon SNS.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs to detect an **operating-system login to an EC2 instance**—for example, an SSH login on Linux or an interactive Windows login—and notify the security team within 15 minutes. Therefore, the solution must collect **guest OS authentication logs**, detect matching login records promptly, and invoke an SNS notification.

## Correct answer: B

The CloudWatch agent can publish selected log files to CloudWatch Logs. Its configuration explicitly includes a `logs` section that specifies which files are published and can also collect Windows Event Log events. This allows the company to collect Linux authentication logs such as `/var/log/secure` or `/var/log/auth.log`, or the appropriate Windows Security events, from every instance. See [Manually create or edit the CloudWatch agent configuration file](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Agent-Configuration-File-Details.html).

A CloudWatch Logs metric filter can then match successful login patterns as log data arrives. A CloudWatch alarm based on that metric can notify an SNS topic when the threshold is breached. AWS documents that metric filters look for terms and patterns **as log data is sent to CloudWatch**, and that the resulting alarm can use an Amazon SNS topic as its notification action. See [Create a CloudWatch alarm based on a log group metric filter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html).

This is the direct, managed, and sufficiently prompt path:

`EC2 OS authentication logs → CloudWatch agent → CloudWatch Logs metric filter → CloudWatch alarm → SNS`

The alarm period and threshold can be configured so notification occurs well within the 15-minute requirement.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Amazon Inspector with EventBridge

Amazon Inspector identifies security findings such as **software package vulnerabilities** and **network reachability issues**. Its EventBridge finding events are generated when Inspector identifies a software vulnerability or network issue; they are not a stream of operating-system login events. See [Amazon Inspector EventBridge events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/eventbridge-integration.html).

Therefore, a Lambda function cannot reliably find EC2 user logins in Inspector notifications because Inspector does not generate those login records.

### C. CloudTrail, CloudWatch Logs, Kinesis, and Lambda

CloudTrail records AWS control-plane activity. The EC2 documentation states that CloudTrail captures Amazon EC2 **API calls**, such as `RunInstances`, `DescribeInstances`, and `StopInstances`. See [Log Amazon EC2 API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitor-with-cloudtrail.html).

CloudTrail can audit a connection workflow that uses **EC2 Instance Connect**, because that workflow invokes the `SendSSHPublicKey` API. However, that does not make CloudTrail a general source for in-guest SSH, RDP, console, or local operating-system login records. Consequently, this option would miss logins that do not use an AWS API operation. Adding Kinesis and Lambda does not correct the absence of the required OS-level events.

### D. Custom scripts, S3, Lambda, and Athena

This is an unnecessarily indirect batch-style architecture. The option does not define how frequently each instance uploads its logs, so it does not reliably guarantee notification within 15 minutes. It also introduces custom scripts, S3 object delivery, Lambda orchestration, and Athena query latency when CloudWatch Logs provides native streaming collection, pattern matching, alarms, and SNS integration. Athena is better suited to querying data already stored in S3 than to immediate login-event alerting.

## Conclusion

**B** is the only option that directly collects EC2 guest operating-system authentication logs and uses native CloudWatch Logs filtering and SNS alarm notification to meet the 15-minute requirement.

zh.question: 一家受到高度监管的公司制定了一项策略：除紧急情况外，DevOps 工程师不应登录其 Amazon EC2 实例。如果 DevOps 工程师确实登录了，必须在事件发生后 15 分钟内通知安全团队。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在每个 EC2 实例上安装 Amazon Inspector agent。订阅 Amazon EventBridge 通知。调用 AWS Lambda 函数来检查消息是否与用户登录有关。如果有关，则使用 Amazon SNS 向安全团队发送通知。
options.B: 在每个 EC2 实例上安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent。配置该 agent 将所有日志推送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs，并设置一个 CloudWatch metric filter 来搜索用户登录。如果发现登录，则使用 Amazon SNS 向安全团队发送通知。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 设置 AWS CloudTrail。将 CloudWatch Logs 订阅到 Amazon Kinesis。将 AWS Lambda 附加到 Kinesis，以解析并确定日志是否包含用户登录。如果包含，则使用 Amazon SNS 向安全团队发送通知。
options.D: 在每个 Amazon EC2 实例上设置脚本，将所有日志推送到 Amazon S3。设置一个 S3 event 来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数会调用 Amazon Athena query。Athena query 检查登录情况，并使用 Amazon SNS 将输出发送给安全团队。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要检测对 **EC2 实例操作系统的登录**——例如 Linux 上的 SSH 登录或交互式 Windows 登录——并在 15 分钟内通知安全团队。因此，该解决方案必须收集 **客户机操作系统身份验证日志**、及时检测匹配的登录记录，并触发 SNS 通知。

## 正确答案：B

CloudWatch agent 可以将选定的日志文件发布到 CloudWatch Logs。其配置明确包含 `logs` 部分，用于指定要发布的文件，也可以收集 Windows Event Log 事件。这使公司能够从每个实例收集 Linux 身份验证日志，例如 `/var/log/secure` 或 `/var/log/auth.log`，或者收集适当的 Windows Security 事件。请参阅 [Manually create or edit the CloudWatch agent configuration file](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch-Agent-Configuration-File-Details.html)。

随后，CloudWatch Logs metric filter 可以在日志数据到达时匹配成功登录模式。基于该指标的 CloudWatch alarm 可在阈值被突破时通知 SNS topic。AWS 文档指出，metric filter 会在日志数据**发送到 CloudWatch 时**查找术语和模式，并且生成的 alarm 可以使用 Amazon SNS topic 作为其通知操作。请参阅 [Create a CloudWatch alarm based on a log group metric filter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)。

这是一条直接、托管且足够及时的路径：

`EC2 OS authentication logs → CloudWatch agent → CloudWatch Logs metric filter → CloudWatch alarm → SNS`

可以配置 alarm 的周期和阈值，以确保在 15 分钟要求之内发出通知。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. Amazon Inspector 与 EventBridge

Amazon Inspector 识别安全发现，例如**软件包漏洞**和**网络可达性问题**。当 Inspector 识别出软件漏洞或网络问题时，会生成其 EventBridge finding events；这些事件并不是操作系统登录事件流。请参阅 [Amazon Inspector EventBridge events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/eventbridge-integration.html)。

因此，Lambda 函数无法在 Inspector 通知中可靠地查找 EC2 用户登录，因为 Inspector 不会生成这些登录记录。

### C. CloudTrail、CloudWatch Logs、Kinesis 和 Lambda

CloudTrail 记录 AWS 控制平面活动。EC2 文档指出，CloudTrail 会捕获 Amazon EC2 **API 调用**，例如 `RunInstances`、`DescribeInstances` 和 `StopInstances`。请参阅 [Log Amazon EC2 API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitor-with-cloudtrail.html)。

CloudTrail 可以审计使用 **EC2 Instance Connect** 的连接工作流程，因为该工作流程会调用 `SendSSHPublicKey` API。然而，这并不意味着 CloudTrail 是客户机内 SSH、RDP、控制台或本地操作系统登录记录的通用来源。因此，此选项会遗漏不使用 AWS API 操作的登录。添加 Kinesis 和 Lambda 无法弥补缺少所需操作系统级事件的问题。

### D. 自定义脚本、S3、Lambda 和 Athena

这是一种不必要地间接、偏向批处理的架构。该选项没有定义每个实例上传日志的频率，因此无法可靠地保证在 15 分钟内发出通知。与 CloudWatch Logs 提供的原生流式收集、模式匹配、alarm 和 SNS 集成相比，它还引入了自定义脚本、S3 对象传输、Lambda 编排和 Athena query 延迟。Athena 更适合查询已存储在 S3 中的数据，而不是用于即时的登录事件告警。

## 结论

**B** 是唯一直接收集 EC2 客户机操作系统身份验证日志，并使用原生 CloudWatch Logs 过滤和 SNS alarm 通知来满足 15 分钟要求的选项。

en.question: A company updated the AWS CloudFormation template for a critical business application. The stack update process failed due to an error in the updated template, and AWS CloudFormation automatically began the stack rollback process. Later, a DevOps engineer discovered that the application was still unavailable and that the stack was in the UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED state. Which combination of actions should the DevOps engineer perform so that the stack rollback can complete successfully? (Choose two.)

options.A: Attach the AWSCloudFormationFullAccess IAM policy to the AWS CloudFormation role.
options.B: Automatically recover the stack resources by using AWS CloudFormation drift detection.
options.C: Issue a ContinueUpdateRollback command from the AWS CloudFormation console or the AWS CLI.
options.D: Manually adjust the resources to match the expectations of the stack.
options.E: Update the existing AWS CloudFormation stack by using the original template.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The failed update has already entered rollback, but CloudFormation could not restore one or more resources and therefore placed the stack in `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED`. The task is to remove the condition that blocked rollback and then explicitly resume the rollback operation.

## Correct answers: C and D

- **D. Manually adjust the resources to match the expectations of the stack.** AWS states that, in most cases, you must first fix the error that caused the update rollback to fail. For example, a resource might have been deleted or changed outside CloudFormation, or another resource condition might prevent restoration. Correcting the affected resource or dependency allows CloudFormation to perform the expected rollback action.
- **C. Issue a `ContinueUpdateRollback` command from the AWS CloudFormation console or the AWS CLI.** After correcting the blocking problem, choose **Continue update rollback** in the console or run `aws cloudformation continue-update-rollback`. This resumes the rollback and attempts to return the stack to `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`. AWS documents this as the recovery operation for a stack in `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` ([Continue rolling back an update](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-continueupdaterollback.html)).

The practical sequence is therefore **D, then C**: fix the resource-level cause, and resume the rollback.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Attach the `AWSCloudFormationFullAccess` IAM policy to the AWS CloudFormation role.** The scenario does not establish that insufficient permissions caused the rollback failure. Broadly granting full CloudFormation access does not repair an externally deleted, modified, or otherwise incompatible resource. If an event identified a permissions failure, the relevant permissions should be corrected specifically, but attaching this broad policy is not the generally required recovery action.
- **B. Automatically recover the stack resources by using AWS CloudFormation drift detection.** Drift detection compares actual resource configurations with the expected template configuration and reports differences; it does not automatically repair resources or resume a failed rollback. AWS explicitly describes drift detection as a way to **identify** unmanaged changes, after which corrective action must be taken ([Detect unmanaged configuration changes with drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)).
- **E. Update the existing stack by using the original template.** AWS states that a stack in `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` **cannot be updated**. It must first be rolled back to a working state such as `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`; only afterward can another update be attempted. Thus, submitting the original template is not the immediate recovery procedure.

zh.question: 一家公司更新了某个关键业务应用程序的 AWS CloudFormation 模板。由于更新后的模板中存在错误，堆栈更新过程失败，AWS CloudFormation 自动开始堆栈回滚过程。随后，一名 DevOps 工程师发现应用程序仍然不可用，并且堆栈处于 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` 状态。为了使堆栈回滚能够成功完成，DevOps 工程师应执行哪两项操作？（选择两项）

options.A: 将 AWSCloudFormationFullAccess IAM policy 附加到 AWS CloudFormation 角色。
options.B: 使用 AWS CloudFormation drift detection 自动恢复堆栈资源。
options.C: 从 AWS CloudFormation 控制台或 AWS CLI 发出 ContinueUpdateRollback 命令。
options.D: 手动调整资源，使其符合堆栈的预期状态。
options.E: 使用原始模板更新现有 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

失败的更新已进入回滚阶段，但 CloudFormation 无法恢复一个或多个资源，因此将堆栈置于 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` 状态。需要消除阻止回滚的条件，然后显式恢复回滚操作。

## 正确答案：C 和 D

- **D. 手动调整资源，使其符合堆栈的预期状态。** AWS 表示，在大多数情况下，必须先修复导致更新回滚失败的错误。例如，某个资源可能已在 CloudFormation 之外被删除或更改，或者其他资源条件可能阻止恢复。纠正受影响的资源或依赖关系后，CloudFormation 即可执行预期的回滚操作。
- **C. 从 AWS CloudFormation 控制台或 AWS CLI 发出 `ContinueUpdateRollback` 命令。** 修复阻塞问题后，在控制台中选择 **Continue update rollback**，或运行 `aws cloudformation continue-update-rollback`。这会恢复回滚，并尝试使堆栈返回 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`。AWS 将此操作记录为处于 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` 状态的堆栈的恢复操作（[继续回滚更新](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-continueupdaterollback.html)）。

因此，实际执行顺序应为 **D，然后 C**：修复资源级别的原因，然后恢复回滚。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A. 将 `AWSCloudFormationFullAccess` IAM policy 附加到 AWS CloudFormation 角色。** 场景并未表明权限不足导致了回滚失败。广泛授予完整的 CloudFormation 访问权限，无法修复在外部被删除、修改或以其他方式不兼容的资源。如果事件表明权限失败，则应针对性地修正相关权限，但附加此宽泛 policy 并不是通常所需的恢复操作。
- **B. 使用 AWS CloudFormation drift detection 自动恢复堆栈资源。** Drift detection 会将实际资源配置与预期模板配置进行比较并报告差异；它不会自动修复资源或恢复失败的回滚。AWS 明确将 drift detection 描述为一种用于**识别**非托管更改的方法，之后必须采取纠正措施（[使用 drift detection 检测非托管配置更改](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)）。
- **E. 使用原始模板更新现有堆栈。** AWS 表示，处于 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_FAILED` 状态的堆栈**无法更新**。必须先将其回滚到诸如 `UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE` 的正常工作状态；之后才能尝试其他更新。因此，提交原始模板并不是即时恢复流程。

en.question: A development team manually builds an artifact locally and then places it in an Amazon S3 bucket. The application has a local cache that must be cleared when a deployment occurs. The team runs a command to do this, downloads the artifact from Amazon S3, and unzips the artifact to complete the deployment. A DevOps team wants to migrate to a CI/CD process and build in checks to stop and roll back the deployment when a failure occurs. This requires the team to track the progression of the deployment. Which combination of actions will accomplish this? (Choose three.)

options.A: Allow developers to check the code into a code repository. Using Amazon EventBridge, on every pull into the main branch, invoke an AWS Lambda function to build the artifact and store it in Amazon S3.
options.B: Create a custom script to clear the cache. Specify the script in the BeforeInstall lifecycle hook in the AppSpec file.
options.C: Create user data for each Amazon EC2 instance that contains the clear cache script. Once deployed, test the application. If it is not successful, deploy it again.
options.D: Set up AWS CodePipeline to deploy the application. Allow developers to check the code into a code repository as a source for the pipeline.
options.E: Use AWS CodeBuild to build the artifact and place it in Amazon S3. Use AWS CodeDeploy to deploy the artifact to Amazon EC2 instances.
options.F: Use AWS Systems Manager to fetch the artifact from Amazon S3 and deploy it to all the instances.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The team needs to replace a manual build-and-deploy workflow with an orchestrated CI/CD process that:

1. Takes source code from a repository.
2. Builds a repeatable deployment artifact and stores/passes it through Amazon S3.
3. Deploys the artifact to EC2 instances.
4. Clears the application cache as part of the deployment lifecycle.
5. Exposes deployment progress and supports failure detection, stopping, and rollback.

## Correct answers: B, D, and E

### B. Create a cache-clearing script and specify it in the `BeforeInstall` lifecycle hook

For an EC2 deployment, the CodeDeploy AppSpec file can associate scripts with deployment lifecycle events. AWS documents `BeforeInstall` as the hook for pre-installation tasks. Therefore, placing the cache-clearing script in this hook makes cache cleanup a controlled, tracked part of every deployment rather than a manual command. A failed or timed-out hook script causes the instance deployment to fail. See [CodeDeploy EC2/On-Premises lifecycle event hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-hooks.html).

### D. Set up CodePipeline with a code repository as the source

CodePipeline provides the end-to-end CI/CD orchestration required by the question. It can start from a source repository and coordinate build, test, and deployment stages. It also provides real-time pipeline status, failed-action details, retries, and execution history, satisfying the requirement to track progression. See [What can I do with CodePipeline?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/welcome-what-can-I-do.html) and [A quick look at CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/welcome-introducing.html).

### E. Use CodeBuild to build the artifact and CodeDeploy to deploy it to EC2

CodeBuild replaces the inconsistent local build process with a managed, repeatable build. Its buildspec defines build and test commands and identifies the output artifacts that CodeBuild uploads to the output bucket. See [Getting started with CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/getting-started-overview.html).

CodeDeploy then handles deployment to EC2, executes the AppSpec lifecycle hooks, records deployment status, and supports stopping failed deployments. A deployment group can also be configured to automatically roll back when a deployment fails or a monitoring alarm threshold is reached; rollback redeploys the last known good revision. See [Stopped, failed, and rolled-back CodeDeploy deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-steps-server.html).

Together, D and E create the source → build → deploy pipeline, while B incorporates the required cache-clearing operation into the managed deployment lifecycle.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EventBridge and Lambda for building the artifact

This is a custom event-driven build mechanism rather than the requested managed CI/CD workflow. It does not by itself provide a complete source/build/deploy pipeline, deployment lifecycle tracking, EC2 deployment hooks, validation, or automatic rollback. CodePipeline with CodeBuild and CodeDeploy provides these capabilities directly.

### C. Put the cache-clearing script in EC2 user data and deploy again after failure

EC2 user data is primarily associated with instance launch, not each application deployment. It is therefore not the correct mechanism for reliably clearing an application cache during every deployment. In addition, simply deploying again after a failed test is not a rollback to the last known good revision and does not provide managed deployment tracking. The cache command belongs in a CodeDeploy lifecycle hook.

### F. Use Systems Manager to fetch and deploy the artifact

Systems Manager can execute commands on managed instances, but this option describes a custom remote-command deployment rather than an integrated CI/CD release process. By itself, it does not supply the CodePipeline stage progression, CodeDeploy AppSpec lifecycle hooks, deployment health tracking, or CodeDeploy automatic rollback behavior required by the scenario.
