There is no standard EC2 memory-utilization metric that can simply be enabled from a dashboard. A dashboard only visualizes metrics that are already being published. The CloudWatch agent is required to collect and publish guest OS memory metrics, which is why E—not D—is correct.

Therefore, **A and E** together provide application-level instance replacement, memory monitoring, alarming, and SNS notification.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师注意到，Auto Scaling 组中运行在 Application Load Balancer 后面的所有 Amazon EC2 实例都无法响应用户请求。这些 EC2 实例也未能通过目标组的 HTTP 健康检查。检查后，工程师发现所有 EC2 实例中的应用程序进程均未运行。系统日志中有大量内存不足消息。工程师需要提高应用程序的弹性，以应对潜在的应用程序内存泄漏。应启用监控和通知，以便在出现问题时发出警报。以下哪种操作组合可以满足这些要求？（请选择两项。）

options.A: 更改 Auto Scaling 配置，使实例在未通过负载均衡器的健康检查时被替换。
options.B: 更改目标组健康检查的 HealthCheckIntervalSeconds 参数，以缩短健康检查之间的间隔。
options.C: 将目标组健康检查从 HTTP 更改为 TCP，以检查应用程序侦听端口是否可访问。
options.D: 在整个 Auto Scaling 组的 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板中启用可用内存消耗指标。在内存利用率较高时创建告警。将 Amazon SNS 主题关联到该告警，以便在告警触发时接收通知。
options.E: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch agent 收集 Auto Scaling 组中 EC2 实例的内存利用率。在内存利用率较高时创建告警，并关联一个 Amazon SNS 主题以接收通知。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

由于实例发生内存不足状况，应用程序进程已停止。因此，解决方案需要同时提供：

1. 当应用程序级别的健康检查失败时进行**自我修复**。
2. **内存监控和通知**，以便在内存压力变得严重之前或变得严重时提醒运维人员。

## 正确答案：A 和 E

### A. 配置 Auto Scaling 组，以替换未通过负载均衡器健康检查的实例

Auto Scaling 组默认使用 EC2 状态检查；即使操作系统仍在运行但应用程序进程已停止，这些检查仍可能通过。AWS 指出，Auto Scaling 默认会忽略 Elastic Load Balancing 健康检查结果。当为 Auto Scaling 组启用 Elastic Load Balancing 健康检查后，Auto Scaling 会将负载均衡器报告为不健康的实例标记为 `Unhealthy`，并替换这些实例。

由于 ALB 的 HTTP 健康检查已检测到应用程序未响应，因此在 Auto Scaling 配置中启用这些健康检查可提供所需的自我修复行为。请参阅 [EC2 Auto Scaling 的 Elastic Load Balancing 健康检查](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)。

### E. 安装 CloudWatch agent，对高内存利用率设置告警，并通过 SNS 发送通知

EC2 的标准 CloudWatch 指标不提供客户机操作系统的内存利用率。AWS 明确指出，必须安装 CloudWatch agent，才能收集可用内存和已用内存等操作系统级指标。请参阅 [使用 CloudWatch agent 收集额外指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/enable-as-instance-metrics.html)。

在 agent 发布内存指标后，CloudWatch 告警可以评估高内存阈值，并向 SNS 主题发送通知。AWS 文档说明，CloudWatch 告警可以在达到阈值时自动发送通知，并且可以配置 SNS 主题。请参阅 [为实例创建 CloudWatch 告警](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-cloudwatch-createalarm.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 缩短 `HealthCheckIntervalSeconds`

较短的间隔可能会更快地检测到应用程序故障，但它本身不会导致 Auto Scaling 组替换实例。必须先将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用 Elastic Load Balancing 健康检查，如选项 A 所述。此外，它也不提供内存监控或通知。ALB 健康检查的时间设置请参阅 [Application Load Balancer 目标组的健康检查](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)。

### C. 将目标组健康检查从 HTTP 更改为 TCP

Application Load Balancer 目标组健康检查支持 **HTTP 或 HTTPS**，不支持 TCP。更重要的是，HTTP 健康检查能够感知应用程序状态，并正确检测到这里的实际故障：应用程序进程不再响应。即使某种负载均衡器类型支持传输层可达性检查，这种检查也不如 HTTP 健康检查合适。请参阅 [ALB 健康检查设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)。

### D. 直接在 CloudWatch 控制面板中启用可用内存指标

不存在可直接从控制面板启用的标准 EC2 内存利用率指标。控制面板仅能可视化已发布的指标。必须使用 CloudWatch agent 收集并发布客户机操作系统内存指标，因此正确的是 E，而不是 D。

因此，**A 和 E** 共同提供应用程序级别的实例替换、内存监控、告警和 SNS 通知。

en.question: An ecommerce company uses a large number of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) backed Amazon EC2 instances. To decrease manual work across all the instances, a DevOps engineer is tasked with automating restart actions when EC2 instance retirement events are scheduled. How can this be accomplished?

options.A: Create a scheduled Amazon EventBridge rule to run an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook that checks if any EC2 instances are scheduled for retirement once a week. If the instance is scheduled for retirement, the runbook will hibernate the instance.
options.B: Enable EC2 Auto Recovery on all of the instances. Create an AWS Config rule to limit the recovery to occur during a maintenance window only.
options.C: Reboot all EC2 instances during an approved maintenance window that is outside of standard business hours. Set up Amazon CloudWatch alarms to send a notification in case any instance is failing EC2 instance status checks.
options.D: Set up an AWS Health Amazon EventBridge rule to run AWS Systems Manager Automation runbooks that stop and start the EC2 instance when a retirement scheduled event occurs.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company wants an **event-driven, automated response** when AWS schedules retirement of an **EBS-backed EC2 instance**. The response must restart the affected instance in a way that moves it away from the impaired underlying hardware, without requiring periodic polling or manual intervention.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Set up an AWS Health Amazon EventBridge rule to run AWS Systems Manager Automation runbooks that stop and start the EC2 instance when a retirement scheduled event occurs.**

AWS publishes scheduled EC2 retirement notifications as **AWS Health events**. EventBridge can match the EBS-backed retirement event type, `AWS_EC2_PERSISTENT_INSTANCE_RETIREMENT_SCHEDULED`, and invoke Systems Manager Automation. AWS documents this exact workflow and specifies the `AWS-RestartEC2Instance` Automation runbook as the target: [Running operations on EC2 instances automatically in response to events in AWS Health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/automating-instance-actions.html).

For an EBS-backed instance, stopping and starting it before retirement is the appropriate remediation. Starting the stopped instance migrates it to new hardware, preserving the EBS-backed root volume: [Instance retirement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-retirement.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Weekly polling followed by hibernation

This is not the best solution because:

- Retirement is already delivered as an AWS Health event, so polling only once a week introduces unnecessary delay and could miss the opportunity to remediate promptly.
- The option only says to **hibernate** the instance, not restart it. That leaves the instance stopped and does not complete the required automated restart workflow.
- AWS specifically documents an immediate EventBridge-to-Systems Manager Automation pattern for scheduled stop/retirement events rather than periodic polling: [Manage instances scheduled to stop or retire](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/schedevents_actions_retire.html).

### B. EC2 Auto Recovery controlled by AWS Config

EC2 automatic recovery is triggered when an instance experiences a **failed system status check** caused by an underlying hardware or software problem. It is not the event-driven response to a future scheduled retirement notification. AWS Config also does not provide the described mechanism for restricting EC2 automatic recovery to a maintenance window: [Key concepts of automatic instance recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-recover.html).

### C. Reboot every instance manually and configure alarms

This does not satisfy the requirement to automate actions specifically for affected instances when retirement events occur. It also causes unnecessary disruption by rebooting every instance. More importantly, a normal reboot keeps an instance on the **same host**, whereas stop/start can move an EBS-backed instance to a new host. Therefore, rebooting does not provide the required host migration for retirement remediation: [EC2 instance lifecycle and differences between instance states](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-lifecycle.html).

Thus, **D** is the event-driven and AWS-recommended solution.

zh.question: 一家电商公司使用大量由 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 支持的 Amazon EC2 实例。为了减少所有实例上的手动工作，DevOps 工程师需要在计划安排 EC2 实例停用事件时自动执行重启操作。如何实现这一目标？

options.A: 创建一个计划运行的 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以运行 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册，每周检查一次是否有任何 EC2 实例计划停用。如果实例计划停用，该运行手册将使实例休眠。
options.B: 在所有实例上启用 EC2 Auto Recovery。创建 AWS Config 规则，将恢复操作限制为仅在维护窗口期间发生。
options.C: 在标准工作时间以外的已批准维护窗口内重启所有 EC2 实例。设置 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，以便在任何实例未通过 EC2 实例状态检查时发送通知。
options.D: 设置 AWS Health Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在发生计划停用事件时运行 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册来停止并启动 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

公司希望在 AWS 为**由 EBS 支持的 EC2 实例**安排停用时，获得一种**事件驱动的自动化响应**。该响应必须以将受影响实例迁离受损底层硬件的方式重启实例，无需定期轮询或人工干预。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 设置 AWS Health Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在发生计划停用事件时运行 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册来停止并启动 EC2 实例。**

AWS 会将计划的 EC2 实例停用通知发布为 **AWS Health 事件**。EventBridge 可以匹配 EBS 支持的实例停用事件类型 `AWS_EC2_PERSISTENT_INSTANCE_RETIREMENT_SCHEDULED`，并调用 Systems Manager Automation。AWS 记录了这一确切工作流程，并指定将 `AWS-RestartEC2Instance` Automation 运行手册作为目标：[Running operations on EC2 instances automatically in response to events in AWS Health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/automating-instance-actions.html)。

对于由 EBS 支持的实例，在停用前停止并启动它是适当的补救措施。启动已停止的实例会将其迁移到新硬件上，同时保留 EBS 支持的根卷：[Instance retirement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-retirement.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 每周轮询，然后休眠

这不是最佳解决方案，原因如下：

- 停用事件已作为 AWS Health 事件发送，因此每周仅轮询一次会引入不必要的延迟，并且可能错过及时补救的机会。
- 该选项仅说明将实例**休眠**，而不是重启实例。这会使实例保持停止状态，无法完成所需的自动化重启工作流程。
- AWS 专门记录了针对计划停止/停用事件的即时 EventBridge 到 Systems Manager Automation 模式，而不是定期轮询：[Manage instances scheduled to stop or retire](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/schedevents_actions_retire.html)。

### B. 由 AWS Config 控制的 EC2 Auto Recovery

当实例因底层硬件或软件问题而发生**系统状态检查失败**时，EC2 自动恢复才会触发。它并非针对未来计划停用通知的事件驱动响应。此外，AWS Config 不提供将 EC2 自动恢复限制在维护窗口内执行的所述机制：[Key concepts of automatic instance recovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-recover.html)。

### C. 手动重启所有实例并配置告警

这无法满足在停用事件发生时，专门针对受影响实例自动执行操作的要求。此外，重启所有实例会造成不必要的中断。更重要的是，普通重启会使实例保留在**同一主机**上，而停止/启动则可以将由 EBS 支持的实例迁移至新主机。因此，重启无法为实例停用补救提供所需的主机迁移：[EC2 instance lifecycle and differences between instance states](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-instance-lifecycle.html)。

因此，**D** 是事件驱动且由 AWS 推荐的解决方案。

en.question: A company manages AWS accounts for application teams in AWS Control Tower. Individual application teams are responsible for securing their respective AWS accounts. A DevOps engineer needs to enable Amazon GuardDuty for all AWS accounts in which the application teams have not already enabled GuardDuty. The DevOps engineer is using AWS CloudFormation StackSets from the AWS Control Tower management account. How should the DevOps engineer configure the CloudFormation template to prevent failure during the StackSets deployment?

options.A: Create a CloudFormation custom resource that invokes an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to conditionally enable GuardDuty if GuardDuty is not already enabled in the accounts.
options.B: Use the Conditions section of the CloudFormation template to enable GuardDuty in accounts where GuardDuty is not already enabled.
options.C: Use the CloudFormation Fn::GetAtt intrinsic function to check whether GuardDuty is already enabled. If GuardDuty is not already enabled, use the Resources section of the CloudFormation template to enable GuardDuty.
options.D: Manually discover the list of AWS account IDs where GuardDuty is not enabled. Use the CloudFormation Fn::ImportValue intrinsic function to import the list of account IDs into the CloudFormation template to skip deployment for the listed AWS accounts.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The StackSet will run the same CloudFormation template in accounts where GuardDuty might already be enabled and in accounts where it is not. GuardDuty is enabled once per AWS account and Region by creating a detector. Therefore, blindly attempting to create another detector can cause the stack instance deployment to fail. The template needs a dynamic, idempotent check of the target account's current GuardDuty state.

## Correct answer: A

Create a **Lambda-backed CloudFormation custom resource**. On stack create or update, the Lambda function can call GuardDuty (for example, `ListDetectors`) and:

1. Return success without creating anything if a detector already exists.
2. Create/enable the GuardDuty detector if none exists.
3. Send a success response to CloudFormation so that the StackSet operation completes consistently.

AWS provides an official pattern specifically for this scenario: traditional CloudFormation conditions perform static comparisons and cannot dynamically inspect GuardDuty's current service state; attempting to enable GuardDuty where it is already active can fail the deployment. The documented solution is a Lambda-backed custom resource that checks the state and enables GuardDuty only when necessary. AWS also explicitly notes that this solution can be extended across accounts and Regions with StackSets. See [Enable Amazon GuardDuty conditionally by using AWS CloudFormation templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/enable-amazon-guardduty-conditionally-by-using-aws-cloudformation-templates.html).

Lambda-backed custom resources are invoked during custom-resource create, update, and delete operations, allowing the function to implement this dynamic provisioning logic. See [Lambda-backed custom resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/template-custom-resources-lambda.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B — Incorrect.** CloudFormation `Conditions` cannot query the live GuardDuty state. Conditions are evaluated from input or pseudo parameters, mappings, and other conditions; they cannot reference resource logical IDs or attributes. An external parameter could be supplied manually, but the `Conditions` section alone cannot discover whether a GuardDuty detector already exists. See [CloudFormation Conditions section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/conditions-section-structure.html).

- **C — Incorrect.** `Fn::GetAtt` retrieves a supported attribute from a resource identified by a logical name in the template. It is not a discovery function for querying arbitrary existing resources or determining whether GuardDuty is already enabled. See [Referencing resources with `Fn::GetAtt`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/resources-section-structure.html).

- **D — Incorrect.** `Fn::ImportValue` imports an output exported by another CloudFormation stack; it does not perform GuardDuty discovery or control which StackSet target accounts receive a deployment. Cross-stack imports are also limited to the same account and Region, so an account list exported from the management account would not be directly importable by stack instances in member accounts. The proposed manual inventory would also become stale and would not provide the required dynamic, idempotent behavior. See [CloudFormation cross-stack reference considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-exports.html).

Therefore, **A** is the only option that dynamically checks each target account and avoids duplicate GuardDuty enablement failures during the StackSet deployment.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Control Tower 中为应用程序团队管理 AWS 账户。各个应用程序团队负责保护各自的 AWS 账户。一名 DevOps 工程师需要为所有尚未由应用程序团队启用 GuardDuty 的 AWS 账户启用 Amazon GuardDuty。该 DevOps 工程师正在使用来自 AWS Control Tower 管理账户的 AWS CloudFormation StackSets。DevOps 工程师应如何配置 CloudFormation 模板，以防止 StackSets 部署期间失败？

options.A: 创建一个调用 AWS Lambda 函数的 CloudFormation 自定义资源。将 Lambda 函数配置为：仅当账户中尚未启用 GuardDuty 时才有条件地启用 GuardDuty。
options.B: 使用 CloudFormation 模板的 Conditions 部分，在尚未启用 GuardDuty 的账户中启用 GuardDuty。
options.C: 使用 CloudFormation Fn::GetAtt 内置函数检查 GuardDuty 是否已启用。如果 GuardDuty 尚未启用，请使用 CloudFormation 模板的 Resources 部分启用 GuardDuty。
options.D: 手动确定尚未启用 GuardDuty 的 AWS 账户 ID 列表。使用 CloudFormation Fn::ImportValue 内置函数将账户 ID 列表导入 CloudFormation 模板，以跳过对所列 AWS 账户的部署。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

StackSet 将在可能已启用 GuardDuty 的账户以及尚未启用 GuardDuty 的账户中运行相同的 CloudFormation 模板。通过创建 detector，可在每个 AWS 账户和 Region 中启用一次 GuardDuty。因此，盲目尝试创建另一个 detector 可能导致堆栈实例部署失败。该模板需要动态且幂等地检查目标账户当前的 GuardDuty 状态。

## 正确答案：A

创建一个由 **Lambda 支持的 CloudFormation 自定义资源**。在创建或更新堆栈时，Lambda 函数可以调用 GuardDuty（例如，`ListDetectors`），并且：

1. 如果 detector 已存在，则不创建任何内容并返回成功。
2. 如果不存在 detector，则创建/启用 GuardDuty detector。
3. 向 CloudFormation 发送成功响应，使 StackSet 操作能够一致地完成。

AWS 专门为此场景提供了官方模式：传统 CloudFormation 条件执行静态比较，无法动态检查 GuardDuty 当前的服务状态；在 GuardDuty 已启用的位置尝试启用它可能导致部署失败。文档化的解决方案是使用由 Lambda 支持的自定义资源来检查状态，并且仅在必要时启用 GuardDuty。AWS 还明确指出，此解决方案可以通过 StackSets 扩展到多个账户和 Region。请参阅 [使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板有条件地启用 Amazon GuardDuty](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/patterns/enable-amazon-guardduty-conditionally-by-using-aws-cloudformation-templates.html)。

由 Lambda 支持的自定义资源会在自定义资源的创建、更新和删除操作期间被调用，使该函数能够实现这种动态预置逻辑。请参阅 [由 Lambda 支持的自定义资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/template-custom-resources-lambda.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B — 错误。** CloudFormation `Conditions` 无法查询实时 GuardDuty 状态。条件根据输入参数或伪参数、映射及其他条件进行评估；它们无法引用资源逻辑 ID 或属性。虽然可以手动提供外部参数，但仅凭 `Conditions` 部分无法发现 GuardDuty detector 是否已存在。请参阅 [CloudFormation Conditions 部分](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/conditions-section-structure.html)。

- **C — 错误。** `Fn::GetAtt` 从模板中由逻辑名称标识的资源检索受支持的属性。它不是用于查询任意现有资源或确定 GuardDuty 是否已启用的发现函数。请参阅 [使用 `Fn::GetAtt` 引用资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/resources-section-structure.html)。

- **D — 错误。** `Fn::ImportValue` 导入由另一个 CloudFormation 堆栈导出的输出；它不会执行 GuardDuty 发现，也不会控制哪些 StackSet 目标账户接收部署。跨堆栈导入还仅限于同一账户和 Region，因此管理账户导出的账户列表无法由成员账户中的堆栈实例直接导入。所提出的手动清单也会过时，并且无法提供所需的动态、幂等行为。请参阅 [CloudFormation 跨堆栈引用注意事项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-exports.html)。

因此，**A** 是唯一能够动态检查每个目标账户并避免在 StackSet 部署期间因重复启用 GuardDuty 而失败的选项。

en.question: A company has an AWS Control Tower landing zone. The company's DevOps team creates a workload OU. A development OU and a production OU are nested under the workload OU. The company grants users full access to the company's AWS accounts to deploy applications. The DevOps team needs to allow only a specific management IAM role to manage the IAM roles and policies of any AWS accounts in only the production OU. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an SCP that denies full access with a condition to exclude the management IAM role for the organization root.
options.B: Ensure that the FullAWSAccess SCP is applied at the organization root.
options.C: Create an SCP that allows IAM related actions. Attach the SCP to the development OU.
options.D: Create an SCP that denies IAM related actions with a condition to exclude the management IAM role. Attach the SCP to the workload OU.
options.E: Create an SCP that denies IAM related actions with a condition to exclude the management IAM role. Attach the SCP to the production OU.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to preserve broad access generally, while preventing all principals **except a designated management IAM role** from managing IAM roles and policies in accounts under the **production OU only**.

AWS Organizations SCPs are permission guardrails; they do not grant permissions themselves. An account's principals can use only permissions allowed throughout the hierarchy, and an explicit deny in any applicable SCP overrides an allow. AWS also warns that removing `FullAWSAccess` without replacing its allows can cause all actions in member accounts to fail. See [Service control policies (SCPs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) and [SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html).

## Correct answers: B and E

- **B. Ensure that the FullAWSAccess SCP is applied at the organization root.**  
  Permissions must be explicitly allowed at every level from the organization root through the OU path to the account. Keeping `FullAWSAccess` at the root supports the deny-list strategy: actions remain generally available unless a more specific SCP explicitly denies them. The existing full-access IAM policies still grant the actual permissions; the SCP merely establishes the maximum available permissions.

- **E. Create an SCP that denies IAM-related actions with a condition to exclude the management IAM role. Attach the SCP to the production OU.**  
  Attaching the explicit deny to the production OU scopes the guardrail to production accounts and their descendants. The condition can exclude the approved management role—for example, by testing the `aws:PrincipalArn` global condition key—so the deny applies to other principals but not that role. SCPs do not support `Principal` or `NotPrincipal`, so a condition-based exception is the appropriate construction; see [SCP syntax—Unsupported elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_syntax.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Incorrect.** An explicit deny attached at the organization root is inherited by every OU and member account beneath the root. Denying full access there, except for the management role, would restrict the development OU and all other OUs, not only production. An allow lower in the hierarchy cannot override that root-level explicit deny.

- **C. Incorrect.** The restriction is required for the production OU, not the development OU. Additionally, an SCP `Allow` does not grant IAM permissions and cannot override an applicable explicit deny.

- **D. Incorrect.** The workload OU is the parent of both development and production. A deny attached there would apply to accounts in both child OUs, unnecessarily restricting development. AWS documents that a deny attached at any level applies to all OUs and accounts underneath that level.

Therefore, **B establishes the broad allow baseline, and E adds the narrowly scoped production IAM restriction with an exception for the management role**.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个 AWS Control Tower landing zone。该公司的 DevOps 团队创建了一个工作负载 OU。一个开发 OU 和一个生产 OU 嵌套在该工作负载 OU 下。该公司向用户授予对公司 AWS 账户的完全访问权限以部署应用程序。DevOps 团队需要仅允许一个特定的管理 IAM role 管理仅位于生产 OU 中的任何 AWS 账户的 IAM roles 和 policies。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 SCP，拒绝完全访问，并添加一个条件以排除该管理 IAM role；将其应用于组织根节点。
options.B: 确保将 FullAWSAccess SCP 应用于组织根节点。
options.C: 创建一个允许 IAM 相关操作的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到开发 OU。
options.D: 创建一个拒绝 IAM 相关操作、且带有排除管理 IAM role 条件的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到工作负载 OU。
options.E: 创建一个拒绝 IAM 相关操作、且带有排除管理 IAM role 条件的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到生产 OU。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是在总体上保留广泛访问权限，同时阻止除指定管理 IAM role 外的所有主体管理**仅生产 OU** 下账户中的 IAM roles 和 policies。

AWS Organizations SCP 是权限护栏；它们本身不授予权限。账户主体只能使用在整个层级结构中均被允许的权限，并且任何适用 SCP 中的显式拒绝都会覆盖允许。AWS 还警告，如果移除 `FullAWSAccess` 而未以其他允许规则替代，成员账户中的所有操作都可能失败。请参阅 [Service control policies (SCPs)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) 和 [SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)。

## 正确答案：B 和 E

- **B. 确保将 FullAWSAccess SCP 应用于组织根节点。**  
  权限必须在从组织根节点、经过 OU 路径到达账户的每一层均被显式允许。将 `FullAWSAccess` 保留在根节点支持拒绝列表策略：除非更具体的 SCP 显式拒绝，否则操作通常仍然可用。现有的完全访问 IAM policies 仍会授予实际权限；SCP 仅用于确定可用权限的最大范围。

- **E. 创建一个拒绝 IAM 相关操作、且带有排除管理 IAM role 条件的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到生产 OU。**  
  将显式拒绝附加到生产 OU，会使该护栏的范围限定为生产账户及其后代。该条件可以排除获批准的管理 role——例如，使用 `aws:PrincipalArn` 全局条件键进行测试——因此拒绝会应用于其他主体，但不应用于该 role。SCP 不支持 `Principal` 或 `NotPrincipal`，因此基于条件的例外是合适的构造方式；请参阅 [SCP syntax—Unsupported elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_syntax.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A. 不正确。** 附加到组织根节点的显式拒绝会被根节点下的每个 OU 和成员账户继承。在此处拒绝完全访问（管理 role 除外）将限制开发 OU 和所有其他 OU，而不仅仅是生产 OU。层级结构中较低层的允许无法覆盖根节点级别的显式拒绝。

- **C. 不正确。** 限制要求适用于生产 OU，而不是开发 OU。此外，SCP `Allow` 不会授予 IAM 权限，也无法覆盖适用的显式拒绝。

- **D. 不正确。** 工作负载 OU 是开发 OU 和生产 OU 的父级。附加到该处的拒绝会应用于两个子 OU 中的账户，从而不必要地限制开发环境。AWS 文档指出，附加在任意层级的拒绝都会应用于该层级下的所有 OU 和账户。

因此，**B 建立广泛允许的基准，而 E 添加了范围精确的生产环境 IAM 限制，并为管理 role 提供例外。**

en.question: A company hired a penetration tester to simulate an internal security breach. The tester performed port scans on the company's Amazon EC2 instances. The company's security measures did not detect the port scans. The company needs a solution that automatically provides notification when port scans are performed on EC2 instances. The company creates and subscribes to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. What should the company do next to meet the requirement?

options.A: Ensure that Amazon GuardDuty is enabled. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm for detected EC2 and port scan findings. Connect the alarm to the SNS topic.
options.B: Ensure that Amazon Inspector is enabled. Create an Amazon EventBridge event for detected network reachability findings that indicate port scans. Connect the event to the SNS topic.
options.C: Ensure that Amazon Inspector is enabled. Create an Amazon EventBridge event for detected CVEs that cause open port vulnerabilities. Connect the event to the SNS topic.
options.D: Ensure that AWS CloudTrail is enabled. Create an AWS Lambda function to analyze the CloudTrail logs for unusual amounts of traffic from an IP address range. Connect the Lambda function to the SNS topic.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The company needs to detect **actual port-scanning behavior involving EC2 instances** and automatically notify subscribers through the existing SNS topic. This requires a threat-detection service that analyzes network activity—not a service that merely identifies exposed ports, software vulnerabilities, or AWS API calls.

### Why A is correct

**Amazon GuardDuty** continuously analyzes AWS data sources, including an independent stream of VPC Flow Logs, to identify suspicious activity affecting EC2 resources. The company does **not** need to create or configure VPC Flow Logs separately for GuardDuty to use this data ([GuardDuty data sources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_data-sources.html)).

GuardDuty can generate reconnaissance findings associated with port scanning and port probing, such as `Recon:EC2/Portscan` and `Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort` ([GuardDuty suppression-rule examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/findings_suppression-rule.html)). This directly addresses the requirement to detect when scanning activity occurs.

For automated notification, GuardDuty findings can be matched by an Amazon EventBridge rule and sent to the existing SNS topic. GuardDuty publishes findings to EventBridge in near real time, and SNS can be configured as the rule target ([Processing GuardDuty findings with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_findings_eventbridge.html); [Setting up GuardDuty alerts through SNS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_settingup.html)). EventBridge was formerly known as Amazon CloudWatch Events. Operationally, an EventBridge rule—not a metric-threshold CloudWatch alarm—is the documented mechanism for routing GuardDuty findings to SNS.

### Why the other options are incorrect

- **B — Amazon Inspector network-reachability findings:** Inspector identifies **open network paths** to EC2 instances by analyzing configurations such as security groups, network ACLs, route tables, and gateways. These findings show that an instance or port is reachable; they do not indicate that someone actually performed a port scan. Inspector network-reachability scans also run periodically rather than serving as continuous behavioral threat detection ([Amazon Inspector finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-types.html)).

- **C — Amazon Inspector CVE findings:** Package-vulnerability findings identify software packages affected by Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures. A vulnerable application or exposed service might increase risk, but a CVE finding does not provide evidence that port-scanning activity occurred ([Amazon Inspector finding types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-types.html)).

- **D — CloudTrail log analysis:** AWS CloudTrail records EC2 API activity, including management operations such as launching, describing, or stopping instances. Ordinary TCP or UDP port scans are network-traffic activity, not EC2 API calls, so CloudTrail logs do not provide the packet- or flow-level evidence needed for this detection. A Lambda function analyzing those logs therefore cannot reliably detect the scans ([Logging Amazon EC2 API calls with CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitor-with-cloudtrail.html)).

Therefore, the company should enable **Amazon GuardDuty** and route the relevant GuardDuty EC2 port-scan findings to the subscribed SNS topic.

zh.question: 一家公司聘请了一名渗透测试人员来模拟内部安全漏洞。该测试人员对公司的 Amazon EC2 实例执行了端口扫描。公司的安全措施未能检测到这些端口扫描。公司需要一种解决方案，以便在对 EC2 实例执行端口扫描时自动提供通知。公司创建并订阅了一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。接下来公司应采取什么措施来满足该要求？

options.A: 确保已启用 Amazon GuardDuty。为检测到的 EC2 和端口扫描发现创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报。将该警报连接到 SNS 主题。
options.B: 确保已启用 Amazon Inspector。为指示端口扫描的已检测网络可达性发现创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件。将该事件连接到 SNS 主题。
options.C: 确保已启用 Amazon Inspector。为导致开放端口漏洞的已检测 CVE 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件。将该事件连接到 SNS 主题。
options.D: 确保已启用 AWS CloudTrail。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来分析 CloudTrail 日志，以查找来自某个 IP 地址范围的异常大量流量。将 Lambda 函数连接到 SNS 主题。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

公司需要检测**涉及 EC2 实例的实际端口扫描行为**，并通过现有 SNS 主题自动通知订阅者。这需要能够分析网络活动的威胁检测服务，而不是仅识别暴露端口、软件漏洞或 AWS API 调用的服务。

### 为什么 A 正确

**Amazon GuardDuty** 持续分析 AWS 数据源，包括独立的 VPC Flow Logs 数据流，以识别影响 EC2 资源的可疑活动。公司**无需**单独创建或配置 VPC Flow Logs 即可供 GuardDuty 使用此数据（[GuardDuty 数据源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_data-sources.html)）。

GuardDuty 可以生成与端口扫描和端口探测相关的侦察发现，例如 `Recon:EC2/Portscan` 和 `Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort`（[GuardDuty 抑制规则示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/findings_suppression-rule.html)）。这直接满足了检测扫描活动发生时间的要求。

对于自动通知，可以通过 Amazon EventBridge 规则匹配 GuardDuty 发现，并将其发送到现有 SNS 主题。GuardDuty 会近乎实时地将发现发布到 EventBridge，并且 SNS 可以配置为该规则的目标（[使用 EventBridge 处理 GuardDuty 发现](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_findings_eventbridge.html)；[通过 SNS 设置 GuardDuty 警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_settingup.html)）。EventBridge 以前称为 Amazon CloudWatch Events。从操作上看，EventBridge 规则（而不是基于指标阈值的 CloudWatch 警报）才是将 GuardDuty 发现路由到 SNS 的文档化机制。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

- **B — Amazon Inspector 网络可达性发现：** Inspector 通过分析安全组、网络 ACL、路由表和网关等配置，识别通向 EC2 实例的**开放网络路径**。这些发现表明实例或端口可达；它们并不表明有人确实执行了端口扫描。Inspector 网络可达性扫描也是定期运行，而不是用作持续的行为威胁检测（[Amazon Inspector 发现类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-types.html)）。

- **C — Amazon Inspector CVE 发现：** 软件包漏洞发现可识别受 Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures 影响的软件包。易受攻击的应用程序或暴露的服务可能会增加风险，但 CVE 发现并不能提供发生端口扫描活动的证据（[Amazon Inspector 发现类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-types.html)）。

- **D — CloudTrail 日志分析：** AWS CloudTrail 会记录 EC2 API 活动，包括启动、描述或停止实例等管理操作。普通 TCP 或 UDP 端口扫描属于网络流量活动，而不是 EC2 API 调用，因此 CloudTrail 日志无法提供此检测所需的数据包级或流级证据。因此，分析这些日志的 Lambda 函数无法可靠地检测扫描（[使用 CloudTrail 记录 Amazon EC2 API 调用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitor-with-cloudtrail.html)）。

因此，公司应启用 **Amazon GuardDuty**，并将相关 GuardDuty EC2 端口扫描发现路由到已订阅的 SNS 主题。

en.question: A company runs applications in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The EKS cluster uses an Application Load Balancer to route traffic to the applications that run in the cluster. A new application that was migrated to the EKS cluster is performing poorly. All the other applications in the EKS cluster maintain appropriate operation. The new application scales out horizontally to the preconfigured maximum number of pods immediately upon deployment, before any user traffic routes to the web application. Which solution will resolve the scaling behavior of the web application in the EKS cluster?

options.A: Implement the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler in the EKS cluster.
options.B: Implement the Vertical Pod Autoscaler in the EKS cluster.
options.C: Implement the Cluster Autoscaler.
options.D: Implement the AWS Load Balancer Controller in the EKS cluster.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The application immediately increases to its configured **maximum number of Pods even before user traffic arrives**, while the other applications and the cluster are operating normally. This points to the new application's Pods being **under-resourced or incorrectly sized** for their baseline/startup CPU or memory demand. The horizontal scaling mechanism therefore sees excessive utilization and keeps adding replicas, but the additional replicas do not correct the underlying per-Pod resource sizing problem.

## Correct answer: B. Implement the Vertical Pod Autoscaler

The **Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA)** automatically adjusts CPU and memory requests for Pods to right-size an application. AWS specifically documents that VPA can detect an under-resourced, CPU-constrained Pod and relaunch it with more appropriate CPU and memory reservations. This is the relevant corrective action when a newly migrated application consumes excessive resources relative to its configured Pod requests before it receives traffic. See [Adjust pod resources with Vertical Pod Autoscaler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/vertical-pod-autoscaler.html).

Properly sizing each Pod reduces the inappropriate utilization signal that is causing the application to reach its horizontal maximum and also addresses the application's poor performance.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Implement the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler — Incorrect.** The HPA changes the **number of Pods** based on observed utilization and scales up to a configured maximum. The described behavior—horizontal expansion to a preconfigured maximum—strongly indicates that horizontal autoscaling is already occurring. AWS's HPA example shows that utilization above the target causes replicas to increase until the target is met or the configured maximum is reached. Adding HPA does not correct undersized CPU or memory requests for each Pod. See [Scale pod deployments with Horizontal Pod Autoscaler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/horizontal-pod-autoscaler.html).

- **C. Implement the Cluster Autoscaler — Incorrect.** Cluster Autoscaler adjusts the number of **worker nodes** when Pods cannot be scheduled or need to be rescheduled. The issue is the application's Pod sizing and replica behavior, not insufficient node capacity. See [Scale cluster compute with Karpenter and Cluster Autoscaler](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/autoscaling.html).

- **D. Implement the AWS Load Balancer Controller — Incorrect.** The AWS Load Balancer Controller provisions and manages AWS load balancers for Kubernetes `Ingress` and `Service` resources. It controls how traffic is exposed and routed to Pods; it does not right-size Pod CPU or memory or control Pod replica scaling. The scenario also states that an ALB is already routing traffic to the cluster applications. See [Route internet traffic with AWS Load Balancer Controller](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/aws-load-balancer-controller.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群中运行应用程序。该 EKS 集群使用 Application Load Balancer 将流量路由到在集群中运行的应用程序。一个刚迁移到 EKS 集群的新应用程序性能不佳。EKS 集群中的所有其他应用程序均保持正常运行。新应用程序在部署后立即水平扩展到预先配置的最大 Pod 数量，而此时尚未有任何用户流量被路由到该 Web 应用程序。哪种解决方案可以解决 EKS 集群中该 Web 应用程序的扩缩容行为？

options.A: 在 EKS 集群中实施 Horizontal Pod Autoscaler。
options.B: 在 EKS 集群中实施 Vertical Pod Autoscaler。
options.C: 实施 Cluster Autoscaler。
options.D: 在 EKS 集群中实施 AWS Load Balancer Controller。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查的内容

该应用程序甚至在用户流量到达之前，就立即增加到其配置的**最大 Pod 数量**，而其他应用程序和集群均正常运行。这表明新应用程序的 Pod 对其基准/启动 CPU 或内存需求而言**资源不足或规格配置不正确**。因此，水平扩缩容机制检测到过高的利用率并持续添加副本，但额外副本并未解决每个 Pod 资源规格配置不当这一根本问题。

## 正确答案：B. 实施 Vertical Pod Autoscaler

**Vertical Pod Autoscaler (VPA)** 会自动调整 Pod 的 CPU 和内存请求，以便为应用程序进行适当的规格配置。AWS 明确指出，VPA 可以检测资源不足、受 CPU 限制的 Pod，并使用更合适的 CPU 和内存预留量重新启动该 Pod。当新迁移的应用程序在接收流量之前，相对于其配置的 Pod 请求消耗过多资源时，这是相关的纠正措施。请参阅 [使用 Vertical Pod Autoscaler 调整 Pod 资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/vertical-pod-autoscaler.html)。

正确配置每个 Pod 的规格，可减少导致应用程序达到其水平扩展最大值的不当利用率信号，同时也能解决该应用程序的性能不佳问题。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **A. 实施 Horizontal Pod Autoscaler — 不正确。** HPA 会根据观测到的利用率改变 **Pod 数量**，并扩展至配置的最大值。所描述的行为——水平扩展到预先配置的最大值——强烈表明水平自动扩缩容已经在发生。AWS 的 HPA 示例显示，利用率超过目标值会导致副本数量增加，直到达到目标值或配置的最大值。添加 HPA 无法纠正每个 Pod 的 CPU 或内存请求配置不足的问题。请参阅 [使用 Horizontal Pod Autoscaler 扩展 Pod 部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/horizontal-pod-autoscaler.html)。

- **C. 实施 Cluster Autoscaler — 不正确。** Cluster Autoscaler 会在 Pod 无法被调度或需要重新调度时调整 **工作节点** 的数量。问题在于应用程序的 Pod 规格和副本行为，而不是节点容量不足。请参阅 [使用 Karpenter 和 Cluster Autoscaler 扩展集群计算资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/autoscaling.html)。

- **D. 实施 AWS Load Balancer Controller — 不正确。** AWS Load Balancer Controller 为 Kubernetes `Ingress` 和 `Service` 资源预置和管理 AWS 负载均衡器。它控制如何向 Pod 暴露流量并将流量路由至 Pod；它不会适当配置 Pod 的 CPU 或内存规格，也不会控制 Pod 副本扩缩容。该场景还说明，ALB 已经在将流量路由至集群中的应用程序。请参阅 [使用 AWS Load Balancer Controller 路由互联网流量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/aws-load-balancer-controller.html)。

en.question: A company has an AWS Control Tower landing zone that manages its organization in AWS Organizations. The company created an OU structure that is based on the company's requirements. The company's DevOps team has established the core accounts for the solution and an account for all centralized AWS CloudFormation and AWS Service Catalog solutions. The company wants to offer a series of customizations that an account can request through AWS Control Tower. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Enable trusted access for CloudFormation with Organizations by using service-managed permissions.
options.B: Create an IAM role that is named AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess. Configure the role with a trust policy that allows the AWSControlTowerAdmin role in the management account to assume the role. Attach the AWSServiceCatalogAdminFullAccess IAM policy to the AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess role.
options.C: Create a Service Catalog product for each CloudFormation template.
options.D: Create a CloudFormation stack set for each CloudFormation template. Enable automatic deployment for each stack set. Create a CloudFormation stack instance that targets specific OUs.
options.E: Deploy the Customizations for AWS Control Tower (CfCT) CloudFormation stack.
options.F: Create a CloudFormation template that contains the resources for each customization.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company wants account-level customizations that users can select when creating or updating accounts through AWS Control Tower. This is the **Account Factory Customization (AFC)** blueprint workflow: define a customization in a CloudFormation template, package it as an AWS Service Catalog product in a centralized blueprint hub account, and grant AWS Control Tower access to that hub account.

## Correct answers: B, C, and F

### B. Create the `AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess` IAM role

AWS Control Tower requires this specifically named role in the blueprint hub account. AWS Control Tower assumes it to administer the Service Catalog portfolio and blueprint products and share the selected blueprint with member accounts. The role must trust the `AWSControlTowerAdmin` role in the management account, and the managed policy `AWSServiceCatalogAdminFullAccess` must be attached. AWS documentation also specifies trust for the principal that operates AWS Control Tower in the management account. See [Step 1: Create the required role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/step-1-create-blueprint-access-role.html).

### C. Create a Service Catalog product for each CloudFormation template

AFC represents an account blueprint as an **AWS Service Catalog product** stored in the blueprint hub account. AWS Control Tower can then present the available blueprint product during account creation or update. The documented AFC setup explicitly includes creating the Service Catalog blueprint product. See [Set up for customization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/afc-setup-steps.html).

An individual account can have only one AFC blueprint product applied at a time, but the company can maintain multiple products representing different available customizations.

### F. Create a CloudFormation template containing the resources for each customization

For a CloudFormation-based AFC blueprint, the template defines the resources and configuration that AWS Control Tower will provision in the customized account. The template is uploaded when creating the corresponding Service Catalog product. See [Step 2: Create the AWS Service Catalog product](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/step-2-create-blueprint-product.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Enable CloudFormation trusted access with Organizations

This is not one of the required AFC blueprint setup steps. AFC accesses the centralized blueprint hub account through the specifically configured `AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess` role. The documented setup consists of creating that role, creating the Service Catalog product, reviewing the blueprint, and selecting it during account provisioning—not manually enabling CloudFormation trusted access for Organizations.

### D. Manually create automatically deployed StackSets targeting OUs

This describes an organization-wide push deployment to OUs, not an account-requested AFC blueprint. AFC users select a Service Catalog blueprint during the AWS Control Tower account workflow. The administrator supplies the template and product; manually creating StackSets and stack instances is not part of the documented AFC setup. Automatic OU deployment would also apply the customization based on OU membership rather than based on an account's blueprint request.

### E. Deploy Customizations for AWS Control Tower (CfCT)

CfCT is a separate GitOps-style landing-zone customization framework. It deploys resources and policies automatically to specified accounts and OUs using CloudFormation templates, configuration packages, and AWS Control Tower lifecycle events. It is useful for centrally enforced landing-zone customizations, but it is not required for selectable AFC blueprint products. AWS states that CfCT customizes accounts and OUs through automated deployments, whereas the requirement here aligns with AFC's user-selected blueprint workflow. See [Benefits of Customizations for AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/customize-landing-zone.html).

Therefore, the required combination is **B, C, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个 AWS Control Tower 登陆区，该登陆区在 AWS Organizations 中管理其组织。该公司创建了一个基于公司要求的 OU 结构。公司的 DevOps 团队已为该解决方案建立了核心账户，以及一个用于所有集中式 AWS CloudFormation 和 AWS Service Catalog 解决方案的账户。该公司希望提供一系列账户可通过 AWS Control Tower 请求的自定义项。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 使用服务托管权限，为 CloudFormation 启用与 Organizations 的可信访问。
options.B: 创建一个名为 AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess 的 IAM 角色。为该角色配置一个信任策略，允许管理账户中的 AWSControlTowerAdmin 角色担任该角色。将 AWSServiceCatalogAdminFullAccess IAM 策略附加到 AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess 角色。
options.C: 为每个 CloudFormation 模板创建一个 Service Catalog 产品。
options.D: 为每个 CloudFormation 模板创建一个 CloudFormation StackSet。为每个 StackSet 启用自动部署。创建一个以特定 OU 为目标的 CloudFormation 堆栈实例。
options.E: 部署 Customizations for AWS Control Tower (CfCT) CloudFormation 堆栈。
options.F: 创建一个 CloudFormation 模板，其中包含每项自定义所需的资源。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司希望提供账户级自定义项，用户可以在通过 AWS Control Tower 创建或更新账户时选择这些自定义项。这是 **Account Factory Customization (AFC)** 蓝图工作流程：在 CloudFormation 模板中定义自定义项，将其打包为集中式蓝图中心账户中的 AWS Service Catalog 产品，并授予 AWS Control Tower 对该中心账户的访问权限。

## 正确答案：B、C 和 F

### B. 创建 `AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess` IAM 角色

AWS Control Tower 要求在蓝图中心账户中使用这个特定名称的角色。AWS Control Tower 担任该角色，以管理 Service Catalog 产品组合和蓝图产品，并与成员账户共享选定的蓝图。该角色必须信任管理账户中的 `AWSControlTowerAdmin` 角色，并且必须附加托管策略 `AWSServiceCatalogAdminFullAccess`。AWS 文档还规定，必须信任在管理账户中操作 AWS Control Tower 的主体。请参阅 [步骤 1：创建所需角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/step-1-create-blueprint-access-role.html)。

### C. 为每个 CloudFormation 模板创建一个 Service Catalog 产品

AFC 将账户蓝图表示为存储在蓝图中心账户中的 **AWS Service Catalog 产品**。随后，AWS Control Tower 可以在创建或更新账户期间展示可用的蓝图产品。文档化的 AFC 设置明确包括创建 Service Catalog 蓝图产品。请参阅 [设置自定义](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/afc-setup-steps.html)。

单个账户一次只能应用一个 AFC 蓝图产品，但公司可以维护多个产品来表示不同的可用自定义项。

### F. 创建一个包含每项自定义资源的 CloudFormation 模板

对于基于 CloudFormation 的 AFC 蓝图，该模板定义 AWS Control Tower 将在已自定义账户中预置的资源和配置。在创建相应的 Service Catalog 产品时上传该模板。请参阅 [步骤 2：创建 AWS Service Catalog 产品](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/step-2-create-blueprint-product.html)。

## 其他选项不正确的原因

### A. 为 CloudFormation 启用与 Organizations 的可信访问

这不是所需的 AFC 蓝图设置步骤之一。AFC 通过专门配置的 `AWSControlTowerBlueprintAccess` 角色访问集中式蓝图中心账户。文档化的设置包括创建该角色、创建 Service Catalog 产品、审核蓝图，以及在账户预置期间选择该蓝图，而不是手动为 CloudFormation 启用与 Organizations 的可信访问。

### D. 手动创建以 OU 为目标并自动部署的 StackSets

这描述的是向 OU 进行组织范围的推送部署，而不是由账户请求的 AFC 蓝图。AFC 用户在 AWS Control Tower 账户工作流程中选择一个 Service Catalog 蓝图。管理员提供模板和产品；手动创建 StackSets 和堆栈实例不是文档化 AFC 设置的一部分。自动 OU 部署还会根据 OU 成员资格应用自定义项，而不是根据账户的蓝图请求进行应用。

### E. 部署 Customizations for AWS Control Tower (CfCT)

CfCT 是一个独立的、GitOps 风格的登陆区自定义框架。它使用 CloudFormation 模板、配置包和 AWS Control Tower 生命周期事件，将资源和策略自动部署到指定账户和 OU。它适用于集中强制实施的登陆区自定义，但不是可选择的 AFC 蓝图产品所必需的。AWS 指出，CfCT 通过自动化部署来自定义账户和 OU，而此处的要求符合 AFC 的用户选择蓝图工作流程。请参阅 [Customizations for AWS Control Tower 的优势](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/customize-landing-zone.html)。

因此，所需的组合是 **B、C 和 F**。

en.question: A company runs a workload on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs a control that requires the use of Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) on all EC2 instances in the AWS account. If an EC2 instance does not prevent the use of Instance Metadata Service Version 1 (IMDSv1), the EC2 instance must be terminated. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Set up AWS Config in the account. Use a managed rule to check EC2 instances. Configure the rule to remediate the findings by using AWS Systems Manager Automation to terminate the instance.
options.B: Create a permissions boundary that prevents the ec2:RunInstance action if the ec2:MetadataHttpTokens condition key is not set to a value of required. Attach the permissions boundary to the IAM role that was used to launch the instance.
options.C: Set up Amazon Inspector in the account. Configure Amazon Inspector to activate deep inspection for EC2 instances. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for an Inspector2 finding. Set an AWS Lambda function as the target to terminate the instance.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for the EC2 instance launch successful event. Send the event to an AWS Lambda function to inspect the EC2 metadata and to terminate the instance.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a **detective and reactive compliance control** for every EC2 instance: detect whether the instance permits IMDSv1 and, if it does, **terminate the noncompliant instance**.

## Correct answer: A

AWS Config provides the managed rule **`EC2_IMDSV2_CHECK`** (`ec2-imdsv2-check`). It evaluates EC2 instances and marks an instance **NON_COMPLIANT when `HttpTokens` is `optional`**, which means IMDSv1 is still permitted. See [AWS Config: ec2-imdsv2-check](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-imdsv2-check.html).

AWS Config can associate a noncompliant rule result with an AWS Systems Manager Automation document for remediation. AWS documents that Config remediation actions are performed through Systems Manager Automation documents and can use either managed or custom documents. See [Remediating noncompliant resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html).

The managed Systems Manager Automation runbook [`AWS-TerminateEC2Instance`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-terminateec2instance.html) accepts EC2 instance IDs and terminates those instances. Therefore, the Config rule plus automatic SSM Automation remediation directly implements the required behavior. The rule and remediation should be deployed in every applicable AWS Region in the account.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Permissions boundary

An IAM policy can use `ec2:MetadataHttpTokens` to prevent `RunInstances` requests that do not require IMDSv2; AWS documents this as a valid preventive technique. However, this option does **not** satisfy the stated remediation requirement:

- It prevents a launch rather than terminating a noncompliant instance.
- It does not evaluate or terminate existing instances that already permit IMDSv1.
- Attaching the boundary to one launch role does not establish an account-wide control for launches performed through other principals.
- It also does not address an existing instance whose metadata options are subsequently changed unless additional controls are included for `ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions`.

AWS distinguishes controls for new launches from controls for existing instances in [Transition to using IMDSv2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-metadata-transition-to-version-2.html). Thus, B can be part of a defense-in-depth preventive strategy, but it does not implement the required detect-and-terminate behavior.

### C. Amazon Inspector deep inspection

Amazon Inspector deep inspection searches Linux EC2 instances for **operating-system and programming-language package vulnerabilities**. It does not evaluate the EC2 `HttpTokens` metadata option or generate an IMDSv2 configuration-compliance finding. See [Amazon Inspector deep inspection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/deep-inspection.html). Consequently, an Inspector finding EventBridge rule would not reliably identify instances that permit IMDSv1.

### D. EC2 launch event and Lambda

The named **`EC2 Instance Launch Successful`** event is an **EC2 Auto Scaling** event, not a universal event for every EC2 instance launched in the account. AWS also states that these Auto Scaling events are delivered on a best-effort basis. Its event payload identifies the launched instance but does not contain its metadata-options compliance state. See [Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling event reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-event-reference.html).

A custom event-driven Lambda design could be built with additional API calls and broader event coverage, but the option as written is less complete and less directly aligned than the purpose-built AWS Config managed rule with SSM Automation remediation.

zh.question: 一家公司在 Amazon EC2 实例上运行工作负载。该公司需要一种控制措施，要求 AWS 账户中的所有 EC2 实例都使用 Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2)。如果某个 EC2 实例未禁止使用 Instance Metadata Service Version 1 (IMDSv1)，则必须终止该 EC2 实例。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在账户中设置 AWS Config。使用托管规则检查 EC2 实例。配置该规则以使用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 修复发现结果并终止实例。
options.B: 创建一个权限边界：如果 `ec2:MetadataHttpTokens` 条件键未设置为 `required` 值，则阻止 `ec2:RunInstance` 操作。将该权限边界附加到用于启动实例的 IAM 角色。
options.C: 在账户中设置 Amazon Inspector。配置 Amazon Inspector 以对 EC2 实例启用深度检查。为 Inspector2 发现结果创建 Amazon EventBridge 规则。将 AWS Lambda 函数设为目标以终止实例。
options.D: 为 EC2 实例启动成功事件创建 Amazon EventBridge 规则。将事件发送到 AWS Lambda 函数，以检查 EC2 元数据并终止实例。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要针对每个 EC2 实施一项**侦测型和响应型合规控制**：检测实例是否允许 IMDSv1；如果允许，则**终止不合规实例**。

## 正确答案：A

AWS Config 提供托管规则 **`EC2_IMDSV2_CHECK`** (`ec2-imdsv2-check`)。该规则评估 EC2 实例，并在 `HttpTokens` 为 `optional` 时将实例标记为 **NON_COMPLIANT**，这意味着仍允许使用 IMDSv1。请参阅 [AWS Config: ec2-imdsv2-check](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-imdsv2-check.html)。

AWS Config 可以将不合规规则结果与用于修复的 AWS Systems Manager Automation 文档关联。AWS 文档说明，Config 修复操作通过 Systems Manager Automation 文档执行，并且可以使用托管文档或自定义文档。请参阅 [使用 AWS Config 修复不合规资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)。

托管的 Systems Manager Automation 运行手册 [`AWS-TerminateEC2Instance`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-terminateec2instance.html) 接受 EC2 实例 ID 并终止这些实例。因此，Config 规则加上自动 SSM Automation 修复可直接实现所需行为。该规则和修复措施应部署在账户中所有适用的 AWS Region。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 权限边界

IAM 策略可以使用 `ec2:MetadataHttpTokens` 阻止不要求使用 IMDSv2 的 `RunInstances` 请求；AWS 将此记录为一种有效的预防性技术。但是，该选项**不**满足所述的修复要求：

- 它会阻止启动，而不是终止不合规实例。
- 它不会评估或终止已经允许 IMDSv1 的现有实例。
- 将边界附加到一个启动角色，无法为通过其他主体执行的启动操作建立账户级控制。
- 除非针对 `ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions` 包含额外控制，否则它也无法处理元数据选项随后被更改的现有实例。

AWS 在 [过渡到使用 IMDSv2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instance-metadata-transition-to-version-2.html) 中区分了针对新启动实例和现有实例的控制措施。因此，B 可以作为纵深防御预防策略的一部分，但它并未实现所需的检测并终止行为。

### C. Amazon Inspector 深度检查

Amazon Inspector 深度检查会在 Linux EC2 实例中搜索**操作系统和编程语言软件包漏洞**。它不会评估 EC2 `HttpTokens` 元数据选项，也不会生成 IMDSv2 配置合规性发现结果。请参阅 [Amazon Inspector 深度检查](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/deep-inspection.html)。因此，针对 Inspector 发现结果的 EventBridge 规则无法可靠地识别允许 IMDSv1 的实例。

### D. EC2 启动事件和 Lambda

所述的 **`EC2 Instance Launch Successful`** 事件是一个 **EC2 Auto Scaling** 事件，并非账户中每个已启动 EC2 实例的通用事件。AWS 还说明，这些 Auto Scaling 事件以尽力而为的方式传递。其事件负载会标识已启动的实例，但不包含其元数据选项合规状态。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 事件参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-event-reference.html)。

可以通过额外的 API 调用和更广泛的事件覆盖范围构建自定义事件驱动的 Lambda 设计，但按选项中的描述，该方案不如专门构建的 AWS Config 托管规则加 SSM Automation 修复完整，也没有后者直接符合要求。

en.question: A company builds an application that uses an Application Load Balancer in front of Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The application is stateless. The Auto Scaling group uses a custom AMI that is fully prebuilt. The EC2 instances do not have a custom bootstrapping process. The AMI that the Auto Scaling group uses was recently deleted. The Auto Scaling group's scaling activities show failures because the AMI ID does not exist. Which combination of steps should a DevOps engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a new launch template that uses the new AMI.
options.B: Update the Auto Scaling group to use the new launch template.
options.C: Reduce the Auto Scaling group's desired capacity to 0.
options.D: Increase the Auto Scaling group's desired capacity by 1.
options.E: Create a new AMI from a running EC2 instance in the Auto Scaling group.
options.F: Create a new AMI by copying the most recent public AMI of the operating system that the EC2 instances use.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

The Auto Scaling group cannot launch replacement or scale-out instances because its instance configuration references an AMI that has been deleted. Because the application uses a **fully prebuilt custom AMI** and has **no bootstrapping process**, the recovery must preserve the software and configuration already present on the existing instances. The application being stateless makes an existing healthy instance an appropriate source for rebuilding the image because no required application state should be tied to that individual instance.

## Correct answers: A, B, and E

The appropriate sequence is **E → A → B**:

1. **E. Create a new AMI from a running EC2 instance in the Auto Scaling group.**  
   A surviving instance was launched from the deleted custom AMI and therefore contains the prebuilt operating system, application, and configuration. Amazon EC2 supports creating a new AMI from an existing running or stopped instance. AWS explains that the resulting AMI includes the instance customizations and can subsequently be used to launch new instances. See [Create an AMI from an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-an-ami-ebs.html).

2. **A. Create a new launch template that uses the new AMI.**  
   A launch template defines the instance configuration that Auto Scaling uses, including the AMI ID. The new template must reference the newly created, valid AMI instead of the deleted AMI. AWS documents that a launch template includes settings such as the AMI ID, instance type, key pair, and security groups. See [Step 1: Create a launch template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/create-your-first-auto-scaling-group.html).

3. **B. Update the Auto Scaling group to use the new launch template.**  
   Merely creating the template does not change the Auto Scaling group's active instance configuration. The group must be updated to reference the new launch template so that future scaling and replacement launches use the valid AMI. AWS explicitly documents updating an existing group to use a launch template or a particular template version. See [Update an Auto Scaling group to use a launch template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/examples-launch-templates-aws-cli.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **C. Reduce the Auto Scaling group's desired capacity to 0 — Incorrect.**  
  This does not repair the invalid AMI reference. It would terminate the remaining healthy instances, causing an outage, and the group would still be unable to launch instances afterward because its configuration would continue to reference the deleted AMI. It could also eliminate the running instance needed to reconstruct the custom AMI.

- **D. Increase the Auto Scaling group's desired capacity by 1 — Incorrect.**  
  This triggers another launch attempt using the same nonexistent AMI ID, so the scaling activity will fail again. The launch configuration must be repaired before increasing capacity.

- **F. Create a new AMI by copying the most recent public AMI of the operating system — Incorrect.**  
  A public operating-system AMI would provide only the base OS, not the company's fully prebuilt application and custom configuration. Because the instances have no bootstrap process, Auto Scaling would have no mechanism to install and configure the application after launch. Creating an AMI from an existing application instance preserves those customizations, as described in the EC2 AMI creation documentation.

Therefore, **A, B, and E** restore a valid prebuilt image and configure the Auto Scaling group to use it.

zh.question: 一家公司构建了一个应用程序，该应用程序在 Auto Scaling group 中的 Amazon EC2 实例前使用 Application Load Balancer。该应用程序是无状态的。Auto Scaling group 使用一个完全预构建的自定义 AMI。EC2 实例没有自定义引导过程。Auto Scaling group 使用的 AMI 最近被删除。Auto Scaling group 的扩缩活动显示失败，因为该 AMI ID 不存在。DevOps 工程师应采取哪些步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 创建一个使用新 AMI 的新 launch template。
options.B: 更新 Auto Scaling group 以使用新的 launch template。
options.C: 将 Auto Scaling group 的所需容量降低至 0。
options.D: 将 Auto Scaling group 的所需容量增加 1。
options.E: 从 Auto Scaling group 中正在运行的 EC2 实例创建一个新 AMI。
options.F: 通过复制 EC2 实例所使用操作系统的最新 public AMI 来创建一个新 AMI。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

Auto Scaling group 无法启动替换实例或横向扩展实例，因为其实例配置引用了一个已删除的 AMI。由于该应用程序使用**完全预构建的自定义 AMI**，且**没有引导过程**，恢复操作必须保留现有实例上已存在的软件和配置。应用程序是无状态的，这使得现有的健康实例成为重建镜像的合适来源，因为不应有任何必需的应用程序状态绑定到该单个实例。

## 正确答案：A、B 和 E

适当的顺序为 **E → A → B**：

1. **E. 从 Auto Scaling group 中正在运行的 EC2 实例创建一个新 AMI。**  
   一个存活的实例是从已删除的自定义 AMI 启动的，因此其中包含预构建的操作系统、应用程序和配置。Amazon EC2 支持从现有正在运行或已停止的实例创建新的 AMI。AWS 说明，生成的 AMI 包含实例自定义内容，之后可用于启动新实例。参阅 [Create an AMI from an instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/creating-an-ami-ebs.html)。

2. **A. 创建一个使用新 AMI 的新 launch template。**  
   launch template 定义 Auto Scaling 使用的实例配置，其中包括 AMI ID。新模板必须引用新创建的有效 AMI，而不是已删除的 AMI。AWS 文档指出，launch template 包含 AMI ID、实例类型、密钥对和安全组等设置。参阅 [Step 1: Create a launch template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/create-your-first-auto-scaling-group.html)。

3. **B. 更新 Auto Scaling group 以使用新的 launch template。**  
   仅创建模板不会更改 Auto Scaling group 当前使用的实例配置。必须更新该组以引用新的 launch template，从而使未来的扩缩和替换启动使用有效的 AMI。AWS 明确说明了如何更新现有组以使用 launch template 或特定模板版本。参阅 [Update an Auto Scaling group to use a launch template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/examples-launch-templates-aws-cli.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **C. 将 Auto Scaling group 的所需容量降低至 0 — 错误。**  
  这不能修复无效的 AMI 引用。它会终止剩余的健康实例，导致服务中断；并且该组之后仍无法启动实例，因为其配置仍会引用已删除的 AMI。它还可能会消除用于重建自定义 AMI 所需的运行中实例。

- **D. 将 Auto Scaling group 的所需容量增加 1 — 错误。**  
  这会使用同一个不存在的 AMI ID 再次触发启动尝试，因此扩缩活动将再次失败。必须先修复启动配置，然后才能增加容量。

- **F. 通过复制操作系统的最新 public AMI 来创建一个新 AMI — 错误。**  
  public 操作系统 AMI 只会提供基础操作系统，不包含公司完全预构建的应用程序和自定义配置。由于实例没有引导过程，Auto Scaling 在启动后将没有安装和配置应用程序的机制。从现有应用程序实例创建 AMI 可以保留这些自定义内容，如 EC2 AMI 创建文档中所述。

因此，**A、B 和 E** 可恢复有效的预构建镜像，并配置 Auto Scaling group 使用该镜像。

en.question: A company deploys a web application on Amazon EC2 instances that are behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company stores the application code in an AWS CodeCommit repository. When code is merged to the main branch, an AWS Lambda function invokes an AWS CodeBuild project. The CodeBuild project packages the code, stores the packaged code in AWS CodeArtifact, and invokes AWS Systems Manager Run Command to deploy the packaged code to the EC2 instances. Previous deployments have resulted in defects, EC2 instances that are not running the latest version of the packaged code, and inconsistencies between instances. Which combination of actions should a DevOps engineer take to implement a more reliable deployment solution? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline that uses the CodeCommit repository as a source provider. Configure pipeline stages that run the CodeBuild project in parallel to build and test the application. In the pipeline, pass the CodeBuild project output artifact to an AWS CodeDeploy action.
options.B: Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline that uses the CodeCommit repository as a source provider. Create separate pipeline stages that run a CodeBuild project to build and then test the application. In the pipeline, pass the CodeBuild project output artifact to an AWS CodeDeploy action.
options.C: Create an AWS CodeDeploy application and a deployment group to deploy the packaged code to the EC2 instances. Configure the ALB for the deployment group.
options.D: Create individual Lambda functions that use AWS CodeDeploy instead of Systems Manager to run build, test, and deploy actions.
options.E: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Modify the CodeBuild project to store the packages in the S3 bucket instead of in CodeArtifact. Use deploy actions in CodeDeploy to deploy the artifact to the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The current process uses a Lambda function and Systems Manager Run Command as a custom deployment mechanism. That approach lacks a managed, end-to-end release workflow and can leave different EC2 instances on different application versions. The more reliable solution is to use:

1. **CodePipeline** to enforce ordered build, test, and deployment stages.
2. **CodeDeploy** to coordinate deployment across the EC2 fleet and integrate deployment activity with the existing ALB.

## Correct answers: B and C

### B. Create sequential build and test stages in CodePipeline, then pass the artifact to CodeDeploy

This provides a controlled promotion path: **source → build → test → deploy**. Testing should occur after the build succeeds and should consume the artifact produced by that build. AWS's CodePipeline tutorial demonstrates adding a separate test stage after the build stage and explicitly configuring the build artifact as the test action's input. It also demonstrates selecting CodeDeploy as the deployment provider after the earlier stages succeed. See [Tutorial: Create a four-stage pipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-four-stage-pipeline.html).

The CodeDeploy action for CodePipeline accepts one input artifact and requires a CodeDeploy application and deployment group. It then deploys the application code to the configured EC2 deployment fleet. See [AWS CodeDeploy deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html).

Sequential stages prevent untested builds from reaching the EC2 instances and provide centralized execution status, failure handling, and traceability.

### C. Create a CodeDeploy application and deployment group, and configure the ALB for the deployment group

The CodeDeploy application and deployment group identify the target EC2 fleet and define how deployment is performed. Integrating the ALB with the deployment group improves reliability because, for an in-place deployment, CodeDeploy can deregister an instance while it is being updated and register it again after the deployment work is complete. CodeDeploy also supports blue/green deployments to EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. See [Set up a load balancer for CodeDeploy Amazon EC2 deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-groups-create-load-balancer.html).

This managed fleet-wide deployment process directly addresses inconsistent versions and partially updated instances.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Run build and test in parallel

Build and test are dependent operations in this scenario: the test must validate the packaged output produced by the build. Running them in parallel can cause the test to run without the correct build artifact or to validate a different revision. AWS's pipeline example passes the build artifact into a later test stage, supporting the sequential design in B rather than parallel execution. See [Tutorial: Create a four-stage pipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-four-stage-pipeline.html).

### D. Use individual Lambda functions for build, test, and deployment

This preserves a fragmented, custom orchestration model. CodeDeploy is a deployment service; it is not a replacement for CodeBuild's build/test capabilities or CodePipeline's workflow orchestration. The documented CodePipeline CodeDeploy action is specifically a **deploy** action that sends an input artifact to an EC2 deployment fleet. See [AWS CodeDeploy deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html).

### E. Manually move the package from CodeArtifact to a new S3 bucket

CodeDeploy application revisions for EC2 can be stored in Amazon S3 or GitHub, as documented in [Working with application revisions for CodeDeploy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/application-revisions.html). However, this option does not provide the required reliable build-test-deploy orchestration and is unnecessary when using B: CodePipeline manages its artifact store and passes the CodeBuild output artifact directly to its CodeDeploy action. Merely changing the package location does not solve skipped testing, inconsistent fleet deployment, or ALB coordination.

zh.question: 一家公司在位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上部署了一个 Web 应用程序。该公司将应用程序代码存储在 AWS CodeCommit 存储库中。当代码合并到 main 分支时，AWS Lambda 函数会调用一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目。该 CodeBuild 项目对代码进行打包，将打包后的代码存储在 AWS CodeArtifact 中，并调用 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 将打包后的代码部署到 EC2 实例。以前的部署曾导致缺陷、部分 EC2 实例未运行最新版本的打包代码，以及实例之间存在不一致。DevOps 工程师应采取哪种操作组合来实施更可靠的部署解决方案？（选择两项。）

options.A: 在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个管道，使用 CodeCommit 存储库作为源提供程序。配置管道阶段，以并行方式运行 CodeBuild 项目来构建和测试应用程序。在管道中，将 CodeBuild 项目输出构件传递给 AWS CodeDeploy 操作。
options.B: 在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个管道，使用 CodeCommit 存储库作为源提供程序。创建独立的管道阶段，依次运行 CodeBuild 项目来构建应用程序，然后测试应用程序。在管道中，将 CodeBuild 项目输出构件传递给 AWS CodeDeploy 操作。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CodeDeploy 应用程序和部署组，以将打包后的代码部署到 EC2 实例。为该部署组配置 ALB。
options.D: 创建各个 Lambda 函数，使用 AWS CodeDeploy 而非 Systems Manager 来执行构建、测试和部署操作。
options.E: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。修改 CodeBuild 项目，使其将软件包存储在 S3 存储桶中，而不是 CodeArtifact 中。使用 CodeDeploy 中的部署操作将构件部署到 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

当前流程使用 Lambda 函数和 Systems Manager Run Command 作为自定义部署机制。这种方法缺乏受管的端到端发布工作流程，并且可能导致不同的 EC2 实例运行不同版本的应用程序。更可靠的解决方案是使用：

1. **CodePipeline** 强制执行有序的构建、测试和部署阶段。
2. **CodeDeploy** 协调整个 EC2 实例队列的部署，并将部署活动与现有 ALB 集成。

## 正确答案：B 和 C

### B. 在 CodePipeline 中创建顺序的构建和测试阶段，然后将构件传递给 CodeDeploy

这提供了一条受控的提升路径：**源代码 → 构建 → 测试 → 部署**。测试应在构建成功后进行，并且应使用该构建产生的构件。AWS 的 CodePipeline 教程演示了如何在构建阶段之后添加单独的测试阶段，并明确将构建构件配置为测试操作的输入。该教程还演示了如何在先前阶段成功后选择 CodeDeploy 作为部署提供程序。请参阅 [教程：创建四阶段管道](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-four-stage-pipeline.html)。

适用于 CodePipeline 的 CodeDeploy 操作接受一个输入构件，并且需要一个 CodeDeploy 应用程序和部署组。随后，它会将应用程序代码部署到已配置的 EC2 部署实例队列。请参阅 [AWS CodeDeploy 部署操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html)。

顺序阶段可防止未经测试的构建版本到达 EC2 实例，并提供集中式执行状态、故障处理和可追溯性。

### C. 创建 CodeDeploy 应用程序和部署组，并为部署组配置 ALB

CodeDeploy 应用程序和部署组用于标识目标 EC2 实例队列并定义部署执行方式。将 ALB 与部署组集成可提高可靠性，因为对于原地部署，CodeDeploy 可以在实例更新期间将其注销，并在部署工作完成后再次注册。CodeDeploy 还支持对位于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 EC2 实例执行蓝绿部署。请参阅 [为 CodeDeploy Amazon EC2 部署设置负载均衡器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-groups-create-load-balancer.html)。

这一受管的全实例队列部署流程直接解决了版本不一致和实例仅部分更新的问题。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 并行运行构建和测试

在此情形中，构建和测试是相互依赖的操作：测试必须验证构建产生的打包输出。并行运行它们可能导致测试在没有正确构建构件的情况下运行，或验证了不同的修订版本。AWS 的管道示例会将构建构件传递到后续测试阶段，支持 B 中的顺序设计，而非并行执行。请参阅 [教程：创建四阶段管道](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-four-stage-pipeline.html)。

### D. 对构建、测试和部署使用各个 Lambda 函数

这保留了碎片化的自定义编排模型。CodeDeploy 是一项部署服务；它不能替代 CodeBuild 的构建/测试功能，也不能替代 CodePipeline 的工作流程编排功能。已记录的 CodePipeline CodeDeploy 操作专门是一项 **部署** 操作，它将输入构件发送到 EC2 部署实例队列。请参阅 [AWS CodeDeploy 部署操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html)。

### E. 将软件包从 CodeArtifact 手动迁移到新的 S3 存储桶

如 [使用 CodeDeploy 的应用程序修订版本](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/application-revisions.html) 中所述，适用于 EC2 的 CodeDeploy 应用程序修订版本可以存储在 Amazon S3 或 GitHub 中。但是，此选项无法提供所需的可靠构建-测试-部署编排；并且在使用 B 时也没有必要这样做：CodePipeline 会管理其构件存储，并将 CodeBuild 输出构件直接传递给其 CodeDeploy 操作。仅仅更改软件包位置无法解决跳过测试、实例队列部署不一致或 ALB 协调的问题。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. The company's automation account contains a CI/CD pipeline that creates and configures new AWS accounts. The company has a group of internal service teams that provide services to accounts in the organization. The service teams operate out of a set of services accounts. The service teams want to receive an AWS CloudTrail event in their services accounts when the CreateAccount API call creates a new account. How should the company share this CloudTrail event with the service accounts?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule in the automation account to send account creation events to the default event bus in the services accounts. Update the default event bus in the services accounts to allow events from the automation account.
options.B: Create a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus in the services accounts. Update the custom event bus to allow events from the automation account. Create an EventBridge rule in the services account that directly listens to CloudTrail events from the automation account.
options.C: Create a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus in the automation account and the services accounts. Create an EventBridge rule and policy that connects the custom event buses that are in the automation account and the services accounts.
options.D: Create a custom Amazon EventBridge event bus in the automation account. Create an EventBridge rule and policy that connects the custom event bus to the default event buses in the services accounts.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The `CreateAccount` activity occurs in the automation account, but the service teams need the resulting event delivered to event buses in their separate services accounts. Therefore, the company needs **cross-account EventBridge routing** from the account where the event is generated to the accounts where it will be consumed.

AWS Organizations records both `CreateAccount` and the asynchronous `CreateAccountResult` as CloudTrail events. The latter can be matched when the requirement is specifically to notify teams after the account has actually been created successfully. AWS also notes that Organizations activity is recorded in `us-east-1`. See [Logging API calls with AWS CloudTrail for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_cloudtrail-integration.html).

## Correct answer: A

Create an EventBridge rule in the **automation account** that matches the relevant AWS Organizations event—for example, `CreateAccountResult` with a `SUCCEEDED` state—and configure the default event bus in each services account as a cross-account target. Each receiving default event bus must have a resource-based policy that permits the automation account to send events.

This follows the documented cross-account EventBridge procedure:

1. In the receiver account, grant the sender permission on the receiving event bus.
2. In the sender account, create a rule whose target is the receiver account's event bus.
3. Optionally, create receiver-side rules to route the received event to local targets.

See [Sending and receiving events between AWS accounts in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-cross-account.html) and [Permissions for event buses in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-bus-perms.html).

The default bus is appropriate because AWS service events are delivered to the account's default event bus. For current deployments, the cross-account event bus target also requires an IAM role in the sending account; this can be created as part of configuring the target.

A rule has a maximum of five targets. If there are more than five services accounts, the company can create additional equivalent rules; this quota does not change the required architecture. See [How event buses work in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-bus.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

The receiver-side custom bus policy is valid by itself, but the option omits the essential **sender-side rule** that forwards the event from the automation account to that custom bus. A rule in a services account cannot simply listen directly to CloudTrail events generated in another account. The event must first be sent cross-account by a rule in the automation account. A receiver-side rule can process an event only after the event has arrived on the receiver's bus.

### C

Creating custom buses and resource policies does not automatically connect or replicate them. More importantly, the AWS Organizations CloudTrail event initially arrives on the automation account's **default bus**, not on a newly created custom bus. The option provides no rule on the source default bus that matches the account-creation event and forwards it.

### D

This also starts with a custom bus in the automation account, but the CloudTrail/AWS service event is delivered to the default bus. Without a rule that transfers the event from the default bus to that custom bus, the custom bus has no account-creation event to forward. The direct and documented design is a rule on the automation account's source/default bus targeting the authorized event buses in the services accounts.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的组织来管理其 AWS 账户。该公司的自动化账户包含一个 CI/CD 管道，用于创建和配置新的 AWS 账户。该公司有一组内部服务团队，为组织中的账户提供服务。这些服务团队在一组服务账户中运行。服务团队希望在 CreateAccount API 调用创建新账户时，在其服务账户中接收 AWS CloudTrail 事件。公司应如何与服务账户共享此 CloudTrail 事件？

options.A: 在自动化账户中创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，将账户创建事件发送到服务账户中的默认事件总线。更新服务账户中的默认事件总线，以允许来自自动化账户的事件。
options.B: 在服务账户中创建自定义 Amazon EventBridge 事件总线。更新自定义事件总线，以允许来自自动化账户的事件。在服务账户中创建一条 EventBridge 规则，直接侦听来自自动化账户的 CloudTrail 事件。
options.C: 在自动化账户和服务账户中创建自定义 Amazon EventBridge 事件总线。创建一条 EventBridge 规则和策略，以连接自动化账户和服务账户中的自定义事件总线。
options.D: 在自动化账户中创建自定义 Amazon EventBridge 事件总线。创建一条 EventBridge 规则和策略，以将自定义事件总线连接到服务账户中的默认事件总线。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

`CreateAccount` 活动发生在自动化账户中，但服务团队需要将产生的事件传送到其独立服务账户中的事件总线。因此，公司需要从生成事件的账户向使用事件的账户进行**跨账户 EventBridge 路由**。

AWS Organizations 会将 `CreateAccount` 和异步的 `CreateAccountResult` 都记录为 CloudTrail 事件。当要求是在账户实际成功创建后通知团队时，可以匹配后者。AWS 还指出，Organizations 活动会记录在 `us-east-1` 中。请参阅 [Logging API calls with AWS CloudTrail for AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_cloudtrail-integration.html)。

## 正确答案：A

在**自动化账户**中创建一条 EventBridge 规则，以匹配相关的 AWS Organizations 事件——例如状态为 `SUCCEEDED` 的 `CreateAccountResult`——并将每个服务账户中的默认事件总线配置为跨账户目标。每个接收方默认事件总线都必须具有资源型策略，以允许自动化账户发送事件。

这遵循已记录的跨账户 EventBridge 流程：

1. 在接收方账户中，授予发送方在接收事件总线上的权限。
2. 在发送方账户中，创建一条规则，并将接收方账户的事件总线作为其目标。
3. 可选：创建接收方规则，将收到的事件路由到本地目标。

请参阅 [Sending and receiving events between AWS accounts in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-cross-account.html) 和 [Permissions for event buses in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-bus-perms.html)。

默认事件总线适用，因为 AWS 服务事件会传送到该账户的默认事件总线。对于当前部署，跨账户事件总线目标还需要发送账户中的 IAM 角色；该角色可在配置目标时创建。

一条规则最多有五个目标。如果服务账户超过五个，公司可以创建额外的等效规则；此配额不会改变所需的架构。请参阅 [How event buses work in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-event-bus.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B

接收方自定义事件总线策略本身是有效的，但该选项遗漏了关键的**发送方规则**，即从自动化账户将事件转发到该自定义事件总线的规则。服务账户中的规则无法直接侦听在另一个账户中生成的 CloudTrail 事件。必须先通过自动化账户中的规则跨账户发送该事件。接收方规则只有在事件已到达接收方事件总线后才能处理它。

### C

创建自定义事件总线和资源策略不会自动连接或复制它们。更重要的是，AWS Organizations CloudTrail 事件最初会到达自动化账户的**默认事件总线**，而不是新建的自定义事件总线。该选项没有提供源默认事件总线上的规则来匹配账户创建事件并将其转发。

### D

此选项同样从自动化账户中的自定义事件总线开始，但 CloudTrail/AWS 服务事件会传送到默认事件总线。如果没有规则将事件从默认事件总线传输到该自定义事件总线，则自定义事件总线没有可转发的账户创建事件。直接且有文档支持的设计是在自动化账户的源/默认事件总线上创建规则，并以服务账户中已获授权的事件总线为目标。

en.question: A DevOps engineer is building a solution that uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queues. The solution also includes an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB table. The Lambda function pulls content from an SQS queue event source and writes the content to the DynamoDB table. The solution must maximize the scalability of Lambda and must prevent successfully processed SQS messages from being processed multiple times. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Decrease the batch window to 1 second when configuring the Lambda function's event source mapping.
options.B: Decrease the batch size to 1 when configuring the Lambda function's event source mapping.
options.C: Include the ReportBatchItemFailures value in the FunctionResponseTypes list in the Lambda function's event source mapping.
options.D: Set the queue visibility timeout on the Lambda function's event source mapping to account for invocation throttling of the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

Lambda polls an SQS queue and invokes the function with **batches** of messages. By default, if processing any message causes the batch invocation to fail, **every message in the batch becomes visible again after the visibility timeout**, including messages that were already processed successfully. The requirement is therefore to retain batching and Lambda scaling while retrying only the failed records.

## Correct answer: C

**C. Include `ReportBatchItemFailures` in the `FunctionResponseTypes` list in the Lambda function's event source mapping.**

This enables **partial batch responses**. The function must catch per-record failures and return the message IDs of only the failed records in `batchItemFailures`. Lambda then deletes the successfully processed messages and makes only the failed messages available for retry.

AWS explicitly states that partial batch responses avoid reprocessing successfully processed messages from a failed batch.
