AWS also states that when `ReportBatchItemFailures` is enabled, Lambda does **not scale down message polling when function invocations fail**. This directly addresses both requirements: minimizing unnecessary duplicate processing and maintaining message-processing scalability. See [Implementing partial batch responses](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-errorhandling.html) and [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html).

The handler implementation is important: enabling the event source mapping setting alone is not enough unless the function returns the failed message identifiers in the expected response format.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Decrease the batch window to 1 second

The batch window controls how long Lambda waits to gather records before invoking the function. Reducing it can reduce batching latency, but it does not change the default failure behavior: if a batch fails, successfully processed records in that batch can still be retried. It can also result in smaller, less efficient batches. AWS describes the batch window as a record-gathering setting, not a per-record failure-handling mechanism. See [Creating an SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html).

### B. Decrease the batch size to 1

A batch size of 1 avoids the specific case where one failed record causes other records in the same batch to be retried. However, it sacrifices batching efficiency and does not maximize throughput or scalability. AWS notes that larger batch sizes can improve efficiency for fast workloads or workloads with significant per-invocation overhead. Moreover, Lambda event source mappings and SQS standard queues use at-least-once processing, so reducing the batch size does not provide a general exactly-once guarantee. Partial batch responses are the purpose-built solution. See [Using Lambda with Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html) and [Creating an SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html).

### D. Set the queue visibility timeout to account for invocation throttling

A sufficiently long visibility timeout is a valid configuration best practice. AWS recommends setting it to at least six times the function timeout, with additional time for any batch window, so Lambda has time to retry when throttling occurs. However, visibility timeout does not distinguish successful records from failed records. If a batch fails, all of its messages become visible again after the timeout unless partial batch responses are enabled. It therefore delays redelivery but does not prevent successfully processed messages from being retried. Also, visibility timeout is fundamentally an SQS queue setting, not the mechanism for reporting individual item failures. See [Configuring a queue to use with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html).

## Important operational caveat

SQS standard queues and Lambda event source mappings provide **at-least-once** delivery, so duplicates can still occur in exceptional circumstances. Lambda functions that write to DynamoDB should therefore remain idempotent, for example by using a message identifier as a DynamoDB key or by using a conditional write. Among the listed choices, however, `ReportBatchItemFailures` is the AWS feature specifically designed to prevent successfully processed records from being retried because another record in the same batch failed.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在构建一个使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列的解决方案。该解决方案还包括一个 AWS Lambda 函数和一个 Amazon DynamoDB 表。Lambda 函数从 SQS 队列事件源拉取内容，并将内容写入 DynamoDB 表。该解决方案必须最大限度地提高 Lambda 的可扩展性，并且必须防止已成功处理的 SQS 消息被多次处理。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在配置 Lambda 函数的事件源映射时，将批处理窗口减少到 1 秒。
options.B: 在配置 Lambda 函数的事件源映射时，将批处理大小减少到 1。
options.C: 在 Lambda 函数的事件源映射中，将 `ReportBatchItemFailures` 值包含在 `FunctionResponseTypes` 列表中。
options.D: 在 Lambda 函数的事件源映射上设置队列可见性超时，以应对 Lambda 函数调用受到限制的情况。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查的内容

Lambda 轮询 SQS 队列，并使用消息的**批次**调用函数。默认情况下，如果处理任意一条消息导致批次调用失败，**批次中的每条消息都会在可见性超时后再次变为可见**，包括已经成功处理的消息。因此，该要求是在仅重试失败记录的同时保留批处理能力和 Lambda 的扩展能力。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 在 Lambda 函数的事件源映射中，将 `ReportBatchItemFailures` 包含在 `FunctionResponseTypes` 列表中。**

这会启用**部分批次响应**。函数必须捕获每条记录的失败，并在 `batchItemFailures` 中仅返回失败记录的消息 ID。随后，Lambda 会删除已成功处理的消息，并仅使失败的消息可供重试。

AWS 明确指出，部分批次响应可避免重新处理失败批次中已成功处理的消息。AWS 还指出，启用 `ReportBatchItemFailures` 后，Lambda 在函数调用失败时**不会降低消息轮询的扩展速度**。这直接满足了两项要求：最大限度减少不必要的重复处理，并维持消息处理的可扩展性。请参阅 [实施部分批次响应](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-errorhandling.html) 和 [将 Lambda 与 Amazon SQS 配合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html)。

处理程序的实现很重要：除非函数以预期响应格式返回失败消息标识符，否则仅启用事件源映射设置是不够的。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 将批处理窗口减少到 1 秒

批处理窗口控制 Lambda 在调用函数前等待收集记录的时长。缩短该窗口可以降低批处理延迟，但不会改变默认的失败行为：如果一个批次失败，该批次中已成功处理的记录仍然可能被重试。它还可能导致批次更小、效率更低。AWS 将批处理窗口描述为记录收集设置，而不是逐记录失败处理机制。请参阅 [创建 SQS 事件源映射](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)。

### B. 将批处理大小减少到 1

批处理大小为 1 可以避免一条失败记录导致同一批次中其他记录被重试的特定情况。但是，这会牺牲批处理效率，且无法最大化吞吐量或可扩展性。AWS 指出，对于处理速度快的工作负载或每次调用开销较大的工作负载，较大的批处理大小可以提高效率。此外，Lambda 事件源映射和 SQS 标准队列采用至少一次处理，因此减小批处理大小不能提供通用的恰好一次保证。部分批次响应才是为此目的专门设计的解决方案。请参阅 [将 Lambda 与 Amazon SQS 配合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-sqs.html) 和 [创建 SQS 事件源映射](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)。

### D. 设置队列可见性超时以应对调用限制

足够长的可见性超时是一项有效的配置最佳实践。AWS 建议将其设置为至少函数超时的六倍，并为任何批处理窗口预留额外时间，以便 Lambda 在发生限制时有时间重试。但是，可见性超时无法区分成功记录和失败记录。如果一个批次失败，除非启用了部分批次响应，否则其中所有消息都会在超时后再次变为可见。因此，它会延迟重新投递，但不会阻止已成功处理的消息被重试。此外，可见性超时本质上是 SQS 队列设置，而不是用于报告单个项目失败的机制。请参阅 [配置要与 Lambda 一起使用的队列](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)。

## 重要的运维注意事项

SQS 标准队列和 Lambda 事件源映射提供**至少一次**投递，因此在异常情况下仍可能发生重复。因而，向 DynamoDB 写入数据的 Lambda 函数应保持幂等性，例如使用消息标识符作为 DynamoDB 键，或使用条件写入。然而，在所列选项中，`ReportBatchItemFailures` 是 AWS 专门设计的功能，用于防止因同一批次中的另一条记录失败而重试已成功处理的记录。

en.question: A company has a new AWS account that teams will use to deploy various applications. The teams will create many Amazon S3 buckets for application-specific purposes and to store AWS CloudTrail logs. The company has enabled Amazon Macie for the account. A DevOps engineer needs to optimize the Macie costs for the account without compromising the account's functionality. Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Exclude S3 buckets that contain CloudTrail logs from automated discovery.
options.B: Exclude S3 buckets that have public read access from automated discovery.
options.C: Configure scheduled daily discovery jobs for all S3 buckets in the account.
options.D: Configure discovery jobs to include S3 objects based on the last modified criterion.
options.E: Configure discovery jobs to include S3 objects that are tagged as production only.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The objective is to reduce the amount of S3 data that Amazon Macie analyzes for sensitive data, while preserving the useful security coverage and normal operation of the applications and CloudTrail.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. Exclude S3 buckets that contain CloudTrail logs from automated discovery

This avoids spending Macie sensitive-data discovery resources on dedicated audit-log buckets. Excluding a bucket from automated sensitive data discovery causes Macie to stop selecting and analyzing objects in that bucket, which directly narrows the analysis scope. It does not stop CloudTrail from writing logs or remove the bucket from Macie's general S3 security inventory. Macie separately maintains an S3 inventory and evaluates buckets for security and access-control issues. See [Excluding or including S3 buckets in automated sensitive data discovery](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-asdd-account-configure.html) and [Monitoring data security and privacy with Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html).

CloudTrail also recommends using a dedicated, tightly controlled S3 bucket for audit logs, reinforcing that these buckets have a distinct, known purpose and can be scoped separately from application-data discovery. See [CloudTrail preventative security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/best-practices-security.html).

### D. Configure discovery jobs to include S3 objects based on the last modified criterion

Macie supports S3 object criteria based on the object's **Last modified** timestamp. A job can therefore analyze only objects created or changed after a specified time, before a specified time, or within a time range. This reduces unnecessary reanalysis while retaining discovery coverage for relevant new or changed application data. Periodic jobs also incrementally analyze only objects created or changed since the preceding run. See [Scope options for sensitive data discovery jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-scope.html).

Macie pricing includes charges for monitoring and analyzing S3 objects, so reducing the amount of data selected for analysis helps optimize costs. See [Pricing for Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Exclude S3 buckets that have public read access from automated discovery

Publicly readable buckets have increased exposure risk and are important candidates for sensitive-data analysis, not buckets that should be categorically excluded. Macie separately detects and reports bucket security and public-access issues, but excluding these buckets from content analysis would prevent Macie from determining whether the exposed objects contain sensitive data. See [Monitoring data security and privacy with Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html).

### C. Configure scheduled daily discovery jobs for all S3 buckets in the account

This is overly broad and would increase rather than optimize analysis costs. Macie lets jobs target selected buckets or buckets that match runtime criteria, and periodic jobs can use incremental analysis. A daily job across every bucket would also include the CloudTrail log buckets that should be excluded from sensitive-data analysis in this scenario. See [Creating a sensitive data discovery job—Choose S3 buckets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-create.html).

### E. Configure discovery jobs to include S3 objects that are tagged as production only

Macie does support object-tag criteria, but the scenario does not state that all objects are consistently tagged or that only production objects require sensitive-data discovery. Restricting discovery to a `production` tag could omit untagged, development, test, or other application objects that still contain sensitive data. Therefore, it could compromise discovery coverage. The last-modified criterion in option D is the supported, generally applicable way to reduce redundant analysis without relying on an unstated tagging policy. See [Scope options for sensitive data discovery jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-scope.html).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个新的 AWS 账户，团队将使用该账户部署各种应用程序。团队将创建许多 Amazon S3 存储桶，用于特定于应用程序的用途以及存储 AWS CloudTrail 日志。公司已为该账户启用 Amazon Macie。一名 DevOps 工程师需要在不影响账户功能的情况下优化该账户的 Macie 成本。哪些解决方案能够满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 从自动发现中排除包含 CloudTrail 日志的 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 从自动发现中排除具有公共读取访问权限的 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 为账户中的所有 S3 存储桶配置计划的每日发现作业。
options.D: 配置发现作业，以根据上次修改条件包含 S3 对象。
options.E: 配置发现作业，仅包含标记为生产环境的 S3 对象。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

目标是在保留有用的安全覆盖范围以及应用程序和 CloudTrail 正常运行的同时，减少 Amazon Macie 为发现敏感数据而分析的 S3 数据量。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 从自动发现中排除包含 CloudTrail 日志的 S3 存储桶

这样可以避免将 Macie 的敏感数据发现资源耗费在专用审计日志存储桶上。从自动敏感数据发现中排除一个存储桶，会使 Macie 停止选择和分析该存储桶中的对象，从而直接缩小分析范围。这不会阻止 CloudTrail 写入日志，也不会将该存储桶从 Macie 的常规 S3 安全清单中移除。Macie 会单独维护 S3 清单，并评估存储桶是否存在安全和访问控制问题。请参阅 [在自动敏感数据发现中排除或包含 S3 存储桶](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-asdd-account-configure.html) 和 [使用 Macie 监控数据安全性和隐私](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html)。

CloudTrail 还建议使用专用且受到严格控制的 S3 存储桶来存储审计日志，这进一步说明这些存储桶具有明确且独特的用途，可以与应用程序数据发现分开设定范围。请参阅 [CloudTrail 预防性安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/best-practices-security.html)。

### D. 配置发现作业，以根据上次修改条件包含 S3 对象

Macie 支持基于对象 **Last modified** 时间戳的 S3 对象条件。因此，作业可以仅分析在指定时间之后创建或更改、在指定时间之前创建或更改，或处于某个时间范围内的对象。这样可减少不必要的重复分析，同时保留对相关新增或更改的应用程序数据的发现覆盖范围。周期性作业也仅会增量分析自上一次运行以来创建或更改的对象。请参阅 [敏感数据发现作业的范围选项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-scope.html)。

Macie 定价包括监控和分析 S3 对象的费用，因此减少选择进行分析的数据量有助于优化成本。请参阅 [Macie 定价](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/what-is-macie.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 从自动发现中排除具有公共读取访问权限的 S3 存储桶

可公开读取的存储桶具有更高的暴露风险，是敏感数据分析的重要候选对象，而不应被一律排除。Macie 会单独检测并报告存储桶安全性和公共访问问题，但从内容分析中排除这些存储桶，将阻止 Macie 确定暴露的对象是否包含敏感数据。请参阅 [使用 Macie 监控数据安全性和隐私](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/monitoring-s3.html)。

### C. 为账户中的所有 S3 存储桶配置计划的每日发现作业

该选项范围过于宽泛，会增加而非优化分析成本。Macie 允许作业以选定的存储桶或符合运行时条件的存储桶为目标，并且周期性作业可使用增量分析。对每个存储桶执行每日作业还会包含在此情境中应从敏感数据分析中排除的 CloudTrail 日志存储桶。请参阅 [创建敏感数据发现作业—选择 S3 存储桶](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-create.html)。

### E. 配置发现作业，仅包含标记为生产环境的 S3 对象

Macie 确实支持对象标签条件，但该情境并未说明所有对象均被一致地标记，也未说明仅生产对象需要进行敏感数据发现。将发现范围限制为 `production` 标签，可能会遗漏未标记的、开发、测试或其他仍包含敏感数据的应用程序对象。因此，这可能会影响发现覆盖范围。选项 D 中的上次修改条件是在不依赖未说明的标签策略的前提下，减少冗余分析的受支持且普遍适用的方法。请参阅 [敏感数据发现作业的范围选项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-scope.html)。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. The company recently acquired another company that has standalone AWS accounts. The acquiring company's DevOps team needs to consolidate the administration of the AWS accounts for both companies and retain full administrative control of the accounts. The DevOps team also needs to collect and group findings across all the accounts to implement and maintain a security posture. Which combination of steps should the DevOps team take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Invite the acquired company's AWS accounts to join the organization. Create an SCP that has full administrative privileges. Attach the SCP to the management account.
options.B: Invite the acquired company's AWS accounts to join the organization. Create the OrganizationAccountAccessRole IAM role in the invited accounts. Grant permission to the management account to assume the role.
options.C: Use AWS Security Hub to collect and group findings across all accounts. Use Security Hub to automatically detect new accounts as the accounts are added to the organization.
options.D: Use AWS Firewall Manager to collect and group findings across all accounts. Enable all features for the organization. Designate an account in the organization as the delegated administrator account for Firewall Manager.
options.E: Use Amazon Inspector to collect and group findings across all accounts. Designate an account in the organization as the delegated administrator account for Amazon Inspector.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company has two separate requirements:

1. Bring the acquired company's existing standalone accounts under the existing AWS Organizations structure while preserving administrative access from the management account.
2. Centrally collect, view, and group security findings across the organization's accounts.

## Correct answers: B and C

### B. Invite the accounts and create `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`

Existing standalone accounts must be **invited** to join the organization. Unlike accounts created directly within an organization, invited accounts do **not** automatically receive the `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`. AWS documents that this role must be created manually in each invited account, typically with `AdministratorAccess`, and configured to trust the organization's management account. Authorized principals in the management account also need permission to call `sts:AssumeRole` on it.

This provides the required cross-account administrative control over the acquired accounts. See [Creating OrganizationAccountAccessRole for an invited account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create-cross-account-role.html).

### C. Use AWS Security Hub across the organization

AWS Security Hub CSPM integrates with AWS Organizations and uses a delegated administrator to centrally manage Security Hub across organization accounts. With central configuration, a policy associated with the organization root can automatically enable Security Hub for both existing accounts and new accounts that join the organization. See [Security Hub account management with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/securityhub-accounts.html) and [automatically enabling organization accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/accounts-orgs-auto-enable.html).

Security Hub is specifically suited to centralized security-posture management: its administrator can access and manage findings from member accounts, and findings can be grouped by attributes such as AWS account ID. Cross-Region aggregation can additionally consolidate findings from linked Regions into a home Region. See [Security Hub aggregation for administrator and member accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/finding-aggregation.html) and [Grouping findings in Security Hub](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/finding-list-grouping.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

An SCP does not grant administrative permissions. It only defines the maximum permissions available to IAM principals in member accounts; actual permissions must be granted through IAM policies and roles. Furthermore, SCPs do not affect users or roles in the organization's management account. Therefore, attaching a full-access SCP to the management account neither creates cross-account access nor provides administrative control of the invited accounts. See [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

### D. Incorrect

AWS Firewall Manager centrally deploys and manages security policies such as AWS WAF, Shield Advanced, VPC security group, network ACL, Network Firewall, and DNS Firewall policies. It is not the general-purpose service for collecting and grouping findings from security services across accounts. See [Setting up AWS Firewall Manager policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/getting-started-fms-intro.html).

Enabling all Organizations features and designating a Firewall Manager administrator are valid Firewall Manager prerequisites, but they do not satisfy the stated findings-aggregation requirement.

### E. Incorrect

Amazon Inspector can centrally manage and aggregate its own findings across organization accounts, but its scope is vulnerability management: it scans eligible EC2 instances, ECR container images, and Lambda functions for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure. It does not provide the broad, multi-service security-posture findings collection and grouping requested here. Security Hub is the appropriate aggregation layer and can receive Inspector findings along with findings from other supported services. See [What is Amazon Inspector?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html).

Therefore, the required combination is **B and C**.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的组织来管理其 AWS 账户。该公司最近收购了另一家公司，后者拥有独立的 AWS 账户。收购方公司的 DevOps 团队需要整合两家公司 AWS 账户的管理，同时保留对这些账户的完全管理控制权。DevOps 团队还需要收集并分组所有账户中的发现结果，以实施和维护安全态势。DevOps 团队应采取哪种步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 邀请被收购公司的 AWS 账户加入组织。创建一个具有完全管理权限的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到管理账户。
options.B: 邀请被收购公司的 AWS 账户加入组织。在受邀账户中创建 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` IAM 角色。授予管理账户承担该角色的权限。
options.C: 使用 AWS Security Hub 收集并分组所有账户中的发现结果。使用 Security Hub 在账户加入组织时自动检测新账户。
options.D: 使用 AWS Firewall Manager 收集并分组所有账户中的发现结果。为组织启用所有功能。指定组织中的一个账户作为 Firewall Manager 的委托管理员账户。
options.E: 使用 Amazon Inspector 收集并分组所有账户中的发现结果。指定组织中的一个账户作为 Amazon Inspector 的委托管理员账户。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司有两个独立的要求：

1. 在保留管理账户管理访问权限的同时，将被收购公司的现有独立账户纳入现有的 AWS Organizations 结构。
2. 集中收集、查看和分组组织内各账户的安全发现结果。

## 正确答案：B 和 C

### B. 邀请账户并创建 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`

必须**邀请**现有独立账户加入组织。与直接在组织内创建的账户不同，受邀账户不会自动获得 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole`。AWS 文档说明，必须在每个受邀账户中手动创建此角色，通常附加 `AdministratorAccess`，并将其配置为信任组织的管理账户。管理账户中的授权主体还需要具有对该角色调用 `sts:AssumeRole` 的权限。

这提供了对被收购账户所需的跨账户管理控制。请参阅 [为受邀账户创建 OrganizationAccountAccessRole](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_accounts_create-cross-account-role.html)。

### C. 在整个组织中使用 AWS Security Hub

AWS Security Hub CSPM 与 AWS Organizations 集成，并使用委托管理员在组织账户中集中管理 Security Hub。通过集中配置，与组织根关联的策略可以为现有账户及新加入组织的账户自动启用 Security Hub。请参阅 [使用 AWS Organizations 管理 Security Hub 账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/securityhub-accounts.html) 和 [自动启用组织账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/accounts-orgs-auto-enable.html)。

Security Hub 专门适用于集中式安全态势管理：其管理员可以访问和管理成员账户中的发现结果，并且可以按 AWS 账户 ID 等属性对发现结果分组。跨区域聚合还可以将关联区域中的发现结果整合到主区域中。请参阅 [管理员和成员账户的 Security Hub 聚合](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/finding-aggregation.html) 和 [在 Security Hub 中对发现结果分组](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/finding-list-grouping.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 错误

SCP 不授予管理权限。它仅定义成员账户中 IAM 主体可获得的最大权限；实际权限必须通过 IAM 策略和角色授予。此外，SCP 不会影响组织管理账户中的用户或角色。因此，将完全访问 SCP 附加到管理账户既不会创建跨账户访问，也无法提供对受邀账户的管理控制。请参阅 [服务控制策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

### D. 错误

AWS Firewall Manager 可集中部署和管理安全策略，例如 AWS WAF、Shield Advanced、VPC 安全组、网络 ACL、Network Firewall 和 DNS Firewall 策略。它不是用于跨账户收集和分组来自安全服务发现结果的通用服务。请参阅 [设置 AWS Firewall Manager 策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/getting-started-fms-intro.html)。

为 Organizations 启用所有功能以及指定 Firewall Manager 管理员是有效的 Firewall Manager 前提条件，但这些措施并不能满足所述的发现结果聚合要求。

### E. 错误

Amazon Inspector 可以集中管理和聚合其自身在组织账户中的发现结果，但其范围是漏洞管理：它会扫描符合条件的 EC2 实例、ECR 容器映像和 Lambda 函数，以检测软件漏洞及非预期的网络暴露。它无法提供此处所要求的广泛、多服务的安全态势发现结果收集和分组功能。Security Hub 是适当的聚合层，并且除其他受支持服务的发现结果外，还可以接收 Inspector 发现结果。请参阅 [什么是 Amazon Inspector？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/what-is-inspector.html)。

因此，所需的组合是 **B 和 C**。

en.question: A company has an application and a CI/CD pipeline. The CI/CD pipeline consists of an AWS CodePipeline pipeline and an AWS CodeBuild project. The CodeBuild project runs tests against the application as part of the build process and outputs a test report. The company must keep the test reports for 90 days. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add a new stage in the CodePipeline pipeline after the stage that contains the CodeBuild project. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the reports. Configure an S3 deploy action type in the new CodePipeline stage with the appropriate path and format for the reports.
options.B: Add a report group in the CodeBuild project buildspec file with the appropriate path and format for the reports. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the reports. Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function to copy the reports to the S3 bucket when a build is completed. Create an S3 Lifecycle rule to expire the objects after 90 days.
options.C: Add a new stage in the CodePipeline pipeline. Configure a test action type with the appropriate path and format for the reports. Configure the report expiration time to be 90 days in the CodeBuild project buildspec file.
options.D: Add a report group in the CodeBuild project buildspec file with the appropriate path and format for the reports. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the reports. Configure the report group as an artifact in the CodeBuild project buildspec file. Configure the S3 bucket as the artifact destination. Set the object expiration to 90 days.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: B

The CodeBuild project generates test reports, but the company must retain them for **90 days**. CodeBuild reports themselves expire **30 days after creation**, so the report data must be preserved outside CodeBuild in durable storage such as Amazon S3. AWS specifically recommends exporting raw test-result data to S3 when it must be kept longer than 30 days. See [Test reports in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html).

Option **B** provides a complete retention workflow:

1. **Define the report group in the buildspec.** The buildspec `reports` section specifies the test-report files, their location, and their format so that CodeBuild can create and process the report. See the [CodeBuild buildspec reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).
2. **Detect build completion with EventBridge.** CodeBuild emits build state-change events containing the build ID and a `current-phase` value of `COMPLETED`. An EventBridge rule can match this event and invoke Lambda after the report has been generated. See the [CodeBuild build-notification event format](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-build-notifications-ref.html).
3. **Persist the report data in Amazon S3.** Using the completed build ID, Lambda can call `BatchGetBuilds` to obtain the associated `reportArns`, `BatchGetReports` to retrieve report details, and `DescribeTestCases` to retrieve the test-case results. Lambda can then write the retrieved report data to S3. This reporting API sequence is demonstrated in the [CodeBuild test-report CLI sample](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-test-report-cli.html).
4. **Enforce 90-day retention.** An S3 Lifecycle rule with an expiration action automatically deletes the stored report objects after 90 days. See [Managing the lifecycle of S3 objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html) and [S3 Lifecycle configuration elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intro-lifecycle-rules.html).

Therefore, **B** both preserves the reports beyond CodeBuild's 30-day native retention period and explicitly enforces the required 90-day expiration policy.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

An S3 deploy action operates on a CodePipeline input artifact. This option does not configure the test output as a CodeBuild report group or explain how the test-report data becomes the artifact consumed by the deploy action. More importantly, it provides **no S3 Lifecycle rule or other deletion mechanism**, so it does not enforce expiration after 90 days. CodeBuild output artifacts used by subsequent pipeline actions must be produced as pipeline artifacts; see the [CodeBuild action reference for CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html).

### C

The described configuration is unsupported. A CodeBuild buildspec can define reports, but it does not provide a setting that changes a report's expiration to 90 days. CodeBuild's native report retention is fixed at 30 days, after which the report expires. Longer retention requires preserving the result data outside the native report store, such as in S3. See [Test reports in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html) and the [buildspec syntax](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).

### D

A CodeBuild **report group cannot be configured as an artifact**. The buildspec defines `reports` and `artifacts` as separate top-level sections: `reports` tells CodeBuild how to process test results, while `artifacts` defines ordinary build-output files to upload. The same underlying files could be listed independently in both sections, but that is not the same as making the report group itself an artifact. See the [CodeBuild buildspec reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).

In addition, automatic deletion of S3 objects after a specified number of days is implemented through an **S3 Lifecycle expiration rule**. Option B explicitly includes that required mechanism, whereas D's statement to “set the object expiration” does not correct its unsupported report-group-as-artifact design.

## Conclusion

**Choose B.** It configures CodeBuild reporting, initiates post-build processing through EventBridge and Lambda, stores the report data durably in S3, and uses an S3 Lifecycle rule to expire it after exactly 90 days.

zh.question: 某公司有一个应用程序和一个 CI/CD 管道。该 CI/CD 管道由一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道和一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目组成。CodeBuild 项目在构建过程中针对应用程序运行测试，并输出测试报告。公司必须将测试报告保留 90 天。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 CodePipeline 管道中包含 CodeBuild 项目的阶段之后添加一个新阶段。创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储报告。在新的 CodePipeline 阶段中配置 S3 部署操作类型，并为报告配置适当的路径和格式。
options.B: 在 CodeBuild 项目的 buildspec 文件中添加一个报告组，并为报告配置适当的路径和格式。创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储报告。配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在构建完成时调用 AWS Lambda 函数将报告复制到 S3 存储桶。创建一条 S3 Lifecycle 规则，在 90 天后使对象过期。
options.C: 在 CodePipeline 管道中添加一个新阶段。配置一个测试操作类型，并为报告配置适当的路径和格式。在 CodeBuild 项目的 buildspec 文件中将报告过期时间配置为 90 天。
options.D: 在 CodeBuild 项目的 buildspec 文件中添加一个报告组，并为报告配置适当的路径和格式。创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储报告。在 CodeBuild 项目的 buildspec 文件中将报告组配置为构件。将 S3 存储桶配置为构件目标位置。将对象过期时间设置为 90 天。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：B

CodeBuild 项目会生成测试报告，但公司必须将其保留 **90 天**。CodeBuild 报告本身会在创建 **30 天后**过期，因此必须将报告数据保存在 CodeBuild 之外的持久性存储中，例如 Amazon S3。当测试结果原始数据需要保留超过 30 天时，AWS 明确建议将其导出到 S3。请参阅 [AWS CodeBuild 中的测试报告](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html)。

选项 **B** 提供了完整的保留工作流程：

1. **在 buildspec 中定义报告组。** buildspec 的 `reports` 部分指定测试报告文件、其位置和格式，以便 CodeBuild 可以创建和处理报告。请参阅 [CodeBuild buildspec 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。
2. **使用 EventBridge 检测构建完成。** CodeBuild 会发出构建状态变更事件，其中包含构建 ID 以及值为 `COMPLETED` 的 `current-phase`。EventBridge 规则可匹配此事件，并在报告生成后调用 Lambda。请参阅 [CodeBuild 构建通知事件格式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-build-notifications-ref.html)。
3. **将报告数据持久保存到 Amazon S3。** Lambda 可使用已完成的构建 ID 调用 `BatchGetBuilds` 来获取关联的 `reportArns`，调用 `BatchGetReports` 来检索报告详细信息，以及调用 `DescribeTestCases` 来检索测试用例结果。然后，Lambda 可以将检索到的报告数据写入 S3。此报告 API 调用序列在 [CodeBuild 测试报告 CLI 示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-test-report-cli.html)中有所演示。
4. **强制执行 90 天保留期。** 带有过期操作的 S3 Lifecycle 规则会在 90 天后自动删除存储的报告对象。请参阅 [管理 S3 对象的生命周期](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-lifecycle-mgmt.html) 和 [S3 Lifecycle 配置元素](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intro-lifecycle-rules.html)。

因此，**B** 既能在 CodeBuild 的 30 天原生保留期之后保存报告，又能明确实施所要求的 90 天过期策略。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A

S3 部署操作针对的是 CodePipeline 输入构件。该选项未将测试输出配置为 CodeBuild 报告组，也未说明测试报告数据如何成为部署操作所使用的构件。更重要的是，它**没有提供 S3 Lifecycle 规则或其他删除机制**，因此无法强制在 90 天后过期。供后续管道操作使用的 CodeBuild 输出构件必须作为管道构件生成；请参阅 [CodePipeline 的 CodeBuild 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)。

### C

所描述的配置不受支持。CodeBuild buildspec 可以定义报告，但无法提供将报告过期时间改为 90 天的设置。CodeBuild 的原生报告保留期固定为 30 天，之后报告会过期。若要实现更长的保留期，必须将结果数据保存在原生报告存储之外，例如保存到 S3。请参阅 [AWS CodeBuild 中的测试报告](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/test-reporting.html) 和 [buildspec 语法](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。

### D

CodeBuild **报告组不能配置为构件**。buildspec 将 `reports` 和 `artifacts` 定义为独立的顶级部分：`reports` 告知 CodeBuild 如何处理测试结果，而 `artifacts` 定义要上传的普通构建输出文件。相同的底层文件可以在两个部分中分别列出，但这并不等同于将报告组本身作为构件。请参阅 [CodeBuild buildspec 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。

此外，在指定天数后自动删除 S3 对象是通过 **S3 Lifecycle 过期规则**实现的。选项 B 明确包含了这一必需机制，而 D 所说的“设置对象过期时间”并不能修正其不受支持的“将报告组作为构件”的设计。

## 结论

**选择 B。** 它配置 CodeBuild 报告，通过 EventBridge 和 Lambda 启动构建后处理，将报告数据持久存储在 S3 中，并使用 S3 Lifecycle 规则在恰好 90 天后使其过期。

en.question: A company uses an Amazon API Gateway regional REST API to host its application API. The REST API has a custom domain. The REST API's default endpoint is deactivated. The company's internal teams consume the API. The company wants to use mutual TLS between the API and the internal teams as an additional layer of authentication. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create a private certificate authority (CA). Provision a client certificate that is signed by the private CA.
options.B: Provision a client certificate that is signed by a public certificate authority (CA). Import the certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).
options.C: Upload the provisioned client certificate to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the API Gateway mutual TLS to use the client certificate that is stored in the S3 bucket as the trust store.
options.D: Upload the provisioned client certificate private key to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the API Gateway mutual TLS to use the private key that is stored in the S3 bucket as the trust store.
options.E: Upload the root private certificate authority (CA) certificate to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the API Gateway mutual TLS to use the private CA certificate that is stored in the S3 bucket as the trust store.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs to establish client-certificate authentication for an API Gateway **Regional custom domain**. Each internal client must present a client certificate, and API Gateway must have a truststore containing the CA certificates needed to validate that client certificate.

## Correct answers: A and E

### A. Create a private CA and provision a client certificate signed by it

For internal teams, a private PKI is appropriate. AWS Private CA—historically referred to as ACM Private CA—can issue private end-entity certificates, including certificates used for client authentication. AWS documents that private end-entity certificates can be requested from ACM or issued through AWS Private CA. Certificates requested through ACM from an AWS Private CA can also be exported with their private keys for use by clients. See [Issue private end-entity certificates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/privateca/latest/userguide/PcaIssueCert.html).

Thus, the internal clients receive certificates whose signatures chain back to the company's private CA.

### E. Put the private CA certificate chain in the S3 truststore

API Gateway's mutual TLS truststore is a PEM file containing certificates from trusted **certificate authorities**. AWS explicitly states that the truststore must include the complete chain of trust, beginning with the issuing CA certificate and continuing through the root CA certificate. API Gateway then validates the certificate presented by each client against that chain. The truststore is uploaded to S3 and referenced by the Regional custom domain's mutual TLS configuration. See [Mutual TLS for REST APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/rest-api-mutual-tls.html).

If the root private CA directly issued the client certificates, its CA certificate is sufficient. If subordinate or intermediate CAs are used, their certificates must also be included in the same PEM truststore.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B — Incorrect.** API Gateway can trust client certificates issued by either public or private CAs, but importing the individual client certificate into ACM is not how API Gateway establishes client trust. The client must possess and present its certificate and private key, while API Gateway validates the certificate against the corresponding CA chain in its S3 truststore. Additionally, option E contains the private CA certificate, which would not validate a client certificate issued by an unrelated public CA.

- **C — Incorrect.** Because the client certificate in this scenario is signed by a private CA, the normal truststore contents are the **issuing CA through root CA certificates**, not the issued leaf/client certificate. Placing the CA chain in the truststore allows API Gateway to validate certificates for all authorized internal clients issued by that CA.

- **D — Incorrect.** A truststore contains public X.509 CA certificates, never a client's private key. The private key must remain protected and under the client's control; API Gateway does not need it to validate the client's signature during the TLS handshake.

Therefore, **A and E** form the coherent solution: issue client certificates from a private CA, and configure API Gateway to trust that CA through a PEM truststore in Amazon S3.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon API Gateway 区域性 REST API 来托管其应用程序 API。该 REST API 具有自定义域名。该 REST API 的默认终端节点已停用。公司的内部团队使用该 API。公司希望在 API 与内部团队之间使用双向 TLS，作为额外的身份验证层。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 使用 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) 创建私有证书颁发机构 (CA)。预置由该私有 CA 签名的客户端证书。
options.B: 预置由公共证书颁发机构 (CA) 签名的客户端证书。将该证书导入 AWS Certificate Manager (ACM)。
options.C: 将预置的客户端证书上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 API Gateway 双向 TLS，以使用存储在 S3 存储桶中的客户端证书作为信任库。
options.D: 将预置的客户端证书私钥上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 API Gateway 双向 TLS，以使用存储在 S3 存储桶中的私钥作为信任库。
options.E: 将根私有证书颁发机构 (CA) 证书上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 API Gateway 双向 TLS，以使用存储在 S3 存储桶中的私有 CA 证书作为信任库。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要为 API Gateway **区域性自定义域名** 建立客户端证书身份验证。每个内部客户端都必须提供客户端证书，并且 API Gateway 必须具有一个信任库，其中包含验证该客户端证书所需的 CA 证书。

## 正确答案：A 和 E

### A. 创建私有 CA，并预置由其签名的客户端证书

对于内部团队，私有 PKI 是合适的选择。AWS Private CA——历史上称为 ACM Private CA——可以签发私有终端实体证书，包括用于客户端身份验证的证书。AWS 文档指出，可以从 ACM 请求私有终端实体证书，也可以通过 AWS Private CA 签发此类证书。通过 ACM 从 AWS Private CA 请求的证书还可以连同其私钥一起导出，供客户端使用。请参阅 [签发私有终端实体证书](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/privateca/latest/userguide/PcaIssueCert.html)。

因此，内部客户端会获得其签名链可追溯至公司私有 CA 的证书。

### E. 将私有 CA 证书链放入 S3 信任库

API Gateway 的双向 TLS 信任库是一个 PEM 文件，其中包含受信任**证书颁发机构**的证书。AWS 明确指出，信任库必须包含完整的信任链，从签发 CA 证书开始，一直到根 CA 证书。随后，API Gateway 会根据该链验证每个客户端提供的证书。信任库会上传至 S3，并由区域性自定义域名的双向 TLS 配置引用。请参阅 [API Gateway 中 REST API 的双向 TLS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/rest-api-mutual-tls.html)。

如果根私有 CA 直接签发客户端证书，则其 CA 证书已足够。如果使用下级 CA 或中间 CA，其证书也必须包含在同一个 PEM 信任库中。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B — 不正确。** API Gateway 可以信任由公共或私有 CA 签发的客户端证书，但将单个客户端证书导入 ACM 并不是 API Gateway 建立客户端信任的方式。客户端必须持有并提供其证书和私钥，而 API Gateway 则根据其 S3 信任库中对应的 CA 链验证该证书。此外，选项 E 包含私有 CA 证书，无法验证由无关公共 CA 签发的客户端证书。

- **C — 不正确。** 由于此场景中的客户端证书由私有 CA 签名，通常的信任库内容应为**从签发 CA 到根 CA 的证书**，而不是已签发的叶子/客户端证书。将 CA 链放入信任库，使 API Gateway 能够验证由该 CA 向所有已授权内部客户端签发的证书。

- **D — 不正确。** 信任库包含公共 X.509 CA 证书，绝不包含客户端私钥。私钥必须受到保护并由客户端控制；API Gateway 在 TLS 握手期间验证客户端签名时并不需要该私钥。

因此，**A 和 E** 构成连贯的解决方案：由私有 CA 签发客户端证书，并将 API Gateway 配置为通过 Amazon S3 中的 PEM 信任库信任该 CA。

en.question: A company uses AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory as its identity provider (IdP). The company requires all infrastructure to be defined and deployed by AWS CloudFormation. A DevOps engineer needs to create a fleet of Windows-based Amazon EC2 instances to host an application. The DevOps engineer has created a CloudFormation template that contains an EC2 launch template, IAM role, EC2 security group, and EC2 Auto Scaling group. The DevOps engineer must implement a solution that joins all EC2 instances to the domain of the AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: In the CloudFormation template, create an AWS::SSM::Document resource that joins the EC2 instance to the AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain by using the parameters for the existing directory. Update the launch template to include the SSMAssociation property to use the new SSM document. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore and AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess AWS managed policies to the IAM role that the EC2 instances use.
options.B: In the CloudFormation template, update the launch template to include specific tags that propagate on launch. Create an AWS::SSM::Association resource to associate the AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain Automation runbook with the EC2 instances that have the specified tags. Define the required parameters to join the AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore and AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess AWS managed policies to the IAM role that the EC2 instances use.
options.C: Store the existing AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain connection details in AWS Secrets Manager. In the CloudFormation template, create an AWS::SSM::Association resource to associate the AWS-CreateManagedWindowsInstanceWithApproval Automation runbook with the EC2 Auto Scaling group. Pass the ARNs for the parameters from Secrets Manager to join the domain. Attach the AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess and SecretsManagerReadWrite AWS managed policies to the IAM role that the EC2 instances use.
options.D: Store the existing AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain administrator credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. In the CloudFormation template, update the EC2 launch template to include user data. Configure the user data to pull the administrator credentials from Secrets Manager and to join the AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore and SecretsManagerReadWrite AWS managed policies to the IAM role that the EC2 instances use.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a CloudFormation-defined, low-maintenance way to ensure that every Windows EC2 instance launched into an Auto Scaling fleet joins an existing AWS Managed Microsoft AD domain. Because instances will be added and replaced dynamically, the solution should automatically discover new instances rather than create a separate association for every instance or maintain custom bootstrap code.

## Correct answer: B

Create an `AWS::SSM::Association` that uses the AWS-managed `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` document, target the instances by a tag applied at launch, and give the instance role the Systems Manager and Directory Service permissions.

AWS documents `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` specifically for joining a Systems Manager managed node to an AWS Directory Service domain. Its required inputs include the directory ID, directory name, and DNS IP addresses ([AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/walkthrough-powershell.html)).

This design is particularly appropriate for an Auto Scaling group:

- An `AWS::SSM::Association` can use an AWS-predefined SSM document, pass document parameters, and select managed nodes through `Targets`. CloudFormation supports tag-based target formats for the association ([AWS::SSM::Association](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-ssm-association.html)).
- AWS states that using tag targets is the best practice for associations with Auto Scaling groups. When all instances receive the same tag, one association can apply to current and newly launched instances ([Running Auto Scaling groups with associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-asg.html)).
- `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` supplies the core permissions needed for the instances to operate as Systems Manager managed nodes. `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess` is specifically required when using Systems Manager to join Windows EC2 instances to Microsoft AD and allows SSM Agent to access Directory Service for domain-join requests ([Systems Manager instance permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/setup-instance-permissions.html)).

Therefore, B provides a fully CloudFormation-managed and dynamically scalable solution without maintaining a custom domain-join document, credentials, or user-data script.

> Although the option calls `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` an “Automation runbook,” AWS documentation presents it as an AWS-predefined SSM document used to run the domain join. `AWS::SSM::Association` supports both Command and Automation documents, so the described association approach remains the intended and valid solution.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

An EC2 **launch template does not have an `SSMAssociation` property**. The documented `AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate LaunchTemplateData` properties include items such as `IamInstanceProfile`, `TagSpecifications`, and `UserData`, but not `SSMAssociation` ([LaunchTemplateData reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-ec2-launchtemplate-launchtemplatedata.html)).

Additionally, creating a custom `AWS::SSM::Document` is unnecessary because AWS already provides `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain`. A separate `AWS::SSM::Association`, as in B, is the correct CloudFormation mechanism for dynamically targeting the Auto Scaling instances.

### C

`AWS-CreateManagedWindowsInstance` is designed to **create a new Windows EC2 instance configured for Systems Manager management**. Its parameters concern launching an instance—AMI, instance type, subnet, VPC, key pair, and security group—not joining the existing Auto Scaling fleet to a domain ([AWS-CreateManagedWindowsInstance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-createmanagedwindowsinstance.html)).

The fleet is already provisioned by the launch template and Auto Scaling group, so using an instance-creation runbook would duplicate or bypass the required architecture. Secrets Manager connection ARNs are also not substitutes for the directory ID, directory name, and DNS address parameters expected by `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain`. `SecretsManagerReadWrite` is excessive for this task.

### D

A custom user-data script could potentially perform a domain join, but it is less operationally efficient and less secure than the managed Systems Manager solution. It requires maintaining domain-join scripting, retrieving and handling domain administrator credentials on every instance, managing reboot and retry behavior, and granting broad Secrets Manager access.

AWS provides `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` and the purpose-built `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess` policy so that administrator credentials do not need to be embedded in or fetched by custom instance bootstrap logic. `SecretsManagerReadWrite` is also broader than necessary because an instance retrieving a secret would, at most, require narrowly scoped read permission—not write access.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory 作为其身份提供商 (IdP)。该公司要求所有基础设施均通过 AWS CloudFormation 定义和部署。一名 DevOps 工程师需要创建一组基于 Windows 的 Amazon EC2 实例来托管应用程序。该 DevOps 工程师已创建一个 CloudFormation 模板，其中包含 EC2 启动模板、IAM 角色、EC2 安全组和 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。该 DevOps 工程师必须实施一个解决方案，使所有 EC2 实例加入 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 目录的域。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，创建一个 `AWS::SSM::Document` 资源，通过使用现有目录的参数将 EC2 实例加入 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 域。更新启动模板以包含 `SSMAssociation` 属性，从而使用新的 SSM 文档。将 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 和 `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess` AWS 托管策略附加到 EC2 实例使用的 IAM 角色。
options.B: 在 CloudFormation 模板中，更新启动模板以包含在启动时传播的特定标签。创建一个 `AWS::SSM::Association` 资源，以便将 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` Automation runbook 关联到具有指定标签的 EC2 实例。定义加入 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 目录所需的参数。将 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 和 `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess` AWS 托管策略附加到 EC2 实例使用的 IAM 角色。
options.C: 将现有 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 域的连接详细信息存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。在 CloudFormation 模板中，创建一个 `AWS::SSM::Association` 资源，以便将 `AWS-CreateManagedWindowsInstanceWithApproval` Automation runbook 关联到 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。传递来自 Secrets Manager 的参数 ARN 以加入域。将 `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess` 和 `SecretsManagerReadWrite` AWS 托管策略附加到 EC2 实例使用的 IAM 角色。
options.D: 将现有 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 域管理员凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。在 CloudFormation 模板中，更新 EC2 启动模板以包含用户数据。配置用户数据以从 Secrets Manager 提取管理员凭证，并加入 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 域。将 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 和 `SecretsManagerReadWrite` AWS 托管策略附加到 EC2 实例使用的 IAM 角色。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一种由 CloudFormation 定义且维护工作量低的方式，以确保在 Auto Scaling 队列中启动的每个 Windows EC2 实例都能加入现有的 AWS Managed Microsoft AD 域。由于实例会被动态添加和替换，该解决方案应自动发现新实例，而不是为每个实例创建单独的关联，或维护自定义的引导代码。

## 正确答案：B

创建一个使用 AWS 托管 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` 文档的 `AWS::SSM::Association`，通过启动时应用的标签来定位实例，并为实例角色授予 Systems Manager 和 Directory Service 权限。

AWS 专门将 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` 用于把 Systems Manager 托管节点加入 AWS Directory Service 域。其必需输入包括目录 ID、目录名称和 DNS IP 地址（[AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/walkthrough-powershell.html)）。

此设计尤其适用于 Auto Scaling 组：

- `AWS::SSM::Association` 可以使用 AWS 预定义的 SSM 文档、传递文档参数，并通过 `Targets` 选择托管节点。CloudFormation 支持关联的基于标签的目标格式（[AWS::SSM::Association](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-ssm-association.html)）。
- AWS 指出，对于 Auto Scaling 组关联，使用标签目标是最佳实践。当所有实例获得相同标签时，一个关联即可应用于当前实例和新启动的实例（[Running Auto Scaling groups with associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-asg.html)）。
- `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 提供实例作为 Systems Manager 托管节点运行所需的核心权限。在使用 Systems Manager 将 Windows EC2 实例加入 Microsoft AD 时，必须使用 `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess`；该策略允许 SSM Agent 访问 Directory Service 来发起域加入请求（[Systems Manager instance permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/setup-instance-permissions.html)）。

因此，B 提供了一个完全由 CloudFormation 管理、可动态扩展的解决方案，无需维护自定义域加入文档、凭证或用户数据脚本。

> 虽然该选项将 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` 称为“Automation runbook”，但 AWS 文档将其描述为用于执行域加入操作的 AWS 预定义 SSM 文档。`AWS::SSM::Association` 同时支持 Command 和 Automation 文档，因此所述的关联方法仍是预期且有效的解决方案。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A

EC2 **启动模板不具有 `SSMAssociation` 属性**。已记录的 `AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate LaunchTemplateData` 属性包括 `IamInstanceProfile`、`TagSpecifications` 和 `UserData` 等，但不包括 `SSMAssociation`（[LaunchTemplateData reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-properties-ec2-launchtemplate-launchtemplatedata.html)）。

此外，无需创建自定义 `AWS::SSM::Document`，因为 AWS 已提供 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain`。如 B 所示，单独的 `AWS::SSM::Association` 才是动态定位 Auto Scaling 实例的正确 CloudFormation 机制。

### C

`AWS-CreateManagedWindowsInstance` 旨在**创建一个配置为由 Systems Manager 管理的新 Windows EC2 实例**。其参数涉及启动实例，例如 AMI、实例类型、子网、VPC、密钥对和安全组，而不是将现有 Auto Scaling 队列加入域（[AWS-CreateManagedWindowsInstance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-createmanagedwindowsinstance.html)）。

该队列已经由启动模板和 Auto Scaling 组预置，因此使用实例创建 runbook 会重复或绕过所需的架构。Secrets Manager 连接 ARN 也不能替代 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` 所需的目录 ID、目录名称和 DNS 地址参数。对于此任务，`SecretsManagerReadWrite` 权限过大。

### D

自定义用户数据脚本可能可以执行域加入，但其运营效率和安全性都不如托管的 Systems Manager 解决方案。它要求维护域加入脚本、在每个实例上检索和处理域管理员凭证、管理重启和重试行为，并授予广泛的 Secrets Manager 访问权限。

AWS 提供 `AWS-JoinDirectoryServiceDomain` 和专用的 `AmazonSSMDirectoryServiceAccess` 策略，因此无需在自定义实例引导逻辑中嵌入或获取管理员凭证。`SecretsManagerReadWrite` 的权限范围也超出必要范围，因为检索密钥的实例最多只需要范围受限的读取权限，而不需要写入权限。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. The company has a root OU that has a child OU. The root OU has an SCP that allows all actions on all resources. The child OU has an SCP that allows all actions for Amazon DynamoDB and AWS Lambda, and denies all other actions. The company has an AWS account that is named vendor-data in the child OU. A DevOps engineer has an IAM user that is attached to the Administrator Access IAM policy in the vendor-data account. The DevOps engineer attempts to launch an Amazon EC2 instance in the vendor-data account but receives an access denied error. Which change should the DevOps engineer make to launch the EC2 instance in the vendor-data account?

options.A: Attach the AmazonEC2FullAccess IAM policy to the IAM user.
options.B: Create a new SCP that allows all actions for Amazon EC2. Attach the SCP to the vendor-data account.
options.C: Update the SCP in the child OU to allow all actions for Amazon EC2.
options.D: Create a new SCP that allows all actions for Amazon EC2. Attach the SCP to the root OU.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The IAM user already has `AdministratorAccess`, so the failure is not caused by a missing EC2 IAM policy. The question tests how **service control policies (SCPs) form a permissions ceiling across the AWS Organizations hierarchy**.

AWS states that an SCP does not grant permissions; it defines the maximum permissions available to IAM principals. An account has only the permissions permitted by **every parent above it**, and a permission blocked at any parent level remains unavailable even when the user has `AdministratorAccess` ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). AWS also documents that, when using allow-list SCPs, an explicit allow must exist at every level from the root through each OU in the path to the account ([How SCPs work with Allow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)).

## Correct answer: C

**C. Update the SCP in the child OU to allow all actions for Amazon EC2.**

The root permits all actions, and the IAM policy permits all actions, but the child OU's SCP permits only DynamoDB and Lambda while denying or omitting EC2. Therefore, EC2 is blocked at the child OU level. The child OU SCP must be updated so that EC2 actions are no longer denied and are included in the allowed actions. After that change, the user's existing `AdministratorAccess` policy can authorize the necessary EC2 actions.

Although this change affects all accounts under the child OU, it is the only listed option that removes the blocking restriction at the level where it is imposed.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Attach `AmazonEC2FullAccess` to the IAM user — Incorrect.**  
  The user already has `AdministratorAccess`, which includes EC2 permissions. More importantly, an IAM allow cannot exceed the permissions ceiling imposed by an SCP. AWS explicitly notes that an action blocked by an SCP remains unavailable even if an administrator attaches `AdministratorAccess` to the user ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

- **B. Attach a new EC2-allowing SCP to the `vendor-data` account — Incorrect.**  
  SCPs can indeed be attached directly to accounts, so the attachment target itself is valid ([Attach policies with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)). However, an account-level allow cannot override a restriction inherited from its parent OU. EC2 must be permitted at every level in the path, and the child OU currently blocks it. Thus, adding an EC2 allow only at the account does not make EC2 effective.

- **D. Attach a new EC2-allowing SCP to the root OU — Incorrect.**  
  The root already allows all actions, including EC2. Adding another EC2 allow at the root changes nothing because EC2 remains blocked by the child OU SCP. An allow at a higher level cannot bypass a lower-level OU restriction.

Therefore, **C** is correct.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理其 AWS 账户。该公司有一个根 OU，其中包含一个子 OU。根 OU 有一个 SCP，允许对所有资源执行所有操作。子 OU 有一个 SCP，允许对 Amazon DynamoDB 和 AWS Lambda 执行所有操作，并拒绝所有其他操作。该公司在子 OU 中有一个名为 vendor-data 的 AWS 账户。一名 DevOps 工程师在 vendor-data 账户中有一个 IAM 用户，该用户附加了 Administrator Access IAM policy。该 DevOps 工程师尝试在 vendor-data 账户中启动一个 Amazon EC2 实例，但收到 access denied 错误。DevOps 工程师应进行哪项更改，才能在 vendor-data 账户中启动 EC2 实例？

options.A: 将 AmazonEC2FullAccess IAM policy 附加到 IAM 用户。
options.B: 创建一个允许对 Amazon EC2 执行所有操作的新 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到 vendor-data 账户。
options.C: 更新子 OU 中的 SCP，以允许对 Amazon EC2 执行所有操作。
options.D: 创建一个允许对 Amazon EC2 执行所有操作的新 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到根 OU。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查的内容

该 IAM 用户已经拥有 `AdministratorAccess`，因此失败并非由缺少 EC2 IAM policy 导致。本题考查的是 **service control policies (SCPs) 如何在 AWS Organizations 层次结构中形成权限上限**。

AWS 指出，SCP 不授予权限；它定义 IAM principals 可获得的最大权限。一个账户仅拥有其上方 **每一个父级** 所允许的权限；在任意父级层面被阻止的权限，即使用户拥有 `AdministratorAccess` 仍然不可用（[SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。AWS 还说明，使用 allow-list SCPs 时，从根到通往账户路径上的每个 OU 层级都必须有显式 Allow（[SCP 如何与 Allow 配合工作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)）。

## 正确答案：C

**C. 更新子 OU 中的 SCP，以允许对 Amazon EC2 执行所有操作。**

根允许所有操作，IAM policy 也允许所有操作，但子 OU 的 SCP 仅允许 DynamoDB 和 Lambda，同时拒绝或未包含 EC2。因此，EC2 在子 OU 层级被阻止。必须更新子 OU 的 SCP，以便不再拒绝 EC2 操作，并将 EC2 包含在允许的操作中。完成该更改后，用户现有的 `AdministratorAccess` policy 就可以授权所需的 EC2 操作。

虽然此更改会影响子 OU 下的所有账户，但它是所列选项中唯一能够在施加阻止限制的层级移除该限制的选项。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A. 将 `AmazonEC2FullAccess` 附加到 IAM 用户 — 不正确。**  
  该用户已经拥有 `AdministratorAccess`，其中包含 EC2 权限。更重要的是，IAM allow 不能超出 SCP 施加的权限上限。AWS 明确指出，即使管理员将 `AdministratorAccess` 附加给用户，被 SCP 阻止的操作仍然不可用（[SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。

- **B. 将一个允许 EC2 的新 SCP 附加到 `vendor-data` 账户 — 不正确。**  
  SCP 确实可以直接附加到账户，因此该附加目标本身是有效的（[使用 AWS Organizations 附加 policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)）。但是，账户级别的 allow 无法覆盖从其父 OU 继承的限制。EC2 必须在路径上的每个层级均被允许，而子 OU 当前阻止了它。因此，仅在账户级别添加 EC2 allow 不会使 EC2 权限生效。

- **D. 将一个允许 EC2 的新 SCP 附加到根 OU — 不正确。**  
  根已经允许所有操作，包括 EC2。在根级别添加另一个 EC2 allow 不会改变任何内容，因为 EC2 仍被子 OU SCP 阻止。较高级别的 allow 无法绕过较低级别 OU 的限制。

因此，**C** 是正确答案。

en.question: A company's security policies require the use of security hardened AMIs in production environments. A DevOps engineer has used EC2 Image Builder to create a pipeline that builds the AMIs on a recurring schedule. The DevOps engineer needs to update the launch templates of the company's Auto Scaling groups. The Auto Scaling groups must use the newest AMIs during the launch of Amazon EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to receive new AMI events from Image Builder. Target an AWS Systems Manager Run Command document that updates the launch templates of the Auto Scaling groups with the newest AMI ID.
options.B: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to receive new AMI events from Image Builder. Target an AWS Lambda function that updates the launch templates of the Auto Scaling groups with the newest AMI ID.
options.C: Configure the launch template to use a value from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store for the AMI ID. Configure the Image Builder pipeline to update the Parameter Store value with the newest AMI ID.
options.D: Configure the Image Builder distribution settings to update the launch templates with the newest AMI IConfigure the Auto Scaling groups to use the newest version of the launch template.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: D

The company already uses EC2 Image Builder to produce recurring security-hardened AMIs. The remaining requirement is to propagate each newly built AMI into the EC2 launch templates used by the Auto Scaling groups, with the least custom automation and maintenance.

### Why D is correct

EC2 Image Builder provides a native launch-template integration in its AMI distribution settings. When a build is distributed, Image Builder can create a new version of each configured launch template. The new version retains the launch template’s existing settings and replaces the AMI ID with the newly built image. Image Builder can also set the generated launch-template version as the default version. See [Configure AMI distribution with an EC2 launch template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/dist-using-launch-template.html).

The Auto Scaling groups can then be configured to use the latest or default launch-template version. Consequently, after each successful Image Builder run, subsequent EC2 instance launches use the launch-template version containing the newest hardened AMI. AWS documents how an Auto Scaling group can use the latest launch-template version in [Update an Auto Scaling group to use the latest version of a launch template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/examples-launch-templates-aws-cli.html).

This is the most operationally efficient solution because it uses the purpose-built Image Builder integration and requires no custom event-processing code, command-running instances, or separate AMI-reference workflow.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EventBridge with Systems Manager Run Command

Image Builder can send image state-change events to EventBridge, including events indicating that an image is available. However, Systems Manager Run Command is designed to execute SSM documents on managed nodes. It is not a direct mechanism for updating an EC2 launch-template resource. See [Event messages that Image Builder sends](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/integ-eventbridge.html) and [Systems Manager Run Command as an EventBridge target](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html).

Implementing this option would require managed instances on which custom update scripts run, adding infrastructure, permissions, error handling, and maintenance that the native Image Builder integration avoids.

### B. EventBridge with Lambda

This approach could work technically: EventBridge could detect a completed Image Builder build, and a Lambda function could call EC2 APIs to create or update launch-template versions. Image Builder’s EventBridge integration is documented in [Integrate EC2 Image Builder with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/integ-eventbridge.html).

However, the company would need to develop, secure, test, monitor, retry, and maintain the Lambda function. Because Image Builder already provides the required launch-template update as a managed distribution feature, this custom solution is less operationally efficient than D.

### C. Use an SSM Parameter Store reference for the AMI ID

A launch template can reference an SSM parameter instead of embedding an AMI ID, and Image Builder distribution settings can store the output AMI ID in such a parameter. For subsequent launches to resolve the newest value, the launch template must use an **unversioned** `resolve:ssm:parameter-name` reference; EC2 resolves the latest parameter version when an instance is launched. See [Use Systems Manager parameters instead of AMI IDs in launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/using-systems-manager-parameters.html) and [Create an AMI distribution configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/cr-upd-ami-distribution-settings.html).

Although this is a supported way to make future launches resolve a changing AMI ID, it does not update the launch template with a new AMI or create a new launch-template version after each build. It updates an indirect parameter reference instead. The requirement specifically calls for updating the Auto Scaling groups’ launch templates, so Image Builder’s direct launch-template distribution integration in D is the better match.

## Key takeaway

When recurring EC2 Image Builder pipelines must propagate new AMIs directly into launch templates, configure **Image Builder distribution settings with launch-template configurations**, and configure the Auto Scaling groups to follow the appropriate latest or default launch-template version.

zh.question: 一家公司的安全策略要求在生产环境中使用经过安全加固的 AMI。一名 DevOps 工程师已使用 EC2 Image Builder 创建了一个管道，以定期构建这些 AMI。该 DevOps 工程师需要更新公司的 Auto Scaling 组的启动模板。Auto Scaling 组在启动 Amazon EC2 实例时必须使用最新的 AMI。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以接收来自 Image Builder 的新 AMI 事件。将 AWS Systems Manager Run Command 文档设为目标，以使用最新的 AMI ID 更新 Auto Scaling 组的启动模板。
options.B: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以接收来自 Image Builder 的新 AMI 事件。将 AWS Lambda 函数设为目标，以使用最新的 AMI ID 更新 Auto Scaling 组的启动模板。
options.C: 配置启动模板，使其使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 中的 AMI ID 值。配置 Image Builder 管道，以使用最新的 AMI ID 更新 Parameter Store 值。
options.D: 配置 Image Builder 分发设置，以使用最新的 AMI ID 更新启动模板。配置 Auto Scaling 组以使用启动模板的最新版本。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：D

该公司已使用 EC2 Image Builder 定期生成经过安全加固的 AMI。剩余要求是将每个新构建的 AMI 传播到 Auto Scaling 组所使用的 EC2 启动模板中，同时最大限度减少自定义自动化和维护。

### 为什么 D 正确

EC2 Image Builder 在其 AMI 分发设置中提供原生的启动模板集成。构建完成并分发时，Image Builder 可以为每个已配置的启动模板创建新版本。新版本会保留启动模板的现有设置，并将 AMI ID 替换为新构建的映像。Image Builder 还可以将生成的启动模板版本设为默认版本。请参阅 [使用 EC2 启动模板配置 AMI 分发](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/dist-using-launch-template.html)。

随后，可以将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用最新或默认的启动模板版本。因此，在每次 Image Builder 成功运行后，后续启动的 EC2 实例将使用包含最新加固 AMI 的启动模板版本。AWS 在 [更新 Auto Scaling 组以使用启动模板的最新版本](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/examples-launch-templates-aws-cli.html) 中说明了 Auto Scaling 组如何使用最新的启动模板版本。

这是运营效率最高的解决方案，因为它使用了专门构建的 Image Builder 集成，不需要自定义事件处理代码、运行命令的实例或单独的 AMI 引用工作流程。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. EventBridge 与 Systems Manager Run Command

Image Builder 可以将映像状态更改事件发送到 EventBridge，其中包括指示映像可用的事件。但是，Systems Manager Run Command 旨在对托管节点执行 SSM 文档。它并不是更新 EC2 启动模板资源的直接机制。请参阅 [Image Builder 发送的事件消息](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/integ-eventbridge.html) 和 [作为 EventBridge 目标的 Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)。

实施此选项需要托管实例来运行自定义更新脚本，从而增加了基础设施、权限、错误处理和维护，而原生 Image Builder 集成可以避免这些额外工作。

### B. EventBridge 与 Lambda

此方法在技术上可行：EventBridge 可以检测到已完成的 Image Builder 构建，而 Lambda 函数可以调用 EC2 API 来创建或更新启动模板版本。Image Builder 的 EventBridge 集成记录在 [将 EC2 Image Builder 与 EventBridge 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/integ-eventbridge.html) 中。

但是，公司需要开发、保护、测试、监控、重试和维护该 Lambda 函数。由于 Image Builder 已经将所需的启动模板更新作为托管分发功能提供，因此这一自定义解决方案的运营效率低于 D。

### C. 对 AMI ID 使用 SSM Parameter Store 引用

启动模板可以引用 SSM 参数，而不是嵌入 AMI ID；Image Builder 分发设置可以将输出的 AMI ID 存储在此类参数中。要使后续启动能够解析最新值，启动模板必须使用**未版本化的** `resolve:ssm:parameter-name` 引用；EC2 会在启动实例时解析最新的参数版本。请参阅 [在启动模板中使用 Systems Manager 参数而不是 AMI ID](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/using-systems-manager-parameters.html) 和 [创建 AMI 分发配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/cr-upd-ami-distribution-settings.html)。

尽管这是让未来启动解析会变更的 AMI ID 的一种受支持方法，但它不会在每次构建后使用新 AMI 更新启动模板，也不会创建新的启动模板版本。它更新的是间接参数引用。该要求明确要求更新 Auto Scaling 组的启动模板，因此 D 中 Image Builder 的直接启动模板分发集成更符合要求。

## 关键要点

当定期运行的 EC2 Image Builder 管道必须将新 AMI 直接传播到启动模板时，请配置包含启动模板配置的 **Image Builder 分发设置**，并将 Auto Scaling 组配置为遵循相应的最新或默认启动模板版本。

en.question: A company has configured an Amazon S3 event source on an AWS Lambda function. The company needs the Lambda function to run when a new object is created or an existing object is modified in a particular S3 bucket. The Lambda function will use the S3 bucket name and the S3 object key of the incoming event to read the contents of the created or modified S3 object. The Lambda function will parse the contents and save the parsed contents to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The Lambda function's execution role has permissions to read from the S3 bucket and to write to the DynamoDB table. During testing, a DevOps engineer discovers that the Lambda function does not run when objects are added to the S3 bucket or when existing objects are modified. Which solution will resolve this problem?

options.A: Increase the memory of the Lambda function to give the function the ability to process large files from the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create a resource policy on the Lambda function to grant Amazon S3 the permission to invoke the Lambda function for the S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as an OnFailure destination for the Lambda function.
options.D: Provision space in the /tmp folder of the Lambda function to give the function the ability to process large files from the S3 bucket.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The S3 notification is intended to invoke the Lambda function when an object is created or overwritten. The function's **execution role** already grants the permissions that the function needs *after it starts*: reading the S3 object and writing to DynamoDB. However, an execution role does not authorize Amazon S3 to invoke the function.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Create a resource policy on the Lambda function to grant Amazon S3 permission to invoke the Lambda function for the S3 bucket.**

Lambda needs a **resource-based policy** that allows the `s3.amazonaws.com` service principal to perform `lambda:InvokeFunction`, normally restricted by the source bucket ARN and source AWS account. AWS documentation explicitly states that an S3 source bucket needs this resource-based permission before it can invoke the function. When a trigger is created through the Lambda console, Lambda normally creates this policy automatically; when notification configuration is performed through another mechanism, the permission must be added separately. See [Configure Amazon S3 to invoke the function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3-tutorial.html) and [Granting permissions to invoke an AWS Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/grant-destinations-permissions-to-s3.html).

A typical permission statement can be added with `aws lambda add-permission`, specifying:

- Principal: `s3.amazonaws.com`
- Action: `lambda:InvokeFunction`
- Source ARN: the relevant S3 bucket ARN
- Source account: the bucket owner's AWS account

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Increase Lambda memory — Incorrect.** Memory affects the resources and proportional CPU available while the function is executing. Insufficient memory could cause a function invocation to fail, but it does not grant S3 permission to initiate the invocation. The symptom is that the function does not run at all, not that it runs and encounters a processing or out-of-memory error. See [Lambda memory configuration troubleshooting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/troubleshooting-configuration.html).

- **C. Configure an SQS queue as an OnFailure destination — Incorrect.** An OnFailure destination captures records for asynchronous invocations that were accepted by Lambda but ultimately failed after retries. It does not authorize S3 to invoke the function and therefore cannot fix the missing invocation permission. See [Lambda on-failure destination](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-error-handling.html).

- **D. Provision additional `/tmp` space — Incorrect.** Lambda ephemeral storage provides temporary local storage in `/tmp` for code that needs working space during execution. Increasing it can address runtime storage exhaustion, but it has no effect on whether S3 is permitted to invoke the function. See [Configure ephemeral storage for Lambda functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html).

Therefore, **B** resolves the invocation failure.

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS Lambda 函数上配置 Amazon S3 事件源。当特定 S3 存储桶中创建新对象或修改现有对象时，公司需要运行 Lambda 函数。Lambda 函数将使用传入事件中的 S3 存储桶名称和 S3 对象键来读取已创建或修改的 S3 对象内容。Lambda 函数将解析内容，并将解析后的内容保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。Lambda 函数的执行角色拥有从 S3 存储桶读取以及向 DynamoDB 表写入的权限。在测试期间，一名 DevOps 工程师发现，当对象添加到 S3 存储桶中或修改现有对象时，Lambda 函数不会运行。哪种解决方案可以解决此问题？

options.A: 增加 Lambda 函数的内存，使该函数能够处理来自 S3 存储桶的大型文件。
options.B: 在 Lambda 函数上创建资源策略，授予 Amazon S3 为该 S3 存储桶调用 Lambda 函数的权限。
options.C: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为 Lambda 函数的 OnFailure 目标。
options.D: 在 Lambda 函数的 /tmp 文件夹中预配空间，使该函数能够处理来自 S3 存储桶的大型文件。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该 S3 通知旨在对象被创建或覆盖时调用 Lambda 函数。函数的**执行角色**已授予函数在*启动后*所需的权限：读取 S3 对象并写入 DynamoDB。但是，执行角色并不授权 Amazon S3 调用该函数。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 在 Lambda 函数上创建资源策略，授予 Amazon S3 为该 S3 存储桶调用 Lambda 函数的权限。**

Lambda 需要一个**基于资源的策略**，允许 `s3.amazonaws.com` 服务主体执行 `lambda:InvokeFunction`，通常会通过源存储桶 ARN 和源 AWS 账户加以限制。AWS 文档明确指出，S3 源存储桶在能够调用函数之前需要此基于资源的权限。通过 Lambda 控制台创建触发器时，Lambda 通常会自动创建该策略；如果通过其他机制执行通知配置，则必须单独添加此权限。请参阅 [配置 Amazon S3 以调用函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3-tutorial.html) 和 [授予调用 AWS Lambda 函数的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/grant-destinations-permissions-to-s3.html)。

可以使用 `aws lambda add-permission` 添加典型的权限声明，并指定：

- 主体：`s3.amazonaws.com`
- 操作：`lambda:InvokeFunction`
- 源 ARN：相关 S3 存储桶 ARN
- 源账户：存储桶所有者的 AWS 账户

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A. 增加 Lambda 内存 — 不正确。** 内存会影响函数执行期间可用的资源和按比例分配的 CPU。内存不足可能导致函数调用失败，但不会授予 S3 发起调用的权限。此处的症状是函数根本没有运行，而不是函数运行后遇到处理错误或内存不足错误。请参阅 [Lambda 内存配置故障排除](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/troubleshooting-configuration.html)。

- **C. 将 SQS 队列配置为 OnFailure 目标 — 不正确。** OnFailure 目标会捕获已被 Lambda 接受、但在重试后最终失败的异步调用记录。它不会授权 S3 调用函数，因此无法修复缺失的调用权限。请参阅 [Lambda 调用失败目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-async-error-handling.html)。

- **D. 预配额外的 `/tmp` 空间 — 不正确。** Lambda 临时存储为需要在执行期间使用工作空间的代码提供 `/tmp` 中的临时本地存储。增加该空间可以解决运行时存储耗尽问题，但不会影响 S3 是否被允许调用函数。请参阅 [为 Lambda 函数配置临时存储](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-ephemeral-storage.html)。

因此，**B** 可以解决调用失败问题。

en.question: A company has deployed a critical application in two AWS Regions. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in both Regions. The company has Amazon Route 53 alias DNS records for both ALBs. The company uses Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller to ensure that the application can fail over between the two Regions. The Route 53 ARC configuration includes a routing control for both Regions. The company uses Route 53 ARC to perform quarterly disaster recovery (DR) tests. During the most recent DR test, a DevOps engineer accidentally turned off both routing controls. The company needs to ensure that at least one routing control is turned on at all times. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: In Route 53 ARC, create a new assertion safety rule. Apply the assertion safety rule to the two routing controls. Configure the rule with the ATLEAST type with a threshold of 1.
options.B: In Route 53 ARC, create a new gating safety rule. Apply the assertion safety rule to the two routing controls. Configure the rule with the OR type with a threshold of 1.
options.C: In Route 53 ARC, create a new resource set. Configure the resource set with an AWS::Route53::HealthCheck resource type. Specify the ARNs of the two routing controls as the target resource. Create a new readiness check for the resource set.
options.D: In Route 53 ARC, create a new resource set. Configure the resource set with an AWS::Route53RecoveryReadiness::DNSTargetResource resource type. Add the domain names of the two Route 53 alias DNS records as the target resource. Create a new readiness check for the resource set.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application uses two Route 53 ARC routing controls to direct traffic between two Regional ALBs. During a DR test, both controls were accidentally set to `Off`, which could stop traffic from reaching either Region. The requirement is therefore to enforce an invariant: **after every routing-control state change, at least one of the two controls must remain `On`.**

## Correct answer: A

Create an **assertion safety rule** over the two routing controls with:

- `Type: ATLEAST`
- `Threshold: 1`
- `Inverted: false`

An assertion rule validates the resulting states when routing controls are changed. If a requested change would violate the rule, ARC rejects the state change. AWS specifically describes the use case of an assertion rule that ensures at least one routing control in a set is `On`, thereby ensuring that traffic continues to flow to at least one Region or Availability Zone. See [Types of safety rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/routing-control.safety-rules.html).

AWS also provides an exact example with two asserted routing controls and the configuration `{"Threshold": 1, "Type": "ATLEAST", "Inverted": false}` to prevent both controls from being turned off. See [Create safety rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/getting-started-cli-routing-config.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Gating safety rule — incorrect

A gating rule provides an overall **permission switch** for whether a set of target routing controls can be updated. It requires one or more separate gating controls and a set of target controls. It does not directly enforce the required invariant that at least one of the two Regional routing controls remains `On`.

AWS distinguishes this from an assertion rule: assertion rules enforce conditions on routing-control states, while gating rules allow or prevent updates to target controls based on a gating control. See [Types of safety rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/routing-control.safety-rules.html).

### C. Health check resource set and readiness check — incorrect

An ARC readiness check audits whether application replicas and resources are prepared for recovery, including configuration, capacity, quotas, and routing policies. It does not reject an unsafe routing-control state change. Therefore, it cannot guarantee that one routing control always remains on.

Additionally, an `AWS::Route53::HealthCheck` resource set represents Route 53 health-check resources; the ARNs of ARC routing controls are not Route 53 health-check resource ARNs. See [Readiness check in ARC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.html) and [Resource types and ARN formats in ARC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.resource-types-arns.html).

### D. DNS target resource readiness check — incorrect

A DNS target resource readiness check audits DNS configuration and architectural resiliency. Like other readiness checks, it reports readiness issues but does not enforce routing-control state transitions or prevent both controls from being turned off. Safety rules—not resource sets or readiness checks—provide that enforcement. See [Readiness check in ARC](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.html).

Therefore, **A** is the solution that directly and automatically prevents the unsafe all-controls-off state.

zh.question: 一家公司已在两个 AWS 区域部署了一个关键应用程序。该应用程序在两个区域中都使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。该公司为两个 ALB 配置了 Amazon Route 53 别名 DNS 记录。该公司使用 Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller 来确保应用程序可以在两个区域之间进行故障转移。Route 53 ARC 配置包含两个区域各自的路由控制。该公司使用 Route 53 ARC 执行季度灾难恢复 (DR) 测试。在最近一次 DR 测试期间，一名 DevOps 工程师意外关闭了两个路由控制。该公司需要确保始终至少有一个路由控制处于开启状态。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Route 53 ARC 中，创建一个新的断言安全规则。将该断言安全规则应用于这两个路由控制。将规则配置为 ATLEAST 类型，阈值设为 1。
options.B: 在 Route 53 ARC 中，创建一个新的门控安全规则。将该断言安全规则应用于这两个路由控制。将规则配置为 OR 类型，阈值设为 1。
options.C: 在 Route 53 ARC 中，创建一个新的资源集。将资源集配置为 AWS::Route53::HealthCheck 资源类型。将两个路由控制的 ARN 指定为目标资源。为该资源集创建新的就绪情况检查。
options.D: 在 Route 53 ARC 中，创建一个新的资源集。将资源集配置为 AWS::Route53RecoveryReadiness::DNSTargetResource 资源类型。将两个 Route 53 别名 DNS 记录的域名添加为目标资源。为该资源集创建新的就绪情况检查。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序使用两个 Route 53 ARC 路由控制，在两个区域 ALB 之间引导流量。在一次 DR 测试期间，两个控制都被意外设为 `Off`，这可能导致流量无法到达任一区域。因此，要求是强制实施一项不变条件：**在每次路由控制状态变更后，两个控制中必须至少有一个保持 `On`。**

## 正确答案：A

在两个路由控制上创建一条**断言安全规则**，配置如下：

- `Type: ATLEAST`
- `Threshold: 1`
- `Inverted: false`

当路由控制发生变更时，断言规则会验证变更后的状态。如果所请求的变更会违反该规则，ARC 会拒绝该状态变更。AWS 明确说明了断言规则的一种使用场景：确保一组路由控制中至少有一个处于 `On` 状态，从而确保流量持续流向至少一个区域或可用区。参阅 [安全规则的类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/routing-control.safety-rules.html)。

AWS 还提供了一个确切示例，其中包含两个被断言的路由控制以及配置 `{"Threshold": 1, "Type": "ATLEAST", "Inverted": false}`，以防止两个控制都被关闭。参阅 [创建安全规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/getting-started-cli-routing-config.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 门控安全规则 — 不正确
