CloudTrail 会记录 EC2 API 活动，并且 CloudTrail 会将 `AWS API Call via CloudTrail` 事件发送到默认 EventBridge 事件总线。EventBridge 模式可以根据 `source: aws.ec2`、CloudTrail 详细信息类型以及相关的资源创建操作（例如 `RunInstances`）进行筛选。AWS 文档说明了这一确切架构：EventBridge 规则可以选择 **EC2**、**AWS API Call via CloudTrail** 和特定的 EC2 操作，然后使用 Lambda 函数作为目标。请参阅 [AWS API 调用 EventBridge 规则教程](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html) 和 [通过 CloudTrail 传送的 AWS 服务事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-service-event-cloudtrail.html)。

Lambda 函数会接收 CloudTrail 事件，并可从其 `userIdentity` 元素中获取调用方信息。例如，`principalId` 是发起调用实体的唯一标识符；而 ARN、用户名、会话颁发者、源身份，或 IAM Identity Center 的 `onBehalfOf.userId` 则可以根据请求的身份验证方式提供额外的身份上下文。请参阅 [CloudTrail userIdentity 字段](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html)。

这种事件驱动设计会在每次匹配的创建调用后立即执行标记逻辑，因此是满足一小时要求的最佳解决方案。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A：** 当向某个 **S3 对象** 添加或更新标签时，会生成 `s3:ObjectTagging:Put`。它不表示 EC2 资源的创建，甚至也不表示 CloudTrail 日志对象的创建。CloudTrail 通常会将新对象写入存储桶；仅仅传送日志并不会触发 `ObjectTagging:Put`。存储桶版本控制无法纠正这种不匹配。请参阅 [S3 对象标记事件通知](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-tagging.html)。

- **B：** S3 服务器访问日志会记录针对日志存储桶发出的请求；它不提供资源标记所需的 EC2 创建者身份。此外，`s3:ObjectTagging:*` 事件与 S3 对象标签变更有关，而非 EC2 资源创建活动。该选项也没有说明如何调用已配置的 Lambda 函数。

- **C：** 每小时一次的计划扫描对截止时间而言可靠性较低。在某次运行刚结束后立即创建的资源，可能要到接近一小时后才能被处理，而 CloudTrail 传送和 Lambda 处理还会增加额外时间。AWS 表示 CloudTrail 通常大约每五分钟发布一次 S3 日志文件，但不保证传送时间。因此，总延迟可能超过一小时。在 CloudTrail 事件可以由 EventBridge 直接匹配的情况下，读取并重复扫描 S3 日志文件也会造成不必要的复杂性。请参阅 [CloudTrail 跟踪的工作方式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/how-cloudtrail-works.html)。

en.question: A company runs an application for multiple environments in a single AWS account. An AWS CodePipeline pipeline uses a development Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster to test an image for the application from an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. The pipeline promotes the image to a production ECS cluster. The company needs to move the production cluster into a separate AWS account in the same AWS Region. The production cluster must be able to download the images over a private connection. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon ECR VPC endpoints and an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint. In the separate AWS account, create an ECR repository. Set the repository policy to allow the production ECS tasks to pull images from the main AWS account. Configure the production ECS task execution role to have permission to download the image from the ECR repository.
options.B: Set a repository policy on the production ECR repository in the main AWS account. Configure the repository policy to allow the production ECS tasks in the separate AWS account to pull images from the main account. Configure the production ECS task execution role to have permission to download the image from the ECR repository.
options.C: Configure ECR private image replication in the main AWS account. Activate cross-account replication. Define the destination account ID of the separate AWS account.
options.D: Use Amazon ECR VPC endpoints and an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint. Set a repository policy on the production ECR repository in the main AWS account. Configure the repository policy to allow the production ECS tasks in the separate AWS account to pull images from the main account. Configure the production ECS task execution role to have permission to download the image from the ECR repository.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The production ECS cluster is moving to a different AWS account, but it must continue pulling the application image from the ECR repository in the main account. The solution therefore needs to provide both:

1. **Cross-account authorization** to pull the image.
2. **Private network connectivity** from the production VPC to ECR and the underlying image layers.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Use Amazon ECR VPC endpoints and an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint, configure the source ECR repository policy for cross-account access, and grant the production ECS task execution role permission to download the image.**

This is the only option that addresses both access and connectivity:

- An ECR repository policy on the repository in the main account can authorize principals from the production account to perform pull operations such as `ecr:BatchGetImage` and `ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer`. AWS provides repository-policy examples that grant specified principals permission to pull images: [Amazon ECR repository policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/repository-policy-examples.html).
- The ECS identity used for image retrieval must have the required ECR permissions. For Fargate, this is the task execution role; AWS documents `ecr:BatchGetImage`, `ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer`, and `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken` as required actions: [Using Amazon ECR images with Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/ECR_on_ECS.html).
- ECR interface VPC endpoints provide the private ECR API and Docker Registry paths. An S3 gateway endpoint is also required because ECR stores image layers in Amazon S3. AWS explicitly states that ECS tasks pulling private ECR images require the S3 gateway endpoint and, depending on launch type/platform version, the ECR endpoints: [Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html).

Thus, the production tasks can pull directly from the main account's repository without sending the image-download traffic over the public internet.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

This option unnecessarily creates an ECR repository in the production account but does not configure replication or another mechanism to place the source images into that repository. Moreover, a policy on the new repository cannot grant access to an unrelated repository in the main account; the resource policy must be attached to the repository that contains the image. Therefore, its cross-account access configuration is incorrect even though the endpoint components are appropriate.

### B

The cross-account repository policy and ECS execution-role permissions address authorization, but this option does not create ECR interface VPC endpoints or the S3 gateway endpoint. It therefore does not satisfy the explicit requirement to download images over a private connection. ECR image pulls need access both to ECR and to the S3 bucket that stores the image layers, as described in the [ECR VPC endpoint documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html).

### C

Amazon ECR does support cross-account replication, but replication by itself does not ensure that ECS downloads the replicated image over a private connection. The production VPC would still need the applicable ECR VPC endpoints and S3 endpoint. In addition, cross-account replication requires a registry permissions policy in the destination account, and only images pushed or restored after replication is configured are replicated. These requirements and limitations are documented in [Private image replication in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/replication.html). Therefore, C is incomplete for the stated private-connectivity requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 AWS 账户中为多个环境运行应用程序。一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道使用开发 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群，对来自 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库的应用程序镜像进行测试。该管道随后将镜像提升到生产 ECS 集群。公司需要将生产集群迁移到同一 AWS Region 中的单独 AWS 账户。生产集群必须能够通过私有连接下载镜像。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon ECR VPC 终端节点和 Amazon S3 网关终端节点。在单独的 AWS 账户中，创建一个 ECR 存储库。设置存储库策略，以允许生产 ECS 任务从主 AWS 账户拉取镜像。配置生产 ECS 任务执行角色，使其具有从 ECR 存储库下载镜像的权限。
options.B: 在主 AWS 账户中的生产 ECR 存储库上设置存储库策略。配置该存储库策略，以允许单独 AWS 账户中的生产 ECS 任务从主账户拉取镜像。配置生产 ECS 任务执行角色，使其具有从 ECR 存储库下载镜像的权限。
options.C: 在主 AWS 账户中配置 ECR 私有镜像复制。启用跨账户复制。定义单独 AWS 账户的目标账户 ID。
options.D: 使用 Amazon ECR VPC 终端节点和 Amazon S3 网关终端节点。在主 AWS 账户中的生产 ECR 存储库上设置存储库策略。配置该存储库策略，以允许单独 AWS 账户中的生产 ECS 任务从主账户拉取镜像。配置生产 ECS 任务执行角色，使其具有从 ECR 存储库下载镜像的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

生产 ECS 集群将迁移到不同的 AWS 账户，但它必须继续从主账户中的 ECR 存储库拉取应用程序镜像。因此，该解决方案需要同时提供：

1. 用于拉取镜像的**跨账户授权**。
2. 从生产 VPC 到 ECR 及底层镜像层的**私有网络连接**。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 使用 Amazon ECR VPC 终端节点和 Amazon S3 网关终端节点，为源 ECR 存储库策略配置跨账户访问，并授予生产 ECS 任务执行角色下载镜像的权限。**

这是唯一同时解决访问和连接问题的选项：

- 主账户中存储库的 ECR 存储库策略可以授权来自生产账户的主体执行拉取操作，例如 `ecr:BatchGetImage` 和 `ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer`。AWS 提供了授予指定主体拉取镜像权限的存储库策略示例：[Amazon ECR 存储库策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/repository-policy-examples.html)。
- 用于检索镜像的 ECS 身份必须具备所需的 ECR 权限。对于 Fargate，这个身份是任务执行角色；AWS 将 `ecr:BatchGetImage`、`ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer` 和 `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken` 记录为所需操作：[将 Amazon ECR 镜像与 Amazon ECS 配合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/ECR_on_ECS.html)。
- ECR 接口 VPC 终端节点提供私有 ECR API 和 Docker Registry 路径。还需要 S3 网关终端节点，因为 ECR 将镜像层存储在 Amazon S3 中。AWS 明确指出，拉取私有 ECR 镜像的 ECS 任务需要 S3 网关终端节点，并且根据启动类型/平台版本，也需要 ECR 终端节点：[Amazon ECR 接口 VPC 终端节点](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html)。

因此，生产任务可以直接从主账户的存储库拉取镜像，而无需通过公共互联网传输镜像下载流量。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A

此选项不必要地在生产账户中创建了 ECR 存储库，但没有配置复制或其他机制来将源镜像放入该存储库。此外，新存储库上的策略无法授予对主账户中无关存储库的访问权限；资源策略必须附加到包含镜像的存储库。因此，尽管终端节点组件是合适的，其跨账户访问配置仍不正确。

### B

跨账户存储库策略和 ECS 执行角色权限解决了授权问题，但此选项没有创建 ECR 接口 VPC 终端节点或 S3 网关终端节点。因此，它不满足通过私有连接下载镜像这一明确要求。ECR 镜像拉取既需要访问 ECR，也需要访问存储镜像层的 S3 存储桶，如 [ECR VPC 终端节点文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html) 中所述。

### C

Amazon ECR 确实支持跨账户复制，但仅靠复制并不能确保 ECS 通过私有连接下载已复制的镜像。生产 VPC 仍需要适用的 ECR VPC 终端节点和 S3 终端节点。此外，跨账户复制要求目标账户中具有注册表权限策略，并且只有在配置复制之后推送或恢复的镜像才会被复制。这些要求和限制记录在 [Amazon ECR 中的私有镜像复制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/replication.html) 中。因此，对于所述的私有连接要求，C 并不完整。

en.question: A company needs to ensure that flow logs remain configured for all existing and new VPCs in its AWS account. The company uses an AWS CloudFormation stack to manage its VPCs. The company needs a solution that will work for any VPCs that any IAM user creates. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add the AWS::EC2::FlowLog resource to the CloudFormation stack that creates the VPCs.
options.B: Create an organization in AWS Organizations. Add the company's AWS account to the organization. Create an SCP to prevent users from modifying VPC flow logs.
options.C: Turn on AWS Config. Create an AWS Config rule to check whether VPC flow logs are turned on. Configure automatic remediation to turn on VPC flow logs.
options.D: Create an IAM policy to deny the use of API calls for VPC flow logs. Attach the IAM policy to all IAM users.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an account-wide control that covers:

- VPCs that already exist
- VPCs created in the future
- VPCs created outside the existing CloudFormation stack by any IAM user
- Automatic correction when flow logging is missing

## Correct answer: C

**Turn on AWS Config, create a rule that checks whether VPC flow logs are enabled, and configure automatic remediation to enable them.**

AWS provides the managed Config rule `VPC_FLOW_LOGS_ENABLED`. It evaluates `AWS::EC2::VPC` resources and checks whether flow logs are enabled for **all VPCs**, reporting noncompliance when at least one VPC does not have flow logs enabled. This gives account-level coverage rather than coverage limited to a particular CloudFormation stack. See [vpc-flow-logs-enabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/vpc-flow-logs-enabled.html).

AWS Config can associate a remediation action, implemented through an AWS Systems Manager Automation document, with a Config rule. Automatic remediation then acts on resources reported as noncompliant. See [Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html) and [Setting Up Auto Remediation for AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/setup-autoremediation.html).

Therefore, this solution detects existing or newly created VPCs without flow logs and automatically corrects them, regardless of whether the VPC was created through CloudFormation or directly by an IAM principal.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Add `AWS::EC2::FlowLog` to the VPC CloudFormation stack

`AWS::EC2::FlowLog` creates a flow log for a specified VPC, subnet, or network interface. It would work for VPCs managed by that template, but it does not automatically discover or manage VPCs that IAM users create outside the stack. See [AWS::EC2::FlowLog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-ec2-flowlog.html).

Thus, it does not satisfy the requirement to cover **any VPC that any IAM user creates**.

### B. Use an SCP to prevent users from modifying VPC flow logs

An SCP is a permissions guardrail: it limits the maximum permissions available to principals but does not perform configuration changes or enable flow logs. AWS explicitly states that SCPs do not grant permissions; they restrict permissions. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Preventing modification or deletion could help preserve a flow log that is already configured, but it would not enable flow logs on existing noncompliant VPCs or automatically create flow logs when a new VPC is created without one.

### D. Deny VPC flow log API calls with an IAM policy

Denying flow-log API calls would block users from creating or changing flow logs; it would not ensure that flow logs are enabled. It could actually prevent legitimate enablement or remediation. Additionally, attaching the policy only to IAM users would not provide a comprehensive configuration-control mechanism for all possible principals or existing resources.

AWS Config detection plus automatic remediation is the only option that both identifies missing flow logs and corrects the configuration across existing and future VPCs.

zh.question: 一家公司需要确保其 AWS 账户中所有现有和新建 VPC 都始终配置了流日志。该公司使用 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈来管理其 VPC。该公司需要一种适用于任何 IAM 用户创建的任何 VPC 的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 AWS::EC2::FlowLog 资源添加到用于创建 VPC 的 CloudFormation 堆栈中。
options.B: 在 AWS Organizations 中创建一个组织。将公司的 AWS 账户添加到该组织中。创建一个 SCP 以防止用户修改 VPC 流日志。
options.C: 开启 AWS Config。创建一个 AWS Config 规则来检查是否已开启 VPC 流日志。配置自动修复以开启 VPC 流日志。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 策略以拒绝使用 VPC 流日志的 API 调用。将该 IAM 策略附加到所有 IAM 用户。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

公司需要一项覆盖整个账户的控制措施，能够涵盖：

- 已存在的 VPC
- 将来创建的 VPC
- 任意 IAM 用户在现有 CloudFormation 堆栈之外创建的 VPC
- 流日志缺失时的自动修正

## 正确答案：C

**开启 AWS Config，创建一条检查是否启用了 VPC 流日志的规则，并配置自动修复以启用流日志。**

AWS 提供了托管的 Config 规则 `VPC_FLOW_LOGS_ENABLED`。该规则评估 `AWS::EC2::VPC` 资源，并检查是否已为**所有 VPC**启用流日志；当至少有一个 VPC 未启用流日志时，会报告不合规。这提供了账户级别的覆盖范围，而不是仅限于特定 CloudFormation 堆栈的覆盖范围。请参阅 [vpc-flow-logs-enabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/vpc-flow-logs-enabled.html)。

AWS Config 可以将通过 AWS Systems Manager Automation 文档实施的修复操作与 Config 规则关联。自动修复随后会对报告为不合规的资源采取操作。请参阅 [使用 AWS Config 修复不合规资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html) 和 [为 AWS Config 设置自动修复](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/setup-autoremediation.html)。

因此，无论 VPC 是通过 CloudFormation 还是由 IAM 主体直接创建，此解决方案都能检测没有流日志的现有或新建 VPC，并自动进行修正。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 将 `AWS::EC2::FlowLog` 添加到 VPC CloudFormation 堆栈

`AWS::EC2::FlowLog` 会为指定的 VPC、子网或网络接口创建流日志。它适用于由该模板管理的 VPC，但不会自动发现或管理 IAM 用户在堆栈外创建的 VPC。请参阅 [AWS::EC2::FlowLog](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-resource-ec2-flowlog.html)。

因此，它无法满足覆盖**任意 IAM 用户创建的任何 VPC**这一要求。

### B. 使用 SCP 防止用户修改 VPC 流日志

SCP 是一种权限防护机制：它限制主体可获得的最大权限，但不会执行配置更改或启用流日志。AWS 明确指出，SCP 不授予权限；它们仅限制权限。请参阅 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

防止修改或删除可以帮助保留已经配置的流日志，但无法为现有不合规 VPC 启用流日志，也无法在新建 VPC 未配置流日志时自动创建流日志。

### D. 使用 IAM 策略拒绝 VPC 流日志 API 调用

拒绝流日志 API 调用会阻止用户创建或更改流日志，而不能确保流日志已启用。实际上，这可能会阻止合法的启用或修复操作。此外，仅将该策略附加到 IAM 用户，无法为所有可能的主体或现有资源提供全面的配置控制机制。

只有 AWS Config 检测结合自动修复，才能同时识别缺失的流日志，并针对现有和未来的 VPC 修正配置。

en.question: A company's application teams use AWS CodeCommit repositories for their applications. The application teams have repositories in multiple AWS accounts. All accounts are in an organization in AWS Organizations. Each application team uses AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) configured with an external IdP to assume a developer IAM role. The developer role allows the application teams to use Git to work with the code in the repositories. A security audit reveals that the application teams can modify the main branch in any repository. A DevOps engineer must implement a solution that allows the application teams to modify the main branch of only the repositories that they manage. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Update the SAML assertion to pass the user's team name. Update the IAM role's trust policy to add an access-team session tag that has the team name.
options.B: Create an approval rule template for each team in the Organizations management account. Associate the template with all the repositories. Add the developer role ARN as an approver.
options.C: Create an approval rule template for each account. Associate the template with all repositories. Add the "aws:ResourceTag/access-team": "$ ; {aws:PrincipalTag/access-team}" condition to the approval rule template.
options.D: For each CodeCommit repository, add an access-team tag that has the value set to the name of the associated team.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The developer role already grants broad CodeCommit write access, including access to every repository's `main` branch. The solution therefore needs an organization-wide **ABAC guardrail** that compares each developer's team attribute with the team tag on the target repository and explicitly denies updates to `main` when they do not match.

## Correct answers: A, D, and E

### A. Pass the team name as a principal/session tag

The external IdP must supply the user's team name so that it is available as `aws:PrincipalTag/access-team` during authorization. AWS documents that SAML attributes can be passed as session tags and that subsequent requests include the `aws:PrincipalTag` context key. The role trust policy must permit `sts:TagSession` for an IdP to pass session tags. This enables the principal side of the ABAC comparison in option E. See [Pass session tags in AWS STS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_session-tags.html).

Although the option says the trust policy “adds” the tag, the precise implementation is that the SAML assertion passes the `access-team` tag and the role trust policy authorizes session tagging.

### D. Tag every repository with its owning team

Each repository needs an `access-team` resource tag whose value identifies the managing application team. This supplies `aws:ResourceTag/access-team` for comparison with the developer's principal tag. CodeCommit supports policies that allow or deny operations according to tags on repositories, as shown in [Customer managed policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/customer-managed-policies.html).

### E. Apply an SCP that denies `main` updates when the tags differ

The SCP explicitly denies `GitPush`, `PutFile`, and `Merge*` when all of the following are true:

- The target reference is `refs/heads/main`.
- The repository's `access-team` tag does not equal the developer session's `access-team` principal tag.
- The `codecommit:References` key is present.

AWS documents the same branch-protection pattern using `codecommit:References`, `StringEqualsIfExists`, and the required `Null` test for a `Deny` statement containing `GitPush`. It also documents that an asterisk resource can apply the restriction to `main` across repositories. See [Customer managed policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/customer-managed-policies.html) and [Limit pushes and merges to branches in AWS CodeCommit](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-conditional-branch.html).

An SCP does not grant access; it limits the maximum permissions available in member accounts. Therefore, the developer role's existing permissions continue to permit normal work, while the SCP overrides those permissions for nonmatching team/repository combinations. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Together, A, D, and E implement:

`developer team session tag` **matches** `repository team resource tag` → no SCP denial for `main`

`developer team session tag` **does not match** `repository team resource tag` → explicit SCP denial for `main`

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Approval templates do not provide the required authorization control

Approval rule templates apply approval requirements to **pull requests** created in associated repositories. They do not prevent direct Git pushes or API file updates to a branch. In addition, making the broad developer role an approver would not establish team-to-repository ownership. See [Working with approval rule templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/approval-rule-templates.html).

### C. Approval templates cannot use this IAM condition as proposed

An approval rule template defines pull-request approval requirements, such as the number or pool of approvers and destination branch filters. It is not an IAM policy in which `aws:ResourceTag` can be compared with `aws:PrincipalTag`. It also would not govern direct `GitPush` or `PutFile` access. See [Working with approval rule templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/approval-rule-templates.html).

### F. The permissions-boundary statement has the wrong effect and condition

A permissions boundary is evaluated as an intersection with the role's identity-based permissions; it establishes maximum permissions and does not independently grant access. See [Evaluating identity-based policies with permissions boundaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html).

More importantly, this boundary uses `Effect: Allow` together with `StringNotEquals`. It would make the listed `main`-branch actions boundary-eligible when the repository and principal team tags **do not match**, while failing to allow them through the boundary when the tags do match—the opposite of the requirement. The correct pattern is the explicit conditional `Deny` in option E.

zh.question: 某公司的应用程序团队使用 AWS CodeCommit 存储库来管理其应用程序。应用程序团队在多个 AWS 账户中拥有存储库。所有账户都属于 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织。每个应用程序团队都使用配置了外部 IdP 的 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 来担任开发人员 IAM 角色。开发人员角色允许应用程序团队使用 Git 处理存储库中的代码。一项安全审计发现，应用程序团队可以修改任何存储库中的 main 分支。DevOps 工程师必须实施一个解决方案，使应用程序团队只能修改由其管理的存储库的 main 分支。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 更新 SAML 断言以传递用户的团队名称。更新 IAM 角色的信任策略，以添加一个值为团队名称的 access-team 会话标签。
options.B: 在 Organizations 管理账户中为每个团队创建一个审批规则模板。将该模板与所有存储库关联。将开发人员角色 ARN 添加为审批人。
options.C: 为每个账户创建一个审批规则模板。将该模板与所有存储库关联。向审批规则模板添加 `"aws:ResourceTag/access-team": "$ ; {aws:PrincipalTag/access-team}"` 条件。
options.D: 对于每个 CodeCommit 存储库，添加一个 access-team 标签，并将其值设置为关联团队的名称。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

开发人员角色已授予广泛的 CodeCommit 写入权限，包括访问每个存储库的 `main` 分支。因此，该解决方案需要一个组织范围的 **ABAC 防护机制**，用于将每位开发人员的团队属性与目标存储库上的团队标签进行比较，并在二者不匹配时显式拒绝对 `main` 的更新。

## 正确答案：A、D 和 E

### A. 将团队名称作为主体/会话标签传递

外部 IdP 必须提供用户的团队名称，以便在授权期间将其作为 `aws:PrincipalTag/access-team` 使用。AWS 文档说明，SAML 属性可以作为会话标签传递，并且后续请求会包含 `aws:PrincipalTag` 上下文键。角色信任策略必须允许 IdP 使用 `sts:TagSession` 来传递会话标签。这样便可为选项 E 中的 ABAC 比较提供主体侧的属性。请参阅 [在 AWS STS 中传递会话标签](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_session-tags.html)。

虽然选项表述为信任策略“添加”标签，但准确的实现方式是：SAML 断言传递 `access-team` 标签，而角色信任策略授权进行会话标签标记。

### D. 使用所属团队标签标记每个存储库

每个存储库都需要一个 `access-team` 资源标签，其值标识负责管理的应用程序团队。这会提供 `aws:ResourceTag/access-team`，用于与开发人员的主体标签进行比较。CodeCommit 支持根据存储库标签允许或拒绝操作的策略，如[客户托管策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/customer-managed-policies.html)所示。

### E. 应用 SCP，以便在标签不匹配时拒绝对 `main` 的更新

当以下所有条件都满足时，SCP 会显式拒绝 `GitPush`、`PutFile` 和 `Merge*`：

- 目标引用为 `refs/heads/main`。
- 存储库的 `access-team` 标签不等于开发人员会话的 `access-team` 主体标签。
- 存在 `codecommit:References` 键。

AWS 使用 `codecommit:References`、`StringEqualsIfExists` 以及在包含 `GitPush` 的 `Deny` 语句中必需的 `Null` 测试，记录了相同的分支保护模式。AWS 还说明，星号资源可将对 `main` 的限制应用于所有存储库。请参阅[客户托管策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/customer-managed-policies.html)和 [限制对 AWS CodeCommit 中分支的推送和合并](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-conditional-branch.html)。

SCP 不授予权限；它限制成员账户中可用的最大权限。因此，开发人员角色的现有权限仍允许正常工作，而对于团队与存储库不匹配的组合，SCP 会覆盖这些权限。请参阅 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

A、D 和 E 共同实现了：

`开发人员团队会话标签` **匹配** `存储库团队资源标签` → 对 `main` 不会触发 SCP 拒绝

`开发人员团队会话标签` **不匹配** `存储库团队资源标签` → SCP 对 `main` 显式拒绝

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 审批模板无法提供所需的授权控制

审批规则模板会将审批要求应用于关联存储库中创建的**拉取请求**。它们无法阻止直接 Git 推送或对分支进行 API 文件更新。此外，将具有广泛权限的开发人员角色设为审批人，也无法建立团队与存储库之间的所有权关系。请参阅 [使用审批规则模板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/approval-rule-templates.html)。

### C. 审批模板无法按建议使用该 IAM 条件

审批规则模板定义拉取请求的审批要求，例如审批人数量或审批人池以及目标分支筛选条件。它不是 IAM 策略，因此无法在其中将 `aws:ResourceTag` 与 `aws:PrincipalTag` 进行比较。它同样无法控制直接 `GitPush` 或 `PutFile` 访问。请参阅 [使用审批规则模板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/approval-rule-templates.html)。

### F. 权限边界语句具有错误的效果和条件

权限边界作为角色基于身份的权限的交集进行评估；它建立最大权限范围，并不独立授予访问权限。请参阅 [使用权限边界评估基于身份的策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)。

更重要的是，该边界将 `Effect: Allow` 与 `StringNotEquals` 一起使用。当存储库和主体的团队标签**不匹配**时，它会使列出的 main 分支操作符合权限边界条件；而当标签匹配时，它却无法通过权限边界允许这些操作——这与要求完全相反。正确模式是选项 E 中的显式条件 `Deny`。

en.question: A company uses AWS WAF to protect its cloud infrastructure. A DevOps engineer needs to give an operations team the ability to analyze log messages from AWS WAF. The operations team needs to be able to create alarms for specific patterns in the log output. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Configure the appropriate AWS WAF web ACL to send log messages to the log group. Instruct the operations team to create CloudWatch metric filters.
options.B: Create an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster and appropriate indexes. Configure an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to stream log data to the indexes. Use OpenSearch Dashboards to create filters and widgets.
options.C: Create an Amazon S3 bucket for the log output. Configure AWS WAF to send log outputs to the S3 bucket. Instruct the operations team to create AWS Lambda functions that detect each desired log message pattern. Configure the Lambda functions to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic.
options.D: Create an Amazon S3 bucket for the log output. Configure AWS WAF to send log outputs to the S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to create an external table definition that fits the log message pattern. Instruct the operations team to write SQL queries and to create Amazon CloudWatch metric filters for the Athena queries.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The operations team must be able to analyze AWS WAF log records, identify specific patterns, and create alarms, while minimizing infrastructure and custom-code management.

## Correct answer: A

AWS WAF can deliver web ACL traffic logs directly to a CloudWatch Logs log group. AWS states that after you provide the log group ARN and enable logging, AWS WAF delivers the logs to log streams in that group. The log group name must begin with `aws-waf-logs-` ([AWS WAF CloudWatch Logs documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/logging-cw-logs.html)).

The operations team can then create CloudWatch Logs metric filters that match specific terms or structured fields in the WAF log events and publish a CloudWatch metric. For example, assigning a metric value of `1` counts every matching log event ([Creating a metric filter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)). A standard CloudWatch alarm can monitor the metric produced by the filter; AWS explicitly documents this as the **metric filter approach** for alarming on logs ([Alarming on logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)).

This solution uses direct managed-service integration and requires no data pipeline, search cluster, query scheduler, or custom pattern-detection code, so it has the least operational overhead.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B — OpenSearch Service and Firehose:** AWS WAF supports Firehose as a logging destination, and an OpenSearch-based architecture could provide extensive search and visualization capabilities. However, it requires provisioning and operating an OpenSearch domain or collection, indexes, and a Firehose delivery pipeline. That is substantially more operational overhead than direct delivery to CloudWatch Logs with metric filters. AWS lists CloudWatch Logs, Amazon S3, and Firehose as supported WAF logging destinations ([AWS WAF logging destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/logging-destinations.html)).

- **C — S3, Lambda, and SNS:** S3 can store WAF logs, but creating and maintaining a separate Lambda function for every desired pattern introduces custom code, invocation configuration, error handling, and ongoing maintenance. Publishing matches directly to SNS also does not provide the simple CloudWatch metric-and-alarm workflow requested. CloudWatch Logs metric filters provide this pattern detection natively with less overhead.

- **D — S3 and Athena:** Athena is suitable for interactive SQL analysis of logs in S3, but CloudWatch Logs metric filters operate on **CloudWatch Logs log groups**, not on Athena query results. The documented workflow starts by selecting a CloudWatch log group and creating the metric filter on that group ([Creating a metric filter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)). Therefore, the proposed “CloudWatch metric filters for the Athena queries” is not a valid direct integration. Scheduled queries and additional automation could be constructed, but they would add overhead and are not what this option describes.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS WAF 保护其云基础设施。一名 DevOps 工程师需要让运维团队能够分析来自 AWS WAF 的日志消息。运维团队需要能够针对日志输出中的特定模式创建警报。哪种解决方案能以最低的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组。配置相应的 AWS WAF Web ACL，使其将日志消息发送到该日志组。指导运维团队创建 CloudWatch 指标筛选器。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集群和相应的索引。配置一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流，将日志数据流式传输到这些索引。使用 OpenSearch Dashboards 创建筛选器和小组件。
options.C: 为日志输出创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 AWS WAF 将日志输出发送到该 S3 存储桶。指导运维团队创建 AWS Lambda 函数，以检测每种所需的日志消息模式。配置 Lambda 函数发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。
options.D: 为日志输出创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。配置 AWS WAF 将日志输出发送到该 S3 存储桶。使用 Amazon Athena 创建符合日志消息模式的外部表定义。指导运维团队编写 SQL 查询，并为 Athena 查询创建 Amazon CloudWatch 指标筛选器。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

运维团队必须能够分析 AWS WAF 日志记录、识别特定模式并创建警报，同时尽可能减少基础设施和自定义代码管理。

## 正确答案：A

AWS WAF 可以将 Web ACL 流量日志直接传送到 CloudWatch Logs 日志组。AWS 说明，在提供日志组 ARN 并启用日志记录后，AWS WAF 会将日志传送到该组中的日志流。日志组名称必须以 `aws-waf-logs-` 开头（[AWS WAF CloudWatch Logs 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/logging-cw-logs.html)）。

随后，运维团队可以创建 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器，以匹配 WAF 日志事件中的特定术语或结构化字段，并发布 CloudWatch 指标。例如，分配指标值 `1` 会对每个匹配的日志事件进行计数（[创建指标筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)）。标准 CloudWatch 警报可以监控由该筛选器生成的指标；AWS 明确将此记录为针对日志创建警报的**指标筛选器方法**（[针对日志创建警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)）。

此解决方案使用直接的托管服务集成，不需要数据管道、搜索集群、查询调度程序或自定义模式检测代码，因此运维开销最低。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B — OpenSearch Service 和 Firehose：** AWS WAF 支持将 Firehose 作为日志目标，并且基于 OpenSearch 的架构可以提供广泛的搜索和可视化功能。但是，它需要预置和运营 OpenSearch 域或集合、索引以及 Firehose 传输管道。这比直接传送到 CloudWatch Logs 并使用指标筛选器的运维开销大得多。AWS 将 CloudWatch Logs、Amazon S3 和 Firehose 列为支持的 WAF 日志目标（[AWS WAF 日志目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/logging-destinations.html)）。

- **C — S3、Lambda 和 SNS：** S3 可以存储 WAF 日志，但为每个所需模式创建和维护单独的 Lambda 函数会引入自定义代码、调用配置、错误处理和持续维护。将匹配项直接发布到 SNS 也无法提供题目所要求的简单 CloudWatch 指标和警报工作流程。CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器能够以更低开销原生提供这种模式检测。

- **D — S3 和 Athena：** Athena 适用于对 S3 中的日志进行交互式 SQL 分析，但 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器作用于 **CloudWatch Logs 日志组**，而不是 Athena 查询结果。文档化的工作流程是先选择一个 CloudWatch 日志组，然后在该组上创建指标筛选器（[创建指标筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)）。因此，所提出的“针对 Athena 查询创建 CloudWatch 指标筛选器”并不是有效的直接集成。可以构建计划查询和额外自动化，但这会增加开销，并且不是该选项所描述的内容。

en.question: A software team is using AWS CodePipeline to automate its Java application release pipeline. The pipeline consists of a source stage, then a build stage, and then a deploy stage. Each stage contains a single action that has a runOrder value of 1. The team wants to integrate unit tests into the existing release pipeline. The team needs a solution that deploys only the code changes that pass all unit tests. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Modify the build stage. Add a test action that has a runOrder value of 1. Use AWS CodeDeploy as the action provider to run unit tests.
options.B: Modify the build stage. Add a test action that has a runOrder value of 2. Use AWS CodeBuild as the action provider to run unit tests.
options.C: Modify the deploy stage. Add a test action that has a runOrder value of 1. Use AWS CodeDeploy as the action provider to run unit tests.
options.D: Modify the deploy stage. Add a test action that has a runOrder value of 2. Use AWS CodeBuild as the action provider to run unit tests.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to insert unit testing **after the application is built but before it is deployed**, so a failed test prevents the pipeline from reaching the deploy stage.

**Correct answer: B**

Add a **CodeBuild test action** to the existing build stage with `runOrder: 2`:

- The existing build action has `runOrder: 1`, so it runs first and produces the built artifact.
- AWS documents that actions with larger `runOrder` values run serially after actions with smaller values; actions with the same value run in parallel. Therefore, the test action at order 2 runs only after the order-1 build action completes. See [CodePipeline action declaration — `runOrder`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-requirements.html).
- CodeBuild is supported as either a **Build** or **Test** category action provider, runs the commands in the buildspec, accepts input artifacts, and may produce no output artifact. This makes it suitable for running unit tests against the build output. See [CodeBuild build and test action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html).
- A stage completes all its actions and can have a `Failed` status. Consequently, if the CodeBuild unit-test action fails, the build stage does not succeed and the subsequent deploy stage is not reached. See [CodePipeline stage operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/concepts.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A:** A test action with `runOrder: 1` would run in parallel with the existing build action rather than after it, so it could not reliably test the newly built artifact. Additionally, CodeDeploy is a **Deploy** category provider, not the appropriate test provider. The [CodeDeploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html) identifies its action category as `Deploy`.

- **C:** Both actions in the deploy stage would have `runOrder: 1`, so the test and deployment would run in parallel. The application could begin deployment before testing succeeds. CodeDeploy is also a deployment provider, not the correct provider for executing unit tests.

- **D:** CodeBuild can run the tests, but placing it in the deploy stage with `runOrder: 2` means the existing deployment action at order 1 runs first. The tests would therefore execute **after deployment**, violating the requirement to deploy only code changes that pass all unit tests.

Thus, **B** provides the required sequence: **build → unit test → deploy**.

zh.question: 某软件团队正在使用 AWS CodePipeline 自动化其 Java 应用程序发布管道。该管道依次包含源阶段、构建阶段和部署阶段。每个阶段都包含一个 `runOrder` 值为 1 的单一操作。团队希望将单元测试集成到现有发布管道中。团队需要一种仅部署通过所有单元测试的代码更改的解决方案。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 修改构建阶段。添加一个 `runOrder` 值为 1 的测试操作。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 作为操作提供程序来运行单元测试。
options.B: 修改构建阶段。添加一个 `runOrder` 值为 2 的测试操作。使用 AWS CodeBuild 作为操作提供程序来运行单元测试。
options.C: 修改部署阶段。添加一个 `runOrder` 值为 1 的测试操作。使用 AWS CodeDeploy 作为操作提供程序来运行单元测试。
options.D: 修改部署阶段。添加一个 `runOrder` 值为 2 的测试操作。使用 AWS CodeBuild 作为操作提供程序来运行单元测试。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是在**应用程序构建完成后、部署之前**插入单元测试，因此测试失败会阻止管道进入部署阶段。

**正确答案：B**

向现有构建阶段添加一个 `runOrder: 2` 的 **CodeBuild 测试操作**：

- 现有构建操作的 `runOrder: 1`，因此它会先运行并生成构建构件。
- AWS 文档指出，具有较大 `runOrder` 值的操作会在具有较小值的操作之后串行运行；具有相同值的操作会并行运行。因此，顺序为 2 的测试操作仅会在顺序为 1 的构建操作完成后运行。请参阅 [CodePipeline 操作声明 — `runOrder`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-requirements.html)。
- CodeBuild 支持作为 **Build** 或 **Test** 类别的操作提供程序，可运行 buildspec 中的命令、接受输入构件，并且可以不生成输出构件。因此，它适合针对构建输出运行单元测试。请参阅 [CodeBuild 构建和测试操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)。
- 一个阶段会完成其所有操作，并且可能具有 `Failed` 状态。因此，如果 CodeBuild 单元测试操作失败，构建阶段不会成功，后续的部署阶段也不会到达。请参阅 [CodePipeline 阶段操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/concepts.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **A：** `runOrder: 1` 的测试操作会与现有构建操作并行运行，而不是在其之后运行，因此无法可靠地测试新构建的构件。此外，CodeDeploy 是 **Deploy** 类别的提供程序，而不是适当的测试提供程序。[CodeDeploy 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html) 将其操作类别标识为 `Deploy`。

- **C：** 部署阶段中的两个操作都具有 `runOrder: 1`，因此测试和部署会并行运行。应用程序可能在测试成功之前就开始部署。CodeDeploy 也是部署提供程序，而不是执行单元测试的正确提供程序。

- **D：** CodeBuild 可以运行测试，但将其放在 `runOrder: 2` 的部署阶段意味着顺序为 1 的现有部署操作会先运行。因此，测试会在部署**之后**执行，违反了仅部署通过所有单元测试的代码更改这一要求。

因此，**B** 提供了所需的顺序：**构建 → 单元测试 → 部署**。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage several AWS accounts that the company's developers use. The company requires all data to be encrypted in transit. Multiple Amazon S3 buckets that were created in developer accounts allow unencrypted connections. A DevOps engineer must enforce encryption of data in transit for all existing S3 buckets that are created in accounts in the organization. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy an AWS Network Firewall firewall to each account. Route all outbound requests from the AWS environment through the firewall. Deploy a policy to block access to all outbound requests on port 80.
options.B: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy an AWS Network Firewall firewall to each account. Route all inbound requests to the AWS environment through the firewall. Deploy a policy to block access to all inbound requests on port 80.
options.C: Turn on AWS Config for the organization. Deploy a conformance pack that uses the s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only managed rule and an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook. Use a runbook that adds a bucket policy statement to deny access to an S3 bucket when the value of the aws:SecureTransport condition key is false.
options.D: Turn on AWS Config for the organization. Deploy a conformance pack that uses the s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only managed rule and an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook. Use a runbook that adds a bucket policy statement to deny access to an S3 bucket when the value of the s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id condition key is null.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs to enforce **encryption in transit** for Amazon S3 across existing buckets in multiple AWS Organizations member accounts. The solution must both:

1. Detect buckets that allow unencrypted HTTP requests.
2. Remediate those buckets centrally across the organization.

## Correct answer: C

AWS Config provides the managed rule `S3_BUCKET_SSL_REQUESTS_ONLY`, which marks an S3 bucket **NON_COMPLIANT** when its bucket policy allows HTTP requests. AWS Config organization conformance packs can deploy Config rules and remediation actions across the member accounts of an AWS organization. See [s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only.html) and [Managing organization conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-pack-organization-apis.html).

The associated Systems Manager Automation runbook, `AWSConfigRemediation-RestrictBucketSSLRequestsOnly`, creates a bucket policy statement that explicitly denies HTTP requests. See [AWSConfigRemediation-RestrictBucketSSLRequestsOnly](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-s3-deny-http.html).

Specifically, denying access when:

```json
"Bool": {
  "aws:SecureTransport": "false"
}
```

requires requests to use HTTPS/TLS. AWS documents `aws:SecureTransport` as the global condition key used to determine whether an S3 request was sent through HTTPS. See [Enforcing encryption in transit for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html).

Therefore, **C** provides organization-wide compliance detection and automated remediation for existing S3 buckets.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** Blocking outbound port 80 with AWS Network Firewall is not an S3 resource-policy enforcement mechanism and does not remediate the affected bucket policies. It also depends on requests traversing the deployed firewalls, whereas an S3 bucket policy denying `aws:SecureTransport=false` directly rejects insecure requests regardless of the caller's network path.

- **B — Incorrect.** Blocking inbound port 80 is directionally inappropriate for controlling requests made to Amazon S3 and, like option A, does not update or remediate the S3 bucket policies. Direct S3 policy enforcement is the appropriate control.

- **D — Incorrect.** `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` concerns **server-side encryption at rest**. A policy that tests whether this request header is null can deny object uploads that do not request SSE-KMS; it does not determine whether the connection uses HTTPS/TLS. See [Requiring server-side encryption with SSE-KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html).

Thus, the required answer is **C**.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织来管理该公司开发人员使用的多个 AWS 账户。该公司要求所有数据在传输过程中均须加密。在开发人员账户中创建的多个 Amazon S3 存储桶允许未加密的连接。DevOps 工程师必须对组织中账户内创建的所有现有 S3 存储桶强制实施传输中数据加密。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 将 AWS Network Firewall 防火墙部署到每个账户。将来自 AWS 环境的所有出站请求通过该防火墙路由。部署一项策略以阻止对端口 80 的所有出站请求的访问。
options.B: 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 将 AWS Network Firewall 防火墙部署到每个账户。将所有进入 AWS 环境的入站请求通过该防火墙路由。部署一项策略以阻止对端口 80 的所有入站请求的访问。
options.C: 为组织启用 AWS Config。部署一个使用 s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only 托管规则和 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册的合规性包。使用一个运行手册，该运行手册会添加一条存储桶策略语句：当 aws:SecureTransport 条件键的值为 false 时，拒绝对 S3 存储桶的访问。
options.D: 为组织启用 AWS Config。部署一个使用 s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only 托管规则和 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册的合规性包。使用一个运行手册，该运行手册会添加一条存储桶策略语句：当 s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id 条件键的值为 null 时，拒绝对 S3 存储桶的访问。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要对多个 AWS Organizations 成员账户中现有 Amazon S3 存储桶强制实施**传输中加密**。该解决方案必须同时：

1. 检测允许未加密 HTTP 请求的存储桶。
2. 在整个组织中集中修复这些存储桶。

## 正确答案：C

AWS Config 提供托管规则 `S3_BUCKET_SSL_REQUESTS_ONLY`；当某个 S3 存储桶的存储桶策略允许 HTTP 请求时，该规则会将该存储桶标记为 **NON_COMPLIANT**。AWS Config 组织合规性包可以在 AWS 组织的成员账户中部署 Config 规则和修复操作。请参阅 [s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only.html) 和 [Managing organization conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-pack-organization-apis.html)。

关联的 Systems Manager Automation 运行手册 `AWSConfigRemediation-RestrictBucketSSLRequestsOnly` 会创建一条明确拒绝 HTTP 请求的存储桶策略语句。请参阅 [AWSConfigRemediation-RestrictBucketSSLRequestsOnly](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-s3-deny-http.html)。

具体而言，当拒绝以下条件的访问时：

```json
"Bool": {
  "aws:SecureTransport": "false"
}
```

即要求请求使用 HTTPS/TLS。AWS 将 `aws:SecureTransport` 记录为一个全局条件键，用于确定 S3 请求是否通过 HTTPS 发送。请参阅 [Enforcing encryption in transit for Amazon S3](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingEncryptionInTransit.html)。

因此，**C** 可为现有 S3 存储桶提供组织范围的合规性检测和自动修复。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A — 错误。** 使用 AWS Network Firewall 阻止出站端口 80 并不是 S3 资源策略强制实施机制，也不会修复受影响的存储桶策略。它还依赖请求必须经过已部署的防火墙；而拒绝 `aws:SecureTransport=false` 的 S3 存储桶策略会直接拒绝不安全请求，无论调用方使用何种网络路径。

- **B — 错误。** 阻止入站端口 80 并不适合控制对 Amazon S3 发出的请求，而且与选项 A 一样，它不会更新或修复 S3 存储桶策略。直接实施 S3 策略才是适当的控制措施。

- **D — 错误。** `s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` 涉及**静态服务器端加密**。测试此请求标头是否为 null 的策略可以拒绝未请求 SSE-KMS 的对象上传；它并不能确定连接是否使用 HTTPS/TLS。请参阅 [Requiring server-side encryption with SSE-KMS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingKMSEncryption.html)。

因此，所需的答案是 **C**。

options.B: Change "Resource": "*"to "Resource": "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
options.E: Change "Action": "ec2:*"to "Action": "ec2:StopInstances"

en.explanation:
## Correct answers: B, D, and E

The Lambda function has one required capability: stop EC2 instances whose `Environment` tag is exactly `NonProduction`. A least-privilege policy must therefore constrain the **resource**, **target tag**, and **allowed action**.

### B — Restrict the resource to EC2 instance ARNs

Change:

```json
"Resource": "*"
```

to:

```json
"Resource": "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
```

This limits the permission to EC2 instance resources instead of leaving the statement applicable to all resources. AWS’s official tag-based EC2 start/stop example similarly uses an EC2 instance ARN together with the stop action and a resource-tag condition ([AWS IAM EC2 start/stop policy example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_ec2-start-stop-tags.html)). If the Region and account are known, those wildcard fields should also be replaced with specific values for even tighter scope.

### D — Require the exact `Environment=NonProduction` tag

Add:

```json
"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {
    "ec2:ResourceTag/Environment": "NonProduction"
  }
}
```

This permits the operation only when the target instance has the required tag and value. It follows AWS’s documented pattern of using `StringEquals` with an EC2 resource-tag condition to control which instances can be started or stopped ([AWS IAM EC2 start/stop policy example](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_ec2-start-stop-tags.html)).

### E — Restrict the action to `ec2:StopInstances`

Change:

```json
"Action": "ec2:*"
```

to:

```json
"Action": "ec2:StopInstances"
```

The function only needs to stop instances. Granting `ec2:*` would also authorize unrelated EC2 operations, contrary to least privilege.

The resulting policy is:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "ec2:StopInstances",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "ec2:ResourceTag/Environment": "NonProduction"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A — Does not correctly identify calls made by the Lambda function

A Lambda function makes downstream AWS API calls using credentials from its execution role ([Lambda IAM documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/security_iam_service-with-iam.html)). Consequently, the EC2 request is made through an assumed-role session; `aws:PrincipalType` is not the Lambda service-principal name `lambda.amazonaws.com`. AWS documents the possible principal properties and the distinction between role-based and service-principal request contexts ([AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html), [IAM principal key values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_variables.html)). This condition would not provide the intended restriction and could prevent the legitimate request.

### C — “Not Production” is broader than “NonProduction”

The following condition does not require the exact approved value:

```json
"StringNotEquals": {
  "ec2:ResourceTag/Environment": "Production"
}
```

It could permit instances tagged `Development`, `Test`, `Staging`, or any other value besides `Production`. Negated condition operators can also evaluate as matching when the relevant context key is absent, potentially including untagged instances. AWS documents the behavior of negated condition operators and missing context keys in its IAM condition documentation ([IAM condition operators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_condition_operators.html)). Option D is the required exact positive match.

### F — Does not express a valid recurring weekend condition

`${aws:DateTime:Friday}` and `${aws:DateTime:Monday}` are not valid IAM policy variables. IAM date operators compare `aws:CurrentTime` with specific ISO 8601 or epoch date-time values; they do not provide symbolic weekday variables for recurring weekly windows ([IAM date condition operators](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_condition_operators.html), [IAM policy variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_variables.html)).

The weekend schedule should be enforced by the mechanism that invokes the Lambda function. The execution-role policy should independently restrict what the function can do whenever it runs.

## Conclusion

**B, D, and E** implement least privilege by allowing only `ec2:StopInstances`, only against EC2 instance resources, and only when the target has the exact `Environment=NonProduction` tag.

options.B: 将 "Resource": "*" 更改为 "Resource": "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
options.E: 将 "Action": "ec2:*" 更改为 "Action": "ec2:StopInstances"

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：B、D 和 E

Lambda 函数只有一项必需能力：停止 `Environment` 标签恰好为 `NonProduction` 的 EC2 实例。因此，最小权限策略必须限制 **资源**、**目标标签** 和 **允许的操作**。

### B — 将资源限制为 EC2 实例 ARN

将：

```json
"Resource": "*"
```

更改为：

```json
"Resource": "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*"
```

这会将权限限制为 EC2 实例资源，而不是让该语句适用于所有资源。AWS 的官方基于标签的 EC2 启动/停止示例同样结合 EC2 实例 ARN、停止操作和资源标签条件（[AWS IAM EC2 启动/停止策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_ec2-start-stop-tags.html)）。如果已知 Region 和账户，也应将这些通配符字段替换为特定值，以进一步缩小范围。

### D — 要求精确的 `Environment=NonProduction` 标签

添加：

```json
"Condition": {
  "StringEquals": {
    "ec2:ResourceTag/Environment": "NonProduction"
  }
}
```

这仅在目标实例具有所需标签和值时才允许该操作。它遵循 AWS 已记录的模式，即使用带有 EC2 资源标签条件的 `StringEquals` 来控制哪些实例可被启动或停止（[AWS IAM EC2 启动/停止策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_ec2-start-stop-tags.html)）。

### E — 将操作限制为 `ec2:StopInstances`

将：

```json
"Action": "ec2:*"
```

更改为：

```json
"Action": "ec2:StopInstances"
```

该函数只需要停止实例。授予 `ec2:*` 还会授权不相关的 EC2 操作，这违背了最小权限原则。

最终策略为：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "ec2:StopInstances",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:ec2:*:*:instance/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "ec2:ResourceTag/Environment": "NonProduction"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A — 未能正确识别由 Lambda 函数发起的调用

Lambda 函数使用其执行角色的凭证发起下游 AWS API 调用（[Lambda IAM 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/security_iam_service-with-iam.html)）。因此，EC2 请求通过承担角色的会话发出；`aws:PrincipalType` 并不是 Lambda 服务主体名称 `lambda.amazonaws.com`。AWS 记录了可能的主体属性，以及基于角色和服务主体请求上下文之间的区别（[AWS 全局条件上下文键](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)、[IAM 主体键值](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_variables.html)）。此条件无法提供预期的限制，并且可能阻止合法请求。

### C — “非 Production” 的范围比 “NonProduction” 更宽泛

以下条件并不要求精确的已批准值：

```json
"StringNotEquals": {
  "ec2:ResourceTag/Environment": "Production"
}
```

它可能允许标记为 `Development`、`Test`、`Staging`，或除 `Production` 外任何其他值的实例。否定条件运算符还可能在相关上下文键缺失时判定为匹配，从而可能包含未标记的实例。AWS 在其 IAM 条件文档中说明了否定条件运算符和缺失上下文键的行为（[IAM 条件运算符](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_condition_operators.html)）。选项 D 才是所需的精确正向匹配。

### F — 未表达有效的重复周末条件

`${aws:DateTime:Friday}` 和 `${aws:DateTime:Monday}` 不是有效的 IAM 策略变量。IAM 日期运算符将 `aws:CurrentTime` 与特定的 ISO 8601 或 epoch 日期时间值进行比较；它们不提供用于重复每周时间窗口的符号化星期变量（[IAM 日期条件运算符](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_elements_condition_operators.html)、[IAM 策略变量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_variables.html)）。

应由调用 Lambda 函数的机制来强制执行周末计划。无论函数何时运行，其执行角色策略都应独立限制函数能够执行的操作。

## 结论

**B、D 和 E** 通过仅允许 `ec2:StopInstances`、仅针对 EC2 实例资源，并且仅当目标具有精确的 `Environment=NonProduction` 标签时才允许操作，从而实现最小权限。

en.question: A company is developing an application that will generate log events. The log events consist of five distinct metrics every one tenth of a second and produce a large amount of data. The company needs to configure the application to write the logs to Amazon Timestream. The company will configure a daily query against the Timestream table. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the FASTEST query performance? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use batch writes to write multiple log events in a single write operation.
options.B: Write each log event as a single write operation.
options.C: Treat each log as a single-measure record.
options.D: Treat each log as a multi-measure record.
options.E: Configure the memory store retention period to be longer than the magnetic store retention period.
options.F: Configure the memory store retention period to be shorter than the magnetic store retention period.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application produces **five correlated metrics every 0.1 second**, so the design must handle a high ingestion rate and optimize a **daily analytical query** over a relatively large time range.

## Correct answers: A, D, F

- **A. Use batch writes to write multiple log events in a single write operation.**  
  Timestream's `WriteRecords` API can send multiple data points in one request. AWS states that batching multiple data points is beneficial for **performance and cost**. This reduces per-request overhead and is the appropriate ingestion pattern for the application's large event volume. See [Batching writes with WriteRecords API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/writes.batching-writes.html).

- **D. Treat each log as a multi-measure record.**  
  The five metrics are emitted together at the same timestamp, which is the intended use case for multi-measure records. Instead of creating five rows and repeating dimensions, Timestream stores the metrics as columns in one compact row. AWS states that this compact representation causes queries to process less data, improving overall query performance; it also increases write throughput. See [Writes—single-measure and multi-measure records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/writes.html).

- **F. Configure the memory store retention period to be shorter than the magnetic store retention period.**  
  The query runs daily and therefore is an analytical query over a comparatively large amount of data. AWS explains that the memory store is optimized for small, recent, point-in-time queries, whereas the magnetic store is optimized for fast analytical queries over medium-to-large data volumes. AWS specifically gives the example of queries processing a day's worth or more of data and recommends a relatively short memory retention period while allowing more data to flow to the magnetic store. The magnetic retention must also be longer to preserve the historical data needed by recurring daily queries. See [Configuring Amazon Timestream for LiveAnalytics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/configuration.html) and [Storage architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/architecture.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. Write each log event as a single write operation.**  
  Individual requests introduce unnecessary request and network overhead at this ingestion frequency. This is the opposite of AWS's recommendation to batch multiple data points per `WriteRecords` operation.

- **C. Treat each log as a single-measure record.**  
  A single-measure record stores only one metric per row. Therefore, each event containing five simultaneous metrics would require five rows with repeated dimensions. AWS recommends single-measure records primarily when an application monitors one metric or does not emit multiple metrics at the same time. Multi-measure records are more compact and provide better query performance for correlated metrics.

- **E. Configure the memory store retention period to be longer than the magnetic store retention period.**  
  This does not fit the stated daily analytical query pattern. Keeping a large historical interval in memory is suited less to broad analytical scans than using the magnetic store, which AWS optimizes for medium-to-large-volume analytical queries. A longer magnetic retention period preserves historical data, while a shorter memory retention period handles recent writes and point-in-time access.

Therefore, the best combination is **A, D, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发一个将生成日志事件的应用程序。日志事件每 0.1 秒包含五个不同的指标，并会产生大量数据。该公司需要将应用程序配置为把日志写入 Amazon Timestream。该公司将针对 Timestream 表配置每日查询。哪种步骤组合将以最快的查询性能满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 使用批量写入，在一次写入操作中写入多个日志事件。
options.B: 将每个日志事件作为一次单独的写入操作进行写入。
options.C: 将每条日志视为单指标记录。
options.D: 将每条日志视为多指标记录。
options.E: 将内存存储保留期配置为长于磁盘存储保留期。
options.F: 将内存存储保留期配置为短于磁盘存储保留期。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该应用程序每 0.1 秒生成 **五个相关指标**，因此设计必须处理高摄取速率，并针对相对较大时间范围内的**每日分析查询**进行优化。

## 正确答案：A、D、F

- **A. 使用批量写入，在一次写入操作中写入多个日志事件。**  
  Timestream 的 `WriteRecords` API 可以在一个请求中发送多个数据点。AWS 表示，对多个数据点进行批量处理有利于提升**性能和成本效益**。这可减少每个请求的开销，并且是适用于该应用程序大量事件数据的摄取模式。请参阅 [使用 WriteRecords API 批量写入](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/writes.batching-writes.html)。

- **D. 将每条日志视为多指标记录。**  
  这五个指标会在同一时间戳一起发出，这正是多指标记录的预期使用场景。Timestream 不会创建五行并重复维度，而是将指标作为一行紧凑记录中的列进行存储。AWS 表示，这种紧凑表示形式可使查询处理更少的数据，从而提高整体查询性能；它还可以提高写入吞吐量。请参阅 [写入——单指标和多指标记录](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/writes.html)。

- **F. 将内存存储保留期配置为短于磁盘存储保留期。**  
  查询每天运行一次，因此是针对相对大量数据的分析查询。AWS 说明，内存存储针对较小规模、近期的时间点查询进行了优化，而磁盘存储针对中到大规模数据量的快速分析查询进行了优化。AWS 特别举例说明了处理一天或更长时间数据的查询，并建议使用相对较短的内存保留期，以便让更多数据流入磁盘存储。磁盘存储的保留期也必须更长，以保留重复每日查询所需的历史数据。请参阅 [配置 Amazon Timestream for LiveAnalytics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/configuration.html) 和 [存储架构](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/timestream/latest/developerguide/architecture.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **B. 将每个日志事件作为一次单独的写入操作进行写入。**  
  在这种摄取频率下，单独请求会引入不必要的请求和网络开销。这与 AWS 建议在每次 `WriteRecords` 操作中批量处理多个数据点的做法相反。

- **C. 将每条日志视为单指标记录。**  
  单指标记录每行仅存储一个指标。因此，包含五个同时发生指标的每个事件将需要五行，并重复维度。AWS 建议主要在应用程序监控一个指标或不同时发出多个指标时使用单指标记录。对于相关指标，多指标记录更紧凑，并提供更好的查询性能。

- **E. 将内存存储保留期配置为长于磁盘存储保留期。**  
  这不符合所述的每日分析查询模式。与使用 AWS 针对中到大规模数据量分析查询优化的磁盘存储相比，在内存中保留较大的历史时间范围不太适合广泛的分析扫描。较长的磁盘存储保留期可保留历史数据，而较短的内存存储保留期则可处理近期写入和时间点访问。

因此，最佳组合是 **A、D 和 F**。

en.question: A DevOps engineer has created an AWS CloudFormation template that deploys an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances run Amazon Linux. The application is deployed to the EC2 instances by using shell scripts that contain user data. The EC2 instances have an IAM instance profile that has an IAM role with the AmazonSSMManagedinstanceCore managed policy attached. The DevOps engineer has modified the user data in the CloudFormation template to install a new version of the application. The engineer has also applied the stack update. However, the application was not updated on the running EC2 instances. The engineer needs to ensure that the changes to the application are installed on the running EC2 instances. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Configure the user data content to use the Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) multipart format. Set the scripts-user parameter to always in the text/cloud-config section.
options.B: Refactor the user data commands to use the cfn-init helper script. Update the user data to install and configure the cfn-hup and cfn-init helper scripts to monitor and apply the metadata changes.
options.C: Configure an EC2 launch template for the EC2 instances. Create a new EC2 Auto Scaling group. Associate the Auto Scaling group with the EC2 launch template. Use the AutoScalingScheduledAction update policy for the Auto Scaling group.
options.D: Refactor the user data commands to use an AWS Systems Manager document (SSM document). Add an AWS CLI command in the user data to use Systems Manager Run Command to apply the SSM document to the EC2 instances.
options.E: Refactor the user data command to use an AWS Systems Manager document (SSM document). Use Systems Manager State Manager to create an association between the SSM document and the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

Changing the `UserData` property in a CloudFormation template does not, by itself, rerun the shell script on an already-running Linux instance. EC2 documentation states that Linux user-data scripts and cloud-init directives run only during the first launch boot cycle by default. The engineer therefore needs a configuration-management mechanism that can apply changes to existing instances rather than relying on launch-time initialization. See [EC2 instance user data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html).

## Correct answers: B and E

### B. Use `cfn-init` with `cfn-hup`

The application configuration can be moved into `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` metadata and applied by `cfn-init`. The `cfn-hup` daemon monitors the EC2 resource's CloudFormation metadata and invokes `cfn-init` when that metadata changes.

AWS provides an application-update walkthrough that uses exactly this pattern: `cfn-hup` detects updates to `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` metadata and calls `cfn-init` to apply the updated packages, files, commands, and services on the running EC2 instance. Without `cfn-hup`, `cfn-init` normally runs only during initial startup. See the [CloudFormation cfn-hup application update walkthrough](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/updating.stacks.walkthrough.html).

Therefore, **B provides a CloudFormation-native way to install later application versions on existing instances**.

### E. Use an SSM document with a State Manager association

The instances already have an instance profile with `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`, allowing them to operate as Systems Manager managed nodes and process associations. The application installation commands can be placed in an SSM Command document, and State Manager can associate that document with the target EC2 instances.

A State Manager association defines the SSM document, target resources, and optional schedule. By default, it runs when created. It can also run immediately when the association is updated or when the referenced `$LATEST`/`$DEFAULT` document version changes. This makes it suitable for deploying and maintaining the required application version on already-running instances. See [when State Manager associations are applied](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-about.html) and [scheduling State Manager associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-associations-creating.html).

Therefore, **E provides the Systems Manager configuration-management solution for applying the application update to running instances**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. MIME multipart user data with `scripts-user: always`

MIME multipart formatting is useful for combining multiple user-data content types, and cloud-init can be configured to execute scripts during later boots. However, this does not create a process that reacts to a CloudFormation stack update while the instance remains running. At best, the script would run during a later reboot/start after the appropriate cloud-init configuration had already been installed. It does not directly ensure that the current application change is applied to the running instances after the stack update.

### C. Launch template, new Auto Scaling group, and `AutoScalingScheduledAction`

This unnecessarily changes the architecture and selects the wrong update policy. `AutoScalingScheduledAction` controls how CloudFormation handles an Auto Scaling group's minimum, maximum, and desired capacity when scheduled scaling actions exist. It does **not** roll out a changed launch template or application version to instances. Policies such as `AutoScalingRollingUpdate`, `AutoScalingReplacingUpdate`, or `AutoScalingInstanceRefresh` are the policies associated with replacing or refreshing Auto Scaling instances. See the [CloudFormation UpdatePolicy reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-updatepolicy.html).

### D. Invoke Run Command from user data

This still places the trigger inside user data, which is the mechanism that failed in the scenario. Because the existing running instances do not rerun changed user data by default, the newly added `aws ssm send-command` command would not execute on them.

Additionally, the stated instance role has only `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`. Its policy permits the managed-node/SSM Agent operations needed to receive and report commands and associations, but it does not include `ssm:SendCommand`. Consequently, code running under that instance profile cannot initiate Run Command unless additional IAM permission is granted. See the [`AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` policy document](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore.html).

Thus, **State Manager association in E is the appropriate automated trigger**, rather than attempting to initiate Run Command from launch-time user data.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师创建了一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于在 Amazon EC2 实例上部署应用程序。这些 EC2 实例运行 Amazon Linux。该应用程序通过包含用户数据的 shell 脚本部署到 EC2 实例。EC2 实例具有一个 IAM 实例配置文件，该配置文件中的 IAM 角色附加了 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 托管策略。DevOps 工程师已修改 CloudFormation 模板中的用户数据，以安装新版本的应用程序。该工程师还已应用堆栈更新。但是，运行中的 EC2 实例上的应用程序并未更新。工程师需要确保应用程序更改安装到运行中的 EC2 实例上。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将用户数据内容配置为使用 Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) multipart 格式。在 `text/cloud-config` 部分中将 `scripts-user` 参数设置为 `always`。
options.B: 重构用户数据命令以使用 `cfn-init` 辅助脚本。更新用户数据以安装和配置 `cfn-hup` 和 `cfn-init` 辅助脚本，以监控并应用元数据更改。
options.C: 为 EC2 实例配置一个 EC2 启动模板。创建一个新的 EC2 Auto Scaling 组。将该 Auto Scaling 组与 EC2 启动模板关联。对 Auto Scaling 组使用 `AutoScalingScheduledAction` 更新策略。
options.D: 重构用户数据命令以使用 AWS Systems Manager 文档（SSM 文档）。在用户数据中添加 AWS CLI 命令，以使用 Systems Manager Run Command 将 SSM 文档应用到 EC2 实例。
options.E: 重构用户数据命令以使用 AWS Systems Manager 文档（SSM 文档）。使用 Systems Manager State Manager 在 SSM 文档和 EC2 实例之间创建关联。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查的内容

仅更改 CloudFormation 模板中的 `UserData` 属性，并不会让已在运行的 Linux 实例重新执行 shell 脚本。EC2 文档指出，默认情况下，Linux 用户数据脚本和 cloud-init 指令仅在首次启动的引导周期中运行。因此，工程师需要一种能够将更改应用到现有实例的配置管理机制，而不能依赖仅在启动时执行的初始化机制。请参阅 [EC2 实例用户数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/user-data.html)。

## 正确答案：B 和 E

### B. 将 `cfn-init` 与 `cfn-hup` 配合使用

可以将应用程序配置移至 `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` 元数据中，并由 `cfn-init` 应用。`cfn-hup` 守护进程会监控 EC2 资源的 CloudFormation 元数据，并在该元数据发生变化时调用 `cfn-init`。

AWS 提供了一个应用程序更新演练，恰好使用了这种模式：`cfn-hup` 检测 `AWS::CloudFormation::Init` 元数据的更新，并调用 `cfn-init`，以便在运行中的 EC2 实例上应用更新后的软件包、文件、命令和服务。如果没有 `cfn-hup`，`cfn-init` 通常只会在初始启动期间运行。请参阅 [CloudFormation cfn-hup 应用程序更新演练](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/updating.stacks.walkthrough.html)。

因此，**B 提供了一种 CloudFormation 原生方式，用于在现有实例上安装后续版本的应用程序**。

### E. 使用带有 State Manager 关联的 SSM 文档

这些实例已具有附加 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 的实例配置文件，因此能够作为 Systems Manager 托管节点运行并处理关联。应用程序安装命令可以置于 SSM Command 文档中，State Manager 可以将该文档与目标 EC2 实例关联。

State Manager 关联定义了 SSM 文档、目标资源和可选计划。默认情况下，它会在创建时运行。当关联更新或引用的 `$LATEST`/`$DEFAULT` 文档版本发生变化时，它也可以立即运行。因此，它适合在已经运行的实例上部署和维护所需版本的应用程序。请参阅 [State Manager 关联何时应用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-about.html) 和 [计划 State Manager 关联](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-associations-creating.html)。

因此，**E 提供了 Systems Manager 配置管理解决方案，用于将应用程序更新应用到运行中的实例**。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 使用 `scripts-user: always` 的 MIME multipart 用户数据

MIME multipart 格式适合组合多种用户数据内容类型，并且 cloud-init 可以配置为在后续引导期间执行脚本。但是，这不会创建一个能够在实例保持运行时响应 CloudFormation 堆栈更新的流程。最多只能在已安装适当 cloud-init 配置后的下一次重启或启动期间执行脚本。它不能直接确保在堆栈更新后将当前应用程序更改应用到运行中的实例。

### C. 启动模板、新 Auto Scaling 组和 `AutoScalingScheduledAction`

此选项不必要地改变了架构，并且选择了错误的更新策略。`AutoScalingScheduledAction` 控制当存在计划扩缩操作时，CloudFormation 如何处理 Auto Scaling 组的最小容量、最大容量和所需容量。它**不会**将已更改的启动模板或应用程序版本部署到实例。`AutoScalingRollingUpdate`、`AutoScalingReplacingUpdate` 或 `AutoScalingInstanceRefresh` 等策略才与替换或刷新 Auto Scaling 实例相关。请参阅 [CloudFormation UpdatePolicy 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/TemplateReference/aws-attribute-updatepolicy.html)。

### D. 从用户数据调用 Run Command

此选项仍然将触发器放在用户数据中，而用户数据正是此场景中失效的机制。由于现有的运行中实例默认不会重新执行已更改的用户数据，新添加的 `aws ssm send-command` 命令不会在这些实例上执行。

此外，题述实例角色仅具有 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore`。该策略允许托管节点/SSM Agent 接收和报告命令及关联所需的操作，但不包括 `ssm:SendCommand`。因此，除非授予额外 IAM 权限，否则在该实例配置文件下运行的代码无法发起 Run Command。请参阅 [`AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 策略文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-managed-policy/latest/reference/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore.html)。

因此，**E 中的 State Manager 关联才是适当的自动化触发器**，而不是尝试从启动时用户数据发起 Run Command。

en.question: A company is refactoring applications to use AWS. The company identifies an internal web application that needs to make Amazon S3 API calls in a specific AWS account. The company wants to use its existing identity provider (IdP) auth.company.com for authentication. The IdP supports only OpenID Connect (OIDC). A DevOps engineer needs to secure the web application's access to the AWS account. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Configure AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). Configure an IdP. Upload the IdP metadata from the existing IdP.
options.B: Create an IAM IdP by using the provider URL, audience, and signature from the existing IP.
options.C: Create an IAM role that has a policy that allows the necessary S3 actions. Configure the role's trust policy to allow the OIDC IP to assume the role if the sts.amazon.com:aud context key is appid_from_idp.
options.D: Create an IAM role that has a policy that allows the necessary S3 actions. Configure the role's trust policy to allow the OIDC IP to assume the role if the auth.company.com:aud context key is appid_from_idp.
options.E: Configure the web application to use the AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity API operation to retrieve temporary credentials. Use the temporary credentials to make the S3 API calls.
options.F: Configure the web application to use the GetFederationToken API operation to retrieve temporary credentials. Use the temporary credentials to make the S3 API calls.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The application must authenticate users through the company's existing **OIDC-only** identity provider and then obtain AWS credentials that permit only the required Amazon S3 API operations. The standard direct-federation design is:

1. Register the external OIDC provider in IAM.
2. Create an IAM role whose permissions policy grants the required S3 access and whose trust policy trusts that OIDC provider for the application's audience.
3. Exchange the OIDC token for temporary role credentials by calling AWS STS `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`.

## Correct answers: B, D, and E

### B. Create an IAM OIDC identity provider

IAM must know and trust the external OIDC issuer before a role can be assumed using a token from that issuer. An IAM OIDC provider is configured with the provider URL and the application's client ID/audience; AWS validates the provider's signing keys and HTTPS certificate, using configured certificate thumbprints as a fallback when necessary. The option's reference to the provider's “signature” is imprecise, but it describes the required IAM OIDC provider registration step. See [Create an IAM OIDC identity provider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_create_oidc.html).

### D. Create an S3-access role and trust the OIDC provider using `auth.company.com:aud`

The role needs two distinct policy elements:

- A permissions policy allowing only the required S3 actions and resources.
- A trust policy allowing the registered OIDC provider to perform `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`.

For a manually configured OIDC provider, AWS documents that the audience condition key is formed from the OIDC provider's fully qualified issuer URL plus `:aud`. AWS gives the example `server.example.com:aud`; therefore, for this provider, `auth.company.com:aud` is the appropriate key. Comparing it to `appid_from_idp` restricts role assumption to tokens issued for this particular application. See [Create a role for OpenID Connect federation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_create_for-idp_oidc.html).

### E. Call `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` and use the returned credentials for S3

`AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` accepts an OIDC-compliant web identity token from a known IdP and returns temporary role credentials. Those credentials—access key ID, secret access key, and session token—can then sign the application's S3 API requests. The call itself does not require preexisting AWS credentials, which avoids embedding long-term AWS keys in the web application. See the [`AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` API documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Configure IAM Identity Center and upload IdP metadata

IAM Identity Center's external identity-provider federation uses **SAML 2.0 for authentication** and SCIM for provisioning. The company's IdP supports only OIDC, so the proposed SAML metadata integration does not satisfy the requirement. Direct IAM OIDC federation is the applicable solution. See [Using SAML and SCIM identity federation with external identity providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/other-idps.html).

### C. Use `sts.amazon.com:aud` in the trust policy

The audience condition key must be namespaced to the actual OIDC provider/issuer, such as `auth.company.com:aud`, not to an STS hostname. Consequently, `sts.amazon.com:aud` would not evaluate the `aud` claim from this provider correctly. Some specific providers and integrations use particular audience **values** such as `sts.amazonaws.com`, but that does not change the condition-key namespace to `sts.amazon.com`.

### F. Call `GetFederationToken`

`GetFederationToken` is not the OIDC token-exchange operation. It must be called with long-term credentials belonging to an IAM user (or, though discouraged, the root user) and is generally used by a custom server-side identity broker. AWS specifically recommends `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` or Amazon Cognito for browser/mobile applications authenticated by an OIDC-compatible provider. See the [`GetFederationToken` API documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_GetFederationToken.html) and [AWS STS credential comparison](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_sts-comparison.html).

zh.question: 一家公司正在重构应用程序以使用 AWS。该公司确定了一个内部 Web 应用程序，该应用程序需要在特定 AWS 账户中发出 Amazon S3 API 调用。该公司希望使用其现有的身份提供商 (IdP) auth.company.com 进行身份验证。该 IdP 仅支持 OpenID Connect (OIDC)。一名 DevOps 工程师需要保护该 Web 应用程序对 AWS 账户的访问。以下哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（请选择三项。）

options.A: 配置 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。配置一个 IdP。上传现有 IdP 中的 IdP 元数据。
options.B: 使用现有 IdP 的提供商 URL、受众和签名创建一个 IAM IdP。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM 角色，并附加允许必要 S3 操作的策略。配置该角色的信任策略，以便当 sts.amazon.com:aud 上下文键为 appid_from_idp 时允许 OIDC IdP 代入该角色。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 角色，并附加允许必要 S3 操作的策略。配置该角色的信任策略，以便当 auth.company.com:aud 上下文键为 appid_from_idp 时允许 OIDC IdP 代入该角色。
options.E: 配置 Web 应用程序使用 AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity API 操作来获取临时凭证。使用这些临时凭证发出 S3 API 调用。
options.F: 配置 Web 应用程序使用 GetFederationToken API 操作来获取临时凭证。使用这些临时凭证发出 S3 API 调用。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该应用程序必须通过公司现有的、**仅支持 OIDC** 的身份提供商对用户进行身份验证，然后获取仅允许所需 Amazon S3 API 操作的 AWS 凭证。标准的直接联合身份验证设计如下：

1. 在 IAM 中注册外部 OIDC 提供商。
2. 创建一个 IAM 角色，其权限策略授予所需的 S3 访问权限，且其信任策略信任该 OIDC 提供商所对应的应用程序受众。
3. 通过调用 AWS STS `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`，将 OIDC 令牌交换为临时角色凭证。

## 正确答案：B、D 和 E

### B. 创建 IAM OIDC 身份提供商

在能够使用来自该外部 OIDC 颁发者的令牌代入角色之前，IAM 必须识别并信任该颁发者。IAM OIDC 提供商需使用提供商 URL 和应用程序的客户端 ID/受众进行配置；AWS 会验证该提供商的签名密钥和 HTTPS 证书，并在必要时使用配置的证书指纹作为备用方案。选项中提到提供商的“签名”并不精确，但它描述了所需的 IAM OIDC 提供商注册步骤。请参阅 [创建 IAM OIDC 身份提供商](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_create_oidc.html)。

### D. 创建具有 S3 访问权限的角色，并使用 `auth.company.com:aud` 信任 OIDC 提供商

该角色需要两个不同的策略元素：

- 一个仅允许所需 S3 操作和资源的权限策略。
- 一个允许已注册 OIDC 提供商执行 `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` 的信任策略。

对于手动配置的 OIDC 提供商，AWS 文档说明受众条件键由 OIDC 提供商的完全限定颁发者 URL 加上 `:aud` 组成。AWS 提供的示例为 `server.example.com:aud`；因此，对于该提供商，`auth.company.com:aud` 是适当的键。将其与 `appid_from_idp` 比较，会将角色代入限制为仅使用为此特定应用程序签发的令牌。请参阅 [为 OpenID Connect 联合身份验证创建角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_create_for-idp_oidc.html)。

### E. 调用 `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`，并使用返回的凭证访问 S3

`AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` 接受来自已知 IdP 的、符合 OIDC 标准的 Web 身份令牌，并返回临时角色凭证。随后，这些凭证（访问密钥 ID、秘密访问密钥和会话令牌）可用于对应用程序的 S3 API 请求进行签名。该调用本身不需要预先存在的 AWS 凭证，从而避免在 Web 应用程序中嵌入长期 AWS 密钥。请参阅 [`AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` API 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 配置 IAM Identity Center 并上传 IdP 元数据

IAM Identity Center 与外部身份提供商的联合身份验证使用 **SAML 2.0 进行身份验证**，并使用 SCIM 进行预置。公司的 IdP 仅支持 OIDC，因此所提议的 SAML 元数据集成无法满足要求。应使用直接 IAM OIDC 联合身份验证。请参阅 [使用 SAML 和 SCIM 与外部身份提供商进行身份联合](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/other-idps.html)。

### C. 在信任策略中使用 `sts.amazon.com:aud`

受众条件键必须使用实际 OIDC 提供商/颁发者作为命名空间，例如 `auth.company.com:aud`，而不是 STS 主机名。因此，`sts.amazon.com:aud` 无法正确评估此提供商的 `aud` 声明。一些特定提供商和集成会使用诸如 `sts.amazonaws.com` 的特定受众**值**，但这不会将条件键命名空间更改为 `sts.amazon.com`。

### F. 调用 `GetFederationToken`

`GetFederationToken` 不是 OIDC 令牌交换操作。必须使用属于 IAM 用户的长期凭证（或者不建议使用的根用户凭证）调用它，通常用于自定义服务器端身份代理。对于由兼容 OIDC 的提供商进行身份验证的浏览器/移动应用程序，AWS 明确建议使用 `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` 或 Amazon Cognito。请参阅 [`GetFederationToken` API 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/STS/latest/APIReference/API_GetFederationToken.html) 和 [AWS STS 凭证比较](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_sts-comparison.html)。
