- Supports both configuration-change and periodic triggers.

These behaviors are documented in the [`cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check` managed rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check.html).

AWS Config emits **Config Rules Compliance Change** events. EventBridge rules can filter these events by rule name, resource type, and resource ID, allowing the engineer to select the managed rule and the specific CloudFormation stack, then send the event to SNS ([Monitoring AWS Config with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/monitor-config-with-cloudwatchevents.html)). Thus, notification is event-driven as soon as AWS Config determines that the selected stack is noncompliant. The original drift-detection Lambda can become redundant after this solution is implemented.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

Adding SNS as another target of the **scheduled** EventBridge rule causes SNS to receive the hourly schedule event. Scheduled-rule targets receive the event that matches the schedule; they do not automatically receive the output or eventual result of another target's Lambda invocation ([Creating a scheduled EventBridge rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-create-rule-schedule.html)).

Consequently, SNS would be invoked hourly regardless of whether drift was detected. An SNS filter policy only controls which published messages are delivered to a particular subscription; it cannot add CloudFormation drift results that are absent from the scheduled event ([SNS subscription filter policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-subscription-filter-policies.html)). Also, filter policies are associated with subscriptions, not directly with the topic as stated.

### B. Incorrect

CloudFormation drift status can be queried, but adding the second Lambda as another target of the same hourly scheduled rule makes the two Lambda invocations independent and effectively simultaneous. The querying Lambda could run before the first Lambda has started the operation or while the operation is still `DETECTION_IN_PROGRESS`. The option does not provide orchestration, retries, polling, or a later trigger after completion.

Therefore, it does not reliably notify when the asynchronous operation finishes and, in any event, it can run only on the hourly schedule rather than reacting to a compliance-state change. CloudFormation documents that drift detection has distinct in-progress and completed states ([CloudFormation drift status codes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)).

### C. Incorrect

Amazon GuardDuty produces security findings for potential threats and suspicious activity; it is not a CloudFormation configuration-drift detection service. Its findings can be processed with EventBridge, but there is no GuardDuty feature that performs drift detection for CloudFormation stacks ([Managing GuardDuty findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/findings_management.html)).

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师开发了一个 AWS Lambda 函数。该 Lambda 函数会对特定 CloudFormation 堆栈中的所有受支持资源启动 AWS CloudFormation 漂移检测操作。随后，该 Lambda 函数会退出本次调用。DevOps 工程师创建了一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，每小时调用一次该 Lambda 函数。AWS 账户中已存在一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。DevOps 工程师已订阅该 SNS 主题以接收通知。当在此特定堆栈配置中检测到漂移时，DevOps 工程师需要尽快收到通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将现有 EventBridge 规则也配置为以 SNS 主题为目标。配置 SNS 订阅筛选策略以匹配 CloudFormation 堆栈。将该订阅筛选策略附加到 SNS 主题。
options.B: 创建第二个 Lambda 函数，以查询 CloudFormation API 获取该堆栈的漂移检测结果。如果检测到漂移，则将第二个 Lambda 函数配置为向 SNS 主题发布消息。调整现有 EventBridge 规则，使其也以第二个 Lambda 函数为目标。
options.C: 在账户中配置 Amazon GuardDuty，以对所有 CloudFormation 堆栈执行漂移检测。创建第二个 EventBridge 规则，以响应特定 CloudFormation 堆栈的 GuardDuty 漂移检测事件发现。将 SNS 主题配置为第二个 EventBridge 规则的目标。
options.D: 在账户中配置 AWS Config。使用 `cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check` 托管规则。创建第二个 EventBridge 规则，以响应 CloudFormation 堆栈的合规性变更事件。将 SNS 主题配置为第二个 EventBridge 规则的目标。

zh.explanation:
## 题目问什么

初始 Lambda 函数仅会**启动**堆栈漂移检测，随后退出。CloudFormation 漂移检测是异步的：该操作可能会保持在 `DETECTION_IN_PROGRESS`，随后最终变为 `DETECTION_COMPLETE`，此时堆栈状态可能为 `DRIFTED` 或 `IN_SYNC`（[CloudFormation 漂移状态代码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)）。因此，要求是在所选堆栈被确定发生漂移时生成 SNS 通知，而不只是当每小时检测作业启动时通知。

## 正确答案：D

使用 `cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check` 托管规则配置 AWS Config，并使用第二个 EventBridge 规则将相关合规性变更路由到现有 SNS 主题。

AWS Config 托管规则：

- 评估 `AWS::CloudFormation::Stack` 资源。
- 执行 `DetectStackDrift`。
- 当堆栈为 `IN_SYNC` 时，将规则和堆栈报告为 `COMPLIANT`；当堆栈为 `DRIFTED` 时，将其报告为 `NON_COMPLIANT`。
- 同时支持配置变更触发器和定期触发器。

这些行为记录在 [`cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check` 托管规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudformation-stack-drift-detection-check.html)中。

AWS Config 会发出 **Config Rules Compliance Change** 事件。EventBridge 规则可以按规则名称、资源类型和资源 ID 筛选这些事件，从而让工程师选择该托管规则和特定 CloudFormation 堆栈，然后将事件发送到 SNS（[使用 EventBridge 监控 AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/monitor-config-with-cloudwatchevents.html)）。因此，一旦 AWS Config 确定所选堆栈不合规，便会以事件驱动方式发送通知。实施此解决方案后，原始的漂移检测 Lambda 可能变得多余。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 不正确

将 SNS 添加为**计划** EventBridge 规则的另一个目标，会使 SNS 接收每小时计划事件。计划规则的目标会接收与计划匹配的事件；它们不会自动接收另一个目标 Lambda 调用的输出或最终结果（[创建计划 EventBridge 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-create-rule-schedule.html)）。

因此，无论是否检测到漂移，SNS 都会每小时被调用。SNS 筛选策略仅控制将哪些已发布消息传送到特定订阅；它无法添加计划事件中不存在的 CloudFormation 漂移结果（[SNS 订阅筛选策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-subscription-filter-policies.html)）。此外，如选项所述，筛选策略与订阅关联，而不是直接与主题关联。

### B. 不正确

虽然可以查询 CloudFormation 漂移状态，但将第二个 Lambda 作为同一每小时计划规则的另一个目标，会使两个 Lambda 调用彼此独立且实际上同时执行。查询 Lambda 可能在第一个 Lambda 启动操作之前运行，也可能在操作仍处于 `DETECTION_IN_PROGRESS` 时运行。该选项未提供编排、重试、轮询或在完成后触发的机制。

因此，它无法可靠地在异步操作完成时发送通知；无论如何，它只能按每小时计划运行，而不能响应合规状态变更。CloudFormation 文档说明，漂移检测具有不同的进行中和已完成状态（[CloudFormation 漂移状态代码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)）。

### C. 不正确

Amazon GuardDuty 会针对潜在威胁和可疑活动生成安全发现；它不是 CloudFormation 配置漂移检测服务。其发现可以使用 EventBridge 处理，但 GuardDuty 没有对 CloudFormation 堆栈执行漂移检测的功能（[管理 GuardDuty 发现](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/findings_management.html)）。

en.question: A company has deployed a complex container-based workload on AWS. The workload uses Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus for monitoring. The workload runs in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster in an AWS account. The company’s DevOps team wants to receive workload alerts by using the company’s Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. The SNS topic is in the same AWS account as the EKS cluster. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use the Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus remote write URL to send alerts to the SNS topic
options.B: Create an alerting rule that checks the availability of each of the workload’s containers.
options.C: Create an alert manager configuration for the SNS topic.
options.D: Modify the access policy of the SNS topic. Grant the aps.amazonaws.com service principal the sns:Publish permission and the sns:GetTopicAttributes permission for the SNS topic.
options.E: Modify the IAM role that Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus uses. Grant the role the sns:Publish permission and the sns:GetTopicAttributes permission for the SNS topic.
options.F: Create an OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for the EKS cluster. Create a cluster service account. Grant the account the sns:Publish permission and the sns:GetTopicAttributes permission by using an IAM role.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The required alerting path is:

**EKS workload metrics → Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus alerting rule → Alertmanager → Amazon SNS topic**

Therefore, the company must define when an alert should fire, configure Amazon SNS as the Alertmanager receiver, and authorize the managed Prometheus service to publish to the topic.

## Correct answers: B, C, and D

### B. Create an alerting rule that checks the availability of each workload container

Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus alerting rules define alert conditions by using PromQL and thresholds. When an alerting rule triggers, the alert is sent to Alertmanager, which can forward it to Amazon SNS. A container-availability rule provides the condition that initiates the alerting workflow. See [Using rules to modify or monitor metrics as they are received](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-Ruler.html).

### C. Create an alert manager configuration for the SNS topic

The SNS topic must be configured as an Alertmanager receiver. The configuration includes an `sns_configs` block with the topic ARN and SigV4 Region. Alertmanager then forwards matching alerts to that receiver. See [Configure alert manager to send messages to your Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-receiver-config.html).

### D. Modify the SNS topic access policy to grant `aps.amazonaws.com` `sns:Publish` and `sns:GetTopicAttributes`

AWS explicitly requires a resource-based access policy on the SNS topic that authorizes the Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus service principal, `aps.amazonaws.com`, to perform `sns:Publish` and `sns:GetTopicAttributes`. AWS also recommends restricting the policy with `aws:SourceArn` for the Prometheus workspace and `aws:SourceAccount`. See [Giving Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus permission to send alert messages to your Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-receiver-AMPpermission.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Use the remote write URL to send alerts to the SNS topic

The remote write endpoint is for **ingesting metric samples into** an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace. It does not send alerts to SNS. Alert delivery is performed by Alertmanager after an alerting rule fires. See [RemoteWrite](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-APIReference-RemoteWrite.html).

### E. Modify an IAM role that Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus uses

For this managed Alertmanager-to-SNS integration, AWS documents granting permission through the **SNS topic's resource-based access policy** to the `aps.amazonaws.com` service principal. IAM permissions for working with Alertmanager are assigned to users, groups, or roles that administer Alertmanager; they are not a replacement for the SNS topic policy required for managed-service publishing. See [Understanding IAM permissions needed for working with alert manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-IAM-permissions.html) and the [SNS topic permission procedure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-receiver-AMPpermission.html).

### F. Create an EKS OIDC provider and IAM role for a Kubernetes service account

IAM roles for service accounts are relevant when a pod running in EKS must call AWS APIs directly. In this scenario, the pod or Kubernetes service account does not publish the alert. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus Alertmanager publishes it, so the required authorization is the SNS resource policy for the `aps.amazonaws.com` service principal. Creating an OIDC provider and service account does not establish the required Alertmanager receiver or SNS authorization.

**Answer: B, C, D**

zh.question: 一家公司已在 AWS 上部署了一个复杂的基于容器的工作负载。该工作负载使用 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 进行监控。该工作负载运行在某个 AWS 账户中的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群内。公司的 DevOps 团队希望通过公司的 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题接收工作负载警报。该 SNS 主题与 EKS 集群位于同一 AWS 账户中。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus remote write URL 将警报发送到 SNS 主题
options.B: 创建一条警报规则，用于检查工作负载中每个容器的可用性。
options.C: 为 SNS 主题创建 alert manager 配置。
options.D: 修改 SNS 主题的访问策略。向 `aps.amazonaws.com` 服务主体授予该 SNS 主题的 `sns:Publish` 和 `sns:GetTopicAttributes` 权限。
options.E: 修改 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 使用的 IAM 角色。向该角色授予 SNS 主题的 `sns:Publish` 和 `sns:GetTopicAttributes` 权限。
options.F: 为 EKS 集群创建 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 提供商。创建集群服务账户。使用 IAM 角色向该账户授予 `sns:Publish` 和 `sns:GetTopicAttributes` 权限。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

所需的警报路径如下：

**EKS 工作负载指标 → Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 警报规则 → Alertmanager → Amazon SNS 主题**

因此，公司必须定义何时触发警报，将 Amazon SNS 配置为 Alertmanager 接收方，并授权托管 Prometheus 服务向该主题发布消息。

## 正确答案：B、C 和 D

### B. 创建一条警报规则，用于检查每个工作负载容器的可用性

Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 警报规则使用 PromQL 和阈值定义警报条件。当警报规则被触发时，警报将发送到 Alertmanager，后者可以将其转发至 Amazon SNS。容器可用性规则提供了启动警报工作流的条件。请参阅 [使用规则在接收指标时修改或监控指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-Ruler.html)。

### C. 为 SNS 主题创建 alert manager 配置

必须将 SNS 主题配置为 Alertmanager 接收方。该配置包括含有主题 ARN 和 SigV4 Region 的 `sns_configs` 块。随后，Alertmanager 会将匹配的警报转发给该接收方。请参阅 [配置 alert manager 以向 Amazon SNS 主题发送消息](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-receiver-config.html)。

### D. 修改 SNS 主题访问策略，以向 `aps.amazonaws.com` 授予 `sns:Publish` 和 `sns:GetTopicAttributes`

AWS 明确要求在 SNS 主题上设置基于资源的访问策略，以授权 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 服务主体 `aps.amazonaws.com` 执行 `sns:Publish` 和 `sns:GetTopicAttributes`。AWS 还建议使用 Prometheus workspace 的 `aws:SourceArn` 和 `aws:SourceAccount` 来限制该策略。请参阅 [授予 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 向 Amazon SNS 主题发送警报消息的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-receiver-AMPpermission.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 使用 remote write URL 将警报发送到 SNS 主题

remote write 端点用于将指标样本**提取并写入** Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace。它不会向 SNS 发送警报。警报规则触发后，由 Alertmanager 执行警报传递。请参阅 [RemoteWrite](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-APIReference-RemoteWrite.html)。

### E. 修改 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 使用的 IAM 角色

对于此托管的 Alertmanager 到 SNS 集成，AWS 文档说明应通过 SNS 主题的**基于资源的访问策略**，向 `aps.amazonaws.com` 服务主体授予权限。用于操作 Alertmanager 的 IAM 权限会分配给管理 Alertmanager 的用户、组或角色；它们不能替代托管服务发布消息所必需的 SNS 主题策略。请参阅 [了解使用 alert manager 所需的 IAM 权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-IAM-permissions.html) 和 [SNS 主题权限流程](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prometheus/latest/userguide/AMP-alertmanager-receiver-AMPpermission.html)。

### F. 为 Kubernetes 服务账户创建 EKS OIDC 提供商和 IAM 角色

当运行于 EKS 中的 pod 必须直接调用 AWS API 时，IAM roles for service accounts 才相关。在此场景中，并非 pod 或 Kubernetes 服务账户发布警报，而是 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus Alertmanager 发布警报。因此，所需的授权是针对 `aps.amazonaws.com` 服务主体的 SNS 资源策略。创建 OIDC 提供商和服务账户既不会建立所需的 Alertmanager 接收方，也不会建立 SNS 授权。

**答案：B、C、D**

en.question: A company's organization in AWS Organizations has a single OU. The company runs Amazon EC2 instances in the OU accounts. The company needs to limit the use of each EC2 instance’s credentials to the specific EC2 instance that the credential is assigned to. A DevOps engineer must configure security for the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an SCP that specifies the VPC CIDR block. Configure the SCP to check whether the value of the aws:VpcSourcelp condition key is in the specified block. In the same SCP check, check whether the values of the aws:EC2InstanceSourcePrivatelPv4 and aws:SourceVpc condition keys are the same. Deny access if either condition is false. Apply the SCP to the OU.
options.B: Create an SCP that checks whether the values of the aws:EC2InstanceSourceVPC and aws:SourceVpc condition keys are the same. Deny access if the values are not the same. In the same SCP check, check whether the values of the aws:EC2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4 and aws:VpcSourceIp condition keys are the same. Deny access if the values are not the same. Apply the SCP to the OU.
options.C: Create an SCP that includes a list of acceptable VPC values and checks whether the value of the aws:SourceVpc condition key is in the list. In the same SCP check, define a list of acceptable IP address values and check whether the value of the aws:VpcSourceIp condition key is in the list. Deny access if either condition is false. Apply the SCP to each account in the organization.
options.D: Create an SCP that checks whether the values of the aws:EC2InstanceSourceVPC and aws:VpcSourceIp condition keys are the same. Deny access if the values are not the same. In the same SCP check, check whether the values of the aws:EC2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4 and aws:SourceVpc condition keys are the same. Deny access if the values are not the same. Apply the SCP to each account in the organization.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company wants EC2 instance-profile credentials to be usable only from the EC2 instance to which AWS delivered those credentials. Because all relevant accounts are in one OU, an SCP attached to that OU can enforce the restriction across those accounts.

## Correct answer: B

AWS provides two complementary pairs of request-context keys for this purpose:

- `aws:Ec2InstanceSourceVpc` identifies the VPC to which the EC2 IAM role credentials were delivered. It should be compared with `aws:SourceVpc`, which identifies the VPC through which the current request arrived.
- `aws:Ec2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4` identifies the primary private IPv4 address to which the credentials were delivered. It should be compared with `aws:VpcSourceIp`, which identifies the private source IP of the current request through a VPC endpoint.

Therefore, denying requests when either of these comparisons does not match binds the credentials to the originating VPC and specific instance private IP. AWS documentation provides an SCP example containing exactly these comparisons and notes that the VPC ID must accompany the private IPv4 comparison because private IP addresses are not globally unique. See [AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html).

Attaching the SCP to the single OU causes it to affect all accounts beneath that OU, which is the efficient organization-wide placement for this scenario. AWS confirms that an SCP attached to an OU affects all accounts under that OU. See [Attach policies with AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A:** The comparison pairs are incorrect. `aws:Ec2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4` is an IP address, whereas `aws:SourceVpc` is a VPC ID, so comparing them cannot establish the required relationship. A fixed VPC CIDR allowlist also restricts credentials to a network range rather than dynamically binding each credential to the individual instance that received it.

- **C:** Static lists of acceptable VPC IDs and IP addresses implement a network allowlist. They do not compare the current request's source with the VPC and private IP embedded in each EC2 role session, so credentials copied from one allowed instance could potentially be used from another allowed location. Also, attaching the same SCP separately to every account is unnecessary when one OU contains all the accounts. However, attaching SCPs directly to accounts is technically supported; that is not the fundamental error in this option.

- **D:** It compares unlike values: `aws:Ec2InstanceSourceVpc` is a VPC ID but `aws:VpcSourceIp` is an IP address, while `aws:Ec2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4` is an IP address but `aws:SourceVpc` is a VPC ID. The correct pairings are VPC-to-VPC and private-IP-to-private-IP. Direct account attachment is supported, but it is less efficient than attaching once to the OU and does not fix the invalid comparisons.

zh.question: 某公司在 AWS Organizations 中的组织只有一个 OU。该公司在 OU 内的账户中运行 Amazon EC2 实例。公司需要将每个 EC2 实例凭证的使用限制为仅能由分配了该凭证的特定 EC2 实例使用。DevOps 工程师必须为这些 EC2 实例配置安全性。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个指定 VPC CIDR 块的 SCP。将 SCP 配置为检查 aws:VpcSourcelp 条件键的值是否位于指定块中。在同一个 SCP 检查中，检查 aws:EC2InstanceSourcePrivatelPv4 和 aws:SourceVpc 条件键的值是否相同。如果任一条件为 false，则拒绝访问。将 SCP 应用于 OU。
options.B: 创建一个 SCP，检查 aws:EC2InstanceSourceVPC 和 aws:SourceVpc 条件键的值是否相同。如果值不相同，则拒绝访问。在同一个 SCP 检查中，检查 aws:EC2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4 和 aws:VpcSourceIp 条件键的值是否相同。如果值不相同，则拒绝访问。将 SCP 应用于 OU。
options.C: 创建一个 SCP，其中包含可接受 VPC 值的列表，并检查 aws:SourceVpc 条件键的值是否在该列表中。在同一个 SCP 检查中，定义可接受 IP 地址值的列表，并检查 aws:VpcSourceIp 条件键的值是否在该列表中。如果任一条件为 false，则拒绝访问。将 SCP 应用于组织中的每个账户。
options.D: 创建一个 SCP，检查 aws:EC2InstanceSourceVPC 和 aws:VpcSourceIp 条件键的值是否相同。如果值不相同，则拒绝访问。在同一个 SCP 检查中，检查 aws:EC2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4 和 aws:SourceVpc 条件键的值是否相同。如果值不相同，则拒绝访问。将 SCP 应用于组织中的每个账户。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司希望 EC2 实例配置文件凭证只能从 AWS 向其交付这些凭证的 EC2 实例使用。由于所有相关账户都位于一个 OU 中，因此可以将 SCP 附加到该 OU，以便在这些账户中强制实施该限制。

## 正确答案：B

AWS 为此目的提供了两组互补的请求上下文键：

- `aws:Ec2InstanceSourceVpc` 标识交付 EC2 IAM 角色凭证的 VPC。应将其与 `aws:SourceVpc` 进行比较，后者标识当前请求通过其到达的 VPC。
- `aws:Ec2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4` 标识交付凭证的主私有 IPv4 地址。应将其与 `aws:VpcSourceIp` 进行比较，后者标识当前请求通过 VPC 终端节点发出时的私有源 IP。

因此，当这两项比较中的任一项不匹配时拒绝请求，便可将凭证绑定到源 VPC 和特定实例的私有 IP。AWS 文档提供了一个恰好包含这些比较的 SCP 示例，并指出 VPC ID 必须与私有 IPv4 比较一起使用，因为私有 IP 地址并非全局唯一。请参阅 [AWS 全局条件上下文键](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)。

将 SCP 附加到这个唯一的 OU，会使其影响该 OU 下的所有账户，这正是此场景中高效的全组织范围部署方式。AWS 确认，附加到 OU 的 SCP 会影响该 OU 下的所有账户。请参阅 [使用 AWS Organizations 附加策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A：**比较配对不正确。`aws:Ec2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4` 是 IP 地址，而 `aws:SourceVpc` 是 VPC ID，因此比较它们无法建立所需的关系。固定的 VPC CIDR 允许列表也只是将凭证限制到一个网络范围，而不是动态地将每个凭证绑定到接收它的具体实例。

- **C：**可接受 VPC ID 和 IP 地址的静态列表实现的是网络允许列表。它们不会将当前请求的来源与嵌入每个 EC2 角色会话中的 VPC 和私有 IP 进行比较，因此从一个被允许的实例复制的凭证可能会在另一个被允许的位置使用。此外，当一个 OU 包含所有账户时，分别将同一个 SCP 附加到每个账户并无必要。不过，直接将 SCP 附加到账户在技术上是受支持的；这并非此选项的根本错误。

- **D：**它比较了不同类型的值：`aws:Ec2InstanceSourceVpc` 是 VPC ID，而 `aws:VpcSourceIp` 是 IP 地址；`aws:Ec2InstanceSourcePrivateIPv4` 是 IP 地址，而 `aws:SourceVpc` 是 VPC ID。正确的配对应该是 VPC 对 VPC，以及私有 IP 对私有 IP。直接附加到账户是受支持的，但不如一次附加到 OU 高效，也无法修正无效的比较。

en.question: A company has a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances that run Linux in a single AWS account. The company is using an AWS Systems Manager Automation task across the EC2 instances. During the most recent patch cycle, several EC2 instances went into an error state because of insufficient available disk space. A DevOps engineer needs to ensure that the EC2 instances have sufficient available disk space during the patching process in the future. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Ensure that the Amazon CloudWatch agent is installed on all EC2 instances.
options.B: Create a cron job that is installed on each EC2 instance to periodically delete temporary files.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch log group for the EC2 instances. Configure a cron job that is installed on each EC2 instance to write the available disk space to a CloudWatch log stream for the relevant EC2 instance.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to monitor available disk space on all EC2 instances. Add the alarm as a safety control to the Systems Manager Automation task.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function to periodically check for sufficient available disk space on all EC2 instances by evaluating each EC2 instance's respective Amazon CloudWatch log stream.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The patching failures occurred because the Linux file systems lacked enough free space. The solution therefore needs two capabilities:

1. Publish operating-system-level disk-space data from every EC2 instance to CloudWatch.
2. Use a disk-space alarm to prevent the Systems Manager Automation execution from continuing when an instance is unhealthy.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. Ensure that the Amazon CloudWatch agent is installed on all EC2 instances

Standard EC2 metrics do not provide guest operating system file-system capacity. The CloudWatch agent can collect Linux disk metrics, including `disk_free`, `disk_used`, `disk_total`, and `disk_used_percent`. After the agent is installed and configured to collect the relevant mounted file systems, CloudWatch has the metric data needed to detect low available space.

AWS documents the supported Linux disk metrics in [Metrics collected by the CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/metrics-collected-by-CloudWatch-agent.html).

### D. Create a CloudWatch alarm to monitor available disk space on all EC2 instances, and add the alarm as a safety control to the Automation task

A CloudWatch alarm can evaluate the disk metric emitted by the agent, such as alarming when `disk_free` falls below a required threshold or when `disk_used_percent` rises above one. Systems Manager Automation supports monitoring CloudWatch alarms during an execution. If a monitored alarm enters the `ALARM` state, Automation stops the execution and cancels pending executions, preventing patching from continuing against instances that do not have sufficient disk space.

AWS describes this behavior in [Configuring Automations to monitor CloudWatch Alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/automation-cw-alarm-monitoring.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create a cron job to periodically delete temporary files

This is an uncontrolled remediation rather than a reliable safety check. It does not verify that enough space is available immediately before or during patching, does not stop the Automation task when capacity remains insufficient, and could delete files that should be retained. It also adds per-instance operational maintenance that the CloudWatch-agent-and-alarm design avoids.

### C. Write available disk space to a CloudWatch Logs log stream by using cron

Available disk space should be published as a CloudWatch **metric**, not encoded as log events that require later parsing or evaluation. The CloudWatch agent already supports native disk metrics, so custom cron jobs, log groups, and per-instance log streams are unnecessary. Moreover, this option does not create an alarm or connect the result to Systems Manager Automation.

### E. Use Lambda to periodically evaluate each instance's CloudWatch log stream

This depends on the unnecessary log-based design in option C and introduces custom polling logic, Lambda code, scheduling, and failure handling. It also does not state that the result is attached to Automation as an alarm safety control. CloudWatch alarms natively evaluate the agent's disk metrics, and Systems Manager Automation natively stops when a monitored alarm activates.

Therefore, **A and D** provide the AWS-native monitoring and Automation safety-control solution.

zh.question: 某公司在一个 AWS 账户中拥有一组运行 Linux 的 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司正在跨这些 EC2 实例使用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 任务。在最近一次修补周期中，由于可用磁盘空间不足，多个 EC2 实例进入错误状态。DevOps 工程师需要确保未来在修补过程中 EC2 实例具有足够的可用磁盘空间。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 确保所有 EC2 实例上均已安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent。
options.B: 创建一个 cron 作业，并将其安装在每个 EC2 实例上以定期删除临时文件。
options.C: 为 EC2 实例创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 日志组。配置一个安装在每个 EC2 实例上的 cron 作业，将可用磁盘空间写入相关 EC2 实例的 CloudWatch 日志流。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 警报来监控所有 EC2 实例上的可用磁盘空间。将该警报作为安全控制措施添加到 Systems Manager Automation 任务中。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，通过评估每个 EC2 实例各自的 Amazon CloudWatch 日志流，定期检查所有 EC2 实例是否具有足够的可用磁盘空间。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

修补失败的原因是 Linux 文件系统缺少足够的可用空间。因此，该解决方案需要具备两项能力：

1. 将每个 EC2 实例中的操作系统级磁盘空间数据发布到 CloudWatch。
2. 当实例处于不健康状态时，使用磁盘空间警报阻止 Systems Manager Automation 执行继续进行。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 确保所有 EC2 实例上均已安装 Amazon CloudWatch agent

标准 EC2 指标不提供来宾操作系统文件系统容量信息。CloudWatch agent 可以收集 Linux 磁盘指标，包括 `disk_free`、`disk_used`、`disk_total` 和 `disk_used_percent`。安装并配置 agent 以收集相关挂载文件系统的数据后，CloudWatch 就拥有检测可用空间不足所需的指标数据。

AWS 在[由 CloudWatch agent 收集的指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/metrics-collected-by-CloudWatch-agent.html)中记录了受支持的 Linux 磁盘指标。

### D. 创建一个 CloudWatch 警报来监控所有 EC2 实例上的可用磁盘空间，并将该警报作为安全控制措施添加到 Automation 任务中

CloudWatch 警报可以评估 agent 发出的磁盘指标，例如当 `disk_free` 低于所需阈值时发出警报，或当 `disk_used_percent` 高于阈值时发出警报。Systems Manager Automation 支持在执行期间监控 CloudWatch 警报。如果受监控的警报进入 `ALARM` 状态，Automation 会停止执行并取消待执行任务，从而防止针对没有足够磁盘空间的实例继续修补。

AWS 在[配置 Automations 以监控 CloudWatch Alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/automation-cw-alarm-monitoring.html)中介绍了此行为。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 创建 cron 作业以定期删除临时文件

这是一种不受控制的修复措施，而不是可靠的安全检查。它无法验证在修补前或修补期间是否立即具有足够空间；当容量仍然不足时，它也不会停止 Automation 任务，并且可能会删除应保留的文件。此外，它还增加了逐实例的运维维护工作，而 CloudWatch-agent-and-alarm 设计可以避免这些工作。

### C. 使用 cron 将可用磁盘空间写入 CloudWatch Logs 日志流

可用磁盘空间应作为 CloudWatch **指标**发布，而不是编码为需要后续解析或评估的日志事件。CloudWatch agent 已原生支持磁盘指标，因此无需自定义 cron 作业、日志组和逐实例日志流。此外，此选项既没有创建警报，也没有将结果关联到 Systems Manager Automation。

### E. 使用 Lambda 定期评估每个实例的 CloudWatch 日志流

此方法依赖于选项 C 中不必要的基于日志的设计，并引入了自定义轮询逻辑、Lambda 代码、调度和故障处理。该选项也没有说明要将结果作为警报安全控制措施附加到 Automation。CloudWatch 警报可以原生评估 agent 的磁盘指标，而 Systems Manager Automation 会在受监控警报激活时原生停止。

因此，**A 和 D** 提供了 AWS 原生的监控和 Automation 安全控制解决方案。

en.question: A DevOps engineer is building an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to query an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster. The Lambda function performs only read queries. Amazon EventBridge events invoke the Lambda function. As more events invoke the Lambda function each second, the database's latency increases and the database's throughput decreases. The DevOps engineer needs to improve the performance of the application. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy. Connect the proxy to the Aurora cluster reader endpoint. Set a maximum connections percentage on the proxy.
options.B: Implement database connection pooling inside the Lambda code. Set a maximum number of connections on the database connection pool.
options.C: Implement the database connection opening outside the Lambda event handler code.
options.D: Implement the database connection opening and closing inside the Lambda event handler code.
options.E: Connect to the proxy endpoint from the Lambda function.
options.F: Connect to the Aurora cluster endpoint from the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

EventBridge is driving increasing Lambda concurrency. Each concurrent Lambda execution can create a database connection, so connection setup, teardown, and connection-count pressure can consume Aurora memory and CPU, increasing latency and reducing throughput. Because the workload is read-only, the solution should both reuse/pool connections and direct the traffic to Aurora readers.

## Correct answers: A, C, and E

### A. Create an RDS Proxy for the Aurora reader path and configure a maximum connections percentage

RDS Proxy pools and multiplexes client connections. Many Lambda-side connections can therefore share a smaller number of underlying Aurora connections, reducing connection setup overhead and the likelihood of exhausting database connections. AWS documents that `MaxConnectionsPercent` limits the connections the proxy can establish with the target database as a percentage of the database's `max_connections` setting. This protects Aurora from excessive connection pressure.

For a read-only workload, a proxy read-only/reader endpoint distributes queries across Aurora reader instances and improves read scalability. See [RDS Proxy connection pooling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html) and [RDS Proxy connection settings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html).

AWS also states that proxy reader endpoints improve the read scalability of query-intensive applications and distribute queries across reader DB instances: [Working with RDS Proxy endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-endpoints.html).

### C. Open the database connection outside the Lambda event handler

Lambda can reuse an execution environment for subsequent invocations. Initializing the database connection outside the handler allows those invocations to reuse the connection instead of repeatedly paying connection and authentication setup costs. AWS explicitly recommends initializing database connections outside the function handler to take advantage of execution-environment reuse: [Lambda best practices — Function code](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html).

This reuse occurs within each warm Lambda execution environment; RDS Proxy then provides pooling and multiplexing across the larger population of Lambda environments.

### E. Connect the Lambda function to the proxy endpoint

Creating a proxy has no benefit if the application bypasses it. The Lambda function must use the proxy endpoint so its database traffic passes through RDS Proxy and benefits from connection pooling, multiplexing, connection limits, and reader routing.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Implement connection pooling inside the Lambda code

An application-level pool is local to a Lambda execution environment. As Lambda scales out, many independent execution environments—and therefore many independent pools—can be created. A per-pool maximum does not impose an effective global database connection limit. It also duplicates the connection-pooling responsibility that RDS Proxy is specifically designed to provide. AWS notes that RDS Proxy pooling means applications do not need to implement logic to minimize simultaneous database connections: [RDS Proxy connection pooling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html).

### D. Open and close the database connection inside the Lambda handler

Opening and closing on every invocation creates connection churn and prevents warm execution environments from reusing an initialized connection. This conflicts with the current Lambda best-practice guidance to initialize database connections outside the handler. A code sample that opens or closes a connection inside a handler does not override this explicit performance recommendation.

### F. Connect directly to the Aurora cluster endpoint

A direct cluster connection bypasses RDS Proxy, so Lambda traffic would not benefit from the proxy's pooling, multiplexing, or `MaxConnectionsPercent` protection. In addition, the normal/default Aurora cluster endpoint is the writer endpoint; the read-only workload should use the proxy's reader path rather than sending all queries to the writer.

Therefore, the best combination is **A, C, and E**.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在构建一个应用程序，该应用程序使用 AWS Lambda 函数查询 Amazon Aurora MySQL 数据库集群。Lambda 函数仅执行读取查询。Amazon EventBridge 事件会调用该 Lambda 函数。随着每秒调用 Lambda 函数的事件数量增加，数据库延迟增大，数据库吞吐量下降。DevOps 工程师需要提高应用程序的性能。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 使用 Amazon RDS Proxy 创建代理。将代理连接到 Aurora 集群读取器终端节点。在代理上设置最大连接百分比。
options.B: 在 Lambda 代码中实现数据库连接池。在数据库连接池上设置最大连接数。
options.C: 在 Lambda 事件处理程序代码之外实现数据库连接的打开操作。
options.D: 在 Lambda 事件处理程序代码内部实现数据库连接的打开和关闭操作。
options.E: 从 Lambda 函数连接到代理终端节点。
options.F: 从 Lambda 函数连接到 Aurora 集群终端节点。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

EventBridge 正在推动 Lambda 并发量增加。每个并发 Lambda 执行都可能创建一个数据库连接，因此，连接建立、拆除以及连接数量压力会消耗 Aurora 的内存和 CPU，从而增加延迟并降低吞吐量。由于该工作负载为只读，解决方案既应复用/池化连接，也应将流量定向到 Aurora 读取器。

## 正确答案：A、C 和 E

### A. 为 Aurora 读取器路径创建 RDS Proxy，并配置最大连接百分比

RDS Proxy 会池化并多路复用客户端连接。因此，许多 Lambda 端连接可以共享较少数量的底层 Aurora 连接，从而减少连接建立开销，并降低耗尽数据库连接的可能性。AWS 文档指出，`MaxConnectionsPercent` 会将代理可与目标数据库建立的连接数限制为数据库 `max_connections` 设置的百分比。这可以保护 Aurora 免受过大的连接压力。

对于只读工作负载，代理的只读/读取器终端节点可将查询分配到 Aurora 读取器实例，并提高读取可扩展性。请参阅 [RDS Proxy 连接池](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html) 和 [RDS Proxy 连接设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-connections.html)。

AWS 还指出，代理读取器终端节点可以提高查询密集型应用程序的读取可扩展性，并将查询分配到读取器 DB 实例：[使用 RDS Proxy 终端节点](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy-endpoints.html)。

### C. 在 Lambda 事件处理程序之外打开数据库连接

Lambda 可以为后续调用复用执行环境。在处理程序之外初始化数据库连接，可使这些调用复用该连接，而不是反复承担连接和身份验证设置的成本。AWS 明确建议在函数处理程序之外初始化数据库连接，以利用执行环境复用：[Lambda 最佳实践 — 函数代码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/best-practices.html)。

这种复用发生在每个预热的 Lambda 执行环境中；RDS Proxy 随后会在更大范围的 Lambda 环境群体之间提供连接池化和多路复用。

### E. 将 Lambda 函数连接到代理终端节点

如果应用程序绕过代理，创建代理将毫无益处。Lambda 函数必须使用代理终端节点，使其数据库流量经过 RDS Proxy，并从连接池化、多路复用、连接限制和读取器路由中受益。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 在 Lambda 代码中实现连接池

应用程序级连接池仅在一个 Lambda 执行环境内有效。当 Lambda 横向扩展时，可能会创建许多相互独立的执行环境，因此也会创建许多独立的连接池。每个池的最大值无法施加有效的全局数据库连接限制。它还重复实现了 RDS Proxy 专门用于提供的连接池职责。AWS 指出，RDS Proxy 连接池意味着应用程序无需实现用于最小化同时数据库连接数的逻辑：[RDS Proxy 连接池](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/rds-proxy.howitworks.html)。

### D. 在 Lambda 处理程序内部打开和关闭数据库连接

每次调用时打开和关闭连接会造成连接频繁变动，并阻止预热执行环境复用已初始化的连接。这与当前 Lambda 最佳实践中在处理程序之外初始化数据库连接的指导相冲突。某个在处理程序内部打开或关闭连接的代码示例，并不能推翻这项明确的性能建议。

### F. 直接连接到 Aurora 集群终端节点

直接连接集群会绕过 RDS Proxy，因此 Lambda 流量无法从代理的连接池化、多路复用或 `MaxConnectionsPercent` 保护中受益。此外，常规/默认 Aurora 集群终端节点是写入器终端节点；只读工作负载应使用代理的读取器路径，而非将所有查询发送到写入器。

因此，最佳组合是 **A、C 和 E**。

en.question: A company has an AWS CloudFormation stack that is deployed in a single AWS account. The company has configured the stack to send event notifications to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. A DevOps engineer must implement an automated solution that applies a tag to the specific CloudFormation stack instance only after a successful stack update occurs. The DevOps engineer has created an AWS Lambda function that applies and updates this tag for the specific stack instance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Run the AWS-UpdateCloudFormationStack AWS Systems ManagerAutomation runbook when Systems Manager detects an UPDATE_COMPLETE event for the instance status of the CloudFormation stack. Configure the runbook to invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Create a custom AWS Config rule that produces a compliance change event if the CloudFormation stack has an UPDATE_COMPLETE instance status. Configure AWS Config to directly invoke the Lambda function to automatically remediate the change event.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches the UPDATE_COMPLETE event pattern for the instance status of the CloudFormation stack. Configure the rule to invoke the Lambda function.
options.D: Adjust the configuration of the CloudFormation stack to send notifications for only an UPDATE_COMPLETE instance status event to the SNS topic. Subscribe the Lambda function to the SNS topic.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The automation must react to a **successful update of one specific CloudFormation stack**, not merely to any configuration change or to every notification that CloudFormation publishes. The existing Lambda function must be invoked only when that stack reaches `UPDATE_COMPLETE`.

## Correct answer: C

**Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches the CloudFormation stack's `UPDATE_COMPLETE` status event and targets the Lambda function.**

CloudFormation sends **CloudFormation Stack Status Change** events to EventBridge. These events contain the stack identifier in `detail.stack-id` and the stack status in `detail.status-details.status`. AWS documents the event structure and shows that the source is `aws.cloudformation` and the detail type is `CloudFormation Stack Status Change` ([CloudFormation Stack Status Change event detail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/event-detail-stack-status-change.html)).

EventBridge rules can filter CloudFormation events by fields such as the event source, detail type, stack ID, and status. AWS specifically documents using nested `status-details.status` values in a CloudFormation event pattern ([Creating a custom event pattern for an EventBridge rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/eventbridge-using-events-rules-patterns.html)). The rule can therefore use a pattern conceptually like:

```json
{
  "source": ["aws.cloudformation"],
  "detail-type": ["CloudFormation Stack Status Change"],
  "detail": {
    "stack-id": ["specific-stack-arn"],
    "status-details": {
      "status": ["UPDATE_COMPLETE"]
    }
  }
}
```

CloudFormation records the stack-level `UPDATE_COMPLETE` event after it has successfully updated the stack ([Events generated during a successful stack update](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-monitor-stack.html)). Setting the Lambda function as the EventBridge rule target therefore invokes the tagging logic at the required time and only for the specified stack.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Systems Manager Automation runbook

`AWS-UpdateCloudFormationStack` is a runbook for **performing an update of a CloudFormation stack from a template in Amazon S3**; it is not an event detector for completed CloudFormation updates ([AWS-UpdateCloudFormationStack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-updatecloudformationstack.html)). Systems Manager does not independently detect the described `UPDATE_COMPLETE` event in the manner stated. EventBridge is the appropriate event-routing service, and invoking this runbook after an update would also be unnecessary and potentially initiate another stack update.

### B. AWS Config rule with direct Lambda remediation

AWS Config rules evaluate resource compliance; they are not the most direct mechanism for reacting to the CloudFormation operation lifecycle event. More importantly, AWS Config remediation is applied through **Systems Manager Automation documents**, including custom Automation documents, rather than by configuring AWS Config to directly invoke a Lambda function as the remediation action ([Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)). Therefore, this option describes the remediation integration incorrectly.

### D. Filter CloudFormation SNS notifications at the stack configuration

CloudFormation can associate SNS topic ARNs with a stack for stack event notifications, but the stack's notification ARN configuration is a list of associated SNS topics; it does not provide a setting that makes CloudFormation publish only `UPDATE_COMPLETE` events ([CloudFormation notification ARNs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vsts/latest/userguide/cloudformation-create-update.html)). Consequently, the proposed adjustment to have CloudFormation send only that one status event is not supported as described. EventBridge provides the required event-pattern filtering directly.

Therefore, **C** is the solution that precisely filters for the successful update of the specific stack and invokes the tagging Lambda function.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个部署在单个 AWS 账户中的 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈。该公司已将该堆栈配置为向 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题发送事件通知。DevOps 工程师必须实施一种自动化解决方案，仅在成功完成堆栈更新后，才对特定的 CloudFormation 堆栈实例应用标签。DevOps 工程师已创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于为特定堆栈实例应用和更新此标签。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 当 Systems Manager 检测到 CloudFormation 堆栈实例状态的 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 事件时，运行 AWS-UpdateCloudFormationStack AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册。将该运行手册配置为调用 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 创建一个自定义 AWS Config 规则，如果 CloudFormation 堆栈具有 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 实例状态，则生成合规性更改事件。将 AWS Config 配置为直接调用 Lambda 函数，以自动修复该更改事件。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，用于匹配 CloudFormation 堆栈实例状态的 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 事件模式。将该规则配置为调用 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 调整 CloudFormation 堆栈的配置，使其仅将 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 实例状态事件的通知发送到 SNS 主题。让 Lambda 函数订阅该 SNS 主题。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该自动化必须对**一个特定 CloudFormation 堆栈的成功更新**作出响应，而不仅仅是对任何配置变更或 CloudFormation 发布的每一条通知作出响应。仅当该堆栈达到 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 时，才必须调用现有的 Lambda 函数。

## 正确答案：C

**创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，用于匹配 CloudFormation 堆栈的 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 状态事件，并将 Lambda 函数设为目标。**

CloudFormation 会将 **CloudFormation Stack Status Change** 事件发送至 EventBridge。这些事件在 `detail.stack-id` 中包含堆栈标识符，并在 `detail.status-details.status` 中包含堆栈状态。AWS 记录了该事件结构，并说明事件源为 `aws.cloudformation`，详细类型为 `CloudFormation Stack Status Change`（[CloudFormation Stack Status Change event detail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/event-detail-stack-status-change.html)）。

EventBridge 规则可以按事件源、详细类型、堆栈 ID 和状态等字段筛选 CloudFormation 事件。AWS 专门说明了如何在 CloudFormation 事件模式中使用嵌套的 `status-details.status` 值（[Creating a custom event pattern for an EventBridge rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/eventbridge-using-events-rules-patterns.html)）。因此，该规则可以使用概念上类似如下的模式：

```json
{
  "source": ["aws.cloudformation"],
  "detail-type": ["CloudFormation Stack Status Change"],
  "detail": {
    "stack-id": ["specific-stack-arn"],
    "status-details": {
      "status": ["UPDATE_COMPLETE"]
    }
  }
}
```

CloudFormation 会在成功更新堆栈后记录堆栈级别的 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 事件（[Events generated during a successful stack update](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-updating-stacks-monitor-stack.html)）。因此，将 Lambda 函数设置为 EventBridge 规则目标，即可在所需的时间调用标签逻辑，并且仅针对指定堆栈调用。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. Systems Manager Automation 运行手册

`AWS-UpdateCloudFormationStack` 是一个用于**根据 Amazon S3 中的模板执行 CloudFormation 堆栈更新**的运行手册；它不是用于检测已完成 CloudFormation 更新的事件检测器（[AWS-UpdateCloudFormationStack](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-updatecloudformationstack.html)）。Systems Manager 不会以题目所述的方式独立检测 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 事件。EventBridge 才是适当的事件路由服务，并且在更新后调用此运行手册也是不必要的，还可能发起另一次堆栈更新。

### B. 使用直接 Lambda 修复的 AWS Config 规则

AWS Config 规则评估资源合规性；它们不是对 CloudFormation 操作生命周期事件作出响应的最直接机制。更重要的是，AWS Config 修复通过 **Systems Manager Automation 文档**应用，其中包括自定义 Automation 文档，而不是将 AWS Config 配置为直接调用 Lambda 函数作为修复操作（[Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)）。因此，此选项错误地描述了修复集成方式。

### D. 在堆栈配置中筛选 CloudFormation SNS 通知

CloudFormation 可以将 SNS 主题 ARN 与堆栈关联以接收堆栈事件通知，但堆栈的通知 ARN 配置是关联 SNS 主题的列表；它不提供让 CloudFormation 仅发布 `UPDATE_COMPLETE` 事件的设置（[CloudFormation notification ARNs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vsts/latest/userguide/cloudformation-create-update.html)）。因此，按所述方式调整 CloudFormation 以仅发送该状态事件并不受支持。EventBridge 直接提供所需的事件模式筛选。

因此，**C** 是能够精确筛选特定堆栈成功更新并调用标签 Lambda 函数的解决方案。

en.question: A company deploys an application to two AWS Regions. The application creates and stores objects in an Amazon S3 bucket that is in the same Region as the application. Both deployments of the application need to have access to all the objects and their metadata from both Regions. The company has configured two-way replication between the S3 buckets and has enabled S3 Replication metrics on each S3 bucket. A DevOps engineer needs to implement a solution that retries the replication process if an object fails to replicate. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that listens to S3 event notifications for failed replication events. Create an AWS Lambda function that downloads the failed replication object and then runs a PutObject command for the object to the destination bucket. Configure the EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function to handle the object that failed to replicate.
options.B: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure S3 event notifications to send failed replication notifications to the SQS queue. Create an AWS Lambda function that downloads the failed replication object and then runs a PutObject command for the object to the destination bucket. Configure the Lambda function to poll the queue for notifications to process.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that listens to S3 event notifications for failed replications. Create an AWS Lambda function that downloads the failed replication object and then runs a PutObject command for the object to the destination bucket.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that will use S3 batch operations to retry the replication on the existing object for a failed replication. Configure S3 event notifications to send failed replication notifications to the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The two buckets already use bidirectional S3 Replication, and S3 Replication metrics are enabled. The required solution must:

1. Detect an individual object whose replication failed.
2. Retry **S3 Replication** for that existing object, rather than implement a separate object-copy mechanism.
3. Preserve the replication behavior for the object and its metadata.

## Correct answer: D

**Create a Lambda function that starts an S3 Batch Replication operation for the failed object, and configure the S3 replication-failure event notification to invoke the function.**

With Replication metrics enabled, Amazon S3 supports the `s3:Replication:OperationFailedReplication` notification, which identifies an eligible object that failed replication. S3 can send this event directly to Lambda. The official event-type documentation explicitly lists replication failure events among the event types supported for SQS, SNS, and Lambda: [Supported event types and destinations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html).

S3 Batch Replication is specifically designed to replicate existing objects on demand, including **objects that have failed replication**. A Batch Replication job can also filter on an object replication status of `FAILED`: [Replicating existing objects with Batch Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-batch.html).

This retries the managed S3 replication workflow by using the existing replication configuration. That matters because S3 Replication handles not only object data but also supported metadata, tags, ACL updates, annotations, and Object Lock retention information: [What is replicated with replication configurations?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-what-is-isnot-replicated.html).

In practice, the Lambda function would identify the failed object/version from the event and create the required S3 Batch Replication job and manifest. The Lambda execution role and Batch Operations role need the corresponding permissions, including permission to initiate replication.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EventBridge plus Lambda performing `PutObject`

EventBridge can route S3 events to Lambda, but the proposed Lambda implementation manually downloads and uploads the object. A `PutObject` to the other bucket is a new object write, not a retry of the failed S3 replication operation for the original object version. It also does not inherently reproduce all replication-managed metadata, tags, ACLs, Object Lock settings, and replication state. S3 Batch Replication is the purpose-built mechanism for retrying objects with failed replication status.

### B. SQS plus Lambda performing `PutObject`

SQS is a supported destination for S3 replication events, but adding a queue does not correct the central problem: the Lambda function performs a manual download and `PutObject` instead of retrying S3 Replication. The requirement is better met by initiating Batch Replication for the failed object, which applies the configured replication behavior and metadata handling.

### C. EventBridge rule and Lambda performing `PutObject`

This has the same incorrect manual-copy approach as A and B. In addition, the option does not state that the EventBridge rule is configured to invoke the Lambda function, so the event-processing workflow is incomplete.

Therefore, **D** is the only option that both reacts to the native failed-replication event and uses the AWS capability specifically intended to reprocess objects that failed replication.

zh.question: 一家公司将一个应用程序部署到两个 AWS Region。该应用程序在与应用程序位于同一 Region 的 Amazon S3 存储桶中创建和存储对象。两个应用程序部署都需要访问来自两个 Region 的所有对象及其元数据。该公司已在 S3 存储桶之间配置双向复制，并且已在每个 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 Replication 指标。DevOps 工程师需要实施一个解决方案，以便在对象复制失败时重试复制过程。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，用于侦听失败复制事件的 S3 事件通知。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于下载复制失败的对象，然后对目标存储桶中的对象运行 PutObject 命令。配置 EventBridge 规则以调用 Lambda 函数来处理复制失败的对象。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列。配置 S3 事件通知，以便将复制失败通知发送到 SQS 队列。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于下载复制失败的对象，然后对目标存储桶中的对象运行 PutObject 命令。配置 Lambda 函数轮询队列以处理通知。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，用于侦听复制失败的 S3 事件通知。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于下载复制失败的对象，然后对目标存储桶中的对象运行 PutObject 命令。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将使用 S3 batch operations 对复制失败的现有对象重试复制。配置 S3 事件通知，以便将复制失败通知发送到 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

这两个存储桶已经使用双向 S3 Replication，并且已启用 S3 Replication 指标。所需解决方案必须：

1. 检测复制失败的单个对象。
2. 对该现有对象重试 **S3 Replication**，而不是实施单独的对象复制机制。
3. 保留对象及其元数据的复制行为。

## 正确答案：D

**创建一个 Lambda 函数，为复制失败的对象启动 S3 Batch Replication 操作，并配置 S3 复制失败事件通知来调用该函数。**

启用 Replication 指标后，Amazon S3 支持 `s3:Replication:OperationFailedReplication` 通知，该通知会识别复制失败的符合条件对象。S3 可以将此事件直接发送到 Lambda。官方事件类型文档明确将复制失败事件列为 SQS、SNS 和 Lambda 支持的事件类型之一：[支持的事件类型和目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html)。

S3 Batch Replication 专为按需复制现有对象而设计，其中包括**复制失败的对象**。Batch Replication 作业还可以按对象复制状态 `FAILED` 进行筛选：[使用 Batch Replication 复制现有对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-batch.html)。

这会通过使用现有复制配置来重试由 S3 托管的复制工作流。这一点很重要，因为 S3 Replication 不仅处理对象数据，还处理受支持的元数据、标签、ACL 更新、注释和 Object Lock 保留信息：[使用复制配置复制哪些内容？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-what-is-isnot-replicated.html)。

在实践中，Lambda 函数将从事件中识别失败的对象/版本，并创建所需的 S3 Batch Replication 作业和清单。Lambda 执行角色和 Batch Operations 角色需要相应权限，包括启动复制的权限。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. EventBridge 加 Lambda 执行 `PutObject`

EventBridge 可以将 S3 事件路由到 Lambda，但所提出的 Lambda 实现会手动下载并上传对象。向另一个存储桶执行 `PutObject` 是一次新的对象写入，而不是针对原始对象版本重试失败的 S3 Replication 操作。它也无法固有地重现由复制管理的所有元数据、标签、ACL、Object Lock 设置和复制状态。S3 Batch Replication 是重试复制状态为失败的对象的专用机制。

### B. SQS 加 Lambda 执行 `PutObject`

SQS 是 S3 复制事件支持的目标，但添加队列并不能解决核心问题：Lambda 函数执行的是手动下载和 `PutObject`，而不是重试 S3 Replication。通过为失败对象启动 Batch Replication，可以更好地满足此要求，因为它会应用已配置的复制行为和元数据处理。

### C. EventBridge 规则和 Lambda 执行 `PutObject`

这与 A 和 B 一样，采用了不正确的手动复制方法。此外，该选项未说明配置 EventBridge 规则来调用 Lambda 函数，因此事件处理工作流并不完整。

因此，**D** 是唯一一个既能响应原生复制失败事件，又能使用 AWS 专门用于重新处理复制失败对象的功能的选项。

en.question: A company needs to implement failover for its application. The application includes an Amazon CloudFront distribution and a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) in an AWS Region. The company has configured the ALB as the default origin for the distribution. After some recent application outages, the company wants a zero-second RTO. The company deploys the application to a secondary Region in a warm standby configuration. A DevOps engineer needs to automate the failover of the application to the secondary Region so that HTTP GET requests meet the desired RTO. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a second CloudFront distribution that has the secondary ALB as the default origin. Create Amazon Route 53 alias records that have a failover policy and Evaluate Target Health set to Yes for both CloudFront distributions. Update the application to use the new record set.
options.B: Create a new origin on the distribution for the secondary ALCreate a new origin group. Set the original ALB as the primary origin. Configure the origin group to fail over for HTTP 5xx status codes. Update the default behavior to use the origin group.
options.C: Create Amazon Route 53 alias records that have a failover policy and Evaluate Target Health set to Yes for both ALBs. Set the TTL of both records to 0. Update the distribution's origin to use the new record set.
options.D: Create a CloudFront function that detects HTTP 5xx status codes. Configure the function to return a 307 Temporary Redirect error response to the secondary ALB if the function detects 5xx status codes. Update the distribution's default behavior to send origin responses to the function.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The application already uses a CloudFront distribution in front of a Regional public ALB. The requirement is to fail over HTTP `GET` requests to the warm-standby Region without waiting for DNS failover or client-side DNS cache expiration. The failover therefore needs to occur inside the existing CloudFront request path, on a per-request basis.

## Correct answer: B

Create the secondary ALB as another CloudFront origin, place both ALBs in an origin group with the original ALB as primary, configure the appropriate HTTP `5xx` status codes as failover criteria, and associate the default cache behavior with that origin group.

CloudFront origin groups are purpose-built for this scenario. On a cache miss, CloudFront first sends the request to the primary origin. If the primary returns a configured error code, CloudFront sends the same request to the secondary origin. AWS supports failover criteria including `500`, `502`, `503`, and `504`. CloudFront origin failover applies to `GET`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS`, which directly matches the question's requirement for HTTP `GET` requests. See [Create an origin group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html) and [Request and response behavior for origin groups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorOriginGroups.html).

This is request-level failover within CloudFront, so it avoids DNS propagation and resolver-cache delays and provides the closest match to the requested zero-second RTO.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Two CloudFront distributions with Route 53 failover aliases

This is invalid as described because Route 53 does **not** allow **Evaluate Target Health = Yes** when an alias target is a CloudFront distribution. Additionally, DNS-based failover depends on health detection and clients or recursive resolvers obtaining an updated DNS response, rather than retrying the failed request immediately against another origin. See [Route 53 failover alias record values](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-failover-alias.html).

### C. Route 53 failover records for the two ALBs

Route 53 can evaluate the health of Application Load Balancer alias targets, but this design moves failover to DNS. DNS recursive resolvers cache records according to TTL, so DNS failover cannot guarantee immediate per-request recovery for an already failing `GET` request. AWS documentation explicitly explains that TTL controls how long recursive resolvers cache a record and that cached values delay the effect of changes. See [TTL values for Route 53 records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-basic.html).

It is therefore not the correct mechanism for the zero-second-RTO requirement when CloudFront's native origin failover can retry the request against the secondary origin.

### D. CloudFront Function that processes origin responses

CloudFront Functions cannot be configured for an **origin-response** event. They support viewer-side events, while origin request/response triggers require Lambda@Edge. Moreover, CloudFront does not invoke an edge function for a viewer-response event when the origin returns an HTTP status code of `400` or higher, so the proposed function would not detect the `5xx` responses as described. See [Restrictions on edge functions—HTTP status codes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-function-restrictions-all.html).

Therefore, **B** is the only option that provides native, automated, per-request CloudFront failover for HTTP `GET` requests.

zh.question: 一家公司需要为其应用程序实施故障转移。该应用程序包含一个 Amazon CloudFront 分配和 AWS Region 中的一个公共 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。该公司已将该 ALB 配置为该分配的默认源站。最近发生一些应用程序中断后，公司希望实现零秒 RTO。公司以温备用配置将应用程序部署到辅助 Region。一名 DevOps 工程师需要自动将应用程序故障转移到辅助 Region，以便 HTTP GET 请求满足所需的 RTO。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建第二个 CloudFront 分配，并将辅助 ALB 作为默认源站。为两个 CloudFront 分配创建具有故障转移策略且 Evaluate Target Health 设置为 Yes 的 Amazon Route 53 别名记录。更新应用程序以使用新的记录集。
options.B: 在该分配上为辅助 ALCreate 创建一个新源站。创建一个新的源站组。将原始 ALB 设置为主源站。将源站组配置为针对 HTTP 5xx 状态代码进行故障转移。更新默认行为以使用该源站组。
options.C: 为两个 ALB 创建具有故障转移策略且 Evaluate Target Health 设置为 Yes 的 Amazon Route 53 别名记录。将两个记录的 TTL 都设置为 0。更新该分配的源站以使用新的记录集。
options.D: 创建一个用于检测 HTTP 5xx 状态代码的 CloudFront 函数。如果该函数检测到 5xx 状态代码，则将其配置为向辅助 ALB 返回 307 Temporary Redirect 错误响应。更新该分配的默认行为，以将源站响应发送到该函数。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

该应用程序已经使用位于 Regional 公共 ALB 前面的 CloudFront 分配。要求是在无需等待 DNS 故障转移或客户端 DNS 缓存过期的情况下，将 HTTP `GET` 请求故障转移到温备用 Region。因此，故障转移需要在现有 CloudFront 请求路径内、按每个请求发生。

## 正确答案：B

将辅助 ALB 创建为另一个 CloudFront 源站，将两个 ALB 放入一个源站组，并将原始 ALB 设为主源站；将适当的 HTTP `5xx` 状态代码配置为故障转移条件，并将默认缓存行为关联到该源站组。

CloudFront 源站组专为此场景设计。在缓存未命中时，CloudFront 会先将请求发送到主源站。如果主源站返回已配置的错误代码，CloudFront 会将同一请求发送到辅助源站。AWS 支持的故障转移条件包括 `500`、`502`、`503` 和 `504`。CloudFront 源站故障转移适用于 `GET`、`HEAD` 和 `OPTIONS`，这与题目对 HTTP `GET` 请求的要求完全匹配。请参阅 [创建源站组](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html) 和 [源站组的请求和响应行为](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/RequestAndResponseBehaviorOriginGroups.html)。

这是 CloudFront 内的请求级故障转移，因此可避免 DNS 传播和解析器缓存延迟，并且最符合所要求的零秒 RTO。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 使用 Route 53 故障转移别名的两个 CloudFront 分配

按描述而言，此方案无效，因为当别名目标是 CloudFront 分配时，Route 53 **不**允许将 **Evaluate Target Health = Yes**。此外，基于 DNS 的故障转移依赖于健康状况检测，以及客户端或递归解析器获得更新后的 DNS 响应，而不是立即针对另一个源站重试失败的请求。请参阅 [Route 53 故障转移别名记录值](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-failover-alias.html)。

### C. 两个 ALB 的 Route 53 故障转移记录

Route 53 可以评估 Application Load Balancer 别名目标的运行状况，但该设计将故障转移移至 DNS。DNS 递归解析器会根据 TTL 缓存记录，因此对于已失败的 `GET` 请求，DNS 故障转移无法保证立即按请求恢复。AWS 文档明确说明，TTL 控制递归解析器缓存记录的时长，并且缓存的值会延迟变更生效。请参阅 [Route 53 记录的 TTL 值](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/resource-record-sets-values-basic.html)。

因此，当 CloudFront 的原生源站故障转移可以针对辅助源站重试请求时，它并不是满足零秒 RTO 要求的正确机制。

### D. 处理源站响应的 CloudFront Function

CloudFront Functions 无法针对 **origin-response** 事件进行配置。它们支持查看器端事件，而源站请求/响应触发器需要 Lambda@Edge。此外，当源站返回 `400` 或更高的 HTTP 状态代码时，CloudFront 不会为 viewer-response 事件调用边缘函数，因此所提议的函数无法按描述检测 `5xx` 响应。请参阅 [边缘函数限制——HTTP 状态代码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/edge-function-restrictions-all.html)。

因此，**B** 是唯一可为 HTTP `GET` 请求提供原生、自动化且按请求执行的 CloudFront 故障转移的选项。

en.question: A cloud team uses AWS Organizations and AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) to manage a company's AWS accounts. The company recently established a research team. The research team requires the ability to fully manage the resources in its account. The research team must not be able to create IAM users. The cloud team creates a Research Administrator permission set in IAM Identity Center for the research team. The permission set has the AdministratorAccess AWS managed policy attached. The cloud team must ensure that no one on the research team can create IAM users. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM policy that denies the iam:CreateUser action. Attach the IAM policy to the Research Administrator permission set.
options.B: Create an IAM policy that allows all actions except the iam:CreateUser action. Use the IAM policy to set the permissions boundary for the Research Administrator permission set.
options.C: Create an SCP that denies the iam:CreateUser action. Attach the SCP to the research team's AWS account.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that deletes IAM users. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that detects the IAM CreateUser event. Configure the rule to invoke the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: C — Attach an SCP that denies `iam:CreateUser` to the research account

The research team receives an IAM Identity Center permission set with the AWS managed `AdministratorAccess` policy. Therefore, the required solution must prevent `iam:CreateUser` even if team members can otherwise manage IAM roles, policies, and workload identities in their account.

A **service control policy (SCP)** provides the necessary organization-level guardrail. SCPs define the maximum permissions available to IAM users and IAM roles in member accounts. An explicit deny for `iam:CreateUser` in an SCP cannot be overridden by `AdministratorAccess` or another identity-based policy. Consequently, neither the IAM Identity Center role nor another role or workload identity created in the research account can create IAM users. See [AWS Organizations service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

AWS Organizations supports attaching an SCP directly to an individual member account. Because the account belongs to the research team, applying the restriction account-wide ensures that all access paths used by the team are covered. Administrators within the member account also cannot detach or modify this guardrail merely because they have `AdministratorAccess`; SCP attachment and management are controlled through AWS Organizations outside the member account. See [Attaching policies in AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Attach a deny policy to the Research Administrator permission set

A custom policy in an IAM Identity Center permission set is applied to the IAM role that users assume in the target account. An explicit deny for `iam:CreateUser` would therefore prevent direct calls made through that particular role. See [Custom permissions for IAM Identity Center permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetcustom.html).

However, the restriction does not automatically propagate to other principals. Because the role retains broad administrative permissions, a researcher could create or configure another IAM role or workload identity that does not contain the deny and use that principal to call `iam:CreateUser`. AWS documents this privilege-escalation concern when delegating identity administration: created identities must also be constrained appropriately. See [Delegating responsibility with permissions boundaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html). Thus, this option does not ensure that IAM user creation is impossible through every path.

### B. Set a permissions boundary on the Research Administrator permission set

A permissions boundary limits the maximum identity-based permissions of the specific role to which it is attached. The role’s effective permissions are determined by the intersection of its identity-based policies and its permissions boundary. See [IAM policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html).

The boundary would constrain the IAM Identity Center-created role, but it would not automatically apply to new roles or workload identities that the administrator creates. Preventing that bypass would require additional controls that force approved boundaries onto every created principal and prevent those boundaries from being changed or removed. Option B includes no such controls, so it is not an account-wide, non-bypassable restriction.

### D. Detect `CreateUser` and delete the user with Lambda

This is reactive remediation rather than preventive enforcement. The IAM user would be created and exist until EventBridge detects the event and the Lambda function successfully deletes it. Event delivery or function execution could also be delayed or fail. Because the requirement is to ensure that the research team **cannot create** IAM users, deleting users after creation does not satisfy it.

**Answer: C**

zh.question: 某云团队使用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On) 来管理一家公司的 AWS 账户。该公司最近成立了一个研究团队。研究团队需要能够完全管理其账户中的资源。研究团队不得能够创建 IAM 用户。云团队在 IAM Identity Center 中为研究团队创建了一个 Research Administrator 权限集。该权限集附加了 `AdministratorAccess` AWS 托管策略。云团队必须确保研究团队中没有人能够创建 IAM 用户。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个拒绝 `iam:CreateUser` 操作的 IAM 策略。将该 IAM 策略附加到 Research Administrator 权限集。
options.B: 创建一个允许除 `iam:CreateUser` 操作以外所有操作的 IAM 策略。使用该 IAM 策略为 Research Administrator 权限集设置权限边界。
options.C: 创建一个拒绝 `iam:CreateUser` 操作的 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到研究团队的 AWS 账户。
options.D: 创建一个删除 IAM 用户的 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一个检测 IAM CreateUser 事件的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则以调用 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：C — 将拒绝 `iam:CreateUser` 的 SCP 附加到研究账户

研究团队获得了一个 IAM Identity Center 权限集，该权限集具有 AWS 托管的 `AdministratorAccess` 策略。因此，所需的解决方案必须能够阻止 `iam:CreateUser`，即使团队成员仍可以在其账户中管理 IAM roles、策略和工作负载身份。

**服务控制策略 (SCP)** 提供了所需的组织级防护栏。SCP 定义了成员账户中 IAM 用户和 IAM roles 可获得的最大权限。SCP 中对 `iam:CreateUser` 的显式拒绝无法被 `AdministratorAccess` 或其他基于身份的策略覆盖。因此，IAM Identity Center role，以及在研究账户中创建的其他 role 或工作负载身份，都无法创建 IAM 用户。请参阅 [AWS Organizations 服务控制策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

AWS Organizations 支持将 SCP 直接附加到单个成员账户。由于该账户属于研究团队，在整个账户范围内应用该限制可确保覆盖团队使用的所有访问路径。成员账户内的管理员即使拥有 `AdministratorAccess`，也无法仅凭此权限解除或修改此防护栏；SCP 的附加和管理通过成员账户外部的 AWS Organizations 进行控制。请参阅 [在 AWS Organizations 中附加策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_policies_attach.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 将拒绝策略附加到 Research Administrator 权限集

IAM Identity Center 权限集中的自定义策略会应用于用户在目标账户中担任的 IAM role。因此，对 `iam:CreateUser` 的显式拒绝会阻止通过该特定 role 发出的直接调用。请参阅 [IAM Identity Center 权限集的自定义权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetcustom.html)。

但是，该限制不会自动传播到其他主体。由于该 role 保留了广泛的管理权限，研究人员可以创建或配置另一个不包含该拒绝策略的 IAM role 或工作负载身份，并使用该主体调用 `iam:CreateUser`。AWS 在委派身份管理时记录了这一权限提升问题：所创建的身份也必须受到适当约束。请参阅 [使用权限边界委派职责](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html)。因此，该选项无法确保无法通过所有路径创建 IAM 用户。

### B. 为 Research Administrator 权限集设置权限边界

权限边界会限制附加该边界的特定 role 所能拥有的最大基于身份的权限。该 role 的有效权限由其基于身份的策略与其权限边界的交集决定。请参阅 [IAM 策略评估逻辑](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)。

该边界会约束 IAM Identity Center 创建的 role，但不会自动应用于管理员创建的新 roles 或工作负载身份。要防止这种绕过方式，需要额外的控制措施，以强制将批准的边界应用于每个创建的主体，并防止这些边界被更改或移除。选项 B 不包含此类控制措施，因此它不是账户范围内且无法绕过的限制。

### D. 检测 `CreateUser` 并使用 Lambda 删除用户

这是一种事后补救，而非预防性强制措施。IAM 用户会被创建，并在 EventBridge 检测到事件且 Lambda 函数成功将其删除之前一直存在。事件传递或函数执行也可能延迟或失败。由于要求是确保研究团队**无法创建** IAM 用户，在创建后再删除用户并不满足要求。

**答案：C**

en.question: A company releases a new application in a new AWS account. The application includes an AWS Lambda function that processes messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The Lambda function stores the results in an Amazon S3 bucket for further downstream processing. The Lambda function needs to process the messages within a specific period of time after the messages are published. The Lambda function has a batch size of 10 messages and takes a few seconds to process a batch of messages. As load increases on the application's first day of service, messages in the queue accumulate at a greater rate than the Lambda function can process the messages. Some messages miss the required processing timelines. The logs show that many messages in the queue have data that is not valid. The company needs to meet the timeline requirements for messages that have valid data. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Increase the Lambda function's batch size. Change the SQS standard queue to an SQS FIFO queue. Request a Lambda concurrency increase in the AWS Region.
options.B: Reduce the Lambda function's batch size. Increase the SQS message throughput quota. Request a Lambda concurrency increase in the AWS Region.
options.C: Increase the Lambda function's batch size. Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration on the S3 bucket. Configure an SQS dead-letter queue.
options.D: Keep the Lambda function's batch size the same. Configure the Lambda function to report failed batch items. Configure an SQS dead-letter queue.

en.explanation:
## What the scenario is testing

The queue backlog is not primarily caused by the configured batch size or by S3 transfer performance. The key detail is that **many messages contain invalid data**. With the default Lambda–SQS error behavior, one failed item can cause the entire batch to return to the queue, including successfully processed messages. Repeatedly retrying these batches consumes processing capacity and delays valid messages.

## Correct answer: D

**Keep the batch size at 10, configure the Lambda function to report failed batch items, and configure an SQS dead-letter queue (DLQ).**

By default, if Lambda encounters an error while processing an SQS batch, **all messages in the batch become visible again**, including messages that were successfully processed. Enabling `ReportBatchItemFailures` on the event source mapping allows the function to return only the identifiers of failed messages. Lambda can then delete successful messages and retry only invalid or otherwise failed messages. AWS also states that when `ReportBatchItemFailures` is enabled, Lambda does not scale down message polling because of these reported item failures, which helps prevent expected bad records from reducing the valid-message processing rate. See [Handling errors for an SQS event source in Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-errorhandling.html).

A DLQ, configured through the source queue's redrive policy, eventually isolates messages that repeatedly fail. AWS specifically recommends combining partial batch responses with a DLQ to avoid the **snowball anti-pattern**, in which unprocessable messages are repeatedly returned to the source queue, consume Lambda capacity, and eventually outnumber valid messages. See [Best practices for implementing partial batch responses](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/lambda-event-filtering-partial-batch-responses-for-sqs/best-practices-partial-batch-responses.html).

This combination directly protects the processing timeline for valid messages without requiring a batch-size change.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Increase batch size, change to FIFO, and request a concurrency increase

This does not address poison or invalid messages and their repeated retries. In addition, a FIFO queue has a maximum Lambda batch size of **10**, so the current batch size of 10 cannot be increased after changing to FIFO. FIFO processing concurrency is also constrained by message-group IDs and is unnecessary because the scenario does not require strict ordering. A concurrency increase alone would not prevent invalid messages from causing repeated whole-batch retries. The Lambda SQS configuration documentation lists a maximum batch size of 10 for FIFO queues and up to 10,000 for standard queues: [Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html).

### B. Reduce batch size, increase SQS throughput quota, and request a concurrency increase

Reducing the batch size can limit the number of valid records affected by one bad record, but it also reduces per-invocation efficiency and does not isolate invalid messages. The stated symptoms indicate processing failures and retries rather than an SQS message-throughput bottleneck. Increasing concurrency also does not fix the default behavior in which a failed invocation returns the entire batch to the queue; moreover, Lambda applies backoff and reduces concurrency following function-code failures. Partial batch responses and a DLQ address the actual cause directly. See [Handling errors for an SQS event source in Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-errorhandling.html).

### C. Increase batch size, enable S3 Transfer Acceleration, and configure a DLQ

The DLQ is useful, but this option omits partial batch responses. Until a bad message reaches the DLQ's `maxReceiveCount`, its entire batch can continue to be retried, including valid messages. Increasing the batch size can expose even more valid messages to unnecessary retries when one item fails. S3 Transfer Acceleration is unrelated to the identified Lambda–SQS batch-failure problem and does not stop invalid queue messages from consuming Lambda capacity. AWS documents that partial batch responses return only failed messages to the queue and that repeatedly failing messages can then be sent to a DLQ: [Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在一个新的 AWS 账户中发布了一个新应用程序。该应用程序包含一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于处理来自 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列的消息。Lambda 函数将结果存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中，以供后续下游处理。Lambda 函数需要在消息发布后的特定时间段内处理这些消息。该 Lambda 函数的批处理大小为 10 条消息，并且处理一批消息需要几秒钟。随着应用程序在服务第一天的负载增加，队列中消息积压的速度超过了 Lambda 函数处理消息的速度。一些消息未能满足所需的处理时限。日志显示队列中的许多消息包含无效数据。公司需要满足包含有效数据的消息的时限要求。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 增大 Lambda 函数的批处理大小。将 SQS 标准队列更改为 SQS FIFO 队列。在 AWS 区域中申请提高 Lambda 并发配额。
options.B: 减小 Lambda 函数的批处理大小。提高 SQS 消息吞吐量配额。在 AWS 区域中申请提高 Lambda 并发配额。
options.C: 增大 Lambda 函数的批处理大小。在 S3 存储桶上配置 S3 Transfer Acceleration。配置 SQS 死信队列。
options.D: 保持 Lambda 函数的批处理大小不变。配置 Lambda 函数以报告批处理失败项目。配置 SQS 死信队列。

zh.explanation:
## 此场景考查的内容

队列积压的主要原因不是配置的批处理大小或 S3 传输性能。关键细节是，**许多消息包含无效数据**。在默认的 Lambda–SQS 错误处理行为下，一个失败项目可能导致整个批次重新返回队列，其中包括已成功处理的消息。反复重试这些批次会消耗处理容量，并延迟有效消息的处理。

## 正确答案：D

**保持批处理大小为 10，配置 Lambda 函数报告失败的批处理项目，并配置 SQS 死信队列 (DLQ)。**

默认情况下，如果 Lambda 在处理 SQS 批次时遇到错误，**批次中的所有消息都会再次变为可见**，其中包括已成功处理的消息。在事件源映射上启用 `ReportBatchItemFailures` 可使函数仅返回失败消息的标识符。随后，Lambda 可以删除成功消息，并且仅重试无效或以其他方式失败的消息。AWS 还指出，启用 `ReportBatchItemFailures` 后，Lambda 不会因为这些已报告的项目失败而缩减消息轮询，这有助于避免预期的错误记录降低有效消息处理速率。请参阅 [Handling errors for an SQS event source in Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-errorhandling.html)。

通过源队列的重驱动策略配置的 DLQ 最终会隔离反复失败的消息。AWS 特别建议将部分批处理响应与 DLQ 结合使用，以避免出现**滚雪球反模式**：无法处理的消息被反复返回源队列，消耗 Lambda 容量，并最终数量超过有效消息。请参阅 [Best practices for implementing partial batch responses](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/lambda-event-filtering-partial-batch-responses-for-sqs/best-practices-partial-batch-responses.html)。

这种组合无需更改批处理大小，即可直接保护有效消息的处理时限。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 增大批处理大小，更改为 FIFO，并申请提高并发配额

这不能解决有毒或无效消息及其反复重试的问题。此外，FIFO 队列的 Lambda 最大批处理大小为 **10**，因此更改为 FIFO 后，当前为 10 的批处理大小无法再增大。FIFO 处理并发性还受到消息组 ID 的限制，并且由于该场景不需要严格排序，所以没有必要使用 FIFO。仅提高并发性也无法防止无效消息导致整个批次被反复重试。Lambda SQS 配置文档指出，FIFO 队列的最大批处理大小为 10，而标准队列最高可达 10,000：[Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)。

### B. 减小批处理大小，提高 SQS 吞吐量配额，并申请提高并发配额

减小批处理大小可以限制单条错误记录影响的有效记录数量，但也会降低每次调用的效率，并且不能隔离无效消息。所述症状表明是处理失败和重试，而不是 SQS 消息吞吐量瓶颈。提高并发性同样无法解决默认行为：失败调用会将整个批次返回队列；此外，Lambda 在发生函数代码失败后会应用退避并降低并发性。部分批处理响应和 DLQ 可直接解决实际原因。请参阅 [Handling errors for an SQS event source in Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-errorhandling.html)。

### C. 增大批处理大小，启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration，并配置 DLQ

DLQ 很有用，但该选项缺少部分批处理响应。在错误消息达到 DLQ 的 `maxReceiveCount` 之前，其整个批次仍可能被持续重试，其中包括有效消息。当一个项目失败时，增大批处理大小可能会使更多有效消息遭受不必要的重试。S3 Transfer Acceleration 与已识别的 Lambda–SQS 批处理失败问题无关，无法阻止无效队列消息消耗 Lambda 容量。AWS 文档指出，部分批处理响应仅将失败消息返回队列，随后反复失败的消息可以被发送到 DLQ：[Creating and configuring an Amazon SQS event source mapping](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-sqs-configure.html)。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on AWS Lambda and sends logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. An Amazon Kinesis data stream is subscribed to the log groups in CloudWatch Logs. A single consumer Lambda function processes the logs from the data stream and stores the logs in an Amazon S3 bucket.
