The company’s DevOps team has noticed high latency during the processing and ingestion of some logs. Which combination of steps will reduce the latency? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a data stream consumer with enhanced fan-out. Set the Lambda function that processes the logs as the consumer.
options.B: Increase the ParallelizationFactor setting in the Lambda event source mapping.
options.C: Configure reserved concurrency for the Lambda function that processes the logs.
options.D: Increase the batch size in the Kinesis data stream.
options.E: Turn off the ReportBatchItemFailures setting in the Lambda event source mapping.
options.F: Increase the number of shards in the Kinesis data stream.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

CloudWatch Logs delivers log records to a Kinesis data stream, and one Lambda consumer processes those records and writes them to S3. The objective is to reduce end-to-end latency by improving Kinesis record delivery and increasing the rate at which Lambda can process records concurrently.

## Correct answers: A, B, and F

### A. Create an enhanced fan-out consumer

Enhanced fan-out gives the Lambda consumer dedicated read throughput for each shard and pushes records over a long-lived HTTP/2 connection. AWS explicitly recommends enhanced fan-out to **minimize latency and maximize read throughput**. Even with one consumer, AWS documents a typical propagation delay of approximately 70 ms for enhanced fan-out compared with approximately 200 ms for a shared-throughput consumer. Therefore, this directly reduces Kinesis-to-Lambda delivery latency.

References: [Lambda polling and batching for Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html) and [shared throughput compared with enhanced fan-out](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/enhanced-consumers.html).

### B. Increase `ParallelizationFactor`

By default, Lambda processes one batch at a time from each Kinesis shard. `ParallelizationFactor` allows Lambda to process up to 10 concurrent batches from each shard while preserving ordering at the partition-key level. AWS states that this setting helps increase processing throughput when data volume is volatile and `IteratorAge` is high. Increasing it therefore helps the consumer catch up more quickly and reduces record-processing latency.

Reference: [Lambda polling and batching for Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html).

### F. Increase the number of Kinesis shards

Each shard can be processed independently. Adding shards creates more opportunities for Lambda to process batches concurrently and increases the stream's aggregate capacity. AWS specifically states that adding shards increases the speed at which the Lambda function processes records. This reduces backlog and iterator age when the existing shard count is insufficient.

Reference: [Lambda polling and batching for Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### C. Configure reserved concurrency

Reserved concurrency protects a function from other functions consuming all available account concurrency, but it also places an upper bound on that function's concurrency. It does not pre-initialize execution environments and does not inherently increase Kinesis shard-level processing parallelism. This would be useful if monitoring showed that the consumer was being throttled because account concurrency was unavailable, but the scenario does not identify account-level concurrency contention. `ParallelizationFactor` and additional shards are the direct processing-scale changes here.

Reference: [Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-concurrency.html).

### D. Increase the batch size in the Kinesis data stream

Batch size is a property of the **Lambda event source mapping**, not a setting that is increased “in the Kinesis data stream.” A larger Lambda batch can amortize invocation overhead and improve throughput in some workloads, but it does not add shard capacity or concurrent processing paths. Depending on batching-window configuration, waiting to accumulate records can also add latency. It is not one of the three direct latency-reduction measures in this scenario.

Reference: [Lambda event source mapping batching behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-eventsourcemapping.html).

### E. Turn off `ReportBatchItemFailures`

`ReportBatchItemFailures` permits the function to report partial batch success so that Lambda retries from the failed record instead of treating the whole batch as failed. AWS states that enabling this feature can reduce retries. Turning it off can cause more successful records to be reprocessed and can hold up processing on the affected shard, potentially increasing rather than reducing latency.

Reference: [Partial batch responses for Kinesis and Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-kinesis-batchfailurereporting.html).

**Answer: A, B, F**

zh.question: 一家公司有一个运行在 AWS Lambda 上并将日志发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 的应用程序。Amazon Kinesis 数据流订阅了 CloudWatch Logs 中的日志组。一个消费者 Lambda 函数处理来自该数据流的日志，并将日志存储到 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该公司的 DevOps 团队发现某些日志在处理和摄取期间存在高延迟。哪种步骤组合可以降低延迟？（选择三个。）

options.A: 创建一个启用了 enhanced fan-out 的数据流消费者。将处理日志的 Lambda 函数设置为该消费者。
options.B: 增加 Lambda event source mapping 中的 ParallelizationFactor 设置。
options.C: 为处理日志的 Lambda 函数配置 reserved concurrency。
options.D: 增加 Kinesis 数据流中的 batch size。
options.E: 在 Lambda event source mapping 中关闭 ReportBatchItemFailures 设置。
options.F: 增加 Kinesis 数据流中的分片数量。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

CloudWatch Logs 将日志记录传递到 Kinesis 数据流，一个 Lambda 消费者处理这些记录并将其写入 S3。目标是通过改善 Kinesis 记录传递以及提高 Lambda 并发处理记录的速率来降低端到端延迟。

## 正确答案：A、B 和 F

### A. 创建 enhanced fan-out 消费者

Enhanced fan-out 为 Lambda 消费者提供每个分片的专用读取吞吐量，并通过持久 HTTP/2 连接推送记录。AWS 明确建议使用 enhanced fan-out 来**最大限度地降低延迟并提高读取吞吐量**。即使只有一个消费者，AWS 文档也指出，enhanced fan-out 的典型传播延迟约为 70 ms，而共享吞吐量消费者约为 200 ms。因此，这会直接降低从 Kinesis 到 Lambda 的传递延迟。

参考资料：[Lambda polling and batching for Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html) 和 [shared throughput compared with enhanced fan-out](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/streams/latest/dev/enhanced-consumers.html)。

### B. 增加 `ParallelizationFactor`

默认情况下，Lambda 每次从每个 Kinesis 分片处理一个批次。`ParallelizationFactor` 允许 Lambda 从每个分片最多并发处理 10 个批次，同时在分区键级别保持顺序。AWS 表示，当数据量波动较大且 `IteratorAge` 较高时，此设置有助于提高处理吞吐量。因此，增加该值有助于消费者更快地追上积压数据，并降低记录处理延迟。

参考资料：[Lambda polling and batching for Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)。

### F. 增加 Kinesis 分片数量

每个分片都可以独立处理。添加分片会创造更多让 Lambda 并发处理批次的机会，并提高数据流的总容量。AWS 明确指出，添加分片会提高 Lambda 函数处理记录的速度。当现有分片数量不足时，这会减少积压和 iterator age。

参考资料：[Lambda polling and batching for Kinesis](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-kinesis.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### C. 配置 reserved concurrency

Reserved concurrency 可保护某个函数，避免其他函数耗尽所有可用的账户并发容量，但它也会为该函数的并发量设置上限。它不会预先初始化执行环境，也不会从根本上增加 Kinesis 分片级别的处理并行度。如果监控显示消费者由于账户并发容量不可用而被限流，这会很有用；但题目并未指出存在账户级别的并发争用。`ParallelizationFactor` 和增加分片才是此处直接的处理扩展措施。

参考资料：[Lambda reserved concurrency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-concurrency.html)。

### D. 增加 Kinesis 数据流中的 batch size

Batch size 是 **Lambda event source mapping** 的属性，而不是可以在“Kinesis 数据流中”增加的设置。较大的 Lambda 批次在某些工作负载中可以分摊调用开销并提高吞吐量，但它不会增加分片容量或并发处理路径。根据 batching window 配置的不同，等待累积记录还可能增加延迟。这不是本场景中三项直接降低延迟的措施之一。

参考资料：[Lambda event source mapping batching behavior](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-eventsourcemapping.html)。

### E. 关闭 `ReportBatchItemFailures`

`ReportBatchItemFailures` 允许函数报告部分批次成功，以便 Lambda 从失败记录开始重试，而不是将整个批次视为失败。AWS 表示，启用此功能可以减少重试。关闭它可能导致更多已成功的记录被重新处理，并可能阻塞受影响分片上的处理，因此可能增加而非降低延迟。

参考资料：[Partial batch responses for Kinesis and Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/services-kinesis-batchfailurereporting.html)。

**答案：A、B、F**

en.question: A company operates sensitive workloads across the AWS accounts that are in the company's organization in AWS Organizations. The company uses an IP address range to delegate IP addresses for Amazon VPC CIDR blocks and all non-cloud hardware. The company needs a solution that prevents principals that are outside the company’s IP address range from performing AWS actions in the organization's accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure AWS Firewall Manager for the organization. Create an AWS Network Firewall policy that allows only source traffic from the company's IP address range. Set the policy scope to all accounts in the organization.
options.B: In Organizations, create an SCP that denies source IP addresses that are outside of the company’s IP address range. Attach the SCP to the organization's root.
options.C: Configure Amazon GuardDuty for the organization. Create a GuardDuty trusted IP address list for the company's IP range. Activate the trusted IP list for the organization.
options.D: In Organizations, create an SCP that allows source IP addresses that are inside of the company’s IP address range. Attach the SCP to the organization's root.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a **preventive, organization-wide authorization control** that blocks AWS API and console actions when the request originates outside approved corporate IP ranges. This is an identity-policy evaluation problem, not merely a VPC traffic-filtering or threat-detection problem.

## Correct answer: B

**Create an SCP that explicitly denies requests from source IP addresses outside the corporate range, and attach it to the organization root.**

The SCP can use an explicit `Deny` with the `NotIpAddress` condition operator and the global condition key `aws:SourceIp`, conceptually as follows:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": {
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Action": "*",
    "Resource": "*",
    "Condition": {
      "NotIpAddress": {
        "aws:SourceIp": [
          "CORPORATE-CIDR-1",
          "CORPORATE-CIDR-2"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

AWS provides the same pattern in its official policy example: a `Deny` on all actions when `aws:SourceIp` is not in the specified CIDR ranges. The policy acts as a guardrail and does not itself grant permissions. See [AWS: Denies access to AWS based on the source IP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_aws_deny-ip.html).

Attaching this explicit-deny SCP to the organization root makes the restriction effective for member accounts beneath the root. AWS Organizations documents that a `Deny` at any level from the root to the account overrides applicable allows, and specifically that a root-level deny affects all accounts underneath it. See [SCP evaluation and strategy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html).

In a production implementation, the company should test the SCP carefully and account for request paths such as VPC endpoints and AWS service-to-service calls. Also, SCPs do not restrict actions performed in the Organizations management account or through service-linked roles; those require separate controls. See [Tasks and entities not restricted by SCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Firewall Manager with an AWS Network Firewall policy

AWS Firewall Manager can centrally deploy and manage Network Firewall protections for VPCs across an organization. However, Network Firewall filters **network traffic routed through firewall endpoints in VPCs**. It does not establish an organization-wide identity authorization boundary for every AWS API or console action made by principals.

For example, a principal can call an AWS service's public API endpoint without that control-plane request traversing the workload VPC's Network Firewall endpoint. AWS describes Firewall Manager Network Firewall policies as protections for filtering VPC network traffic, not as IAM authorization controls. See [Using AWS Network Firewall policies in Firewall Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/network-firewall-policies.html).

### C. GuardDuty trusted IP address list

GuardDuty is a threat-detection service. A trusted IP list changes finding generation: trusted IPs prevent certain non-DNS GuardDuty findings from being generated. It does **not** allow or deny AWS API actions and therefore cannot enforce the required access restriction. See [Managing Amazon GuardDuty findings](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/findings_management.html).

### D. SCP that allows requests from inside the corporate IP range

An allow-only SCP is not the appropriate standalone solution as described. AWS Organizations attaches the managed `FullAWSAccess` SCP by default. Merely attaching another SCP with a conditional `Allow` does not create an explicit denial for requests originating outside the range while broader applicable allows remain.

An explicit `Deny` is the reliable guardrail because it overrides allows at lower levels and in IAM policies. An allow-list SCP design could be constructed only by deliberately replacing broader allow SCPs and ensuring the required allow exists at every level from the root to each account, which option D does not specify. The documented deny-by-IP pattern in option B directly meets the requirement.

**Therefore, B is the best answer.**

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中该公司组织内的 AWS 账户中运行敏感工作负载。该公司使用一个 IP 地址范围为 Amazon VPC CIDR 块和所有非云硬件分配 IP 地址。该公司需要一种解决方案，以防止公司 IP 地址范围之外的主体在组织的账户中执行 AWS 操作。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为组织配置 AWS Firewall Manager。创建一个 AWS Network Firewall 策略，仅允许来自公司 IP 地址范围的源流量。将策略范围设置为组织中的所有账户。
options.B: 在 Organizations 中，创建一个 SCP，拒绝来自公司 IP 地址范围之外的源 IP 地址。将 SCP 附加到组织的根。
options.C: 为组织配置 Amazon GuardDuty。为公司的 IP 范围创建 GuardDuty 受信任 IP 地址列表。为组织激活该受信任 IP 列表。
options.D: 在 Organizations 中，创建一个 SCP，允许来自公司 IP 地址范围之内的源 IP 地址。将 SCP 附加到组织的根。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

公司需要一种**预防性的、覆盖整个组织的授权控制措施**，以在请求源自获批公司 IP 范围之外时阻止 AWS API 和控制台操作。这是一个身份策略评估问题，而不仅仅是 VPC 流量筛选或威胁检测问题。

## 正确答案：B

**创建一个 SCP，显式拒绝源 IP 地址位于公司范围之外的请求，并将其附加到组织根。**

该 SCP 可以结合全局条件键 `aws:SourceIp` 使用带有 `NotIpAddress` 条件运算符的显式 `Deny`，概念如下：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": {
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Action": "*",
    "Resource": "*",
    "Condition": {
      "NotIpAddress": {
        "aws:SourceIp": [
          "CORPORATE-CIDR-1",
          "CORPORATE-CIDR-2"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

AWS 在其官方策略示例中提供了相同的模式：当 `aws:SourceIp` 不在指定 CIDR 范围内时，拒绝所有操作。该策略充当防护栏，本身不授予权限。请参阅 [AWS：基于源 IP 拒绝对 AWS 的访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_examples_aws_deny-ip.html)。

将此显式拒绝 SCP 附加到组织根，可使该限制对根下的成员账户生效。AWS Organizations 文档说明，从根到账户的任意层级的 `Deny` 都会覆盖适用的允许，并且特别指出根级别的拒绝会影响其下的所有账户。请参阅 [SCP 评估和策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)。

在生产实施中，公司应仔细测试 SCP，并考虑 VPC 终端节点和 AWS 服务到服务调用等请求路径。此外，SCP 不限制在 Organizations 管理账户中执行的操作，也不限制通过服务相关角色执行的操作；这些操作需要单独的控制措施。请参阅 [不受 SCP 限制的任务和实体](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 使用 AWS Network Firewall 策略的 Firewall Manager

AWS Firewall Manager 可以在整个组织的 VPC 中集中部署和管理 Network Firewall 防护。但是，Network Firewall 筛选的是**通过 VPC 中防火墙终端节点路由的网络流量**。它不会为主体执行的每一个 AWS API 或控制台操作建立覆盖整个组织的身份授权边界。

例如，主体可以调用 AWS 服务的公共 API 终端节点，而无需让该控制平面请求穿过工作负载 VPC 的 Network Firewall 终端节点。AWS 将 Firewall Manager Network Firewall 策略描述为用于筛选 VPC 网络流量的保护措施，而不是 IAM 授权控制。请参阅 [在 Firewall Manager 中使用 AWS Network Firewall 策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/waf/latest/developerguide/network-firewall-policies.html)。

### C. GuardDuty 受信任 IP 地址列表

GuardDuty 是一项威胁检测服务。受信任 IP 列表会改变发现结果的生成方式：受信任 IP 会阻止生成某些非 DNS GuardDuty 发现结果。它**不会**允许或拒绝 AWS API 操作，因此无法强制执行所需的访问限制。请参阅 [管理 Amazon GuardDuty 发现结果](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/findings_management.html)。

### D. 允许来自公司 IP 范围之内请求的 SCP

如题目所述，仅允许的 SCP 并不是适当的独立解决方案。AWS Organizations 默认附加托管的 `FullAWSAccess` SCP。仅附加另一个带条件 `Allow` 的 SCP，并不会在更广泛的适用允许仍然存在时，对源自该范围之外的请求创建显式拒绝。

显式 `Deny` 是可靠的防护栏，因为它会覆盖较低层级和 IAM 策略中的允许。只有在刻意替换更广泛的允许 SCP，并确保从根到每个账户的每个层级都存在所需允许时，才可以构建允许列表 SCP 设计，而选项 D 并未说明这些内容。选项 B 中有文档记录的基于 IP 的拒绝模式可直接满足要求。

**因此，B 是最佳答案。**

en.question: A company deploys an application in two AWS Regions. The application currently uses an Amazon S3 bucket in the primary Region to store data. A DevOps engineer needs to ensure that the application is highly available in both Regions. The DevOps engineer has created a new S3 bucket in the secondary Region. All existing and new objects must be in both S3 buckets. The application must fail over between the Regions with no data loss. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a new IAM role that allows the Amazon S3 and S3 Batch Operations service principals to assume the role that has the necessary permissions for S3 replication.
options.B: Create a new IAM role that allows the AWS Batch service principal to assume the role that has the necessary permissions for S3 replication.
options.C: Create an S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) rule on the source S3 bucket. Configure the rule to use the IAM role for Amazon S3 to replicate to the target S3 bucket.
options.D: Create a two-way replication rule on the source S3 bucket. Configure the rule to use the IAM role for Amazon S3 to replicate to the target S3 bucket.
options.E: Create an AWS Batch job that has an AWS Fargate orchestration type. Configure the job to use the IAM role for AWS Batch. Specify a Bash command to use the AWS CLI to synchronize the contents of the source S3 bucket and the target S3 bucket
options.F: Create an operation in S3 Batch Operations to replicate the contents of the source S3 bucket to the target S3 bucket. Configure the operation to use the IAM role for Amazon S3.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A, D, and F

The company needs to solve three separate requirements:

1. **Replicate future writes in both directions**, because either Region can become active after failover.
2. **Backfill the objects that already exist** in the original bucket.
3. **Provide the correct IAM trust and permissions** for both continuous S3 replication and the backfill operation.

### A. Create an IAM role for Amazon S3 and S3 Batch Operations

This is correct. Continuous S3 replication and S3 Batch Replication must be authorized to perform the required reads and replication actions. The role therefore needs trust relationships for the relevant service principals:

- `s3.amazonaws.com` for live S3 replication
- `batchoperations.s3.amazonaws.com` for the S3 Batch Replication job

The role must also have the required permissions on the source and destination buckets and objects. AWS documents the IAM requirements for both live replication and S3 Batch Replication in [Setting up permissions for live replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/setting-repl-config-perm-overview.html).

### D. Create two-way replication between the buckets

This is correct. Once the application fails over, it can write objects to the secondary bucket. Those writes must be replicated back to the original bucket so that the buckets do not diverge and a later failback remains possible.

AWS defines **two-way replication**, also called bidirectional replication, as replication in both directions:

- Primary bucket → secondary bucket
- Secondary bucket → primary bucket

Although this is implemented through two underlying directional replication rules, AWS uses the term “two-way replication rule” for the overall configuration. It is the appropriate configuration for keeping buckets in different Regions synchronized for failover scenarios. See [Creating two-way replication rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mrap-create-two-way-replication-rules.html).

### F. Use S3 Batch Operations to replicate the existing objects

This is correct. Live S3 replication does not automatically copy objects that existed before the replication configuration was enabled. Because the original bucket already contains data and the secondary bucket is new, the existing objects require a one-time backfill.

**S3 Batch Replication** is the native managed feature for replicating existing objects on demand. After the historical objects have been copied, the two-way live replication configuration handles subsequent writes in either Region. See [Creating a Batch Replication job for a new replication configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-new-config.html) and [Replicating existing objects with S3 Batch Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-batch.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create a role trusted by AWS Batch

AWS Batch is a compute job-scheduling service and is different from **S3 Batch Operations**. An S3 Batch Replication job uses the S3 Batch Operations service principal, `batchoperations.s3.amazonaws.com`, not the AWS Batch service principal. Therefore, this role would not establish the correct trust relationship for the required S3 replication services. See [S3 replication IAM permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/setting-repl-config-perm-overview.html).

### C. Configure only one-way Cross-Region Replication

A single CRR rule from the primary bucket to the secondary bucket would copy new primary-Region writes, but it would not copy objects written to the secondary bucket after failover back to the primary bucket. The buckets could then diverge, making subsequent failback unsafe. The workload therefore requires the bidirectional configuration represented by D, not only one directional CRR rule. See [Creating two-way replication rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mrap-create-two-way-replication-rules.html).

### E. Run `aws s3 sync` from an AWS Batch job on Fargate

This introduces unnecessary custom infrastructure and operations, including an AWS Batch job definition, Fargate execution, scheduling, retries, monitoring, and custom synchronization logic. It also does not establish continuous bidirectional S3 replication. S3 Batch Replication is the purpose-built managed mechanism for backfilling objects that existed before live replication was configured, making F the more operationally efficient choice. See [S3 Batch Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-batch.html).

## Replication timing consideration

Amazon S3 replication is asynchronous. Even S3 Replication Time Control provides a service-level objective to replicate 99.99% of new objects within 15 minutes rather than synchronous zero-RPO replication. Thus, “no data loss” in this question refers to backfilling all existing data and maintaining bidirectional replication so that writes made in either active Region are copied to the other bucket; it should not be interpreted as a guarantee that no acknowledged write can ever be pending during an abrupt Regional failure. AWS describes the asynchronous replication model in the [Amazon S3 replication overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html).

zh.question: 某公司在两个 AWS 区域中部署了一套应用程序。该应用程序目前使用主区域中的一个 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储数据。一名 DevOps 工程师需要确保该应用程序在两个区域中都具有高可用性。该 DevOps 工程师已在辅助区域中创建了一个新的 S3 存储桶。所有现有对象和新对象都必须存在于两个 S3 存储桶中。应用程序必须能够在区域之间故障转移，且不丢失数据。哪种步骤组合能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 创建一个新的 IAM 角色，允许 Amazon S3 和 S3 Batch Operations 服务主体代入该角色；该角色具有 S3 复制所需的权限。
options.B: 创建一个新的 IAM 角色，允许 AWS Batch 服务主体代入该角色；该角色具有 S3 复制所需的权限。
options.C: 在源 S3 存储桶上创建 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) 规则。配置该规则使用适用于 Amazon S3 的 IAM 角色向目标 S3 存储桶进行复制。
options.D: 在源 S3 存储桶上创建双向复制规则。配置该规则使用适用于 Amazon S3 的 IAM 角色向目标 S3 存储桶进行复制。
options.E: 创建一个使用 AWS Fargate 编排类型的 AWS Batch 作业。配置该作业使用适用于 AWS Batch 的 IAM 角色。指定一个 Bash 命令，使用 AWS CLI 同步源 S3 存储桶和目标 S3 存储桶的内容。
options.F: 在 S3 Batch Operations 中创建一个操作，将源 S3 存储桶的内容复制到目标 S3 存储桶。配置该操作使用适用于 Amazon S3 的 IAM 角色。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A、D 和 F

公司需要解决三个独立的要求：

1. **在两个方向上复制未来写入的数据**，因为故障转移后任一区域都可能成为活动区域。
2. **回填原始存储桶中已经存在的对象**。
3. **为持续 S3 复制和回填操作提供正确的 IAM 信任关系和权限**。

### A. 为 Amazon S3 和 S3 Batch Operations 创建 IAM 角色

此选项正确。必须授权持续 S3 复制和 S3 Batch Replication 执行所需的读取和复制操作。因此，该角色需要为相关服务主体建立信任关系：

- 用于实时 S3 复制的 `s3.amazonaws.com`
- 用于 S3 Batch Replication 作业的 `batchoperations.s3.amazonaws.com`

该角色还必须拥有源存储桶和目标存储桶及其中对象所需的权限。AWS 在[设置实时复制的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/setting-repl-config-perm-overview.html)中记录了实时复制和 S3 Batch Replication 的 IAM 要求。

### D. 在存储桶之间创建双向复制

此选项正确。应用程序故障转移后，可以向辅助存储桶写入对象。这些写入必须复制回原始存储桶，以防止两个存储桶的数据出现分歧，并确保之后仍可故障恢复。

AWS 将**双向复制**（two-way replication），也称为双向复制（bidirectional replication），定义为两个方向上的复制：

- 主存储桶 → 辅助存储桶
- 辅助存储桶 → 主存储桶

虽然其通过两条底层的单向复制规则实现，但 AWS 使用“two-way replication rule”一词来表示整体配置。对于在不同区域中保持存储桶同步以支持故障转移的场景，这是适当的配置。请参阅[创建双向复制规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mrap-create-two-way-replication-rules.html)。

### F. 使用 S3 Batch Operations 复制现有对象

此选项正确。实时 S3 复制不会自动复制在启用复制配置之前已经存在的对象。由于原始存储桶已经包含数据且辅助存储桶是新建的，因此必须对现有对象执行一次性回填。

**S3 Batch Replication** 是用于按需复制现有对象的原生托管功能。复制完历史对象后，双向实时复制配置将处理任一区域中的后续写入。请参阅[为新的复制配置创建 Batch Replication 作业](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-new-config.html)和[使用 S3 Batch Replication 复制现有对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-batch.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 创建由 AWS Batch 信任的角色

AWS Batch 是一项计算作业调度服务，不同于 **S3 Batch Operations**。S3 Batch Replication 作业使用的是 S3 Batch Operations 服务主体 `batchoperations.s3.amazonaws.com`，而不是 AWS Batch 服务主体。因此，该角色无法为所需的 S3 复制服务建立正确的信任关系。请参阅[S3 复制 IAM 权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/setting-repl-config-perm-overview.html)。

### C. 仅配置单向 Cross-Region Replication

从主存储桶到辅助存储桶的一条 CRR 规则可以复制主区域中新写入的数据，但无法将故障转移后写入辅助存储桶的对象复制回主存储桶。这样两个存储桶的数据可能出现分歧，导致后续故障恢复不安全。因此，该工作负载需要 D 所代表的双向配置，而非仅一条单向 CRR 规则。请参阅[创建双向复制规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/mrap-create-two-way-replication-rules.html)。

### E. 在 Fargate 上运行 AWS Batch 作业来执行 `aws s3 sync`

这会引入不必要的自定义基础设施和运维工作，包括 AWS Batch 作业定义、Fargate 执行、调度、重试、监控以及自定义同步逻辑。它也无法建立持续的双向 S3 复制。S3 Batch Replication 是专门用于回填在配置实时复制之前已存在对象的托管机制，因此 F 是运营效率更高的选择。请参阅[S3 Batch Replication](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/s3-batch-replication-batch.html)。

## 复制时序注意事项

Amazon S3 复制是异步的。即使是 S3 Replication Time Control，提供的也是在 15 分钟内复制 99.99% 新对象的服务级别目标，而不是同步的零 RPO 复制。因此，本题中的“无数据丢失”是指回填所有现有数据并维持双向复制，以便在任一活动区域中写入的数据都会复制到另一个存储桶；不应将其理解为保证在突发区域故障期间绝不会有任何已确认写入仍处于待复制状态。AWS 在[Amazon S3 复制概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication.html)中介绍了异步复制模型。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. The company needs an automated process across all AWS accounts to isolate any compromised Amazon EC2 instances when the instances receive a specific tag. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy the CloudFormation stacks in all AWS accounts.
options.B: Create an SCP that has a Deny statement for the ec2:* action with a condition of "aws:RequestTag/isolation": false.
options.C: Attach the SCP to the root of the organization.
options.D: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that creates an EC2 instance role that has no IAM policies attached. Configure the template to have a security group that has an explicit Deny rule on all traffic. Use the CloudFormation template to create an AWS Lambda function that attaches the IAM role to instances. Configure the Lambda function to add a network ACL. Set up an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function when a specific tag is applied to a compromised EC2 instance.
options.E: Create an AWS CloudFormation template that creates an EC2 instance role that has no IAM policies attached. Configure the template to have a security group that has no inbound rules or outbound rules. Use the CloudFormation template to create an AWS Lambda function that attaches the IAM role to instances. Configure the Lambda function to replace any existing security groups with the new security group. Set up an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function when a specific tag is applied to a compromised EC2 instance.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an **event-driven remediation mechanism** that is available across its AWS accounts and that **network-isolates a compromised EC2 instance when an isolation tag is applied**. This requires:

1. A multi-account deployment mechanism for the remediation resources.
2. An automated response that detects the tag change and replaces the instance's network access with a quarantine security group.

## Correct answers: A and E

### A. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to deploy the CloudFormation stacks in all AWS accounts

CloudFormation StackSets with service-managed permissions can target an entire AWS Organization or selected organizational units, making StackSets the appropriate mechanism for consistently deploying the Lambda function, EventBridge rule, IAM resources, and quarantine security group to the organization's member accounts. AWS documents that a StackSet can target the entire organization and include all accounts in the targeted OUs. See [Create a CloudFormation StackSet with service-managed permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html).

This provides the required organization-wide deployment layer. Strictly, service-managed StackSets do not deploy to the Organizations management account, so that account would need a separate deployment if it also runs workloads; in the normal exam interpretation, the requirement refers to the managed member accounts.

### E. Create an isolation role and a security group with no inbound or outbound rules, and use EventBridge and Lambda to apply them

This option provides the actual automated isolation workflow:

- An EventBridge rule detects a tag change on an EC2 instance.
- EventBridge invokes Lambda.
- Lambda replaces the instance's existing security groups with the quarantine security group.
- With no inbound or outbound rules, the quarantine security group allows no ordinary inbound or outbound network traffic.
- Replacing the existing security groups is important because rules from multiple attached security groups are aggregated; merely adding a restrictive group would not override permissions from existing groups.
- Replacing the instance role with one that has no policies also removes permissions available through the instance profile.

AWS provides an example of an EventBridge rule matching `Tag Change on Resource` events for EC2 instances and invoking Lambda in [Step 4: Create the EventBridge rule that launches the function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/tag-editor/latest/userguide/monitor-example.html). AWS also documents that security groups support only allow rules, that a group with no inbound rules allows no inbound traffic, and that removing all outbound rules prevents outbound traffic. See [Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create an SCP that denies `ec2:*` based on `aws:RequestTag/isolation`

This does not isolate the instance's network traffic. An SCP limits the maximum API permissions available to IAM principals in member accounts; it is not a VPC firewall and does not remove the instance's current network connectivity. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Additionally, `aws:RequestTag/isolation` evaluates a tag supplied as part of an API request. To test a tag already attached to a target resource, the relevant global condition-key form is `aws:ResourceTag/isolation`. AWS explains this distinction in [Tag-based access control in AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_tagging_abac.html). The condition shown in the option is also incomplete policy syntax because it provides no condition operator such as `StringEquals`.

### C. Attach the SCP to the root of the organization

Attaching an SCP at the root would propagate its API-permission restrictions to member accounts, but it still would not perform network quarantine. It also depends on the unsuitable and incorrectly expressed SCP in option B. Therefore, B and C are governance controls, not the required automated incident-isolation workflow.

### D. Use a security group with an explicit deny rule and add a network ACL

This option is invalid because **security groups do not support explicit deny rules**; they support allow rules only. Furthermore, a network ACL operates at the **subnet level**, affecting all instances in its associated subnet rather than isolating only the tagged compromised instance. AWS summarizes these distinctions in [Compare security groups and network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/infrastructure-security.html).

Therefore, **A and E** together provide the intended multi-account, tag-triggered EC2 quarantine solution.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织来管理多个 AWS 账户。该公司需要一个跨所有 AWS 账户的自动化流程，以便在任何已遭入侵的 Amazon EC2 实例获得特定标签时隔离该实例。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 在所有 AWS 账户中部署 CloudFormation 堆栈。
options.B: 创建一个 SCP，其中包含针对 `ec2:*` 操作的 Deny 语句，条件为 `"aws:RequestTag/isolation": false`。
options.C: 将 SCP 附加到组织的根节点。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，该模板创建一个未附加任何 IAM 策略的 EC2 实例角色。将模板配置为具有一个对所有流量设有显式 Deny 规则的安全组。使用 CloudFormation 模板创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将 IAM 角色附加到实例。配置 Lambda 函数以添加网络 ACL。设置一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在特定标签应用于已遭入侵的 EC2 实例时调用 Lambda 函数。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，该模板创建一个未附加任何 IAM 策略的 EC2 实例角色。将模板配置为具有一个没有入站规则或出站规则的安全组。使用 CloudFormation 模板创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数将 IAM 角色附加到实例。配置 Lambda 函数以使用新安全组替换所有现有安全组。设置一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在特定标签应用于已遭入侵的 EC2 实例时调用 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一种**事件驱动的修复机制**，该机制可在其 AWS 账户中使用，并且能够在对已遭入侵的 EC2 实例应用隔离标签时，**对该实例进行网络隔离**。这需要：

1. 一种用于部署修复资源的多账户部署机制。
2. 一种自动响应机制，用于检测标签更改，并以隔离安全组替换实例的网络访问配置。

## 正确答案：A 和 E

### A. 使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 在所有 AWS 账户中部署 CloudFormation 堆栈

具备服务托管权限的 CloudFormation StackSets 可以面向整个 AWS Organization 或选定的组织单元，因此 StackSets 是一种适当的机制，可将 Lambda 函数、EventBridge 规则、IAM 资源和隔离安全组一致地部署到组织的成员账户中。AWS 文档说明，StackSet 可以面向整个组织，并包含目标 OU 中的所有账户。请参阅 [Create a CloudFormation StackSet with service-managed permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)。

这提供了所需的组织范围部署层。严格来说，服务托管 StackSets 不会部署到 Organizations 管理账户；因此，如果该账户也运行工作负载，则需要单独部署。按照通常的考试理解，此要求指的是受管理的成员账户。

### E. 创建隔离角色和没有入站或出站规则的安全组，并使用 EventBridge 和 Lambda 应用它们

此选项提供了实际的自动隔离工作流：

- EventBridge 规则检测 EC2 实例上的标签变更。
- EventBridge 调用 Lambda。
- Lambda 使用隔离安全组替换实例现有的安全组。
- 由于没有入站或出站规则，隔离安全组不允许任何常规入站或出站网络流量。
- 替换现有安全组非常重要，因为附加的多个安全组中的规则会被汇总；仅添加一个限制性安全组不会覆盖现有安全组授予的权限。
- 将实例角色替换为没有策略的角色，也会移除可通过实例配置文件获得的权限。

AWS 提供了一个示例：EventBridge 规则可匹配 EC2 实例的 `Tag Change on Resource` 事件并调用 Lambda。请参阅 [Step 4: Create the EventBridge rule that launches the function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/tag-editor/latest/userguide/monitor-example.html)。AWS 还记录了安全组仅支持允许规则、没有入站规则的安全组不允许入站流量，以及移除所有出站规则会阻止出站流量。请参阅 [Security group rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/security-group-rules.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 创建一个基于 `aws:RequestTag/isolation` 拒绝 `ec2:*` 的 SCP

这不会隔离实例的网络流量。SCP 限制成员账户中 IAM 主体可获得的最大 API 权限；它不是 VPC 防火墙，也不会移除实例当前的网络连接。请参阅 [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

此外，`aws:RequestTag/isolation` 用于评估作为 API 请求一部分提供的标签。若要测试已附加到目标资源的标签，相关的全局条件键形式是 `aws:ResourceTag/isolation`。AWS 在 [Tag-based access control in AWS Organizations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_tagging_abac.html) 中解释了这种区别。该选项所示的条件也不是完整的策略语法，因为它没有提供诸如 `StringEquals` 的条件运算符。

### C. 将 SCP 附加到组织的根节点

在根节点附加 SCP 会将其 API 权限限制传播至成员账户，但仍无法执行网络隔离。它还依赖于选项 B 中不合适且表达错误的 SCP。因此，B 和 C 是治理控制措施，而非所需的自动化事件隔离工作流。

### D. 使用带有显式拒绝规则的安全组并添加网络 ACL

此选项无效，因为**安全组不支持显式拒绝规则**；它们仅支持允许规则。此外，网络 ACL 在**子网级别**运行，会影响关联子网中的所有实例，而不是只隔离带标签的已遭入侵实例。AWS 在 [Compare security groups and network ACLs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/infrastructure-security.html) 中总结了这些区别。

因此，**A 和 E** 共同提供了预期的多账户、由标签触发的 EC2 隔离解决方案。

en.question: A company manages multiple AWS accounts by using AWS Organizations with OUs for the different business divisions. The company is updating their corporate network to use new IP address ranges. The company has 10 Amazon S3 buckets in different AWS accounts. The S3 buckets store reports for the different divisions. The S3 bucket configurations allow only private corporate network IP addresses to access the S3 buckets. A DevOps engineer needs to change the range of IP addresses that have permission to access the contents of the S3 buckets. The DevOps engineer also needs to revoke the permissions of two OUs in the company. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new SCP that has two statements, one that allows access to the new range of IP addresses for all the S3 buckets and one that denies access to the old range of IP addresses for all the S3 buckets. Set a permissions boundary for the OrganizationAccountAccessRole role in the two OUs to deny access to the S3 buckets.
options.B: Create a new SCP that has a statement that allows only the new range of IP addresses to access the S3 buckets. Create another SCP that denies access to the S3 buckets. Attach the second SCP to the two OUs.
options.C: On all the S3 buckets, configure resource-based policies that allow only the new range of IP addresses to access the S3 buckets. Create a new SCP that denies access to the S3 buckets. Attach the SCP to the two OUs.
options.D: On all the S3 buckets, configure resource-based policies that allow only the new range of IP addresses to access the S3 buckets. Set a permissions boundary for the OrganizationAccountAccessRole role in the two OUs to deny access to the S3 buckets.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The solution must implement two different control scopes:

1. Update the network-based restriction on 10 specific S3 buckets so that access uses the **new corporate IP ranges**.
2. Revoke S3 access for all applicable principals in accounts under **two organizational units (OUs)**.

## Correct answer: C

Configure each S3 bucket's **resource-based bucket policy** with an `aws:SourceIp` condition for the new corporate CIDR ranges. Amazon S3 supports bucket-policy conditions based on source IP address; the AWS example uses `IpAddress` with `aws:SourceIp` to restrict `s3:GetObject` to an IP range. See [Bucket policy examples using condition keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/amazon-s3-policy-keys.html).

Then create an SCP that explicitly denies the required S3 actions and attach it to the two OUs. An SCP attached at an OU is inherited by the member accounts below that OU, and a deny at any level in an account's organizational path denies the permission. See [SCP evaluation — How SCPs work with Deny](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html).

This correctly separates:

- **Resource-level/network access control:** S3 bucket policies using the new IP ranges.
- **Organization-level account guardrails:** an SCP denying S3 access for the two OUs.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

An SCP does **not grant permissions**. It only establishes the maximum permissions available to IAM principals in member accounts. Therefore, an SCP `Allow` statement for the new IP range cannot by itself grant access to the buckets or replace the buckets' current IP-based resource policies. AWS explicitly states that SCPs never grant permissions. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Additionally, a permissions boundary on `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` would restrict only that specific role in each affected account. It would not revoke S3 access for every user and role in the two OUs.

### B

The deny SCP attached to the two OUs is appropriate, but the first SCP is not. Again, SCPs do not grant access, so an SCP that allows requests from the new IP range does not configure the S3 buckets to accept those requests. The IP restriction must be implemented through the buckets' resource-based policies.

### D

The S3 bucket-policy portion is correct, but the permissions-boundary portion is too narrow. A permissions boundary applies to an individual IAM **user or role** and sets that entity's maximum permissions. It is not an OU-level control and does not automatically restrict all principals in all accounts under an OU. See [Evaluating effective permissions with boundaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html).

Applying a boundary only to `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` would leave other IAM users, roles, root users, and sessions in those accounts unaffected by that boundary. An SCP is the appropriate mechanism because it applies organization-wide guardrails to member accounts beneath the targeted OUs.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理多个 AWS 账户，并为不同业务部门设置了 OU。该公司正在更新其企业网络以使用新的 IP 地址范围。该公司在不同的 AWS 账户中拥有 10 个 Amazon S3 存储桶。这些 S3 存储桶存储不同部门的报告。S3 存储桶配置仅允许来自私有企业网络 IP 地址的访问。DevOps 工程师需要更改有权访问 S3 存储桶内容的 IP 地址范围。DevOps 工程师还需要撤销公司中两个 OU 的权限。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 SCP，其中包含两个语句：一个语句允许新的 IP 地址范围访问所有 S3 存储桶，另一个语句拒绝旧的 IP 地址范围访问所有 S3 存储桶。为这两个 OU 中的 OrganizationAccountAccessRole 角色设置权限边界，以拒绝对 S3 存储桶的访问。
options.B: 创建一个新的 SCP，其中包含一条语句，仅允许新的 IP 地址范围访问 S3 存储桶。创建另一个拒绝访问 S3 存储桶的 SCP。将第二个 SCP 附加到这两个 OU。
options.C: 在所有 S3 存储桶上配置基于资源的策略，仅允许新的 IP 地址范围访问 S3 存储桶。创建一个拒绝访问 S3 存储桶的新 SCP。将该 SCP 附加到这两个 OU。
options.D: 在所有 S3 存储桶上配置基于资源的策略，仅允许新的 IP 地址范围访问 S3 存储桶。为这两个 OU 中的 OrganizationAccountAccessRole 角色设置权限边界，以拒绝对 S3 存储桶的访问。

zh.explanation:
## 问题要求

该解决方案必须实施两种不同范围的控制：

1. 更新 10 个特定 S3 存储桶基于网络的限制，以便访问使用**新的企业 IP 范围**。
2. 撤销隶属于**两个组织单位（OU）**的账户中所有适用主体的 S3 访问权限。

## 正确答案：C

为每个 S3 存储桶的**基于资源的存储桶策略**配置针对新企业 CIDR 范围的 `aws:SourceIp` 条件。Amazon S3 支持基于源 IP 地址的存储桶策略条件；AWS 示例使用 `IpAddress` 和 `aws:SourceIp` 将 `s3:GetObject` 限制为某个 IP 范围。请参阅 [使用条件键的存储桶策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/amazon-s3-policy-keys.html)。

然后，创建一个显式拒绝所需 S3 操作的 SCP，并将其附加到这两个 OU。附加到 OU 的 SCP 会由该 OU 下的成员账户继承，而账户组织路径中任何层级的拒绝都会拒绝该权限。请参阅 [SCP 评估 — SCP 如何与 Deny 配合工作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)。

这正确地区分了：

- **资源级别/网络访问控制：**使用新 IP 范围的 S3 存储桶策略。
- **组织级别账户防护机制：**针对这两个 OU 拒绝 S3 访问的 SCP。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A

SCP **不会授予权限**。它仅为成员账户中 IAM 主体可获得的权限设定最大范围。因此，针对新 IP 范围的 SCP `Allow` 语句本身无法授予对存储桶的访问权限，也无法替换存储桶当前基于 IP 的资源策略。AWS 明确指出，SCP 永远不会授予权限。请参阅 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

此外，针对 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` 的权限边界仅会限制每个受影响账户中的该特定角色。它无法撤销这两个 OU 中所有用户和角色的 S3 访问权限。

### B

附加到两个 OU 的拒绝 SCP 是合适的，但第一个 SCP 不合适。再次说明，SCP 不会授予访问权限，因此允许来自新 IP 范围的请求的 SCP 不会将 S3 存储桶配置为接受这些请求。IP 限制必须通过存储桶的基于资源的策略实施。

### D

S3 存储桶策略部分是正确的，但权限边界部分的范围过窄。权限边界应用于单个 IAM **用户或角色**，并设置该实体的最大权限。它不是 OU 级别的控制措施，也不会自动限制 OU 下所有账户中的全部主体。请参阅 [使用边界评估有效权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html)。

仅将边界应用于 `OrganizationAccountAccessRole` 不会影响这些账户中的其他 IAM 用户、角色、根用户和会话。SCP 才是适当的机制，因为它会对目标 OU 下成员账户实施组织范围的防护机制。

en.question: A company has started using AWS across several teams. Each team has multiple accounts and unique security profiles. The company manages the accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations. Each account has its own configuration and security controls. The company's DevOps team wants to use preventive and detective controls to govern all accounts. The DevOps team needs to ensure the security of accounts now and in the future as the company creates new accounts in the organization. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Organizations to create OUs that have appropriate SCPs attached for each team. Place team accounts in the appropriate OUs to apply security controls. Create any new team accounts in the appropriate OUs.
options.B: Create an AWS Control Tower landing zone. Configure OUs and appropriate controls in AWS Control Tower for the existing teams. Configure trusted access for AWS Control Tower. Enroll the existing accounts in the appropriate OUs that match the appropriate security policies for each team. Use AWS Control Tower to provision any new accounts.
options.C: Create AWS CloudFormation stack sets in the organization's management account. Configure a stack set that deploys AWS Config with configuration rules and remediation actions for all controls to each account in the organization. Update the stack sets to deploy to new accounts as the accounts are created.
options.D: Configure AWS Config to manage the AWS Config rules across all AWS accounts in the organization. Deploy conformance packs that provide AWS Config rules and remediation actions across the organization.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

The company needs a centrally governed multi-account environment that:

- Supports different security profiles for different teams through OUs.
- Applies both **preventive** and **detective** controls.
- Brings existing accounts under governance.
- Ensures that newly created accounts are governed consistently.

## Correct answer: B

**Create an AWS Control Tower landing zone, configure team-specific OUs and controls, enroll the existing accounts, and provision new accounts through AWS Control Tower.**

AWS Control Tower is purpose-built to establish and govern a multi-account landing zone. During landing zone setup, it applies mandatory **preventive controls** to enforce policies and mandatory **detective controls** to detect configuration violations. Controls can then be enabled for the appropriate OUs according to each team's security profile. See [What happens when you set up a landing zone](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-control-tower-works.html).

Existing accounts can be enrolled into the appropriate registered OU. During enrollment, AWS Control Tower baselines the account, applies the OU's SCP-based mandatory controls, enables AWS Config, and deploys the AWS Config rules used for detective controls. See [Enroll an existing account into AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html).

AWS Control Tower also provides Account Factory and related account-management functionality for provisioning standardized new accounts into governed OUs. This ensures that future accounts receive the applicable baseline and controls rather than requiring teams to configure each account independently. See [Provision and manage accounts in AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/provision-and-manage-accounts.html).

The trusted-access step is also relevant: AWS Control Tower uses trusted access with AWS Organizations to detect preventive-control drift and track account and OU changes. See [Enabling trusted access with AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-CTower.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Organizations OUs and SCPs only

SCPs provide centralized **permissions guardrails** by limiting the maximum permissions available to principals in member accounts. They are therefore suitable for preventive governance, but this solution does not provide the required detective configuration-compliance controls or a complete governed account-provisioning and enrollment workflow. See [Differences between SCPs and RCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_authorization_policies.html).

### C. CloudFormation StackSets that deploy AWS Config rules and remediation

AWS Config rules assess resource configurations, and remediation actions can respond to noncompliance. That primarily supplies detective and corrective behavior; it does not by itself provide the SCP-based preventive controls required by the question. It would also require the DevOps team to design and maintain the complete governance implementation instead of using AWS Control Tower's integrated landing-zone, enrollment, OU-control, and account-provisioning capabilities.

### D. Organization-wide AWS Config conformance packs

Organization conformance packs centrally deploy AWS Config rules and remediation actions and can automatically deploy to newly added organization accounts. However, these are configuration-compliance mechanisms, not a complete combination of preventive and detective governance. They do not replace preventive controls such as SCP-based restrictions or provide the full landing-zone and governed account-provisioning workflow. AWS documents that organization conformance packs are deployed to new accounts, but also notes that deployment depends on an available configuration recorder. See [Managing organization conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-pack-organization-apis.html).

Therefore, **B** is the only option that comprehensively addresses existing accounts, future accounts, OU-specific security profiles, and both preventive and detective controls.

zh.question: 一家公司开始在多个团队中使用 AWS。每个团队拥有多个账户和独特的安全配置文件。该公司在 AWS Organizations 的一个组织中管理这些账户。每个账户都有自己的配置和安全控制措施。公司的 DevOps 团队希望使用预防性和检测性控制措施来治理所有账户。DevOps 团队需要确保当前账户以及未来随着公司在组织中创建新账户时的账户安全。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Organizations 创建 OU，并为每个团队附加适当的 SCP。将团队账户放入相应的 OU 以应用安全控制措施。将任何新的团队账户创建在相应的 OU 中。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Control Tower landing zone。在 AWS Control Tower 中为现有团队配置 OU 和适当的控制措施。为 AWS Control Tower 配置 trusted access。将现有账户注册到与每个团队相应安全策略匹配的适当 OU 中。使用 AWS Control Tower 预置任何新账户。
options.C: 在组织的管理账户中创建 AWS CloudFormation stack sets。配置一个 stack set，将包含所有控制措施的配置规则和修复操作的 AWS Config 部署到组织中的每个账户。随着新账户的创建，更新 stack sets 以部署到新账户。
options.D: 配置 AWS Config，以管理组织中所有 AWS 账户的 AWS Config 规则。部署 conformance packs，以在整个组织中提供 AWS Config 规则和修复操作。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

公司需要一个集中治理的多账户环境，该环境应：

- 通过 OU 支持不同团队的不同安全配置文件。
- 同时应用**预防性**和**检测性**控制措施。
- 将现有账户纳入治理。
- 确保新创建的账户得到一致治理。

## 正确答案：B

**创建一个 AWS Control Tower landing zone，配置团队专用的 OU 和控制措施，注册现有账户，并通过 AWS Control Tower 预置新账户。**

AWS Control Tower 专为建立和治理多账户 landing zone 而设计。在设置 landing zone 期间，它会应用强制性的**预防性控制措施**来强制执行策略，并应用强制性的**检测性控制措施**来检测配置违规。随后，可以根据每个团队的安全配置文件，为相应的 OU 启用控制措施。请参阅 [设置 landing zone 时会发生什么](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/how-control-tower-works.html)。

现有账户可以注册到相应已注册的 OU 中。在注册过程中，AWS Control Tower 会为账户应用基线配置，应用该 OU 基于 SCP 的强制性控制措施，启用 AWS Config，并部署用于检测性控制措施的 AWS Config 规则。请参阅 [将现有账户注册到 AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html)。

AWS Control Tower 还通过 Account Factory 及相关的账户管理功能，将标准化新账户预置到受治理的 OU 中。这可确保未来账户获得适用的基线和控制措施，而不是要求团队独立配置每个账户。请参阅 [在 AWS Control Tower 中预置和管理账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/provision-and-manage-accounts.html)。

trusted access 步骤也与此相关：AWS Control Tower 使用与 AWS Organizations 的 trusted access 来检测预防性控制措施偏移，并跟踪账户和 OU 变更。请参阅 [使用 AWS Control Tower 启用 trusted access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-CTower.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 仅使用 Organizations OU 和 SCP

SCP 通过限制成员账户中主体可获得的最大权限，提供集中式的**权限 guardrails**。因此，它们适用于预防性治理，但该解决方案无法提供所需的检测性配置合规控制措施，也不提供完整的受治理账户预置和注册工作流程。请参阅 [SCP 与 RCP 之间的差异](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_authorization_policies.html)。

### C. 使用 CloudFormation StackSets 部署 AWS Config 规则和修复措施

AWS Config 规则评估资源配置，修复操作可以响应不合规情况。这主要提供检测性和纠正性行为；其本身并不提供题目所要求的基于 SCP 的预防性控制措施。此外，它还要求 DevOps 团队设计和维护完整的治理实现，而不是使用 AWS Control Tower 集成的 landing zone、账户注册、OU 控制和账户预置功能。

### D. 全组织范围的 AWS Config conformance packs

组织 conformance packs 可集中部署 AWS Config 规则和修复操作，并可自动部署到新加入组织的账户。但是，这些是配置合规机制，而不是预防性和检测性治理的完整组合。它们不能替代基于 SCP 限制等预防性控制措施，也不提供完整的 landing zone 和受治理账户预置工作流程。AWS 文档指出，组织 conformance packs 会部署到新账户，但也说明部署取决于是否存在可用的 configuration recorder。请参阅 [管理组织 conformance packs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/conformance-pack-organization-apis.html)。

因此，只有 **B** 能够全面满足现有账户、未来账户、OU 专用安全配置文件以及预防性和检测性控制措施的要求。

en.question: A company uses an AWS CodeCommit repository to store its source code and corresponding unit tests. The company has configured an AWS CodePipeline pipeline that includes an AWS CodeBuild project that runs when code is merged to the main branch of the repository. The company wants the CodeBuild project to run the unit tests. If the unit tests pass, the CodeBuild project must tag the most recent commit. How should the company configure the CodeBuild project to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure the CodeBuild project to use native Git to done the CodeCommit repository. Configure the project to run the unit tests. Configure the project to use native Git to create a tag and to push the Git tag to the repository if the code passes the unit tests.
options.B: Configure the CodeBuild projed to use native Git to done the CodeCommit repository. Configure the project to run the unit tests. Configure the project to use AWS CLI commands to create a new repository tag in the repository if the code passes the unit tests.
options.C: Configure the CodeBuild project to use AWS CLI commands to copy the code from the CodeCommit repository. Configure the project to run the unit tests. Configure the project to use AWS CLI commands to create a new Git tag in the repository if the code passes the unit tests.
options.D: Configure the CodeBuild project to use AWS CLI commands to copy the code from the CodeCommit repository. Configure the project to run the unit tests. Configure the project to use AWS CLI commands to create a new repository tag in the repository if the code passes the unit tests.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The build must do two things in sequence:

1. Run the unit tests against the commit that triggered the pipeline.
2. Only after the tests succeed, create a **Git tag that points to that commit** and push the tag back to CodeCommit.

This is a Git operation, not an AWS resource-tagging operation.

## Correct answer: A

Configure the pipeline/CodeBuild integration so that CodeBuild receives a **full Git clone**, run the unit tests from the build specification, and then use native Git commands such as `git tag` and `git push` after a successful test phase.

AWS documents that a CodeCommit source action can use the **Full clone** (`CODEBUILD_CLONE_REF`) format, which allows a downstream CodeBuild action to clone the repository together with its Git metadata. The default ZIP artifact is only a shallow copy and is not the appropriate format when the build needs to perform repository-level Git operations. See the [CodeCommit source action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeCommit.html) and the [full-clone CodePipeline tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-codecommit-gitclone.html).

AWS also documents the native commands for creating and publishing a CodeCommit Git tag:

```bash
git tag <tag-name> <commit-id>
git push origin <tag-name>
```

See [Use Git to create a tag](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-create-tag.html).

In practice, the build should place the tag/push commands after the unit-test command so they execute only if testing succeeds. The CodeBuild service role must have appropriately scoped `codecommit:GitPull` and `codecommit:GitPush` permissions; AWS states that `GitPush` is required whenever a Git client sends data to CodeCommit. See [Required permissions for Git client commands](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/auth-and-access-control-permissions-reference.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B:** The AWS CLI `codecommit tag-resource` operation creates or updates an **AWS resource tag on the CodeCommit repository**. Such a key-value metadata tag is used for organization, cost allocation, or access control; it does not create a Git reference pointing to the tested commit. A commit-related Git tag must be created and pushed with Git.

- **C:** AWS CLI CodeCommit API commands do not provide the required workflow of cloning the repository with its Git metadata and creating a normal Git tag. The supported mechanism for creating a commit tag is native `git tag`, followed by `git push`. A full Git clone is also needed for reliable Git metadata operations in the downstream CodeBuild action.

- **D:** This combines both errors: copying source through AWS CLI commands does not establish the appropriate native Git working repository, and a repository resource tag is not a Git commit tag.

Therefore, **A** is the only option that creates a Git tag for the successfully tested commit and publishes that tag to CodeCommit.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS CodeCommit 存储库来存储其源代码和相应的单元测试。该公司已配置一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道，其中包含一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目，该项目会在代码合并到存储库的 main 分支时运行。公司希望 CodeBuild 项目运行单元测试。如果单元测试通过，CodeBuild 项目必须为最新的提交创建标签。公司应如何配置 CodeBuild 项目以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置 CodeBuild 项目以使用原生 Git 克隆 CodeCommit 存储库。配置该项目运行单元测试。配置该项目在代码通过单元测试时使用原生 Git 创建标签，并将 Git 标签推送到存储库。
options.B: 配置 CodeBuild 项目以使用原生 Git 克隆 CodeCommit 存储库。配置该项目运行单元测试。配置该项目在代码通过单元测试时使用 AWS CLI 命令在存储库中创建新的存储库标签。
options.C: 配置 CodeBuild 项目以使用 AWS CLI 命令从 CodeCommit 存储库复制代码。配置该项目运行单元测试。配置该项目在代码通过单元测试时使用 AWS CLI 命令在存储库中创建新的 Git 标签。
options.D: 配置 CodeBuild 项目以使用 AWS CLI 命令从 CodeCommit 存储库复制代码。配置该项目运行单元测试。配置该项目在代码通过单元测试时使用 AWS CLI 命令在存储库中创建新的存储库标签。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

构建必须按顺序完成两项操作：

1. 针对触发管道的提交运行单元测试。
2. 仅在测试成功后，创建一个**指向该提交的 Git 标签**，并将该标签推送回 CodeCommit。

这是 Git 操作，而不是 AWS 资源标签操作。

## 正确答案：A

配置 pipeline/CodeBuild 集成，使 CodeBuild 接收一个**完整 Git 克隆**，从构建规范中运行单元测试，然后在测试阶段成功后使用 `git tag` 和 `git push` 等原生 Git 命令。

AWS 文档说明，CodeCommit 源操作可以使用 **Full clone** (`CODEBUILD_CLONE_REF`) 格式，该格式允许下游 CodeBuild 操作连同 Git 元数据一起克隆存储库。默认的 ZIP 构件仅是浅层副本；当构建需要执行存储库级别的 Git 操作时，它并不是合适的格式。请参阅 [CodeCommit 源操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeCommit.html) 和 [完整克隆 CodePipeline 教程](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-codecommit-gitclone.html)。

AWS 还记录了用于创建和发布 CodeCommit Git 标签的原生命令：

```bash
git tag <tag-name> <commit-id>
git push origin <tag-name>
```

请参阅 [使用 Git 创建标签](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/how-to-create-tag.html)。

在实践中，构建应将标签/推送命令放在单元测试命令之后，使其仅在测试成功时执行。CodeBuild 服务角色必须具有适当范围的 `codecommit:GitPull` 和 `codecommit:GitPush` 权限；AWS 指出，只要 Git 客户端向 CodeCommit 发送数据，就需要 `GitPush`。请参阅 [Git 客户端命令所需的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codecommit/latest/userguide/auth-and-access-control-permissions-reference.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **B：**AWS CLI `codecommit tag-resource` 操作会在 CodeCommit 存储库上创建或更新一个 **AWS 资源标签**。这种键值元数据标签用于组织、成本分配或访问控制；它不会创建指向已测试提交的 Git 引用。与提交相关的 Git 标签必须使用 Git 创建并推送。

- **C：**AWS CLI CodeCommit API 命令无法提供所需的工作流程，即使用 Git 元数据克隆存储库并创建普通 Git 标签。创建提交标签所支持的机制是原生 `git tag`，然后执行 `git push`。下游 CodeBuild 操作还需要完整 Git 克隆，以可靠地执行 Git 元数据操作。

- **D：**该选项同时包含两项错误：通过 AWS CLI 命令复制源代码无法建立适当的原生 Git 工作存储库，并且存储库资源标签不是 Git 提交标签。

因此，**A** 是唯一能够为成功通过测试的提交创建 Git 标签并将该标签发布到 CodeCommit 的选项。

en.question: A DevOps engineer manages a company's Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster. The cluster runs on several Amazon EC2 instances that are in an Auto Scaling group. The DevOps engineer must implement a solution that logs and reviews all stopped tasks for errors. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to capture task state changes. Send the event to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to investigate stopped tasks.
options.B: Configure tasks to write log data in the embedded metric format. Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Monitor the ContainerInstanceCount metric for changes.
options.C: Configure the EC2 instances to store logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create a CloudWatch Contributor Insights rule that uses the EC2 instance log data. Use the Contributor Insights rule to investigate stopped tasks.
options.D: Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hook for the EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING scale-in event. Write the SystemEventLog file to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the log file for errors.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The requirement is to **retain a record of every ECS task that transitions to `STOPPED` and investigate why it stopped**. The solution therefore needs to capture ECS task lifecycle events—not merely application logs, EC2 host logs, or infrastructure metrics—and provide a way to query the captured error details.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to capture task state changes. Send the event to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use CloudWatch Logs Insights to investigate stopped tasks.**

Amazon ECS emits **ECS Task State Change** events when tasks change state, including transitions from `RUNNING` to `STOPPED`. For a stopped task, the event contains fields such as `stoppedReason` and `stopCode`, which provide information about why the task stopped. This applies to tasks stopped by the scheduler, API operations, container failures, container-instance termination, and other lifecycle causes. See [Amazon ECS task state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ecs_task_events.html).

AWS also documents that ECS event capture uses **EventBridge to store task lifecycle events in CloudWatch Logs**, and that these events help identify why tasks or containers stop running. See [Amazon ECS event capture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-lifecycle-events.html).

After the events are stored, CloudWatch Logs Insights can interactively search and analyze them to identify operational issues and potential causes. Queries can filter for `detail.lastStatus = "STOPPED"` and inspect fields such as `detail.stoppedReason`, `detail.stopCode`, container exit codes, task ARNs, and timestamps. See [Analyzing log data with CloudWatch Logs Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/AnalyzingLogData.html).

Therefore, **A directly captures all stopped-task events and provides the required investigation capability**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Embedded metric format and `ContainerInstanceCount`

Embedded metric format would publish application-derived logs and metrics, but it does not by itself capture every ECS task state transition or the ECS-generated reason that a task stopped. More importantly, `ContainerInstanceCount` measures the number of EC2 instances running the ECS agent and registered with the cluster; it does **not** represent stopped tasks or task errors. See [Amazon ECS Container Insights metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-metrics-ECS.html).

### C. EC2 host logs and Contributor Insights

EC2 instance logs are host-level logs and are not the authoritative stream of structured ECS task state changes. They do not inherently guarantee a record for every stopped ECS task with ECS fields such as `stopCode` and `stoppedReason`.

Contributor Insights analyzes log fields to identify **top-N contributors**, unique contributors, and entities affecting system performance. Although it can analyze suitable CloudWatch log data, configuring it against generic EC2 instance logs is not the direct or comprehensive solution for reviewing every stopped task. See [Use Contributor Insights to analyze high-cardinality data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights.html).

### D. Auto Scaling termination lifecycle hook

An `EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING` lifecycle hook runs when an EC2 instance in the Auto Scaling group is being terminated during scale-in. It would cover only that particular instance-termination path. ECS tasks can stop for many unrelated reasons, including scheduler actions, application/container failures, API calls, health failures, or deployment activity. A host system log copied during instance termination therefore cannot log **all** stopped tasks. See [Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-lifecycle.html) and the ECS task-stop scenarios in [Amazon ECS task state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ecs_task_events.html).

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师管理一家公司的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群。该集群运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的多台 Amazon EC2 实例上。DevOps 工程师必须实施一个解决方案，以记录并审查所有已停止的任务是否存在错误。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则以捕获任务状态变更。将事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 调查已停止的任务。
options.B: 将任务配置为以嵌入式指标格式写入日志数据。将日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。监控 `ContainerInstanceCount` 指标的变化。
options.C: 将 EC2 实例配置为将日志存储在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中。创建一个使用 EC2 实例日志数据的 CloudWatch Contributor Insights 规则。使用 Contributor Insights 规则调查已停止的任务。
options.D: 为 `EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING` 缩容事件配置 EC2 Auto Scaling 生命周期挂钩。将 SystemEventLog 文件写入 Amazon S3。使用 Amazon Athena 查询日志文件中的错误。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查的内容

要求是**保留每个转换为 `STOPPED` 状态的 ECS 任务的记录，并调查其停止原因**。因此，该解决方案需要捕获 ECS 任务生命周期事件，而不仅仅是应用程序日志、EC2 主机日志或基础设施指标，并且需要提供查询所捕获错误详细信息的方法。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则以捕获任务状态变更。将事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 调查已停止的任务。**

Amazon ECS 会在任务状态发生变化时发出 **ECS Task State Change** 事件，其中包括从 `RUNNING` 转换为 `STOPPED` 的情况。对于已停止的任务，该事件包含 `stoppedReason` 和 `stopCode` 等字段，可提供任务停止原因的信息。这适用于由调度程序、API 操作、容器故障、容器实例终止及其他生命周期原因导致停止的任务。请参阅 [Amazon ECS task state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ecs_task_events.html)。

AWS 还说明，ECS 事件捕获使用 **EventBridge 将任务生命周期事件存储到 CloudWatch Logs 中**，并且这些事件有助于确定任务或容器为何停止运行。请参阅 [Amazon ECS event capture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/task-lifecycle-events.html)。

在存储这些事件后，CloudWatch Logs Insights 可以对其进行交互式搜索和分析，以识别运营问题及潜在原因。查询可以筛选 `detail.lastStatus = "STOPPED"`，并检查 `detail.stoppedReason`、`detail.stopCode`、容器退出代码、任务 ARN 和时间戳等字段。请参阅 [Analyzing log data with CloudWatch Logs Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/AnalyzingLogData.html)。

因此，**A 会直接捕获所有已停止任务事件，并提供所需的调查能力**。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 嵌入式指标格式和 `ContainerInstanceCount`

嵌入式指标格式会发布源自应用程序的日志和指标，但它本身无法捕获每个 ECS 任务状态转换，也无法捕获 ECS 生成的任务停止原因。更重要的是，`ContainerInstanceCount` 衡量的是运行 ECS agent 并已注册到集群的 EC2 实例数量；它**不**表示已停止的任务或任务错误。请参阅 [Amazon ECS Container Insights metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-metrics-ECS.html)。

### C. EC2 主机日志和 Contributor Insights

EC2 实例日志属于主机级日志，并不是结构化 ECS 任务状态变更的权威事件流。它们无法固有地保证记录每一个已停止的 ECS 任务，也不保证包含 `stopCode` 和 `stoppedReason` 等 ECS 字段。

Contributor Insights 会分析日志字段，以识别**排名前 N 的贡献者**、唯一贡献者以及影响系统性能的实体。尽管它可以分析适当的 CloudWatch 日志数据，但针对通用 EC2 实例日志进行配置，并不是审查每个已停止任务的直接或全面解决方案。请参阅 [Use Contributor Insights to analyze high-cardinality data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights.html)。

### D. Auto Scaling 终止生命周期挂钩

当 Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例在缩容期间即将终止时，会运行 `EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING` 生命周期挂钩。它仅涵盖该特定的实例终止路径。ECS 任务可能因许多无关原因而停止，包括调度程序操作、应用程序/容器故障、API 调用、运行状况故障或部署活动。因此，在实例终止期间复制主机系统日志无法记录**所有**已停止的任务。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-lifecycle.html) 以及 [Amazon ECS task state change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ecs_task_events.html) 中的 ECS 任务停止场景。

en.question: A company wants to deploy a workload on several hundred Amazon EC2 instances. The company will provision the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group by using a launch template. The workload will pull files from an Amazon S3 bucket, process the data, and put the results into a different S3 bucket. The EC2 instances must have least-privilege permissions and must use temporary security credentials. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an IAM role that has the appropriate permissions for S3 buckets Add the IAM role to an instance profile.
options.B: Update the launch template to include the IAM instance profile.
options.C: Create an IAM user that has the appropriate permissions for Amazon S3 Generate a secret key and token.
options.D: Create a trust anchor and profile Attach the IAM role to the profile.
options.E: Update the launch template Modify the user data to use the new secret key and token.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The EC2 instances in the Auto Scaling group need narrowly scoped access to read files from one S3 bucket and write results to another. They must also use temporary credentials rather than embedded, long-term IAM user access keys.

## Correct answers: A and B

### A. Create an IAM role with the required S3 permissions and add it to an instance profile

This provides least-privilege authorization by limiting the role policy to only the required S3 resources and actions—for example, `s3:GetObject` on the input bucket objects and `s3:PutObject` on the output bucket objects, plus only any additional bucket-level permissions that the workload actually requires.

For applications running on EC2, AWS recommends associating an IAM role with the instance. Applications and AWS SDKs on the instance can then automatically retrieve temporary, rotating credentials from the EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS). The permissions of those credentials are determined by the role policy. See [Use temporary credentials with AWS resources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_use-resources.html).

An instance profile is the container through which the IAM role is attached to an EC2 instance, so option A creates the correct identity and permission mechanism.

### B. Update the launch template to include the IAM instance profile

Because the Auto Scaling group launches instances from a launch template, the launch template must specify the instance profile. This ensures every newly launched instance receives the IAM role automatically. AWS documents selecting the role under **IAM instance profile** in a launch template or setting `IamInstanceProfile` in the launch template data. See [IAM role for Amazon EC2](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/us-iam-role.html).

Together, A and B provide scalable, automatically rotated temporary credentials without storing credentials in the AMI, application, or user data.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **C. Create an IAM user and generate a secret key and token — Incorrect.** IAM user access keys are long-term credentials, not the recommended temporary credentials for software running on EC2. The appropriate EC2 mechanism is an IAM role whose temporary credentials are automatically delivered and refreshed through IMDS. A session token is associated with temporary STS credentials; simply creating an IAM user access key does not satisfy the stated temporary-credential requirement.

- **D. Create a trust anchor and profile — Incorrect.** Trust anchors and profiles are IAM Roles Anywhere constructs intended to authenticate workloads running **outside AWS** by using X.509 certificates. These workloads are running directly on EC2, where an EC2 IAM role and instance profile are the native solution. See [Access for non-AWS workloads](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_non-aws.html).

- **E. Put a secret key and token in launch-template user data — Incorrect.** Embedding credentials in user data creates a credential-distribution and exposure risk and does not provide automatic credential rotation. It is also unnecessary because SDKs and the AWS CLI can automatically obtain the role's temporary credentials from IMDS. This option depends on the inappropriate IAM-user approach in C and violates the requirement to use securely managed temporary credentials.

Therefore, the required combination is **A and B**.

zh.question: 一家公司希望在数百个 Amazon EC2 实例上部署一个工作负载。该公司将使用启动模板在 Auto Scaling 组中预置 EC2 实例。该工作负载将从一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中提取文件、处理数据，并将结果放入另一个 S3 存储桶中。EC2 实例必须具有最小权限，并且必须使用临时安全凭证。以下哪些步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个具有适当 S3 存储桶权限的 IAM role。将该 IAM role 添加到实例配置文件。
options.B: 更新启动模板以包含 IAM 实例配置文件。
options.C: 创建一个具有适当 Amazon S3 权限的 IAM user。生成密钥和令牌。
options.D: 创建一个信任锚点和配置文件。将 IAM role 附加到该配置文件。
options.E: 更新启动模板。修改用户数据以使用新的密钥和令牌。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

Auto Scaling 组中的 EC2 实例需要受到严格限制的权限，以便从一个 S3 存储桶读取文件并将结果写入另一个存储桶。它们还必须使用临时凭证，而不是嵌入式的长期 IAM user 访问密钥。

## 正确答案：A 和 B

### A. 创建具有所需 S3 权限的 IAM role，并将其添加到实例配置文件

通过将 role 策略限制为仅允许所需的 S3 资源和操作，此方法可提供最小权限授权——例如，对输入存储桶对象的 `s3:GetObject` 权限以及对输出存储桶对象的 `s3:PutObject` 权限，外加仅限工作负载实际所需的其他存储桶级权限。

对于在 EC2 上运行的应用程序，AWS 建议将 IAM role 与实例关联。实例上的应用程序和 AWS SDK 随后可以从 EC2 Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) 自动获取临时、轮换的凭证。这些凭证的权限由 role 策略决定。请参阅 [将临时凭证与 AWS 资源结合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp_use-resources.html)。

实例配置文件是将 IAM role 附加到 EC2 实例的容器，因此选项 A 创建了正确的身份和权限机制。

### B. 更新启动模板以包含 IAM 实例配置文件

由于 Auto Scaling 组通过启动模板启动实例，启动模板必须指定实例配置文件。这可确保每个新启动的实例都会自动获得 IAM role。AWS 文档说明，可以在启动模板中选择 **IAM instance profile** 下的 role，或在启动模板数据中设置 `IamInstanceProfile`。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 的 IAM role](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/us-iam-role.html)。

A 和 B 共同提供了可扩展、自动轮换的临时凭证，无需将凭证存储在 AMI、应用程序或用户数据中。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **C. 创建 IAM user 并生成密钥和令牌 — 错误。** IAM user 访问密钥是长期凭证，并非建议用于在 EC2 上运行的软件的临时凭证。适用于 EC2 的机制是 IAM role，其临时凭证通过 IMDS 自动提供和刷新。会话令牌与临时 STS 凭证相关；仅创建 IAM user 访问密钥无法满足所述的临时凭证要求。

- **D. 创建信任锚点和配置文件 — 错误。** 信任锚点和配置文件是 IAM Roles Anywhere 构造，旨在通过 X.509 证书验证运行在 **AWS 外部** 的工作负载。这些工作负载直接运行在 EC2 上，因此 EC2 IAM role 和实例配置文件才是原生解决方案。请参阅 [非 AWS 工作负载的访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_non-aws.html)。

- **E. 将密钥和令牌放入启动模板用户数据中 — 错误。** 将凭证嵌入用户数据会造成凭证分发和泄露风险，并且无法提供自动凭证轮换。这也没有必要，因为 SDK 和 AWS CLI 可以从 IMDS 自动获取 role 的临时凭证。此选项依赖于 C 中不恰当的 IAM user 方法，并且违反了使用安全管理的临时凭证这一要求。

因此，所需的组合是 **A 和 B**。

en.question: A company is using AWS CodeDeploy to automate software deployment. The deployment must meet these requirements: • A number of instances must be available to serve traffic during the deployment. Traffic must be balanced across those instances, and the instances must automatically heal in the event of failure. • A new fleet of instances must be launched for deploying a new revision automatically, with no manual provisioning. • Traffic must be rerouted to the new environment to half of the new instances at a time. The deployment should succeed if traffic is rerouted to at least half of the instances: otherwise, it should fail. • Before routing traffic to the new fleet of instances, the temporary files generated during the deployment process must be deleted. • At the end of a successful deployment, the original instances in the deployment group must be deleted immediately to reduce costs. How can a DevOps engineer meet these requirements?

options.A: Use an Application Load Balancer and an in-place deployment. Associate the Auto Scaling group with the deployment group. Use the Automatically copy Auto Scaling group option, and use CodeDeployDefault.OneAtAtime as the deployment configuration. Instruct AWS CodeDeploy to terminate the original instances in the deployment group, and use the AllowTraffic hook within appspec.yml to delete the temporary files.
options.B: Use an Application Load Balancer and a blue/green deployment. Associate the Auto Scaling group and Application Load Balancer target group with the deployment group. Use the Automatically copy Auto Scaling group option, create a custom deployment configuration with minimum healthy hosts defined as 50%, and assign the configuration to the deployment group. Instruct AWS CodeDeploy to terminate the original instances in the deployment group, and use the BeforeBlockTraffic hook within appspec.yml to delete the temporary files.
options.C: Use an Application Load Balancer and a blue/green deployment. Associate the Auto Scaling group and the Application Load Balancer target group with the deployment group. Use the Automatically copy Auto Scaling group option, and use CodeDeployDefault.HalfAtAtime as the deployment configuration. Instruct AWS CodeDeploy to terminate the original instances in the deployment group, and use the BeforeAllowTraffic hook within appspec.yml to delete the temporary files.
options.D: Use an Application Load Balancer and an in-place deployment. Associate the Auto Scaling group and Application Load Balancer target group with the deployment group. Use the Automatically copy Auto Scaling group option, and use CodeDeployDefault.AllatOnce as a deployment configuration. Instruct AWS CodeDeploy to terminate the original instances in the deployment group, and use the BlockTraffic hook within appspec.yml to delete the temporary files.

en.explanation:
## What the scenario requires

The deployment needs a separately provisioned replacement fleet, load-balanced availability, automatic instance replacement, traffic registration in half-fleet batches, a pre-traffic cleanup action on replacement instances, and immediate cleanup of the original fleet after success. These requirements point to an **EC2 blue/green CodeDeploy deployment backed by an Auto Scaling group and an Application Load Balancer**.

## Correct answer: C

**C meets all the requirements:**

- **Blue/green deployment:** This creates a separate replacement environment rather than updating the currently serving instances in place.
- **Automatically copy Auto Scaling group:** CodeDeploy creates the replacement Auto Scaling group by copying the specified original group. AWS states that the number of currently healthy instances in the selected group is created in the replacement environment. This provides the requested automatic provisioning without manual instance creation. See [Create a deployment group for an EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-groups-create-blue-green.html).
- **Application Load Balancer target group:** CodeDeploy registers the replacement instances with the selected target group and reroutes traffic according to the deployment configuration. The Auto Scaling group provides self-healing: EC2 Auto Scaling replaces instances that fail EC2 health checks and, when Elastic Load Balancing health checks are enabled for the group, also replaces instances that the load balancer reports as unhealthy. See [Health checks for Auto Scaling instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html).
- **`CodeDeployDefault.HalfAtATime`:** For an EC2 blue/green deployment, this configuration routes traffic to up to half of the replacement instances at a time. The deployment succeeds if rerouting succeeds for at least half of the instances; otherwise, it fails. This exactly matches both the batch-size and success-threshold requirements. See [CodeDeploy deployment configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-configurations.html).
