- **`BeforeAllowTraffic` hook:** This hook runs on replacement instances before they are registered with the load balancer, so it is the appropriate point to delete deployment-generated temporary files before production traffic arrives. See [EC2/On-Premises AppSpec lifecycle hooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-hooks.html).
- **Terminate original instances:** A blue/green deployment group can be configured to terminate the original instances after traffic is successfully rerouted. The termination wait period can be set for immediate cleanup, reducing cost.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

- It specifies an **in-place deployment**, which updates the existing fleet instead of automatically creating a separate replacement fleet.
- **Automatically copy Auto Scaling group** is a blue/green replacement-environment option, not an in-place deployment strategy.
- `CodeDeployDefault.OneAtATime` routes/registers one replacement instance at a time, not half at a time, and has different success semantics.
- `AllowTraffic` is reserved for CodeDeploy and **cannot be used to run an AppSpec script**, so it cannot perform temporary-file cleanup.

### B

- Blue/green, the copied Auto Scaling group, ALB target group, and original-instance termination are appropriate.
- However, the requirement exactly matches the predefined **`CodeDeployDefault.HalfAtATime`** behavior. Merely defining minimum healthy hosts as 50% does not express the requirement as precisely as the predefined configuration that AWS explicitly documents as routing to up to half of the replacement instances at a time and succeeding when at least half are rerouted.
- More decisively, `BeforeBlockTraffic` runs on instances **before they are deregistered** from a load balancer. In a blue/green deployment, it applies to the original environment, not to replacement instances before they begin serving traffic. The required cleanup belongs in `BeforeAllowTraffic` on the replacement fleet.

### D

- An **in-place deployment** does not create the required new replacement fleet.
- `CodeDeployDefault.AllAtOnce` routes traffic to all replacement instances at once in blue/green deployments and can succeed if rerouting succeeds for only one instance; that does not match the half-at-a-time and at-least-half success requirements.
- `BlockTraffic` is reserved for CodeDeploy and cannot run a user-defined cleanup script.

Therefore, **C** is the only option that satisfies every requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS CodeDeploy 自动化软件部署。部署必须满足以下要求：• 在部署期间，必须有一定数量的实例可用于处理流量。流量必须在这些实例之间实现负载均衡，并且实例必须能够在发生故障时自动恢复。• 必须自动启动一组新的实例来部署新修订版本，无需手动预置。• 流量必须一次重新路由到新环境中一半的新实例。如果流量至少成功重新路由到一半的实例，部署应成功；否则应失败。• 在将流量路由到新实例组之前，必须删除部署过程中生成的临时文件。• 成功部署结束时，必须立即删除部署组中的原始实例以降低成本。DevOps 工程师如何满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Application Load Balancer 和就地部署。将 Auto Scaling 组与部署组关联。使用 Automatically copy Auto Scaling group 选项，并使用 CodeDeployDefault.OneAtAtime 作为部署配置。指示 AWS CodeDeploy 终止部署组中的原始实例，并在 appspec.yml 中使用 AllowTraffic 挂钩删除临时文件。
options.B: 使用 Application Load Balancer 和蓝/绿部署。将 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 目标组与部署组关联。使用 Automatically copy Auto Scaling group 选项，创建将最小正常主机数定义为 50% 的自定义部署配置，并将该配置分配给部署组。指示 AWS CodeDeploy 终止部署组中的原始实例，并在 appspec.yml 中使用 BeforeBlockTraffic 挂钩删除临时文件。
options.C: 使用 Application Load Balancer 和蓝/绿部署。将 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 目标组与部署组关联。使用 Automatically copy Auto Scaling group 选项，并使用 CodeDeployDefault.HalfAtAtime 作为部署配置。指示 AWS CodeDeploy 终止部署组中的原始实例，并在 appspec.yml 中使用 BeforeAllowTraffic 挂钩删除临时文件。
options.D: 使用 Application Load Balancer 和就地部署。将 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 目标组与部署组关联。使用 Automatically copy Auto Scaling group 选项，并使用 CodeDeployDefault.AllatOnce 作为部署配置。指示 AWS CodeDeploy 终止部署组中的原始实例，并在 appspec.yml 中使用 BlockTraffic 挂钩删除临时文件。

zh.explanation:
## 场景要求

该部署需要一个单独预置的替换实例组、经过负载均衡的可用性、自动实例替换、以半个实例组为批次进行流量注册、在流量进入前对替换实例执行清理操作，以及在成功后立即清理原始实例组。这些要求表明应使用由 Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 支持的 **EC2 蓝/绿 CodeDeploy 部署**。

## 正确答案：C

**C 满足所有要求：**

- **蓝/绿部署：** 该方式会创建一个独立的替换环境，而不是就地更新当前正在提供服务的实例。
- **Automatically copy Auto Scaling group：** CodeDeploy 会通过复制指定的原始组来创建替换 Auto Scaling 组。AWS 指出，所选组中当前处于正常状态的实例数量会在替换环境中创建。这在无需手动创建实例的情况下提供了所需的自动预置功能。请参阅 [为 EC2/On-Premises 蓝/绿部署创建部署组](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-groups-create-blue-green.html)。
- **Application Load Balancer 目标组：** CodeDeploy 会将替换实例注册到所选目标组中，并根据部署配置重新路由流量。Auto Scaling 组提供自我修复能力：EC2 Auto Scaling 会替换未通过 EC2 运行状况检查的实例；如果为该组启用了 Elastic Load Balancing 运行状况检查，还会替换负载均衡器报告为不正常的实例。请参阅 [Auto Scaling 实例的运行状况检查](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)。
- **`CodeDeployDefault.HalfAtATime`：** 对于 EC2 蓝/绿部署，此配置一次将流量路由到最多一半的替换实例。如果至少一半实例的流量重新路由成功，部署即成功；否则，部署失败。这完全符合批次大小和成功阈值要求。请参阅 [CodeDeploy 部署配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-configurations.html)。
- **`BeforeAllowTraffic` 挂钩：** 此挂钩会在替换实例注册到负载均衡器之前在这些实例上运行，因此适合用于在生产流量到达之前删除部署生成的临时文件。请参阅 [EC2/On-Premises AppSpec 生命周期挂钩](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-hooks.html)。
- **终止原始实例：** 可以将蓝/绿部署组配置为在流量成功重新路由后终止原始实例。终止等待期可以设置为立即清理，以降低成本。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A

- 它指定了**就地部署**，该方式更新现有实例组，而不是自动创建一个独立的替换实例组。
- **Automatically copy Auto Scaling group** 是蓝/绿替换环境的选项，而不是就地部署策略。
- `CodeDeployDefault.OneAtATime` 会一次路由/注册一个替换实例，而不是一次处理一半实例，并且具有不同的成功语义。
- `AllowTraffic` 保留供 CodeDeploy 使用，**不能用于运行 AppSpec 脚本**，因此无法执行临时文件清理。

### B

- 蓝/绿部署、复制的 Auto Scaling 组、ALB 目标组和原始实例终止本身都是合适的。
- 但是，该要求与预定义的 **`CodeDeployDefault.HalfAtATime`** 行为完全一致。仅将最小正常主机数定义为 50%，无法像 AWS 明确说明的预定义配置那样精确表达该要求；该预定义配置会一次将流量路由到最多一半的替换实例，并且在至少一半实例完成重新路由时成功。
- 更关键的是，`BeforeBlockTraffic` 会在实例**从负载均衡器注销之前**运行。在蓝/绿部署中，它适用于原始环境，而不是在替换实例开始处理流量之前运行。所需的清理操作应位于替换实例组的 `BeforeAllowTraffic` 中。

### D

- **就地部署**不会创建所需的新替换实例组。
- 在蓝/绿部署中，`CodeDeployDefault.AllAtOnce` 会一次将流量路由到所有替换实例，并且在仅一个实例的重新路由成功时也可能部署成功；这不符合一次处理一半实例以及至少一半成功的要求。
- `BlockTraffic` 保留供 CodeDeploy 使用，不能运行用户定义的清理脚本。

因此，**C** 是唯一满足所有要求的选项。

en.question: A company needs to adopt a multi-account strategy to deploy its applications and the associated CI/CD infrastructure. The company has created an organization in AWS Organizations that has all features enabled. The company has configured AWS Control Tower and has set up a landing zone. The company needs to use AWS Control Tower controls (guardrails) in all AWS accounts in the organization. The company must create the accounts for a multi-environment application and must ensure that all accounts are configured to an initial baseline. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Control Tower Account Factory Customization (AFC) blueprint that uses the baseline configuration. Use AWS Control Tower Account Factory to provision a dedicated AWS account for each environment and a CI/CD account by using the blueprint.
options.B: Use AWS Control Tower Account Factory to provision a dedicated AWS account for each environment and a CI/CD account. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to apply the baseline configuration to the new accounts.
options.C: Use Organizations to provision a multi-environment AWS account and a CI/CD account. In the Organizations management account, create an AWS Lambda function that assumes the Organizations access role to apply the baseline configuration to the new accounts.
options.D: Use Organizations to provision a dedicated AWS account for each environment, an audit account, and a CI/CD account. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to apply the baseline configuration to the new accounts.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company already has an AWS Control Tower landing zone and wants to:

1. Create separate accounts for the application's environments and CI/CD infrastructure.
2. Bring those accounts under AWS Control Tower governance so that applicable controls are enforced.
3. Apply a predefined initial baseline configuration.
4. Minimize ongoing operational effort.

## Correct answer: A

**Create an AWS Control Tower Account Factory Customization (AFC) blueprint that contains the baseline configuration, and use Account Factory to provision each environment account and the CI/CD account from that blueprint.**

AFC is designed specifically for this use case. AWS Control Tower can use an AWS Service Catalog blueprint backed by CloudFormation or Terraform to customize an account while the account is being provisioned. AWS states that, after AFC is configured, Control Tower automates future provisioning and the customer does not have to maintain customization pipelines. This directly addresses the requirement for the **least operational overhead**: [Customize accounts with Account Factory Customization (AFC)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/af-customization-page.html).

When account creation completes, the resources specified in the blueprint are already deployed in the new account: [Create a customized account from a blueprint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/create-afc-customized-account.html).

Account Factory provisions the accounts into the Control Tower landing zone and a registered OU with the Control Tower baseline enabled. Control Tower enrollment baselines the accounts and applies mandatory and detective controls associated with the selected OU. The enrollment process also configures services such as AWS Config and the relevant Control Tower StackSets: [What happens during account enrollment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html).

Therefore, AFC combines governed account provisioning and application-specific baseline deployment into a managed workflow rather than requiring a separately operated customization mechanism.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Account Factory plus separately managed CloudFormation StackSets

Account Factory is appropriate for creating governed accounts, and StackSets could technically deploy the baseline afterward. However, this separates account vending from customization and requires the company to manage the StackSet deployment, targeting, sequencing, failures, and updates independently.

AFC already directs CloudFormation to create and manage the required StackSet on behalf of AWS Control Tower and automates future customized account provisioning. Consequently, option B has more operational overhead than A: [Customize accounts with Account Factory Customization (AFC)](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/af-customization-page.html).

### C. Organizations account creation plus a custom Lambda function

This option creates a bespoke account-customization system. The company would need to develop, secure, monitor, retry, and maintain the Lambda function and its cross-account role-assumption logic.

In addition, creating an account directly through AWS Organizations is not equivalent to provisioning it through Account Factory. Control Tower enrollment is the process that baselines an account, places it into the designated governed OU, applies mandatory controls, and configures detective controls. Direct Organizations provisioning would therefore need additional enrollment or auto-enrollment handling: [What happens during account enrollment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html).

It also describes a single "multi-environment" application account rather than a dedicated account for each environment, weakening the intended multi-account isolation.

### D. Organizations account creation plus StackSets

This option also bypasses the integrated Account Factory/AFC workflow. Accounts created directly through Organizations require additional Control Tower enrollment handling before they receive the full Control Tower account baseline and applicable controls. Independently operated StackSets add deployment and lifecycle-management overhead: [Provision and manage accounts with Account Factory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/account-factory.html) and [What happens during account enrollment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html).

The additional audit account is also unnecessary for the stated application-account requirement because an AWS Control Tower landing zone already includes its governance account structure. Most importantly, the option does not provide the managed, integrated customization-at-provisioning capability offered by AFC.

## Conclusion

**A** is the best solution because Account Factory provisions the accounts under AWS Control Tower governance while AFC deploys the required initial baseline as part of the same automated workflow, avoiding a custom Lambda solution or separately maintained StackSet process.

zh.question: 一家公司需要采用多账户策略来部署其应用程序和相关的 CI/CD 基础设施。该公司已在 AWS Organizations 中创建了一个启用了所有功能的组织。该公司已配置 AWS Control Tower 并设置了 landing zone。该公司需要在组织中的所有 AWS 账户中使用 AWS Control Tower 控制措施（guardrails）。该公司必须为多环境应用程序创建账户，并确保所有账户都配置了初始基线。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运营开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个使用基线配置的 AWS Control Tower Account Factory Customization (AFC) blueprint。使用该 blueprint 通过 AWS Control Tower Account Factory 为每个环境以及 CI/CD 账户预置专用 AWS 账户。
options.B: 使用 AWS Control Tower Account Factory 为每个环境以及 CI/CD 账户预置专用 AWS 账户。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 将基线配置应用到新账户。
options.C: 使用 Organizations 预置一个多环境 AWS 账户和一个 CI/CD 账户。在 Organizations 管理账户中，创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数承担 Organizations 访问角色以将基线配置应用到新账户。
options.D: 使用 Organizations 为每个环境、审计账户和 CI/CD 账户预置专用 AWS 账户。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 将基线配置应用到新账户。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司已有一个 AWS Control Tower landing zone，并希望：

1. 为应用程序的各个环境和 CI/CD 基础设施创建独立账户。
2. 将这些账户纳入 AWS Control Tower 治理，以便强制实施适用的控制措施。
3. 应用预定义的初始基线配置。
4. 最大限度地减少持续的运营工作量。

## 正确答案：A

**创建一个包含基线配置的 AWS Control Tower Account Factory Customization (AFC) blueprint，并使用 Account Factory 通过该 blueprint 为每个环境账户和 CI/CD 账户进行预置。**

AFC 专为此使用场景而设计。AWS Control Tower 可以使用由 CloudFormation 或 Terraform 支持的 AWS Service Catalog blueprint，在账户预置期间对账户进行自定义。AWS 表示，配置 AFC 后，Control Tower 会自动执行未来的预置，客户无需维护自定义管道。这直接满足了**最低运营开销**这一要求：[使用 Account Factory Customization (AFC) 自定义账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/af-customization-page.html)。

当账户创建完成时，blueprint 中指定的资源已部署到新账户中：[从 blueprint 创建自定义账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/create-afc-customized-account.html)。

Account Factory 会将账户预置到已启用 Control Tower 基线的 Control Tower landing zone 和已注册 OU 中。Control Tower 注册会为账户应用基线，并应用与所选 OU 关联的强制性控制措施和检测性控制措施。注册过程还会配置 AWS Config 等服务以及相关的 Control Tower StackSets：[账户注册期间会发生什么](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html)。

因此，AFC 将受治理的账户预置和应用程序特定基线部署整合到一个托管工作流中，而不是要求单独运行自定义机制。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. Account Factory 加上单独管理的 CloudFormation StackSets

Account Factory 适合创建受治理的账户，而 StackSets 在技术上可以在之后部署基线。但是，这会将账户创建与自定义分离，要求公司独立管理 StackSet 的部署、目标选择、顺序、故障和更新。

AFC 已经指示 CloudFormation 代表 AWS Control Tower 创建和管理所需的 StackSet，并自动执行未来的自定义账户预置。因此，选项 B 的运营开销高于 A：[使用 Account Factory Customization (AFC) 自定义账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/af-customization-page.html)。

### C. Organizations 账户创建加上自定义 Lambda 函数

此选项会创建一个定制的账户自定义系统。公司需要开发、保护、监控、重试和维护 Lambda 函数及其跨账户角色承担逻辑。

此外，通过 AWS Organizations 直接创建账户并不等同于通过 Account Factory 预置账户。Control Tower 注册是为账户应用基线、将其置于指定的受治理 OU 中、应用强制性控制措施以及配置检测性控制措施的过程。因此，直接通过 Organizations 预置还需要额外处理注册或自动注册：[账户注册期间会发生什么](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html)。

它还描述了一个单独的“多环境”应用程序账户，而非每个环境一个专用账户，这削弱了预期的多账户隔离。

### D. Organizations 账户创建加上 StackSets

此选项同样绕过了集成的 Account Factory/AFC 工作流。直接通过 Organizations 创建的账户在获得完整的 Control Tower 账户基线和适用控制措施之前，需要额外处理 Control Tower 注册。独立运行的 StackSets 会增加部署和生命周期管理开销：[使用 Account Factory 预置和管理账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/account-factory.html) 和 [账户注册期间会发生什么](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html)。

由于 AWS Control Tower landing zone 已包含其治理账户结构，因此额外的审计账户对于所述的应用程序账户要求也是不必要的。最重要的是，该选项未提供 AFC 所提供的托管式、预置期间集成自定义功能。

## 结论

**A** 是最佳解决方案，因为 Account Factory 会在 AWS Control Tower 治理下预置账户，而 AFC 会作为同一自动化工作流的一部分部署所需的初始基线，从而避免使用自定义 Lambda 解决方案或单独维护 StackSet 流程。

en.question: A DevOps team has created a Custom Lambda rule in AWS Config. The rule monitors Amazon Elastic Container Repository (Amazon ECR) policy statements for ecr:* actions. When a noncompliant repository is detected, Amazon EventBridge uses Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to route the notification to a security team. When the custom AWS Config rule is evaluated, the AWS Lambda function fails to run. Which solution will resolve the issue?

options.A: Modify the Lambda function's resource policy to grant AWS Config permission to invoke the function.
options.B: Modify the SNS topic policy to include configuration changes for EventBridge to publish to the SNS topic.
options.C: Modify the Lambda function's execution role to include configuration changes for custom AWS Config rules.
options.D: Modify all the ECR repository policies to grant AWS Config access to the necessary ECR API actions.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The custom rule uses AWS Lambda as its evaluation engine. The key failure occurs when the AWS Config rule is evaluated and the Lambda function does not run, so the issue is at the **service-to-function invocation boundary**, before the downstream EventBridge/SNS notification path or the function's ECR inspection logic matters.

AWS documentation states that AWS Config invokes the Lambda function associated with a custom Lambda rule when the rule is initiated. Lambda documentation further states that when an AWS service invokes a function, the service must be granted permission through the function's **resource-based policy**. Therefore, the function policy must allow the AWS Config service principal to perform `lambda:InvokeFunction`, preferably restricted by source account and source ARN conditions where applicable. See [Creating AWS Config Custom Lambda Rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_develop-rules_lambda-functions.html) and [Granting Lambda function access to AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/permissions-function-services.html).

## Correct answer

**A. Modify the Lambda function's resource policy to grant AWS Config permission to invoke the function.**

This resolves the direct cause: AWS Config needs permission on the Lambda function's resource-based policy to invoke it. Conceptually, the statement permits the `config.amazonaws.com` service principal to call `lambda:InvokeFunction` on the function.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. Modify the SNS topic policy to include configuration changes for EventBridge to publish to the SNS topic.**  
  An SNS topic policy allowing the `events.amazonaws.com` principal to perform `sns:Publish` is required for EventBridge-to-SNS delivery, as documented in [Amazon SNS permissions for EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-use-resource-based.html). However, that is a **downstream notification permission**. It cannot resolve AWS Config's inability to invoke the evaluation Lambda function in the first place.

- **C. Modify the Lambda function's execution role to include configuration changes for custom AWS Config rules.**  
  The execution role controls what the Lambda function can do **after it has been invoked**, such as accessing AWS Config APIs, configuration snapshots, or ECR APIs. AWS documents `AWSConfigRulesExecutionRole` as granting the function access to AWS Config APIs and configuration snapshots; it does not grant AWS Config permission to invoke the function. See [AWS managed policy: AWSConfigRulesExecutionRole](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html). An execution-role problem would generally cause authorization failures inside an already-started invocation, not prevent AWS Config from invoking the function.

- **D. Modify all the ECR repository policies to grant AWS Config access to the necessary ECR API actions.**  
  AWS Config is not directly running the repository-policy inspection code; the Lambda function performs the evaluation. Any necessary calls to ECR would be authorized through the Lambda execution role and, where relevant, ECR resource policies. Changing every repository policy neither grants AWS Config permission to invoke Lambda nor addresses the reported invocation-stage failure. It would also be an unnecessarily broad modification to the resources being assessed.

**Answer: A**

zh.question: 一个 DevOps 团队在 AWS Config 中创建了一个自定义 Lambda 规则。该规则监控 Amazon Elastic Container Repository (Amazon ECR) 策略语句中的 `ecr:*` 操作。检测到不合规的存储库时，Amazon EventBridge 使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 将通知路由到安全团队。评估自定义 AWS Config 规则时，AWS Lambda 函数无法运行。哪种解决方案可以解决该问题？

options.A: 修改 Lambda 函数的资源策略，以授予 AWS Config 调用该函数的权限。
options.B: 修改 SNS 主题策略，以包含配置更改，从而允许 EventBridge 向 SNS 主题发布消息。
options.C: 修改 Lambda 函数的执行角色，以包含针对自定义 AWS Config 规则的配置更改。
options.D: 修改所有 ECR 存储库策略，以授予 AWS Config 对所需 ECR API 操作的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该自定义规则使用 AWS Lambda 作为其评估引擎。关键故障发生在评估 AWS Config 规则时 Lambda 函数未能运行，因此问题位于**服务到函数的调用边界**，在下游 EventBridge/SNS 通知路径或函数的 ECR 检查逻辑发挥作用之前。

AWS 文档指出，当自定义 Lambda 规则启动时，AWS Config 会调用与该规则关联的 Lambda 函数。Lambda 文档还指出，当 AWS 服务调用函数时，必须通过函数的**基于资源的策略**授予该服务权限。因此，函数策略必须允许 AWS Config 服务主体执行 `lambda:InvokeFunction`，并且在适用时，最好使用源账户和源 ARN 条件进行限制。请参阅 [创建 AWS Config 自定义 Lambda 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_develop-rules_lambda-functions.html) 和 [授予 Lambda 函数对 AWS 服务的访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/permissions-function-services.html)。

## 正确答案

**A. 修改 Lambda 函数的资源策略，以授予 AWS Config 调用该函数的权限。**

这解决了直接原因：AWS Config 需要在 Lambda 函数的基于资源的策略中获得调用该函数的权限。从概念上讲，该语句允许 `config.amazonaws.com` 服务主体对该函数调用 `lambda:InvokeFunction`。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **B. 修改 SNS 主题策略，以包含配置更改，从而允许 EventBridge 向 SNS 主题发布消息。**  
  如 [EventBridge 的 Amazon SNS 权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-use-resource-based.html) 所述，允许 `events.amazonaws.com` 主体执行 `sns:Publish` 的 SNS 主题策略是 EventBridge 向 SNS 传递消息所必需的。但是，这属于**下游通知权限**。它无法解决 AWS Config 最初无法调用评估 Lambda 函数的问题。

- **C. 修改 Lambda 函数的执行角色，以包含针对自定义 AWS Config 规则的配置更改。**  
  执行角色控制 Lambda 函数在**被调用后**可以执行的操作，例如访问 AWS Config API、配置快照或 ECR API。AWS 将 `AWSConfigRulesExecutionRole` 文档化为向函数授予 AWS Config API 和配置快照访问权限；它并不授予 AWS Config 调用该函数的权限。请参阅 [AWS 托管策略：AWSConfigRulesExecutionRole](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)。执行角色问题通常会导致已启动调用内部的授权失败，而不会阻止 AWS Config 调用该函数。

- **D. 修改所有 ECR 存储库策略，以授予 AWS Config 对所需 ECR API 操作的访问权限。**  
  AWS Config 并不直接运行存储库策略检查代码；由 Lambda 函数执行评估。对 ECR 的任何必要调用都将通过 Lambda 执行角色以及相关情况下的 ECR 资源策略进行授权。更改每个存储库策略既不会授予 AWS Config 调用 Lambda 的权限，也无法解决所报告的调用阶段失败。此外，这还会对正在评估的资源进行不必要的广泛修改。

**答案：A**

en.question: A developer is creating a proof of concept for a new software as a service (SaaS) application. The application is in a shared development AWS account that is part of an organization in AWS Organizations. The developer needs to create service-linked IAM roles for the AWS services that are being considered for the proof of concept. The solution needs to give the developer the ability to create and configure the service-linked roles only. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM user for the developer in the organization's management account. Configure a cross-account role in the development account for the developer to use. Limit the scope of the cross-account role to common services.
options.B: Add the developer to an IAM group. Attach the PowerUserAccess managed policy to the IAM group. Enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA) on the user account.
options.C: Add an SCP to the development account in Organizations. Configure the SCP with a Deny rule for iam:* to limit the developer's access.
options.D: Create an IAM role that has the necessary IAM access to allow the developer to create policies and roles. Create and attach a permissions boundary to the role. Grant the developer access to assume the role.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The developer needs delegated IAM administration in the shared development account, but only within a tightly controlled scope for creating and configuring service-linked roles. The key requirement is therefore to grant the necessary IAM permissions while enforcing a maximum-permissions guardrail.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an IAM role with the required IAM permissions, attach a permissions boundary, and allow the developer to assume the role.**

A permissions boundary sets the maximum permissions that an identity-based policy can grant to a role. AWS specifically recommends permissions boundaries when delegating permissions management—for example, when developers need to create or manage roles for their workloads. The boundary does not grant access by itself, so the assumable role must also have an identity policy granting the required operations. See [Use permissions boundaries to delegate permissions management within an account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html).

For least privilege, the role policy and its boundary should be scoped to service-linked-role management, such as:

- `iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole`
- Any required configuration operations, such as `iam:AttachRolePolicy`, `iam:PutRolePolicy`, or `iam:UpdateRoleDescription`
- Service-linked-role ARN paths such as `arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*`
- Where appropriate, the `iam:AWSServiceName` condition key to restrict creation to the AWS services being evaluated

AWS documents these resource and condition-based restrictions in [Service-linked role permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_create-service-linked-role.html). Thus, option D provides the intended combination of delegated access and an enforceable upper limit on permissions.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. IAM user in the management account with a cross-account role

This introduces an unnecessary long-term IAM user in the highly privileged Organizations management account. The application and required roles are in the development account, so access should be delegated directly through a controlled role there. In addition, limiting the cross-account role to “common services” does not specifically guarantee that the developer can perform only the required service-linked-role operations.

### B. PowerUserAccess with MFA

MFA improves authentication security but does not reduce authorization scope. `PowerUserAccess` grants broad permissions to create and configure application resources across AWS services; it also explicitly includes permission to create service-linked roles. Therefore, it grants substantially more access than the requirement permits. See [Developer power user job function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_job-functions.html).

### C. SCP with `Deny` for `iam:*`

An SCP does not grant permissions; it establishes the maximum permissions available to identities in member accounts. An explicit denial of `iam:*` would block the developer from calling `iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole` and the other IAM operations needed to configure the roles. AWS confirms that users and roles must still receive permissions from IAM policies and that an SCP denial overrides an IAM allow. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Therefore, **D** is the best solution.

zh.question: 一名开发人员正在为一个新的软件即服务 (SaaS) 应用程序创建概念验证。该应用程序位于一个共享的开发 AWS 账户中，该账户属于 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织。开发人员需要为正在考虑用于概念验证的 AWS 服务创建服务相关 IAM 角色。该解决方案需要仅授予开发人员创建和配置服务相关角色的能力。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在组织的管理账户中为开发人员创建一个 IAM 用户。在开发账户中配置一个供开发人员使用的跨账户角色。将跨账户角色的范围限制为常用服务。
options.B: 将开发人员添加到一个 IAM 组。将 PowerUserAccess 托管策略附加到该 IAM 组。对用户账户强制实施多重身份验证 (MFA)。
options.C: 在 Organizations 中向开发账户添加 SCP。配置该 SCP，使其包含针对 `iam:*` 的 Deny 规则，以限制开发人员的访问权限。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 角色，该角色具有允许开发人员创建策略和角色所需的 IAM 访问权限。创建权限边界并将其附加到该角色。授予开发人员代入该角色的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

开发人员需要在共享开发账户中获得委派的 IAM 管理权限，但仅限于为创建和配置服务相关角色而严格控制的范围。因此，关键要求是在强制实施最大权限护栏的同时授予必要的 IAM 权限。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 创建具有所需 IAM 权限的 IAM 角色，附加权限边界，并允许开发人员代入该角色。**

权限边界设定了基于身份的策略可授予某个角色的最大权限。AWS 明确建议在委派权限管理时使用权限边界——例如，当开发人员需要为其工作负载创建或管理角色时。权限边界本身不授予访问权限，因此可代入的角色还必须具有一个身份策略，用于授予所需操作。请参阅 [使用权限边界在账户内委派权限管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)。

为遵循最小权限原则，角色策略及其边界应限定为服务相关角色管理，例如：

- `iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole`
- 所需的任何配置操作，例如 `iam:AttachRolePolicy`、`iam:PutRolePolicy` 或 `iam:UpdateRoleDescription`
- 服务相关角色 ARN 路径，例如 `arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*`
- 在适当的情况下，使用 `iam:AWSServiceName` 条件键将创建操作限制为正在评估的 AWS 服务

AWS 在[服务相关角色权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_create-service-linked-role.html)中记录了这些基于资源和条件的限制。因此，选项 D 提供了委派访问权限与可强制执行的权限上限的预期组合。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 在管理账户中创建 IAM 用户并使用跨账户角色

这会在具有高权限的 Organizations 管理账户中引入一个不必要的长期 IAM 用户。应用程序和所需角色均位于开发账户中，因此应通过该账户内受控的角色直接委派访问权限。此外，将跨账户角色限制为“常用服务”并不能明确保证开发人员只能执行所需的服务相关角色操作。

### B. 使用 MFA 的 PowerUserAccess

MFA 可以提高身份验证安全性，但不会缩小授权范围。`PowerUserAccess` 授予在各 AWS 服务中创建和配置应用程序资源的广泛权限；它还明确包含创建服务相关角色的权限。因此，它授予的访问权限远远超出该要求所允许的范围。请参阅[开发人员高级用户职能](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_job-functions.html)。

### C. 对 `iam:*` 使用 `Deny` 的 SCP

SCP 不授予权限；它规定成员账户中身份可获得的最大权限。对 `iam:*` 的显式拒绝将阻止开发人员调用 `iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole`，以及配置这些角色所需的其他 IAM 操作。AWS 确认，用户和角色仍必须从 IAM 策略中获得权限，并且 SCP 拒绝会覆盖 IAM 允许。请参阅 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

因此，**D** 是最佳解决方案。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. The company wants its monitoring system to receive an alert when a root user logs in. The company also needs a dashboard to display any log activity that the root user generates. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Enable AWS Config with a multi-account aggregator. Configure log forwarding to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
options.B: Create an Amazon QuickSight dashboard that uses an Amazon CloudWatch Logs query.
options.C: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs metric filter to match root user login events. Configure a CloudWatch alarm and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send alerts to the company's monitoring system.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs subscription filter to match root user login events. Configure the filter to forward events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Configure the SNS topic to send alerts to the company's monitoring system.
options.E: Create an AWS CloudTrail organization trail. Configure the organization trail to send events to Amazon CloudWatch Logs.
options.F: Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that uses a CloudWatch Logs Insights query.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The solution needs three capabilities across all accounts in the AWS organization:

1. Centrally capture root-user activity from every account.
2. Generate an alert when a root user signs in.
3. Display root-user log activity on a dashboard.

## Correct answers: C, E, and F

### E. Create a CloudTrail organization trail and send events to CloudWatch Logs

An organization trail logs events for the management account and all member accounts in the AWS organization. Sending those events to CloudWatch Logs provides the centralized log group that the metric filter and Logs Insights dashboard can use. AWS documents that organization trails log events for all organization accounts, and that CloudTrail can deliver events to CloudWatch Logs for monitoring and analysis.

- [Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html)
- [Monitoring CloudTrail log files with CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/monitor-cloudtrail-log-files-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)

### C. Create a CloudWatch Logs metric filter, CloudWatch alarm, and SNS notification

A metric filter can match CloudTrail events associated with the root identity and publish a metric value when a matching event occurs. A CloudWatch alarm can monitor that metric and notify an SNS topic, whose subscription delivers the alert to the monitoring system.

This is the AWS-documented pattern for monitoring root-user activity: CloudTrail trail → CloudWatch Logs metric filter → CloudWatch alarm → SNS notification. The filter can be made specific to root-user console sign-in events, such as by matching the root identity and the relevant `ConsoleLogin` event.

- [Security Hub CloudWatch.1: metric filter and alarm for root-user usage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-controls.html)
- [Monitoring CloudTrail log files with CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/monitor-cloudtrail-log-files-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)

### F. Create a CloudWatch dashboard that uses a Logs Insights query

CloudWatch Logs Insights can query the centralized CloudTrail log group for events generated by the root identity. AWS explicitly supports adding Logs Insights query results as a widget on a CloudWatch dashboard. This provides the required display of detailed root-user log activity, rather than only an aggregate alarm count.

- [Add a CloudWatch Logs Insights query to a dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_ExportQueryResults.html)

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Enable AWS Config with a multi-account aggregator

AWS Config records resource configurations, configuration changes, and compliance state. It is not the service that captures authentication events or general API activity performed by the root user. A Config aggregator therefore does not replace the required CloudTrail organization trail. The documented root-usage control uses CloudTrail, a CloudWatch Logs metric filter, an alarm, and SNS; it is not backed by an AWS Config managed rule.

- [Security Hub CloudWatch.1: metric filter and alarm for root-user usage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-controls.html)

### B. Create a QuickSight dashboard that uses a CloudWatch Logs query

QuickSight is not the native destination for directly adding a CloudWatch Logs Insights query as described. CloudWatch provides the direct supported workflow: run a Logs Insights query and add its results to a CloudWatch dashboard. Therefore, F meets the requirement directly without a separate analytics ingestion architecture.

- [Add a CloudWatch Logs Insights query to a dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_ExportQueryResults.html)

### D. Send a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter directly to SNS

Amazon SNS is not a supported direct destination for a CloudWatch Logs subscription filter. The documented destinations are Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, Amazon Data Firehose, and OpenSearch Service. Consequently, the subscription-filter-to-SNS architecture stated in D is invalid. The correct SNS alerting path is a metric filter followed by a CloudWatch alarm, as in C.

- [CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)

Therefore, **C + E + F** provides organization-wide collection, alerting for root-user sign-ins, and dashboard visualization of root-user activity.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理其 AWS 账户。该公司希望在根用户登录时，其监控系统能够收到警报。该公司还需要一个控制面板来显示根用户生成的任何日志活动。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 启用具有多账户聚合器的 AWS Config。配置日志转发到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。
options.B: 创建一个使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 查询的 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器以匹配根用户登录事件。配置 CloudWatch 警报和 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以向公司的监控系统发送警报。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器以匹配根用户登录事件。配置该筛选器将事件转发到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。配置 SNS 主题以向公司的监控系统发送警报。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS CloudTrail 组织跟踪。配置该组织跟踪将事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。
options.F: 创建一个使用 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询的 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该解决方案需要在 AWS 组织的所有账户中具备三项能力：

1. 集中捕获每个账户中的根用户活动。
2. 在根用户登录时生成警报。
3. 在控制面板上显示根用户日志活动。

## 正确答案：C、E 和 F

### E. 创建 CloudTrail 组织跟踪并将事件发送到 CloudWatch Logs

组织跟踪会记录 AWS 组织中管理账户和所有成员账户的事件。将这些事件发送到 CloudWatch Logs 后，便可提供指标筛选器和 Logs Insights 控制面板可使用的集中式日志组。AWS 文档说明，组织跟踪会记录所有组织账户的事件，并且 CloudTrail 可以将事件传输到 CloudWatch Logs 以进行监控和分析。

- [为组织创建跟踪](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html)
- [使用 CloudWatch Logs 监控 CloudTrail 日志文件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/monitor-cloudtrail-log-files-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)

### C. 创建 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器、CloudWatch 警报和 SNS 通知

指标筛选器可以匹配与根身份关联的 CloudTrail 事件，并在发生匹配事件时发布指标值。CloudWatch 警报可以监控该指标并通知 SNS 主题，该主题的订阅会将警报传送到监控系统。

这是 AWS 文档化的根用户活动监控模式：CloudTrail 跟踪 → CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器 → CloudWatch 警报 → SNS 通知。可以使该筛选器专门匹配根用户控制台登录事件，例如通过匹配根身份和相关的 `ConsoleLogin` 事件。

- [Security Hub CloudWatch.1：用于根用户使用情况的指标筛选器和警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-controls.html)
- [使用 CloudWatch Logs 监控 CloudTrail 日志文件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/monitor-cloudtrail-log-files-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)

### F. 创建使用 Logs Insights 查询的 CloudWatch 控制面板

CloudWatch Logs Insights 可以查询集中式 CloudTrail 日志组，以查找由根身份生成的事件。AWS 明确支持将 Logs Insights 查询结果作为小组件添加到 CloudWatch 控制面板。这可以按要求显示详细的根用户日志活动，而不仅仅是聚合的警报计数。

- [将 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询添加到控制面板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_ExportQueryResults.html)

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 启用具有多账户聚合器的 AWS Config

AWS Config 记录资源配置、配置更改和合规性状态。它并不是用于捕获根用户执行的身份验证事件或常规 API 活动的服务。因此，Config 聚合器不能替代所需的 CloudTrail 组织跟踪。文档化的根用户使用情况控制使用 CloudTrail、CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器、警报和 SNS；它并非由 AWS Config 托管规则支持。

- [Security Hub CloudWatch.1：用于根用户使用情况的指标筛选器和警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/securityhub/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-controls.html)

### B. 创建使用 CloudWatch Logs 查询的 QuickSight 控制面板

QuickSight 并不是用于按所述方式直接添加 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询的原生目标。CloudWatch 提供了直接支持的工作流程：运行 Logs Insights 查询并将其结果添加到 CloudWatch 控制面板。因此，F 可以直接满足要求，无需单独的分析数据提取架构。

- [将 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询添加到控制面板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_ExportQueryResults.html)

### D. 将 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器直接发送到 SNS

Amazon SNS 不是 CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器支持的直接目标。文档中列出的目标包括 Kinesis Data Streams、Lambda、Amazon Data Firehose 和 OpenSearch Service。因此，D 中所述的订阅筛选器到 SNS 的架构无效。正确的 SNS 告警路径是先使用指标筛选器，再使用 CloudWatch 警报，如 C 所示。

- [CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)

因此，**C + E + F** 提供了组织范围内的收集、根用户登录警报以及根用户活动的控制面板可视化。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. A DevOps engineer must ensure that all users who access the AWS Management Console are authenticated through the company’s corporate identity provider (IdP). Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use Amazon GuardDuty with a delegated administrator account Use GuardDuty to enforce denial of IAM user logins.
options.B: Use AWS IAM Identity Center to configure identity federation with SAML 2.0.
options.C: Create a permissions boundary in AWS IAM Identity Center to deny password logins for IAM users.
options.D: Create IAM groups in the Organizations management account to apply consistent permissions for all IAM users.
options.E: Create an SCP in Organizations to deny password creation for IAM users.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs two complementary controls:

1. A centralized federation path that authenticates workforce users through the corporate identity provider (IdP).
2. An organization-wide guardrail that prevents IAM users from being given native AWS Management Console passwords.

## Correct answers: B and E

### B. Use AWS IAM Identity Center to configure identity federation with SAML 2.0

IAM Identity Center can use an external corporate IdP as its identity source. AWS states that, with an external IdP, IAM Identity Center redirects AWS Management Console authentication to that IdP and then grants access based on IAM Identity Center assignments and policies. SAML 2.0 is the standard federation protocol for this integration. This establishes the required corporate-authentication path. See [External identity providers in IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html) and [Federating users from an existing identity source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction_identity-management.html).

### E. Create an SCP in Organizations to deny password creation for IAM users

An IAM user needs a password/login profile to sign in directly to the AWS Management Console. The relevant IAM operations include `iam:CreateLoginProfile` for creating a console password and `iam:UpdateLoginProfile` for changing one. AWS Organizations SCPs centrally establish the maximum permissions available to IAM users and roles in member accounts; an explicit deny remains effective even when an account administrator attaches an otherwise broad IAM policy. Therefore, an SCP denying the login-profile operations prevents member-account administrators from enabling native password-based console access and supports the requirement that users use federation instead. See [Managing passwords for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_admin-change-user.html) and [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

A representative guardrail would deny at least:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": {
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Action": [
      "iam:CreateLoginProfile",
      "iam:UpdateLoginProfile"
    ],
    "Resource": "*"
  }
}
```

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Use GuardDuty to enforce denial of IAM user logins

GuardDuty is a threat-detection service. It analyzes AWS activity and produces security findings; it is not an authentication-policy enforcement service and cannot deny IAM user console sign-ins. See [What is Amazon GuardDuty?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html).

### C. Create a permissions boundary in IAM Identity Center to deny password logins

Permissions boundaries are IAM authorization controls attached to IAM users or roles. They define the maximum AWS API permissions that identity-based policies can grant; they do not select or enforce the user's authentication mechanism. In addition, an “IAM Identity Center permissions boundary” for denying password login is not the appropriate construct. See [Permissions boundaries for IAM entities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html).

A boundary could restrict whether a particular IAM principal is authorized to call an IAM API such as `CreateLoginProfile`, but that is not the centralized organization-wide control described by this option and does not itself prevent that principal from authenticating with an already configured password.

### D. Create IAM groups in the Organizations management account

IAM users and IAM groups are account-level identities. A group in the management account does not contain or centrally govern IAM users in all member accounts. Groups also manage authorization permissions, not the requirement to authenticate through the corporate IdP. Central workforce access across organization accounts should instead be managed through IAM Identity Center. See [Compare IAM identities and credentials](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction_identity-management.html).

## Technical caveat

**B and E are the intended and best available answers**, but option E is imprecisely worded. Denying future password creation does not automatically remove login profiles that already exist. Existing IAM user passwords would need to be disabled with `DeleteLoginProfile`; AWS explicitly states that deleting an IAM user's password removes that user's direct console access. Also, SCPs do not affect users or roles in the Organizations management account. A fully rigorous implementation must therefore:

- remove existing IAM user login profiles,
- deny creation/update of new login profiles in member accounts, and
- separately control IAM users in the management account.

These limitations are documented in [Managing passwords for IAM users](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_admin-change-user.html) and [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 来管理其 AWS 账户。一名 DevOps 工程师必须确保所有访问 AWS Management Console 的用户都通过公司的企业身份提供商 (IdP) 进行身份验证。以下哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 使用具有委派管理员账户的 Amazon GuardDuty。使用 GuardDuty 强制拒绝 IAM 用户登录。
options.B: 使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 通过 SAML 2.0 配置身份联合。
options.C: 在 AWS IAM Identity Center 中创建权限边界，以拒绝 IAM 用户使用密码登录。
options.D: 在 Organizations 管理账户中创建 IAM 组，以便为所有 IAM 用户应用一致的权限。
options.E: 在 Organizations 中创建 SCP，以拒绝为 IAM 用户创建密码。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

公司需要两项互补的控制措施：

1. 一个集中式联合访问路径，通过企业身份提供商 (IdP) 对员工用户进行身份验证。
2. 一个组织范围的防护措施，防止为 IAM 用户设置原生 AWS Management Console 密码。

## 正确答案：B 和 E

### B. 使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 通过 SAML 2.0 配置身份联合

IAM Identity Center 可以使用外部企业 IdP 作为其身份源。AWS 表示，使用外部 IdP 时，IAM Identity Center 会将 AWS Management Console 身份验证重定向到该 IdP，然后根据 IAM Identity Center 分配和策略授予访问权限。SAML 2.0 是此集成使用的标准联合协议。这建立了所需的企业身份验证路径。请参阅 [IAM Identity Center 中的外部身份提供商](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/manage-your-identity-source-idp.html) 和 [从现有身份源联合用户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction_identity-management.html)。

### E. 在 Organizations 中创建 SCP，以拒绝为 IAM 用户创建密码

IAM 用户需要密码/登录配置文件才能直接登录 AWS Management Console。相关 IAM 操作包括用于创建控制台密码的 `iam:CreateLoginProfile`，以及用于更改密码的 `iam:UpdateLoginProfile`。AWS Organizations SCP 集中定义成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色可获得的最大权限；即使账户管理员附加了原本权限宽泛的 IAM 策略，显式拒绝仍然有效。因此，拒绝登录配置文件操作的 SCP 可防止成员账户管理员启用原生的基于密码的控制台访问，并支持用户必须改用联合访问的要求。请参阅 [管理 IAM 用户的密码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_admin-change-user.html) 和 [服务控制策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

一个代表性的防护措施至少应拒绝：

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": {
    "Effect": "Deny",
    "Action": [
      "iam:CreateLoginProfile",
      "iam:UpdateLoginProfile"
    ],
    "Resource": "*"
  }
}
```

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 使用 GuardDuty 强制拒绝 IAM 用户登录

GuardDuty 是一项威胁检测服务。它分析 AWS 活动并生成安全发现；它不是身份验证策略强制执行服务，也无法拒绝 IAM 用户的控制台登录。请参阅 [什么是 Amazon GuardDuty？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/what-is-guardduty.html)。

### C. 在 IAM Identity Center 中创建权限边界，以拒绝密码登录

权限边界是附加到 IAM 用户或角色的 IAM 授权控制机制。它们定义基于身份的策略可授予的最大 AWS API 权限；它们不选择或强制用户的身份验证机制。此外，用于拒绝密码登录的“IAM Identity Center 权限边界”并不是适当的构造。请参阅 [IAM 实体的权限边界](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html)。

权限边界可以限制特定 IAM 主体是否有权调用诸如 `CreateLoginProfile` 之类的 IAM API，但这并不是该选项所描述的集中式组织范围控制，并且它本身无法阻止该主体使用已配置的密码进行身份验证。

### D. 在 Organizations 管理账户中创建 IAM 组

IAM 用户和 IAM 组都是账户级身份。管理账户中的组不能包含或集中管理所有成员账户中的 IAM 用户。组管理的是授权权限，而不是通过企业 IdP 进行身份验证的要求。跨组织账户的集中式员工访问应改由 IAM Identity Center 管理。请参阅 [比较 IAM 身份和凭证](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/introduction_identity-management.html)。

## 技术注意事项

**B 和 E 是预期的且最佳可用的答案**，但选项 E 的措辞不够精确。拒绝未来创建密码不会自动删除已经存在的登录配置文件。必须使用 `DeleteLoginProfile` 禁用现有 IAM 用户密码；AWS 明确指出，删除 IAM 用户的密码会移除该用户的直接控制台访问权限。此外，SCP 不影响 Organizations 管理账户中的用户或角色。因此，严谨的完整实施还必须：

- 删除现有 IAM 用户登录配置文件，
- 拒绝在成员账户中创建或更新新的登录配置文件，以及
- 单独控制管理账户中的 IAM 用户。

这些限制记录在 [管理 IAM 用户的密码](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_passwords_admin-change-user.html) 和 [服务控制策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) 中。

en.question: A company has deployed a new platform that runs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The new platform hosts web applications that users frequently update. The application developers build the Docker images for the applications and deploy the Docker images manually to the platform. The platform usage has increased to more than 500 users every day. Frequent updates, building the updated Docker images for the applications, and deploying the Docker images on the platform manually have all become difficult to manage. The company needs to receive an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification if Docker image scanning returns any HIGH or CRITICAL findings for operating system or programming language package vulnerabilities. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an AWS CodeCommit repository to store the Dockerfile and Kubernetes deployment files. Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. Use an Amazon S3 event to invoke the pipeline when a newer version of the Dockerfile is committed. Add a step to the pipeline to initiate the AWS CodeBuild project.
options.B: Create an AWS CodeCommit repository to store the Dockerfile and Kubernetes deployment files. Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. Use an Amazon EventBridge event to invoke the pipeline when a newer version of the Dockerfile is committed. Add a step to the pipeline to initiate the AWS CodeBuild project.
options.C: Create an AWS CodeBuild project that builds the Docker images and stores the Docker images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Turn on basic scanning for the ECR repository. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that monitors Amazon GuardDuty events. Configure the EventBridge rule to send an event to an SNS topic when the finding-severity-counts parameter is more than 0 at a CRITICAL or HIGH level.
options.D: Create an AWS CodeBuild project that builds the Docker images and stores the Docker images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Turn on enhanced scanning for the ECR repository. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that monitors ECR image scan events. Configure the EventBridge rule to send an event to an SNS topic when the finding-severity-counts parameter is more than 0 at a CRITICAL or HIGH level.
options.E: Create an AWS CodeBuild project that scans the Dockerfile. Configure the project to build the Docker images and store the Docker images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository if the scan is successful. Configure an SNS topic to provide notification if the scan returns any vulnerabilities.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs two capabilities:

1. An event-driven CI/CD workflow that reacts to changes to the Dockerfile and Kubernetes deployment files instead of requiring developers to build images manually.
2. Container-image scanning that covers **both operating system and programming-language packages**, with an SNS notification when **HIGH or CRITICAL** findings occur.

## Correct answers: B and D

### B. Use CodeCommit, CodePipeline, EventBridge, and CodeBuild

A CodeCommit repository is an appropriate source for the Dockerfile and Kubernetes manifests. An EventBridge rule can monitor CodeCommit repository state changes, such as a branch update caused by a commit, and invoke `StartPipelineExecution` on the target CodePipeline pipeline. The pipeline can then run the CodeBuild project to build the image.

AWS documents that a CodeCommit repository state-change event can be matched by EventBridge and used to start a CodePipeline execution: [Create an EventBridge rule for a CodeCommit source](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-trigger-source-repo-changes-cfn.html).

### D. Build into ECR, enable enhanced scanning, and route scan findings to SNS

CodeBuild can build the container image and push it to Amazon ECR. **Enhanced scanning** is required because it integrates Amazon ECR with Amazon Inspector and scans container images for both:

- Operating system vulnerabilities
- Programming-language package vulnerabilities

Enhanced scanning can operate on image push or continuously. Amazon Inspector emits EventBridge events when the initial image scan completes and when findings are created, updated, or closed. AWS's initial scan event includes the `finding-severity-counts` object with fields such as `CRITICAL` and `HIGH`, allowing an EventBridge rule to identify scans with relevant findings and route the event to an SNS topic.

See:

- [Amazon ECR enhanced scanning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced.html)
- [EventBridge events sent for enhanced scanning in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced-events.html)

Therefore, **B + D** provides event-driven image builds and the required vulnerability notifications.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect — an S3 event does not represent a CodeCommit commit

The Dockerfile is committed to CodeCommit, not uploaded to an S3 bucket. CodeCommit repository changes generate repository state-change events that EventBridge can use to start CodePipeline. An S3 object event is therefore the wrong trigger for detecting a new CodeCommit revision.

### C. Incorrect — wrong scan type and wrong security-event source

This option has two problems:

- **Basic scanning** scans operating system packages only; it does not satisfy the requirement to detect programming-language package vulnerabilities. AWS explicitly distinguishes basic scanning, which provides OS scans, from enhanced scanning, which covers OS and programming-language packages: [Amazon ECR image scanning types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html).
- GuardDuty events are unrelated to ECR image vulnerability scan results. Enhanced ECR scanning uses Amazon Inspector, which emits `Inspector2 Scan` and `Inspector2 Finding` events to EventBridge.

### E. Incorrect — scanning the Dockerfile is not equivalent to scanning the built image

A Dockerfile is only a set of image-build instructions. Scanning the Dockerfile does not inventory and assess all OS and language packages contained in the completed image. The requirement is specifically met by Amazon ECR enhanced scanning through Amazon Inspector. Additionally, the option does not describe the appropriate EventBridge integration for filtering HIGH or CRITICAL ECR/Inspector scan findings and routing those events to SNS.

zh.question: 一家公司已部署一个运行在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上的新平台。该新平台托管用户频繁更新的 Web 应用程序。应用程序开发人员为这些应用程序构建 Docker 镜像，并将 Docker 镜像手动部署到该平台。平台使用量已增加到每天超过 500 名用户。频繁更新、为应用程序构建更新后的 Docker 镜像以及在平台上手动部署 Docker 镜像，都已变得难以管理。如果 Docker 镜像扫描针对操作系统或编程语言软件包漏洞返回任何 HIGH 或 CRITICAL 发现结果，公司需要收到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 存储库来存储 Dockerfile 和 Kubernetes 部署文件。在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个管道。当提交较新版本的 Dockerfile 时，使用 Amazon S3 事件调用该管道。在该管道中添加一个步骤以启动 AWS CodeBuild 项目。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 存储库来存储 Dockerfile 和 Kubernetes 部署文件。在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个管道。当提交较新版本的 Dockerfile 时，使用 Amazon EventBridge 事件调用该管道。在该管道中添加一个步骤以启动 AWS CodeBuild 项目。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目，用于构建 Docker 镜像并将 Docker 镜像存储在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库中。为 ECR 存储库启用基本扫描。创建一个监控 Amazon GuardDuty 事件的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。当 finding-severity-counts 参数在 CRITICAL 或 HIGH 级别大于 0 时，配置 EventBridge 规则将事件发送到 SNS 主题。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目，用于构建 Docker 镜像并将 Docker 镜像存储在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库中。为 ECR 存储库启用增强扫描。创建一个监控 ECR 镜像扫描事件的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。当 finding-severity-counts 参数在 CRITICAL 或 HIGH 级别大于 0 时，配置 EventBridge 规则将事件发送到 SNS 主题。
options.E: 创建一个扫描 Dockerfile 的 AWS CodeBuild 项目。将该项目配置为构建 Docker 镜像，并且仅在扫描成功时将 Docker 镜像存储在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库中。配置一个 SNS 主题，以便在扫描返回任何漏洞时提供通知。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要两项能力：

1. 事件驱动的 CI/CD 工作流，能够对 Dockerfile 和 Kubernetes 部署文件的更改作出响应，而不是要求开发人员手动构建镜像。
2. 容器镜像扫描，覆盖**操作系统和编程语言软件包**，并且在出现 **HIGH 或 CRITICAL** 发现结果时发送 SNS 通知。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B. 使用 CodeCommit、CodePipeline、EventBridge 和 CodeBuild

CodeCommit 存储库是 Dockerfile 和 Kubernetes 清单的合适源。EventBridge 规则可以监控 CodeCommit 存储库状态更改，例如由提交导致的分支更新，并在目标 CodePipeline 管道上调用 `StartPipelineExecution`。随后，该管道可以运行 CodeBuild 项目来构建镜像。

AWS 文档说明，EventBridge 可以匹配 CodeCommit 存储库状态更改事件，并使用该事件启动 CodePipeline 执行：[为 CodeCommit 源创建 EventBridge 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-trigger-source-repo-changes-cfn.html)。

### D. 构建至 ECR、启用增强扫描，并将扫描发现结果路由至 SNS

CodeBuild 可以构建容器镜像并将其推送到 Amazon ECR。必须使用**增强扫描**，因为它将 Amazon ECR 与 Amazon Inspector 集成，并扫描容器镜像中的以下两类漏洞：

- 操作系统漏洞
- 编程语言软件包漏洞

增强扫描可在镜像推送时运行，也可持续运行。Amazon Inspector 会在初始镜像扫描完成时，以及在发现结果被创建、更新或关闭时发出 EventBridge 事件。AWS 的初始扫描事件包含 `finding-severity-counts` 对象，其中包含 `CRITICAL` 和 `HIGH` 等字段，因此 EventBridge 规则可以识别具有相关发现结果的扫描，并将事件路由到 SNS 主题。

请参阅：

- [Amazon ECR 增强扫描](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced.html)
- [Amazon ECR 中针对增强扫描发送的 EventBridge 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced-events.html)

因此，**B + D** 同时提供事件驱动的镜像构建和所需的漏洞通知。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 不正确 — S3 事件不代表 CodeCommit 提交

Dockerfile 被提交到 CodeCommit，而不是上传到 S3 存储桶。CodeCommit 存储库更改会生成存储库状态更改事件，EventBridge 可以使用这些事件启动 CodePipeline。因此，S3 对象事件不是检测新 CodeCommit 修订版本的正确触发器。

### C. 不正确 — 错误的扫描类型和安全事件来源

此选项有两个问题：

- **基本扫描**仅扫描操作系统软件包；它无法满足检测编程语言软件包漏洞的要求。AWS 明确区分基本扫描（提供 OS 扫描）和增强扫描（覆盖 OS 和编程语言软件包）：[Amazon ECR 镜像扫描类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html)。
- GuardDuty 事件与 ECR 镜像漏洞扫描结果无关。增强型 ECR 扫描使用 Amazon Inspector，后者会向 EventBridge 发出 `Inspector2 Scan` 和 `Inspector2 Finding` 事件。

### E. 不正确 — 扫描 Dockerfile 不等同于扫描构建完成的镜像

Dockerfile 只是一组镜像构建指令。扫描 Dockerfile 无法清点和评估完整镜像中包含的所有 OS 和语言软件包。该要求需通过 Amazon Inspector 的 Amazon ECR 增强扫描来满足。此外，该选项未说明适当的 EventBridge 集成，以筛选 HIGH 或 CRITICAL ECR/Inspector 扫描发现结果并将这些事件路由至 SNS。

options.A: Enable IAM authentication on all API methods by setting AWS JAM as the authorization method.
options.B: Create a token-based AWS Lambda authorizer that passes the caller's identity in a bearer token.
options.C: Create a request parameter-based AWS Lambda authorizer that passes the caller's identity in a combination of headers, query string parameters, stage variables, and $cortext variables.
options.D: Use Amazon Cognito user pools as the authorizer to control access to the API.
options.E: Verify the identity of the requester by using Signature Version 4 to sign client requests by using AWS credentials.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The VPC endpoint policy restricts access by the caller's AWS Organizations OU path through the `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` condition key. Therefore, API Gateway must be able to identify the caller as an authenticated AWS principal. The error occurs because the requests are currently reaching the endpoint without a valid AWS Signature Version 4 authorization header, so the endpoint evaluates the caller as **anonymous**.

## Correct answers: A and E

### A. Enable IAM authentication on all API methods by setting `AWS_IAM` as the authorization method

Option A contains an apparent typo (`AWS JAM`); it should be interpreted as **AWS IAM**.

API Gateway documentation states that IAM authentication must be enabled by setting each method's `authorizationType` to `AWS_IAM` for IAM permissions to control API invocation. AWS also specifically documents that private APIs can return the shown `User: anonymous is not authorized` error when access is based on AWS principals but the methods are not configured with `AWS_IAM` authorization.

With `AWS_IAM` enabled, API Gateway authorizes the authenticated caller against permissions such as `execute-api:Invoke`.

### E. Sign client requests with Signature Version 4 using AWS credentials

The client must send a valid SigV4-signed request so that the VPC endpoint can derive the authenticated IAM principal and populate principal-related request context, including the Organizations path used by `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths`.

AWS documents the endpoint-policy behavior explicitly:

- No authorization header: the invoker is evaluated as anonymous.
- A valid SigV4/SigV4a signature: the invoker is evaluated as the IAM identity represented by the signature.
- Non-SigV4 authorization information, including a bearer token: the invoker is evaluated as anonymous.

Thus, **A configures the API methods to use IAM authorization, and E supplies the authenticated AWS identity required by both IAM authorization and the OU-based endpoint-policy condition**.

See [Use VPC endpoint policies for private APIs in API Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-vpc-endpoint-policies.html), [Control who can call an API Gateway API method with IAM policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-control-access-using-iam-policies-to-invoke-api.html), and [Create a private API—troubleshooting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-api-create.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Token-based Lambda authorizer

A bearer token does not establish an IAM identity for evaluation by the VPC endpoint policy. API Gateway evaluates the VPC endpoint policy before evaluating the method's Lambda authorizer, and AWS explicitly states that non-SigV4 authorization information such as a bearer token is treated as an anonymous caller at the endpoint-policy layer. The request would therefore still fail the `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` condition before the Lambda authorizer could solve the problem.

### C. Request parameter-based Lambda authorizer

A request-based Lambda authorizer can consume headers, query parameters, stage variables, and request context variables, but it does not make the incoming request a SigV4-authenticated AWS principal. Because the VPC endpoint policy is evaluated first, it still cannot obtain the principal's Organizations OU path from an unsigned request.

### D. Amazon Cognito user pool authorizer

A Cognito user pool authorizer authenticates an application user through a JWT bearer token. It does not cause the VPC endpoint policy to recognize the caller as an IAM principal belonging to an Organizations OU. At the endpoint-policy layer, this non-SigV4 bearer-token request is evaluated as anonymous.

The decisive distinction is that Lambda and Cognito authorizers authenticate at the API authorization layer, whereas this endpoint policy requires an authenticated **AWS principal identity**, supplied through SigV4, before the API's authorizer is evaluated.

options.A: 通过将 AWS JAM 设置为授权方法，在所有 API 方法上启用 IAM 身份验证。
options.B: 创建一个基于令牌的 AWS Lambda 授权方，在 bearer token 中传递调用方的身份。
options.C: 创建一个基于请求参数的 AWS Lambda 授权方，在标头、查询字符串参数、阶段变量和 $cortext 变量的组合中传递调用方的身份。
options.D: 使用 Amazon Cognito 用户池作为授权方来控制对 API 的访问。
options.E: 使用 AWS 凭证通过 Signature Version 4 对客户端请求进行签名，以验证请求者的身份。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查的内容

VPC 终端节点策略通过 `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` 条件键，根据调用方的 AWS Organizations OU 路径限制访问。因此，API Gateway 必须能够将调用方识别为经过身份验证的 AWS 主体。发生此错误是因为请求当前到达终端节点时没有有效的 AWS Signature Version 4 授权标头，因此终端节点将调用方评估为 **anonymous**。

## 正确答案：A 和 E

### A. 通过将 `AWS_IAM` 设置为授权方法，在所有 API 方法上启用 IAM 身份验证

选项 A 中明显存在笔误（`AWS JAM`）；应将其理解为 **AWS IAM**。

API Gateway 文档指出，必须将每个方法的 `authorizationType` 设置为 `AWS_IAM` 以启用 IAM 身份验证，从而使 IAM 权限能够控制 API 调用。AWS 还专门说明，当访问基于 AWS 主体、但方法未配置 `AWS_IAM` 授权时，私有 API 可能会返回所示的 `User: anonymous is not authorized` 错误。

启用 `AWS_IAM` 后，API Gateway 会根据 `execute-api:Invoke` 等权限对经过身份验证的调用方进行授权。

### E. 使用 AWS 凭证通过 Signature Version 4 对客户端请求进行签名

客户端必须发送有效的 SigV4 签名请求，以便 VPC 终端节点能够推导出经过身份验证的 IAM 主体，并填充与主体相关的请求上下文，包括 `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` 所使用的 Organizations 路径。

AWS 明确记录了终端节点策略行为：

- 没有授权标头：调用方被评估为匿名。
- 有效的 SigV4/SigV4a 签名：调用方被评估为该签名所代表的 IAM 身份。
- 非 SigV4 授权信息，包括 bearer token：调用方被评估为匿名。

因此，**A 将 API 方法配置为使用 IAM 授权，而 E 提供了 IAM 授权和基于 OU 的终端节点策略条件所需的经过身份验证的 AWS 身份**。

请参阅 [在 API Gateway 中对私有 API 使用 VPC 终端节点策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-vpc-endpoint-policies.html)、[使用 IAM 策略控制谁可以调用 API Gateway API 方法](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/api-gateway-control-access-using-iam-policies-to-invoke-api.html) 和 [创建私有 API—故障排除](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/apigateway/latest/developerguide/apigateway-private-api-create.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 基于令牌的 Lambda 授权方

bearer token 不会为 VPC 终端节点策略评估建立 IAM 身份。API Gateway 会先于方法的 Lambda 授权方评估 VPC 终端节点策略，并且 AWS 明确指出，在终端节点策略层，诸如 bearer token 之类的非 SigV4 授权信息会被视为匿名调用方。因此，在 Lambda 授权方能够解决问题之前，请求仍会无法满足 `aws:PrincipalOrgPaths` 条件。

### C. 基于请求参数的 Lambda 授权方

基于请求的 Lambda 授权方可以使用标头、查询参数、阶段变量和请求上下文变量，但它不会使传入请求成为经过 SigV4 身份验证的 AWS 主体。由于 VPC 终端节点策略会先被评估，它仍无法从未签名的请求中获取主体的 Organizations OU 路径。

### D. Amazon Cognito 用户池授权方

Cognito 用户池授权方通过 JWT bearer token 对应用程序用户进行身份验证。它不会使 VPC 终端节点策略将调用方识别为属于 Organizations OU 的 IAM 主体。在终端节点策略层，这种非 SigV4 的 bearer-token 请求会被评估为匿名。

关键区别在于，Lambda 和 Cognito 授权方在 API 授权层进行身份验证，而此终端节点策略要求在评估 API 授权方之前，通过 SigV4 提供经过身份验证的 **AWS 主体身份**。

en.question: A company wants to decrease the time it takes to develop new features. The company uses AWS CodeBuild and AWS CodeDeploy to build and deploy its applications. The company uses AWS CodePipeline to deploy each microservice with its own CI/CD pipeline. The company needs more visibility into the average time between the release of new features and the average time to recover after a failed deployment. Which solution will provide this visibility with the LEAST configuration effort?

options.A: Program an AWS Lambda function that creates Amazon CloudWatch custom metrics with information about successful runs and failed runs for each pipeline. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function every 5 minutes. Use the metrics to build a CloudWatch dashboard.
options.B: Program an AWS Lambda function that creates Amazon CloudWatch custom metrics with information about successful runs and failed runs for each pipeline. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function after every successful run and after every failed run. Use the metrics to build a CloudWatch dashboard.
options.C: Program an AWS Lambda function that writes information about successful runs and failed runs to Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function after every successful run and after every failed run. Build an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to show the information from DynamoDB.
options.D: Program an AWS Lambda function that writes information about successful runs and failed runs to Amazon DynamoDB. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function every 5 minutes. Build an Amazon QuickSight dashboard to show the information from DynamoDB.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company wants CI/CD operational visibility into two delivery metrics across its microservice pipelines:

- **Time between successful feature releases**
- **Mean time to recover (MTTR)** after a failed deployment

The key qualifier is **least configuration effort**. The solution should therefore consume pipeline state changes as events instead of periodically polling pipelines, and it should use the native monitoring service rather than introduce a separate database and BI platform.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Invoke Lambda from EventBridge after every successful or failed pipeline run, publish custom CloudWatch metrics, and display them in a CloudWatch dashboard.**

CodePipeline emits pipeline execution state-change events when executions succeed or fail. These events include fields such as the pipeline name, execution ID, start time, event time, and state. EventBridge can filter for specific states such as `SUCCEEDED` and `FAILED` and route matching events to a target such as Lambda. This makes the collection process event-driven and near-real-time, without requiring scheduled polling. See [CodePipeline pipeline execution state-change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html).

The Lambda function can process these timestamps and states by pipeline, calculate or publish the values needed for release intervals and recovery durations, and use the pipeline name as a metric dimension. CloudWatch supports publishing application-defined metrics through `PutMetricData`, including metric dimensions and statistics such as `Average`. See [Publishing custom CloudWatch metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/publishingMetrics.html).

The metrics can then be selected directly for visualization in a CloudWatch dashboard. See [Adding a metric graph to a CloudWatch dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/add_line_dashboard.html).

This architecture uses the pipeline events at the moment they occur and stays within the EventBridge–Lambda–CloudWatch monitoring stack, providing the requested visibility with the least operational and configuration overhead.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Scheduled Lambda invocation with CloudWatch metrics

Invoking Lambda every 5 minutes does not directly consume pipeline state-change events. The function would need to poll CodePipeline APIs, identify executions that occurred since its previous invocation, prevent duplicate processing, and preserve a checkpoint or other state. It also introduces up to several minutes of reporting delay. Because CodePipeline already emits `SUCCEEDED` and `FAILED` events that EventBridge can match, scheduled polling requires more implementation effort than option B.

### C. Event-driven Lambda with DynamoDB and QuickSight

The event-driven invocation is appropriate, but adding DynamoDB plus QuickSight introduces an unnecessary persistence and BI layer when the desired output is operational metrics. The company would need to design and operate the DynamoDB table, prepare an analytics-compatible dataset, configure permissions, and build a QuickSight analysis and dashboard.

Moreover, DynamoDB is not listed as a direct QuickSight relational data source; accessing data from an unlisted source requires linking or importing it through a supported source, which adds even more integration work. See [QuickSight supported data sources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/supported-data-sources.html). CloudWatch custom metrics and dashboards are the more direct fit for pipeline timing and recovery metrics.

### D. Scheduled Lambda with DynamoDB and QuickSight

This option combines both disadvantages:

- Scheduled polling instead of reacting directly to CodePipeline events
- Extra DynamoDB and QuickSight configuration instead of publishing operational metrics directly to CloudWatch

It therefore has the greatest configuration and operational overhead of the four choices.

## Conclusion

**B** is the best answer because it captures each pipeline success or failure immediately through EventBridge, uses Lambda to publish pipeline-specific custom metrics, and displays those metrics directly in CloudWatch without scheduled polling or an additional database and BI stack.

zh.question: 一家公司希望缩短开发新功能所需的时间。该公司使用 AWS CodeBuild 和 AWS CodeDeploy 来构建和部署其应用程序。该公司使用 AWS CodePipeline 为每个微服务部署各自的 CI/CD 管道。该公司需要更深入地了解新功能发布之间的平均时间，以及失败部署后的平均恢复时间。哪种解决方案能够以最少的配置工作量提供这种可见性？

options.A: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，为每个管道创建包含成功运行和失败运行信息的 Amazon CloudWatch 自定义指标。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每 5 分钟调用一次该 Lambda 函数。使用这些指标构建一个 CloudWatch 控制面板。
options.B: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，为每个管道创建包含成功运行和失败运行信息的 Amazon CloudWatch 自定义指标。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在每次成功运行和每次失败运行后调用该 Lambda 函数。使用这些指标构建一个 CloudWatch 控制面板。
options.C: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将成功运行和失败运行的信息写入 Amazon DynamoDB。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，在每次成功运行和每次失败运行后调用该 Lambda 函数。构建一个 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板来显示 DynamoDB 中的信息。
options.D: 编写一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将成功运行和失败运行的信息写入 Amazon DynamoDB。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每 5 分钟调用一次该 Lambda 函数。构建一个 Amazon QuickSight 控制面板来显示 DynamoDB 中的信息。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司希望获得其微服务管道中以下两项交付指标的 CI/CD 运营可见性：

- **成功发布功能之间的时间**
- 部署失败后的**平均恢复时间 (MTTR)**

关键限定条件是**最少的配置工作量**。因此，该解决方案应将管道状态变更作为事件进行处理，而不是定期轮询管道；同时应使用原生监控服务，而不是引入单独的数据库和 BI 平台。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 在每次管道成功或失败运行后，由 EventBridge 调用 Lambda，发布自定义 CloudWatch 指标，并在 CloudWatch 控制面板中显示这些指标。**

当 CodePipeline 执行成功或失败时，会发出管道执行状态变更事件。这些事件包含管道名称、执行 ID、开始时间、事件时间和状态等字段。EventBridge 可以筛选 `SUCCEEDED` 和 `FAILED` 等特定状态，并将匹配的事件路由到 Lambda 等目标。这使得收集过程由事件驱动且接近实时，无需进行计划轮询。请参阅 [CodePipeline 管道执行状态变更事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html)。

Lambda 函数可以按管道处理这些时间戳和状态，计算或发布功能发布间隔及恢复持续时间所需的数值，并将管道名称用作指标维度。CloudWatch 支持通过 `PutMetricData` 发布应用程序定义的指标，包括指标维度以及 `Average` 等统计数据。请参阅 [发布自定义 CloudWatch 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/publishingMetrics.html)。

随后，可以直接选择这些指标以在 CloudWatch 控制面板中进行可视化。请参阅 [向 CloudWatch 控制面板添加指标图表](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/add_line_dashboard.html)。

此架构在管道事件发生时立即使用这些事件，并保持在 EventBridge–Lambda–CloudWatch 监控栈内，以最少的运营和配置开销提供所请求的可见性。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 使用 CloudWatch 指标计划调用 Lambda

每 5 分钟调用一次 Lambda 并不会直接使用管道状态变更事件。该函数需要轮询 CodePipeline API，识别自上次调用以来发生的执行，防止重复处理，并维护检查点或其他状态。它还会导致最长数分钟的报告延迟。由于 CodePipeline 已经会发出可由 EventBridge 匹配的 `SUCCEEDED` 和 `FAILED` 事件，计划轮询比选项 B 需要更多实现工作量。

### C. 使用 DynamoDB 和 QuickSight 的事件驱动 Lambda

事件驱动的调用是合适的，但当所需输出为运营指标时，添加 DynamoDB 和 QuickSight 会引入不必要的持久化和 BI 层。公司需要设计和运维 DynamoDB 表、准备与分析兼容的数据集、配置权限，以及构建 QuickSight 分析和控制面板。

此外，DynamoDB 未被列为 QuickSight 的直接关系型数据源；访问未列出的数据源需要通过受支持的数据源进行链接或导入，这会增加更多集成工作。请参阅 [QuickSight 支持的数据源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/supported-data-sources.html)。对于管道时间和恢复指标，CloudWatch 自定义指标和控制面板是更直接的选择。

### D. 使用 DynamoDB 和 QuickSight 的计划 Lambda

此选项结合了两项缺点：

- 使用计划轮询，而非直接响应 CodePipeline 事件
- 需要额外配置 DynamoDB 和 QuickSight，而非直接将运营指标发布到 CloudWatch

因此，它在四个选项中具有最高的配置和运营开销。

## 结论

**B** 是最佳答案，因为它通过 EventBridge 立即捕获每个管道的成功或失败，使用 Lambda 发布特定于管道的自定义指标，并直接在 CloudWatch 中显示这些指标，无需计划轮询或额外的数据库和 BI 栈。

en.question: A company has developed a static website hosted on an Amazon S3 bucket. The website is deployed using AWS CloudFormation. The CloudFormation template defines an S3 bucket and a custom resource that copies content into the bucket from a source location. The company has decided that it needs to move the website to a new location, so the existing CloudFormation stack must be deleted and re-created. However, CloudFormation reports that the stack could not be deleted cleanly. What is the MOST likely cause and how can the DevOps engineer mitigate this problem for this and future versions of the website?

options.A: Deletion has failed because the S3 bucket has an active website configuration. Modify the CloudFormation template to remove the WebsiteConfiguration property from the S3 bucket resource.
options.B: Deletion has failed because the S3 bucket is not empty. Modify the custom resource's AWS Lambda function code to recursively empty the bucket when RequestType is Delete.
options.C: Deletion has failed because the custom resource does not define a deletion policy. Add a DeletionPolicy property to the custom resource definition with a value of RemoveOnDeletion.
options.D: Deletion has failed because the S3 bucket is not empty. Modify the S3 bucket resource in the CloudFormation template to add a DeletionPolicy property with a value of Empty.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The stack creates an S3 bucket and then uses a Lambda-backed custom resource to upload the static website files. During stack deletion, CloudFormation attempts to delete the bucket, but an S3 bucket must be empty before it can be deleted. The required mitigation is therefore to make the component that populated the bucket also clean it up during deletion.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Deletion has failed because the S3 bucket is not empty. Modify the custom resource's AWS Lambda function code to recursively empty the bucket when `RequestType` is `Delete`.**

CloudFormation's `AWS::S3::Bucket` documentation explicitly states: **“You can only delete empty buckets. Deletion fails for buckets that have contents.”** The website files copied by the custom resource remain in the bucket, so CloudFormation cannot delete the bucket and the stack enters a deletion-failed state. See [AWS::S3::Bucket](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-s3-bucket.html).

When a stack is deleted, CloudFormation sends the custom resource provider a request with `RequestType` set to `Delete`. The Lambda function should handle this event by deleting all objects from the destination bucket before returning success. If bucket versioning is enabled, cleanup must also remove all object versions and delete markers—not merely the currently visible objects. See [CloudFormation custom resource request object](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/crpg-ref.html).

The template should also preserve the dependency between the custom resource and the bucket so that, during deletion, the custom resource's cleanup runs before CloudFormation attempts to delete the bucket.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** An active `WebsiteConfiguration` does not prevent S3 bucket deletion. The blocking condition is that the bucket contains the website objects. Removing the website configuration would not empty the bucket.

- **C — Incorrect.** `RemoveOnDeletion` is not a valid CloudFormation `DeletionPolicy` value. Valid options include `Delete`, `Retain`, `RetainExceptOnCreate`, and `Snapshot`. More importantly, a deletion policy on the custom resource would not automatically remove the S3 objects; cleanup logic must be implemented by the custom resource provider. See [DeletionPolicy attribute](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html).

- **D — Incorrect.** `Empty` is not a valid `DeletionPolicy` value. Even with `DeletionPolicy: Delete`—which is already the normal default for an S3 bucket—CloudFormation requires all objects to be removed before bucket deletion can succeed. A deletion policy does not provide an automatic “empty bucket” operation.

Therefore, **B** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司开发了一个托管在 Amazon S3 存储桶上的静态网站。该网站使用 AWS CloudFormation 部署。CloudFormation 模板定义了一个 S3 存储桶和一个自定义资源，该自定义资源将内容从源位置复制到该存储桶中。公司决定需要将该网站迁移到新位置，因此必须删除并重新创建现有的 CloudFormation 堆栈。但是，CloudFormation 报告该堆栈无法被完全删除。最可能的原因是什么？DevOps 工程师应如何针对当前及未来版本的网站缓解此问题？

options.A: 删除失败是因为 S3 存储桶具有活动的网站配置。修改 CloudFormation 模板，以从 S3 存储桶资源中移除 WebsiteConfiguration 属性。
options.B: 删除失败是因为 S3 存储桶不为空。修改自定义资源的 AWS Lambda 函数代码，以便在 RequestType 为 Delete 时递归清空该存储桶。
options.C: 删除失败是因为自定义资源未定义删除策略。向自定义资源定义中添加 DeletionPolicy 属性，并将其值设为 RemoveOnDeletion。
options.D: 删除失败是因为 S3 存储桶不为空。修改 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3 存储桶资源，以添加值为 Empty 的 DeletionPolicy 属性。

zh.explanation:
## 本题考查的内容

该堆栈创建一个 S3 存储桶，然后使用由 Lambda 支持的自定义资源上传静态网站文件。在删除堆栈期间，CloudFormation 会尝试删除该存储桶，但 S3 存储桶在删除前必须为空。因此，所需的缓解措施是让负责填充存储桶的组件也在删除期间清理该存储桶。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 删除失败是因为 S3 存储桶不为空。修改自定义资源的 AWS Lambda 函数代码，以便在 `RequestType` 为 `Delete` 时递归清空该存储桶。**

CloudFormation 的 `AWS::S3::Bucket` 文档明确指出：**“只能删除空的存储桶。对于包含内容的存储桶，删除会失败。”** 自定义资源复制的网站文件仍保留在存储桶中，因此 CloudFormation 无法删除该存储桶，堆栈会进入删除失败状态。请参阅 [AWS::S3::Bucket](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-resource-s3-bucket.html)。
