删除堆栈时，CloudFormation 会向自定义资源提供程序发送一个请求，其中 `RequestType` 设置为 `Delete`。Lambda 函数应通过删除目标存储桶中的所有对象来处理此事件，然后再返回成功。如果启用了存储桶版本控制，清理操作还必须删除所有对象版本和删除标记，而不仅仅是当前可见的对象。请参阅 [CloudFormation custom resource request object](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/crpg-ref.html)。

模板还应保留自定义资源与存储桶之间的依赖关系，以便在删除期间，自定义资源的清理操作会在 CloudFormation 尝试删除存储桶之前运行。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A — 错误。** 活动的 `WebsiteConfiguration` 不会阻止删除 S3 存储桶。阻塞条件是存储桶中包含网站对象。移除网站配置不会清空存储桶。

- **C — 错误。** `RemoveOnDeletion` 不是有效的 CloudFormation `DeletionPolicy` 值。有效选项包括 `Delete`、`Retain`、`RetainExceptOnCreate` 和 `Snapshot`。更重要的是，自定义资源上的删除策略不会自动删除 S3 对象；必须由自定义资源提供程序实现清理逻辑。请参阅 [DeletionPolicy attribute](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/aws-attribute-deletionpolicy.html)。

- **D — 错误。** `Empty` 不是有效的 `DeletionPolicy` 值。即使使用 `DeletionPolicy: Delete`（这已是 S3 存储桶的默认正常行为），CloudFormation 也要求在成功删除存储桶之前移除所有对象。删除策略不会提供自动“清空存储桶”的操作。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company uses Amazon EC2 as its primary compute platform. A DevOps team wants to audit the company's EC2 instances to check whether any prohibited applications have been installed on the EC2 instances. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Configure AWS Systems Manager on each instance. Use AWS Systems Manager Inventory. Use Systems Manager resource data sync to synchronize and store findings in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs when new objects are added to the S3 bucket. Configure the Lambda function to identify prohibited applications.
options.B: Configure AWS Systems Manager on each instance. Use Systems Manager Inventory Create AWS Config rules that monitor changes from Systems Manager Inventory to identify prohibited applications.
options.C: Configure AWS Systems Manager on each instance. Use Systems Manager Inventory. Filter a trail in AWS CloudTrail for Systems Manager Inventory events to identify prohibited applications.
options.D: Designate Amazon CloudWatch Logs as the log destination for all application instances. Run an automated script across all instances to create an inventory of installed applications. Configure the script to forward the results to CloudWatch Logs. Create a CloudWatch alarm that uses filter patterns to search log data to identify prohibited applications.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs a low-operations way to discover installed software on EC2 instances and continuously evaluate that software against a prohibited-application policy. The native integration between **AWS Systems Manager Inventory** and **AWS Config** is designed for this scenario.

## Correct answer: B

Systems Manager Inventory collects application metadata from managed instances, including application name, publisher, version, installation time, architecture, and package ID. AWS Config can record the `AWS::SSM::ManagedInstanceInventory` resource type and evaluate changes to that inventory.

AWS provides the managed Config rule **`EC2_MANAGEDINSTANCE_APPLICATIONS_BLACKLISTED`**, which checks that specified applications are not installed on managed EC2 instances. Its trigger type is **configuration changes**, and its resource type is **`AWS::SSM::ManagedInstanceInventory`**. This directly satisfies the requirement without custom processing code, making it the most operationally efficient solution. See [ec2-managedinstance-applications-blacklisted](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-managedinstance-applications-blacklisted.html) and [Recording Software Configuration for Managed Instances with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/recording-managed-instance-inventory.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Systems Manager Inventory, resource data sync, S3, and Lambda

A resource data sync can export Inventory data to a central S3 bucket, so a Lambda function could process that data and search for prohibited applications. However, this requires an S3 bucket, permissions and event notifications, custom Lambda code, error handling, and ongoing maintenance. Resource data sync is primarily useful for aggregating Inventory data for centralized querying and analysis. The native AWS Config managed rule performs the required compliance evaluation with substantially less custom infrastructure and operational overhead. See [Systems Manager Inventory resource data sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-resource-data-sync.html).

### C. Filter CloudTrail for Systems Manager Inventory events

CloudTrail records Systems Manager **control-plane API operations**, such as `PutInventory`; it is not the native compliance-evaluation mechanism for determining whether prohibited applications are present on instances. Filtering API activity would show that Inventory-related operations occurred, but it would not provide the direct, continuously evaluated application compliance state that the Config managed rule provides. See [Systems Manager management events in CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/monitoring-cloudtrail-logs.html).

### D. Custom scripts, CloudWatch Logs, and alarms

This solution recreates inventory collection and policy evaluation with custom scripts and log processing. The team would need to deploy, schedule, update, and troubleshoot the script across every instance and maintain log filters and alarms. Systems Manager Inventory already has a dedicated `AWS:Application` inventory type for installed-application metadata, so this custom approach is less operationally efficient. See [Metadata collected by Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-schema.html).

Therefore, **B** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon EC2 作为其主要计算平台。一个 DevOps 团队希望审计公司的 EC2 实例，以检查 EC2 实例上是否安装了任何被禁止的应用程序。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在每个实例上配置 AWS Systems Manager。使用 AWS Systems Manager Inventory。使用 Systems Manager resource data sync 同步调查结果并将其存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，使其在新对象添加到 S3 存储桶时运行。配置该 Lambda 函数以识别被禁止的应用程序。
options.B: 在每个实例上配置 AWS Systems Manager。使用 Systems Manager Inventory。创建 AWS Config 规则，以监控来自 Systems Manager Inventory 的更改并识别被禁止的应用程序。
options.C: 在每个实例上配置 AWS Systems Manager。使用 Systems Manager Inventory。在 AWS CloudTrail 中筛选 Systems Manager Inventory 事件，以识别被禁止的应用程序。
options.D: 将 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 指定为所有应用程序实例的日志目标。在所有实例上运行自动化脚本，以创建已安装应用程序的清单。配置该脚本将结果转发到 CloudWatch Logs。创建一个使用筛选模式搜索日志数据以识别被禁止应用程序的 CloudWatch 警报。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该公司需要一种低运营开销的方法来发现 EC2 实例上安装的软件，并持续根据被禁止应用程序策略评估这些软件。**AWS Systems Manager Inventory** 与 **AWS Config** 之间的原生集成正是为此场景而设计的。

## 正确答案：B

Systems Manager Inventory 从受管实例收集应用程序元数据，包括应用程序名称、发布者、版本、安装时间、架构和软件包 ID。AWS Config 可以记录 `AWS::SSM::ManagedInstanceInventory` 资源类型，并评估该清单的变更。

AWS 提供托管 Config 规则 **`EC2_MANAGEDINSTANCE_APPLICATIONS_BLACKLISTED`**，用于检查指定的应用程序是否未安装在受管 EC2 实例上。其触发器类型为**配置变更**，资源类型为 **`AWS::SSM::ManagedInstanceInventory`**。这可以直接满足需求，无需自定义处理代码，因此是运营效率最高的解决方案。请参阅 [ec2-managedinstance-applications-blacklisted](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-managedinstance-applications-blacklisted.html) 和 [Recording Software Configuration for Managed Instances with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/recording-managed-instance-inventory.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. Systems Manager Inventory、resource data sync、S3 和 Lambda

resource data sync 可以将 Inventory 数据导出到集中式 S3 存储桶，因此 Lambda 函数可以处理这些数据并搜索被禁止的应用程序。但是，这需要 S3 存储桶、权限和事件通知、自定义 Lambda 代码、错误处理以及持续维护。resource data sync 的主要用途是聚合 Inventory 数据，以便进行集中查询和分析。原生 AWS Config 托管规则能够以明显更少的自定义基础设施和运营开销执行所需的合规性评估。请参阅 [Systems Manager Inventory resource data sync](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-resource-data-sync.html)。

### C. 筛选 CloudTrail 中的 Systems Manager Inventory 事件

CloudTrail 记录 Systems Manager **控制平面 API 操作**，例如 `PutInventory`；它并不是确定实例上是否存在被禁止应用程序的原生合规性评估机制。筛选 API 活动可以显示发生过与 Inventory 相关的操作，但无法提供 Config 托管规则所提供的直接且持续评估的应用程序合规状态。请参阅 [Systems Manager management events in CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/monitoring-cloudtrail-logs.html)。

### D. 自定义脚本、CloudWatch Logs 和警报

此解决方案通过自定义脚本和日志处理重新实现清单收集和策略评估。团队需要在每个实例上部署、安排、更新和排查该脚本，并维护日志筛选器和警报。Systems Manager Inventory 已具有专用于已安装应用程序元数据的 `AWS:Application` 清单类型，因此这种自定义方法的运营效率较低。请参阅 [Metadata collected by Inventory](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/inventory-schema.html)。

因此，**B** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company has an event-driven JavaScript application. The application uses decoupled AWS managed services that publish, consume, and route events. During application testing, events are not delivered to the target that is specified by an Amazon EventBridge rule. A DevOps team must provide application testers with additional functionality to view, troubleshoot, and prevent the loss of events without redeployment of the application. Which combination of steps should the DevOps team take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Launch AWS Device Farm with a standard test environment and project to run a specific build of the application.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Enable AWS CloudTrail. Create a CloudTrail trail that specifies the S3 bucket as the storage location.
options.C: Configure the EventBridge rule to use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue as a dead-letter queue.
options.D: Configure the EventBridge rule to use an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue as a dead-letter queue.
options.E: Create a log group in Amazon CloudWatch Logs Specify the log group as an additional target of the EventBridge rule.
options.F: Update the application code base to use the AWS X-Ray SDK tracing feature to instrument the code with support for the X-Amzn-Trace-Id header.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The application uses EventBridge and other decoupled managed services, but an EventBridge rule is not delivering events to its configured target. The testers need capabilities to:

1. **View events and configuration activity** for troubleshooting.
2. **Capture failed deliveries** so events are not lost.
3. Add these capabilities **without changing and redeploying the JavaScript application**.

## Correct answers: B, C, and E

### B. Create an S3 bucket and an AWS CloudTrail trail that stores logs in the bucket

CloudTrail records EventBridge API activity, including calls made through the console and EventBridge API. A trail provides an ongoing record and delivers the log files to Amazon S3. This helps testers investigate rule creation or modification, target configuration, permissions-related changes, and other control-plane activity that could explain the delivery issue.

AWS notes that CloudTrail captures EventBridge API calls and that a trail delivers ongoing log files to an S3 bucket. `PutEvents` is a data event rather than a default management event, so CloudTrail is primarily complementary configuration/API auditing here; the actual matched event payload is made visible by option E. See [Logging Amazon EventBridge API calls using AWS CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/logging-using-cloudtrail.html).

### C. Configure an SQS standard queue as the EventBridge rule target's dead-letter queue

This directly addresses event loss. If EventBridge cannot deliver an event to the target, it can send the event to the DLQ for later inspection and reprocessing. DLQ messages also contain troubleshooting attributes such as the error code, error message, rule ARN, target ARN, retry attempts, and exhausted retry condition.

EventBridge rule DLQs support **SQS standard queues only**. See [Using dead-letter queues to process undelivered events in EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rule-dlq.html).

### E. Add a CloudWatch Logs log group as another target of the EventBridge rule

CloudWatch Logs is a supported EventBridge target. Without an input transformer, EventBridge writes the event payload as the log message. Adding the log group as an additional target lets testers view events that match the rule independently of whether delivery to the application's original target succeeds. This requires only EventBridge configuration, not application redeployment.

See [EventBridge targets — CloudWatch Logs groups as targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Launch AWS Device Farm

Device Farm is for testing mobile and web applications on browsers or physical devices. It does not provide EventBridge event inspection, target-delivery diagnostics, or durable capture of failed EventBridge events. It is unrelated to the event-routing failure described.

### D. Use an SQS FIFO queue as the dead-letter queue

EventBridge does **not** support FIFO queues as rule DLQs. Only SQS standard queues are supported, making C correct and D invalid. See [EventBridge DLQ considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rule-dlq.html).

### F. Instrument the application with the AWS X-Ray SDK

X-Ray can provide distributed tracing, but this option explicitly requires updating the JavaScript code base to instrument AWS SDK clients. AWS documentation shows code changes such as wrapping clients with `captureAWS`, `captureAWSClient`, or `captureAWSv3Client`. Those changes would require building and redeploying the application, directly violating the requirement to add troubleshooting functionality **without redeployment**. See [Tracing AWS SDK calls with the X-Ray SDK for Node.js](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-nodejs-awssdkclients.html).

Therefore, the best combination is **B, C, and E**.

zh.question: 某公司有一个事件驱动的 JavaScript 应用程序。该应用程序使用解耦的 AWS 托管服务来发布、使用和路由事件。在应用程序测试期间，事件未传递到 Amazon EventBridge 规则指定的目标。DevOps 团队必须为应用程序测试人员提供额外功能，以便查看、排查并防止事件丢失，而无需重新部署应用程序。DevOps 团队应采取哪种步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择三项）

options.A: 启动 AWS Device Farm，并使用标准测试环境和项目来运行应用程序的特定构建版本。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。启用 AWS CloudTrail。创建一个 CloudTrail 跟踪，将该 S3 存储桶指定为存储位置。
options.C: 将 EventBridge 规则配置为使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 标准队列作为死信队列。
options.D: 将 EventBridge 规则配置为使用 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO 队列作为死信队列。
options.E: 在 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 中创建一个日志组。将该日志组指定为 EventBridge 规则的额外目标。
options.F: 更新应用程序代码库，以使用 AWS X-Ray SDK 跟踪功能，为代码添加对 `X-Amzn-Trace-Id` 标头的支持。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该应用程序使用 EventBridge 和其他解耦的托管服务，但 EventBridge 规则未将事件传递到其配置的目标。测试人员需要具备以下能力：

1. **查看事件和配置活动**，以便排查问题。
2. **捕获传递失败的事件**，从而避免事件丢失。
3. 在**不更改和重新部署 JavaScript 应用程序**的情况下添加这些功能。

## 正确答案：B、C 和 E

### B. 创建一个 S3 存储桶和一个将日志存储在该存储桶中的 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪

CloudTrail 会记录 EventBridge API 活动，包括通过控制台和 EventBridge API 发出的调用。跟踪会提供持续记录，并将日志文件传送到 Amazon S3。这有助于测试人员调查规则创建或修改、目标配置、与权限相关的更改，以及其他可能解释传递问题的控制平面活动。

AWS 指出，CloudTrail 可捕获 EventBridge API 调用，且跟踪会将持续生成的日志文件传送到 S3 存储桶。`PutEvents` 属于数据事件，而不是默认管理事件，因此 CloudTrail 在此主要用于补充配置/API 审计；实际匹配的事件有效负载可通过选项 E 查看。请参阅 [使用 AWS CloudTrail 记录 Amazon EventBridge API 调用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/logging-using-cloudtrail.html)。

### C. 将 SQS 标准队列配置为 EventBridge 规则目标的死信队列

这直接解决事件丢失问题。如果 EventBridge 无法将事件传递到目标，它可以将事件发送到 DLQ，以供后续检查和重新处理。DLQ 消息还包含故障排查属性，例如错误代码、错误消息、规则 ARN、目标 ARN、重试次数以及重试耗尽条件。

EventBridge 规则 DLQ **仅支持 SQS 标准队列**。请参阅 [在 EventBridge 中使用死信队列处理未传递的事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rule-dlq.html)。

### E. 将 CloudWatch Logs 日志组作为 EventBridge 规则的另一目标

CloudWatch Logs 是受支持的 EventBridge 目标。如果未使用输入转换器，EventBridge 会将事件有效负载写入日志消息。将日志组添加为额外目标后，测试人员可以查看与规则匹配的事件，而不受事件能否成功传递到应用程序原始目标的影响。这只需要进行 EventBridge 配置，无需重新部署应用程序。

请参阅 [EventBridge 目标 — 将 CloudWatch Logs 组作为目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 启动 AWS Device Farm

Device Farm 用于在浏览器或物理设备上测试移动和 Web 应用程序。它不提供 EventBridge 事件检查、目标传递诊断或对传递失败的 EventBridge 事件进行持久捕获的功能。它与题目描述的事件路由失败无关。

### D. 使用 SQS FIFO 队列作为死信队列

EventBridge **不**支持将 FIFO 队列用作规则 DLQ。仅支持 SQS 标准队列，因此 C 正确而 D 无效。请参阅 [EventBridge DLQ 注意事项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-rule-dlq.html)。

### F. 使用 AWS X-Ray SDK 对应用程序进行插桩

X-Ray 可以提供分布式跟踪，但此选项明确要求更新 JavaScript 代码库，以便对 AWS SDK 客户端进行插桩。AWS 文档展示了诸如使用 `captureAWS`、`captureAWSClient` 或 `captureAWSv3Client` 包装客户端之类的代码更改。这些更改需要构建并重新部署应用程序，直接违反了在**无需重新部署**的情况下添加故障排查功能这一要求。请参阅 [使用适用于 Node.js 的 X-Ray SDK 跟踪 AWS SDK 调用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/xray/latest/devguide/xray-sdk-nodejs-awssdkclients.html)。

因此，最佳组合是 **B、C 和 E**。

en.question: A company is migrating its container-based workloads to an AWS Organizations multi-account environment. The environment consists of application workload accounts that the company uses to deploy and run the containerized workloads. The company has also provisioned a shared services account for shared workloads in the organization. The company must follow strict compliance regulations. All container images must receive security scanning before they are deployed to any environment. Images can be consumed by downstream deployment mechanisms after the images pass a scan with no critical vulnerabilities. Pre-scan and post-scan images must be isolated from one another so that a deployment can never use pre-scan images. A DevOps engineer needs to create a strategy to centralize this process. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repositories in the shared services account: one repository for each pre-scan image and one repository for each post-scan image. Configure Amazon ECR image scanning to run on new image pushes to the pre-scan repositories. Use resource-based policies to grant the organization write access to the pre-scan repositories and read access to the post-scan repositories.
options.B: Create pre-scan Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repositories in each account that publishes container images. Create repositories for post-scan images in the shared services account. Configure Amazon ECR image scanning to run on new image pushes to the pre-scan repositories. Use resource-based policies to grant the organization read access to the post-scan repositories.
options.C: Configure image replication for each image from the image's pre-scan repository to the image's post-scan repository.
options.D: Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline for each pre-scan repository. Create a source stage that runs when new images are pushed to the pre-scan repositories. Create a stage that uses AWS CodeBuild as the action provider. Write a buildspec.yaml definition that determines the image scanning status and pushes images without critical vulnerabilities to the post-scan repositories.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to image scanning completed events and invokes the Lambda function. Write function code that determines the image scanning status and pushes images without critical vulnerabilities to the post-scan repositories.

en.explanation:
## Correct answers: A and E

The company needs a centralized image-quarantine and promotion process. Images must first enter a repository that deployment systems cannot read, be scanned, and become deployable only after the scan confirms that there are no critical vulnerabilities. The solution must also minimize the number of account-specific repositories, pipelines, and policies to administer.

### A. Centralize pre-scan and post-scan ECR repositories

Creating both repository classes in the shared services account establishes one centrally governed registry location:

- Publishing accounts receive **write access to pre-scan repositories**.
- Scan-on-push is enabled for those pre-scan repositories.
- Deployment roles receive **read access only to post-scan repositories**.
- Deployment roles receive no pull access to pre-scan repositories, preventing an unapproved image from being deployed.

Amazon ECR repository policies are resource-based policies and support cross-account permissions, including separate permissions for pushing and pulling images. AWS provides examples of cross-account push and pull policies in the [Amazon ECR repository policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/repository-policy-examples.html).

This design also has less administrative overhead than distributing pre-scan repositories across every application account. Repository policies, scanning configuration, lifecycle settings, monitoring, and governance can all be managed centrally.

### E. Use EventBridge and Lambda to promote approved images

Amazon ECR can send an `ECR Image Scan` event to Amazon EventBridge when a basic image scan completes. The event identifies the repository and image digest and includes the scan status and finding severity counts. AWS notes that a severity such as `CRITICAL` appears in `finding-severity-counts` only when findings of that severity exist. A Lambda function can therefore verify that the scan completed successfully and that the image has no critical findings before promoting it. See [Amazon ECR events and EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/ecr-eventbridge.html).

A single EventBridge rule and reusable Lambda function can handle scan results from all centralized pre-scan repositories. This is more efficient than maintaining a separate CI/CD pipeline for every repository and ensures that processing starts at the relevant event—**scan completion**, not merely image push.

The function must perform a complete registry-to-registry image copy into the corresponding post-scan repository. [`BatchGetImage`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/APIReference/API_BatchGetImage.html) can retrieve the image manifest, but copying the manifest alone is insufficient if the destination repository does not already contain its referenced layers. [`PutImage`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/APIReference/API_PutImage.html) can return `LayersNotFoundException` when those layers are missing. The Lambda implementation must therefore copy or upload the layers as well—for example, by packaging a daemonless OCI registry-copy utility. AWS documents direct registry copying with tools such as `skopeo` in its [ECR image migration guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/migrate-from-third-party.html). A Docker daemon is not inherently required.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create pre-scan repositories in every publishing account

This could preserve separation, but it does not provide the **least administrative overhead**. Each publishing account would require repository provisioning, scan settings, IAM and repository policies, monitoring, lifecycle configuration, and governance. Centralizing both repository classes in the shared services account is simpler and provides a consistent organization-wide control point.

### C. Replicate images from pre-scan to post-scan repositories

ECR replication is initiated by image push or restore activity; it is not conditional on an image completing a vulnerability scan with no critical findings. It therefore cannot implement the required compliance gate and could replicate an image before approval.

Replication also preserves repository names, and ECR does not support changing a repository name during replication. That does not naturally implement promotion between separately named pre-scan and post-scan repositories. See [Amazon ECR private image replication considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/replication.html).

### D. Create one CodePipeline pipeline per pre-scan repository

A CodeBuild action could be customized to check scan results and copy approved images, but this option explicitly requires a separate pipeline for every pre-scan repository. Each pipeline adds stages, service roles, build specifications, build projects, artifacts, and ongoing maintenance.

In addition, the Amazon ECR source action starts a pipeline when an image is pushed and produces an `imageDetail.json` source artifact; it is not triggered specifically by scan completion. The CodeBuild logic would therefore need to wait for or poll the scan status to avoid evaluating the image too early. See the [Amazon ECR source action reference for CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECR.html).

One scan-completion EventBridge rule and one Lambda function provide the same approval gate with fewer resources and less synchronization logic.

## Final answer

**A and E**

zh.question: 一家企业正在将其基于容器的工作负载迁移到 AWS Organizations 多账户环境。该环境包含应用程序工作负载账户，企业使用这些账户部署和运行容器化工作负载。企业还为组织中的共享工作负载预置了一个共享服务账户。企业必须遵守严格的合规性法规。所有容器镜像在部署到任何环境之前都必须接受安全扫描。镜像在通过扫描且不存在严重漏洞后，可以由下游部署机制使用。扫描前和扫描后的镜像必须彼此隔离，以确保部署永远不会使用扫描前的镜像。DevOps 工程师需要创建一种策略来集中管理此流程。以下哪种步骤组合能够以最少的管理开销满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 在共享服务账户中创建 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库：为每个扫描前镜像创建一个存储库，并为每个扫描后镜像创建一个存储库。将 Amazon ECR 镜像扫描配置为在有新镜像推送到扫描前存储库时运行。使用基于资源的策略，向组织授予对扫描前存储库的写入权限以及对扫描后存储库的读取权限。
options.B: 在每个发布容器镜像的账户中创建扫描前 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库。在共享服务账户中为扫描后镜像创建存储库。将 Amazon ECR 镜像扫描配置为在有新镜像推送到扫描前存储库时运行。使用基于资源的策略，向组织授予对扫描后存储库的读取权限。
options.C: 为每个镜像配置镜像复制，从该镜像的扫描前存储库复制到该镜像的扫描后存储库。
options.D: 为每个扫描前存储库在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个管道。创建一个源阶段，使其在新镜像被推送到扫描前存储库时运行。创建一个使用 AWS CodeBuild 作为操作提供程序的阶段。编写一个 buildspec.yaml 定义，用于确定镜像扫描状态，并将没有严重漏洞的镜像推送到扫描后存储库。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则来响应镜像扫描完成事件并调用该 Lambda 函数。编写函数代码，以确定镜像扫描状态，并将没有严重漏洞的镜像推送到扫描后存储库。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A 和 E

企业需要一个集中的镜像隔离和提升流程。镜像必须首先进入部署系统无法读取的存储库，接受扫描，并且只有在扫描确认不存在严重漏洞后才能变得可部署。该解决方案还必须尽量减少需要管理的特定账户存储库、管道和策略数量。

### A. 集中管理扫描前和扫描后 ECR 存储库

在共享服务账户中创建两类存储库，可以建立一个集中治理的注册表位置：

- 发布账户获得对**扫描前存储库的写入权限**。
- 对这些扫描前存储库启用推送时扫描。
- 部署角色仅获得对**扫描后存储库的读取权限**。
- 部署角色没有对扫描前存储库的拉取权限，从而防止未经批准的镜像被部署。

Amazon ECR 存储库策略是基于资源的策略，并支持跨账户权限，包括用于推送和拉取镜像的独立权限。AWS 在 [Amazon ECR repository policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/repository-policy-examples.html) 中提供了跨账户推送和拉取策略示例。

与将扫描前存储库分布在每个应用程序账户中相比，此设计的管理开销也更低。存储库策略、扫描配置、生命周期设置、监控和治理都可以集中管理。

### E. 使用 EventBridge 和 Lambda 提升已批准的镜像

当基本镜像扫描完成时，Amazon ECR 可以向 Amazon EventBridge 发送 `ECR Image Scan` 事件。该事件会标识存储库和镜像摘要，并包含扫描状态和发现项严重性计数。AWS 指出，只有在存在该严重性级别的发现项时，`finding-severity-counts` 中才会出现诸如 `CRITICAL` 的严重性级别。因此，Lambda 函数可以在提升镜像之前验证扫描是否成功完成，以及该镜像是否没有严重发现项。请参阅 [Amazon ECR events and EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/ecr-eventbridge.html)。

一条 EventBridge 规则和一个可重用的 Lambda 函数可以处理所有集中式扫描前存储库的扫描结果。这比为每个存储库维护单独的 CI/CD 管道更高效，并确保处理在相关事件发生时启动——即**扫描完成**，而不只是镜像推送。

该函数必须将完整镜像从一个注册表复制到另一个注册表，并复制到相应的扫描后存储库中。[`BatchGetImage`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/APIReference/API_BatchGetImage.html) 可以检索镜像清单，但如果目标存储库尚未包含其引用的层，仅复制清单是不够的。当这些层缺失时，[`PutImage`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/APIReference/API_PutImage.html) 可能返回 `LayersNotFoundException`。因此，Lambda 实现还必须复制或上传这些层，例如通过打包一个无守护进程的 OCI 注册表复制工具。AWS 在其 [ECR image migration guidance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/migrate-from-third-party.html) 中记录了如何使用 `skopeo` 等工具进行直接注册表复制。不一定需要 Docker 守护进程。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 在每个发布账户中创建扫描前存储库

这可以保持隔离，但无法实现**最少的管理开销**。每个发布账户都需要进行存储库预置、扫描设置、IAM 和存储库策略配置、监控、生命周期配置以及治理。将两类存储库都集中在共享服务账户中更简单，并提供一致的组织级控制点。

### C. 将镜像从扫描前存储库复制到扫描后存储库

ECR 复制由镜像推送或恢复活动启动；它不以镜像完成漏洞扫描且没有严重漏洞为条件。因此，它无法实施所需的合规性门控，并且可能在镜像获批之前复制该镜像。

复制还会保留存储库名称，并且 ECR 不支持在复制期间更改存储库名称。这无法自然地实现扫描前和扫描后这两个名称不同的存储库之间的提升。请参阅 [Amazon ECR private image replication considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/replication.html)。

### D. 为每个扫描前存储库创建一个 CodePipeline 管道

可以自定义 CodeBuild 操作来检查扫描结果并复制已批准的镜像，但该选项明确要求为每个扫描前存储库创建单独的管道。每个管道都会增加阶段、服务角色、构建规范、构建项目、构件以及持续维护工作。

此外，Amazon ECR 源操作会在镜像被推送时启动管道，并生成一个 `imageDetail.json` 源构件；它并非专门由扫描完成触发。因此，CodeBuild 逻辑需要等待或轮询扫描状态，以避免过早评估镜像。请参阅 [Amazon ECR source action reference for CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECR.html)。

一条扫描完成 EventBridge 规则和一个 Lambda 函数可通过更少的资源和更少的同步逻辑提供相同的审批门控。

## 最终答案

**A 和 E**

en.question: A company uses an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to deploy its web applications on containers. The web applications contain confidential data that cannot be decrypted without specific credentials. A DevOps engineer has stored the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. The secrets are encrypted by an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. A Kubernetes service account for a third-party tool makes the secrets available to the applications. The service account assumes an IAM role that the company created to access the secrets. The service account receives an Access Denied (403 Forbidden) error while trying to retrieve the secrets from Secrets Manager. What is the root cause of this issue?

options.A: The IAM role that is attached to the EKS cluster does not have access to retrieve the secrets from Secrets Manager.
options.B: The key policy for the customer managed key does not allow the Kubernetes service account IAM role to use the key.
options.C: The key policy for the customer managed key does not allow the EKS cluster IAM role to use the key.
options.D: The IAM role that is assumed by the Kubernetes service account does not have permission to access the EKS cluster.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The Kubernetes workload retrieves a Secrets Manager secret by using the IAM role associated with its Kubernetes service account. Because the secret is encrypted with a **customer managed KMS key**, successful retrieval requires authorization for both:

1. `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` on the secret.
2. `kms:Decrypt` on the customer managed KMS key.

AWS documents that applications in EKS Pods use the IAM role associated with their Kubernetes service account to call AWS services. It also states that `GetSecretValue` requires KMS permissions when the secret is protected by a customer managed key, and provides an example granting both `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` and `kms:Decrypt` to the calling identity ([EKS IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html), [Secrets Manager IAM policy examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/auth-and-access_iam-policies.html), [Secrets Manager KMS permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)).

## Correct answer: B

**B. The key policy for the customer managed key does not allow the Kubernetes service account IAM role to use the key.**

The relevant caller is the IAM role assumed by the Kubernetes service account. Although that role can access the secret, Secrets Manager performs the KMS operation on behalf of the caller. If the customer managed KMS key does not authorize that role—directly in the key policy or through a key policy that enables appropriate IAM authorization—the decryption operation is denied, causing the secret retrieval request to fail with `AccessDenied`/HTTP 403.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. The EKS cluster IAM role cannot retrieve the secret:** The cluster IAM role is used by the EKS control plane for cluster operations. The application Pod calls Secrets Manager using credentials for the IAM role associated with its Kubernetes service account, not the cluster IAM role.
- **C. The KMS key policy does not allow the EKS cluster IAM role:** The cluster role is not the principal retrieving and decrypting the secret. KMS access must be available to the workload's service-account IAM role.
- **D. The service-account IAM role cannot access the EKS cluster:** Permission to access the EKS cluster does not authorize retrieval or decryption of a Secrets Manager secret. The relevant permissions are Secrets Manager access and KMS key usage, especially `kms:Decrypt`.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群在容器上部署其 Web 应用程序。这些 Web 应用程序包含机密数据，如果没有特定凭证便无法解密。DevOps 工程师已将凭证存储在 AWS Secrets Manager 中。这些密钥由 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户自主管理型密钥加密。某个用于第三方工具的 Kubernetes 服务账户使这些密钥可供应用程序使用。该服务账户会担任公司为访问密钥而创建的 IAM 角色。该服务账户尝试从 Secrets Manager 检索密钥时收到 Access Denied (403 Forbidden) 错误。此问题的根本原因是什么？

options.A: 附加到 EKS 集群的 IAM 角色没有从 Secrets Manager 检索密钥的访问权限。
options.B: 客户自主管理型密钥的密钥策略不允许 Kubernetes 服务账户 IAM 角色使用该密钥。
options.C: 客户自主管理型密钥的密钥策略不允许 EKS 集群 IAM 角色使用该密钥。
options.D: 由 Kubernetes 服务账户担任的 IAM 角色没有访问 EKS 集群的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

Kubernetes 工作负载通过与其 Kubernetes 服务账户关联的 IAM 角色检索 Secrets Manager 密钥。由于该密钥使用 **客户自主管理型 KMS 密钥** 加密，因此成功检索需要同时获得以下两项授权：

1. 对该密钥的 `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` 权限。
2. 对客户自主管理型 KMS 密钥的 `kms:Decrypt` 权限。

AWS 文档指出，EKS Pod 中的应用程序使用与其 Kubernetes 服务账户关联的 IAM 角色来调用 AWS 服务。文档还说明，当密钥由客户自主管理型密钥保护时，`GetSecretValue` 需要 KMS 权限，并提供了一个示例，向调用身份同时授予 `secretsmanager:GetSecretValue` 和 `kms:Decrypt` 权限（[EKS 服务账户的 IAM 角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)、[Secrets Manager IAM 策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/auth-and-access_iam-policies.html)、[Secrets Manager KMS 权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/secretsmanager/latest/userguide/security-encryption.html)）。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 客户自主管理型密钥的密钥策略不允许 Kubernetes 服务账户 IAM 角色使用该密钥。**

相关调用方是 Kubernetes 服务账户所担任的 IAM 角色。即使该角色可以访问密钥，Secrets Manager 也会代表调用方执行 KMS 操作。如果客户自主管理型 KMS 密钥未授权该角色——无论是直接在密钥策略中授权，还是通过允许适当 IAM 授权的密钥策略授权——解密操作都会被拒绝，导致密钥检索请求因 `AccessDenied`/HTTP 403 而失败。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A. EKS 集群 IAM 角色无法检索密钥：** 集群 IAM 角色由 EKS 控制平面用于执行集群操作。应用程序 Pod 使用与其 Kubernetes 服务账户关联的 IAM 角色凭证来调用 Secrets Manager，而不是使用集群 IAM 角色。
- **C. KMS 密钥策略不允许 EKS 集群 IAM 角色：** 集群角色不是检索和解密密钥的主体。KMS 访问权限必须授予工作负载的服务账户 IAM 角色。
- **D. 服务账户 IAM 角色无法访问 EKS 集群：** 访问 EKS 集群的权限并不能授权检索或解密 Secrets Manager 密钥。相关权限是 Secrets Manager 访问权限和 KMS 密钥使用权限，尤其是 `kms:Decrypt`。

en.question: A company is migrating its product development teams from an on-premises data center to a hybrid environment. The new environment will add four AWS Regions and will give the developers the ability to use the Region that is geographically closest to them. All the development teams use a shared set of Linux applications. The on-premises data center stores the applications on a NetApp ONTAP storage device. The storage volume is mounted read-only on the development on-premises VMs. The company updates the applications on the shared volume once a week. A DevOps engineer needs to replicate the data to all the new Regions. The DevOps engineer must ensure that the data is always up to date with deduplication. The data also must not be dependent on the availability of the on-premises storage device. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway in the on-premises data center. Create S3 buckets in each Region. Set up a cron job to copy the data from the storage device to the S3 File Gateway. Set up S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to the S3 buckets in each Region.
options.B: Create an Amazon FSx File Gateway in one Region. Create file servers in Amazon FSx for Windows File Server in each Region. Set up a cron job to copy the data from the storage device to the FSx File Gateway.
options.C: Create Multi-AZ Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP instances and volumes in each Region. Configure a scheduled SnapMirror relationship between the on-premises storage device and the FSx for ONTAP instances.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system in each Region. Deploy an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center. Configure a schedule for DataSync to copy the data to Amazon EFS daily.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a regional, read-only copy of an existing NetApp ONTAP volume in each of four AWS Regions. The solution must:

- Replicate directly from the on-premises ONTAP system.
- Keep each AWS copy synchronized with weekly source updates.
- Preserve deduplication/storage-efficiency benefits.
- Make the regional copies independently available rather than requiring developers to access the on-premises device.
- Provide a Linux-compatible shared file system.

## Correct answer: C

**Create Multi-AZ Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file systems and volumes in each Region, and configure scheduled SnapMirror relationships from the on-premises ONTAP system.**

This is the native ONTAP-to-ONTAP solution:

- AWS explicitly recommends SnapMirror for replicating an on-premises NetApp ONTAP file system to FSx for ONTAP. SnapMirror performs efficient **block-level replication** from a source ONTAP volume to a destination ONTAP volume.
- Most importantly for this question, AWS states that **deduplicated and compressed data remains in those states during SnapMirror migration**, reducing transfer time and bandwidth. AWS also documents that storage savings achieved on the source read-write volume are preserved in the destination data-protection volume.
- SnapMirror can perform scheduled replication for both in-Region and cross-Region deployments, including replication from on premises to AWS, and can run as frequently as every five minutes. A suitable schedule can therefore keep all four regional copies current after the weekly application update.
- SnapMirror destination volumes are read-only while the relationship remains active, matching the existing read-only application distribution model.
- Each FSx for ONTAP deployment is an AWS-hosted file system, so developers use the regional copy rather than reading the application volume through the on-premises storage system. Multi-AZ deployment additionally provides high availability within each selected Region.

See [Migrating to FSx for ONTAP using NetApp SnapMirror](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/migrating-fsx-ontap-snapmirror.html), [Replicating your data using NetApp SnapMirror](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/scheduled-replication.html), and [Managing storage efficiencies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/manage-vol-SE.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. S3 File Gateway and S3 Cross-Region Replication

An S3 File Gateway converts files into Amazon S3 objects with a one-to-one file-to-object mapping. S3 CRR would replicate those objects, but the option does not create a regional NFS file service or File Gateway in each destination Region for the Linux development VMs. It also does not preserve ONTAP block-level deduplication semantics. AWS notes that S3 replication can actually increase storage consumed because replicated object versions are stored separately. Therefore, this is an object-replication design, not the required regional ONTAP file-volume replication design. See [How Amazon S3 File Gateway works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/file-gateway-concepts.html).

### B. FSx File Gateway and FSx for Windows File Server

FSx File Gateway is designed to provide on-premises access to **FSx for Windows File Server** shares. It requires Windows file systems, SMB, and Microsoft Active Directory; it is not an ONTAP replication service for shared Linux applications. The proposed cron job also does not describe replication from the gateway to each regional Windows file system. Additionally, AWS states that FSx File Gateway is no longer available to new customers. See [What is Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html).

### D. Amazon EFS and AWS DataSync

DataSync can copy data from on-premises NFS storage to EFS and can support periodic transfers, but this option schedules synchronization only daily, so regional copies can remain stale between transfers. More importantly, it does not provide or preserve the ONTAP block-level deduplication and compression behavior explicitly required by the question. It also replaces the existing ONTAP storage model even though AWS provides native ONTAP-to-ONTAP replication through FSx for ONTAP and SnapMirror. See [Using AWS DataSync to transfer data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/trnsfr-data-using-datasync.html).

Therefore, **C** is the only option that directly satisfies the ONTAP compatibility, scheduled synchronization, deduplication, regional availability, and read-only-copy requirements.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其产品开发团队从本地数据中心迁移到混合环境。新环境将新增四个 AWS Region，并使开发人员能够使用地理位置上离他们最近的 Region。所有开发团队都使用一组共享的 Linux 应用程序。本地数据中心将这些应用程序存储在 NetApp ONTAP 存储设备上。该存储卷以只读方式挂载到开发团队的本地 VM。公司每周在共享卷上更新一次应用程序。DevOps 工程师需要将数据复制到所有新的 Region。DevOps 工程师必须确保数据始终保持最新，并且具有重复数据删除功能。数据还不得依赖于本地存储设备的可用性。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在本地数据中心创建 Amazon S3 File Gateway。在每个 Region 中创建 S3 存储桶。设置 cron 作业，将数据从存储设备复制到 S3 File Gateway。设置 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)，复制到每个 Region 中的 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 在一个 Region 中创建 Amazon FSx File Gateway。在每个 Region 中创建 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 文件服务器。设置 cron 作业，将数据从存储设备复制到 FSx File Gateway。
options.C: 在每个 Region 中创建 Multi-AZ Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 实例和卷。配置从本地存储设备到 FSx for ONTAP 实例的定期 SnapMirror 关系。
options.D: 在每个 Region 中创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。在本地数据中心部署 AWS DataSync 代理。配置 DataSync 的计划以每天将数据复制到 Amazon EFS。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要在四个 AWS Region 中分别拥有一个现有 NetApp ONTAP 卷的区域性只读副本。该解决方案必须：

- 直接从本地 ONTAP 系统进行复制。
- 使每个 AWS 副本与每周的源数据更新保持同步。
- 保留重复数据删除/存储效率优势。
- 使各区域副本能够独立提供访问，而不是要求开发人员访问本地设备。
- 提供兼容 Linux 的共享文件系统。

## 正确答案：C

**在每个 Region 中创建 Multi-AZ Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 文件系统和卷，并配置从本地 ONTAP 系统发起的定期 SnapMirror 关系。**

这是原生的 ONTAP 到 ONTAP 解决方案：

- AWS 明确建议使用 SnapMirror 将本地 NetApp ONTAP 文件系统复制到 FSx for ONTAP。SnapMirror 会将数据从源 ONTAP 卷高效地进行**块级复制**到目标 ONTAP 卷。
- 对于本题最重要的是，AWS 指出，在 SnapMirror 迁移期间，**已去重和压缩的数据会保持这些状态**，从而减少传输时间和带宽。AWS 还说明，在源读写卷上实现的存储节省会保留在目标数据保护卷中。
- SnapMirror 可以为同一 Region 和跨 Region 部署执行计划复制，包括从本地到 AWS 的复制，并且最快可每五分钟运行一次。因此，合适的计划可以在每周应用程序更新后，使所有四个区域副本保持最新。
- 在关系保持活动状态时，SnapMirror 目标卷为只读，这与现有的只读应用程序分发模型相匹配。
- 每个 FSx for ONTAP 部署都是 AWS 托管的文件系统，因此开发人员使用区域副本，而不是通过本地存储系统读取应用程序卷。Multi-AZ 部署还在每个选定 Region 内提供高可用性。

请参阅 [使用 NetApp SnapMirror 迁移到 FSx for ONTAP](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/migrating-fsx-ontap-snapmirror.html)、[使用 NetApp SnapMirror 复制数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/scheduled-replication.html) 和 [管理存储效率](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/manage-vol-SE.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. S3 File Gateway 和 S3 Cross-Region Replication

S3 File Gateway 将文件转换为 Amazon S3 对象，并采用一对一的文件到对象映射。S3 CRR 会复制这些对象，但该选项没有在每个目标 Region 中为 Linux 开发 VM 创建区域性 NFS 文件服务或 File Gateway。它也不会保留 ONTAP 的块级重复数据删除语义。AWS 指出，S3 复制实际上可能增加消耗的存储空间，因为复制的对象版本会单独存储。因此，这是对象复制设计，而不是所需的区域性 ONTAP 文件卷复制设计。请参阅 [Amazon S3 File Gateway 的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/files3/file-gateway-concepts.html)。

### B. FSx File Gateway 和 FSx for Windows File Server

FSx File Gateway 旨在提供对 **FSx for Windows File Server** 共享的本地访问。它需要 Windows 文件系统、SMB 和 Microsoft Active Directory；它并非用于共享 Linux 应用程序的 ONTAP 复制服务。所提议的 cron 作业也没有说明如何从该网关复制到每个区域的 Windows 文件系统。此外，AWS 表示 FSx File Gateway 不再向新客户提供。请参阅 [什么是 Amazon FSx File Gateway](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/filegateway/latest/filefsxw/what-is-file-fsxw.html)。

### D. Amazon EFS 和 AWS DataSync

DataSync 可以将数据从本地 NFS 存储复制到 EFS，并支持定期传输，但该选项仅将同步计划设为每天一次，因此区域副本可能在两次传输之间处于过期状态。更重要的是，它无法提供或保留题目明确要求的 ONTAP 块级重复数据删除和压缩行为。它还替换了现有 ONTAP 存储模型，尽管 AWS 通过 FSx for ONTAP 和 SnapMirror 提供原生的 ONTAP 到 ONTAP 复制。请参阅 [使用 AWS DataSync 传输数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/trnsfr-data-using-datasync.html)。

因此，**C** 是唯一直接满足 ONTAP 兼容性、计划同步、重复数据删除、区域可用性和只读副本要求的选项。

en.question: A company has an application that stores data that includes personally identifiable information (PII) in an Amazon S3 bucket. All data is encrypted with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed keys. All AWS resources are deployed from an AWS CloudFormation template. A DevOps engineer needs to set up a development environment for the application in a different AWS account. The data in the development environment's S3 bucket needs to be updated once a week from the production environment's S3 bucket. The company must not move PII from the production environment without anonymizing the PII first. The data in each environment must be encrypted with different KMS customer managed keys. Which combination of steps should the DevOps engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Activate Amazon Macie on the S3 bucket in the production account. Create an AWS Step Functions state machine to initiate a discovery job and redact all PII before copying files to the S3 bucket in the development account. Give the state machine tasks decrypt permissions on the KMS key in the production account. Give the state machine tasks encrypt permissions on the KMS key in the development account.
options.B: Set up S3 replication between the production S3 bucket and the development S3 bucket. Activate Amazon Macie on the development S3 bucket. Create an AWS Step Functions state machine to initiate a discovery job and redact all PII as the files are copied to the development S3 bucket. Give the state machine tasks encrypt and decrypt permissions on the KMS key in the development account.
options.C: Set up an S3 Batch Operations job to copy files from the production S3 bucket to the development S3 bucket. In the development account, configure an AWS Lambda function to redact ail PII. Configure S3 Object Lambda to use the Lambda function for S3 GET requests. Give the Lambda function's IAM role encrypt and decrypt permissions on the KMS key in the development account.
options.D: Create a development environment from the CloudFormation template in the development account. Schedule an Amazon EventBridge rule to start the AWS Step Functions state machine once a week.
options.E: Create a development environment from the CloudFormation template in the development account. Schedule a cron job on an Amazon EC2 instance to run once a week to start the S3 Batch Operations job.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement has two essential parts:

1. Provision an equivalent development environment in a different AWS account and refresh its data weekly.
2. Ensure that production PII is discovered and anonymized **before** any data is written to the development account, while decrypting with the production KMS key and encrypting with a different development KMS key.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. Use Macie and a Step Functions redaction/copy workflow

Amazon Macie can run targeted sensitive-data discovery jobs against S3 objects and detect multiple types of PII through managed or custom data identifiers. For encrypted objects, Macie must be able to access and use the encryption key. Macie produces findings and discovery results that identify the type and location of sensitive data; those results can then be processed by a remediation workflow. Macie does not itself rewrite or redact an object—the tasks orchestrated by the state machine must perform the actual redaction. See [Discovering sensitive data with Macie](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/data-classification.html) and [Types of results for sensitive data discovery jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-manage-results.html).

Step Functions can call AWS service APIs through AWS SDK integrations, and the Macie `macie2:CreateClassificationJob` permission allows creation of sensitive-data discovery jobs. Therefore, the state machine can initiate the discovery process and orchestrate the subsequent redaction and copy operations. See [AWS SDK service integrations in Step Functions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/supported-services-awssdk.html) and [Allow users to create sensitive data discovery jobs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html).

Because the source objects use SSE-KMS, the processing tasks need `kms:Decrypt` permission on the production customer managed key. To write anonymized objects under the separate development key, they need `kms:Encrypt` permission on the development customer managed key, together with the appropriate cross-account key policies and S3 permissions. AWS's SSE-KMS replication example similarly demonstrates separate source and destination keys with decrypt permission on the source key and encrypt permission on the destination key. See [Configuring replication for KMS-encrypted objects](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-config-for-kms-objects.html).

This design ensures that only the redacted output crosses into the development account.

### D. Deploy from CloudFormation and schedule the state machine weekly

Reusing the CloudFormation template creates a consistent development environment in the other account. AWS documents CloudFormation templates as a mechanism for standardized deployments across multiple accounts. See [CloudFormation StackSets best practices—Defining the template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-bestpractices.html).

Amazon EventBridge supports recurring cron- or rate-based schedules that invoke the Step Functions `StartExecution` API. Therefore, it can start the anonymization-and-copy state machine once each week without maintaining compute infrastructure. See [Using EventBridge Scheduler to start a Step Functions state machine](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/using-eventbridge-scheduler.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Replicate first, then redact in development — Incorrect

S3 replication would copy the original production objects, including their PII, to the development account before the Macie discovery and redaction workflow runs. That directly violates the requirement that PII must be anonymized **before it is moved** from production. It also grants KMS permissions only for the development key and does not address decrypting the source objects with the production key.

### C. Batch-copy raw objects and redact only on GET — Incorrect

The S3 Batch Operations job copies the unredacted objects into the development bucket first. S3 Object Lambda transforms data only as it is returned through `GET`, `LIST`, or `HEAD` requests; it does not replace the underlying stored development object with a redacted version. Thus, the development bucket would still contain the original PII. See [Transforming objects with S3 Object Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transforming-objects.html).

The option also gives the Lambda function permissions only for the development KMS key, not the production key needed to decrypt source data.

### E. Use an EC2 cron job to start S3 Batch Operations — Incorrect

Although deploying the development environment from CloudFormation is appropriate, this option schedules an S3 Batch Operations copy rather than the Step Functions discovery/redaction workflow from A. Consequently, it does not ensure that PII is anonymized before transfer. An EC2-hosted cron job also introduces unnecessary instance administration when EventBridge can invoke the state machine directly on a managed recurring schedule.

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序将包含个人身份信息（PII）的数据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。所有数据均使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 客户自主管理型密钥进行加密。所有 AWS 资源均通过 AWS CloudFormation 模板部署。DevOps 工程师需要在不同的 AWS 账户中为该应用程序设置开发环境。开发环境 S3 存储桶中的数据需要每周从生产环境 S3 存储桶更新一次。公司不得在未先对 PII 进行匿名化处理的情况下，将 PII 从生产环境迁移出去。每个环境中的数据必须使用不同的 KMS 客户自主管理型密钥进行加密。DevOps 工程师应采取哪种步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 在生产账户的 S3 存储桶上启用 Amazon Macie。创建 AWS Step Functions 状态机以启动发现作业，并在将文件复制到开发账户的 S3 存储桶之前对所有 PII 进行脱敏。向状态机任务授予对生产账户中 KMS 密钥的解密权限。向状态机任务授予对开发账户中 KMS 密钥的加密权限。
options.B: 在生产 S3 存储桶与开发 S3 存储桶之间设置 S3 复制。在开发 S3 存储桶上启用 Amazon Macie。创建 AWS Step Functions 状态机以启动发现作业，并在将文件复制到开发 S3 存储桶时对所有 PII 进行脱敏。向状态机任务授予对开发账户中 KMS 密钥的加密和解密权限。
options.C: 设置一个 S3 Batch Operations 作业，将文件从生产 S3 存储桶复制到开发 S3 存储桶。在开发账户中，配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数以对所有 PII 进行脱敏。配置 S3 Object Lambda，以便在 S3 GET 请求中使用该 Lambda 函数。向 Lambda 函数的 IAM 角色授予对开发账户中 KMS 密钥的加密和解密权限。
options.D: 在开发账户中使用 CloudFormation 模板创建开发环境。计划一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每周启动一次 AWS Step Functions 状态机。
options.E: 在开发账户中使用 CloudFormation 模板创建开发环境。在 Amazon EC2 实例上计划一个 cron 作业，每周运行一次以启动 S3 Batch Operations 作业。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该要求包含两个关键部分：

1. 在不同的 AWS 账户中预置一个等效的开发环境，并且每周刷新其数据。
2. 确保在任何数据写入开发账户**之前**，先发现生产环境中的 PII 并将其匿名化；同时使用生产 KMS 密钥解密，并使用不同的开发 KMS 密钥加密。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 使用 Macie 和 Step Functions 脱敏/复制工作流

Amazon Macie 可以针对 S3 对象运行有针对性的敏感数据发现作业，并通过托管或自定义数据标识符检测多种类型的 PII。对于加密对象，Macie 必须能够访问和使用加密密钥。Macie 会生成发现结果和发现作业结果，用于识别敏感数据的类型和位置；随后可通过修复工作流处理这些结果。Macie 本身不会重写或脱敏对象——由状态机编排的任务必须执行实际的脱敏操作。请参阅 [使用 Macie 发现敏感数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/data-classification.html) 和 [敏感数据发现作业的结果类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/discovery-jobs-manage-results.html)。

Step Functions 可以通过 AWS SDK 集成调用 AWS 服务 API，而 `macie2:CreateClassificationJob` 权限允许创建敏感数据发现作业。因此，状态机可以启动发现流程，并编排后续的脱敏和复制操作。请参阅 [Step Functions 中的 AWS SDK 服务集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/supported-services-awssdk.html) 和 [允许用户创建敏感数据发现作业](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/macie/latest/user/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html)。

由于源对象使用 SSE-KMS，处理任务需要拥有生产客户自主管理型密钥的 `kms:Decrypt` 权限。要使用独立的开发密钥写入匿名化对象，这些任务需要拥有开发客户自主管理型密钥的 `kms:Encrypt` 权限，以及相应的跨账户密钥策略和 S3 权限。AWS 的 SSE-KMS 复制示例同样展示了独立的源密钥和目标密钥：源密钥具有解密权限，目标密钥具有加密权限。请参阅 [为 KMS 加密对象配置复制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-config-for-kms-objects.html)。

此设计确保只有经过脱敏的输出会进入开发账户。

### D. 通过 CloudFormation 部署，并每周计划执行状态机

重复使用 CloudFormation 模板可在另一个账户中创建一致的开发环境。AWS 文档将 CloudFormation 模板作为跨多个账户进行标准化部署的机制。请参阅 [CloudFormation StackSets 最佳实践——定义模板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-bestpractices.html)。

Amazon EventBridge 支持调用 Step Functions `StartExecution` API 的定期 cron 或 rate 计划。因此，它可以每周启动一次匿名化和复制状态机，而无需维护计算基础设施。请参阅 [使用 EventBridge Scheduler 启动 Step Functions 状态机](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/using-eventbridge-scheduler.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 先复制，再在开发环境中脱敏 — 错误

S3 复制会先将包含 PII 的原始生产对象复制到开发账户，然后才运行 Macie 发现和脱敏工作流。这直接违反了 PII 必须在从生产环境迁移**之前**完成匿名化的要求。该选项还仅授予了开发密钥的 KMS 权限，并未解决使用生产密钥解密源对象的问题。

### C. 批量复制原始对象，并仅在 GET 时脱敏 — 错误

S3 Batch Operations 作业会先将未经脱敏的对象复制到开发存储桶。S3 Object Lambda 仅会在通过 `GET`、`LIST` 或 `HEAD` 请求返回数据时转换数据；它不会将开发环境中底层存储的对象替换为脱敏版本。因此，开发存储桶仍将包含原始 PII。请参阅 [使用 S3 Object Lambda 转换对象](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transforming-objects.html)。

该选项还只向 Lambda 函数授予了开发 KMS 密钥的权限，而没有授予解密源数据所需的生产密钥权限。

### E. 使用 EC2 cron 作业启动 S3 Batch Operations — 错误

虽然通过 CloudFormation 部署开发环境是合适的，但该选项计划执行的是 S3 Batch Operations 复制，而不是选项 A 中的 Step Functions 发现/脱敏工作流。因此，它无法确保在传输前对 PII 进行匿名化。与 EventBridge 可以直接按托管的定期计划调用状态机相比，托管在 EC2 上的 cron 作业还会引入不必要的实例管理工作。

en.question: A company uses an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to host its machine learning (ML) application. As the ML model and the container image size grow, the time that new pods take to start up has increased to several minutes. A DevOps engineer needs to reduce the startup time to seconds. The solution must also reduce the startup time to seconds when the pod runs on nodes that were recently added to the cluster. The DevOps engineer creates an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes an automation in AWS Systems Manager. The automation prefetches the container images from an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository when new images are pushed to the repository. The DevOps engineer also configures tags to be applied to the cluster and the node groups. What should the DevOps engineer do next to meet the requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has a policy that allows EventBridge to use Systems Manager to run commands in the EKS cluster's control plane nodes. Create a Systems Manager State Manager association that uses the control plane nodes' tags to prefetch corresponding container images.
options.B: Create an IAM role that has a policy that allows EventBridge to use Systems Manager to run commands in the EKS cluster's nodes. Create a Systems Manager State Manager association that uses the nodes' machine size to prefetch corresponding container images.
options.C: Create an IAM role that has a policy that allows EventBridge to use Systems Manager to run commands in the EKS cluster's nodes. Create a Systems Manager State Manager association that uses the nodes' tags to prefetch corresponding container images.
options.D: Create an IAM role that has a policy that allows EventBridge to use Systems Manager to run commands in the EKS cluster's control plane nodes. Create a Systems Manager State Manager association that uses the nodes' tags to prefetch corresponding container images.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The slow Pod startup is caused by large container images having to be pulled after scheduling. Prefetching the images onto the EKS compute nodes reduces that delay. The solution must work both for existing nodes when an image is pushed and for newly added nodes that do not yet have the image cached.

## Correct answer: C

**Create an IAM role that permits EventBridge to invoke Systems Manager against the EKS nodes, and create a Systems Manager State Manager association that targets the nodes by tags.**

This is correct because:

- EKS application workloads run on the cluster's compute nodes, not on the AWS-managed control plane. AWS describes the control plane separately from the worker machines called nodes in the EKS architecture documentation. Therefore, the image must be prefetched onto the nodes where Pods can run ([Amazon EKS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-architecture.html)).
- EventBridge targets typically require an IAM role that grants EventBridge permission to invoke the target. For a Systems Manager Run Command target, this includes `ssm:SendCommand`; AWS also documents tag-scoped permissions for commands that target instances by tags ([Permissions required for EventBridge to access targets using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-events-iam-roles.html)).
- State Manager supports targeting managed nodes by tags. Most importantly, when a new node receives a matching tag, State Manager automatically applies and immediately runs a Command- or Policy-document association on that node. This satisfies the requirement for nodes that were recently added to the cluster ([State Manager association targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-targets-and-rate-controls.html)).
- AWS specifically recommends tag targets for associations applied to Auto Scaling groups, which is relevant to dynamically scaling EKS node groups ([Running Auto Scaling groups with associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-asg.html)).

Thus, EventBridge initiates prefetching when an image is pushed, while the tag-targeted State Manager association ensures that newly launched matching nodes also receive the prefetched image.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** It targets EKS **control plane nodes**. The EKS control plane is managed by Amazon EKS and is responsible for cluster management; the customer workloads and their container images belong on the compute nodes. Targeting control plane tags therefore does not cache the image where application Pods run.

- **B — Incorrect.** It correctly identifies the EKS nodes, but proposes targeting by **machine size**. State Manager association targeting supports mechanisms such as tags, explicit node selection, resource groups, or all nodes; machine size is not the appropriate State Manager association target selector. It also would not provide the intended flexible mapping between tagged node groups and images.

- **D — Incorrect.** Although it mentions node tags, it grants and directs command execution toward **control plane nodes**. The control plane does not serve as the workload compute fleet on which the ML Pods run, so prefetching there would not reduce application Pod startup time.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群来托管其机器学习 (ML) 应用程序。随着 ML 模型和容器映像大小不断增长，新 Pod 的启动时间已增加到数分钟。一名 DevOps 工程师需要将启动时间缩短到数秒。即使 Pod 在最近添加到集群的节点上运行，该解决方案也必须将启动时间缩短到数秒。该 DevOps 工程师创建了一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，用于调用 AWS Systems Manager 中的自动化操作。当新映像被推送到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库时，该自动化操作会从该存储库预提取容器映像。该 DevOps 工程师还配置了要应用于集群和节点组的标签。该 DevOps 工程师接下来应如何做才能满足要求？

options.A: 创建一个 IAM 角色，并为其附加一项策略，该策略允许 EventBridge 使用 Systems Manager 在 EKS 集群的控制平面节点中运行命令。创建一个 Systems Manager State Manager 关联，使用控制平面节点的标签来预提取相应的容器映像。
options.B: 创建一个 IAM 角色，并为其附加一项策略，该策略允许 EventBridge 使用 Systems Manager 在 EKS 集群的节点中运行命令。创建一个 Systems Manager State Manager 关联，使用节点的机器规格来预提取相应的容器映像。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM 角色，并为其附加一项策略，该策略允许 EventBridge 使用 Systems Manager 在 EKS 集群的节点中运行命令。创建一个 Systems Manager State Manager 关联，使用节点的标签来预提取相应的容器映像。
options.D: 创建一个 IAM 角色，并为其附加一项策略，该策略允许 EventBridge 使用 Systems Manager 在 EKS 集群的控制平面节点中运行命令。创建一个 Systems Manager State Manager 关联，使用节点的标签来预提取相应的容器映像。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

Pod 启动缓慢是因为大型容器映像必须在调度后拉取。将映像预提取到 EKS 计算节点上可减少该延迟。该解决方案必须同时适用于映像被推送时的现有节点，以及尚未缓存该映像的新添加节点。

## 正确答案：C

**创建一个 IAM 角色，使 EventBridge 能够针对 EKS 节点调用 Systems Manager，并创建一个通过标签定位节点的 Systems Manager State Manager 关联。**

此选项正确，原因如下：

- EKS 应用程序工作负载在集群的计算节点上运行，而不是在 AWS 托管的控制平面上运行。AWS 在 EKS 架构文档中将控制平面与称为节点的工作机器分开描述。因此，必须在能够运行 Pod 的节点上预提取映像（[Amazon EKS architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/eks-architecture.html)）。
- EventBridge 目标通常需要一个 IAM 角色，以授予 EventBridge 调用目标的权限。对于 Systems Manager Run Command 目标，这包括 `ssm:SendCommand`；AWS 还记录了针对通过标签定位实例的命令所需的标签范围权限（[Permissions required for EventBridge to access targets using IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-events-iam-roles.html)）。
- State Manager 支持通过标签定位托管节点。最重要的是，当新节点获得匹配的标签时，State Manager 会自动在该节点上应用并立即运行 Command 或 Policy 文档关联。这满足了最近添加到集群的节点的要求（[State Manager association targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-targets-and-rate-controls.html)）。
- AWS 专门建议对应用于 Auto Scaling 组的关联使用标签目标，这与动态扩缩 EKS 节点组相关（[Running Auto Scaling groups with associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-asg.html)）。

因此，当映像被推送时，EventBridge 会启动预提取；而以标签为目标的 State Manager 关联可确保新启动的匹配节点也会获得预提取的映像。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A — 错误。** 它以 EKS **控制平面节点**为目标。EKS 控制平面由 Amazon EKS 管理，负责集群管理；客户工作负载及其容器映像应位于计算节点上。因此，以控制平面标签为目标不会在应用程序 Pod 运行的位置缓存映像。

- **B — 错误。** 它正确识别了 EKS 节点，但建议按**机器规格**进行定位。State Manager 关联定位支持标签、显式节点选择、资源组或所有节点等机制；机器规格不是合适的 State Manager 关联目标选择器。它也无法在带标签的节点组与映像之间提供预期的灵活映射。

- **D — 错误。** 虽然它提到了节点标签，但其授予权限并将命令执行定向到**控制平面节点**。控制平面不是 ML Pod 运行的工作负载计算节点群，因此在其中预提取不会缩短应用程序 Pod 的启动时间。

en.question: A company's application has an API that retrieves workload metrics. The company needs to audit, analyze, and visualize these metrics from the application to detect issues at scale. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge schedule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that calls the API to retrieve workload metrics. Store the workload metric data in an Amazon S3 bucket.
options.B: Configure an Amazon EventBridge schedule to invoke an AWS Lambda function that calls the API to retrieve workload metrics. Store the workload metric data in an Amazon DynamoDB table that has a DynamoDB stream enabled.
options.C: Create an AWS Glue crawler to catalog the workload metric data in the Amazon S3 bucket. Create views in Amazon Athena for the cataloged data.
options.D: Connect an AWS Glue crawler to the Amazon DynamoDB stream to catalog the workload metric data. Create views in Amazon Athena for the cataloged data.
options.E: Create Amazon QuickSight datasets from the Amazon Athena views. Create a QuickSight analysis to visualize the workload metric data as a dashboard.
options.F: Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that has custom widgets that invoke AWS Lambda functions. Configure the Lambda functions to query the workload metrics data from the Amazon Athena views.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an end-to-end, scalable pipeline that:

1. periodically collects metrics from an application API,
2. retains those metrics for historical auditing and analysis,
3. catalogs and queries the stored data, and
4. presents the results in analytical dashboards.

## Correct answers: A, C, and E

### A. Schedule Lambda to retrieve the metrics and store them in Amazon S3

Amazon EventBridge can invoke a Lambda function on a recurring schedule. AWS now recommends EventBridge Scheduler rather than legacy scheduled rules, but the architecture described in the option is valid: the function periodically calls the application API and writes the returned metrics to S3. S3 provides the persistent historical data repository needed for auditing and downstream analytics. See [Tutorial: Schedule an AWS Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html).

### C. Catalog the S3 data with AWS Glue and create Athena views

AWS Glue crawlers support Amazon S3 as a native data source. A crawler can inspect the files, infer their schema, and create metadata tables in the AWS Glue Data Catalog. Athena can then query those cataloged tables and create logical SQL views that aggregate, filter, or normalize the metrics for analysis. Athena views are logical tables defined by `SELECT` queries and can be referenced by later queries. See [Supported data sources for crawling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/crawler-data-stores.html) and [CREATE VIEW in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/create-view.html).

### E. Use the Athena views in QuickSight and create a dashboard

QuickSight has native integration with Athena. A QuickSight dataset can use the AWS Glue Data Catalog/Athena tables or custom SQL, and the dataset can then be visualized in an analysis and published as a dashboard. This is the managed BI layer intended for scalable analysis and visualization. See [Creating a dataset using Amazon Athena data](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/create-a-data-set-athena.html) and [Tutorial: Create an Amazon QuickSight dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/example-analysis.html).

Together, **A → C → E** forms a coherent serverless analytics pipeline:

**EventBridge → Lambda → S3 → Glue Data Catalog → Athena views → QuickSight dashboard**

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. DynamoDB with DynamoDB Streams

DynamoDB can store the retrieved records, but enabling DynamoDB Streams does not help this proposed analytics pipeline. Streams are change-event streams, not the S3-based historical analytical repository consumed by option C. Choosing B would also make the correct S3 crawler and Athena path in C inapplicable. The S3 data-lake pattern is a better fit for retaining and querying a growing body of historical metric records.

### D. Connect an AWS Glue crawler to the DynamoDB stream

This is technically invalid. AWS Glue crawlers can crawl a **DynamoDB table**, but AWS documentation explicitly states that crawlers do not support data streams. Therefore, a crawler cannot connect to a DynamoDB stream as described. See [Supported data sources for crawling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/crawler-data-stores.html).

### F. Build a CloudWatch custom widget backed by Lambda

CloudWatch custom widgets invoke Lambda and display HTML, JSON, or Markdown returned by the function. Consequently, this option would require custom Lambda code to query Athena and custom code to render and maintain the visualization. It is possible to build bespoke displays this way, but it is not the appropriate managed analytics and visualization solution when QuickSight provides native Athena datasets, analyses, and dashboards. See [Details about custom widgets in CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/add_custom_widget_dashboard_about.html).

Therefore, the best combination is **A, C, and E**.

zh.question: 某公司的应用程序有一个用于检索工作负载指标的 API。该公司需要对来自该应用程序的这些指标进行审计、分析和可视化，以大规模检测问题。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数调用 API 来检索工作负载指标。将工作负载指标数据存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。
options.B: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划来调用 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数调用 API 来检索工作负载指标。将工作负载指标数据存储在启用了 DynamoDB stream 的 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Glue crawler 来对 Amazon S3 存储桶中的工作负载指标数据进行编目。为已编目的数据创建 Amazon Athena 视图。
options.D: 将 AWS Glue crawler 连接到 Amazon DynamoDB stream，以对工作负载指标数据进行编目。为已编目的数据创建 Amazon Athena 视图。
options.E: 从 Amazon Athena 视图创建 Amazon QuickSight 数据集。创建 QuickSight 分析，以将工作负载指标数据可视化为仪表板。
options.F: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 仪表板，其中包含调用 AWS Lambda 函数的自定义小组件。配置 Lambda 函数以从 Amazon Athena 视图中查询工作负载指标数据。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一个端到端、可扩展的管道，以便：

1. 定期从应用程序 API 收集指标，
2. 保留这些指标以供历史审计和分析，
3. 对存储的数据进行编目和查询，以及
4. 在分析仪表板中展示结果。

## 正确答案：A、C 和 E

### A. 计划 Lambda 检索指标并将其存储在 Amazon S3 中

Amazon EventBridge 可以按重复计划调用 Lambda 函数。AWS 现在建议使用 EventBridge Scheduler，而不是旧版计划规则，但选项中描述的架构是有效的：该函数定期调用应用程序 API，并将返回的指标写入 S3。S3 提供了审计和下游分析所需的持久化历史数据存储库。请参阅 [教程：计划执行 AWS Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-run-lambda-schedule.html)。

### C. 使用 AWS Glue 对 S3 数据进行编目，并创建 Athena 视图

AWS Glue crawler 原生支持 Amazon S3 作为数据源。crawler 可以检查文件、推断其架构，并在 AWS Glue Data Catalog 中创建元数据表。随后，Athena 可以查询这些已编目的表，并创建逻辑 SQL 视图，以便聚合、筛选或规范化指标以供分析。Athena 视图是由 `SELECT` 查询定义的逻辑表，可由后续查询引用。请参阅 [支持用于爬取的数据源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/crawler-data-stores.html) 和 [Athena 中的 CREATE VIEW](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/create-view.html)。

### E. 在 QuickSight 中使用 Athena 视图并创建仪表板

QuickSight 与 Athena 原生集成。QuickSight 数据集可以使用 AWS Glue Data Catalog/Athena 表或自定义 SQL，随后可在分析中将数据集可视化并发布为仪表板。这是专用于可扩展分析和可视化的托管 BI 层。请参阅 [使用 Amazon Athena 数据创建数据集](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/create-a-data-set-athena.html) 和 [教程：创建 Amazon QuickSight 仪表板](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/quick/latest/userguide/example-analysis.html)。

总体而言，**A → C → E** 构成了一个连贯的无服务器分析管道：

**EventBridge → Lambda → S3 → Glue Data Catalog → Athena views → QuickSight dashboard**

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 使用 DynamoDB 和 DynamoDB Streams

DynamoDB 可以存储检索到的记录，但启用 DynamoDB Streams 对这个提议的分析管道没有帮助。Streams 是变更事件流，并不是选项 C 所使用的、基于 S3 的历史分析存储库。选择 B 也会使 C 中正确的 S3 crawler 和 Athena 路径无法适用。S3 数据湖模式更适合保留和查询不断增长的历史指标记录。

### D. 将 AWS Glue crawler 连接到 DynamoDB stream

这在技术上无效。AWS Glue crawler 可以爬取 **DynamoDB 表**，但 AWS 文档明确指出 crawler 不支持数据流。因此，crawler 无法按所述方式连接到 DynamoDB stream。请参阅 [支持用于爬取的数据源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/glue/latest/dg/crawler-data-stores.html)。

### F. 构建由 Lambda 支持的 CloudWatch 自定义小组件

CloudWatch 自定义小组件会调用 Lambda，并显示由该函数返回的 HTML、JSON 或 Markdown。因此，此选项需要自定义 Lambda 代码来查询 Athena，以及自定义代码来呈现和维护可视化内容。虽然可以通过这种方式构建定制显示，但当 QuickSight 已提供原生 Athena 数据集、分析和仪表板时，它并不是合适的托管分析和可视化解决方案。请参阅 [有关 CloudWatch 自定义小组件的详细信息](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/add_custom_widget_dashboard_about.html)。

因此，最佳组合是 **A、C 和 E**。

en.question: A DevOps engineer is building the infrastructure for an application. The application needs to run on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster that includes Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances need to use an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system as a storage backend. The Amazon EFS Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver is installed on the EKS cluster. When the DevOps engineer starts the application, the EC2 instances do not mount the EFS file system. Which solutions will fix the problem? (Choose three.)

options.A: Switch the EKS nodes from Amazon EC2 to AWS Fargate.
options.B: Add an inbound rule to the EFS file system’s security group to allow NFS traffic from the EKS cluster.
options.C: Create an IAM role that allows the Amazon EFS CSI driver to interact with the file system
options.D: Set up AWS DataSync to configure file transfer between the EFS file system and the EKS nodes.
options.E: Create a mount target for the EFS file system in the subnet of the EKS nodes.
options.F: Disable encryption or the EFS file system.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The EKS worker nodes are Amazon EC2 instances, and the application must mount an EFS file system through the installed Amazon EFS CSI driver. A successful mount depends on three layers being configured correctly:

1. **Network authorization** to the EFS mount target over NFS.
2. **IAM permissions** for the EFS CSI driver.
3. **An EFS mount target** reachable from the nodes.

## Correct answers: B, C, and E

### B. Add an inbound rule to the EFS file system’s security group to allow NFS traffic from the EKS cluster

Correct. More precisely, the security group associated with the **EFS mount target** must allow inbound TCP/NFS traffic on port **2049** from the security group used by the EKS EC2 nodes. AWS documents that the EC2 clients need outbound access on port 2049 and the EFS mount target security group needs a corresponding inbound rule from the EC2 security group. Without this rule, the nodes cannot establish the NFS connection to EFS. See [Network access to EFS file systems](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/network-access.html).

### C. Create an IAM role that allows the Amazon EFS CSI driver to interact with the file system

Correct. The EFS CSI driver requires IAM permissions, normally supplied through **EKS Pod Identity** or **IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA)**. AWS provides the `AmazonEFSCSIDriverPolicy`, which permits the driver to create/delete access points and list EFS file systems, mount targets, access points, and EC2 Availability Zones. See [Use elastic file system storage with Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/efs-csi.html) and [AmazonEFSCSIDriverPolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html).

### E. Create a mount target for the EFS file system in the subnet of the EKS nodes

Correct in the intended exam context. An EFS mount target is the VPC network endpoint through which EC2 clients access the file system. For a Regional EFS file system, AWS recommends a mount target in each Availability Zone from which clients access EFS. Only one mount target can exist per Availability Zone; if that Availability Zone contains several subnets, nodes in those subnets can share the mount target. Therefore, creating a mount target in the nodes' subnet/AZ provides the required local EFS endpoint. See [Mount targets and Availability Zones](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/accessing-fs.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Switch the EKS nodes from Amazon EC2 to AWS Fargate

Incorrect. Fargate can mount EFS for statically provisioned volumes, so the claim that Fargate cannot use EFS would be inaccurate. However, changing the compute type is unnecessary and does not correct missing EC2-node networking, IAM, or mount-target configuration. It also changes the stated requirement that the cluster include EC2 instances. AWS notes that Fargate automatically provides the EFS CSI integration but does not support dynamic persistent-volume provisioning for EFS. See [Fargate storage](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate-pod-configuration.html).

### D. Set up AWS DataSync to configure file transfer between the EFS file system and the EKS nodes

Incorrect. DataSync is a data migration and transfer service; it is not part of the Kubernetes persistent-volume mount path. EKS nodes mount EFS directly over NFS through an EFS mount target, so configuring DataSync would not repair an EFS CSI mount failure.

### F. Disable encryption on the EFS file system

Incorrect. EFS supports encrypted file systems and encrypted data in transit. Encryption is not inherently incompatible with the EFS CSI driver and does not replace the required mount target, NFS security-group rule, or driver IAM permissions. AWS recommends encryption at rest and in transit where data-protection requirements apply. See [Data encryption in Amazon EFS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/encryption.html).

Therefore, the three fixes are **B, C, and E**.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在为一个应用程序构建基础设施。该应用程序需要运行在一个包含 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群上。这些 EC2 实例需要使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统作为存储后端。Amazon EFS Container Storage Interface (CSI) 驱动程序已安装在 EKS 集群上。当 DevOps 工程师启动应用程序时，EC2 实例未挂载 EFS 文件系统。哪些解决方案可以修复此问题？（选择三个。）

options.A: 将 EKS 节点从 Amazon EC2 切换为 AWS Fargate。
options.B: 向 EFS 文件系统的安全组添加入站规则，以允许来自 EKS 集群的 NFS 流量。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM 角色，允许 Amazon EFS CSI 驱动程序与该文件系统交互
options.D: 设置 AWS DataSync，以配置 EFS 文件系统和 EKS 节点之间的文件传输。
options.E: 在 EKS 节点所在的子网中为 EFS 文件系统创建挂载目标。
options.F: 禁用 EFS 文件系统的加密。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

EKS 工作节点是 Amazon EC2 实例，应用程序必须通过已安装的 Amazon EFS CSI 驱动程序挂载 EFS 文件系统。成功挂载取决于以下三个层面是否配置正确：

1. 通过 NFS 对 EFS 挂载目标进行**网络授权**。
2. EFS CSI 驱动程序的 **IAM 权限**。
3. 节点可访问的 **EFS 挂载目标**。

## 正确答案：B、C 和 E

### B. 向 EFS 文件系统的安全组添加入站规则，以允许来自 EKS 集群的 NFS 流量

正确。更准确地说，与 **EFS 挂载目标**关联的安全组必须允许来自 EKS EC2 节点所使用安全组的、端口 **2049** 上的入站 TCP/NFS 流量。AWS 文档指出，EC2 客户端需要端口 2049 上的出站访问权限，而 EFS 挂载目标安全组需要具有来自 EC2 安全组的对应入站规则。没有此规则，节点无法建立到 EFS 的 NFS 连接。请参阅 [对 EFS 文件系统的网络访问](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/network-access.html)。

### C. 创建一个 IAM 角色，允许 Amazon EFS CSI 驱动程序与该文件系统交互

正确。EFS CSI 驱动程序需要 IAM 权限，通常通过 **EKS Pod Identity** 或 **IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA)** 提供。AWS 提供 `AmazonEFSCSIDriverPolicy`，该策略允许驱动程序创建/删除访问点，并列出 EFS 文件系统、挂载目标、访问点和 EC2 可用区。请参阅 [将弹性文件系统存储与 Amazon EFS 配合使用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/efs-csi.html) 和 [AmazonEFSCSIDriverPolicy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)。

### E. 在 EKS 节点所在的子网中为 EFS 文件系统创建挂载目标

在本题预期的考试语境中正确。EFS 挂载目标是 EC2 客户端访问文件系统所通过的 VPC 网络终端节点。对于 Regional EFS 文件系统，AWS 建议在客户端访问 EFS 的每个可用区中创建一个挂载目标。每个可用区只能存在一个挂载目标；如果该可用区包含多个子网，则这些子网中的节点可以共享该挂载目标。因此，在节点所在的子网/可用区中创建挂载目标可提供所需的本地 EFS 终端节点。请参阅 [挂载目标和可用区](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/accessing-fs.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 将 EKS 节点从 Amazon EC2 切换为 AWS Fargate

错误。Fargate 可以为静态预置的卷挂载 EFS，因此声称 Fargate 无法使用 EFS 并不准确。但是，更改计算类型没有必要，也无法修复缺失的 EC2 节点网络、IAM 或挂载目标配置。此外，这还改变了集群必须包含 EC2 实例这一既定要求。AWS 指出，Fargate 会自动提供 EFS CSI 集成，但不支持对 EFS 进行动态持久卷预置。请参阅 [Fargate 存储](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate-pod-configuration.html)。

### D. 设置 AWS DataSync，以配置 EFS 文件系统和 EKS 节点之间的文件传输

错误。DataSync 是一项数据迁移和传输服务，并非 Kubernetes 持久卷挂载路径的一部分。EKS 节点通过 EFS 挂载目标直接使用 NFS 挂载 EFS，因此配置 DataSync 无法修复 EFS CSI 挂载失败问题。

### F. 禁用 EFS 文件系统的加密

错误。EFS 支持加密的文件系统和传输中数据加密。加密本身与 EFS CSI 驱动程序并不冲突，也不能替代所需的挂载目标、NFS 安全组规则或驱动程序 IAM 权限。AWS 建议在数据保护要求适用时使用静态加密和传输中加密。请参阅 [Amazon EFS 中的数据加密](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/encryption.html)。

因此，这三个修复方案是 **B、C 和 E**。

en.question: A company deploys an application on on-premises devices in the company’s on-premises data center. The company uses an AWS Direct Connect connection between the data center and the company's AWS account. During initial setup of the on-premises devices and during application updates, the application needs to retrieve configuration files from an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. All traffic from the on-premises devices to Amazon EFS must remain private and encrypted. The on-premises devices must follow the principle of least privilege for AWS access.
