options.B: Update the status of the affected CodeArtifact package version to deleted.
options.C: Update the status of the affected CodeArtifact package version to archived.
options.D: Update the CodeArtifact package origin control settings to allow direct publishing and to block upstream operations.
options.E: Update the CodeArtifact package origin control settings to block direct publishing and to allow upstream operations.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company must do two things for a package that originally came from a public upstream repository:

1. Make the vulnerable package version unavailable for download.
2. Permit the security team to publish an internally patched version while preventing the public upstream from supplying additional versions of that package.

## Correct answers: C and D

### C. Update the affected package version's status to `Archived`

An **Archived** CodeArtifact package version is not listed by package managers, and its assets can no longer be downloaded. Therefore, clients cannot consume the vulnerable version. Unlike permanent deletion, archiving also preserves the version so that its status can be restored later if necessary. AWS explicitly states that consumption of an archived version is blocked. See [CodeArtifact package version status](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/packages-overview.html).

### D. Allow direct publishing and block upstream operations

The required origin-control configuration is:

- **Publish: ALLOW** — permits the security team to publish the patched package version directly to the repository.
- **Upstream: BLOCK** — prevents versions of this package from being ingested from an upstream CodeArtifact repository or external public repository.

AWS documents this exact configuration for the scenario **“Publishing a patched package version of an existing external package.”** See [CodeArtifact package origin controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/package-origin-controls.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Set the package version to `Unlisted`

An **Unlisted** version is omitted from version lists returned to package managers, so normal dependency resolution generally will not select it. However, its assets remain downloadable. For example, a version already referenced by a lock file can still be downloaded and installed. Therefore, `Unlisted` does not satisfy the explicit requirement to prevent downloads. See [CodeArtifact package version status](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/packages-overview.html).

### B. Update the package version status to `Deleted`

`Deleted` is not a valid target for the `UpdatePackageVersionsStatus` operation. That operation can set a target status only to `Archived`, `Published`, or `Unlisted`. Deleting a version is a separate, irreversible `DeletePackageVersions` operation rather than a status update. Thus, as worded, this option is not valid. See [UpdatePackageVersionsStatus](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/APIReference/API_UpdatePackageVersionsStatus.html) and [DeletePackageVersions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePackageVersions.html).

### E. Block direct publishing and allow upstream operations

This is the opposite of what is required. **Publish: BLOCK** would prevent the security team from publishing the patched version, while **Upstream: ALLOW** would continue allowing package versions to be obtained from the public upstream. See [CodeArtifact package origin controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/package-origin-controls.html).

zh.question: 一家公司已设置具有公共上游仓库的 AWS CodeArtifact 仓库。该公司的开发团队从公司内部网络中的仓库使用开源依赖项。公司的安全团队最近发现，开发团队使用的某个软件包的最新版本存在严重漏洞。安全团队已制作修补版本以修复该漏洞。公司需要阻止下载存在漏洞的版本。此外，公司还需要允许安全团队发布修补版本。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将受影响的 CodeArtifact 软件包版本的状态更新为 unlisted。
options.B: 将受影响的 CodeArtifact 软件包版本的状态更新为 deleted。
options.C: 将受影响的 CodeArtifact 软件包版本的状态更新为 archived。
options.D: 更新 CodeArtifact 软件包源控制设置，以允许直接发布并阻止上游操作。
options.E: 更新 CodeArtifact 软件包源控制设置，以阻止直接发布并允许上游操作。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

对于最初来自公共上游仓库的软件包，公司必须完成两件事：

1. 使存在漏洞的软件包版本无法下载。
2. 允许安全团队发布内部修补版本，同时阻止公共上游为该软件包提供其他版本。

## 正确答案：C 和 D

### C. 将受影响的软件包版本状态更新为 `Archived`

处于 **Archived** 状态的 CodeArtifact 软件包版本不会由软件包管理器列出，其资产也无法再被下载。因此，客户端无法使用存在漏洞的版本。与永久删除不同，归档还会保留该版本，以便在必要时以后恢复其状态。AWS 明确指出，已归档版本无法被使用。请参阅 [CodeArtifact 软件包版本状态](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/packages-overview.html)。

### D. 允许直接发布并阻止上游操作

所需的源控制配置为：

- **Publish: ALLOW** — 允许安全团队将修补的软件包版本直接发布到仓库。
- **Upstream: BLOCK** — 阻止从上游 CodeArtifact 仓库或外部公共仓库引入此软件包的版本。

AWS 针对 **“Publishing a patched package version of an existing external package”** 场景记录了这一确切配置。请参阅 [CodeArtifact 软件包源控制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/package-origin-controls.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 将软件包版本设置为 `Unlisted`

**Unlisted** 版本会从软件包管理器返回的版本列表中省略，因此常规依赖项解析通常不会选择它。但是，其资产仍可下载。例如，锁定文件中已引用的版本仍然可以下载和安装。因此，`Unlisted` 不满足阻止下载这一明确要求。请参阅 [CodeArtifact 软件包版本状态](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/packages-overview.html)。

### B. 将软件包版本状态更新为 `Deleted`

`Deleted` 不是 `UpdatePackageVersionsStatus` 操作的有效目标状态。该操作只能将目标状态设置为 `Archived`、`Published` 或 `Unlisted`。删除版本是独立且不可逆的 `DeletePackageVersions` 操作，而不是状态更新。因此，按照该选项的表述，它无效。请参阅 [UpdatePackageVersionsStatus](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/APIReference/API_UpdatePackageVersionsStatus.html) 和 [DeletePackageVersions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/APIReference/API_DeletePackageVersions.html)。

### E. 阻止直接发布并允许上游操作

这与要求完全相反。**Publish: BLOCK** 会阻止安全团队发布修补版本，而 **Upstream: ALLOW** 会继续允许从公共上游获取软件包版本。请参阅 [CodeArtifact 软件包源控制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/package-origin-controls.html)。

en.question: A company is running a custom-built application that processes records. All the components run on Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. Each record's processing is a multistep sequential action that is compute-intensive. Each step is always completed in 5 minutes or less. A limitation of the current system is that if any steps fail, the application has to reprocess the record from the beginning. The company wants to update the architecture so that the application must reprocess only the failed steps. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?

options.A: Create a web application to write records to Amazon S3. Use S3 Event Notifications to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Use an EC2 instance to poll Amazon SNS and start processing. Save intermediate results to Amazon S3 to pass on to the next step.
options.B: Perform the processing steps by using logic in the application. Convert the application code to run in a container. Use AWS Fargate to manage the container instances. Configure the container to invoke itself to pass the state from one step to the next.
options.C: Create a web application to pass records to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Decouple the processing by using the Kinesis data stream and AWS Lambda functions.
options.D: Create a web application to pass records to AWS Step Functions. Decouple the processing into Step Functions tasks and AWS Lambda functions.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application performs a sequence of processing steps for each record. The key requirement is to **checkpoint workflow progress and retry only the failed step**, without rebuilding substantial orchestration, retry, and state-management logic. The solution must also be the **most operationally efficient**.

## Correct answer: D

**Create a web application to pass records to AWS Step Functions. Decouple the processing into Step Functions tasks and AWS Lambda functions.**

AWS Step Functions is designed to orchestrate sequential tasks while maintaining workflow state. AWS specifically documents that, for sequential processing, separate Lambda functions can implement the individual tasks while Step Functions runs them in the correct order, passes data between them, and implements error handling at each step. This provides the required checkpointing: after earlier states complete successfully, a failure in a later `Task` state can be handled at that state rather than restarting the entire business process. See [Using Step Functions with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-step-functions.html).

Step Functions `Task` states support configurable `Retry` policies, including error matching, maximum attempts, delay intervals, exponential backoff, and jitter. Therefore, the failed Lambda-backed task can be retried independently. If retries are exhausted, `Catch` handling can route the execution to a fallback or remediation state. See [Handling errors in Step Functions workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/concepts-error-handling.html).

Each processing step always completes within 5 minutes, which fits within Lambda's configurable maximum timeout of **900 seconds (15 minutes)**. The functions must, of course, be allocated sufficient memory/CPU and tested against realistic upper-bound workloads. See [Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html).

This architecture removes EC2 and Auto Scaling group management and delegates workflow sequencing, state tracking, retries, and failure routing to managed serverless services, making it the most operationally efficient choice.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. S3 events, SNS, EC2 polling, and intermediate S3 results

This is a manually assembled workflow. The application would need custom logic for checkpoints, ordering, correlation, retries, recovery, and passing intermediate results. It also retains an EC2 worker, increasing operational overhead. Additionally, SNS is a publish/subscribe notification service rather than a queue that an EC2 instance directly polls; a poll-based design would normally require an intermediary such as Amazon SQS. Although intermediate S3 objects could be used as checkpoints, this is substantially less operationally efficient than Step Functions' managed workflow state and task-level error handling.

### B. A self-invoking container on AWS Fargate

Fargate removes the need to manage container hosts, but it does not by itself provide durable multistep orchestration or per-step checkpointing. Having the container invoke itself and pass state requires the company to implement and operate custom sequencing, state persistence, duplicate handling, retries, and recovery logic. Step Functions provides these capabilities directly.

### C. Kinesis Data Streams with Lambda

Kinesis is appropriate for durable streaming ingestion and ordered processing within shards, but it is not a native multistep workflow orchestrator. Lambda event-source mappings can retry failed stream records or batches, but that does not automatically track which business-processing step has completed for each record. The company would still need to build its own workflow state, step transitions, and checkpoint logic. Step Functions directly models the sequential actions as states and provides error handling for each task.

Therefore, **D** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一家公司正在运行一个自定义构建的应用程序来处理记录。所有组件都运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。每条记录的处理都是一个多步骤的顺序操作，并且计算密集型。每个步骤始终可在 5 分钟或更短时间内完成。当前系统的一个限制是，如果任何步骤失败，应用程序必须从头开始重新处理该记录。该公司希望更新架构，使应用程序只需重新处理失败的步骤。哪种解决方案能以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Web 应用程序，将记录写入 Amazon S3。使用 S3 Event Notifications 发布到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。使用一个 EC2 实例轮询 Amazon SNS 并开始处理。将中间结果保存到 Amazon S3，以传递给下一步骤。
options.B: 使用应用程序中的逻辑执行处理步骤。将应用程序代码转换为在容器中运行。使用 AWS Fargate 管理容器实例。配置容器调用自身，以将状态从一个步骤传递到下一个步骤。
options.C: 创建一个 Web 应用程序，将记录传递到 Amazon Kinesis data stream。使用 Kinesis data stream 和 AWS Lambda functions 解耦处理过程。
options.D: 创建一个 Web 应用程序，将记录传递到 AWS Step Functions。将处理过程解耦为 Step Functions tasks 和 AWS Lambda functions。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序会对每条记录执行一系列处理步骤。关键要求是**检查点化工作流进度，并且仅重试失败的步骤**，而无需构建大量编排、重试和状态管理逻辑。该解决方案还必须具备**最高的运营效率**。

## 正确答案：D

**创建一个 Web 应用程序，将记录传递到 AWS Step Functions。将处理过程解耦为 Step Functions tasks 和 AWS Lambda functions。**

AWS Step Functions 专为在维护工作流状态的同时编排顺序任务而设计。AWS 明确说明，对于顺序处理，可以由独立的 Lambda functions 实现各个任务，同时 Step Functions 会按正确顺序运行这些任务、在任务之间传递数据，并在每个步骤实施错误处理。这提供了所需的检查点机制：在先前状态成功完成后，后续 `Task` 状态中的失败可以在该状态进行处理，而不是重新启动整个业务流程。请参阅 [Using Step Functions with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-step-functions.html)。

Step Functions `Task` 状态支持可配置的 `Retry` 策略，包括错误匹配、最大尝试次数、延迟间隔、指数退避和抖动。因此，可以独立重试由 Lambda 支持的失败任务。如果重试耗尽，`Catch` 处理可以将执行路由到备用或修复状态。请参阅 [Handling errors in Step Functions workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/concepts-error-handling.html)。

每个处理步骤始终在 5 分钟内完成，符合 Lambda 可配置的最大超时时间，即 **900 秒（15 分钟）**。当然，必须为这些函数分配足够的内存/CPU，并根据真实的上限工作负载进行测试。请参阅 [Lambda function timeout](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/configuration-timeout.html)。

该架构无需管理 EC2 和 Auto Scaling 组，并将工作流排序、状态跟踪、重试和失败路由委托给托管式无服务器服务，因此是运营效率最高的选择。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. S3 事件、SNS、EC2 轮询和中间 S3 结果

这是一个手动组装的工作流。应用程序需要为检查点、排序、关联、重试、恢复以及传递中间结果编写自定义逻辑。它还保留了一个 EC2 worker，从而增加了运营开销。此外，SNS 是发布/订阅通知服务，而不是可由 EC2 实例直接轮询的队列；基于轮询的设计通常需要 Amazon SQS 等中介服务。尽管可以使用中间 S3 对象作为检查点，但与 Step Functions 提供的托管工作流状态和任务级错误处理相比，这种方式的运营效率明显更低。

### B. AWS Fargate 上自调用的容器

Fargate 无需管理容器主机，但它本身并不提供持久的多步骤编排或按步骤进行检查点化的功能。让容器调用自身并传递状态，要求公司实施和运维自定义的排序、状态持久化、重复处理、重试和恢复逻辑。Step Functions 可直接提供这些功能。

### C. 配合 Lambda 的 Kinesis Data Streams

Kinesis 适用于持久化流式摄取以及分片内的有序处理，但它不是原生的多步骤工作流编排器。Lambda event-source mappings 可以重试失败的流记录或批次，但这不会自动跟踪每条记录的哪个业务处理步骤已经完成。公司仍需要自行构建工作流状态、步骤转换和检查点逻辑。Step Functions 可将顺序操作直接建模为状态，并为每个任务提供错误处理。

因此，**D** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company is migrating its on-premises Windows applications and Linux applications to AWS. The company will use automation to launch Amazon EC2 instances to mirror the on-premises configurations. The migrated applications require access to shared storage that uses SMB for Windows and NFS for Linux. The company is also creating a pilot light disaster recovery (DR) environment in another AWS Region. The company will use automation to launch and configure the EC2 instances in the DR Region. The company needs to replicate the storage to the DR Region. Which storage solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon S3 for the application storage. Create an S3 bucket in the primary Region and an S3 bucket in the DR Region. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the primary Region to the DR Region.
options.B: Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for the application storage. Create a backup plan in AWS Backup that creates snapshots of the EBS volumes that are in the primary Region and replicates the snapshots to the DR Region.
options.C: Use a Volume Gateway in AWS Storage Gateway for the application storage. Configure Cross-Region Replication (CRR) of the Volume Gateway from the primary Region to the DR Region.
options.D: Use Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for the application storage. Create an FSx for ONTAP instance in the DR Region. Configure NetApp SnapMirror replication from the primary Region to the DR Region.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

The company needs one shared-storage platform that provides:

1. **SMB access for Windows applications**
2. **NFS access for Linux applications**
3. **Cross-Region replication** to a pilot-light disaster recovery environment

## Correct answer: D

**Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP with NetApp SnapMirror replication** meets all three requirements.

FSx for ONTAP is a managed file-storage service that supports multiprotocol access, including both **NFS and SMB**. Therefore, Windows and Linux EC2 instances can access the required shared application data through their native file protocols. AWS also documents support for NetApp SnapMirror as an FSx for ONTAP feature ([FSx for ONTAP features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html)).

SnapMirror can periodically replicate an FSx for ONTAP volume to a second FSx for ONTAP file system, and AWS explicitly supports both **in-Region and cross-Region deployments**. Replication can be scheduled as frequently as every five minutes, making it appropriate for maintaining a secondary copy for pilot-light DR ([Replicating data using NetApp SnapMirror](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/scheduled-replication.html)).

Thus, deploying FSx for ONTAP in both Regions and configuring SnapMirror provides the required shared file protocols and cross-Region data protection.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Amazon S3 with S3 Cross-Region Replication

S3 CRR can replicate **objects** between buckets, but standard S3 buckets do not directly provide the shared SMB and NFS file-system interfaces required by these applications. Replicating the buckets does not convert S3 object storage into a multiprotocol network file system. An additional file-interface service would be necessary, and none is included in this option.

### B. Amazon EBS with cross-Region snapshot copies

Amazon EBS provides **block storage volumes attached to EC2 instances**, similar to locally attached disks. EBS snapshots are point-in-time backups from which new volumes can be restored, including across Regions ([What is Amazon EBS?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/what-is-ebs.html)).

This does not natively provide a managed shared file system supporting both SMB and NFS. It also provides snapshot-based recovery rather than continuous or scheduled file-system replication to an already provisioned shared-storage system in the DR Region.

### C. Volume Gateway with “Cross-Region Replication”

Volume Gateway presents storage as **iSCSI block devices**, not as shared SMB and NFS file shares. Stored volumes asynchronously back up point-in-time snapshots to Amazon S3 for recovery, but there is no Volume Gateway feature called Cross-Region Replication that directly replicates one gateway to another as described in the option ([What is Volume Gateway?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)).

Therefore, this option fails both the required file-access protocols and the stated replication design.

zh.question: 一家公司正在将其本地 Windows 应用程序和 Linux 应用程序迁移到 AWS。该公司将使用自动化方式启动 Amazon EC2 实例，以镜像本地配置。迁移后的应用程序需要访问使用 Windows SMB 和 Linux NFS 的共享存储。该公司还将在另一个 AWS Region 中创建试点灯（pilot light）灾难恢复（DR）环境。该公司将使用自动化方式在 DR Region 中启动和配置 EC2 实例。该公司需要将存储复制到 DR Region。哪种存储解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Amazon S3 用于应用程序存储。在主 Region 中创建一个 S3 bucket，并在 DR Region 中创建一个 S3 bucket。配置从主 Region 到 DR Region 的 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。
options.B: 将 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 用于应用程序存储。在 AWS Backup 中创建一个备份计划，为主 Region 中的 EBS volumes 创建快照，并将这些快照复制到 DR Region。
options.C: 将 AWS Storage Gateway 中的 Volume Gateway 用于应用程序存储。配置从主 Region 到 DR Region 的 Volume Gateway Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。
options.D: 将 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 用于应用程序存储。在 DR Region 中创建一个 FSx for ONTAP 实例。配置从主 Region 到 DR Region 的 NetApp SnapMirror replication。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

公司需要一个共享存储平台，同时提供：

1. **供 Windows 应用程序使用的 SMB 访问**
2. **供 Linux 应用程序使用的 NFS 访问**
3. 到试点灯灾难恢复环境的 **跨 Region 复制**

## 正确答案：D

**使用 NetApp SnapMirror replication 的 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP** 可满足全部三项要求。

FSx for ONTAP 是一项托管文件存储服务，支持多协议访问，包括 **NFS 和 SMB**。因此，Windows 和 Linux EC2 实例可以通过各自原生的文件协议访问所需的共享应用程序数据。AWS 还将 NetApp SnapMirror 支持记录为 FSx for ONTAP 的一项功能（[FSx for ONTAP 功能](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html)）。

SnapMirror 可以定期将 FSx for ONTAP volume 复制到第二个 FSx for ONTAP file system，并且 AWS 明确支持 **同 Region 和跨 Region 部署**。复制计划最快可设置为每五分钟执行一次，因此适合为试点灯 DR 维护辅助副本（[使用 NetApp SnapMirror 复制数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/scheduled-replication.html)）。

因此，在两个 Region 中部署 FSx for ONTAP 并配置 SnapMirror，可提供所需的共享文件协议和跨 Region 数据保护。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication 的 Amazon S3

S3 CRR 可以在 bucket 之间复制 **对象**，但标准 S3 bucket 不会直接提供这些应用程序所需的共享 SMB 和 NFS 文件系统接口。复制 bucket 不会将 S3 object storage 转换为多协议网络文件系统。还需要额外的文件接口服务，而此选项中并未包含该服务。

### B. 使用跨 Region 快照副本的 Amazon EBS

Amazon EBS 提供附加到 EC2 实例的 **块存储 volumes**，类似于本地附加的磁盘。EBS snapshots 是时间点备份，可用于还原新的 volumes，包括在不同 Region 中进行还原（[什么是 Amazon EBS？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/what-is-ebs.html)）。

这无法原生提供一个同时支持 SMB 和 NFS 的托管共享文件系统。它提供的也是基于快照的恢复，而不是向 DR Region 中已预置的共享存储系统进行持续或定期的文件系统复制。

### C. 使用“Cross-Region Replication”的 Volume Gateway

Volume Gateway 将存储呈现为 **iSCSI block devices**，而非共享 SMB 和 NFS file shares。Stored volumes 会将时间点快照异步备份到 Amazon S3 以供恢复，但并不存在名为 Cross-Region Replication 的 Volume Gateway 功能，可以如选项所述直接将一个 gateway 复制到另一个 gateway（[什么是 Volume Gateway？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/storagegateway/latest/vgw/WhatIsStorageGateway.html)）。

因此，该选项既不满足所需的文件访问协议，也不满足所述的复制设计。

en.question: A company's application uses a fleet of Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances to analyze and process data. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The Auto Scaling group is a target group for an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application analyzes critical data that cannot tolerate interruption. The application also analyzes noncritical data that can withstand interruption. The critical data analysis requires quick scalability in response to real-time application demand. The noncritical data analysis involves memory consumption. A DevOps engineer must implement a solution that reduces scale-out latency for the critical data. The solution also must process the noncritical data. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: For the critical data, modify the existing Auto Scaling group. Create a warm pool instance in the stopped state. Define the warm pool size. Create a new version of the launch template that has detailed monitoring enabled. Use Spot Instances.
options.B: For the critical data, modify the existing Auto Scaling group. Create a warm pool instance in the stopped state. Define the warm pool size. Create a new version of the launch template that has detailed monitoring enabled. Use On-Demand Instances.
options.C: For the critical data, modify the existing Auto Scaling group. Create a lifecycle hook to ensure that bootstrap scripts are completed successfully. Ensure that the application on the instances is ready to accept traffic before the instances are registered. Create a new version of the launch template that has detailed monitoring enabled.
options.D: For the noncritical data, create a second Auto Scaling group that uses a launch template. Configure the launch template to install the unified Amazon CloudWatch agent and to configure the CloudWatch agent with a custom memory utilization metric. Use Spot Instances. Add the new Auto Scaling group as the target group for the ALB. Modify the application to use two target groups for critical data and noncritical data.
options.E: For the noncritical data, create a second Auto Scaling group. Choose the predefined memory utilization metric type for the target tracking scaling policy. Use Spot Instances. Add the new Auto Scaling group as the target group for the ALB. Modify the application to use two target groups for critical data and noncritical data.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The solution must separate two workload characteristics:

1. **Critical analysis:** cannot tolerate interruption and must scale out with low latency.
2. **Noncritical analysis:** can tolerate interruption and should scale according to **memory consumption**.

## Correct answers: B and D

### B — Use an On-Demand warm pool for the critical workload

An EC2 Auto Scaling **warm pool** contains pre-initialized instances that the group can use during scale-out. This accelerates scale-out because the instances have already completed much of their initialization. Instances can be kept in the `Stopped` state to reduce cost while remaining prepared for a warm start. AWS explicitly describes warm pools as a way to make instances ready to serve traffic more quickly during scale-out events ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-warm-pools.html)).

Using **On-Demand Instances** is appropriate because the critical workload cannot tolerate interruption. Enabling detailed monitoring also provides one-minute EC2 metrics instead of the default five-minute interval, allowing scaling policies based on EC2 metrics to react more quickly ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)).

Therefore, B provides both the required reliability and reduced scale-out latency.

### D — Use Spot Instances and a custom memory metric for the noncritical workload

The noncritical workload can withstand interruption, so **Spot Instances** are suitable. AWS states that Spot Instances can be interrupted by EC2, normally with a two-minute interruption notice ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-spot-instances-work.html)).

EC2 does not publish guest operating system memory utilization as a standard EC2 metric. To collect memory metrics, the unified CloudWatch agent must be installed and configured. AWS specifically states that operating-system-level metrics such as available and used memory require the CloudWatch agent ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/enable-as-instance-metrics.html)). The resulting custom memory utilization metric can be used by an Auto Scaling policy.

Separating the workloads into different Auto Scaling groups and ALB target groups permits independent capacity types and scaling behavior. ALB listener rules can route different application traffic to different target groups ([AWS documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A — Incorrect

Although the warm pool would reduce scale-out latency, this option uses **Spot Instances** for critical processing. Spot Instances can be stopped, terminated, or hibernated when EC2 reclaims capacity. That conflicts directly with the requirement that critical analysis cannot tolerate interruption.

### C — Incorrect

A lifecycle hook can keep a newly launched instance in a wait state until bootstrapping and application initialization are complete. This helps prevent an instance from entering service before it is ready, but it does not itself pre-initialize capacity or reduce launch latency. In fact, it can extend the time before a newly launched instance becomes `InService`. A warm pool is the feature designed to reduce scale-out latency.

The option also does not explicitly preserve the critical workload's On-Demand capacity choice as clearly as B does.

### E — Incorrect

EC2 Auto Scaling target tracking does **not** provide a predefined memory-utilization metric. The documented predefined metrics are:

- `ASGAverageCPUUtilization`
- `ASGAverageNetworkIn`
- `ASGAverageNetworkOut`
- `ALBRequestCountPerTarget`

Memory utilization must be collected through the CloudWatch agent and supplied as a custom metric. Therefore, the predefined memory metric proposed by E does not exist for EC2 Auto Scaling.

## Final answer

**B and D**

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序使用一组 Amazon EC2 按需实例来分析和处理数据。这些 EC2 实例位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。该 Auto Scaling 组是 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 的一个目标组。该应用程序会分析不能容忍中断的关键数据。该应用程序还会分析能够承受中断的非关键数据。关键数据分析需要根据实时应用程序需求进行快速扩缩容。非关键数据分析涉及内存消耗。一名 DevOps 工程师必须实施一个能够降低关键数据扩容延迟的解决方案。该解决方案还必须处理非关键数据。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 对于关键数据，修改现有的 Auto Scaling 组。创建一个处于已停止状态的预置实例池实例。定义预置实例池大小。创建启用了详细监控的新启动模板版本。使用 Spot Instances。
options.B: 对于关键数据，修改现有的 Auto Scaling 组。创建一个处于已停止状态的预置实例池实例。定义预置实例池大小。创建启用了详细监控的新启动模板版本。使用 On-Demand Instances。
options.C: 对于关键数据，修改现有的 Auto Scaling 组。创建一个生命周期挂钩，以确保引导脚本成功完成。确保实例上的应用程序已准备好接受流量，然后再注册这些实例。创建启用了详细监控的新启动模板版本。
options.D: 对于非关键数据，创建第二个使用启动模板的 Auto Scaling 组。配置启动模板以安装统一 Amazon CloudWatch 代理，并使用自定义内存利用率指标配置 CloudWatch 代理。使用 Spot Instances。将新的 Auto Scaling 组添加为 ALB 的目标组。修改应用程序，以便针对关键数据和非关键数据使用两个目标组。
options.E: 对于非关键数据，创建第二个 Auto Scaling 组。为目标跟踪扩缩策略选择预定义的内存利用率指标类型。使用 Spot Instances。将新的 Auto Scaling 组添加为 ALB 的目标组。修改应用程序，以便针对关键数据和非关键数据使用两个目标组。

zh.explanation:
## 问题要求

该解决方案必须区分两种工作负载特征：

1. **关键分析：** 不能容忍中断，并且必须以低延迟进行扩容。
2. **非关键分析：** 可以承受中断，并且应根据**内存消耗**进行扩缩容。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B — 对关键工作负载使用 On-Demand 预置实例池

EC2 Auto Scaling **预置实例池**包含该组可在扩容期间使用的预初始化实例。这可加快扩容速度，因为这些实例已经完成了大部分初始化工作。实例可以保持在 `Stopped` 状态，以降低成本，同时仍为快速启动做好准备。AWS 明确说明，预置实例池可使实例在扩容事件期间更快地准备好服务流量（[AWS 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-warm-pools.html)）。

使用 **On-Demand Instances** 是合适的，因为关键工作负载不能容忍中断。启用详细监控还能提供一分钟间隔的 EC2 指标，而不是默认的五分钟间隔，使基于 EC2 指标的扩缩策略能够更快作出响应（[AWS 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-scaling-target-tracking.html)）。

因此，B 同时提供了所需的可靠性和更低的扩容延迟。

### D — 对非关键工作负载使用 Spot Instances 和自定义内存指标

非关键工作负载可以承受中断，因此适合使用 **Spot Instances**。AWS 指出，Spot Instances 可能会被 EC2 中断，通常会提前两分钟发出中断通知（[AWS 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/how-spot-instances-work.html)）。

EC2 不会将客户机操作系统的内存利用率作为标准 EC2 指标发布。要收集内存指标，必须安装并配置统一 CloudWatch 代理。AWS 明确指出，可用内存和已用内存等操作系统级指标需要 CloudWatch 代理（[AWS 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/enable-as-instance-metrics.html)）。生成的自定义内存利用率指标可由 Auto Scaling 策略使用。

将工作负载分离到不同的 Auto Scaling 组和 ALB 目标组中，能够实现独立的容量类型和扩缩行为。ALB 侦听器规则可以将不同的应用程序流量路由到不同的目标组（[AWS 文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)）。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A — 错误

尽管预置实例池会降低扩容延迟，但该选项针对关键处理使用了 **Spot Instances**。当 EC2 回收容量时，Spot Instances 可能会被停止、终止或休眠。这与关键分析不能容忍中断的要求直接冲突。

### C — 错误

生命周期挂钩可以使新启动的实例保持在等待状态，直到引导和应用程序初始化完成。这有助于防止实例在准备就绪之前进入服务，但它本身不会预初始化容量或降低启动延迟。事实上，它可能会延长新启动实例进入 `InService` 状态之前的时间。预置实例池才是专门用于降低扩容延迟的功能。

该选项也不像 B 一样明确地保留关键工作负载对 On-Demand 容量的选择。

### E — 错误

EC2 Auto Scaling 目标跟踪**不**提供预定义的内存利用率指标。文档中列出的预定义指标包括：

- `ASGAverageCPUUtilization`
- `ASGAverageNetworkIn`
- `ASGAverageNetworkOut`
- `ALBRequestCountPerTarget`

内存利用率必须通过 CloudWatch 代理收集，并作为自定义指标提供。因此，E 提出的预定义内存指标并不存在于 EC2 Auto Scaling 中。

## 最终答案

**B 和 D**

en.question: A company recently migrated its application to an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster that uses Amazon EC2 instances. The company configured the application to automatically scale based on CPU utilization. The application produces memory errors when it experiences heavy loads. The application also does not scale out enough to handle the increased load. The company needs to collect and analyze memory metrics for the application over time. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Attach the CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy managed IAM policy to the IAM instance profile that the cluster uses.
options.B: Attach the CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy managed IAM policy to a service account role for the cluster.
options.C: Collect performance metrics by deploying the unified Amazon CloudWatch agent to the existing EC2 instances in the cluster. Add the agent to the AMI for any new EC2 instances that are added to the cluster.
options.D: Collect performance logs by deploying the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry collector as a DaemonSet.
options.E: Analyze the pod_memory_utilization Amazon CloudWatch metric in the ContainerInsights namespace by using the Service dimension.
options.F: Analyze the node_memory_utilization Amazon CloudWatch metric in the ContainerInsights namespace by using the ClusterName dimension.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The application runs as pods on an EC2-backed Amazon EKS cluster. CPU-only scaling is not exposing the application's memory pressure, so the company needs to:

1. Give the metric collector permission to publish to CloudWatch.
2. Install the collector across the current and future EC2 worker-node fleet.
3. Analyze an application-level memory metric rather than only node-level memory.

## Correct answers: A, C, and E

### A. Attach `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` to the cluster's IAM instance profile

This matches the deployment described in option C: the CloudWatch agent is installed on the EC2 worker instances and therefore uses the instances' IAM role. AWS documents that an EC2-hosted CloudWatch agent requires an EC2 IAM role with `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy`, and that the role must be attached to the instance ([CloudWatch agent prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/prerequisites.html)).

### C. Deploy the unified CloudWatch agent to existing instances and include it in the AMI for new instances

EC2's standard metrics do not include guest operating-system memory utilization. AWS states that the CloudWatch agent must be installed to collect operating-system metrics such as available and used memory ([collect additional metrics using the CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/enable-as-instance-metrics.html)). Installing it on existing worker nodes and incorporating it into the node AMI ensures continued collection as the EKS worker fleet scales or is replaced.

For EKS Container Insights, the CloudWatch agent is the component that collects infrastructure and workload performance data. AWS's managed implementation runs the agent across the nodes as a DaemonSet ([Enhanced Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/container-insights-eks-classic.html)). The option's AMI-based deployment is the host-installed alternative represented by this question.

### E. Analyze `pod_memory_utilization` by Kubernetes service

`pod_memory_utilization` measures memory utilization for the application pods. AWS lists it in the `ContainerInsights` namespace and supports the dimension set `Service`, `Namespace`, and `ClusterName`, in addition to pod-, namespace-, and cluster-level dimension sets ([EKS Container Insights metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-metrics-EKS.html)). Grouping the metric by the application's Kubernetes service provides the relevant application-level historical view and can expose memory pressure that CPU-only scaling misses.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Attach the policy to a service account role

A service-account IAM role is appropriate when the CloudWatch agent is deployed as an EKS workload through the CloudWatch Observability add-on or a Kubernetes DaemonSet. However, option C explicitly describes installing the agent on the EC2 instances and baking it into the AMI. That host-based agent obtains credentials from the EC2 instance profile, making A—not B—the matching permission model.

Current AWS managed-add-on deployments commonly use a service-account role, but that is a different deployment model from the AMI-based installation selected here.

### D. Deploy the ADOT collector to collect performance logs

The requirement is to collect and analyze memory **metrics**. Merely deploying an AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry collector for performance logs does not, by itself, configure the required EKS Container Insights memory metrics. The CloudWatch agent solution directly provides the required memory and Container Insights collection path.

### F. Analyze `node_memory_utilization` by `ClusterName`

This is a valid Container Insights metric and dimension, but it reports memory utilization of the worker node or nodes—not the memory behavior of the application pods. Cluster-level node utilization can hide a pod or service that is approaching its memory limit while the overall nodes still have spare capacity. Therefore it is less suitable than `pod_memory_utilization` grouped by service for diagnosing the application's memory errors and inadequate application scaling.

zh.question: 一家公司最近将其应用程序迁移到使用 Amazon EC2 实例的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。该公司将应用程序配置为根据 CPU 利用率自动扩缩。应用程序在经历高负载时会产生内存错误。应用程序的横向扩展也不足以处理增加的负载。公司需要长期收集和分析应用程序的内存指标。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 将 CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy 托管 IAM 策略附加到集群使用的 IAM 实例配置文件。
options.B: 将 CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy 托管 IAM 策略附加到集群的服务账户角色。
options.C: 通过将统一 Amazon CloudWatch 代理部署到集群中现有的 EC2 实例来收集性能指标。将该代理添加到要加入集群的任何新 EC2 实例所使用的 AMI 中。
options.D: 通过将 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry 收集器部署为 DaemonSet 来收集性能日志。
options.E: 使用 Service 维度分析 ContainerInsights 命名空间中的 pod_memory_utilization Amazon CloudWatch 指标。
options.F: 使用 ClusterName 维度分析 ContainerInsights 命名空间中的 node_memory_utilization Amazon CloudWatch 指标。

zh.explanation:
## 问题考查的内容

该应用程序以 Pod 形式运行在由 EC2 支持的 Amazon EKS 集群上。仅基于 CPU 的扩缩无法反映应用程序的内存压力，因此公司需要：

1. 授予指标收集器向 CloudWatch 发布指标的权限。
2. 在当前及未来的 EC2 工作节点集群中安装收集器。
3. 分析应用程序级别的内存指标，而不只是节点级别的内存指标。

## 正确答案：A、C 和 E

### A. 将 `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` 附加到集群的 IAM 实例配置文件

这与选项 C 中描述的部署方式相匹配：CloudWatch 代理安装在 EC2 工作实例上，因此使用这些实例的 IAM 角色。AWS 文档说明，托管在 EC2 上的 CloudWatch 代理需要具有 `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` 的 EC2 IAM 角色，并且该角色必须附加到实例上（[CloudWatch 代理先决条件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/prerequisites.html)）。

### C. 将统一 CloudWatch 代理部署到现有实例，并将其包含在新实例的 AMI 中

EC2 标准指标不包括客户机操作系统的内存利用率。AWS 指出，必须安装 CloudWatch 代理才能收集操作系统指标，例如可用和已使用的内存（[使用 CloudWatch 代理收集额外指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/enable-as-instance-metrics.html)）。将其安装在现有工作节点上，并将其整合到节点 AMI 中，可确保在 EKS 工作节点集群扩展或被替换时持续进行收集。

对于 EKS Container Insights，CloudWatch 代理是收集基础设施和工作负载性能数据的组件。AWS 的托管实现通过 DaemonSet 在所有节点上运行该代理（[Enhanced Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/container-insights-eks-classic.html)）。该选项中基于 AMI 的部署是本题所表示的主机安装替代方案。

### E. 按 Kubernetes 服务分析 `pod_memory_utilization`

`pod_memory_utilization` 衡量应用程序 Pod 的内存利用率。AWS 在 `ContainerInsights` 命名空间中列出了该指标，并支持维度集 `Service`、`Namespace` 和 `ClusterName`，以及 Pod、命名空间和集群级别的维度集（[EKS Container Insights 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-metrics-EKS.html)）。按应用程序的 Kubernetes 服务对该指标进行分组，可以提供相关的应用程序级历史视图，并能暴露仅基于 CPU 的扩缩所遗漏的内存压力。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 将该策略附加到服务账户角色

当通过 CloudWatch Observability add-on 或 Kubernetes DaemonSet 将 CloudWatch 代理部署为 EKS 工作负载时，服务账户 IAM 角色是合适的。但是，选项 C 明确描述了在 EC2 实例上安装代理并将其构建到 AMI 中。该基于主机的代理从 EC2 实例配置文件获取凭证，因此匹配的权限模型是 A，而不是 B。

当前 AWS 托管附加组件的部署通常使用服务账户角色，但这与此处所选的基于 AMI 的安装是不同的部署模型。

### D. 部署 ADOT 收集器以收集性能日志

要求是收集和分析内存**指标**。仅部署 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry 收集器来收集性能日志，本身并不会配置所需的 EKS Container Insights 内存指标。CloudWatch 代理解决方案可直接提供所需的内存和 Container Insights 收集路径。

### F. 按 `ClusterName` 分析 `node_memory_utilization`

这是一个有效的 Container Insights 指标和维度，但它报告的是工作节点的内存利用率，而不是应用程序 Pod 的内存行为。集群级节点利用率可能掩盖某个接近内存限制的 Pod 或服务，而此时整体节点仍有可用容量。因此，与按服务分组的 `pod_memory_utilization` 相比，它不太适合诊断应用程序的内存错误和应用程序扩缩不足问题。

en.question: A company's video streaming platform usage has increased from 10,000 users each day to 50,000 users each day in multiple countries. The company deploys the streaming platform on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). The EKS workload scales up to thousands of nodes during peak viewing time. The company's users report occurrences of unauthorized logins. Users also report sudden interruptions and logouts from the platform. The company wants additional security measures for the entire platform. The company also needs a summarized view of the resource behaviors and interactions across the company's entire AWS environment. The summarized view must show login attempts, API calls, and network traffic. The solution must permit network traffic analysis while minimizing the overhead of managing logs. The solution must also quickly investigate any potential malicious behavior that is associated with the EKS workload. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable Amazon GuardDuty for EKS Audit Log Monitoring. Enable AWS CloudTrail logs. Store the EKS audit logs and CloudTrail log files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to create an external table. Use Amazon QuickSight to create a dashboard.
options.B: Enable Amazon GuardDuty for EKS Audit Log Monitoring. Enable Amazon Detective in the company's AWS account. Enable EKS audit logs from optional source packages in Detective.
options.C: Enable Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights. Enable AWS CloudTrail logs. Store the EKS audit logs and CloudTrail log files in an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon Athena to create an external table. Use Amazon QuickSight to create a dashboard.
options.D: Enable Amazon GuardDuty for EKS Audit Log Monitoring. Enable Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights and VPC Flow Logs. Enable AWS CloudTrail logs.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs two complementary capabilities:

1. **Threat detection for a very large Amazon EKS environment**, especially suspicious Kubernetes API activity that could explain unauthorized access or forced logouts.
2. **Fast investigation through a summarized, correlated view** of login attempts, API calls, network traffic, resource behavior, and interactions—without building and maintaining its own log-storage and query solution.

## Correct answer: B

**Enable Amazon GuardDuty for EKS Audit Log Monitoring, enable Amazon Detective, and enable the EKS audit logs optional source package in Detective.**

GuardDuty EKS Protection continuously analyzes Kubernetes audit logs for threats involving EKS control-plane activity. These audit logs include actions by users, applications that call the Kubernetes API, and the control plane. GuardDuty can therefore generate findings for suspicious activity such as potentially dangerous API calls made by an unauthenticated user. See [Detect threats with Amazon GuardDuty](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/integration-guardduty.html).

Detective is designed for the investigation requirement. It automatically derives events such as **login attempts, API calls, and network traffic** from CloudTrail and VPC flow log data, ingests GuardDuty findings, and uses these events to create a unified behavior graph of resources and their interactions. It also avoids the need to organize the data or develop and tune custom queries. See [How Amazon Detective works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/what-is-detective.html).

The Detective core package includes CloudTrail logs, VPC Flow Logs, and GuardDuty findings. Detective uses independent streams for CloudTrail and VPC flow-log events, so the company does not need to create and manage a separate S3/Athena-based logging pipeline for this analysis. Its optional EKS audit-log source package adds detailed EKS information and correlates EKS user activity with CloudTrail management events and network activity with VPC Flow Logs. See [Detective core and optional data sources](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-source-data-about.html) and [Amazon EKS audit logs in Detective](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/source-data-types-EKS.html).

This combination provides both automated EKS threat findings and rapid, low-management investigation across the wider AWS environment.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A
GuardDuty provides EKS threat detection, but the S3, Athena, and QuickSight solution is a manually constructed analytics pipeline. It does not include VPC Flow Logs, so it cannot provide the required network-traffic analysis. It also creates significant log-storage, schema, query, and dashboard maintenance overhead and does not provide Detective's automatically correlated behavior graph.

### C
CloudWatch Container Insights is primarily for collecting and summarizing container performance metrics and logs—such as CPU, memory, disk, network, and container restart information—not for identifying malicious Kubernetes API activity or correlating security behavior across AWS. See [CloudWatch Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html). This option also omits GuardDuty and VPC Flow Logs, and its Athena/QuickSight implementation requires substantial manual management.

### D
This option collects useful operational and security data, but it provides no Amazon Detective behavior graph. CloudWatch Container Insights, CloudTrail, and VPC Flow Logs do not by themselves create the required unified, summarized security view or rapidly correlate GuardDuty findings with identities, API activity, and network relationships. It also requires the company to configure and manage multiple separate logging and monitoring systems rather than using Detective's managed ingestion and investigation capabilities.

zh.question: 一家公司的视频流媒体平台在多个国家/地区的每日用户数量已从 10,000 增加到 50,000。该公司将流媒体平台部署在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 上。EKS 工作负载在观看高峰期会扩展到数千个节点。公司的用户报告了未经授权的登录事件。用户还报告平台突然中断和退出登录。该公司希望为整个平台增加额外的安全措施。该公司还需要一个汇总视图，用于查看其整个 AWS 环境中的资源行为和交互。该汇总视图必须显示登录尝试、API 调用和网络流量。该解决方案必须能够进行网络流量分析，同时尽可能减少管理日志的开销。该解决方案还必须能够快速调查与 EKS 工作负载相关的任何潜在恶意行为。哪个解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 EKS Audit Log Monitoring 启用 Amazon GuardDuty。启用 AWS CloudTrail 日志。将 EKS 审计日志和 CloudTrail 日志文件存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon Athena 创建外部表。使用 Amazon QuickSight 创建仪表板。
options.B: 为 EKS Audit Log Monitoring 启用 Amazon GuardDuty。在公司的 AWS 账户中启用 Amazon Detective。在 Detective 中从可选源数据包启用 EKS 审计日志。
options.C: 启用 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights。启用 AWS CloudTrail 日志。将 EKS 审计日志和 CloudTrail 日志文件存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中。使用 Amazon Athena 创建外部表。使用 Amazon QuickSight 创建仪表板。
options.D: 为 EKS Audit Log Monitoring 启用 Amazon GuardDuty。启用 Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights 和 VPC Flow Logs。启用 AWS CloudTrail 日志。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司需要两种互补的能力：

1. **针对大型 Amazon EKS 环境的威胁检测**，尤其是可能解释未经授权访问或被强制退出登录的可疑 Kubernetes API 活动。
2. 通过汇总且经过关联的视图进行**快速调查**，该视图涵盖登录尝试、API 调用、网络流量、资源行为和交互，同时无需构建和维护自己的日志存储及查询解决方案。

## 正确答案：B

**为 EKS Audit Log Monitoring 启用 Amazon GuardDuty，启用 Amazon Detective，并在 Detective 中启用 EKS 审计日志可选源数据包。**

GuardDuty EKS Protection 会持续分析 Kubernetes 审计日志，以检测涉及 EKS 控制平面活动的威胁。这些审计日志包括用户、调用 Kubernetes API 的应用程序以及控制平面执行的操作。因此，GuardDuty 可以针对可疑活动生成发现结果，例如未经身份验证的用户发出的潜在危险 API 调用。请参阅 [使用 Amazon GuardDuty 检测威胁](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/integration-guardduty.html)。

Detective 专为调查需求而设计。它会自动从 CloudTrail 和 VPC 流日志数据中获取**登录尝试、API 调用和网络流量**等事件，摄取 GuardDuty 发现结果，并使用这些事件创建资源及其交互的统一行为图。它还无需组织数据或开发和优化自定义查询。请参阅 [Amazon Detective 的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/what-is-detective.html)。

Detective 核心数据包包括 CloudTrail 日志、VPC Flow Logs 和 GuardDuty 发现结果。Detective 使用独立的数据流处理 CloudTrail 和 VPC 流日志事件，因此公司无需为此分析创建和管理单独的基于 S3/Athena 的日志管道。其可选 EKS 审计日志源数据包可添加详细的 EKS 信息，并将 EKS 用户活动与 CloudTrail 管理事件关联，以及将网络活动与 VPC Flow Logs 关联。请参阅 [Detective 核心和可选数据源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/detective-source-data-about.html) 和 [Detective 中的 Amazon EKS 审计日志](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/detective/latest/userguide/source-data-types-EKS.html)。

此组合既能提供自动化的 EKS 威胁发现结果，也能在更广泛的 AWS 环境中实现快速、低管理开销的调查。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A

GuardDuty 提供 EKS 威胁检测，但 S3、Athena 和 QuickSight 方案是手动构建的分析管道。该方案不包括 VPC Flow Logs，因此无法提供所需的网络流量分析。它还会造成大量的日志存储、架构、查询和仪表板维护开销，并且无法提供 Detective 自动关联的行为图。

### C

CloudWatch Container Insights 主要用于收集和汇总容器性能指标与日志，例如 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络和容器重启信息，而非用于识别恶意 Kubernetes API 活动或关联整个 AWS 中的安全行为。请参阅 [CloudWatch Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights.html)。此选项还缺少 GuardDuty 和 VPC Flow Logs，并且其 Athena/QuickSight 实施需要大量人工管理。

### D

此选项收集了有用的运营和安全数据，但没有提供 Amazon Detective 行为图。CloudWatch Container Insights、CloudTrail 和 VPC Flow Logs 本身不会创建所需的统一汇总安全视图，也无法快速将 GuardDuty 发现结果与身份、API 活动和网络关系关联。与使用 Detective 的托管摄取和调查功能相比，该选项还要求公司配置和管理多个独立的日志记录和监控系统。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage hundreds of AWS accounts. The company has a team that is responsible for AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). The IAM team wants to implement AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On). The IAM team must have only the minimum needed permissions to manage IAM Identity Center. The IAM team must not be able to gain unneeded access to the Organizations management account. The IAM team must be able to provision new IAM Identity Center permission sets and assignments for existing and new member accounts. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a new AWS account for the IAM team. In the new account, enable IAM Identity Center. In the Organizations management account, register the new account as a delegated administrator for IAM Identity Center.
options.B: Create a new AWS account for the IAM team. In the Organizations management account, enable IAM Identity Center. In the Organizations management account, register the new account as a delegated administrator for IAM Identity Center.
options.C: In IAM Identity Center, create users and a group for the IAM team. Add the users to the group. Create a new permission set. Attach the AWSSSODirectoryAdministrator managed IAM policy to the group.
options.D: In IAM Identity Center, create users and a group for the IAM team. Add the users to the group. Create a new permission set. Attach the AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator managed IAM policy to the group.
options.E: Assign the permission set to the Organizations management account. Allow the IAM team group to use the permission set.
options.F: Assign the permission set to the new AWS account. Allow the IAM team group to use the permission set.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: **B, D, and F**

### Scenario

The company needs organization-wide IAM Identity Center administration for hundreds of AWS accounts. The IAM team must be able to create permission sets and account assignments for current and future member accounts, but it should perform those duties from a dedicated member account rather than receive unnecessary access to the AWS Organizations management account.

### Why B is correct

**Enable IAM Identity Center in the Organizations management account, and register the new IAM administration account as the delegated administrator.**

An **organization instance** of IAM Identity Center is enabled in the Organizations management account. This is the instance type that supports multi-account permissions and delegated administration. The management account must then register an eligible member account as the delegated administrator; AWS requires this registration to be performed using management-account credentials.

After registration, authorized principals in the delegated-administrator account can perform most IAM Identity Center administrative tasks without routinely accessing the management account. This is precisely the purpose of delegated administration: minimizing how many people need access to the highly privileged management account.

- [IAM Identity Center instance types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-instances.html)
- [Register a member account as delegated administrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin-how-to-register.html)
- [Delegated administration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)

### Why D is correct

**Create the IAM team’s users and group, and create a permission set that includes the `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` AWS managed policy.**

`AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` provides the administrative permissions needed in a multi-account environment, including managing IAM Identity Center permission sets and account assignments for organization member accounts. Those capabilities match the team’s required job function.

The permission set containing this policy can then be assigned to the IAM team’s group in the dedicated delegated-administrator account.

- [AWS managed policies for IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)

### Why F is correct

**Assign the administrative permission set to the new delegated-administrator account and allow the IAM team group to use it.**

This gives the IAM team an administrative role in its dedicated member account—the account from which delegated IAM Identity Center administration is performed. It supplies the required permissions while avoiding an assignment that would let the team sign in to the Organizations management account.

AWS also reserves certain operations involving the management account for administrators operating directly from that account. This separation protects the management account while allowing delegated administrators to manage permission sets and assignments for member accounts.

- [Delegated administration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)
- [Register a member account as delegated administrator](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin-how-to-register.html)

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A — Enable IAM Identity Center in the new member account

A member account can technically enable an **account instance** of IAM Identity Center. However, an account instance does not provide the organization-wide, multi-account permissions required here and cannot be managed through the delegated-administrator model. It therefore cannot provision IAM Identity Center permission sets and account assignments across existing and new organization member accounts.

The company instead needs an organization instance enabled in the Organizations management account, followed by delegation to the new member account as described in B.

- [IAM Identity Center instance types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-instances.html)
- [Considerations for account instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/account-instances-identity-center.html)

### C — Use `AWSSSODirectoryAdministrator`

`AWSSSODirectoryAdministrator` is intended for administering IAM Identity Center directory users and groups. It does not provide the required permission-set and AWS-account-assignment administration capabilities. The question requires the team to provision permission sets and assignments across member accounts, which is the role addressed by `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator`.

- [AWS managed policies for IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)

### E — Assign the permission set to the management account

Assigning the permission set to the Organizations management account would give the IAM team a route to access that highly privileged account, directly conflicting with the requirement to prevent unneeded management-account access.

Delegated administration exists to move routine IAM Identity Center administration to a member account and minimize the number of people who need management-account access. Therefore, the administrative permission set must be assigned to the new delegated-administrator account, as stated in F.

- [Delegated administration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)

Therefore, the required combination is **B, D, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理数百个 AWS 账户。该公司有一个负责 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 的团队。IAM 团队希望实施 AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On)。IAM 团队必须仅拥有管理 IAM Identity Center 所需的最低权限。IAM 团队不得能够获得对 Organizations 管理账户的不必要访问权限。IAM 团队必须能够为现有和新的成员账户预置新的 IAM Identity Center 权限集和分配。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为 IAM 团队创建一个新的 AWS 账户。在新账户中启用 IAM Identity Center。在 Organizations 管理账户中，将该新账户注册为 IAM Identity Center 的委派管理员。
options.B: 为 IAM 团队创建一个新的 AWS 账户。在 Organizations 管理账户中启用 IAM Identity Center。在 Organizations 管理账户中，将该新账户注册为 IAM Identity Center 的委派管理员。
options.C: 在 IAM Identity Center 中，为 IAM 团队创建用户和一个组。将用户添加到该组。创建一个新的权限集。将 AWSSSODirectoryAdministrator 托管 IAM 策略附加到该组。
options.D: 在 IAM Identity Center 中，为 IAM 团队创建用户和一个组。将用户添加到该组。创建一个新的权限集。将 AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator 托管 IAM 策略附加到该组。
options.E: 将该权限集分配给 Organizations 管理账户。允许 IAM 团队组使用该权限集。
options.F: 将该权限集分配给新的 AWS 账户。允许 IAM 团队组使用该权限集。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：**B、D 和 F**

### 场景

公司需要对数百个 AWS 账户进行全组织范围的 IAM Identity Center 管理。IAM 团队必须能够为当前和未来的成员账户创建权限集和账户分配，但应从专用成员账户执行这些职责，而不是获得对 AWS Organizations 管理账户的不必要访问权限。

### B 为什么正确

**在 Organizations 管理账户中启用 IAM Identity Center，并将新的 IAM 管理账户注册为委派管理员。**

IAM Identity Center 的**组织实例**在 Organizations 管理账户中启用。这种实例类型支持多账户权限和委派管理。管理账户随后必须将符合条件的成员账户注册为委派管理员；AWS 要求使用管理账户凭证执行此注册。

注册后，委派管理员账户中经授权的主体可以执行大多数 IAM Identity Center 管理任务，而无需日常访问管理账户。这正是委派管理的目的：最大限度减少需要访问高权限管理账户的人员数量。

- [IAM Identity Center 实例类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-instances.html)
- [将成员账户注册为委派管理员](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin-how-to-register.html)
- [委派管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)

### D 为什么正确

**创建 IAM 团队的用户和组，并创建一个包含 `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` AWS 托管策略的权限集。**

`AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` 提供多账户环境中所需的管理权限，包括管理 IAM Identity Center 权限集以及组织成员账户的账户分配。这些功能与团队所需的职责相匹配。

然后，可以将包含该策略的权限集分配给专用委派管理员账户中的 IAM 团队组。

- [IAM Identity Center 的 AWS 托管策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)

### F 为什么正确

**将管理权限集分配给新的委派管理员账户，并允许 IAM 团队组使用它。**

这会为 IAM 团队在其专用成员账户中授予一个管理角色——该账户正是执行委派 IAM Identity Center 管理的账户。它提供所需权限，同时避免授予团队登录 Organizations 管理账户的分配。

AWS 还会保留涉及管理账户的某些操作，要求管理员直接从该账户执行。这种隔离在允许委派管理员管理成员账户的权限集和分配的同时，保护了管理账户。

- [委派管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)
- [将成员账户注册为委派管理员](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin-how-to-register.html)

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A — 在新的成员账户中启用 IAM Identity Center

成员账户在技术上可以启用 IAM Identity Center 的**账户实例**。但是，账户实例无法提供此处所需的全组织、跨账户权限，也无法通过委派管理员模型进行管理。因此，它无法在现有和新的组织成员账户之间预置 IAM Identity Center 权限集和账户分配。

公司需要的是在 Organizations 管理账户中启用组织实例，然后按照 B 所述将管理委派给新的成员账户。

- [IAM Identity Center 实例类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/identity-center-instances.html)
- [账户实例注意事项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/account-instances-identity-center.html)

### C — 使用 `AWSSSODirectoryAdministrator`

`AWSSSODirectoryAdministrator` 用于管理 IAM Identity Center 目录用户和组。它不提供所需的权限集和 AWS 账户分配管理功能。题目要求团队跨成员账户预置权限集和分配，而这是 `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` 所涵盖的职责。

- [IAM Identity Center 的 AWS 托管策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)

### E — 将权限集分配给管理账户

将权限集分配给 Organizations 管理账户会为 IAM 团队提供访问该高权限账户的途径，直接违背了防止不必要管理账户访问的要求。

委派管理的存在是为了将日常 IAM Identity Center 管理移至成员账户，并尽量减少需要管理账户访问权限的人员数量。因此，必须将管理权限集分配给新的委派管理员账户，如 F 所述。

- [委派管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)

因此，所需的组合是 **B、D 和 F**。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations that has all features enabled. The company uses AWS Backup in a primary account and uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key to encrypt the backups. The company needs to automate a cross-account backup of the resources that AWS Backup backs up in the primary account. The company configures cross-account backup in the Organizations management account. The company creates a new AWS account in the organization and configures an AWS Backup backup vault in the new account. The company creates a KMS key in the new account to encrypt the backups. Finally, the company configures a new backup plan in the primary account. The destination for the new backup plan is the backup vault in the new account. When the AWS Backup job in the primary account is invoked, the job creates backups in the primary account. However, the backups are not copied to the new account's backup vault. Which combination of steps must the company take so that backups can be copied to the new account's backup vault? (Choose two.)

options.A: Edit the backup vault access policy in the new account to allow access to the primary account.
options.B: Edit the backup vault access policy in the primary account to allow access to the new account.
options.C: Edit the backup vault access policy in the primary account to allow access to the KMS key in the new account.
options.D: Edit the key policy of the KMS key in the primary account to share the key with the new account.
options.E: Edit the key policy of the KMS key in the new account to share the key with the primary account.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The source backups are created successfully, so the problem is specifically with the **cross-account copy** into the new account. A successful copy requires both:

1. Permission to write into the **destination backup vault**.
2. Access to the **source customer managed KMS key** so AWS Backup can read/decrypt the encrypted source recovery point during the copy.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. Edit the backup vault access policy in the new account to allow access to the primary account

The new account is the **destination account**, so its backup vault must have a resource-based policy that allows the source/primary account to perform `backup:CopyIntoBackupVault`. AWS explicitly states that the absence of this permission on the destination vault denies cross-account copy attempts. See [Setting up cross-account backup and configuring destination vault access](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html).

### D. Edit the key policy of the KMS key in the primary account to share the key with the new account

The existing backups in the primary account are encrypted with the primary account's customer managed KMS key. The destination account must be permitted to use that source key as part of reading/decrypting the encrypted source recovery point during the copy. AWS's cross-account backup setup guidance explicitly says that, when source resources or snapshots are encrypted, the KMS key used for encryption in the **source account** must be shared with the destination account. See [Setting up cross-account backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/managedservices/latest/appguide/qs-backup-cross-account-snapshot.html).

The copy stored in the destination vault is then encrypted using the destination vault's KMS key. AWS documents that cross-account copies are encrypted with the key of the target vault, while access to source encryption remains necessary to process encrypted source data. See [Encryption for copies to another account or Region](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/encryption.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. Edit the backup vault access policy in the primary account to allow access to the new account.**  
  This is the wrong vault and direction. The copy is being written **into the new account's vault**, so the resource-based `backup:CopyIntoBackupVault` permission belongs on the destination vault, not the source vault.

- **C. Edit the backup vault access policy in the primary account to allow access to the KMS key in the new account.**  
  A backup vault access policy controls AWS Backup actions on that vault; it does not grant access to a KMS key. KMS access is controlled through KMS key policies, grants, and corresponding IAM permissions. It is also the wrong vault because cross-account write access must be configured on the destination vault.

- **E. Edit the key policy of the KMS key in the new account to share the key with the primary account.**  
  The destination key is associated with the destination vault and encrypts the resulting copy. The missing cross-account key-sharing requirement described here is in the opposite direction: the **source key in the primary account** must permit the destination account to process the encrypted source backup. Therefore, D—not E—addresses the source encryption dependency.

zh.question: 某公司在 AWS Organizations 中使用一个已启用所有功能的组织。该公司在主账户中使用 AWS Backup，并使用 AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) 密钥对备份进行加密。该公司需要自动对 AWS Backup 在主账户中备份的资源执行跨账户备份。该公司在 Organizations 管理账户中配置跨账户备份。该公司在组织中创建了一个新的 AWS 账户，并在新账户中配置了一个 AWS Backup 备份保管库。该公司在新账户中创建一个 KMS 密钥来加密备份。最后，该公司在主账户中配置了一个新的备份计划。新备份计划的目标位置是新账户中的备份保管库。当调用主账户中的 AWS Backup 作业时，该作业会在主账户中创建备份。但是，备份不会复制到新账户的备份保管库。公司必须采取哪种步骤组合，以便将备份复制到新账户的备份保管库？（选择两项。）

options.A: 编辑新账户中的备份保管库访问策略，以允许主账户访问。
options.B: 编辑主账户中的备份保管库访问策略，以允许新账户访问。
options.C: 编辑主账户中的备份保管库访问策略，以允许访问新账户中的 KMS 密钥。
options.D: 编辑主账户中 KMS 密钥的密钥策略，以便与新账户共享该密钥。
options.E: 编辑新账户中 KMS 密钥的密钥策略，以便与主账户共享该密钥。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

源备份已成功创建，因此问题具体出在向新账户进行的**跨账户复制**。成功复制需要同时具备以下条件：

1. 具有写入**目标备份保管库**的权限。
2. 能够访问**源客户托管 KMS 密钥**，以便 AWS Backup 在复制期间读取/解密加密的源恢复点。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 编辑新账户中的备份保管库访问策略，以允许主账户访问

新账户是**目标账户**，因此其备份保管库必须具有基于资源的策略，以允许源/主账户执行 `backup:CopyIntoBackupVault`。AWS 明确指出，目标保管库缺少此权限会拒绝跨账户复制尝试。请参阅 [设置跨账户备份和配置目标保管库访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/create-cross-account-backup.html)。

### D. 编辑主账户中 KMS 密钥的密钥策略，以便与新账户共享该密钥

主账户中的现有备份使用主账户的客户托管 KMS 密钥加密。在复制期间读取/解密加密的源恢复点时，必须允许目标账户使用该源密钥。AWS 的跨账户备份设置指南明确指出，当源资源或快照已加密时，必须与目标账户共享用于加密**源账户**资源的 KMS 密钥。请参阅 [设置跨账户备份](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/managedservices/latest/appguide/qs-backup-cross-account-snapshot.html)。

存储在目标保管库中的副本随后会使用目标保管库的 KMS 密钥进行加密。AWS 文档说明，跨账户副本使用目标保管库的密钥加密，但处理加密的源数据仍需要访问源加密密钥。请参阅 [复制到其他账户或区域时的加密](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/encryption.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. 编辑主账户中的备份保管库访问策略，以允许新账户访问。**  
  这是错误的保管库和方向。副本被写入**新账户的保管库**，因此基于资源的 `backup:CopyIntoBackupVault` 权限应配置在目标保管库上，而不是源保管库上。

- **C. 编辑主账户中的备份保管库访问策略，以允许访问新账户中的 KMS 密钥。**  
  备份保管库访问策略控制在该保管库上执行的 AWS Backup 操作；它不授予对 KMS 密钥的访问权限。KMS 访问由 KMS 密钥策略、授权和相应的 IAM 权限控制。此外，这也是错误的保管库，因为必须在目标保管库上配置跨账户写入访问权限。

- **E. 编辑新账户中 KMS 密钥的密钥策略，以便与主账户共享该密钥。**  
  目标密钥与目标保管库关联，并对生成的副本进行加密。此处所述缺失的跨账户密钥共享要求方向相反：**主账户中的源密钥**必须允许目标账户处理加密的源备份。因此，应选择 D，而不是 E，因为 D 能解决源加密依赖关系。

en.question: A company runs an application that uses an Amazon S3 bucket to store images. A DevOps engineer needs to implement a multi- Region strategy for the objects that are stored in the S3 bucket. The company needs to be able to fail over to an S3 bucket in another AWS Region. When an image is added to either S3 bucket, the image must be replicated to the other S3 bucket within 15 minutes. The DevOps engineer enables two-way replication between the S3 buckets. Which combination of steps should the DevOps engineer take next to meet the requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Enable S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC) on each replication rule.
options.B: Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point in an active-passive configuration.
options.C: Call the SubmitMultiRegionAccessPointRoutes operation in the AWS API when the company needs to fail over to the S3 bucket in the other Region.
options.D: Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on both S3 buckets.
options.E: Configure a routing control in Amazon Route 53 Recovery Controller. Add the S3 buckets in an active-passive configuration.
options.F: Call the UpdateRoutingControlStates operation in the AWS API when the company needs to fail over to the S3 bucket in the other Region.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs two related capabilities:

1. **Predictable bidirectional replication** so that new images written to either Regional bucket are replicated to the other bucket within the S3 15-minute replication objective.
2. **Controlled Regional failover** so that application traffic can be shifted from the primary S3 bucket to the secondary bucket.

Because two-way replication is already configured, the remaining steps are to enable the replication-time feature and configure S3-native failover routing.

## Correct answers: A, B, and C

### A. Enable S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC) on each replication rule

S3 RTC is the S3 replication feature intended for workloads that have a 15-minute replication requirement. AWS states that S3 RTC replicates most objects in seconds and 99.9% within 15 minutes, and it provides metrics and events for objects that miss the threshold. Because replication is two-way, RTC must be enabled on **both directional replication rules**. See [Meeting compliance requirements with S3 Replication Time Control](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-time-control.html).

### B. Create an S3 Multi-Region Access Point in an active-passive configuration

An S3 Multi-Region Access Point provides the global S3 endpoint and S3-native routing controls required to shift requests between the Regional buckets. In an **active-passive** configuration, the active Region receives traffic and the passive Region does not, which is the appropriate configuration for controlled disaster-recovery failover. See [Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points routing states](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/FailoverConfiguration.html).

### C. Call `SubmitMultiRegionAccessPointRoutes` when failover is required

This is the S3 Control API operation used to update a Multi-Region Access Point's route configuration. The active bucket is assigned `TrafficDialPercentage=100`, and the passive bucket is assigned `TrafficDialPercentage=0`. During failover, these routing states are reversed to direct new requests to the secondary Region. See [Update a Multi-Region Access Point route configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MrapOperations.html) and [Using S3 Multi-Region Access Point failover controls](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingFailover.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### D. Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on both S3 buckets

S3 Transfer Acceleration speeds long-distance transfers **between clients and an S3 bucket** by using AWS edge locations. It does not provide a 15-minute cross-Region replication objective and does not implement Regional failover between buckets. See [Configuring fast, secure file transfers using Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html).

### E. Configure a routing control in Amazon Route 53 Recovery Controller

Route 53 Application Recovery Controller routing controls are a separate application traffic-recovery mechanism. They are unnecessary here because S3 Multi-Region Access Points have native active-passive routing and failover controls specifically for buckets. The required architecture is configured directly on the Multi-Region Access Point, not by adding the S3 buckets to an ARC routing control.

### F. Call `UpdateRoutingControlStates` when failover is required

`UpdateRoutingControlStates` changes the state of **ARC routing controls**. It does not update an S3 Multi-Region Access Point route configuration. For this S3 architecture, the correct operation is `SubmitMultiRegionAccessPointRoutes`. AWS documents ARC routing-control state updates separately in [Getting and updating routing control states using the ARC API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/routing-control.update.api.html).

Therefore, the required combination is **A, B, and C**.

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序使用 Amazon S3 存储桶来存储图像。一名 DevOps 工程师需要为存储在 S3 存储桶中的对象实施多 Region 策略。公司需要能够故障转移到另一个 AWS Region 中的 S3 存储桶。当图像被添加到任一 S3 存储桶时，该图像必须在 15 分钟内复制到另一个 S3 存储桶。DevOps 工程师在 S3 存储桶之间启用了双向复制。为了满足这些要求，DevOps 工程师接下来应采取哪种步骤组合？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在每个复制规则上启用 S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC)。
options.B: 创建一个采用主动-被动配置的 S3 Multi-Region Access Point。
options.C: 当公司需要故障转移到另一个 Region 中的 S3 存储桶时，在 AWS API 中调用 SubmitMultiRegionAccessPointRoutes 操作。
options.D: 在两个 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration。
options.E: 在 Amazon Route 53 Recovery Controller 中配置路由控制。以主动-被动配置添加 S3 存储桶。
options.F: 当公司需要故障转移到另一个 Region 中的 S3 存储桶时，在 AWS API 中调用 UpdateRoutingControlStates 操作。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

公司需要两项相关能力：

1. **可预测的双向复制**，以便写入任一 Region 存储桶的新图像都会在 S3 的 15 分钟复制目标内复制到另一个存储桶。
2. **受控的 Region 故障转移**，以便将应用程序流量从主 S3 存储桶切换到辅助存储桶。

由于双向复制已配置完成，剩余步骤是启用复制时间功能并配置 S3 原生的故障转移路由。

## 正确答案：A、B 和 C

### A. 在每个复制规则上启用 S3 Replication Time Control (S3 RTC)

S3 RTC 是适用于具有 15 分钟复制要求的工作负载的 S3 复制功能。AWS 表示，S3 RTC 会在数秒内复制大多数对象，并在 15 分钟内复制 99.9% 的对象；它还会为未达到阈值的对象提供指标和事件。由于复制是双向的，因此必须在**两个方向的复制规则**上启用 RTC。请参阅 [使用 S3 Replication Time Control 满足合规性要求](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/replication-time-control.html)。

### B. 创建一个采用主动-被动配置的 S3 Multi-Region Access Point

S3 Multi-Region Access Point 提供全局 S3 端点以及在各 Region 存储桶之间转移请求所需的 S3 原生路由控制。在**主动-被动**配置中，主动 Region 接收流量，而被动 Region 不接收流量，这适合受控的灾难恢复故障转移。请参阅 [Amazon S3 Multi-Region Access Points 路由状态](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/FailoverConfiguration.html)。

### C. 在需要故障转移时调用 `SubmitMultiRegionAccessPointRoutes`

这是用于更新 Multi-Region Access Point 路由配置的 S3 Control API 操作。为主动存储桶分配 `TrafficDialPercentage=100`，并为被动存储桶分配 `TrafficDialPercentage=0`。在故障转移期间，反转这些路由状态以将新请求定向到辅助 Region。请参阅 [更新 Multi-Region Access Point 路由配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/MrapOperations.html) 和 [使用 S3 Multi-Region Access Point 故障转移控制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/UsingFailover.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### D. 在两个 S3 存储桶上启用 S3 Transfer Acceleration

S3 Transfer Acceleration 通过使用 AWS 边缘站点来加快**客户端与 S3 存储桶之间**的长距离传输。它无法提供 15 分钟的跨 Region 复制目标，也不会在存储桶之间实施 Region 故障转移。请参阅 [使用 Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration 配置快速、安全的文件传输](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/transfer-acceleration.html)。

### E. 在 Amazon Route 53 Recovery Controller 中配置路由控制

Route 53 Application Recovery Controller 路由控制是一种独立的应用程序流量恢复机制。此处不需要它，因为 S3 Multi-Region Access Points 具有专门面向存储桶的原生主动-被动路由和故障转移控制。所需架构直接在 Multi-Region Access Point 上配置，而不是通过将 S3 存储桶添加到 ARC 路由控制中来配置。

### F. 在需要故障转移时调用 `UpdateRoutingControlStates`

`UpdateRoutingControlStates` 会更改 **ARC 路由控制**的状态。它不会更新 S3 Multi-Region Access Point 路由配置。对于此 S3 架构，正确的操作是 `SubmitMultiRegionAccessPointRoutes`。AWS 在 [使用 ARC API 获取和更新路由控制状态](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/routing-control.update.api.html) 中单独记录了 ARC 路由控制状态更新。

因此，所需的组合是 **A、B 和 C**。

en.question: A company uses the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) to define its application. The company uses a pipeline that consists of AWS CodePipeline and AWS CodeBuild to deploy the CDK application. The company wants to introduce unit tests to the pipeline to test various infrastructure components. The company wants to ensure that a deployment proceeds if no unit tests result in a failure. Which combination of steps will enforce the testing requirement in the pipeline? (Choose two.)

options.A: Update the CodeBuild build phase commands to run the tests then to deploy the application. Set the OnFailure phase property to ABORT.
options.B: Update the CodeBuild build phase commands to run the tests then to deploy the application. Add the --rollback true flag to the cdk deploy command.
options.C: Update the CodeBuild build phase commands to run the tests then to deploy the application. Add the --require-approval any-change flag to the cdk deploy command.
options.D: Create a test that uses the AWS CDK assertions module. Use the template.hasResourceProperties assertion to test that resources have the expected properties.
options.E: Create a test that uses the cdk diff command. Configure the test to fail if any resources have changed.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement has two parts:

1. Define meaningful **unit tests for the CDK infrastructure**.
2. Make those tests a **deployment gate**, so deployment runs only when every test succeeds.

## Correct answers: A and D

### A. Run tests before deployment and set the CodeBuild phase failure behavior to `ABORT`

CodeBuild runs commands in a phase sequentially. AWS documents that if a command in the `commands` block fails, the remaining commands are skipped. The phase-level `on-failure: ABORT` setting aborts the build when the phase fails. Therefore, placing the test command before `cdk deploy` ensures that a nonzero test result stops the build before deployment begins. If all tests pass, CodeBuild proceeds to the deployment command. See the [CodeBuild buildspec reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).

A representative pattern is:

```yaml
phases:
  build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - npm test
      - npx cdk deploy --require-approval never
```

The option uses the conceptual property name `OnFailure`; in a YAML buildspec, the documented syntax is `on-failure`.

### D. Use the CDK assertions module and `template.hasResourceProperties`

CDK fine-grained assertion tests operate against the synthesized CloudFormation template. The `Template.hasResourceProperties` assertion verifies that a resource of a specified type has the expected property values. This is precisely the type of unit test needed to validate CDK-defined infrastructure before deployment. AWS provides this pattern in [Testing AWS CDK applications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/testing.html).

Together, **D creates the infrastructure tests**, and **A executes those tests as a mandatory gate before deployment**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Add `--rollback true` to `cdk deploy`

Rollback controls what happens **after a deployment has begun and a resource fails to be created or updated**. It rolls the deployment back to the latest stable state. It neither runs unit tests nor prevents deployment because of failed tests. Rollback is also already the default behavior for `cdk deploy`. See the [`cdk deploy` options reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/ref-cli-cmd-deploy.html).

### C. Add `--require-approval any-change`

`--require-approval any-change` requires **manual approval for any stack change**. It does not evaluate unit-test results or automatically allow deployment only when tests pass. It would also introduce an interactive/manual gate, which is different from the requested test-based gate. See the [`--require-approval` option](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/ref-cli-cmd-deploy.html).

### E. Fail if `cdk diff` detects any resource change

`cdk diff` compares the current CDK application with the deployed stack or a saved CloudFormation template and displays the changes. It is a change-inspection tool, not a unit assertion that verifies expected resource properties. Configuring the pipeline to fail whenever any resource changes would reject legitimate infrastructure updates—the very changes the pipeline is intended to deploy. See [Compare stacks with `cdk diff`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/cli.html).

**Answer: A and D**

zh.question: 某公司使用 AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) 定义其应用程序。该公司使用由 AWS CodePipeline 和 AWS CodeBuild 组成的管道来部署 CDK 应用程序。该公司希望在管道中引入单元测试，以测试各种基础设施组件。该公司希望确保仅当所有单元测试均未失败时才继续部署。哪些步骤组合可以在管道中强制执行该测试要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 更新 CodeBuild 构建阶段命令，以先运行测试再部署应用程序。将 OnFailure 阶段属性设置为 ABORT。
options.B: 更新 CodeBuild 构建阶段命令，以先运行测试再部署应用程序。向 cdk deploy 命令添加 --rollback true 标志。
options.C: 更新 CodeBuild 构建阶段命令，以先运行测试再部署应用程序。向 cdk deploy 命令添加 --require-approval any-change 标志。
options.D: 创建一个使用 AWS CDK assertions 模块的测试。使用 template.hasResourceProperties 断言来测试资源是否具有预期属性。
options.E: 创建一个使用 cdk diff 命令的测试。将测试配置为在任何资源发生更改时失败。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该要求包含两个部分：

1. 为 **CDK 基础设施定义有意义的单元测试**。
2. 使这些测试成为 **部署门控条件**，从而仅当每项测试均成功时才执行部署。

## 正确答案：A 和 D

### A. 在部署前运行测试，并将 CodeBuild 阶段失败行为设置为 `ABORT`

CodeBuild 会按顺序运行一个阶段中的命令。AWS 文档说明，如果 `commands` 块中的某个命令失败，其余命令将被跳过。阶段级别的 `on-failure: ABORT` 设置会在该阶段失败时中止构建。因此，将测试命令置于 `cdk deploy` 之前，可确保非零测试结果会在部署开始前停止构建。如果所有测试都通过，CodeBuild 将继续执行部署命令。请参阅 [CodeBuild buildspec 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。

一种典型模式如下：

```yaml
phases:
  build:
    on-failure: ABORT
    commands:
      - npm test
      - npx cdk deploy --require-approval never
```

该选项使用概念性属性名称 `OnFailure`；在 YAML buildspec 中，文档规定的语法是 `on-failure`。

### D. 使用 CDK assertions 模块和 `template.hasResourceProperties`
