CDK 细粒度断言测试针对合成后的 CloudFormation 模板运行。`Template.hasResourceProperties` 断言会验证指定类型的资源是否具有预期的属性值。这正是部署前验证由 CDK 定义的基础设施所需的单元测试类型。AWS 在 [测试 AWS CDK 应用程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/testing.html) 中提供了此模式。

结合使用时，**D 创建基础设施测试**，而 **A 在部署前将这些测试作为强制门控条件执行**。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 向 `cdk deploy` 添加 `--rollback true`

回滚控制的是 **部署已经开始后，资源创建或更新失败时** 的处理方式。它会将部署回滚到最近的稳定状态。它既不会运行单元测试，也不会因测试失败而阻止部署。回滚也是 `cdk deploy` 的默认行为。请参阅 [`cdk deploy` 选项参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/ref-cli-cmd-deploy.html)。

### C. 添加 `--require-approval any-change`

`--require-approval any-change` 要求对 **任何堆栈更改进行手动审批**。它不会评估单元测试结果，也不会仅在测试通过时自动允许部署。此外，它会引入交互式/手动门控，这与所要求的基于测试的门控不同。请参阅 [`--require-approval` 选项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/ref-cli-cmd-deploy.html)。

### E. 如果 `cdk diff` 检测到任何资源更改则失败

`cdk diff` 会将当前 CDK 应用程序与已部署的堆栈或已保存的 CloudFormation 模板进行比较，并显示差异。它是变更检查工具，而不是验证预期资源属性的单元断言。将管道配置为只要任何资源发生更改就失败，会拒绝合法的基础设施更新——而这些更新正是该管道要部署的内容。请参阅 [使用 `cdk diff` 比较堆栈](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/cli.html)。

**答案：A 和 D**

en.question: A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The EC2 instances are in multiple Availability Zones. The application was misconfigured in a single Availability Zone, which caused a partial outage of the application. A DevOps engineer made changes to ensure that the unhealthy EC2 instances in one Availability Zone do not affect the healthy EC2 instances in the other Availability Zones. The DevOps engineer needs to test the application's failover and shift where the ALB sends traffic. During failover, the ALB must avoid sending traffic to the Availability Zone where the failure has occurred. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Turn off cross-zone load balancing on the ALB. Use Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller to start a zonal shift away from the Availability Zone.
options.B: Turn off cross-zone load balancing on the ALB’s target group. Use Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller to start a zonal shift away from the Availability Zone.
options.C: Create an Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller resource set that uses the DNS hostname of the ALB. Start a zonal shift for the resource set away from the Availability Zone.
options.D: Create an Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller resource set that uses the ARN of the ALB’s target group. Create a readiness check that uses the ElbV2TargetGroupsCanServeTraffic rule.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: B

The application needs both **Availability Zone isolation** and a way to **test failover by moving ALB traffic away from one Availability Zone**. The appropriate solution is to disable cross-zone load balancing for the ALB’s **target group**, then use **Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift**.

### Why B is correct

For an Application Load Balancer, cross-zone load balancing is enabled at the **load balancer level** and cannot be disabled there. However, the target group can override the load balancer’s setting by configuring the `load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled` target group attribute to `false`.

With cross-zone load balancing disabled for the target group, each ALB node distributes requests only to registered targets in its own Availability Zone. This establishes zonal fault isolation so that load balancer nodes in healthy zones do not send requests to instances in an unhealthy zone. AWS specifically identifies limiting the effects of a zonal failure as a use case for this target group setting. See [Edit target group attributes for an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html).

The engineer can then use an **ARC zonal shift** to test failover. A zonal shift directs traffic away from the selected Availability Zone for the ALB. Application Load Balancers support zonal shift with either cross-zone load balancing enabled or disabled, provided zonal shift integration is enabled for the ALB. See [Zonal shift for Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.resource-types.app-load-balancers.html) and [Starting a zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.start-cancel.html).

Therefore, **B** combines the valid ALB target-group configuration for zonal isolation with the correct ARC capability for deliberately shifting traffic away from the failed Availability Zone.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Turn off cross-zone load balancing on the ALB

This specifies the wrong configuration scope. For an **Application Load Balancer**, cross-zone load balancing cannot be disabled at the load balancer level. It must be explicitly disabled by overriding the setting on the ALB’s **target group**. Although using ARC zonal shift is appropriate, the first action in this option is not a supported ALB configuration. See [ALB target group attributes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html).

### C. Create an ARC resource set using the ALB DNS hostname

ARC resource sets are part of the **readiness check** capability. Resources are added to these sets by using resource identifiers such as **ARNs**, not an ALB DNS hostname. More importantly, a zonal shift is started for a supported managed resource such as the ALB itself; it is not started for a readiness-check resource set. See [Creating ARC resource sets and readiness checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.create-readiness-check-or-set.html) and [Starting a zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.start-cancel.html).

### D. Create a readiness check for the target group

A readiness check evaluates whether resources and configurations are prepared for recovery. It does **not** change routing or shift active ALB traffic away from an Availability Zone. Therefore, it cannot perform the required failover test. See [What is readiness check in ARC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/readiness-what-is.html).

In addition, the `ElbV2TargetGroupsCanServeTraffic` readiness rule evaluates whether a load balancer’s target groups can serve traffic; it does not initiate a zonal shift. The documented ELBv2 readiness resource is the load balancer, rather than using a target group ARN as proposed in this option. See [ARC readiness rules for Application and Network Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.rules-resources.html).

zh.question: 一家公司有一个应用程序，该应用程序运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面的 Amazon EC2 实例上。EC2 实例位于多个 Availability Zone 中。该应用程序在某个 Availability Zone 中配置错误，导致应用程序部分中断。一名 DevOps 工程师进行了更改，以确保一个 Availability Zone 中不健康的 EC2 实例不会影响其他 Availability Zone 中健康的 EC2 实例。该 DevOps 工程师需要测试应用程序的故障转移以及 ALB 将流量发送到何处的切换。在故障转移期间，ALB 必须避免将流量发送到发生故障的 Availability Zone。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 关闭 ALB 上的 cross-zone load balancing。使用 Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller 启动 zonal shift，使流量避开该 Availability Zone。
options.B: 关闭 ALB 的 target group 上的 cross-zone load balancing。使用 Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller 启动 zonal shift，使流量避开该 Availability Zone。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller resource set，并使用 ALB 的 DNS hostname。针对该 resource set 启动 zonal shift，使流量避开该 Availability Zone。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller resource set，并使用 ALB target group 的 ARN。创建一个使用 ElbV2TargetGroupsCanServeTraffic 规则的 readiness check。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：B

该应用程序既需要 **Availability Zone 隔离**，也需要一种通过将 ALB 流量从某个 Availability Zone 移开来**测试故障转移**的方法。合适的解决方案是为 ALB 的 **target group** 禁用 cross-zone load balancing，然后使用 **Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift**。

### 为什么 B 正确

对于 Application Load Balancer，cross-zone load balancing 在 **load balancer 层级**启用，并且无法在该层级禁用。但是，target group 可以通过将 `load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled` target group attribute 配置为 `false`，来覆盖 load balancer 的设置。

在 target group 上禁用 cross-zone load balancing 后，每个 ALB 节点仅向其自身 Availability Zone 中已注册的 targets 分配请求。这会建立区域故障隔离，因此健康区域中的 load balancer 节点不会将请求发送到不健康区域中的实例。AWS 明确指出，限制区域故障的影响是此 target group 设置的一个使用场景。请参阅 [Edit target group attributes for an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)。

然后，工程师可以使用 **ARC zonal shift** 测试故障转移。zonal shift 会使 ALB 的流量避开所选的 Availability Zone。Application Load Balancers 支持在启用或禁用 cross-zone load balancing 的情况下使用 zonal shift，前提是已为 ALB 启用 zonal shift integration。请参阅 [Zonal shift for Application Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.resource-types.app-load-balancers.html) 和 [Starting a zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.start-cancel.html)。

因此，**B** 将有效的 ALB target-group 区域隔离配置与正确的 ARC 功能相结合，以主动将流量从发生故障的 Availability Zone 移开。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 在 ALB 上关闭 cross-zone load balancing

此选项指定了错误的配置范围。对于 **Application Load Balancer**，无法在 load balancer 层级禁用 cross-zone load balancing。必须通过覆盖 ALB **target group** 上的设置来显式禁用它。虽然使用 ARC zonal shift 是合适的，但此选项中的第一个操作不是受支持的 ALB 配置。请参阅 [ALB target group attributes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)。

### C. 使用 ALB DNS hostname 创建 ARC resource set

ARC resource sets 是 **readiness check** 功能的一部分。资源通过资源标识符（例如 **ARNs**）添加到这些 sets 中，而不是使用 ALB DNS hostname。更重要的是，zonal shift 是针对受支持的托管资源（例如 ALB 本身）启动的；不是针对 readiness-check resource set 启动。请参阅 [Creating ARC resource sets and readiness checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.create-readiness-check-or-set.html) 和 [Starting a zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.start-cancel.html)。

### D. 为 target group 创建 readiness check

readiness check 会评估资源和配置是否已为恢复做好准备。它**不会**更改路由，也不会将活跃的 ALB 流量从某个 Availability Zone 移开。因此，它无法执行所需的故障转移测试。请参阅 [What is readiness check in ARC?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/readiness-what-is.html)。

此外，`ElbV2TargetGroupsCanServeTraffic` readiness rule 会评估 load balancer 的 target groups 是否能够提供流量服务；它不会启动 zonal shift。文档中 ELBv2 readiness resource 是 load balancer，而不是此选项所建议的 target group ARN。请参阅 [ARC readiness rules for Application and Network Load Balancers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/recovery-readiness.rules-resources.html)。

en.question: A company sends its AWS Network Firewall flow logs to an Amazon S3 bucket. The company then analyzes the flow logs by using Amazon Athena. The company needs to transform the flow logs and add additional data before the flow logs are delivered to the existing S3 bucket. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function to transform the data and to write a new object to the existing S3 bucket. Configure the Lambda function with an S3 trigger for the existing S3 bucket. Specify all object create events for the event type. Acknowledge the recursive invocation.
options.B: Enable Amazon EventBridge notifications on the existing S3 bucket. Create a custom EventBridge event bus. Create an EventBridge rule that is associated with the custom event bus. Configure the rule to react to all object create events for the existing S3 bucket and to invoke an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure a Step Functions task to transform the data and to write the data into a new S3 bucket.
options.C: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that is associated with the default EventBridge event bus. Configure the rule to react to all object create events for the existing S3 bucket. Define a new S3 bucket as the target for the rule. Create an EventBridge input transformation to customize the event before passing the event to the rule target.
options.D: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that is configured with an AWS Lambda transformer. Specify the existing S3 bucket as the destination. Change the Network Firewall logging destination from Amazon S3 to Kinesis Data Firehose.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to **transform and enrich AWS Network Firewall flow logs before they are delivered to the existing Amazon S3 bucket**, where Athena will analyze them. Therefore, the transformation must be placed directly in the log-delivery path rather than triggered after the raw log objects are already stored.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream with an AWS Lambda transformer, use the existing S3 bucket as the destination, and change Network Firewall logging to deliver to Firehose.**

AWS Network Firewall supports sending logs directly to an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream. The stream must use **Direct PUT or other sources**, and Network Firewall sends each firewall log as a Firehose record. Firehose can then invoke a Lambda function to transform incoming records and send the transformed output to the configured destination. This produces the required path:

`Network Firewall → Data Firehose → Lambda transformation/enrichment → existing S3 bucket`

Thus, the logs are transformed **before** they reach S3, while the existing bucket can remain the Athena data location.

- [Sending AWS Network Firewall logs to Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/logging-kinesis.html)
- [Transform source data in Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. S3-triggered Lambda that writes to the same bucket

This solution runs only **after** Network Firewall has already delivered the original log object to S3, so it does not satisfy the requirement to transform the logs before delivery. In addition, configuring all object-create events and writing the transformed object back to the same bucket can trigger the function again and create a recursive loop. AWS warns that writing output to the same service or resource that invokes a Lambda function can cause infinite recursive invocations, unexpected charges, and concurrency exhaustion. Merely acknowledging or allowing recursion does not make this an appropriate design.

- [Use Lambda recursive loop detection to prevent infinite loops](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-recursion.html)

### B. S3 EventBridge events on a custom bus invoking Step Functions

Events emitted by AWS services are delivered to the account's **default event bus**. The option associates the rule with a custom event bus without configuring a rule on the default bus to forward the S3 events to that custom bus, so the described custom-bus rule would not directly receive these AWS service events. It also performs processing after object creation and writes the result to a **new bucket**, contrary to the requirement to transform before delivery to the existing bucket.

- [Events from AWS services in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-events.html)

### C. EventBridge input transformation with an S3 bucket target

An EventBridge input transformer changes the **event payload passed to a target**; it does not retrieve and transform the contents of the S3 flow-log object. Additionally, an S3 bucket is not listed as a supported direct EventBridge event-bus rule target. Supported targets include services such as Lambda, Firehose, SQS, SNS, and Step Functions, but not an S3 bucket. This option also specifies a new bucket instead of the existing bucket.

- [Configuring an input transformer when creating an EventBridge rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-transform-input-rule.html)
- [Event bus targets in Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)

zh.question: 一家公司将其 AWS Network Firewall 流日志发送到一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。随后，该公司使用 Amazon Athena 分析这些流日志。该公司需要在将流日志传送到现有 S3 存储桶之前，对流日志进行转换并添加额外数据。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来转换数据，并将新对象写入现有 S3 存储桶。为该 Lambda 函数配置现有 S3 存储桶的 S3 触发器。为事件类型指定所有对象创建事件。确认递归调用。
options.B: 在现有 S3 存储桶上启用 Amazon EventBridge 通知。创建一个自定义 EventBridge 事件总线。创建一个与该自定义事件总线关联的 EventBridge 规则。配置该规则以响应现有 S3 存储桶的所有对象创建事件，并调用 AWS Step Functions 工作流。配置一个 Step Functions 任务来转换数据，并将数据写入新的 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 创建一个与默认 EventBridge 事件总线关联的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则以响应现有 S3 存储桶的所有对象创建事件。将一个新的 S3 存储桶定义为该规则的目标。创建 EventBridge 输入转换，以便在将事件传递给规则目标之前自定义该事件。
options.D: 创建一个配置了 AWS Lambda 转换器的 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。将现有 S3 存储桶指定为目标。将 Network Firewall 日志记录目标从 Amazon S3 更改为 Kinesis Data Firehose。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是在将 AWS Network Firewall 流日志传送到现有 Amazon S3 存储桶**之前**对其进行**转换和扩充**，随后 Athena 将在该存储桶中分析日志。因此，转换必须直接置于日志传送路径中，而不是在原始日志对象已经存储后才触发。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 创建一个带有 AWS Lambda 转换器的 Amazon Data Firehose 传输流，使用现有 S3 存储桶作为目标，并将 Network Firewall 日志记录更改为传送到 Firehose。**

AWS Network Firewall 支持将日志直接发送到 Amazon Data Firehose 传输流。该传输流必须使用 **Direct PUT 或其他来源**，而 Network Firewall 会将每条防火墙日志作为一条 Firehose 记录发送。随后，Firehose 可以调用 Lambda 函数来转换传入记录，并将转换后的输出发送到已配置的目标。这形成了所需路径：

`Network Firewall → Data Firehose → Lambda 转换/扩充 → 现有 S3 存储桶`

因此，日志会在到达 S3 **之前**完成转换，同时现有存储桶仍可作为 Athena 数据位置。

- [将 AWS Network Firewall 日志发送到 Amazon Data Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/network-firewall/latest/developerguide/logging-kinesis.html)
- [在 Amazon Data Firehose 中转换源数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/firehose/latest/dev/data-transformation.html)

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 由 S3 触发并写入同一存储桶的 Lambda

此解决方案仅会在 Network Firewall 已将原始日志对象传送到 S3 **之后**运行，因此不满足在传送前转换日志的要求。此外，配置所有对象创建事件并将转换后的对象写回同一存储桶，可能会再次触发该函数并造成递归循环。AWS 警告，将输出写入调用 Lambda 函数的同一服务或资源可能导致无限递归调用、意外费用和并发耗尽。仅仅确认或允许递归并不能使其成为合适的设计。

- [使用 Lambda 递归循环检测来防止无限循环](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/invocation-recursion.html)

### B. 在自定义事件总线上由 S3 EventBridge 事件调用 Step Functions

AWS 服务发出的事件会传送到账户的**默认事件总线**。该选项将规则关联到自定义事件总线，却没有配置默认事件总线上的规则将 S3 事件转发到该自定义总线，因此所描述的自定义总线规则无法直接接收这些 AWS 服务事件。它还会在对象创建后执行处理，并将结果写入**新存储桶**，这与在传送到现有存储桶之前进行转换的要求不符。

- [Amazon EventBridge 中来自 AWS 服务的事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-events.html)

### C. 以 S3 存储桶为目标的 EventBridge 输入转换

EventBridge 输入转换器会更改**传递给目标的事件有效负载**；它不会检索和转换 S3 流日志对象的内容。此外，S3 存储桶并未列为受支持的 EventBridge 事件总线规则直接目标。受支持的目标包括 Lambda、Firehose、SQS、SNS 和 Step Functions 等服务，但不包括 S3 存储桶。此选项还指定了新存储桶，而不是现有存储桶。

- [创建 EventBridge 规则时配置输入转换器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-transform-input-rule.html)
- [Amazon EventBridge 中的事件总线目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-targets.html)

en.question: A DevOps engineer needs to implement integration tests into an existing AWS CodePipeline CI/CD workflow for an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service. The CI/CD workflow retrieves new application code from an AWS CodeCommit repository and builds a container image. The Cl/CD workflow then uploads the container image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) with a new image tag version. The integration tests must ensure that new versions of the service endpoint are reachable and that various API methods return successful response data. The DevOps engineer has already created an ECS cluster to test the service. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST management overhead? (Choose three.)

options.A: Add a deploy stage to the pipeline. Configure Amazon ECS as the action provider.
options.B: Add a deploy stage to the pipeline. Configure AWS CodeDeploy as the action provider.
options.C: Add an appspec.yml file to the CodeCommit repository.
options.D: Update the image build pipeline stage to output an imagedefinitions.json file that references the new image tag.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function that runs connectivity checks and API calls against the service. Integrate the Lambda function with CodePipeline by using a Lambda action stage.
options.F: Write a script that runs integration tests against the service. Upload the script to an Amazon S3 bucket. Integrate the script in the S3 bucket with CodePipeline by using an S3 action stage.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The pipeline already builds and pushes a newly tagged container image to Amazon ECR. The remaining workflow must:

1. Deploy that exact image version to the existing test ECS cluster/service.
2. Run endpoint connectivity and API-response tests after deployment.
3. Do so with the least operational and configuration overhead.

## Correct answers: A, D, and E

### A. Add a deploy stage and configure Amazon ECS as the action provider

This uses the native **Amazon ECS standard deployment action** in CodePipeline. The action directly updates an ECS service and is configured with the ECS cluster and service names. This is simpler than introducing CodeDeploy blue/green deployment resources when the requirement is only to deploy to a test ECS service for integration testing.

AWS documents the ECS standard action as a CodePipeline `Deploy` action with provider `ECS`; it deploys an ECS service using an image definitions file. See [Amazon ECS deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECS.html).

### D. Update the image build stage to output an `imagedefinitions.json` file that references the new image tag

The ECS standard deployment action consumes `imagedefinitions.json`. The file maps the ECS container name to the complete image URI, including the newly generated ECR image tag. It can be generated during the build and included in the build output artifact.

AWS explicitly states that container pipelines using the ECS standard deploy action must generate this image definitions file and that a build stage can create it as an output artifact. See [CodePipeline image definitions file reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/file-reference.html).

### E. Create a Lambda function for connectivity and API tests and invoke it from CodePipeline

A Lambda invoke action is a low-management, serverless way to make HTTP requests to the deployed endpoint, validate response status/data, and report success or failure to CodePipeline. AWS provides an example Lambda action that performs an HTTP request, checks for a successful response, and calls `PutJobSuccessResult` or `PutJobFailureResult` accordingly.

The Lambda test action should run after the ECS deployment action. See [Invoke a Lambda function from CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-invoke-lambda-function.html) and the [Lambda invoke action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Lambda.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Add a deploy stage and configure AWS CodeDeploy as the action provider

CodeDeploy is used for an ECS **blue/green deployment**, which requires additional CodeDeploy resources and artifacts, including a CodeDeploy application, deployment group, task definition template, AppSpec file, and image details. That is unnecessary for this test deployment and creates more management overhead than the native ECS standard action. See [ECS and CodeDeploy blue/green action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECSbluegreen.html).

### C. Add an `appspec.yml` file to the repository

An AppSpec file is associated with the CodeDeploy ECS blue/green approach. It is not required by the ECS standard deployment action selected in A. The standard action instead needs `imagedefinitions.json`. Selecting C would therefore introduce an artifact for a more complex deployment mechanism that is not needed here.

### F. Store a test script in S3 and integrate it by using an S3 action

A CodePipeline S3 action does not execute a script. The S3 source action retrieves an object from an S3 bucket and provides it as a source artifact; it is not a test execution environment. A separate compute action such as CodeBuild or Lambda would still be required to run the script. The proposed Lambda invoke action directly performs the tests with less management overhead. See [Amazon S3 source action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-S3.html).

Therefore, the least-overhead workflow is **A + D + E**: generate `imagedefinitions.json`, deploy through the native ECS action, and invoke Lambda to run the integration tests.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师需要将集成测试实施到现有的、用于 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务的 AWS CodePipeline CI/CD 工作流程中。该 CI/CD 工作流程从 AWS CodeCommit 存储库检索新的应用程序代码并构建容器镜像。随后，该 CI/CD 工作流程会使用新的镜像标签版本将容器镜像上传到 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR)。集成测试必须确保新版本的服务端点可访问，并且各种 API 方法返回成功的响应数据。DevOps 工程师已经创建了一个 ECS 集群来测试该服务。哪种步骤组合能够以**最低**管理开销满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 向管道添加部署阶段。将 Amazon ECS 配置为操作提供商。
options.B: 向管道添加部署阶段。将 AWS CodeDeploy 配置为操作提供商。
options.C: 向 CodeCommit 存储库添加 appspec.yml 文件。
options.D: 更新镜像构建管道阶段，以输出引用新镜像标签的 imagedefinitions.json 文件。
options.E: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于对该服务运行连接检查和 API 调用。使用 Lambda 操作阶段将该 Lambda 函数与 CodePipeline 集成。
options.F: 编写一个针对该服务运行集成测试的脚本。将该脚本上传到 Amazon S3 存储桶。使用 S3 操作阶段将 S3 存储桶中的脚本与 CodePipeline 集成。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该管道已经构建并将带有新标签的容器镜像推送到 Amazon ECR。其余工作流程必须：

1. 将该确切的镜像版本部署到现有的测试 ECS 集群/服务。
2. 在部署后运行端点连接和 API 响应测试。
3. 以最低的运维和配置开销完成上述操作。

## 正确答案：A、D 和 E

### A. 添加部署阶段，并将 Amazon ECS 配置为操作提供商

这将使用 CodePipeline 中原生的 **Amazon ECS 标准部署操作**。该操作会直接更新 ECS 服务，并通过 ECS 集群和服务名称进行配置。与在仅需部署到测试 ECS 服务以进行集成测试时引入 CodeDeploy 蓝绿部署资源相比，这种方式更简单。

AWS 将 ECS 标准操作记录为一个提供商为 `ECS` 的 CodePipeline `Deploy` 操作；它使用镜像定义文件部署 ECS 服务。请参阅 [Amazon ECS 部署操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECS.html)。

### D. 更新镜像构建阶段，以输出引用新镜像标签的 `imagedefinitions.json` 文件

ECS 标准部署操作使用 `imagedefinitions.json`。该文件将 ECS 容器名称映射到完整镜像 URI，其中包括新生成的 ECR 镜像标签。可以在构建期间生成该文件，并将其包含在构建输出构件中。

AWS 明确指出，使用 ECS 标准部署操作的容器管道必须生成此镜像定义文件，并且构建阶段可以将其创建为输出构件。请参阅 [CodePipeline 镜像定义文件参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/file-reference.html)。

### E. 为连接和 API 测试创建 Lambda 函数，并从 CodePipeline 调用它

Lambda 调用操作是一种低管理开销的无服务器方式，可向已部署的端点发出 HTTP 请求、验证响应状态/数据，并向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。AWS 提供了一个 Lambda 操作示例，该示例执行 HTTP 请求、检查响应是否成功，并相应地调用 `PutJobSuccessResult` 或 `PutJobFailureResult`。

Lambda 测试操作应在 ECS 部署操作之后运行。请参阅 [从 CodePipeline 调用 Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-invoke-lambda-function.html) 和 [Lambda 调用操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Lambda.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 添加部署阶段，并将 AWS CodeDeploy 配置为操作提供商

CodeDeploy 用于 ECS **蓝绿部署**，这需要额外的 CodeDeploy 资源和构件，包括 CodeDeploy 应用程序、部署组、任务定义模板、AppSpec 文件和镜像详细信息。对于此测试部署而言，这些并非必需，并且比原生 ECS 标准操作带来更多管理开销。请参阅 [ECS 和 CodeDeploy 蓝绿操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECSbluegreen.html)。

### C. 向存储库添加 `appspec.yml` 文件

AppSpec 文件与 CodeDeploy ECS 蓝绿部署方法相关联。选项 A 中选择的 ECS 标准部署操作不需要该文件。标准操作需要的是 `imagedefinitions.json`。因此，选择 C 会为这里不需要的、更复杂的部署机制引入一个构件。

### F. 将测试脚本存储在 S3 中，并使用 S3 操作进行集成

CodePipeline S3 操作不会执行脚本。S3 源操作会从 S3 存储桶检索对象并将其作为源构件提供；它不是测试执行环境。仍然需要单独的计算操作（例如 CodeBuild 或 Lambda）来运行该脚本。所提出的 Lambda 调用操作可直接执行测试，且管理开销更低。请参阅 [Amazon S3 源操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-S3.html)。

因此，管理开销最低的工作流程是 **A + D + E**：生成 `imagedefinitions.json`，通过原生 ECS 操作部署，并调用 Lambda 来运行集成测试。

en.question: A company runs applications on Windows and Linux Amazon EC2 instances. The instances run across multiple Availability Zones in an AWS Region. The company uses Auto Scaling groups for each application. The company needs a durable storage solution for the instances. The solution must use SMB for Windows and must use NFS for Linux. The solution must also have sub-millisecond latencies. All instances will read and write the data. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system that has targets in multiple Availability Zones.
options.B: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file system.
options.C: Create a General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume to use for shared storage.
options.D: Update the user data for each application’s launch template to mount the file system.
options.E: Perform an instance refresh on each Auto Scaling group.
options.F: Update the EC2 instances for each application to mount the file system when new instances are launched.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs one durable, shared file-storage solution that:

- supports **SMB for Windows** and **NFS for Linux**;
- can be accessed for reads and writes by instances distributed across multiple Availability Zones;
- provides **sub-millisecond latency**; and
- is automatically mounted by both existing and future instances in the Auto Scaling groups.

## Correct answers: B, D, and E

### B. Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ file system

FSx for NetApp ONTAP is the storage service that meets all the protocol, performance, and availability requirements:

- It supports multiprotocol access, including both **NFS and SMB**.
- With SSD storage, it provides **sub-millisecond file-operation latency**.
- A Multi-AZ deployment synchronously replicates writes to a standby file server in another Availability Zone and is designed to remain available during an AZ failure.
- It provides shared file storage, allowing multiple Windows and Linux clients to read and write the data.

AWS documents the supported NFS and SMB protocols in the [FSx for ONTAP features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html), the SSD latency characteristics in [FSx for ONTAP performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/performance.html), and the cross-AZ synchronous replication of Multi-AZ deployments in [Availability, durability, and deployment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html).

### D. Update the user data for each application's launch template to mount the file system

The launch templates should contain OS-specific user data:

- Windows instances mount the SMB share.
- Linux instances mount the NFS export.

This makes the configuration repeatable and ensures that **future instances** launched by each Auto Scaling group mount the appropriate FSx share automatically. AWS documents that a launch template can contain a user data script that configures instances at launch in [Examples for creating and managing launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/examples-launch-templates-aws-cli.html).

### E. Perform an instance refresh on each Auto Scaling group

Changing the launch template does not retroactively run the new user data on currently running instances. An instance refresh rolls out the updated launch template by replacing existing instances with new instances that use the new user data configuration.

AWS specifically identifies deploying a new user data script across an Auto Scaling group as a use case for [instance refresh](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/asg-instance-refresh.html). Therefore, D configures future launches, while E brings the currently running fleets into the same configuration.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create an Amazon EFS file system that has targets in multiple Availability Zones

Amazon EFS supports NFS, but it does not provide the required SMB access for Windows. AWS explicitly states that EFS supports NFSv4.0 and NFSv4.1 and that mounting EFS on Microsoft Windows EC2 instances is not supported in [Amazon EFS NFS support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-old.html).

Therefore, EFS cannot meet the simultaneous SMB-for-Windows and NFS-for-Linux requirement.

### C. Create a gp3 Amazon EBS volume to use for shared storage

A gp3 EBS volume is block storage, not a managed multiprotocol SMB/NFS shared file system. More importantly, gp3 does not support EBS Multi-Attach. AWS documents that Multi-Attach is available for Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` and `io2` volumes and that the participating instances must be in the same Availability Zone in [Enable Multi-Attach for an Amazon EBS volume](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/working-with-multi-attach.html).

The instances in this scenario span multiple Availability Zones, so a gp3 volume cannot serve as the required shared regional file-storage solution.

### F. Update the EC2 instances for each application to mount the file system when new instances are launched

This is not the correct Auto Scaling deployment mechanism. Updating individual EC2 instances is not a durable configuration for an Auto Scaling fleet, because those instances can later be replaced or scaled in. If the intent is to configure newly launched instances, that is already accomplished declaratively by **D**, through launch-template user data.

Option F also does not ensure that all currently running instances receive the new mounting configuration. The complete approach is to update the launch template and then use an instance refresh: **D + E**.

zh.question: 某公司在 Windows 和 Linux Amazon EC2 实例上运行应用程序。这些实例分布在一个 AWS 区域内的多个可用区中。该公司为每个应用程序使用 Auto Scaling 组。该公司需要为这些实例提供持久的存储解决方案。该解决方案必须为 Windows 使用 SMB，并为 Linux 使用 NFS。该解决方案还必须具有亚毫秒级延迟。所有实例都将读取和写入数据。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统，并在多个可用区中具有挂载目标。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ 文件系统。
options.C: 创建一个 General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷，用作共享存储。
options.D: 更新每个应用程序启动模板的用户数据，以挂载该文件系统。
options.E: 对每个 Auto Scaling 组执行实例刷新。
options.F: 更新每个应用程序的 EC2 实例，使其在启动新实例时挂载该文件系统。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

该公司需要一个持久的共享文件存储解决方案，该解决方案必须：

- 支持 **用于 Windows 的 SMB** 和 **用于 Linux 的 NFS**；
- 可供分布在多个可用区中的实例读取和写入；
- 提供 **亚毫秒级延迟**；并且
- 由 Auto Scaling 组中的现有实例和未来实例自动挂载。

## 正确答案：B、D 和 E

### B. 创建一个 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP Multi-AZ 文件系统

FSx for NetApp ONTAP 是满足全部协议、性能和可用性要求的存储服务：

- 它支持多协议访问，包括 **NFS 和 SMB**。
- 使用 SSD 存储时，它可提供 **亚毫秒级文件操作延迟**。
- Multi-AZ 部署会将写入同步复制到另一个可用区中的备用文件服务器，并且旨在于 AZ 故障期间保持可用。
- 它提供共享文件存储，允许多个 Windows 和 Linux 客户端读取和写入数据。

AWS 在 [FSx for ONTAP features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/what-is-fsx-ontap.html) 中记录了所支持的 NFS 和 SMB 协议，在 [FSx for ONTAP performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/performance.html) 中记录了 SSD 延迟特性，并在 [Availability, durability, and deployment options](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/high-availability-AZ.html) 中记录了 Multi-AZ 部署的跨 AZ 同步复制。

### D. 更新每个应用程序启动模板的用户数据，以挂载文件系统

启动模板应包含特定于操作系统的用户数据：

- Windows 实例挂载 SMB 共享。
- Linux 实例挂载 NFS 导出。

这使配置可重复，并确保每个 Auto Scaling 组将来启动的实例都会自动挂载相应的 FSx 共享。AWS 在 [Examples for creating and managing launch templates](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/examples-launch-templates-aws-cli.html) 中说明，启动模板可以包含在实例启动时配置实例的用户数据脚本。

### E. 对每个 Auto Scaling 组执行实例刷新

更改启动模板不会在当前运行的实例上追溯运行新的用户数据。实例刷新会通过替换现有实例来推出更新后的启动模板；新实例将使用新的用户数据配置。

AWS 明确将跨 Auto Scaling 组部署新的用户数据脚本列为 [instance refresh](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/asg-instance-refresh.html) 的一个使用场景。因此，D 配置未来的启动，而 E 使当前运行的实例组也采用相同配置。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A. 创建一个在多个可用区中具有挂载目标的 Amazon EFS 文件系统

Amazon EFS 支持 NFS，但不提供 Windows 所需的 SMB 访问。AWS 在 [Amazon EFS NFS support](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/efs/latest/ug/mounting-fs-old.html) 中明确指出，EFS 支持 NFSv4.0 和 NFSv4.1，且不支持在 Microsoft Windows EC2 实例上挂载 EFS。

因此，EFS 无法同时满足 Windows 使用 SMB 和 Linux 使用 NFS 的要求。

### C. 创建一个 gp3 Amazon EBS 卷用作共享存储

gp3 EBS 卷是块存储，而不是托管的多协议 SMB/NFS 共享文件系统。更重要的是，gp3 不支持 EBS Multi-Attach。AWS 在 [Enable Multi-Attach for an Amazon EBS volume](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/working-with-multi-attach.html) 中记录，Multi-Attach 可用于 Provisioned IOPS SSD `io1` 和 `io2` 卷，并且参与的实例必须位于同一个可用区。

此场景中的实例跨多个可用区，因此 gp3 卷不能作为所需的共享区域文件存储解决方案。

### F. 更新每个应用程序的 EC2 实例，使其在启动新实例时挂载文件系统

这不是正确的 Auto Scaling 部署机制。更新单个 EC2 实例不是 Auto Scaling 实例组的持久配置，因为这些实例之后可能会被替换或缩减。如果目的是配置新启动的实例，这已经通过 D 以声明方式完成，即通过启动模板用户数据实现。

选项 F 也无法确保所有当前运行的实例获得新的挂载配置。完整的方法是更新启动模板，然后使用实例刷新：**D + E**。

options.A: In the organization's management account, create a new OU. Move the organization's management account to the new OU. Detach the SCP from the organization root. Attach the SCP to the new OU.
options.B: In the organization's management account, update the SCP condition reference to the ARN of the DevOps team's group role to include the AWS account ID of the organization's management account.
options.C: In IAM Identity Center, create a new permission set. Ensure that the assigned policy has full access but explicitly denies permission for the sso:* action and the sso-directory:* action. Update the assigned permission set for the DevOps team's group role in the organization's management account. Delete the SCP.
options.D: In IAM Identity Center, update the DevOps permission set. Ensure that the assigned policy has full access but explicitly denies permission for the sso:* action and the sso-directory:* action. In the Deny statement, add a StringEquals condition that compares the aws:SourceAccount global condition context key with the organization's management account IDelete the SCP.

en.explanation:
## Scenario

A company runs an AWS Organizations organization managed jointly by a security team and a DevOps team, with sign-in through AWS IAM Identity Center. The DevOps group is assigned a permission set named `DevOps` that has the `AdministratorAccess` managed policy attached, and that permission set is provisioned to **every** account in the organization — including the management account, where IAM Identity Center itself is administered.

To block DevOps from touching IAM Identity Center in the management account, the security team attached an SCP to the organization root that denies `sso:*` and `sso-directory:*` when the calling principal ARN matches `arn:aws:iam::*:role/AWSReservedSSO_DevOps_*`. The SCP has no effect: DevOps can still administer IAM Identity Center.

## Root cause

**SCPs never restrict principals operating in the AWS Organizations management account.** SCPs affect only member accounts, and AWS explicitly lists "any action performed by the management account" among the things that cannot be restricted by an SCP, regardless of where the SCP is attached ([Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

Because IAM Identity Center is administered from the management account in this scenario, the restriction has to be enforced through the identity-based permissions that IAM Identity Center provisions into that account — that is, through the permission set assigned there.

## Correct answer: C

Create a **new** permission set whose policy still grants broad (full) access, but adds an explicit deny for the IAM Identity Center administrative actions:

```json
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Action": [
    "sso:*",
    "sso-directory:*"
  ],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

Then change the DevOps group's assignment **for the management account only** so it uses this new permission set, and delete the ineffective SCP.

Why this works:

- **Assignments are per account.** In IAM Identity Center you assign a permission set to a user or group for selected AWS accounts, so the management account can carry a different permission set than the member accounts ([Assign user access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)). The existing account-level assignment can be changed by selecting the account and group and modifying its assigned permission sets ([Change permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtoviewandchangepermissionset.html)).
- **Permission sets become real IAM roles.** When a permission set is assigned, IAM Identity Center provisions a corresponding IAM role in that account and attaches the permission set's policies to it ([Permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)). The deny therefore lands directly on the role the DevOps team assumes in the management account.
- **Explicit deny wins.** In IAM policy evaluation, an explicit `Deny` in an identity-based policy overrides any `Allow`, including the blanket allow supplied by `AdministratorAccess` ([Policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)).
- **Blast radius is contained.** Because the restrictive permission set is used only for the management-account assignment, DevOps retains unrestricted administrator access in all member accounts.

## Why the other options are wrong

### A — Incorrect

Creating an OU, moving the management account into it, and re-attaching the SCP there changes nothing. The problem is not the attachment point; the management account is exempt from SCP enforcement wherever it sits in the organization tree ([Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)). The DevOps role in the management account would still be unaffected.

### B — Incorrect

Replacing the `*` account field in `aws:PrincipalARN` with the management account ID only narrows the match — the existing wildcard already matches the management account. It does not change the policy *type* being used, and an SCP still cannot restrict actions performed by principals in the management account ([Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

### D — Incorrect

Two problems:

1. **Wrong condition key.** `aws:SourceAccount` is populated only when a resource is called directly by an **AWS service principal** acting on a customer's behalf; it is a cross-service confused-deputy control, not the account of the requesting IAM role ([AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)). DevOps users call the API through an IAM Identity Center-provisioned IAM role from the console or CLI, so `aws:SourceAccount` is absent from the request context, the `StringEquals` test never matches, and the deny statement never takes effect. The DevOps team would keep full IAM Identity Center access — exactly the problem being solved.
2. **Wrong scope.** Editing the shared `DevOps` permission set modifies it everywhere it is provisioned; IAM Identity Center propagates permission-set changes to the corresponding roles in all assigned accounts ([Permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)). A separate management-account permission set, as in option C, is the account-specific mechanism AWS provides for this requirement.

options.A: 在组织的管理账户中，创建一个新的 OU。将组织的管理账户移动到该新 OU。将 SCP 从组织根分离。将该 SCP 附加到新的 OU。
options.B: 在组织的管理账户中，更新 SCP 中对 DevOps 团队组角色 ARN 的条件引用，使其包含组织管理账户的 AWS 账户 ID。
options.C: 在 IAM Identity Center 中，创建一个新的权限集。确保所分配的策略具有完全访问权限，但显式拒绝 sso:* 操作和 sso-directory:* 操作的权限。在组织的管理账户中更新为 DevOps 团队组角色分配的权限集。删除该 SCP。
options.D: 在 IAM Identity Center 中，更新 DevOps 权限集。确保所分配的策略具有完全访问权限，但显式拒绝 sso:* 操作和 sso-directory:* 操作的权限。在 Deny 语句中，添加一个 StringEquals 条件，将 aws:SourceAccount 全局条件上下文键与组织的管理账户 ID 进行比较。删除该 SCP。

zh.explanation:
## 场景

某公司运行一个由安全团队和 DevOps 团队共同管理的 AWS Organizations 组织，登录通过 AWS IAM Identity Center 进行。DevOps 组被分配了一个名为 `DevOps` 的权限集，该权限集附加了 `AdministratorAccess` 托管策略，并且该权限集已预置到组织中的**每一个**账户 —— 包括管理 IAM Identity Center 本身的管理账户。

为了阻止 DevOps 在管理账户中操作 IAM Identity Center，安全团队向组织根附加了一个 SCP，当调用主体 ARN 匹配 `arn:aws:iam::*:role/AWSReservedSSO_DevOps_*` 时拒绝 `sso:*` 和 `sso-directory:*`。该 SCP 没有生效：DevOps 仍然可以管理 IAM Identity Center。

## 根本原因

**SCP 从不限制在 AWS Organizations 管理账户中操作的主体。** SCP 仅影响成员账户，AWS 明确将"管理账户执行的任何操作"列为无法通过 SCP 限制的内容，无论 SCP 附加在何处（[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。

由于在此场景中 IAM Identity Center 是从管理账户进行管理的，因此限制必须通过 IAM Identity Center 预置到该账户中的基于身份的权限来实施 —— 也就是通过在该账户中分配的权限集。

## 正确答案：C

创建一个**新的**权限集，其策略仍授予广泛（完全）的访问权限，但为 IAM Identity Center 管理操作添加显式拒绝：

```json
{
  "Effect": "Deny",
  "Action": [
    "sso:*",
    "sso-directory:*"
  ],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

然后**仅针对管理账户**更改 DevOps 组的分配，使其使用这个新权限集，并删除无效的 SCP。

为什么这样可行：

- **分配是按账户进行的。** 在 IAM Identity Center 中，你为选定的 AWS 账户将权限集分配给用户或组，因此管理账户可以使用与成员账户不同的权限集（[Assign user access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)）。现有的账户级分配可以通过选择该账户和组并修改其已分配的权限集来更改（[Change permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/howtoviewandchangepermissionset.html)）。
- **权限集会成为真正的 IAM 角色。** 当分配某个权限集时，IAM Identity Center 会在该账户中预置一个相应的 IAM 角色，并将该权限集的策略附加到该角色（[Permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)）。因此拒绝规则会直接作用于 DevOps 团队在管理账户中所承担的角色。
- **显式拒绝优先。** 在 IAM 策略评估中，基于身份的策略中的显式 `Deny` 会覆盖任何 `Allow`，包括 `AdministratorAccess` 提供的全面允许（[Policy evaluation logic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_evaluation-logic.html)）。
- **影响范围可控。** 由于该限制性权限集仅用于管理账户的分配，DevOps 在所有成员账户中仍保留不受限制的管理员访问权限。

## 其他选项为何错误

### A —— 错误

创建 OU、将管理账户移入其中并在那里重新附加 SCP 不会改变任何事情。问题不在于附加位置；无论管理账户位于组织树中的何处，它都不受 SCP 强制约束（[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。管理账户中的 DevOps 角色仍然不会受到影响。

### B —— 错误

将 `aws:PrincipalARN` 中的 `*` 账户字段替换为管理账户 ID 只是缩小了匹配范围 —— 现有的通配符已经能匹配管理账户。这并未改变所使用的策略*类型*，而 SCP 仍然无法限制管理账户中的主体所执行的操作（[Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。

### D —— 错误

存在两个问题：

1. **条件键错误。** `aws:SourceAccount` 仅在资源由代表客户执行操作的 **AWS 服务主体**直接调用时才会被填充；它是一种跨服务的混淆代理人（confused deputy）控制机制，而不是发起请求的 IAM 角色所属的账户（[AWS global condition context keys](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/reference_policies_condition-keys.html)）。DevOps 用户是通过控制台或 CLI，使用由 IAM Identity Center 预置的 IAM 角色来调用 API 的，因此请求上下文中不存在 `aws:SourceAccount`，`StringEquals` 测试永远不会匹配，拒绝语句也就永远不会生效。DevOps 团队将保留完整的 IAM Identity Center 访问权限 —— 恰恰是需要解决的问题。
2. **作用范围错误。** 编辑共享的 `DevOps` 权限集会在其预置的所有位置修改它；IAM Identity Center 会将权限集的更改传播到所有已分配账户中的相应角色（[Permission sets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/permissionsetsconcept.html)）。像选项 C 那样使用单独的管理账户权限集，才是 AWS 为此需求提供的按账户区分的机制。

en.question: An Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group manages EC2 instances that were created from an AMI. The AMI has the AWS Systems Manager Agent installed. When an EC2 instance is launched into the Auto Scaling group, tags are applied to the EC2 instance. EC2 instances that are launched by the Auto Scaling group must have the correct operating system configuration. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a Systems Manager Run Command document that configures the desired instance configuration. Set up Systems Manager Compliance to invoke the Run Command document when the EC2 instances are not in compliance with the most recent patches.
options.B: Create a Systems Manager State Manager association that links to the Systems Manager command document. Create a tag query that runs immediately.
options.C: Create a Systems Manager Run Command task that specifies the desired instance configuration. Create a maintenance window in Systems Manager Maintenance Windows that runs daily. Register the Run Command task against the maintenance window. Designate the targets.
options.D: Create a Systems Manager Patch Manager patch baseline and a patch group that use the same tags that the Auto Scaling group applies. Register the patch group with the patch baseline. Define a Systems Manager command document to patch the instances Invoke the document by using Systems Manager Run Command.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to ensure that every new EC2 instance launched by the Auto Scaling group receives the desired operating system configuration. Because the instances are dynamically created and receive identifying tags at launch, the solution should automatically discover matching instances and apply the configuration as soon as they become Systems Manager managed nodes.

## Correct answer: B

**Create a Systems Manager State Manager association that links to the Systems Manager command document. Create a tag query that runs immediately.**

A State Manager association defines the configuration through an SSM document and targets the managed nodes to which that configuration must be applied. AWS specifically recommends **tag targets** for associations that manage Auto Scaling groups. If all instances in the group receive the same tag key and value, one association can target the entire group ([Running Auto Scaling groups with associations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-asg.html)).

Most importantly, when an association that uses a Command document targets instances by tags, a newly created node with matching tags is automatically added to the association. State Manager then **runs the association immediately** and subsequently according to its configured schedule ([Using targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-targets-and-rate-controls.html)). State Manager also attempts to run an association when a managed node comes online for the first time ([Understanding when associations are applied](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-about.html)).

This directly addresses the lifecycle of an Auto Scaling group: replacement and scale-out instances automatically receive the required OS configuration without having to predict when they will launch.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** Systems Manager Compliance collects and reports patch and association compliance information; remediation can be performed through separate mechanisms such as Run Command, State Manager, or EventBridge ([AWS Systems Manager Compliance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-compliance.html)). This option incorrectly ties arbitrary desired OS configuration to noncompliance with the latest patches. Patch compliance does not indicate whether all required operating system configuration settings have been applied, and this design does not provide the direct tag-based, immediate association behavior required for newly launched instances.

- **C — Incorrect.** A daily Maintenance Window would apply the configuration only when the scheduled window runs, so a newly launched instance could remain incorrectly configured for almost a day. Maintenance Windows are intended to schedule potentially disruptive or time-sensitive tasks during specified periods; State Manager is the better fit for automated configuration compliance ([AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-windows.html)). Run Command can perform configuration changes, but AWS describes it as supporting **one-time configuration changes**, rather than maintaining desired configuration automatically as new tagged instances appear ([AWS Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html)).

- **D — Incorrect.** Patch Manager patch baselines determine patch behavior for `Scan` and `Install` operations ([Patch baselines](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-patch-baselines.html)). They address operating system and application patching, not general desired OS configuration. In addition, invoking a patching document through Run Command is not an automatic mechanism for configuring every newly launched Auto Scaling instance immediately.

Therefore, **B** is the solution that automatically targets the Auto Scaling instances by tag and applies the required configuration immediately when new instances become managed nodes.

zh.question: 一个 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组管理由 AMI 创建的 EC2 实例。该 AMI 已安装 AWS Systems Manager Agent。当 EC2 实例启动并加入 Auto Scaling 组时，会为该 EC2 实例应用标签。由 Auto Scaling 组启动的 EC2 实例必须具有正确的操作系统配置。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个用于配置所需实例配置的 Systems Manager Run Command 文档。当 EC2 实例不符合最新补丁的合规性要求时，设置 Systems Manager Compliance 调用该 Run Command 文档。
options.B: 创建一个链接到 Systems Manager 命令文档的 Systems Manager State Manager 关联。创建一个立即运行的标签查询。
options.C: 创建一个指定所需实例配置的 Systems Manager Run Command 任务。在 Systems Manager Maintenance Windows 中创建一个每天运行的维护时段。针对该维护时段注册 Run Command 任务。指定目标。
options.D: 创建一个 Systems Manager Patch Manager 补丁基线和补丁组，并使其使用 Auto Scaling 组应用的相同标签。将补丁组注册到该补丁基线。定义一个用于修补实例的 Systems Manager 命令文档。使用 Systems Manager Run Command 调用该文档。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是确保 Auto Scaling 组启动的每个新 EC2 实例都能获得所需的操作系统配置。由于实例是动态创建的，并且在启动时会收到用于标识的标签，因此该解决方案应自动发现匹配的实例，并在它们成为 Systems Manager 托管节点后立即应用配置。

## 正确答案：B

**创建一个链接到 Systems Manager 命令文档的 Systems Manager State Manager 关联。创建一个立即运行的标签查询。**

State Manager 关联通过 SSM 文档定义配置，并以必须应用该配置的托管节点为目标。AWS 明确建议对管理 Auto Scaling 组的关联使用**标签目标**。如果组中的所有实例都收到相同的标签键和值，一个关联即可针对整个组 ([使用关联运行 Auto Scaling 组](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-asg.html))。

最重要的是，当使用 Command 文档的关联通过标签定位实例时，具有匹配标签的新建节点会自动添加到该关联中。随后，State Manager 会**立即运行该关联**，并根据其配置的计划继续运行 ([使用目标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-state-manager-targets-and-rate-controls.html))。当托管节点首次上线时，State Manager 也会尝试运行关联 ([了解何时应用关联](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/state-manager-about.html))。

这直接满足了 Auto Scaling 组的生命周期需求：替换实例和扩展启动的实例都会自动获得所需的 OS 配置，而无需预测它们何时启动。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A — 不正确。** Systems Manager Compliance 会收集并报告补丁和关联的合规性信息；可以通过 Run Command、State Manager 或 EventBridge 等独立机制执行修复操作 ([AWS Systems Manager Compliance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-compliance.html))。该选项错误地将任意所需的 OS 配置与不符合最新补丁要求关联起来。补丁合规性并不能表明所有必需的操作系统配置设置是否均已应用，并且此设计无法为新启动的实例提供所需的、基于标签的即时关联行为。

- **C — 不正确。** 每日 Maintenance Window 仅会在计划的时段运行时应用配置，因此新启动的实例可能在接近一天的时间内保持错误配置。Maintenance Windows 用于在指定时段内安排可能造成中断或具有时间敏感性的任务；对于自动化配置合规性，State Manager 是更合适的选择 ([AWS Systems Manager Maintenance Windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-windows.html))。Run Command 可以执行配置更改，但 AWS 将其描述为支持**一次性配置更改**，而非在新的带标签实例出现时自动维持所需配置 ([AWS Systems Manager Run Command](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/run-command.html))。

- **D — 不正确。** Patch Manager 补丁基线决定 `Scan` 和 `Install` 操作的补丁行为 ([补丁基线](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-patch-baselines.html))。它们处理操作系统和应用程序修补，而不是通用的所需 OS 配置。此外，通过 Run Command 调用修补文档并不是一种可立即配置每个新启动 Auto Scaling 实例的自动化机制。

因此，**B** 是通过标签自动定位 Auto Scaling 实例，并在新实例成为托管节点时立即应用所需配置的解决方案。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage its AWS accounts. The organization root has a child OU that is named Department. The Department OU has a child OU that is named Engineering. The default FullAWSAccess policy is attached to the root, the Department OU, and the Engineering OU. The company has many AWS accounts in the Engineering OU. Each account has an administrative IAM role with the AdministratorAccess IAM policy attached. The default FullAWSAccessPolicy is also attached to each account. A DevOps engineer plans to remove the FullAWSAccess policy from the Department OU. The DevOps engineer will replace the policy with a policy that contains an Allow statement for all Amazon EC2 API operations. What will happen to the permissions of the administrative 1AM roles as a result of this change?

options.A: All API actions on all resources will be allowed.
options.B: All API actions on EC2 resources will be allowed. All other API actions will be denied.
options.C: All API actions on all resources will be denied.
options.D: All API actions on EC2 resources will be denied. All other API actions will be allowed.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The administrative roles have the `AdministratorAccess` IAM policy, but the accounts are member accounts in an AWS Organizations hierarchy. Therefore, their effective permissions are limited by the intersection of the SCPs at the root, every OU in the path, and the account itself.

AWS states that an SCP does not grant permissions; it defines the **maximum available permissions**. A permission must be allowed by the IAM policy and permitted by **every parent** above the account. A permission omitted from an allow-list SCP at any level is implicitly blocked, even when the principal has `AdministratorAccess` ([SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)).

## Correct answer: B

After the change, the applicable SCP path is effectively:

- Root: `FullAWSAccess` — allows all actions
- Department OU: custom SCP — allows only `ec2:*`
- Engineering OU: `FullAWSAccess` — allows all actions
- Account: `FullAWSAccess` — allows all actions
- IAM role: `AdministratorAccess` — grants all actions at the IAM level

For allow-list SCPs, an explicit allow must exist at **every level** from the root through the OUs to the target account. SCP evaluation is deny-by-default for actions not allowed at any level ([How SCPs work with Allow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)).

Consequently, EC2 API operations are allowed throughout the entire path and are also granted by `AdministratorAccess`. Non-EC2 operations are not allowed by the Department OU's replacement SCP, so they are implicitly denied regardless of the broader policies attached to the Engineering OU, account, or IAM role.

Thus, **all EC2 API actions are allowed, and all other API actions are denied**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. All API actions on all resources will be allowed.** Incorrect. The `FullAWSAccess` policies at the root, Engineering OU, and account cannot override the Department OU's narrower allow-list. Every level must permit an action.
- **C. All API actions on all resources will be denied.** Incorrect. EC2 actions remain explicitly allowed by the Department OU policy and are also allowed at every other SCP level and by the role's IAM policy.
- **D. All API actions on EC2 resources will be denied. All other API actions will be allowed.** Incorrect. This reverses the result. The Department OU policy explicitly permits EC2 operations and omits non-EC2 operations, so EC2 remains available while other services are blocked.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理其 AWS 账户。组织根目录下有一个名为 Department 的子 OU。Department OU 下有一个名为 Engineering 的子 OU。默认的 FullAWSAccess 策略已附加到根目录、Department OU 和 Engineering OU。该公司在 Engineering OU 中拥有许多 AWS 账户。每个账户都有一个附加了 AdministratorAccess IAM 策略的管理 IAM 角色。默认的 FullAWSAccessPolicy 也附加到每个账户。某 DevOps 工程师计划从 Department OU 中移除 FullAWSAccess 策略。该 DevOps 工程师将使用包含允许所有 Amazon EC2 API 操作的 Allow 语句的策略来替换该策略。此次更改会对管理 1AM 角色的权限造成什么影响？

options.A: 所有资源上的所有 API 操作都将被允许。
options.B: EC2 资源上的所有 API 操作都将被允许。所有其他 API 操作都将被拒绝。
options.C: 所有资源上的所有 API 操作都将被拒绝。
options.D: EC2 资源上的所有 API 操作都将被拒绝。所有其他 API 操作都将被允许。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

这些管理角色拥有 `AdministratorAccess` IAM 策略，但这些账户是 AWS Organizations 层级结构中的成员账户。因此，其有效权限受根目录、路径中的每个 OU 以及账户本身的 SCP 交集限制。

AWS 指出，SCP 不授予权限；它定义的是**可用权限的最大范围**。某项权限必须同时被 IAM 策略允许，并且被账户上方的**每个父级**所允许。任何层级的允许列表 SCP 中未包含的权限都会被隐式阻止，即使主体拥有 `AdministratorAccess` 也是如此（[SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)）。

## 正确答案：B

更改后，适用的 SCP 路径实际上为：

- 根目录：`FullAWSAccess` — 允许所有操作
- Department OU：自定义 SCP — 仅允许 `ec2:*`
- Engineering OU：`FullAWSAccess` — 允许所有操作
- 账户：`FullAWSAccess` — 允许所有操作
- IAM 角色：`AdministratorAccess` — 在 IAM 层面授予所有操作

对于允许列表 SCP，从根目录经过各个 OU 到目标账户的**每个层级**都必须存在显式允许。对于任何层级未允许的操作，SCP 评估均默认为拒绝（[SCP 如何与 Allow 配合工作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)）。

因此，EC2 API 操作在整个路径中均被允许，并且也由 `AdministratorAccess` 授予。非 EC2 操作不被 Department OU 的替换 SCP 允许，因此无论 Engineering OU、账户或 IAM 角色附加了何种更广泛的策略，这些操作都会被隐式拒绝。

因此，**所有 EC2 API 操作都被允许，所有其他 API 操作都被拒绝**。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 所有资源上的所有 API 操作都将被允许。** 错误。根目录、Engineering OU 和账户上的 `FullAWSAccess` 策略无法覆盖 Department OU 较严格的允许列表。每个层级都必须允许某项操作。
- **C. 所有资源上的所有 API 操作都将被拒绝。** 错误。EC2 操作仍被 Department OU 策略显式允许，并且在所有其他 SCP 层级以及该角色的 IAM 策略中也被允许。
- **D. EC2 资源上的所有 API 操作都将被拒绝。所有其他 API 操作都将被允许。** 错误。该选项将结果颠倒了。Department OU 策略显式允许 EC2 操作且未包含非 EC2 操作，因此 EC2 仍然可用，而其他服务会被阻止。

en.question: A company manages AWS accounts in AWS Organizations. The company needs a solution to send Amazon CloudWatch Logs data to an Amazon S3 bucket in a dedicated AWS account. The solution must support all existing and future CloudWatch Logs log groups. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable Organizations backup policies to back up all log groups to a dedicated S3 bucket. Add an S3 bucket policy that allows access from all accounts that belong to the company.
options.B: Create a backup plan in AWS Backup. Specify a dedicated S3 bucket as a backup vault. Assign all CloudWatch Logs log group resources to the backup plan. Create resource assignments in the backup plan for all accounts that belong to the company.
options.C: Create a backup plan in AWS Backup. Specify a dedicated S3 bucket as a backup vault. Assign all existing log groups to the backup plan. Create resource assignments in the backup plan for all accounts that belong to the company. Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to assign log groups to a backup plan. Create an AWS Config rule that has an automatic remediation action for all noncompliant log groups. Specify the runbook as the rule's target.
options.D: Create a CloudWatch Logs destination and an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream in the dedicated AWS account. Specify the S3 bucket as the destination of the delivery stream. Create subscription filters for all existing log groups in all accounts. Create an AWS Lambda function to call the CloudWatch Logs PutSubscriptionFilter API operation. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function when a CreateLogGroup event occurs.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs continuous, centralized delivery of CloudWatch Logs data from multiple AWS accounts to an S3 bucket in a dedicated account. The design must cover both:

- existing log groups, and
- log groups created in the future.

## Correct answer: D

Create the cross-account logging pipeline in the dedicated account:

1. Create an Amazon Data Firehose delivery stream whose destination is the centralized S3 bucket.
2. Create a CloudWatch Logs destination that points to the Firehose stream and permits the source accounts to use it.
3. In the source accounts, create subscription filters for all existing log groups, targeting the cross-account CloudWatch Logs destination.
4. Detect future `CreateLogGroup` API calls with EventBridge and invoke Lambda to call `PutSubscriptionFilter` for each new log group.

AWS explicitly documents cross-account CloudWatch Logs sharing through a CloudWatch Logs destination and a Firehose delivery stream with Amazon S3 storage. The sender creates a subscription filter against the destination in the receiving account. See [Cross-account cross-Region log data sharing using Firehose](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CrossAccountSubscriptions-Firehose.html) and [Step 4: Create a subscription filter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateSubscriptionFilterFirehose.html).

EventBridge rules can react to AWS API calls recorded by CloudTrail and invoke a Lambda function. Therefore, a rule matching the CloudWatch Logs `CreateLogGroup` operation can trigger automation that calls `PutSubscriptionFilter` for newly created log groups. See [Create an EventBridge rule that reacts to AWS API calls via CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html).

This configuration must be deployed across the required accounts and Regions. CloudWatch Logs notes that a log group and its CloudWatch Logs destination must be in the same Region, although the destination can point to a Firehose stream in another Region.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Organizations backup policies

AWS Organizations backup policies govern AWS Backup plans; they do not turn CloudWatch Logs log groups into data that can be backed up directly to S3. CloudWatch Logs is not listed as an AWS Backup-supported resource type. AWS also states that support should not be assumed unless a resource is explicitly listed. See [AWS Backup feature availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html).

An S3 bucket policy allowing organization accounts does not create a CloudWatch Logs delivery mechanism.

### B. AWS Backup plan with an S3 bucket as the backup vault

This option has two fundamental errors:

- CloudWatch Logs log groups are not AWS Backup-supported resources.
- An S3 bucket cannot be specified as an AWS Backup vault. A backup vault is an AWS Backup container that stores and organizes recovery points, not an arbitrary S3 bucket. See [AWS Backup vaults](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vaults.html).

### C. AWS Backup plus Config and Systems Manager remediation

The Config/Automation workflow cannot fix the underlying service incompatibility. CloudWatch Logs log groups still are not supported AWS Backup resources, and an S3 bucket is still not an AWS Backup vault. Automating an invalid backup assignment does not provide centralized log delivery.

Therefore, **D** is the only option that provides a supported cross-account streaming path to S3 and automatically handles future log groups.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中管理 AWS 账户。该公司需要一种解决方案，将 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 数据发送到专用 AWS 账户中的 Amazon S3 存储桶。该解决方案必须支持所有现有和未来的 CloudWatch Logs 日志组。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 启用 Organizations 备份策略，将所有日志组备份到专用 S3 存储桶。添加一个 S3 存储桶策略，允许属于该公司的所有账户访问。
options.B: 在 AWS Backup 中创建备份计划。将专用 S3 存储桶指定为备份保管库。将所有 CloudWatch Logs 日志组资源分配给该备份计划。为属于该公司的所有账户在备份计划中创建资源分配。
options.C: 在 AWS Backup 中创建备份计划。将专用 S3 存储桶指定为备份保管库。将所有现有日志组分配给该备份计划。为属于该公司的所有账户在备份计划中创建资源分配。创建一个 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册，将日志组分配给备份计划。创建一个 AWS Config 规则，为所有不合规日志组配置自动修复操作。将该运行手册指定为规则的目标。
options.D: 在专用 AWS 账户中创建一个 CloudWatch Logs 目标和一个 Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 传输流。将 S3 存储桶指定为传输流的目标。为所有账户中的所有现有日志组创建订阅筛选器。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来调用 CloudWatch Logs PutSubscriptionFilter API 操作。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以便在发生 CreateLogGroup 事件时调用该 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 问题要求

该公司需要一种持续的集中式传输机制，将多个 AWS 账户中的 CloudWatch Logs 数据发送到专用账户中的 S3 存储桶。该设计必须同时涵盖：

- 现有日志组，以及
- 将来创建的日志组。

## 正确答案：D

在专用账户中创建跨账户日志记录管道：

1. 创建一个 Amazon Data Firehose 传输流，并将集中式 S3 存储桶作为其目标。
2. 创建一个指向 Firehose 流的 CloudWatch Logs 目标，并允许源账户使用该目标。
3. 在源账户中，为所有现有日志组创建订阅筛选器，并将其目标指定为跨账户 CloudWatch Logs 目标。
4. 使用 EventBridge 检测未来的 `CreateLogGroup` API 调用，并调用 Lambda 为每个新日志组调用 `PutSubscriptionFilter`。

AWS 明确记录了通过 CloudWatch Logs 目标和 Firehose 传输流实现跨账户 CloudWatch Logs 共享并存储到 Amazon S3 的方式。发送方会针对接收账户中的目标创建订阅筛选器。请参阅 [使用 Firehose 进行跨账户跨区域日志数据共享](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CrossAccountSubscriptions-Firehose.html) 和 [步骤 4：创建订阅筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateSubscriptionFilterFirehose.html)。

EventBridge 规则可以响应由 CloudTrail 记录的 AWS API 调用并调用 Lambda 函数。因此，匹配 CloudWatch Logs `CreateLogGroup` 操作的规则可以触发自动化，为新创建的日志组调用 `PutSubscriptionFilter`。请参阅 [创建一个通过 CloudTrail 对 AWS API 调用作出反应的 EventBridge 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html)。

此配置必须部署到所需的账户和区域中。CloudWatch Logs 指出，日志组及其 CloudWatch Logs 目标必须位于同一 Region，尽管该目标可以指向另一个 Region 中的 Firehose 流。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. Organizations 备份策略

AWS Organizations 备份策略用于管理 AWS Backup 计划；它们不会将 CloudWatch Logs 日志组转变为可以直接备份到 S3 的数据。CloudWatch Logs 未被列为 AWS Backup 支持的资源类型。AWS 还说明，除非某资源被明确列出，否则不应假定该资源受到支持。请参阅 [AWS Backup 功能可用性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/backup-feature-availability.html)。

允许组织账户访问的 S3 存储桶策略不会创建 CloudWatch Logs 传输机制。

### B. 使用 S3 存储桶作为备份保管库的 AWS Backup 计划

此选项存在两个根本错误：

- CloudWatch Logs 日志组不是 AWS Backup 支持的资源。
- 不能将 S3 存储桶指定为 AWS Backup 保管库。备份保管库是一个 AWS Backup 容器，用于存储和组织恢复点，而不是任意的 S3 存储桶。请参阅 [AWS Backup 保管库](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/vaults.html)。

### C. AWS Backup 加上 Config 和 Systems Manager 修复

Config/Automation 工作流无法解决底层服务不兼容的问题。CloudWatch Logs 日志组仍然不是 AWS Backup 支持的资源，S3 存储桶仍然不是 AWS Backup 保管库。自动化无效的备份分配无法实现集中式日志传输。

因此，**D** 是唯一一种可提供受支持的跨账户流式传输路径到 S3，并自动处理未来日志组的选项。

en.question: A DevOps engineer manages a Java-based application that runs in an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on AWS Fargate. Auto scaling has not been configured for the application. The DevOps engineer has determined that the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) thread count is a good indicator of when to scale the application. The application serves customer traffic on port 8080 and makes JVM metrics available on port 9404. Application use has recently increased. The DevOps engineer needs to configure auto scaling for the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent as a container sidecar. Configure the CloudWatch agent to retrieve JVM metrics from port 9404. Create CloudWatch alarms on the JVM thread count metric to scale the application. Add a step scaling policy in Fargate to scale up and scale down based on the CloudWatch alarms.
options.B: Deploy the Amazon CloudWatch agent as a container sidecar. Configure a metric filter for the JVM thread count metric on the CloudWatch log group for the CloudWatch agent. Add a target tracking policy in Fargate. Select the metric from the metric filter as a scale target.
options.C: Create an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace. Deploy AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry as a container sidecar to publish the JVM metrics from port 9404 to the Prometheus workspace. Configure rules for the workspace to use the JVM thread count metric to scale the application. Add a step scaling policy in Fargate. Select the Prometheus rules to scale up and scaling down.
options.D: Create an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace. Deploy AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry as a container sidecar to retrieve JVM metrics from port 9404 to publish the JVM metrics from port 9404 to the Prometheus workspace. Add a target tracking policy in Fargate. Select the Prometheus metric as a scale target.

en.explanation:
## Correct answers: A and B

The Java application runs as an Amazon ECS service on AWS Fargate and exposes Prometheus-format JVM metrics on port 9404. The scaling signal is JVM thread count, so the solution must collect that metric and make it available to ECS Service Auto Scaling through Application Auto Scaling.

### A. Use the CloudWatch agent and CloudWatch alarm-based step scaling

The CloudWatch agent can run with an ECS workload and scrape Prometheus metrics, including Java/JMX metrics exposed on port 9404. AWS documents JVM thread count as the metric **`jvm_threads_current`** in the Java/JMX metrics collected by Container Insights. See:

- [Installing the CloudWatch agent with Prometheus metric collection on Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-install-ECS.html)
- [Java/JMX sample workload for Amazon ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Sample-Workloads-ECS-javajmx.html)
- [Prometheus metrics collected by Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-metrics.html)

The agent converts selected Prometheus metrics into CloudWatch embedded-metric-format data and publishes them to CloudWatch. The engineer can create CloudWatch alarms for high and low JVM thread-count thresholds and associate those alarms with scale-out and scale-in step scaling policies.

Application Auto Scaling explicitly supports step scaling for ECS services, and customer-created CloudWatch alarms invoke the corresponding scaling policies. Therefore, this is a complete, natively supported monitoring-to-scaling path. See [Step scaling policies for Application Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/application-auto-scaling-step-scaling-policies.html).

### B. Create a CloudWatch custom metric and use target tracking

The CloudWatch agent’s ECS Prometheus pipeline writes embedded-metric-format log events to the following CloudWatch Logs group:

`/aws/ecs/containerinsights/<cluster-name>/prometheus`

This behavior is documented in [Configuring the CloudWatch agent for Prometheus metric collection on ECS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Setup-configure-ECS.html).

A metric filter on that log group can extract the numeric **`jvm_threads_current`** value and publish it as a custom CloudWatch metric. CloudWatch Logs metric filters support converting values in matching log events into CloudWatch metrics. See [Creating a metric filter for a CloudWatch Logs log group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html).

Application Auto Scaling target tracking can then use this custom CloudWatch metric by specifying its namespace, metric name, dimensions, and statistic. Application Auto Scaling automatically creates and manages the required CloudWatch alarms, reducing ongoing alarm and scaling-policy administration. See:

- [Creating a target tracking policy with a custom CloudWatch metric](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/create-target-tracking-policy-cli.html)
- [How target tracking scaling policies work](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/target-tracking-scaling-policy-overview.html)

The metric should be configured as an average JVM thread count per task or equivalent capacity-proportional measurement. Target tracking metrics must change proportionally with scalable capacity; after additional tasks distribute the workload, the average load per task should move back toward the configured target.

Although the metric filter is unnecessary if the embedded metric format output already produces the desired CloudWatch metric, it is still a supported way to create the custom metric required by the option. Thus, B provides a valid end-to-end CloudWatch target-tracking solution.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### C. Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus rules cannot directly invoke step scaling

AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry can scrape the application’s Prometheus endpoint and export metrics to an Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace. AWS documents this collection pattern for ECS application metrics in [Exporting Amazon ECS application metrics to Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/application-metrics-prometheus.html).

However, an AMP recording or alerting rule cannot be selected directly as the trigger for an ECS step scaling policy. Application Auto Scaling step scaling is invoked by **CloudWatch alarms**, not by Prometheus workspace rules. The option does not include any additional mechanism to translate an AMP alert into a CloudWatch alarm or an Application Auto Scaling action. Therefore, C does not provide a supported end-to-end scaling path.

### D. An AMP metric cannot be selected directly as an ECS target-tracking metric

ADOT can publish the JVM metrics to an AMP workspace, but ECS Service Auto Scaling target tracking does not directly accept an AMP workspace metric or PromQL query as its target metric.

Target tracking uses either a predefined metric or a customized **CloudWatch metric**, and Application Auto Scaling creates and manages CloudWatch alarms for that metric. This behavior is documented in [Target tracking scaling policies for Amazon ECS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/service-autoscaling-targettracking.html) and the [custom target-tracking metric configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/create-target-tracking-policy-cli.html).

Consequently, the instruction to select the Prometheus metric in AMP directly as the scaling target is not a supported configuration. An additional bridge that republishes or transforms the AMP data into a CloudWatch custom metric would be required, but D does not include one and such a bridge would add operational overhead.

## Final answer

**A and B** provide supported paths in which JVM thread count becomes a CloudWatch metric that Application Auto Scaling can use to scale the ECS service.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师管理一个基于 Java 的应用程序，该应用程序运行在 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群中。尚未为该应用程序配置自动扩缩。DevOps 工程师确定 Java Virtual Machine (JVM) 线程数是判断何时扩缩应用程序的良好指标。该应用程序通过端口 8080 为客户流量提供服务，并通过端口 9404 提供 JVM 指标。最近应用程序的使用量有所增加。DevOps 工程师需要为该应用程序配置自动扩缩。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 将 Amazon CloudWatch agent 部署为容器 sidecar。配置 CloudWatch agent 从端口 9404 获取 JVM 指标。针对 JVM 线程数指标创建 CloudWatch 告警以扩缩应用程序。在 Fargate 中添加 step scaling policy，以根据 CloudWatch 告警进行扩容和缩容。
options.B: 将 Amazon CloudWatch agent 部署为容器 sidecar。在 CloudWatch agent 的 CloudWatch log group 上为 JVM 线程数指标配置 metric filter。在 Fargate 中添加 target tracking policy。选择 metric filter 中的指标作为扩缩目标。
options.C: 创建一个 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace。将 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry 部署为容器 sidecar，以将端口 9404 中的 JVM 指标发布到 Prometheus workspace。为 workspace 配置规则以使用 JVM 线程数指标扩缩应用程序。在 Fargate 中添加 step scaling policy。选择 Prometheus 规则以进行扩容和缩容。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus workspace。将 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry 部署为容器 sidecar，以从端口 9404 获取 JVM 指标，并将端口 9404 中的 JVM 指标发布到 Prometheus workspace。在 Fargate 中添加 target tracking policy。选择 Prometheus 指标作为扩缩目标。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A 和 B

Java 应用程序作为 AWS Fargate 上的 Amazon ECS 服务运行，并在端口 9404 上公开 Prometheus 格式的 JVM 指标。扩缩信号是 JVM 线程数，因此该解决方案必须收集该指标，并通过 Application Auto Scaling 将其提供给 ECS Service Auto Scaling。

### A. 使用 CloudWatch agent 和基于 CloudWatch 告警的 step scaling

CloudWatch agent 可以与 ECS 工作负载一同运行，并抓取 Prometheus 指标，包括在端口 9404 上公开的 Java/JMX 指标。AWS 将 JVM 线程数记录为由 Container Insights 收集的 Java/JMX 指标 **`jvm_threads_current`**。请参阅：

- [在 Amazon ECS 上安装 CloudWatch agent 并启用 Prometheus 指标收集](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-install-ECS.html)
- [Amazon ECS 的 Java/JMX 示例工作负载](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Sample-Workloads-ECS-javajmx.html)
- [由 Container Insights 收集的 Prometheus 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-metrics.html)

该 agent 会将选定的 Prometheus 指标转换为 CloudWatch embedded-metric-format 数据并发布到 CloudWatch。工程师可以为高、低 JVM 线程数阈值创建 CloudWatch 告警，并将这些告警关联到扩容和缩容 step scaling policy。

Application Auto Scaling 明确支持 ECS 服务的 step scaling，并且由客户创建的 CloudWatch 告警会调用相应的扩缩策略。因此，这是一个完整且原生支持的从监控到扩缩的路径。请参阅 [Application Auto Scaling 的 Step scaling policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/application/userguide/application-auto-scaling-step-scaling-policies.html)。

### B. 创建 CloudWatch custom metric 并使用 target tracking

CloudWatch agent 的 ECS Prometheus 管道会将 embedded-metric-format 日志事件写入以下 CloudWatch Logs group：

`/aws/ecs/containerinsights/<cluster-name>/prometheus`
