AWS provides an Organizations tutorial that specifically demonstrates an SCP denying CloudTrail configuration operations, including `cloudtrail:StopLogging` and `cloudtrail:DeleteTrail`, and explains that attaching it to the organization root affects all member accounts and prevents users from altering the CloudTrail configuration. See [Step 3: Create the service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_tutorials_basic.html) and [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Therefore, **A** is the appropriate centralized preventive control. In practice, the SCP can be attached to the organization root or to every OU containing the governed member accounts. SCPs do not affect the Organizations management account, so the protected CloudTrail configuration should be administered from the management account or an appropriately designed delegated administration model.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Create IAM deny policies in each account

This is decentralized and less tamper-resistant. An administrator in a member account could potentially modify or detach an account-managed IAM policy. By contrast, an SCP is controlled through AWS Organizations and limits member-account permissions even if the account administrator grants broad IAM permissions. AWS states that an action blocked by an SCP cannot be used even when an administrator attaches `AdministratorAccess`. See [SCP effects on permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

### C. Configure CloudWatch alarms

An alarm is a **detective** control: it can notify the security team only after the disabling API request has occurred. AWS documents that API calls recorded by CloudTrail can trigger event-based automation, but such monitoring reacts to an API call rather than preventing it. See [Create an EventBridge rule for an AWS API call via CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html). It therefore does not ensure users cannot disable CloudTrail.

### D. Use AWS Config to re-enable CloudTrail

AWS Config is principally a compliance evaluation and remediation mechanism, not a preventive authorization control. The `cloudtrail-enabled` managed rule periodically checks whether a trail is enabled and reports `NON_COMPLIANT` when it is not. See [AWS Config `cloudtrail-enabled`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudtrail-enabled.html). Even with automated remediation, CloudTrail could be disabled temporarily, creating a monitoring gap, and users would still be able to invoke the disabling action.

**Answer: A**

zh.question: 某安全团队希望使用 AWS CloudTrail 监控 AWS Organizations 中同一组织内多个账户中的所有操作和 API 调用。安全团队需要确保账户用户无法在这些账户中关闭 CloudTrail。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 对所有 OU 应用 SCP，以拒绝 `cloudtrail:StopLogging` 操作和 `cloudtrail:DeleteTrail` 操作。
options.B: 在每个账户中创建 IAM 策略，以拒绝 `cloudtrail:StopLogging` 操作和 `cloudtrail:DeleteTrail` 操作。
options.C: 设置 Amazon CloudWatch 告警，以便在用户在账户中禁用 CloudTrail 时通知安全团队。
options.D: 如果用户在账户中禁用 CloudTrail，则使用 AWS Config 自动重新启用 CloudTrail。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

安全团队需要一个**预防性的、覆盖整个组织的防护措施**，以阻止成员账户中的身份禁用或删除 CloudTrail 日志记录。在变更发生后再进行通知或修复，无法满足确保账户用户**不能**关闭 CloudTrail 的要求。

## 正确答案：A

**对所有 OU 应用 SCP，以拒绝 `cloudtrail:StopLogging` 和 `cloudtrail:DeleteTrail`。**

AWS Organizations 服务控制策略 (SCP) 定义了受影响成员账户中身份可获得的最大权限。适用 SCP 中的显式拒绝不能通过在成员账户中授予 `AdministratorAccess` 或其他 IAM 策略来覆盖。SCP 还会限制成员账户的根用户。

AWS 提供了一份 Organizations 教程，其中专门演示了拒绝 CloudTrail 配置操作（包括 `cloudtrail:StopLogging` 和 `cloudtrail:DeleteTrail`）的 SCP，并说明将其附加到组织根会影响所有成员账户，并阻止用户更改 CloudTrail 配置。请参阅 [步骤 3：创建服务控制策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_tutorials_basic.html) 和 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

因此，**A** 是合适的集中式预防控制措施。实际上，SCP 可以附加到组织根，也可以附加到包含受治理成员账户的每个 OU。SCP 不影响 Organizations 管理账户，因此受保护的 CloudTrail 配置应从管理账户进行管理，或通过经过适当设计的委派管理模型进行管理。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. 在每个账户中创建 IAM 拒绝策略

这是一种分散式方法，且抗篡改能力较弱。成员账户中的管理员可能会修改或分离账户管理的 IAM 策略。相比之下，SCP 通过 AWS Organizations 进行控制；即使账户管理员授予了广泛的 IAM 权限，它仍会限制成员账户的权限。AWS 说明，即使管理员附加了 `AdministratorAccess`，被 SCP 阻止的操作也无法使用。请参阅 [SCP 对权限的影响](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

### C. 配置 CloudWatch 告警

告警是一种**检测性**控制：只有在禁用 API 请求发生后，它才能通知安全团队。AWS 文档说明，由 CloudTrail 记录的 API 调用可以触发基于事件的自动化，但此类监控是对 API 调用作出响应，而不是阻止该调用。请参阅 [为通过 CloudTrail 的 AWS API 调用创建 EventBridge 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html)。因此，它无法确保用户不能禁用 CloudTrail。

### D. 使用 AWS Config 重新启用 CloudTrail

AWS Config 的主要功能是合规性评估和修复机制，而不是预防性的授权控制。`cloudtrail-enabled` 托管规则会定期检查跟踪是否已启用；如果未启用，则报告 `NON_COMPLIANT`。请参阅 [AWS Config `cloudtrail-enabled`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/cloudtrail-enabled.html)。即使使用自动修复，CloudTrail 仍可能会暂时被禁用，从而造成监控缺口，而且用户仍然能够调用禁用操作。

**答案：A**

en.question: A DevOps engineer needs to configure a blue/green deployment for an existing three-tier application. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon RDS database. The EC2 instances run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and are in an Auto Scaling group. The DevOps engineer has created launch templates, Auto Scaling groups, and ALB target groups for the blue environment and the green environment. Each target group specifies which application version, blue or green, will be loaded on the EC2 instances. An Amazon Route 53 record for www.example.com points to the ALB. The deployment must shift traffic all at once from the blue environment to the green environment. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Starta rolling restart of the Auto Scaling group for the green environment to deploy the new application version to the green environment's EC2 instances. When the rolling restart is complete, use an AWS CLI command to update the ALB to send traffic to the green environment's target group.
options.B: Use an AWS CLI command to update the ALB to send traffic to the green environments target group. Start a rolling restart of the Auto Scaling group for the green environment to deploy the new application version to the green environment's EC2 instances.
options.C: Update the launch template to deploy the green environment's application version to the blue environment's EC2 instances. Do not change the target groups or the Auto Scaling groups in either environment. Perform a rolling restart of the blue environments EC2 instances.
options.D: Starta rolling restart of the Auto Scaling group for the green environment to deploy the new application version to the green environment's EC2 instances. When the rolling restart is complete, update Route 53 to point to the green environment's endpoint on the ALB.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The blue and green environments already have separate launch templates, Auto Scaling groups, and ALB target groups. The requirement is to:

1. Deploy and validate the new application version on the green fleet while production traffic remains on blue.
2. Shift production traffic **all at once** to the green target group.

## Correct answer: A

First, perform the rolling restart/instance refresh of the **green Auto Scaling group**. An EC2 Auto Scaling instance refresh replaces instances in batches using the desired launch-template configuration, waits for health and warmup, and can maintain availability during the replacement process. This prepares the complete green fleet before it receives production traffic. See [How an instance refresh works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-refresh-overview.html).

After the green refresh completes, modify the ALB listener's forwarding action so that it points to the green target group. AWS documents that the listener's default action can be changed with `modify-listener`:

```bash
aws elbv2 modify-listener \
  --listener-arn listener-arn \
  --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=green-target-group-arn
```

This changes the ALB from forwarding to blue to forwarding to green, providing the required all-at-once traffic cutover. See [Edit an Application Load Balancer listener rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-rule.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B:** This reverses the required order. It sends production traffic to the green target group **before** the green Auto Scaling group has completed deployment of the new application version. Users could reach old, inconsistent, restarting, or insufficiently validated green instances.

- **C:** This is an in-place rolling deployment to the existing blue environment, not a blue/green deployment. It also replaces blue instances gradually, so it does not provide an all-at-once switch between two separately prepared environments or preserve the original blue fleet for rapid rollback.

- **D:** Route 53 already points `www.example.com` to the ALB. Route 53 aliases route DNS traffic to the load balancer itself, not to an individual ALB target group or a target-group-specific ALB endpoint. AWS documents configuring the Route 53 record with the load balancer's DNS name as the alias target. The selection of blue versus green must therefore be changed in the ALB listener action, not in Route 53. See [Configuring Route 53 to route traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html). DNS changes would also introduce propagation and client caching considerations instead of directly switching the ALB's forwarding target.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师需要为现有的三层应用程序配置蓝/绿部署。该应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并使用 Amazon RDS 数据库。EC2 实例运行在 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 后面，并且位于一个 Auto Scaling 组中。DevOps 工程师已为蓝色环境和绿色环境创建了启动模板、Auto Scaling 组和 ALB 目标组。每个目标组指定将在 EC2 实例上加载哪个应用程序版本，即蓝色或绿色版本。一个用于 www.example.com 的 Amazon Route 53 记录指向该 ALB。部署必须将流量一次性从蓝色环境切换到绿色环境。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 启动绿色环境 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启，以将新应用程序版本部署到绿色环境的 EC2 实例上。滚动重启完成后，使用 AWS CLI 命令更新 ALB，使其将流量发送到绿色环境的目标组。
options.B: 使用 AWS CLI 命令更新 ALB，使其将流量发送到绿色环境的目标组。启动绿色环境 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启，以将新应用程序版本部署到绿色环境的 EC2 实例上。
options.C: 更新启动模板，以便将绿色环境的应用程序版本部署到蓝色环境的 EC2 实例上。不要更改任一环境中的目标组或 Auto Scaling 组。对蓝色环境的 EC2 实例执行滚动重启。
options.D: 启动绿色环境 Auto Scaling 组的滚动重启，以将新应用程序版本部署到绿色环境的 EC2 实例上。滚动重启完成后，更新 Route 53，使其指向 ALB 上绿色环境的终端节点。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

蓝色和绿色环境已经分别拥有独立的启动模板、Auto Scaling 组和 ALB 目标组。要求是：

1. 在生产流量仍保留在蓝色环境时，将新应用程序版本部署并验证到绿色实例集群。
2. 将生产流量**一次性**切换到绿色目标组。

## 正确答案：A

首先，对**绿色 Auto Scaling 组**执行滚动重启/实例刷新。EC2 Auto Scaling 实例刷新会使用所需的启动模板配置分批替换实例，等待运行状况检查和预热完成，并且可以在替换过程中保持可用性。这样可以在绿色实例集群接收生产流量之前完成其准备工作。请参阅 [How an instance refresh works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/instance-refresh-overview.html)。

绿色刷新完成后，修改 ALB 侦听器的转发操作，使其指向绿色目标组。AWS 文档说明，可以使用 `modify-listener` 更改侦听器的默认操作：

```bash
aws elbv2 modify-listener \
  --listener-arn listener-arn \
  --default-actions Type=forward,TargetGroupArn=green-target-group-arn
```

这会将 ALB 从转发到蓝色环境改为转发到绿色环境，从而实现所需的一次性流量切换。请参阅 [Edit an Application Load Balancer listener rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-rule.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **B：** 此选项颠倒了所需的顺序。它在绿色 Auto Scaling 组完成新应用程序版本部署**之前**，就将生产流量发送到绿色目标组。用户可能会访问旧版本、不一致、正在重启或尚未充分验证的绿色实例。

- **C：** 这是对现有蓝色环境进行的原地滚动部署，而不是蓝/绿部署。它还会逐步替换蓝色实例，因此无法在两个独立准备的环境之间提供一次性切换，也无法保留原始蓝色实例集群以便快速回滚。

- **D：** Route 53 已将 `www.example.com` 指向 ALB。Route 53 别名会将 DNS 流量路由到负载均衡器本身，而不是某个单独的 ALB 目标组或特定目标组的 ALB 终端节点。因此，蓝色与绿色环境的选择必须在 ALB 侦听器操作中更改，而不是在 Route 53 中更改。AWS 文档说明，应将负载均衡器的 DNS 名称配置为 Route 53 记录的别名目标。请参阅 [Configuring Route 53 to route traffic to an ELB load balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-to-elb-load-balancer.html)。DNS 更改还会带来传播和客户端缓存方面的考量，而不是直接切换 ALB 的转发目标。

en.question: A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. The application processes a high volume of messages from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. A DevOps engineer noticed that the application took several hours to process a group of messages from the SQS queue. The average CPU utilization of the Auto Scaling group did not cross the threshold of a target tracking scaling policy when processing the messages. The application that processes the SQS queue publishes logs to ‘Amazon CloudWatch Logs. The DevOps engineer needs to ensure that the queue is processed quickly. Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to publish a custom metric by using the ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible SQS queue attribute and the GroupInServiceInstances Auto Scaling group attribute to publish the queue messages for each instance. Schedule an Amazon EventBridge rule to run the Lambda function every hour. Create a target tracking scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group that uses the custom metric to scale in and out.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to publish a custom metric by using the ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible SQS queue attribute and the GroupInServiceInstances Auto Scaling group attribute to publish the queue messages for each instance. Create a CloudWatch subscription filter for the application logs with the Lambda function as the target. Create a target tracking scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group that uses the custom metric to scale in and out.
options.C: Create a target tracking scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. In the target tracking policy, use the ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible SQS queue attribute and the GroupInServiceInstances Auto Scaling group attribute to calculate how many messages are in the queue for each number of instances by using metric math. Use the calculated attribute to scale in and out.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that logs the ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible attribute of the SQS queue to a CloudWatch Logs log group. Schedule an Amazon EventBridge rule to run the Lambda function every 5 minutes. Create a metric filer to count the number of log events from a CloudWatch logs group. Create a target tracking scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group that uses the custom metric to scale in and out.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The EC2 workers are processing an SQS backlog, but average CPU utilization is not proportional to the amount of queued work. The scaling policy therefore needs a metric that represents **work per available worker**, while minimizing custom code and supporting infrastructure.

## Correct answer: C

Use a target tracking policy with CloudWatch metric math to calculate **SQS backlog per EC2 instance**:

`ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible / GroupInServiceInstances`

AWS documents this exact target tracking pattern. `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` represents messages available for processing, and `GroupInServiceInstances` represents the Auto Scaling group's running capacity. AWS's metric-math example uses the expression `m1 / m2` and returns that expression as the scaling metric. See [Create a target tracking scaling policy using metric math — Example: Amazon SQS queue backlog per instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-target-tracking-metric-math.html).

This metric is more appropriate than CPU utilization because it scales with the actual unprocessed workload relative to the number of workers. AWS also explains that queue depth alone might not change proportionally with Auto Scaling group capacity and recommends **backlog per instance** with an acceptable backlog target. See [Scaling based on Amazon SQS — Use target tracking with the right metric](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html).

Because both source metrics are available in CloudWatch and can be combined directly in the target tracking policy, this solution avoids Lambda functions, schedules, log subscriptions, and separately published custom metrics. It therefore has the least operational overhead.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Scheduled Lambda every hour

Although the Lambda function could calculate and publish backlog per instance, it adds custom code, IAM permissions, scheduling, monitoring, and maintenance that metric math eliminates. More importantly, an hourly calculation is too infrequent for a requirement to process a high-volume queue quickly; the scaling signal could be almost an hour late.

### B. Invoke Lambda through a CloudWatch Logs subscription

This also unnecessarily introduces and operates a Lambda-based custom metric publisher. A log subscription is not an appropriate or reliable scheduler for calculating queue backlog per instance: invocations would depend on application log traffic rather than a controlled metric interval and could occur excessively during high-volume processing. Direct CloudWatch metric math provides the required signal without coupling scaling to application logs.

### D. Log queue depth and count log events

This is both operationally complex and technically incorrect. The Lambda runs every 5 minutes and logs the queue-depth value, but the proposed metric filter **counts log events**. That count would generally represent how many times the scheduled function logged—not the `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` value contained in each event. It therefore would not provide the required queue backlog metric. It also adds Lambda, EventBridge, CloudWatch Logs, and a custom metric filter when direct metric math is supported.

Amazon SQS already publishes `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` in the `AWS/SQS` namespace; AWS describes it as the number of messages currently available for retrieval and processing. See [Available CloudWatch metrics for Amazon SQS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-available-cloudwatch-metrics.html).

zh.question: 某公司有一个应用程序运行在 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。该应用程序处理来自 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列的大量消息。一名 DevOps 工程师注意到，该应用程序花费了数小时才处理完 SQS 队列中的一组消息。在处理这些消息时，Auto Scaling 组的平均 CPU 利用率未超过目标跟踪扩缩策略的阈值。处理 SQS 队列的应用程序会将日志发布到 ‘Amazon CloudWatch Logs。DevOps 工程师需要确保能够快速处理队列。哪种解决方案能以**最低的运维开销**满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数，使用 ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible SQS 队列属性和 GroupInServiceInstances Auto Scaling 组属性发布自定义指标，以发布每个实例的队列消息数。安排一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每小时运行一次 Lambda 函数。为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个目标跟踪扩缩策略，该策略使用此自定义指标进行扩容和缩容。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数，使用 ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible SQS 队列属性和 GroupInServiceInstances Auto Scaling 组属性发布自定义指标，以发布每个实例的队列消息数。为应用程序日志创建一个 CloudWatch 订阅筛选器，并将 Lambda 函数作为目标。为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个目标跟踪扩缩策略，该策略使用此自定义指标进行扩容和缩容。
options.C: 为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个目标跟踪扩缩策略。在目标跟踪策略中，使用 ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible SQS 队列属性和 GroupInServiceInstances Auto Scaling 组属性，通过指标数学计算每个实例对应的队列消息数。使用计算得出的属性进行扩容和缩容。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，将 SQS 队列的 ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible 属性记录到 CloudWatch Logs 日志组。安排一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每 5 分钟运行一次 Lambda 函数。创建一个指标筛选器以统计 CloudWatch Logs 日志组中的日志事件数量。为 Auto Scaling 组创建一个目标跟踪扩缩策略，该策略使用此自定义指标进行扩容和缩容。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查的内容

EC2 工作实例正在处理 SQS 积压消息，但平均 CPU 利用率并不与排队工作量成正比。因此，扩缩策略需要一个表示**每个可用工作实例的工作量**的指标，同时尽量减少自定义代码和支持基础设施。

## 正确答案：C

使用带有 CloudWatch 指标数学的目标跟踪策略来计算**每个 EC2 实例对应的 SQS 积压消息数**：

`ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible / GroupInServiceInstances`

AWS 记录了这一确切的目标跟踪模式。`ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` 表示可供处理的消息，`GroupInServiceInstances` 表示 Auto Scaling 组正在运行的容量。AWS 的指标数学示例使用表达式 `m1 / m2`，并将该表达式作为扩缩指标返回。请参阅 [使用指标数学创建目标跟踪扩缩策略 — 示例：每个实例的 Amazon SQS 队列积压消息](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/ec2-auto-scaling-target-tracking-metric-math.html)。

该指标比 CPU 利用率更合适，因为它会随实际未处理工作负载相对于工作实例数量的变化而变化。AWS 还说明，仅使用队列深度可能不会随 Auto Scaling 组容量成比例变化，并建议使用具有可接受积压目标的**每实例积压消息数**。请参阅 [基于 Amazon SQS 进行扩缩 — 使用具有正确指标的目标跟踪](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/as-using-sqs-queue.html)。

由于两个源指标都可在 CloudWatch 中获取，并且可以直接在目标跟踪策略中组合，因此该解决方案无需 Lambda 函数、计划任务、日志订阅和单独发布的自定义指标。因此，它具有最低的运维开销。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 每小时运行一次的计划 Lambda

虽然 Lambda 函数可以计算并发布每实例积压消息数，但它会增加指标数学所能避免的自定义代码、IAM 权限、计划、监控和维护。更重要的是，对于需要快速处理高容量队列的要求而言，每小时计算一次频率太低；扩缩信号可能会延迟近一小时。

### B. 通过 CloudWatch Logs 订阅调用 Lambda

该方案同样不必要地引入并需要运维一个基于 Lambda 的自定义指标发布器。日志订阅并不是计算每实例队列积压消息数的恰当或可靠调度机制：调用将取决于应用程序日志流量，而不是受控的指标时间间隔，并且在高容量处理期间可能过度触发。直接使用 CloudWatch 指标数学即可提供所需信号，而不会将扩缩与应用程序日志耦合。

### D. 记录队列深度并统计日志事件

此方案既增加运维复杂性，又在技术上不正确。Lambda 每 5 分钟运行一次并记录队列深度值，但所提议的指标筛选器会**统计日志事件数量**。该计数通常表示计划函数记录日志的次数，而不是每个事件中包含的 `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible` 值。因此，它无法提供所需的队列积压指标。此外，在直接支持指标数学的情况下，该方案还增加了 Lambda、EventBridge、CloudWatch Logs 和自定义指标筛选器。

Amazon SQS 已在 `AWS/SQS` 命名空间中发布 `ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible`；AWS 将其描述为当前可供检索和处理的消息数量。请参阅 [Amazon SQS 可用的 CloudWatch 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-available-cloudwatch-metrics.html)。

en.question: A company has a single AWS account that runs hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances in a single AWS Region. The company launches and terminates new EC2 instances every hour. The account includes existing EC2 instances that have been running for longer than a week. The company's security policy requires all running EC2 instances to have an EC2 instance profile attached. The company has created a default EC2 instance profile. The default EC2 instance profile must be attached to any EC2 instances that do not have a profile attached. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches the Amazon EC2 RunInstances API calls. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to attach the default instance profile to the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure AWS Config. Deploy an AWS Config ec2-instance-profile-attached managed rule. Configure an automatic remediation action that invokes an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to attach the default instance profile to the EC2 instances.
options.C: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches the Amazon EC2 StartInstances API calls. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook to attach the default instance profile to the EC2 instances.
options.D: Configure AWS Config. Deploy an AWS Config iam-role-managed-policy-check managed rule. Configure an automatic remediation action that invokes an AWS Lambda function to attach the default instance profile to the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs a continuous compliance and remediation solution that covers both:

- newly launched EC2 instances, and
- existing running instances, including instances that have already been running for more than a week.

Any running instance without an IAM instance profile must be detected and have the default profile attached.

## Correct answer: B

The AWS Config managed rule **`ec2-instance-profile-attached`** is designed specifically for this requirement. It evaluates `AWS::EC2::Instance` resources and marks an instance `NON_COMPLIANT` when no IAM instance profile is attached. It is triggered by configuration changes. In addition, when a rule is first added, AWS Config performs an initial evaluation of applicable resources, so it can identify both existing instances and future configuration changes—not merely future launch events. See [ec2-instance-profile-attached](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-instance-profile-attached.html) and [How AWS Config Rules Work and Trigger Types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_components.html).

AWS Config remediation uses **Systems Manager Automation documents** to correct noncompliant resources. An AWS-managed runbook such as **`AWS-AttachIAMToInstance`** can associate an IAM instance profile with the affected EC2 instance. The runbook accepts the instance ID and IAM role name, finds or creates the corresponding instance profile, and attaches it to the instance. See [Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html) and [AWS-AttachIAMToInstance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-attachiamtoinstance.html).

Therefore, **B** provides both fleet-wide detection and automatic remediation for existing and newly created instances.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. EventBridge rule for `RunInstances`

A rule matching `RunInstances` handles only instances associated with future launch API calls. It does not retroactively evaluate the existing EC2 instances that have been running for longer than a week. Consequently, existing running instances without profiles could remain noncompliant.

### C. EventBridge rule for `StartInstances`

`StartInstances` applies when stopped instances are started. It does not cover normal instance launches, and it does not detect existing instances that remain continuously running. This therefore leaves substantial parts of the fleet unevaluated.

### D. `iam-role-managed-policy-check` with Lambda

The `iam-role-managed-policy-check` rule evaluates whether specified managed policies are attached to an **IAM role**; it does not determine whether an **EC2 instance has an instance profile attached**. See [iam-role-managed-policy-check](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/iam-role-managed-policy-check.html). Additionally, AWS Config remediation actions are based on Systems Manager Automation documents rather than directly configuring a Lambda function as the remediation target. Thus, both the selected compliance rule and remediation design are inappropriate for this requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司拥有一个 AWS 账户，该账户在单个 AWS Region 中运行数百个 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司每小时都会启动和终止新的 EC2 实例。该账户中包含已运行超过一周的现有 EC2 实例。公司的安全策略要求所有正在运行的 EC2 实例都必须附加 EC2 实例配置文件。该公司已创建默认 EC2 实例配置文件。必须将默认 EC2 实例配置文件附加到所有尚未附加配置文件的 EC2 实例。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 配置一个与 Amazon EC2 RunInstances API 调用匹配的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将默认实例配置文件附加到 EC2 实例。
options.B: 配置 AWS Config。部署 AWS Config ec2-instance-profile-attached 托管规则。配置一项自动修复操作，以调用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册，将默认实例配置文件附加到 EC2 实例。
options.C: 配置一个与 Amazon EC2 StartInstances API 调用匹配的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则以调用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 运行手册，将默认实例配置文件附加到 EC2 实例。
options.D: 配置 AWS Config。部署 AWS Config iam-role-managed-policy-check 托管规则。配置一项自动修复操作，以调用 AWS Lambda 函数，将默认实例配置文件附加到 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司需要持续的合规性与修复解决方案，以覆盖以下两种情况：

- 新启动的 EC2 实例，以及
- 现有的正在运行的实例，包括已运行超过一周的实例。

必须检测任何未附加 IAM 实例配置文件的正在运行实例，并为其附加默认配置文件。

## 正确答案：B

AWS Config 托管规则 **`ec2-instance-profile-attached`** 专门用于满足此要求。该规则评估 `AWS::EC2::Instance` 资源；当未附加 IAM 实例配置文件时，会将实例标记为 `NON_COMPLIANT`。该规则由配置更改触发。此外，首次添加规则时，AWS Config 会对适用资源执行初始评估，因此它可以识别现有实例和未来的配置更改，而不只是未来的启动事件。请参阅 [ec2-instance-profile-attached](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-instance-profile-attached.html) 和 [How AWS Config Rules Work and Trigger Types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_components.html)。

AWS Config 修复使用 **Systems Manager Automation documents** 来修正不合规资源。诸如 **`AWS-AttachIAMToInstance`** 的 AWS 托管运行手册可以将 IAM 实例配置文件关联到受影响的 EC2 实例。该运行手册接受实例 ID 和 IAM 角色名称，查找或创建相应的实例配置文件，并将其附加到实例。请参阅 [Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html) 和 [AWS-AttachIAMToInstance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-attachiamtoinstance.html)。

因此，**B** 同时为现有实例和新创建的实例提供全范围检测和自动修复。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 用于 `RunInstances` 的 EventBridge 规则

与 `RunInstances` 匹配的规则仅处理与未来启动 API 调用相关的实例。它不会追溯评估已运行超过一周的现有 EC2 实例。因此，未附加配置文件的现有正在运行实例可能仍然不合规。

### C. 用于 `StartInstances` 的 EventBridge 规则

`StartInstances` 适用于启动已停止的实例。它不涵盖常规实例启动，也不会检测持续运行的现有实例。因此，这会导致大量实例未被评估。

### D. 使用 Lambda 的 `iam-role-managed-policy-check`

`iam-role-managed-policy-check` 规则评估指定的托管策略是否附加到 **IAM 角色**；它不会确定 **EC2 实例是否附加了实例配置文件**。请参阅 [iam-role-managed-policy-check](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/iam-role-managed-policy-check.html)。此外，AWS Config 修复操作基于 Systems Manager Automation documents，而不是将 Lambda 函数直接配置为修复目标。因此，所选的合规性规则和修复设计均不适合此要求。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage hundreds of AWS accounts. The company has a team that is responsible for AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). The IAM team wants to implement AWS IAM Identity Center. The IAM team must have only the minimum required permissions to manage IAM Identity Center. The IAM team must not be able to gain unnecessary access to the Organizations management account. The IAM team must be able to provision new IAM Identity Center permission sets and assignments for new and existing member accounts. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create a new AWS account for the IAM team. Enable IAM Identity Center in the new account. In the Organizations management account, register the new account as a delegated administrator for IAM Identity Center.
options.B: Create a new AWS account for the IAM team. Enable IAM Identity Center in the Organizations management account. In the Organizations management account, register the new account as a delegated administrator for IAM Identity Center.
options.C: Create an SCP in Organizations. Create a new OU for the Organizations management account, and link the new SCP to the OU. Configure the SCP to deny all access to IAM Identity Center.
options.D: Create IAM users and an IAM group for the IAM team in IAM Identity Center. Add the users to the group. Create a new permission set. Attach the AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator managed IAM policy to the group.
options.E: Assign the new permission set to the Organizations management account. Allow the IAM team's group to use the permission set.
options.F: Assign the new permission set to the new AWS account. Allow the IAM team's group to use the permission set.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs to let the IAM team administer IAM Identity Center across organization member accounts while avoiding routine access to the highly privileged Organizations management account. The appropriate design is to keep the organization instance in the management account, delegate IAM Identity Center administration to a dedicated member account, and give the team an administrative permission set only in that delegated account.

## Correct answers: B, D, and F

### B. Enable IAM Identity Center in the management account and register the new member account as delegated administrator

An organization instance of IAM Identity Center resides in the AWS Organizations management account. AWS explicitly states that the instance must remain in the management account, although administration can be delegated to a registered member account. Delegated administration minimizes the number of people who need management-account access and permits administrators to manage assignments for organization member accounts. See [Delegated administration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html).

Registration itself must be performed by credentials from the management account. After registration, sufficiently authorized users in the member account can perform most IAM Identity Center administrative tasks. See [Register a member account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin-how-to-register.html).

### D. Create the IAM team’s Identity Center users/group and a permission set that includes `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator`

Interpreting the option's “IAM users and an IAM group” as IAM Identity Center users and a group, the team should receive its administrative permissions through a permission set. The `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` AWS managed policy provides the administrative actions needed to create and manage users, permission sets, and account assignments across organization member accounts. It does not include the additional management-account capabilities of `AWSSSOMasterAccountAdministrator`, such as enabling IAM Identity Center. See [AWS managed policies for IAM Identity Center](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html).

Operationally, the managed policy is attached to the permission set, and the group receives that permission set through an AWS account assignment. AWS documents account assignment as selecting the target account, users or groups, and permission set. See [Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html).

### F. Assign that permission set to the new delegated-administrator account for the IAM team’s group

The IAM team needs to sign in to the dedicated member account with the role generated from this permission set. IAM Identity Center creates the corresponding role in the selected target account and attaches the permission set's policies to that role. From the delegated-administrator account, the team can administer permission sets and assignments for existing and newly added member accounts without receiving an account assignment into the management account. See [Assign user or group access to AWS accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Enable IAM Identity Center in the new member account

This reverses the required order and location. For an organization instance, IAM Identity Center is enabled in—and its instance resides in—the Organizations management account. A member account can subsequently be registered as the delegated administrator, but it does not host the organization instance. See [Delegated administration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html).

### C. Put the Organizations management account in a new OU and deny IAM Identity Center by SCP

The management account cannot be placed in an OU as though it were a member account, and SCPs do not restrict actions performed by the management account. Therefore, this does not provide the proposed protection. AWS explicitly lists “any action performed by the management account” among the tasks and entities not restricted by SCPs. See [Tasks and entities not restricted by SCPs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html).

Additionally, denying all IAM Identity Center access would conflict with the required initial management-account operations, including enabling IAM Identity Center and registering the delegated administrator.

### E. Assign the permission set to the Organizations management account

This would grant the IAM team an access path into the management account, contrary to the requirement to avoid unnecessary management-account access. AWS recommends restricting access to the management account to as few people as possible and using delegated administration for routine IAM Identity Center administration. The delegated administrator also cannot manage permission sets provisioned in the management account. See [Delegated administration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html).

Thus, the least-privilege combination is **B, D, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理数百个 AWS 账户。该公司有一个负责 AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) 的团队。IAM 团队希望实施 AWS IAM Identity Center。IAM 团队必须仅拥有管理 IAM Identity Center 所需的最低权限。IAM 团队不得能够获得对 Organizations 管理账户的不必要访问权限。IAM 团队必须能够为新的和现有的成员账户预置新的 IAM Identity Center 权限集和分配。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 为 IAM 团队创建一个新的 AWS 账户。在新账户中启用 IAM Identity Center。在 Organizations 管理账户中，将新账户注册为 IAM Identity Center 的委派管理员。
options.B: 为 IAM 团队创建一个新的 AWS 账户。在 Organizations 管理账户中启用 IAM Identity Center。在 Organizations 管理账户中，将新账户注册为 IAM Identity Center 的委派管理员。
options.C: 在 Organizations 中创建一个 SCP。为 Organizations 管理账户创建一个新的 OU，并将新的 SCP 关联到该 OU。将 SCP 配置为拒绝对 IAM Identity Center 的所有访问。
options.D: 在 IAM Identity Center 中为 IAM 团队创建 IAM 用户和一个 IAM 组。将用户添加到该组。创建一个新的权限集。将 AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator AWS 托管 IAM 策略附加到该组。
options.E: 将新的权限集分配给 Organizations 管理账户。允许 IAM 团队的组使用该权限集。
options.F: 将新的权限集分配给新的 AWS 账户。允许 IAM 团队的组使用该权限集。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

公司需要让 IAM 团队跨组织成员账户管理 IAM Identity Center，同时避免其日常访问具有高权限的 Organizations 管理账户。合适的设计是在管理账户中保留组织实例，将 IAM Identity Center 管理委派给专用成员账户，并且仅在该委派账户中向团队授予管理权限集。

## 正确答案：B、D 和 F

### B. 在管理账户中启用 IAM Identity Center，并将新的成员账户注册为委派管理员

IAM Identity Center 的组织实例位于 AWS Organizations 管理账户中。AWS 明确指出，该实例必须保留在管理账户中，尽管管理工作可以委派给已注册的成员账户。委派管理可尽量减少需要访问管理账户的人员数量，并允许管理员管理组织成员账户的分配。请参阅 [委派管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)。

注册本身必须由管理账户中的凭证执行。注册后，成员账户中拥有足够授权的用户可以执行大多数 IAM Identity Center 管理任务。请参阅 [注册成员账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin-how-to-register.html)。

### D. 创建 IAM 团队的 Identity Center 用户/组，以及包含 `AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` 的权限集

将选项中的“IAM 用户和 IAM 组”理解为 IAM Identity Center 用户和组后，团队应通过权限集获得其管理权限。`AWSSSOMemberAccountAdministrator` AWS 托管策略提供了在组织成员账户中创建和管理用户、权限集及账户分配所需的管理操作。该策略不包含 `AWSSSOMasterAccountAdministrator` 的额外管理账户功能，例如启用 IAM Identity Center。请参阅 [IAM Identity Center 的 AWS 托管策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/security-iam-awsmanpol.html)。

在操作上，该托管策略会附加到权限集，而组通过 AWS 账户分配获得该权限集。AWS 将账户分配记录为选择目标账户、用户或组以及权限集。请参阅 [为用户或组分配 AWS 账户访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)。

### F. 将该权限集分配给 IAM 团队组的新委派管理员账户

IAM 团队需要使用由此权限集生成的角色登录专用成员账户。IAM Identity Center 会在所选目标账户中创建相应角色，并将权限集的策略附加到该角色。从委派管理员账户中，团队可以为现有和新添加的成员账户管理权限集和分配，而无需获得进入管理账户的账户分配。请参阅 [为用户或组分配 AWS 账户访问权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/assignusers.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 在新的成员账户中启用 IAM Identity Center

这颠倒了所需的顺序和位置。对于组织实例，IAM Identity Center 在 Organizations 管理账户中启用，并且其实例也位于该账户中。成员账户之后可以注册为委派管理员，但不会托管组织实例。请参阅 [委派管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)。

### C. 将 Organizations 管理账户放入新的 OU，并通过 SCP 拒绝 IAM Identity Center

管理账户不能像成员账户一样被放入 OU，并且 SCP 不会限制由管理账户执行的操作。因此，这无法提供所提议的保护。AWS 明确将“由管理账户执行的任何操作”列为不受 SCP 限制的任务和实体。请参阅 [不受 SCP 限制的任务和实体](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html)。

此外，拒绝对 IAM Identity Center 的所有访问会与所需的初始管理账户操作冲突，包括启用 IAM Identity Center 和注册委派管理员。

### E. 将权限集分配给 Organizations 管理账户

这将为 IAM 团队授予进入管理账户的访问路径，这与避免不必要的管理账户访问这一要求相违背。AWS 建议将管理账户访问权限限制为尽可能少的人员，并使用委派管理来处理日常 IAM Identity Center 管理。委派管理员也无法管理在管理账户中预置的权限集。请参阅 [委派管理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/singlesignon/latest/userguide/delegated-admin.html)。

因此，最小权限组合是 **B、D 和 F**。

en.question: A company uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL global database that has two secondary AWS Regions. A DevOps engineer has configured the database parameter group to guarantee an RPO of 60 seconds. Write operations on the primary cluster are occasionally blocked because of the RPO setting. The DevOps engineer needs to reduce the frequency of blocked write operations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add an additional secondary cluster to the global database.
options.B: Enable write forwarding for the global database.
options.C: Remove one of the secondary clusters from the global database.
options.D: Configure synchronous replication for the global database.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A. Add an additional secondary cluster to the global database.

The company has an Aurora PostgreSQL global database with a 60-second RPO configured through `rds.global_db_rpo`. This setting can pause transaction commits on the primary writer when replication lag threatens the configured RPO.

AWS documents the key behavior as follows: a transaction can commit when **at least one secondary cluster** has RPO lag within the configured threshold. Commits are blocked only when **all secondary clusters** exceed that threshold, and they resume when at least one secondary returns within it. See [Managing RPOs for Aurora PostgreSQL–based global databases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html).

Adding another secondary cluster provides an additional cluster that can remain within the 60-second RPO. With three secondaries, the primary blocks commits only if all three simultaneously exceed the threshold. This reduces the frequency of the condition that causes blocked writes. Aurora Global Database also uses dedicated, storage-based cross-Region replication that has little performance impact on the primary cluster, so adding a secondary is not equivalent to adding conventional database-engine replication load. See [Amazon Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. Enable write forwarding for the global database.** Write forwarding allows applications connected to secondary clusters to submit write statements that are forwarded to and executed by the primary writer. It does not change how `rds.global_db_rpo` evaluates secondary replication lag or when primary commits are blocked. See [Using write forwarding in an Amazon Aurora global database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-write-forwarding.html).

- **C. Remove one of the secondary clusters from the global database.** A lagging secondary does not independently block writes while another secondary remains within the RPO. Removing a secondary therefore eliminates one cluster that could satisfy the “at least one secondary” condition. With only one secondary remaining, that cluster exceeding 60 seconds means all remaining secondaries exceed the target, so commits are blocked. Removing a secondary is consequently more likely—not less likely—to trigger RPO-based write blocking.

- **D. Configure synchronous replication for the global database.** Aurora Global Database uses asynchronous, storage-based cross-Region replication and does not provide an option to convert it to configurable synchronous cross-Region replication. In addition, making primary commits wait for remote synchronous acknowledgment would add cross-Region latency and would not address the requirement to reduce blocked writes.

Therefore, **adding an additional secondary cluster** is the solution that reduces the frequency with which every secondary is simultaneously outside the 60-second RPO.

zh.question: 一家公司使用具有两个辅助 AWS 区域的 Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL 全球数据库。一名 DevOps 工程师已配置数据库参数组，以保证 60 秒的 RPO。由于 RPO 设置，主集群上的写入操作偶尔会被阻止。该 DevOps 工程师需要降低写入操作被阻止的频率。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 向全球数据库添加一个额外的辅助集群。
options.B: 为全球数据库启用写入转发。
options.C: 从全球数据库中移除一个辅助集群。
options.D: 为全球数据库配置同步复制。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A. 向全球数据库添加一个额外的辅助集群。

该公司拥有一个 Aurora PostgreSQL 全球数据库，并通过 `rds.global_db_rpo` 配置了 60 秒的 RPO。当复制延迟可能无法满足所配置的 RPO 时，此设置可能会暂停主写入节点上的事务提交。

AWS 对此关键行为的说明如下：当**至少一个辅助集群**的 RPO 延迟处于配置的阈值内时，事务可以提交。仅当**所有辅助集群**均超过该阈值时，提交才会被阻止；当至少一个辅助集群恢复到阈值范围内时，提交将恢复。请参阅 [Managing RPOs for Aurora PostgreSQL–based global databases](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-disaster-recovery.html)。

添加另一个辅助集群可提供一个额外的、能够保持在 60 秒 RPO 范围内的集群。有三个辅助集群时，只有当三个集群同时超过该阈值，主集群才会阻止提交。这降低了导致写入被阻止的条件发生频率。Aurora Global Database 还使用专用的、基于存储的跨区域复制，对主集群的性能影响很小，因此添加辅助集群并不等同于添加传统数据库引擎复制负载。请参阅 [Amazon Aurora Global Database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. 为全球数据库启用写入转发。** 写入转发允许连接到辅助集群的应用程序提交写入语句，这些语句会被转发到主写入节点并由其执行。它不会改变 `rds.global_db_rpo` 评估辅助集群复制延迟的方式，也不会改变主集群提交被阻止的时机。请参阅 [Using write forwarding in an Amazon Aurora global database](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/aurora-global-database-write-forwarding.html)。

- **C. 从全球数据库中移除一个辅助集群。** 只要另一个辅助集群仍在 RPO 范围内，发生延迟的辅助集群不会单独阻止写入。因此，移除一个辅助集群会减少一个可满足“至少一个辅助集群”条件的集群。只剩一个辅助集群时，如果该集群超过 60 秒，则所有剩余辅助集群都超过目标值，提交就会被阻止。因此，移除辅助集群更有可能而不是更不可能触发基于 RPO 的写入阻止。

- **D. 为全球数据库配置同步复制。** Aurora Global Database 使用异步的、基于存储的跨区域复制，不提供将其转换为可配置的同步跨区域复制的选项。此外，让主集群提交等待远程同步确认会增加跨区域延迟，且无法满足减少写入阻止的要求。

因此，**添加一个额外的辅助集群**是能够降低所有辅助集群同时超出 60 秒 RPO 的频率的解决方案。

en.question: A company has a web application that is hosted on an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster. The EKS cluster runs on AWS Fargate that is available through an internet-facing Application Load Balancer. The application is experiencing stability issues that lead to longer response times. A DevOps engineer needs to configure observability in Amazon CloudWatch to troubleshoot the issue. The solution must provide only the minimum necessary permissions. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy the CloudWatch agent as a Kubernetes StatefulSet to the EKS cluster.
options.B: Deploy the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry Collector as a Kubernetes DaemonSet to the EKS cluster.
options.C: Associate a Kubernetes service account with an IAM role by using IAM roles for service accounts in Amazon EKS. Use the CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy AWS managed policy.
options.D: Associate a Kubernetes service account with an IAM role by using IAM roles for service accounts in Amazon EKS. Use the CloudWatchAgentAdminPolicy AWS managed policy.
options.E: Configure an IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for the EKS cluster.
options.F: Enable EKS control plane logging for the EKS cluster.

en.explanation:
## Correct answers: A, C, and F

The application runs on Amazon EKS using AWS Fargate and is experiencing instability and increased response times. The solution needs to collect workload telemetry in CloudWatch, add EKS control-plane diagnostics, and grant the monitoring workload only the permissions it needs. Because Fargate does not support Kubernetes DaemonSets, the monitoring component must use a Fargate-compatible workload deployment.

### A. Deploy the CloudWatch agent as a Kubernetes StatefulSet

This is the Fargate-compatible agent choice among the listed options. The CloudWatch agent can collect application and Prometheus metrics and publish them to CloudWatch, giving the engineer visibility into workload behavior associated with latency and stability problems. AWS provides a specific CloudWatch agent setup procedure for EKS workloads running on Fargate: [Install the CloudWatch agent with Prometheus metrics collection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Setup.html).

The essential distinction is that this is a schedulable application-level controller rather than a node-level DaemonSet. AWS documentation currently describes its Fargate-specific `cwagent-prometheus` workload as a Deployment rather than explicitly as a StatefulSet, but A represents the intended Fargate-compatible CloudWatch agent deployment among these choices.

### C. Use IRSA with `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy`

The CloudWatch agent pod needs AWS credentials to send telemetry to CloudWatch. IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) associates an IAM role with the agent's Kubernetes service account so that the permissions are available to that workload rather than broadly granted to other pods. AWS documents IRSA as a way to provide least-privilege permissions to EKS applications: [IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html).

`CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` is the appropriate managed policy for the agent and is the policy used in AWS's CloudWatch agent setup procedure for both EC2-backed and Fargate-backed EKS workloads: [CloudWatch agent Prometheus setup](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Setup.html).

### F. Enable EKS control plane logging

EKS control plane logging sends API server, audit, authenticator, controller manager, and scheduler logs to CloudWatch Logs. These logs supplement application metrics with information about Kubernetes API activity, authentication, scheduling, and control-plane operations, helping identify infrastructure or orchestration conditions that contribute to instability and slow responses. Control-plane logs are disabled by default and the required log types must be enabled: [Amazon EKS control plane logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/control-plane-logs.html) and [Set up Amazon EKS control plane logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-setup-control-plane-logging.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Deploy ADOT Collector as a Kubernetes DaemonSet

ADOT can provide observability for container workloads, but this option specifies a **DaemonSet**. Amazon EKS on Fargate does not support DaemonSets because Fargate does not expose worker nodes on which one pod per node can be scheduled. AWS recommends reconfiguring software that requires a daemon as a sidecar container instead. Therefore, this deployment cannot run as written: [AWS Fargate considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html).

### D. Use `CloudWatchAgentAdminPolicy`

`CloudWatchAgentAdminPolicy` grants more access than is needed merely to publish monitoring data. In particular, it includes Systems Manager Parameter Store write permissions used for managing CloudWatch agent configuration. `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` provides the narrower permissions required for the running agent, so D violates the minimum-permissions requirement: [AWS managed policies for CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/managed-policies-cloudwatch.html).

### E. Configure an IAM OIDC provider for the cluster

An IAM OIDC provider is a prerequisite for using IRSA, and it must exist for the cluster's OIDC issuer. However, this is a one-time cluster setup action rather than an observability component that must be repeated when configuring the agent. The selected workflow assumes the existing EKS cluster already has the provider required to use the IRSA configuration in C. If it did not, the provider would first need to be created as documented in [Create an IAM OIDC provider for your cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/enable-iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html), but E is not one of the three intended observability steps here.

Therefore, the required combination is **A, C, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个 Web 应用程序，托管在 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群上。该 EKS 集群运行在 AWS Fargate 上，并通过一个面向互联网的 Application Load Balancer 提供服务。该应用程序遇到了稳定性问题，导致响应时间变长。一名 DevOps 工程师需要在 Amazon CloudWatch 中配置可观测性来排查该问题。该解决方案必须仅提供最低必要权限。哪种步骤组合能够满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 将 CloudWatch agent 作为 Kubernetes StatefulSet 部署到 EKS 集群中。
options.B: 将 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry Collector 作为 Kubernetes DaemonSet 部署到 EKS 集群中。
options.C: 通过 Amazon EKS 中的 IAM roles for service accounts 将 Kubernetes 服务账户关联到 IAM 角色。使用 CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy AWS 托管策略。
options.D: 通过 Amazon EKS 中的 IAM roles for service accounts 将 Kubernetes 服务账户关联到 IAM 角色。使用 CloudWatchAgentAdminPolicy AWS 托管策略。
options.E: 为 EKS 集群配置 IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) 提供商。
options.F: 为 EKS 集群启用 EKS control plane logging。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A、C 和 F

该应用程序使用 AWS Fargate 运行在 Amazon EKS 上，并且正经历稳定性问题和响应时间增加。该解决方案需要在 CloudWatch 中收集工作负载遥测数据、添加 EKS control plane 诊断信息，并且仅向监控工作负载授予所需权限。由于 Fargate 不支持 Kubernetes DaemonSets，监控组件必须使用与 Fargate 兼容的工作负载部署方式。

### A. 将 CloudWatch agent 作为 Kubernetes StatefulSet 部署

这是所列选项中与 Fargate 兼容的 agent 选择。CloudWatch agent 可以收集应用程序和 Prometheus 指标并将其发布到 CloudWatch，使工程师能够了解与延迟和稳定性问题相关的工作负载行为。AWS 为在 Fargate 上运行的 EKS 工作负载提供了专门的 CloudWatch agent 设置流程：[使用 Prometheus 指标收集安装 CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Setup.html)。

关键区别在于，这是一个可调度的应用程序级 controller，而非节点级 DaemonSet。AWS 文档目前将其 Fargate 专用的 `cwagent-prometheus` 工作负载描述为 Deployment，而非明确描述为 StatefulSet，但在这些选项中，A 代表预期的、与 Fargate 兼容的 CloudWatch agent 部署方式。

### C. 将 IRSA 与 `CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` 配合使用

CloudWatch agent pod 需要 AWS 凭证才能将遥测数据发送到 CloudWatch。IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) 将 IAM 角色与 agent 的 Kubernetes 服务账户关联，使权限可用于该工作负载，而不会被广泛授予其他 pod。AWS 将 IRSA 记录为一种为 EKS 应用程序提供最低权限的方法：[IAM roles for service accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)。

`CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` 是适用于该 agent 的托管策略，也是 AWS 的 CloudWatch agent 设置流程中用于 EC2 支持和 Fargate 支持的 EKS 工作负载的策略：[CloudWatch agent Prometheus 设置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContainerInsights-Prometheus-Setup.html)。

### F. 启用 EKS control plane logging

EKS control plane logging 会将 API server、audit、authenticator、controller manager 和 scheduler 日志发送至 CloudWatch Logs。这些日志通过提供有关 Kubernetes API 活动、身份验证、调度和 control plane 操作的信息来补充应用程序指标，有助于识别导致不稳定和响应缓慢的基础设施或编排条件。Control-plane 日志默认处于禁用状态，必须启用所需的日志类型：[Amazon EKS control plane logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/control-plane-logs.html) 和 [设置 Amazon EKS control plane logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-setup-control-plane-logging.html)。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 将 ADOT Collector 作为 Kubernetes DaemonSet 部署

ADOT 可以为容器工作负载提供可观测性，但该选项指定了一个 **DaemonSet**。运行在 Fargate 上的 Amazon EKS 不支持 DaemonSets，因为 Fargate 不会公开工作节点，因而无法在每个节点上调度一个 pod。AWS 建议将需要 daemon 的软件重新配置为 sidecar container。因此，此部署无法按所述方式运行：[AWS Fargate 注意事项](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/fargate.html)。

### D. 使用 `CloudWatchAgentAdminPolicy`

`CloudWatchAgentAdminPolicy` 授予的访问权限超出了仅发布监控数据所需的范围。特别是，它包含用于管理 CloudWatch agent 配置的 Systems Manager Parameter Store 写入权限。`CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy` 提供了运行中 agent 所需的更严格权限，因此 D 违反了最低权限要求：[适用于 CloudWatch 的 AWS 托管策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/managed-policies-cloudwatch.html)。

### E. 为集群配置 IAM OIDC provider

IAM OIDC provider 是使用 IRSA 的前提条件，并且必须存在于集群的 OIDC issuer 中。不过，这是一项一次性的集群设置操作，而不是在配置 agent 时必须重复执行的可观测性组件。所选工作流程假定现有 EKS 集群已经具备使用 C 中 IRSA 配置所需的 provider。如果没有，则首先需要按照文档创建 provider：[为您的集群创建 IAM OIDC provider](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/enable-iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html)，但 E 不是预期的三个可观测性步骤之一。

因此，所需的组合是 **A、C 和 F**。

en.question: A company stores its Python-based application code in AWS CodeCommit. The company uses AWS CodePipeline to deploy the application. The CodeCommit repository and the CodePipeline pipeline are deployed to the same AWS account. The company's security team requires all code to be scanned for vulnerabilities before the code is deployed to production. If any vulnerabilities are found, the deployment must stop. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a new CodeBuild project. Configure the project to run a security scan on the code by using Amazon CodeGuru Security. Configure the CodeBuild project to raise an error if CodeGuru Security finds vulnerabilities. Create a new IAM role that has sufficient permissions to run CodeGuru Security scans. Assign the role to the CodeBuild project. In the CodePipeline pipeline, add a new stage before the deployment stage. Select AWS CodeBuild as the action provider for the new stage. Use the source artifact from the CodeCommit repository. Configure the action to use the CodeBuild project.
options.B: Create a new CodeBuild project. Configure the project to run a security scan on the code by using Amazon Inspector. Configure the CodeBuild project to raise an error if Amazon Inspector finds vulnerabilities. Create a new IAM role that has sufficient permissions to run Amazon Inspector scans. Assign the role to the CodeBuild project. In the CodePipeline pipeline, add a new stage before the deployment stage. Select AWS CodeBuild as the action provider for the new stage. Use the source artifact from the CodeCommit repository. Configure the action to use the CodeBuild project.
options.C: Update the IAM role that is attached to CodePipeline to include sufficient permissions to invoke Amazon DevOps Guru. In the CodePipeline pipeline, add a new stage before the deployment stage. Select DevOps Guru as the action provider for the new stage. Use the source artifact from the CodeCommit repository.
options.D: Update the IAM role that is attached to CodePipeline to include sufficient permissions to invoke Amazon DevOps Guru. In the CodePipeline pipeline, add a new stage before the deployment stage. Select CodeGuru Security as the action provider for the new stage. Use the source artifact from the CodeCommit repository.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The pipeline must introduce a **pre-deployment security gate** that statically scans the Python source code and causes the pipeline execution to fail when vulnerabilities are detected. Because CodePipeline runs stages sequentially, the scanning action must be placed before the production deployment action.

## Correct answer: A

**A** uses Amazon CodeGuru Security for the source-code vulnerability analysis and runs the scan from a CodeBuild project. This is the intended architecture because:

1. CodeBuild can receive the CodeCommit source artifact from CodePipeline and execute the commands defined in its build specification. AWS documents that a CodeBuild action consumes its pipeline input artifact and runs commands from the primary source directory ([CodeBuild action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)).
2. The CodeBuild service role can be granted the permissions needed to call the security-scanning service.
3. The build logic can inspect the scan findings and exit with a nonzero status when any vulnerability is found. That makes the CodeBuild action fail, preventing the execution from reaching the later production deployment stage. AWS defines a failed pipeline execution as one that stops and does not completely traverse the pipeline ([CodePipeline concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/concepts.html)).
4. CodeBuild is a supported **Build** and **Test** action provider in CodePipeline ([valid CodePipeline action providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-valid-providers.html)).

Thus, the CodeBuild stage acts as the required security quality gate immediately before deployment.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B — Incorrect

Amazon Inspector is primarily a vulnerability-management service. Although current AWS capabilities include Inspector code-security and CI/CD scanning, the documented CodePipeline integration is the dedicated **`InspectorScan` invoke action**, with configurable vulnerability thresholds that can fail the action ([InspectorScan action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-InspectorScan.html)). The documented CI/CD integration uses the Inspector SBOM Generator and Scan API and is described as detecting vulnerabilities in open-source code or container images ([Inspector and CodePipeline integration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/cicd-inspector-codepipeline-actions.html)).

The option instead proposes a generic CodeBuild project configured to perform the required first-party Python source-code analysis with Inspector. It does not describe the documented `InspectorScan` action or its thresholds, and it is not the intended CodeGuru Security static source-analysis solution in this question.

### C — Incorrect

Amazon DevOps Guru does not scan application source code for security vulnerabilities. It analyzes **operational data** and creates insights when it detects anomalous runtime behavior, including associated metrics, logs, and events ([How DevOps Guru works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/devops-guru/latest/userguide/how-it-works.html)). It therefore cannot provide the required pre-deployment static security gate.

Additionally, DevOps Guru is not listed as a native CodePipeline action provider in the valid provider table.

### D — Incorrect

This option has two separate problems:

- It grants DevOps Guru permissions even though the proposed action is CodeGuru Security; the permissions do not match the service being invoked.
- CodeGuru Security is not listed as a direct native CodePipeline action provider. CodeBuild, however, is a valid provider and can run the scanning commands, which is why the wrapper pattern in **A** is required ([valid CodePipeline action providers](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-valid-providers.html)).

Therefore, **A** is the only option that correctly combines source-code security analysis, appropriate IAM permissions, and a failing pre-deployment CodePipeline gate.

zh.question: 一家公司的 Python 应用程序代码存储在 AWS CodeCommit 中。该公司使用 AWS CodePipeline 部署应用程序。CodeCommit 存储库和 CodePipeline 管道部署在同一个 AWS 账户中。公司的安全团队要求所有代码在部署到生产环境之前都必须进行漏洞扫描。如果发现任何漏洞，部署必须停止。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个新的 CodeBuild 项目。将该项目配置为使用 Amazon CodeGuru Security 对代码运行安全扫描。如果 CodeGuru Security 发现漏洞，则将 CodeBuild 项目配置为引发错误。创建一个具有足够权限以运行 CodeGuru Security 扫描的新 IAM 角色。将该角色分配给 CodeBuild 项目。在 CodePipeline 管道中，在部署阶段之前添加一个新阶段。为新阶段选择 AWS CodeBuild 作为操作提供程序。使用来自 CodeCommit 存储库的源构件。将该操作配置为使用该 CodeBuild 项目。
options.B: 创建一个新的 CodeBuild 项目。将该项目配置为使用 Amazon Inspector 对代码运行安全扫描。如果 Amazon Inspector 发现漏洞，则将 CodeBuild 项目配置为引发错误。创建一个具有足够权限以运行 Amazon Inspector 扫描的新 IAM 角色。将该角色分配给 CodeBuild 项目。在 CodePipeline 管道中，在部署阶段之前添加一个新阶段。为新阶段选择 AWS CodeBuild 作为操作提供程序。使用来自 CodeCommit 存储库的源构件。将该操作配置为使用该 CodeBuild 项目。
options.C: 更新附加到 CodePipeline 的 IAM 角色，使其包含调用 Amazon DevOps Guru 所需的足够权限。在 CodePipeline 管道中，在部署阶段之前添加一个新阶段。为新阶段选择 DevOps Guru 作为操作提供程序。使用来自 CodeCommit 存储库的源构件。
options.D: 更新附加到 CodePipeline 的 IAM 角色，使其包含调用 Amazon DevOps Guru 所需的足够权限。在 CodePipeline 管道中，在部署阶段之前添加一个新阶段。为新阶段选择 CodeGuru Security 作为操作提供程序。使用来自 CodeCommit 存储库的源构件。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该管道必须引入一个**部署前安全门禁**，对 Python 源代码进行静态扫描，并在检测到漏洞时使管道执行失败。由于 CodePipeline 按顺序运行各个阶段，扫描操作必须放置在生产部署操作之前。

## 正确答案：A

**A** 使用 Amazon CodeGuru Security 进行源代码漏洞分析，并通过 CodeBuild 项目运行扫描。这是预期的架构，原因如下：

1. CodeBuild 可以从 CodePipeline 接收 CodeCommit 源构件，并执行其构建规范中定义的命令。AWS 文档说明，CodeBuild 操作会使用其管道输入构件，并从主源目录运行命令（[CodeBuild 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)）。
2. 可以向 CodeBuild 服务角色授予调用安全扫描服务所需的权限。
3. 构建逻辑可以检查扫描发现，并在发现任何漏洞时以非零状态退出。这会使 CodeBuild 操作失败，从而阻止执行进入后续的生产部署阶段。AWS 将失败的管道执行定义为停止且未完整通过管道的执行（[CodePipeline 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/concepts.html)）。
4. CodeBuild 是 CodePipeline 中受支持的 **Build** 和 **Test** 操作提供程序（[有效的 CodePipeline 操作提供程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-valid-providers.html)）。

因此，CodeBuild 阶段充当紧邻部署之前所需的安全质量门禁。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B — 错误

Amazon Inspector 主要是一项漏洞管理服务。尽管当前 AWS 功能包括 Inspector 代码安全和 CI/CD 扫描，但有文档说明的 CodePipeline 集成是专用的 **`InspectorScan` 调用操作**，可配置漏洞阈值以使操作失败（[InspectorScan 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-InspectorScan.html)）。有文档说明的 CI/CD 集成使用 Inspector SBOM Generator 和 Scan API，并且被描述为可检测开源代码或容器镜像中的漏洞（[Inspector 和 CodePipeline 集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/cicd-inspector-codepipeline-actions.html)）。

该选项反而提出一个通用 CodeBuild 项目，并将其配置为使用 Inspector 执行所需的第一方 Python 源代码分析。它没有说明有文档记录的 `InspectorScan` 操作或其阈值，并且不是本题所要求的 CodeGuru Security 静态源代码分析解决方案。

### C — 错误

Amazon DevOps Guru 不会扫描应用程序源代码中的安全漏洞。它分析**运营数据**，并在检测到异常运行时行为时创建洞察，其中包括关联的指标、日志和事件（[DevOps Guru 的工作原理](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/devops-guru/latest/userguide/how-it-works.html)）。因此，它无法提供所需的部署前静态安全门禁。

此外，DevOps Guru 未在有效提供程序表中列为原生 CodePipeline 操作提供程序。

### D — 错误

此选项有两个独立问题：

- 它授予 DevOps Guru 权限，但拟议的操作是 CodeGuru Security；权限与被调用的服务不匹配。
- CodeGuru Security 未被列为直接的原生 CodePipeline 操作提供程序。然而，CodeBuild 是有效的提供程序并且可以运行扫描命令，这就是 **A** 中必须采用封装模式的原因（[有效的 CodePipeline 操作提供程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-valid-providers.html)）。

因此，**A** 是唯一正确结合源代码安全分析、适当 IAM 权限以及可失败的部署前 CodePipeline 门禁的选项。

en.question: A DevOps engineer deploys an application to a fleet of Amazon Linux EC2 instances. The DevOps engineer needs to monitor system metrics across the fleet. The DevOps engineer wants to monitor the relationship between network traffic and memory utilization for the application code. The DevOps engineer wants to track the data on a 60 second interval. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Use Amazon CloudWatch basic monitoring to collect the NetworkIn metric and the MemoryBytesUsed metric. Graph the metrics in CloudWatch.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch detailed monitoring to collect the NetworkIn metric and the MemoryBytesUsed metric. Graph the metrics in CloudWatch.
options.C: Use Amazon CloudWatch detailed monitoring to collect the NetworkIn metric. Install the CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to collect the mem_used metric. Graph the metrics in CloudWatch.
options.D: Use Amazon CloudWatch basic monitoring to collect the built-in NetworkIn metric. Install the CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances to collect the mem_used metric. Graph the metrics in CloudWatch.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement has two parts:

1. Collect incoming network traffic and Linux memory-use data from the EC2 fleet.
2. Track both at a **60-second interval** so that they can be graphed and correlated in CloudWatch.

## Correct answer: C

**Use EC2 detailed monitoring for `NetworkIn`, and install the CloudWatch agent to collect `mem_used`.**

Amazon EC2 publishes metrics to CloudWatch at 5-minute periods by default. Enabling detailed monitoring changes supported EC2 metrics to 1-minute periods, satisfying the 60-second requirement. `NetworkIn` is a native metric in the `AWS/EC2` namespace and supports detailed 1-minute monitoring. It measures the bytes received by an instance across its network interfaces. See [CloudWatch metrics available for EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/viewing_metrics_with_cloudwatch.html) and [Monitor EC2 instances using CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-cloudwatch.html).

Guest operating system memory is not included among the standard `AWS/EC2` instance metrics. The CloudWatch agent must collect it from inside the Amazon Linux instances. The agent supports `mem_used`, defined as the amount of memory currently in use, in bytes, and its collection interval is configurable. See [Metrics collected by the CloudWatch agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/metrics-collected-by-CloudWatch-agent.html).

Therefore, option C provides both required measurements at compatible 60-second granularity so they can be graphed together in CloudWatch.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A:** Basic EC2 monitoring publishes normal EC2 metrics such as `NetworkIn` at **5-minute**, not 60-second, periods. In addition, `MemoryBytesUsed` is not a standard EC2 metric collected by basic monitoring.

- **B:** Detailed monitoring correctly provides 1-minute data for supported EC2 metrics such as `NetworkIn`, but it does not add guest OS memory metrics. `MemoryBytesUsed` is not a built-in `AWS/EC2` metric; a host-level collector such as the CloudWatch agent is required.

- **D:** Installing the CloudWatch agent is appropriate for `mem_used`, but basic monitoring supplies `NetworkIn` at 5-minute periods. Consequently, the network metric does not meet the required 60-second interval and cannot be correlated at the requested native granularity.

The highly voted comment reaches the correct answer, although its claim that `MemoryBytesUsed` is available through basic EC2 monitoring is inaccurate; EC2 standard monitoring does not provide guest OS memory metrics.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师将一个应用程序部署到一组 Amazon Linux EC2 实例上。该 DevOps 工程师需要监控整个实例组的系统指标。该 DevOps 工程师希望监控应用程序代码的网络流量与内存利用率之间的关系，并希望以 60 秒的间隔跟踪数据。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 基本监控收集 NetworkIn 指标和 MemoryBytesUsed 指标。在 CloudWatch 中绘制这些指标。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 详细监控收集 NetworkIn 指标和 MemoryBytesUsed 指标。在 CloudWatch 中绘制这些指标。
options.C: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 详细监控收集 NetworkIn 指标。在 EC2 实例上安装 CloudWatch agent 以收集 mem_used 指标。在 CloudWatch 中绘制这些指标。
options.D: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch 基本监控收集内置的 NetworkIn 指标。在 EC2 实例上安装 CloudWatch agent 以收集 mem_used 指标。在 CloudWatch 中绘制这些指标。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该要求包含两个部分：

1. 从 EC2 实例组收集传入网络流量和 Linux 内存使用数据。
2. 以 **60 秒间隔** 跟踪这两项数据，以便可以在 CloudWatch 中绘制图表并进行关联分析。

## 正确答案：C

**对 `NetworkIn` 使用 EC2 详细监控，并安装 CloudWatch agent 来收集 `mem_used`。**

Amazon EC2 默认每 5 分钟向 CloudWatch 发布一次指标。启用详细监控后，受支持的 EC2 指标将改为每 1 分钟发布一次，从而满足 60 秒的要求。`NetworkIn` 是 `AWS/EC2` 命名空间中的原生指标，并支持详细的 1 分钟监控。它测量实例通过其网络接口接收的字节数。请参阅 [适用于 EC2 实例的 CloudWatch 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/viewing_metrics_with_cloudwatch.html) 和 [使用 CloudWatch 监控 EC2 实例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/using-cloudwatch.html)。

来宾操作系统内存不包含在标准 `AWS/EC2` 实例指标中。CloudWatch agent 必须从 Amazon Linux 实例内部收集该数据。该 agent 支持 `mem_used`，其定义为当前正在使用的内存量（以字节为单位），并且其收集间隔可配置。请参阅 [CloudWatch agent 收集的指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/metrics-collected-by-CloudWatch-agent.html)。

因此，选项 C 以兼容的 60 秒粒度提供了两项所需的测量数据，因此可以在 CloudWatch 中将它们一起绘制。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A：** 基本 EC2 监控会以 **5 分钟** 而非 60 秒的周期发布 `NetworkIn` 等常规 EC2 指标。此外，`MemoryBytesUsed` 不是由基本监控收集的标准 EC2 指标。

- **B：** 详细监控确实可为 `NetworkIn` 等受支持的 EC2 指标提供 1 分钟数据，但它不会添加来宾操作系统内存指标。`MemoryBytesUsed` 不是内置的 `AWS/EC2` 指标；需要使用 CloudWatch agent 等主机级收集器。

- **D：** 安装 CloudWatch agent 对于收集 `mem_used` 是合适的，但基本监控以 5 分钟周期提供 `NetworkIn`。因此，该网络指标不满足所需的 60 秒间隔，且无法以所要求的原生粒度进行关联。

高赞评论得出了正确答案，但其中声称可通过基本 EC2 监控获得 `MemoryBytesUsed` 的说法并不准确；EC2 标准监控不提供来宾操作系统内存指标。

en.question: A company uses AWS Systems Manager to manage a fleet of Amazon Linux EC2 instances that have SSM Agent installed. All EC2 instances are configured to use Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2) and are running in the same AWS account and AWS Region. Company policy requires developers to use only Amazon Linux. The company wants to ensure that all new EC2 instances are automatically managed by Systems Manager after creation. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create an IAM role that has a trust policy that allows Systems Manager to assume the role. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedEC2InstanceDefaultPolicy policy to the role. Configure the default-ec2-instance-management-role SSM service setting to use the role.
options.B: Ensure that AWS Config is set up. Create an AWS Config rule that validates if an EC2 instance has SSM Agent installed. Configure the rule to run on EC2 configuration changes. Configure automatic remediation for the rule to run the AWS- InstallSSMAgent SSM document to install SSM Agent.
options.C: Configure Systems Manager Patch Manager. Create a patch baseline that automatically installs SSM Agent on all new EC2 instances. Create a patch group for all EC2 instances. Attach the patch baseline to the patch group. Create a maintenance window and maintenance window task to start installing SSM Agent daily.
options.D: Create an EC2 instance role that has a trust policy that allows Amazon EC2 to assume the role. Attach the AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore policy to the role. Ensure that AWS Config is set up. Use the ec2-instance-profile-attached managed AWS Config rule to validate if an EC2 instance has the role attached. Configure the rule to run on EC2 configuration changes. Configure automatic remediation for the rule to run the AWS-SetupManagedRoleOnEc2Instance SSM document to attach the role to the EC2 instance.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an account- and Region-level mechanism that automatically gives newly launched Amazon Linux EC2 instances the permissions required to register as Systems Manager managed nodes. The instances already use IMDSv2 and have SSM Agent installed, so the most operationally efficient solution should avoid per-instance profiles, AWS Config remediation, or scheduled maintenance workflows.

## Correct answer: A

**A is correct.** This configures **Systems Manager Default Host Management Configuration**:

1. The IAM role trusts `ssm.amazonaws.com`.
2. The role receives the AWS managed policy `AmazonSSMManagedEC2InstanceDefaultPolicy`.
3. The `/ssm/managed-instance/default-ec2-instance-management-role` service setting is configured to use that role.

AWS states that after Default Host Management Configuration is enabled, EC2 instances in that account and Region that use **IMDSv2** and have **SSM Agent 3.2.582.0 or later** automatically become Systems Manager managed instances. It does this without requiring an IAM instance profile on every EC2 instance. AWS also documents the same trust policy, managed policy, and service-setting procedure described in option A. See [Recommended configuration for EC2 instance permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/setup-instance-permissions.html) and [Default Host Management Configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/fleet-manager-default-host-management-configuration.html).

The Amazon Linux restriction supports this approach because most AWS-provided Amazon Linux 2 and Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs already include SSM Agent. See [SSM Agent on Amazon Linux 2 and Amazon Linux 2023](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/agent-install-al2.html).

This is the most operationally efficient option because it is centrally enabled once per account and Region and automatically onboards eligible current and future instances.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. AWS Config rule plus agent-installation remediation

This addresses the wrong primary problem. The scenario already states that SSM Agent is installed, and AWS-provided Amazon Linux AMIs generally include it. What the instances need is automatic authorization and registration with Systems Manager, which Default Host Management Configuration provides directly.

Adding AWS Config evaluation and remediation introduces unnecessary services, rules, and remediation operations. Moreover, merely installing SSM Agent does not by itself provide the AWS permissions the agent needs to communicate with Systems Manager.

### C. Patch Manager baseline and maintenance window

Patch Manager is for scanning for and installing approved operating-system patches on **managed nodes**; it is not the onboarding mechanism that initially grants an EC2 instance Systems Manager permissions. Patch Manager itself requires SSM Agent to already be running on the managed node. See [Patch Manager prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-prerequisites.html).

A daily maintenance window would also delay onboarding and create considerably more operational overhead than the account-level Default Host Management Configuration.

### D. Instance profile, AWS Config rule, and automatic remediation

This could create a more complicated per-instance remediation workflow, but it is not the most operationally efficient solution. The `ec2-instance-profile-attached` rule checks whether an IAM instance profile is attached; without suitable parameterization, it does not inherently prove that the required Systems Manager role is attached. See [ec2-instance-profile-attached](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-instance-profile-attached.html).

The `AWS-SetupManagedRoleOnEC2Instance` runbook can configure an EC2 instance with an IAM role for Systems Manager access, but using AWS Config and Automation for every noncompliant instance adds unnecessary moving parts compared with enabling the purpose-built Default Host Management Configuration once. See [AWS-SetupManagedRoleOnEC2Instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-setupmanagedroleonec2instance.html).

Therefore, **A** is the direct, scalable, and lowest-operations solution.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Systems Manager 管理一组已安装 SSM Agent 的 Amazon Linux EC2 实例。所有 EC2 实例均配置为使用 Instance Metadata Service Version 2 (IMDSv2)，并且在同一 AWS 账户和 AWS Region 中运行。公司策略要求开发人员只能使用 Amazon Linux。公司希望确保所有新的 EC2 实例在创建后都能自动由 Systems Manager 管理。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 IAM 角色，其信任策略允许 Systems Manager 担任该角色。将 `AmazonSSMManagedEC2InstanceDefaultPolicy` 策略附加到该角色。将 `default-ec2-instance-management-role` SSM 服务设置配置为使用该角色。
options.B: 确保已设置 AWS Config。创建一个 AWS Config 规则，以验证 EC2 实例是否已安装 SSM Agent。将该规则配置为在 EC2 配置发生更改时运行。为该规则配置自动修复，以运行 `AWS- InstallSSMAgent` SSM 文档来安装 SSM Agent。
options.C: 配置 Systems Manager Patch Manager。创建一个补丁基线，以便在所有新的 EC2 实例上自动安装 SSM Agent。为所有 EC2 实例创建一个补丁组。将补丁基线附加到该补丁组。创建一个维护时段和维护时段任务，以每天开始安装 SSM Agent。
options.D: 创建一个 EC2 实例角色，其信任策略允许 Amazon EC2 担任该角色。将 `AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore` 策略附加到该角色。确保已设置 AWS Config。使用托管的 `ec2-instance-profile-attached` AWS Config 规则验证 EC2 实例是否已附加该角色。将该规则配置为在 EC2 配置发生更改时运行。为该规则配置自动修复，以运行 `AWS-SetupManagedRoleOnEc2Instance` SSM 文档将该角色附加到 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一种账户和 Region 级别的机制，能够自动为新启动的 Amazon Linux EC2 实例授予注册为 Systems Manager 托管节点所需的权限。这些实例已经使用 IMDSv2 且安装了 SSM Agent，因此运营效率最高的解决方案应避免使用逐实例配置文件、AWS Config 修复或计划维护工作流程。

## 正确答案：A

**A 是正确的。** 此选项配置了 **Systems Manager Default Host Management Configuration**：

1. IAM 角色信任 `ssm.amazonaws.com`。
2. 该角色被授予 AWS 托管策略 `AmazonSSMManagedEC2InstanceDefaultPolicy`。
3. `/ssm/managed-instance/default-ec2-instance-management-role` 服务设置被配置为使用该角色。

AWS 说明，启用 Default Host Management Configuration 后，该账户和 Region 中使用 **IMDSv2** 且安装 **SSM Agent 3.2.582.0 或更高版本** 的 EC2 实例会自动成为 Systems Manager 托管实例。此方式不要求为每个 EC2 实例都配置 IAM 实例配置文件。AWS 还记录了与选项 A 所述相同的信任策略、托管策略和服务设置流程。请参阅 [Recommended configuration for EC2 instance permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/setup-instance-permissions.html) 和 [Default Host Management Configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/fleet-manager-default-host-management-configuration.html)。

Amazon Linux 限制支持此方法，因为大多数 AWS 提供的 Amazon Linux 2 和 Amazon Linux 2023 AMI 都已包含 SSM Agent。请参阅 [SSM Agent on Amazon Linux 2 and Amazon Linux 2023](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/agent-install-al2.html)。

这是运营效率最高的选项，因为它只需在每个账户和 Region 中集中启用一次，便可自动纳管符合条件的现有和未来实例。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. AWS Config 规则加代理安装修复

这解决的是错误的主要问题。题目已说明 SSM Agent 已安装，并且 AWS 提供的 Amazon Linux AMI 通常已包含该代理。实例所需的是通过 Systems Manager 自动获得授权和注册，而 Default Host Management Configuration 可以直接提供这一能力。

添加 AWS Config 评估和修复会引入不必要的服务、规则和修复操作。此外，仅安装 SSM Agent 本身并不会提供该代理与 Systems Manager 通信所需的 AWS 权限。

### C. Patch Manager 补丁基线和维护时段

Patch Manager 用于扫描和安装已批准的操作系统补丁，目标是 **托管节点**；它并不是最初为 EC2 实例授予 Systems Manager 权限的纳管机制。Patch Manager 本身要求 SSM Agent 已在托管节点上运行。请参阅 [Patch Manager prerequisites](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/patch-manager-prerequisites.html)。

每日维护时段也会延迟纳管，并且相比账户级别的 Default Host Management Configuration 会产生多得多的运营开销。

### D. 实例配置文件、AWS Config 规则和自动修复

这可以创建一个更复杂的逐实例修复工作流程，但不是运营效率最高的解决方案。`ec2-instance-profile-attached` 规则检查是否已附加 IAM 实例配置文件；如果没有适当的参数化，它并不能固有地证明所需的 Systems Manager 角色已附加。请参阅 [ec2-instance-profile-attached](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/ec2-instance-profile-attached.html)。

`AWS-SetupManagedRoleOnEC2Instance` 运行手册可以为 EC2 实例配置 IAM 角色以访问 Systems Manager，但与只启用一次专门构建的 Default Host Management Configuration 相比，对每个不合规实例使用 AWS Config 和 Automation 会增加不必要的组件。请参阅 [AWS-SetupManagedRoleOnEC2Instance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-setupmanagedroleonec2instance.html)。

因此，**A** 是直接、可扩展且运营开销最低的解决方案。
