en.question: A company configured an Amazon S3 event source for an AWS Lambda function. The company needs the Lambda function to run when a new object is created or an existing object is modified in a specific S3 bucket. The Lambda function will use the S3 bucket name and the S3 object key of the incoming event to read the contents of the new or modified S3 object. The Lambda function will parse the contents and save the parsed contents to an Amazon DynamoDB table. The Lambda function's execution role has permissions to read from the S3 bucket and to write to the DynamoDB table. During testing, a DevOps engineer discovers that the Lambda function does not run when objects are added to the S3 bucket or when existing objects are modified. Which solution will resolve these problems?

options.A: Create an S3 bucket policy for the S3 bucket that grants the S3 bucket permission to invoke the Lambda function.
options.B: Create a resource policy for the Lambda function to grant Amazon S3 permission to invoke the Lambda function on the S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as an OnFailure destination for the Lambda function. Update the Lambda function to process messages from the SQS queue and the S3 event notifications.
options.D: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the destination for the S3 bucket event notifications. Update the Lambda function's execution role to have permission to read from the SQS queue. Update the Lambda function to consume messages from the SQS queue.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The S3 event notification is already intended to invoke the Lambda function directly. The function’s **execution role** governs what the function can do after it starts, such as reading the object from S3 and writing to DynamoDB. It does **not** authorize Amazon S3 to invoke the function.

AWS documentation states that S3 must be granted permission to invoke the function through the **Lambda function’s resource-based policy**. S3 invokes Lambda asynchronously and supplies an event containing the S3 bucket name and object key. The `s3:ObjectCreated:*` notification category covers object creation through operations such as `PUT`, `POST`, `COPY`, and multipart upload; uploading a replacement under an existing key is also an object-creation operation from the event-notification perspective. See [Process Amazon S3 event notifications with Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html) and [Supported event types for SQS, SNS, and Lambda](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html).

## Correct answer

**B. Create a resource policy for the Lambda function to grant Amazon S3 permission to invoke the Lambda function on the S3 bucket.**

The Lambda resource-based policy must allow the `s3.amazonaws.com` service principal to perform `lambda:InvokeFunction`, normally restricted by the source bucket ARN and source account. AWS explicitly documents that S3 needs invocation permission on the Lambda function and that this permission is configured on the function when an S3 notification targets Lambda. See [Granting permissions to invoke an AWS Lambda function](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/grant-destinations-permissions-to-s3.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A is incorrect.** An S3 bucket policy controls access to the S3 bucket and its objects. It is not where permission to invoke a Lambda function is granted. The invocation permission belongs in the Lambda function’s resource-based policy.

- **C is incorrect.** An `OnFailure` destination is used after an asynchronous Lambda invocation fails. Here, S3 cannot invoke the function in the first place, so an on-failure destination does not correct the missing invocation permission. It also does not make the SQS queue an S3 event source.

- **D is incorrect.** Routing S3 notifications through SQS is a possible alternative architecture, but it is unnecessary for the stated direct S3-to-Lambda design. Additionally, merely granting the execution role permission to read SQS and modifying function code is not the standard Lambda integration; an SQS event source mapping would be required to poll the queue and invoke the function. The direct and minimal fix is to authorize S3 in the Lambda resource-based policy.

zh.question: 一家公司为 AWS Lambda 函数配置了 Amazon S3 事件源。该公司需要在特定 S3 存储桶中创建新对象或修改现有对象时运行 Lambda 函数。Lambda 函数将使用传入事件中的 S3 存储桶名称和 S3 对象键来读取新增或修改的 S3 对象内容。Lambda 函数将解析内容，并将解析后的内容保存到 Amazon DynamoDB 表中。Lambda 函数的执行角色具有从 S3 存储桶读取以及向 DynamoDB 表写入的权限。在测试期间，一名 DevOps 工程师发现，当对象添加到 S3 存储桶或修改现有对象时，Lambda 函数不会运行。哪种解决方案可以解决这些问题？

options.A: 为 S3 存储桶创建 S3 存储桶策略，授予 S3 存储桶调用 Lambda 函数的权限。
options.B: 为 Lambda 函数创建资源策略，授予 Amazon S3 在该 S3 存储桶上调用 Lambda 函数的权限。
options.C: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为 Lambda 函数的 OnFailure 目标。更新 Lambda 函数，使其处理来自 SQS 队列和 S3 事件通知的消息。
options.D: 将 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列配置为 S3 存储桶事件通知的目标。更新 Lambda 函数的执行角色，使其具有从 SQS 队列读取的权限。更新 Lambda 函数，使其消费来自 SQS 队列的消息。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

S3 事件通知已经旨在直接调用 Lambda 函数。函数的**执行角色**控制函数启动后可以执行的操作，例如从 S3 读取对象并写入 DynamoDB。它**不会**授权 Amazon S3 调用该函数。

AWS 文档指出，必须通过 **Lambda 函数的基于资源的策略**授予 S3 调用函数的权限。S3 以异步方式调用 Lambda，并提供一个包含 S3 存储桶名称和对象键的事件。`s3:ObjectCreated:*` 通知类别涵盖通过 `PUT`、`POST`、`COPY` 和分段上传等操作创建对象；在现有键下上传替换对象，从事件通知的角度来看同样属于对象创建操作。请参阅 [使用 Lambda 处理 Amazon S3 事件通知](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/with-s3.html) 和 [SQS、SNS 和 Lambda 支持的事件类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-event-types-and-destinations.html)。

## 正确答案

**B. 为 Lambda 函数创建资源策略，授予 Amazon S3 在该 S3 存储桶上调用 Lambda 函数的权限。**

Lambda 基于资源的策略必须允许 `s3.amazonaws.com` 服务主体执行 `lambda:InvokeFunction`，通常会通过源存储桶 ARN 和源账户加以限制。AWS 明确说明，S3 需要在 Lambda 函数上拥有调用权限；当 S3 通知以 Lambda 为目标时，此权限需在函数上配置。请参阅 [授予调用 AWS Lambda 函数的权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/grant-destinations-permissions-to-s3.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A 错误。** S3 存储桶策略控制对 S3 存储桶及其对象的访问。它不是授予调用 Lambda 函数权限的位置。调用权限应配置在 Lambda 函数的基于资源的策略中。

- **C 错误。** `OnFailure` 目标用于异步 Lambda 调用失败之后。在这里，S3 根本无法调用该函数，因此失败目标无法修复缺失的调用权限。它也不会使 SQS 队列成为 S3 事件源。

- **D 错误。** 通过 SQS 路由 S3 通知是一种可选架构，但对于题目所述的直接 S3 到 Lambda 设计而言没有必要。此外，仅授予执行角色读取 SQS 的权限并修改函数代码，并不是标准的 Lambda 集成方式；还需要 SQS 事件源映射来轮询队列并调用函数。直接且最小化的修复方法是在 Lambda 基于资源的策略中授权 S3。

en.question: A company recently configured AWS Control Tower in its organization in AWS Organizations. The company enrolled all existing AWS accounts in AWS Control Tower. The company wants to ensure that all new AWS accounts are automatically enrolled in AWS Control Tower. The company has an existing AWS Step Functions workflow that creates new AWS accounts and performs any actions required as part of account creation. The Step Functions workflow is defined in the same AWS account as AWS Control Tower. Which combination of steps should the company add to the Step Functions workflow to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge event that has an aws.controltower source and a CreateManagedAccount detail-type. Add the details of the new AWS account to the detail field of the event.
options.B: Create an Amazon EventBridge event that has an aws.controltower source and a SetupLandingZone detail-type. Add the details of the new AWS account to the detail field of the event.
options.C: Create an AWSControlTowerExecution role in the new AWS account. Configure the role to allow the AWS Control Tower administrator account to assume the role.
options.D: Call the AWS Service Catalog ProvisionProduct API operation with the details of the new AWS account.
options.E: Call the Organizations EnableAWSServiceAccess API operation with the controltower.amazonaws.com service name and the details of the new AWS account.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The workflow already creates an AWS Organizations member account outside AWS Control Tower Account Factory. It must then programmatically bring that newly created account under AWS Control Tower governance. From AWS Control Tower's perspective, this is enrollment of an **existing member account**.

## Correct answers: C and D

### C. Create the `AWSControlTowerExecution` role in the new account

AWS Control Tower requires this role in an account that will be enrolled programmatically. Its trust policy must allow the AWS Control Tower management/administrator account to assume it, enabling AWS Control Tower to deploy the baseline resources and manage the account.

AWS explicitly provides an example for creating the required `AWSControlTowerExecution` role and states that it enables programmatic enrollment. The example trusts the administrator account and grants the role `AdministratorAccess` ([AWS Control Tower: Enrolling existing accounts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html)).

### D. Call the AWS Service Catalog `ProvisionProduct` API operation

AWS Control Tower Account Factory is integrated with AWS Service Catalog. The `ProvisionProduct` API can be used either to provision a new AWS Control Tower account or to enroll an existing organization member account. Because this workflow has already created the account, it supplies that account's details and the target managed OU as provisioning parameters.

AWS documentation specifically states that, to enroll an existing member account with `ProvisionProduct`, the `AWSControlTowerExecution` role must exist in the target account **before** the API is called. This directly establishes the required combination and ordering: **C, then D** ([Automate Account Provisioning by Service Catalog APIs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/automated-provisioning-walkthrough.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create a `CreateManagedAccount` EventBridge event

`CreateManagedAccount` is an AWS Control Tower **lifecycle event emitted after Account Factory creates and provisions an account**. It records the outcome of the operation; publishing a similarly named custom EventBridge event does not invoke account enrollment. Moreover, the documented EventBridge `detail-type` is `AWS Service Event via CloudTrail`, while `CreateManagedAccount` appears as `detail.eventName`, not as the top-level `detail-type` proposed by the option ([AWS Control Tower lifecycle events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/lifecycle-events.html)).

### B. Create a `SetupLandingZone` EventBridge event

`SetupLandingZone` is also a lifecycle event, and it reports whether AWS Control Tower successfully set up the landing zone. It is not a command for enrolling an account. The landing zone is already configured, so attempting to publish this event would neither create nor enroll the new member account. As with option A, the proposed `detail-type` does not match the documented lifecycle-event structure ([AWS Control Tower lifecycle events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/lifecycle-events.html)).

### E. Call `EnableAWSServiceAccess` for `controltower.amazonaws.com`

`EnableAWSServiceAccess` enables **trusted access between AWS Organizations and AWS Control Tower at the organization level**. AWS documents that this trusted access is used for functions such as detecting preventive-control drift and tracking account and OU changes. It does not accept or enroll the details of a particular member account. Additionally, because AWS Control Tower is already configured for this organization, this integration should already be established. Enrollment still requires the actual account-enrollment process, represented here by C and D ([AWS Organizations integration with AWS Control Tower](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-CTower.html)).

Therefore, the required workflow steps are **C and D**.

zh.question: 某公司最近在其 AWS Organizations 组织中配置了 AWS Control Tower。该公司将所有现有 AWS 账户注册到 AWS Control Tower 中。该公司希望确保所有新的 AWS 账户都能自动注册到 AWS Control Tower。该公司有一个现有的 AWS Step Functions 工作流，该工作流会创建新的 AWS 账户并执行作为账户创建流程一部分所需的所有操作。该 Step Functions 工作流与 AWS Control Tower 定义在同一个 AWS 账户中。该公司应向 Step Functions 工作流添加哪种步骤组合以满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件，该事件的 source 为 aws.controltower，detail-type 为 CreateManagedAccount。将新 AWS 账户的详细信息添加到事件的 detail 字段中。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 事件，该事件的 source 为 aws.controltower，detail-type 为 SetupLandingZone。将新 AWS 账户的详细信息添加到事件的 detail 字段中。
options.C: 在新 AWS 账户中创建一个 AWSControlTowerExecution 角色。将该角色配置为允许 AWS Control Tower 管理员账户担任该角色。
options.D: 使用新 AWS 账户的详细信息调用 AWS Service Catalog ProvisionProduct API 操作。
options.E: 使用 controltower.amazonaws.com 服务名称和新 AWS 账户的详细信息调用 Organizations EnableAWSServiceAccess API 操作。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

该工作流已经在 AWS Control Tower Account Factory 之外创建了一个 AWS Organizations 成员账户。随后，它必须以编程方式将这个新创建的账户纳入 AWS Control Tower 治理。从 AWS Control Tower 的角度来看，这属于对一个**现有成员账户**进行注册。

## 正确答案：C 和 D

### C. 在新账户中创建 `AWSControlTowerExecution` 角色

AWS Control Tower 要求将在账户中创建此角色，以便对该账户进行编程式注册。其信任策略必须允许 AWS Control Tower 管理/管理员账户担任此角色，使 AWS Control Tower 能够部署基准资源并管理该账户。

AWS 明确提供了一个用于创建必需 `AWSControlTowerExecution` 角色的示例，并指出该角色能够实现编程式注册。该示例信任管理员账户，并向此角色授予 `AdministratorAccess`（[AWS Control Tower：注册现有账户](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/enroll-account.html)）。

### D. 调用 AWS Service Catalog `ProvisionProduct` API 操作

AWS Control Tower Account Factory 与 AWS Service Catalog 集成。`ProvisionProduct` API 可用于预置新的 AWS Control Tower 账户，或注册现有的组织成员账户。由于此工作流已经创建了账户，因此它会将该账户的详细信息和目标受管 OU 作为预置参数提供。

AWS 文档特别指出，要使用 `ProvisionProduct` 注册现有成员账户，目标账户中必须在调用 API **之前**存在 `AWSControlTowerExecution` 角色。这直接确定了所需的组合和顺序：**先 C，后 D**（[通过 Service Catalog API 自动化账户预置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/automated-provisioning-walkthrough.html)）。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 创建 `CreateManagedAccount` EventBridge 事件

`CreateManagedAccount` 是 AWS Control Tower 的一个**生命周期事件，在 Account Factory 创建并预置账户后发出**。它记录操作结果；发布一个名称相似的自定义 EventBridge 事件并不会触发账户注册。此外，文档中 EventBridge 的 `detail-type` 为 `AWS Service Event via CloudTrail`，而 `CreateManagedAccount` 出现在 `detail.eventName` 中，并非选项所述的顶层 `detail-type`（[AWS Control Tower 生命周期事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/lifecycle-events.html)）。

### B. 创建 `SetupLandingZone` EventBridge 事件

`SetupLandingZone` 也是一个生命周期事件，它报告 AWS Control Tower 是否成功设置了 landing zone。它不是注册账户的命令。landing zone 已经配置完成，因此尝试发布此事件既不会创建新成员账户，也不会将其注册。与选项 A 一样，所述的 `detail-type` 不符合文档中的生命周期事件结构（[AWS Control Tower 生命周期事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/lifecycle-events.html)）。

### E. 为 `controltower.amazonaws.com` 调用 `EnableAWSServiceAccess`

`EnableAWSServiceAccess` 在组织级别启用 AWS Organizations 和 AWS Control Tower 之间的**受信任访问**。AWS 文档说明，此受信任访问可用于检测预防性控制漂移以及跟踪账户和 OU 变更等功能。它不接受或注册特定成员账户的详细信息。此外，由于 AWS Control Tower 已经为此组织配置完成，此集成应该已经建立。注册仍然需要实际的账户注册流程，此处由 C 和 D 表示（[AWS Organizations 与 AWS Control Tower 的集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/services-that-can-integrate-CTower.html)）。

因此，工作流所需的步骤为 **C 和 D**。

en.question: A company's web application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to direct traffic to Amazon EC2 instances across three Availability Zones. The company has deployed a newer version of the application to one Availability Zone for testing. If a problem is detected with the application, the company wants to direct traffic away from the affected Availability Zone until the deployment has been rolled back. The application must remain available and maintain static stability during the rollback. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Disable cross-zone load balancing on the ALB's target group. Initiate a zonal shift on the ALB to direct traffic away from the affected Availability Zone.
options.B: Disable cross-zone load balancing on the ALB's target group. Manually remove instances in the target group that belong to the affected Availability Zone.
options.C: Configure cross-zone load balancing on the ALB's target group to inherit settings from the ALB. Initiate a zonal shift on the ALB to direct traffic away from the affected Availability Zone.
options.D: Configure cross-zone load balancing on the ALB's target group to inherit settings from the ALB. Remove the subnet that is associated with the affected Availability Zone.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

A web application runs on EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer spread across three Availability Zones. A newer application version has been deployed to **only one** Availability Zone as a test. If that version misbehaves, the company needs a fast, temporary, easily reversible way to steer traffic away from that single zone while the other two zones keep serving users from capacity that is already provisioned (static stability), until the deployment is rolled back.

**Disable cross-zone load balancing on the ALB's target group, then initiate a zonal shift on the ALB for the affected Availability Zone.**

### Why disabling cross-zone load balancing matters here

The entire premise of a single-AZ canary deployment is that each Availability Zone behaves as an independent fault container. With cross-zone load balancing **enabled**, every ALB node in every zone distributes requests to registered targets in *all* zones — so requests arriving through the two healthy zones would still be routed to the new, potentially faulty version running in the third zone. The blast radius of the test version would not be confined to its deployment zone at all.

Turning off cross-zone load balancing at the target group makes each zone's ALB nodes route only to targets in their own zone, which is exactly the Availability-Zone–independent architecture that makes a one-zone canary meaningful and makes a zonal evacuation clean. Cross-zone load balancing is an ALB attribute that target groups inherit by default and can override; you can set it explicitly on the target group. See [Edit a target group attribute](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html).

### Why zonal shift is the right evacuation control

Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift lets you move traffic away from an impaired Availability Zone for a load balancer with a **single action**, and the shift is temporary and can be cancelled at any time — ideal for "shift away, roll back, shift traffic back." Initiating a zonal shift removes the affected zone's load balancer IP addresses from the ALB's DNS name, so new connections stop entering through that zone. See [Zonal shift for an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/zonal-shift.html) and [Application Load Balancers and zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.resource-types.app-load-balancers.html).

AWS documents that when cross-zone load balancing is turned off and a zonal shift removes a zonal load balancer IP address, the affected Availability Zone **also loses its target capacity**. In this scenario that is precisely the desired outcome: the zone's ingress path *and* its faulty-version targets are taken out of service in one action, while the two healthy zones continue serving independently.

Note that ARC zonal shift integration must be enabled on the load balancer before a shift can be started; this is a prerequisite of using the feature rather than something that distinguishes the answer choices.

### Static stability

Static stability means recovery does not depend on launching new capacity or making further control-plane changes when a zone is removed. Because the two remaining zones must absorb the traffic previously served by the third, they should be pre-scaled to handle the redistributed load. See [Considerations for zonal autoshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-autoshift.considerations.html) and [Best practices for zonal shifts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/route53-arc-best-practices.zonal-shifts.html). With cross-zone load balancing off, each surviving zone serves its share of traffic from its own pre-provisioned targets, which is the cleanest expression of the static-stability pattern.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Disable cross-zone load balancing and manually remove the affected instances from the target group

Zonal isolation is correct, but manually identifying and deregistering every target in the affected Availability Zone is slow, error-prone, and must be manually undone after the rollback. It bypasses the purpose-built, single-action recovery control (zonal shift) that removes the zone's load balancer IP addresses from DNS and evacuates the zone, and it can be undone with a single cancel action. This is clearly less operationally efficient. See [Zonal shift for an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/zonal-shift.html).

### C. Configure the target group to inherit cross-zone load balancing from the ALB, then initiate a zonal shift

The zonal shift action is right, but inheriting cross-zone load balancing (which is on by default for an ALB) defeats the zonal isolation this deployment strategy depends on. Before the problem is even detected, ALB nodes in all three zones forward requests to the new-version targets in the test zone, so the faulty release affects traffic entering through every zone rather than being contained. Requirements state that traffic should be directed away from the *affected* Availability Zone; that containment model only holds when the target group has cross-zone load balancing disabled. Inheriting the setting is also still a configuration action, so it offers no efficiency advantage. See [Edit a target group attribute](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html) and [Application Load Balancers and zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.resource-types.app-load-balancers.html).

### D. Configure the target group to inherit cross-zone load balancing and remove the subnet for the affected Availability Zone

Removing a subnet changes the ALB's Availability Zone mappings and network topology, and it must be added back after the rollback — a heavier, slower, and less reversible operation than starting and cancelling a zonal shift. It also keeps cross-zone load balancing enabled, so the faulty targets remain reachable through the remaining zones' ALB nodes while the change is being made. Subnet mapping is documented as ALB infrastructure configuration, not as a temporary zonal recovery control. See [Availability Zones for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-subnets.html).

## Conclusion

**A** meets all requirements with the least operational effort: disabling cross-zone load balancing on the target group makes each Availability Zone an independent fault container so the single-AZ test deployment is contained, and an ARC zonal shift then evacuates the affected zone's load balancer IP addresses and target capacity in one reversible action. With the other two zones already scaled to carry the load, the application stays available and statically stable throughout the rollback.

zh.question: 某公司的 Web 应用程序使用 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 将流量分发到三个可用区中的 Amazon EC2 实例。该公司已将应用程序的较新版本部署到其中一个可用区进行测试。如果检测到应用程序出现问题，该公司希望将流量从受影响的可用区引开，直到部署被回滚为止。在回滚期间，应用程序必须保持可用并维持静态稳定性。哪种解决方案能以最高的运维效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 ALB 的目标组上禁用跨区域负载均衡。在 ALB 上发起 zonal shift，将流量从受影响的可用区引开。
options.B: 在 ALB 的目标组上禁用跨区域负载均衡。手动从目标组中移除属于受影响可用区的实例。
options.C: 将 ALB 目标组的跨区域负载均衡配置为继承 ALB 的设置。在 ALB 上发起 zonal shift，将流量从受影响的可用区引开。
options.D: 将 ALB 目标组的跨区域负载均衡配置为继承 ALB 的设置。移除与受影响可用区关联的子网。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

一个 Web 应用程序运行在 Application Load Balancer 后的 EC2 实例上，分布在三个可用区中。较新的应用程序版本**仅**部署到了一个可用区作为测试。如果该版本出现异常，公司需要一种快速、临时且易于撤销的方式，将流量从该单个区域引开，同时另外两个区域继续使用已经预配的容量为用户提供服务（静态稳定性），直到部署被回滚。

**在 ALB 的目标组上禁用跨区域负载均衡，然后针对受影响的可用区在 ALB 上发起 zonal shift。**

### 为什么禁用跨区域负载均衡在此很重要

单可用区金丝雀部署的整个前提是：每个可用区都作为独立的故障隔离单元。当跨区域负载均衡**启用**时，每个区域中的每个 ALB 节点都会将请求分发到*所有*区域中已注册的目标 —— 因此通过两个健康区域进入的请求仍会被路由到运行在第三个区域中的、可能有故障的新版本。测试版本的影响范围根本无法被限制在其部署区域内。

在目标组上关闭跨区域负载均衡，可使每个区域的 ALB 节点只路由到本区域内的目标，这正是使单区域金丝雀部署有意义、并使区域撤离干净利落的可用区独立架构。跨区域负载均衡是一个 ALB 属性，目标组默认继承它并且可以覆盖；你可以在目标组上显式设置它。参见 [Edit a target group attribute](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html)。

### 为什么 zonal shift 是正确的撤离控制手段

Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift 让你能够通过**单个操作**将流量从受损的可用区中转移出负载均衡器，并且该转移是临时的、随时可以取消 —— 非常适合「转移走流量、回滚、再把流量转回来」的场景。发起 zonal shift 会将受影响区域的负载均衡器 IP 地址从 ALB 的 DNS 名称中移除，因此新连接不再通过该区域进入。参见 [Zonal shift for an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/zonal-shift.html) 和 [Application Load Balancers and zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.resource-types.app-load-balancers.html)。

AWS 文档指出，当跨区域负载均衡被关闭且 zonal shift 移除了某个区域的负载均衡器 IP 地址时，受影响的可用区**也会失去其目标容量**。在本场景中这正是期望的结果：该区域的入口路径*以及*其故障版本的目标在一次操作中被同时移出服务，而两个健康区域继续独立提供服务。

请注意，在启动转移之前必须在负载均衡器上启用 ARC zonal shift 集成；这是使用该功能的前提条件，而不是区分各选项的因素。

### 静态稳定性

静态稳定性意味着当某个区域被移除时，恢复不依赖于启动新容量或进行进一步的控制平面更改。由于剩余的两个区域必须承担原先由第三个区域处理的流量，它们应预先扩容以应对重新分配的负载。参见 [Considerations for zonal autoshift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-autoshift.considerations.html) 和 [Best practices for zonal shifts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/route53-arc-best-practices.zonal-shifts.html)。在关闭跨区域负载均衡的情况下，每个存活区域使用自己预先预配的目标来处理其份额的流量，这是静态稳定性模式最清晰的体现。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B. 禁用跨区域负载均衡并手动从目标组中移除受影响的实例

区域隔离是正确的，但手动识别并注销受影响可用区中的每个目标既缓慢又容易出错，并且在回滚后必须手动撤销。它绕过了专门设计的单操作恢复控制手段（zonal shift）—— 后者会将该区域的负载均衡器 IP 地址从 DNS 中移除并撤离该区域，且可以通过一次取消操作撤销。这显然运维效率更低。参见 [Zonal shift for an Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/zonal-shift.html)。

### C. 将目标组配置为继承 ALB 的跨区域负载均衡设置，然后发起 zonal shift

zonal shift 操作是对的，但继承跨区域负载均衡（ALB 默认开启）会破坏此部署策略所依赖的区域隔离。在问题被发现之前，所有三个区域中的 ALB 节点都会将请求转发到测试区域中的新版本目标，因此有故障的版本会影响通过每个区域进入的流量，而不是被隔离。要求指出应将流量从*受影响的*可用区引开；只有当目标组禁用了跨区域负载均衡时，该隔离模型才成立。继承该设置本身仍然是一次配置操作，因此也没有效率上的优势。参见 [Edit a target group attribute](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/edit-target-group-attributes.html) 和 [Application Load Balancers and zonal shift](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/r53recovery/latest/dg/arc-zonal-shift.resource-types.app-load-balancers.html)。

### D. 将目标组配置为继承跨区域负载均衡并移除受影响可用区的子网

移除子网会改变 ALB 的可用区映射和网络拓扑，并且在回滚后必须重新添加回来 —— 这比启动和取消 zonal shift 更繁重、更缓慢、可逆性更差。它同时保持了跨区域负载均衡处于启用状态，因此在进行更改期间，有故障的目标仍可通过其余区域的 ALB 节点访问到。子网映射在文档中被定义为 ALB 基础设施配置，而不是临时的区域恢复控制手段。参见 [Availability Zones for your Application Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/load-balancer-subnets.html)。

## 结论

**A** 以最少的运维工作量满足所有要求：在目标组上禁用跨区域负载均衡使每个可用区成为独立的故障隔离单元，从而将单可用区测试部署限制在其范围内；随后 ARC zonal shift 通过一次可逆的操作撤离受影响区域的负载均衡器 IP 地址和目标容量。由于另外两个区域已经扩容以承载负载，应用程序在整个回滚期间保持可用并具备静态稳定性。

en.question: A company has several AWS accounts. An Amazon Connect instance runs in each account. The company uses an Amazon EventBridge default event bus in each account for event handling. A DevOps team needs to receive all the Amazon Connect events in a single DevOps account. Which solution meets these requirements?

options.A: Update the resource-based policy of the default event bus in each account to allow the DevOps account to replay events. Configure an EventBridge rule in the DevOps account that matches Amazon Connect events and has a target of the default event bus in the other accounts.
options.B: Update the resource-based policy of the default event bus in each account to allow the DevOps account to receive events. Configure an EventBridge rule in the DevOps account that matches Amazon Connect events and has a target of the default event bus in the other accounts.
options.C: Update the resource-based policy of the default event bus in the DevOps account. Update the policy to allow events to be received from the accounts. Configure an EventBridge rule in each account that matches Amazon Connect events and has a target of the DevOps account's default event bus.
options.D: Update the resource-based policy of the default event bus in the DevOps account. Update the policy to allow events to be replayed by the accounts. Configure an EventBridge rule in each account that matches Amazon Connect events and has a target of the DevOps account's default event bus.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs to **forward live Amazon Connect events from several source accounts into one central DevOps account**. Amazon Connect emits several event types to the account's **EventBridge default event bus**, so each source account must match those local events and send them to the centralized bus. AWS documents that Amazon Connect events, including Voice ID events, are sent to the default event bus ([Amazon Connect events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/connect-eventbridge-events.html)).

For cross-account EventBridge routing, AWS specifies this configuration:

1. In the **receiver account**, add a resource-based policy to the destination event bus permitting the source accounts to send events.
2. In each **sender account**, create an EventBridge rule whose target is the receiver account's event bus.

This is the exact sender/receiver model described in the [EventBridge cross-account documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-cross-account.html). The receiving bus policy grants the source accounts permission to perform `events:PutEvents`. For newly created cross-account event-bus targets, an IAM role is also required on the sending side; the console can create this role during rule configuration.

## Correct answer: C

The DevOps account is the **receiver**, so its default event bus must have a resource-based policy that authorizes the other accounts to send events. Each Amazon Connect account is a **sender**, so it needs a rule that matches its local Amazon Connect events and uses the DevOps account's default event bus as the target.

This correctly centralizes the events in the DevOps account.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** The event flow is reversed. A rule in the DevOps account targeting the buses in the Amazon Connect accounts would send events away from the central account rather than collect them. In addition, granting permission to **replay** events is not the authorization needed for live cross-account delivery.

- **B — Incorrect.** This also reverses the sender and receiver configuration. The resource policy must be attached to the **DevOps account's receiving bus**, not to each source account's bus. The rules matching Amazon Connect events must run in the accounts where those events are initially emitted.

- **D — Incorrect.** The rule placement and event-flow direction are correct, but the permission is wrong. The receiving bus must authorize the source accounts to **send/put events**, not replay them. EventBridge replay is an archive feature for historical events, and archived events can only be replayed to their source event bus ([EventBridge archive replay](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-archive.html)).

zh.question: 一家公司拥有多个 AWS 账户。每个账户中都运行一个 Amazon Connect 实例。该公司在每个账户中使用 Amazon EventBridge 默认事件总线进行事件处理。一个 DevOps 团队需要在一个单独的 DevOps 账户中接收所有 Amazon Connect 事件。哪种解决方案能满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新每个账户中默认事件总线的基于资源的策略，以允许 DevOps 账户重放事件。在 DevOps 账户中配置一个与 Amazon Connect 事件匹配的 EventBridge 规则，并将其他账户中的默认事件总线设为目标。
options.B: 更新每个账户中默认事件总线的基于资源的策略，以允许 DevOps 账户接收事件。在 DevOps 账户中配置一个与 Amazon Connect 事件匹配的 EventBridge 规则，并将其他账户中的默认事件总线设为目标。
options.C: 更新 DevOps 账户中默认事件总线的基于资源的策略。更新该策略以允许从这些账户接收事件。在每个账户中配置一个与 Amazon Connect 事件匹配的 EventBridge 规则，并将 DevOps 账户的默认事件总线设为目标。
options.D: 更新 DevOps 账户中默认事件总线的基于资源的策略。更新该策略以允许这些账户重放事件。在每个账户中配置一个与 Amazon Connect 事件匹配的 EventBridge 规则，并将 DevOps 账户的默认事件总线设为目标。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

公司需要将来自多个源账户的**实时 Amazon Connect 事件转发到一个中央 DevOps 账户**。Amazon Connect 会将多种事件类型发送到该账户的 **EventBridge 默认事件总线**，因此每个源账户都必须匹配这些本地事件，并将其发送到集中式事件总线。AWS 文档指出，Amazon Connect 事件（包括 Voice ID 事件）会被发送到默认事件总线（[Amazon Connect 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/connect-eventbridge-events.html)）。

对于跨账户 EventBridge 路由，AWS 指定了以下配置：

1. 在**接收方账户**中，为目标事件总线添加一个基于资源的策略，以允许源账户发送事件。
2. 在每个**发送方账户**中，创建一个 EventBridge 规则，并将接收方账户的事件总线作为其目标。

这正是 [EventBridge 跨账户文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-cross-account.html) 中描述的发送方/接收方模型。接收事件总线的策略授予源账户执行 `events:PutEvents` 的权限。对于新建的跨账户事件总线目标，发送方还需要一个 IAM 角色；控制台可以在配置规则期间创建此角色。

## 正确答案：C

DevOps 账户是**接收方**，因此其默认事件总线必须具有一个基于资源的策略，以授权其他账户发送事件。每个 Amazon Connect 账户都是**发送方**，因此都需要一个规则来匹配其本地 Amazon Connect 事件，并将 DevOps 账户的默认事件总线用作目标。

这可以正确地将事件集中到 DevOps 账户中。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A — 不正确。**事件流方向相反。DevOps 账户中的规则若以 Amazon Connect 账户中的事件总线为目标，会将事件从中央账户发送出去，而不是将其收集进来。此外，授予**重放**事件的权限并不是实时跨账户传递所需的授权。

- **B — 不正确。**这同样颠倒了发送方和接收方的配置。资源策略必须附加到**DevOps 账户的接收事件总线**，而不是每个源账户的事件总线。匹配 Amazon Connect 事件的规则必须在最初发出这些事件的账户中运行。

- **D — 不正确。**规则的位置和事件流方向是正确的，但权限错误。接收事件总线必须授权源账户**发送/写入事件**，而不是重放事件。EventBridge 重放是用于历史事件的归档功能，并且归档事件只能重放到其源事件总线（[EventBridge 归档重放](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-archive.html)）。

en.question: A company has deployed an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster with Amazon EC2 node groups. The company's DevOps team uses the Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler and recently installed a supported EKS cluster Autoscaler. The DevOps team needs to implement a solution to collect metrics and logs of the EKS cluster to establish a baseline for performance. The DevOps team will create an initial set of thresholds for specific metrics and will update the thresholds over time as the cluster is used. The DevOps team must receive an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) email notification if the initial set of thresholds is exceeded or if the EKS cluster Autoscaler is not functioning properly. The solution must collect cluster, node, and pod metrics. The solution also must capture logs in Amazon CloudWatch. Which combination of steps should the DevOps team take to meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Deploy the CloudWatch agent and Fluent Bit to the cluster. Ensure that the EKS cluster has appropriate permissions to send metrics and logs to CloudWatch.
options.B: Deploy AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry to the cluster. Ensure that the EKS cluster has appropriate permissions to send metrics and logs to CloudWatch.
options.C: Create CloudWatch alarms to monitor the CPU, memory, and node failure metrics of the cluster. Configure the alarms to send an SNS email notification to the DevOps team if thresholds are exceeded.
options.D: Create a CloudWatch composite alarm to monitor a metric log filter of the CPU, memory, and node metrics of the cluster. Configure the alarm to send an SNS email notification to the DevOps team when anomalies are detected.
options.E: Create a CloudWatch alarm to monitor the logs of the Autoscaler deployments for errors. Configure the alarm to send an SNS email notification to the DevOps team if thresholds are exceeded.
options.F: Create a CloudWatch alarm to monitor a metric log filter of the Autoscaler deployments for errors. Configure the alarm to send an SNS email notification to the DevOps team if thresholds are exceeded.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The team needs three capabilities:

1. Collect EKS infrastructure metrics at the **cluster, node, and pod** levels and send container logs to CloudWatch.
2. Alert on fixed, initially defined thresholds for CPU, memory, and failed-node metrics.
3. Detect errors from the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler and notify the team through Amazon SNS email.

## Correct answers: A, C, and F

### A. Deploy the CloudWatch agent and Fluent Bit

This is the AWS-documented CloudWatch Container Insights architecture for Amazon EKS. Enhanced Container Insights collects detailed pod-, node-, and cluster-level metrics, with the **CloudWatch agent collecting infrastructure metrics** and **Fluent Bit forwarding container logs**. The workloads need appropriate IAM permissions to publish the telemetry to CloudWatch.

AWS explicitly states that Enhanced Container Insights provides detailed Kubernetes metrics at the pod, node, and cluster levels and collects infrastructure metrics and container logs through the CloudWatch agent and Fluent Bit. AWS also documents Fluent Bit as the supported mechanism for sending container logs to CloudWatch Logs.

References: [Enhanced Container Insights for EKS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/container-insights-eks-classic.html) and [Send EKS container logs to CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-EKS-logs.html).

### C. Create metric alarms for CPU, memory, and node-failure metrics

Container Insights publishes metrics that directly satisfy these monitoring requirements. Examples include:

- `cluster_failed_node_count`
- `node_cpu_utilization`
- `node_memory_utilization`
- `pod_cpu_utilization`
- `pod_memory_utilization`

The team can establish baseline values, create ordinary CloudWatch metric alarms with static thresholds, and revise those thresholds as operating experience increases. CloudWatch alarms can publish state-change notifications to an SNS topic with an email subscription.

References: [EKS Container Insights cluster, node, and pod metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/container-insights-eks-classic-metrics.html) and [Setting up SNS notifications for CloudWatch alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Notify_Users_Alarm_Changes.html).

### F. Create an alarm on a metric filter for Autoscaler errors

The Autoscaler runs as a Kubernetes deployment, and Fluent Bit can send its container logs to CloudWatch Logs. A CloudWatch Logs metric filter can match error patterns in those logs and publish a numerical custom metric. A CloudWatch metric alarm can then evaluate that metric against a threshold and send an SNS notification.

AWS documents this workflow explicitly: create a metric filter over the log group, create an alarm based on the resulting metric, specify the threshold, and select an SNS topic for notification.

Reference: [Create a CloudWatch alarm based on a log group metric filter](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html).

## Why the other options are not the intended answers

### B. Deploy AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry

ADOT is a general OpenTelemetry-based telemetry collection solution, but it is not the specific EKS Container Insights deployment described by the question's requirements. The AWS-documented solution that directly provides the required cluster/node/pod infrastructure metrics together with container log forwarding is the CloudWatch agent plus Fluent Bit. Therefore, A is the precise exam answer.

### D. Create a composite alarm over a metric log filter and use anomaly detection

This option mixes several different CloudWatch concepts incorrectly:

- CPU, memory, and failed-node values are already Container Insights **metrics**; they do not need to be extracted from logs through a metric filter.
- A composite alarm does not directly evaluate a metric or metric filter. It evaluates the **states of other metric or composite alarms** by using Boolean rules.
- The requirement asks for an initial set of thresholds that the team will update, which aligns with static metric alarms in C, not specifically anomaly detection.

Reference: [CloudWatch composite alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html).

### E. Create a CloudWatch alarm that monitors Autoscaler logs directly

For the historical/intended exam architecture, a standard CloudWatch metric alarm cannot evaluate raw log events directly. The logs first need to be converted into a metric by a CloudWatch Logs metric filter, making F the intended answer.

However, current CloudWatch documentation now also describes a newer **Log Alarm** capability that can run a scheduled CloudWatch Logs Insights query and evaluate its aggregated result directly. Under current service functionality, E can therefore also be implemented if interpreted as a CloudWatch Log Alarm. This makes E versus F ambiguous in the question as presently worded, although **F remains the stated and historically intended answer**.

Reference: [CloudWatch log alarms and metric-filter-based alarms](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html).

zh.question: 一家公司已部署一个具有 Amazon EC2 节点组的 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。该公司的 DevOps 团队使用 Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaler，并且最近安装了受支持的 EKS Cluster Autoscaler。DevOps 团队需要实施一个解决方案来收集 EKS 集群的指标和日志，以建立性能基线。DevOps 团队将为特定指标创建一组初始阈值，并会随着集群的使用逐步更新这些阈值。如果超出初始阈值集，或者 EKS Cluster Autoscaler 未正常运行，DevOps 团队必须收到 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 电子邮件通知。该解决方案必须收集集群、节点和 Pod 指标。此外，该解决方案还必须在 Amazon CloudWatch 中捕获日志。DevOps 团队应采取哪种步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 将 CloudWatch agent 和 Fluent Bit 部署到集群。确保 EKS 集群具有将指标和日志发送到 CloudWatch 的适当权限。
options.B: 将 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry 部署到集群。确保 EKS 集群具有将指标和日志发送到 CloudWatch 的适当权限。
options.C: 创建 CloudWatch 警报以监控集群的 CPU、内存和节点故障指标。配置这些警报，以便在超过阈值时向 DevOps 团队发送 SNS 电子邮件通知。
options.D: 创建 CloudWatch 复合警报，以监控集群 CPU、内存和节点指标的指标日志筛选器。当检测到异常时，配置该警报向 DevOps 团队发送 SNS 电子邮件通知。
options.E: 创建 CloudWatch 警报以监控 Autoscaler 部署日志中的错误。如果超过阈值，配置该警报向 DevOps 团队发送 SNS 电子邮件通知。
options.F: 创建 CloudWatch 警报以监控 Autoscaler 部署日志中错误的指标日志筛选器。如果超过阈值，配置该警报向 DevOps 团队发送 SNS 电子邮件通知。

zh.explanation:
## 题目所问内容

团队需要具备三项能力：

1. 在 **集群、节点和 Pod** 层级收集 EKS 基础设施指标，并将容器日志发送至 CloudWatch。
2. 针对 CPU、内存和节点失败指标的预先定义固定阈值发出告警。
3. 检测 Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler 的错误，并通过 Amazon SNS 电子邮件通知团队。

## 正确答案：A、C 和 F

### A. 部署 CloudWatch agent 和 Fluent Bit

这是 AWS 为 Amazon EKS 记录的 CloudWatch Container Insights 架构。增强型 Container Insights 可收集详细的 Pod、节点和集群级别指标，其中 **CloudWatch agent 收集基础设施指标**，而 **Fluent Bit 转发容器日志**。这些工作负载需要具备相应的 IAM 权限，才能将遥测数据发布至 CloudWatch。

AWS 明确说明，增强型 Container Insights 在 Pod、节点和集群级别提供详细的 Kubernetes 指标，并通过 CloudWatch agent 和 Fluent Bit 收集基础设施指标及容器日志。AWS 还将 Fluent Bit 记录为向 CloudWatch Logs 发送容器日志的受支持机制。

参考资料：[适用于 EKS 的增强型 Container Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/container-insights-eks-classic.html) 和 [将 EKS 容器日志发送至 CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Container-Insights-EKS-logs.html)。

### C. 为 CPU、内存和节点失败指标创建指标警报

Container Insights 发布的指标可直接满足这些监控要求。示例包括：

- `cluster_failed_node_count`
- `node_cpu_utilization`
- `node_memory_utilization`
- `pod_cpu_utilization`
- `pod_memory_utilization`

团队可以建立基线值，使用静态阈值创建常规 CloudWatch 指标警报，并随着运营经验的增加修订这些阈值。CloudWatch 警报可以向具有电子邮件订阅的 SNS 主题发布状态变更通知。

参考资料：[EKS Container Insights 集群、节点和 Pod 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/container-insights-eks-classic-metrics.html) 和 [为 CloudWatch 警报设置 SNS 通知](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Notify_Users_Alarm_Changes.html)。

### F. 针对 Autoscaler 错误的指标筛选器创建警报

Autoscaler 作为 Kubernetes 部署运行，而 Fluent Bit 可以将其容器日志发送至 CloudWatch Logs。CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器可以匹配这些日志中的错误模式，并发布数值型自定义指标。随后，CloudWatch 指标警报可以根据阈值评估该指标并发送 SNS 通知。

AWS 明确记录了此工作流程：在日志组上创建指标筛选器、基于生成的指标创建警报、指定阈值，并选择用于通知的 SNS 主题。

参考资料：[基于日志组指标筛选器创建 CloudWatch 警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)。

## 其他选项为何不是预期答案

### B. 部署 AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry

ADOT 是基于 OpenTelemetry 的通用遥测数据收集解决方案，但并非该题需求所描述的特定 EKS Container Insights 部署方式。AWS 所记录的、可直接提供所需集群/节点/Pod 基础设施指标以及容器日志转发功能的解决方案，是 CloudWatch agent 加 Fluent Bit。因此，A 是精确的考试答案。

### D. 对指标日志筛选器创建复合警报并使用异常检测

该选项错误地混合了多种不同的 CloudWatch 概念：

- CPU、内存和节点失败值本身已经是 Container Insights **指标**；无需通过指标筛选器从日志中提取。
- 复合警报不会直接评估指标或指标筛选器。它通过布尔规则评估其他指标警报或复合警报的**状态**。
- 要求中提到团队将设定初始阈值并进行更新，这符合 C 中的静态指标警报，而非特定的异常检测。

参考资料：[CloudWatch 复合警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-combining.html)。

### E. 创建直接监控 Autoscaler 日志的 CloudWatch 警报

对于历史上的预期考试架构，标准 CloudWatch 指标警报无法直接评估原始日志事件。日志首先需要通过 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器转换为指标，因此 F 是预期答案。

但是，当前 CloudWatch 文档现在还描述了一种较新的 **Log Alarm** 功能，该功能可以运行计划性的 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询，并直接评估其聚合结果。根据当前服务功能，如果将其解释为 CloudWatch Log Alarm，E 也可以实施。因此，按照目前的题目表述，E 与 F 存在歧义，尽管 **F 仍是既定且历史上预期的答案**。

参考资料：[CloudWatch 日志警报和基于指标筛选器的警报](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/Alarm-On-Logs.html)。

en.question: A company discovers that its production environment and disaster recovery (DR) environment are deployed to the same AWS Region. All the production applications run on Amazon EC2 instances and are deployed by AWS CloudFormation. The applications use an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP volume for application storage. No application data resides on the EC2 instances. A DevOps engineer copies the required AMIs to a new DR Region. The DevOps engineer also updates the CloudFormation code to accept a Region as a parameter. The storage needs to have an RPO of 10 minutes in the DR Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket in both Regions. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) for the S3 buckets. Create a scheduled AWS Lambda function to copy any new content from the FSx for ONTAP volume to the S3 bucket in the production Region.
options.B: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault and a custom backup plan that has a 10-minute frequency. Specify the DR Region as the target Region. Assign the EC2 instances in the production Region to the backup plan.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to create snapshots of the instance store volumes that are attached to the EC2 instances. Configure the Lambda function to copy the snapshots to the DR Region and to remove the previous copies. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule that invokes the Lambda function every 10 minutes.
options.D: Create an FSx for ONTAP instance in the DR Region. Configure a 5-minute schedule for a volume-level NetApp SnapMirror to replicate the volume from the production Region to the DR Region.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The EC2 instances are stateless from a data-protection perspective: the question explicitly says that all application data is stored on an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP volume. Therefore, the DR solution must replicate that **FSx for ONTAP volume to another AWS Region** with a recovery point objective (RPO) of no more than 10 minutes.

## Correct answer: D

Create an FSx for ONTAP file system in the DR Region and configure **volume-level NetApp SnapMirror** replication on a 5-minute schedule.

AWS documents that SnapMirror can replicate between FSx for ONTAP file systems in both **in-Region and cross-Region deployments**, and that replication can be scheduled as frequently as **every 5 minutes**. AWS also states that FSx for ONTAP supports **volume-level SnapMirror** replication. Therefore, a 5-minute schedule directly protects the storage that contains the application data and satisfies the required 10-minute RPO. See [Replicating your data using NetApp SnapMirror](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/scheduled-replication.html).

The copied AMIs and Region-parameterized CloudFormation templates can recreate the application compute layer in the DR Region, while SnapMirror supplies the replicated application data.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Copy FSx files to S3 and use S3 Cross-Region Replication

This is a custom file-copy pipeline rather than native FSx for ONTAP volume replication. S3 Cross-Region Replication operates only after the data has first been copied from the ONTAP volume into the source S3 bucket. The option does not establish a suitable frequency or an end-to-end 10-minute RPO for the FSx data, and recovery would require reconstructing the ONTAP file-system data from S3. SnapMirror is the purpose-built cross-Region replication mechanism for this workload.

### B. Use AWS Backup every 10 minutes and assign the EC2 instances

This option has two independent problems:

1. AWS Backup snapshot backups can be scheduled only as frequently as **hourly**, not every 10 minutes. See [Backup plan options and configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/plan-options-and-configuration.html).
2. The plan assigns the **EC2 instances**, but the application data resides on the separate FSx for ONTAP volume. FSx for ONTAP backups are per-volume, so protecting only the EC2 resources does not protect the application storage. See [Protecting your data with volume backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/using-backups.html).

Thus, this solution cannot provide the required 10-minute storage RPO.

### C. Snapshot EC2 instance store volumes every 10 minutes

No application data resides on the EC2 instances, so protecting their local storage does not protect the application data. In addition, EC2 instance store is temporary storage: its data is deleted if the instance terminates or fails, and it is not handled through the normal EBS snapshot workflow. AWS recommends backing up critical instance-store data to persistent storage instead. See [Root volumes for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/RootDeviceStorage.html).

Therefore, this option targets the wrong storage and does not replicate the FSx for ONTAP volume.

zh.question: 一家公司发现其生产环境和灾难恢复 (DR) 环境部署在同一个 AWS Region 中。所有生产应用程序都运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上，并通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署。这些应用程序使用 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 卷作为应用程序存储。没有应用程序数据驻留在 EC2 实例上。一名 DevOps 工程师将所需的 AMI 复制到新的 DR Region。该 DevOps 工程师还更新了 CloudFormation 代码，使其能够接受 Region 作为参数。DR Region 中的存储需要具有 10 分钟的 RPO。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 在两个 Region 中各创建一个 Amazon S3 bucket。为这些 S3 bucket 配置 S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR)。创建一个计划执行的 AWS Lambda 函数，将 FSx for ONTAP 卷中的任何新内容复制到生产 Region 中的 S3 bucket。
options.B: 使用 AWS Backup 创建一个备份 vault 和一个频率为 10 分钟的自定义备份计划。将 DR Region 指定为目标 Region。将生产 Region 中的 EC2 实例分配给该备份计划。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，为附加到 EC2 实例的 instance store 卷创建快照。配置该 Lambda 函数将快照复制到 DR Region 并删除之前的副本。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 计划规则，每 10 分钟调用一次该 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 在 DR Region 中创建一个 FSx for ONTAP 实例。配置一个每 5 分钟执行一次的卷级 NetApp SnapMirror，将卷从生产 Region 复制到 DR Region。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

从数据保护的角度来看，EC2 实例是无状态的：题目明确说明，所有应用程序数据都存储在 Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 卷中。因此，DR 解决方案必须将该 **FSx for ONTAP 卷复制到另一个 AWS Region**，且恢复点目标 (RPO) 不得超过 10 分钟。

## 正确答案：D

在 DR Region 中创建一个 FSx for ONTAP 文件系统，并配置按 5 分钟计划执行的 **卷级 NetApp SnapMirror** 复制。

AWS 文档说明，SnapMirror 可以在 **同 Region 和跨 Region 部署**中的 FSx for ONTAP 文件系统之间进行复制，并且复制计划最快可设置为 **每 5 分钟一次**。AWS 还说明 FSx for ONTAP 支持 **卷级 SnapMirror** 复制。因此，5 分钟计划可以直接保护包含应用程序数据的存储，并满足所需的 10 分钟 RPO。请参阅 [Replicating your data using NetApp SnapMirror](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/scheduled-replication.html)。

已复制的 AMI 和接受 Region 参数的 CloudFormation 模板可以在 DR Region 中重新创建应用程序计算层，而 SnapMirror 则提供复制的应用程序数据。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 将 FSx 文件复制到 S3 并使用 S3 Cross-Region Replication

这是一种自定义文件复制管道，而不是原生的 FSx for ONTAP 卷复制。只有先将数据从 ONTAP 卷复制到源 S3 bucket 后，S3 Cross-Region Replication 才会运行。该选项没有建立适当的频率，也无法为 FSx 数据提供端到端的 10 分钟 RPO；恢复时还需要从 S3 重建 ONTAP 文件系统数据。对于此工作负载，SnapMirror 是专门构建的跨 Region 复制机制。

### B. 每 10 分钟使用 AWS Backup，并分配 EC2 实例

此选项存在两个独立的问题：

1. AWS Backup 快照备份的计划频率最高只能为 **每小时一次**，而非每 10 分钟一次。请参阅 [Backup plan options and configuration](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-backup/latest/devguide/plan-options-and-configuration.html)。
2. 该计划分配的是 **EC2 实例**，但应用程序数据驻留在独立的 FSx for ONTAP 卷中。FSx for ONTAP 备份按卷执行，因此仅保护 EC2 资源无法保护应用程序存储。请参阅 [Protecting your data with volume backups](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/ONTAPGuide/using-backups.html)。

因此，此解决方案无法提供所需的 10 分钟存储 RPO。

### C. 每 10 分钟为 EC2 instance store 卷创建快照

没有应用程序数据驻留在 EC2 实例上，因此保护其本地存储并不能保护应用程序数据。此外，EC2 instance store 是临时存储：如果实例终止或发生故障，其数据会被删除，并且无法通过常规的 EBS 快照工作流进行处理。AWS 建议将关键的 instance-store 数据备份到持久性存储。请参阅 [Root volumes for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/RootDeviceStorage.html)。

因此，此选项针对的是错误的存储，并且不会复制 FSx for ONTAP 卷。

en.question: During a security audit, a company discovered that some security groups allow SSH traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. A security team must implement a solution to detect and remediate this issue as soon as possible. The company uses one organization in AWS Organizations to manage all the company's AWS accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Enable AWS Config for all AWS accounts. Use a periodic trigger to activate the vpe-sg-port-restriction-check AWS Config rule. Create an AWS Lambda function to remediate any noncompliant rules.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function in each AWS account to delete all the security group rules. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to match security group update events or creation events. Set the Lambda function in each account as a target for the rule.
options.C: Enable AWS Config for all AWS accounts. Create a custom AWS Config rule to run on the restricted-ssh configuration change trigger. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function to remediate any noncompliant resources.
options.D: Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation document in each account to inspect all security groups and to delete noncompliant rules. Use an Amazon EventBridge rule to run the Automation document every hour.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an organization-wide control that:

1. Detects security groups that expose SSH (TCP port 22) to `0.0.0.0/0`.
2. Reacts as soon as the security-group configuration changes, rather than waiting for an hourly or other periodic scan.
3. Automatically removes or corrects the noncompliant ingress rule.

## Correct answer: C

**C is the best answer.** Interpreting “restricted-ssh configuration change trigger” as a custom AWS Config rule implementing the same SSH-restriction check, the rule can be scoped to `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup` resources and triggered whenever their configurations change. AWS documents that configuration-change-triggered rules run when a matching resource changes, whereas periodic rules run only at the configured frequency. AWS Config custom Lambda rules invoke their associated Lambda function in response to configuration changes, allowing the function to evaluate the changed security group and remediate the offending ingress permission immediately.

The check itself matches the AWS Config `restricted-ssh` behavior: a security group is noncompliant when incoming SSH is accessible from `0.0.0.0/0` or `::/0`. The managed `restricted-ssh` rule supports configuration-change and periodic triggers. See [restricted-ssh](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/restricted-ssh.html), [AWS Config trigger types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html), and [Creating AWS Config Custom Lambda Rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_develop-rules_lambda-functions.html).

AWS Config can also deploy organization Config rules across AWS Organizations accounts, provided Config recording is enabled in those accounts. See [Managing AWS Config rules across an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-rule-multi-account-deployment.html).

> In a production implementation, the more AWS-native pattern would normally be the managed `restricted-ssh` rule plus automatic remediation through a Systems Manager Automation document. AWS Config officially applies remediation actions through SSM Automation documents, including AWS-provided runbooks that revoke unrestricted security-group ingress. However, among the listed choices, C is the only option combining the correct SSH-specific logic with configuration-change-driven detection and immediate remediation. See [Remediating noncompliant resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html) and [`AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-disablepublicaccessforsecuritygroup.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

The rule name appears to contain a typo (`vpe-sg-port-restriction-check` rather than `vpc-sg-port-restriction-check`). More importantly, the actual `vpc-sg-port-restriction-check` rule is **periodic only**. Although it checks ports 22 and 3389 by default and therefore can detect unrestricted SSH, periodic evaluation can delay detection and remediation. It does not best satisfy “as soon as possible.” See [`vpc-sg-port-restriction-check`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/vpc-sg-port-restriction-check.html).

### B

This solution deletes **all security-group rules**, not only the noncompliant SSH ingress rule. That would remove legitimate application, administration, and egress rules and could cause widespread outages. It also requires duplicating and maintaining Lambda/EventBridge infrastructure in every account instead of using AWS Config's organization-level compliance capabilities.

### D

Running the Automation document every hour creates up to an hour of exposure after a security group is changed. It therefore does not remediate the issue as soon as possible. A configuration-change-triggered AWS Config rule reacts to the relevant resource change instead of waiting for a scheduled scan.

## Exam takeaway

Use a **configuration-change-triggered AWS Config rule** for rapid detection of prohibited resource configurations. Prefer the SSH-specific `restricted-ssh` logic, deploy the control across the organization, and associate automatic remediation that revokes the unrestricted ingress permission.

zh.question: 在一次安全审计期间，一家公司发现一些安全组允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的 SSH 流量。安全团队必须实施一个解决方案，以便尽快检测并修复此问题。该公司在 AWS Organizations 中使用一个组织来管理公司的所有 AWS 账户。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 为所有 AWS 账户启用 AWS Config。使用定期触发器激活 vpe-sg-port-restriction-check AWS Config 规则。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来修复任何不合规的规则。
options.B: 在每个 AWS 账户中创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来删除所有安全组规则。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则来匹配安全组更新事件或创建事件。将每个账户中的 Lambda 函数设置为该规则的目标。
options.C: 为所有 AWS 账户启用 AWS Config。创建一个自定义 AWS Config 规则，以便在 restricted-ssh 配置更改触发器上运行。配置该规则调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数来修复任何不合规资源。
options.D: 在每个账户中创建一个 AWS Systems Manager Automation 文档，用于检查所有安全组并删除不合规规则。使用 Amazon EventBridge 规则每小时运行该 Automation 文档。

zh.explanation:
## 题目在问什么

公司需要一项覆盖整个组织的控制措施，以便：

1. 检测将 SSH（TCP 端口 22）暴露给 `0.0.0.0/0` 的安全组。
2. 在安全组配置发生更改后立即作出响应，而不是等待每小时或其他定期扫描。
3. 自动删除或更正不合规的入站规则。

## 正确答案：C

**C 是最佳答案。** 将“restricted-ssh 配置更改触发器”理解为实现相同 SSH 限制检查的自定义 AWS Config 规则，该规则可以限定为 `AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup` 资源，并在其配置发生更改时触发。AWS 文档说明，由配置更改触发的规则会在匹配资源发生更改时运行，而定期规则仅按配置的频率运行。AWS Config 自定义 Lambda 规则会响应配置更改调用其关联的 Lambda 函数，使该函数能够评估已更改的安全组，并立即修复违规的入站权限。

该检查本身与 AWS Config 的 `restricted-ssh` 行为一致：当入站 SSH 可从 `0.0.0.0/0` 或 `::/0` 访问时，安全组即为不合规。托管的 `restricted-ssh` 规则支持配置更改和定期触发器。请参阅 [restricted-ssh](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/restricted-ssh.html)、[AWS Config 触发器类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html) 和 [创建 AWS Config 自定义 Lambda 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/evaluate-config_develop-rules_lambda-functions.html)。

AWS Config 还可以跨 AWS Organizations 账户部署组织 Config 规则，前提是这些账户中已启用 Config 记录。请参阅 [跨组织管理 AWS Config 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-rule-multi-account-deployment.html)。

> 在生产实施中，更符合 AWS 原生模式的通常是使用托管的 `restricted-ssh` 规则，并通过 Systems Manager Automation 文档进行自动修复。AWS Config 会通过 SSM Automation 文档正式应用修复操作，其中包括可撤销无限制安全组入站访问的 AWS 提供运行手册。但是，在所列选项中，只有 C 同时结合了正确的 SSH 专用逻辑、由配置更改驱动的检测以及即时修复。请参阅 [使用 AWS Config 修复不合规资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html) 和 [`AWS-DisablePublicAccessForSecurityGroup`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-aws-disablepublicaccessforsecuritygroup.html)。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### A

该规则名称似乎包含拼写错误（`vpe-sg-port-restriction-check`，而不是 `vpc-sg-port-restriction-check`）。更重要的是，实际的 `vpc-sg-port-restriction-check` 规则**仅支持定期**运行。尽管它默认检查端口 22 和 3389，因此可以检测不受限制的 SSH，但定期评估可能延迟检测和修复。它不能最好地满足“尽快”的要求。请参阅 [`vpc-sg-port-restriction-check`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/vpc-sg-port-restriction-check.html)。

### B

此解决方案会删除**所有安全组规则**，而不仅是违规的 SSH 入站规则。这会移除合法的应用程序、管理和出站规则，并可能导致大范围中断。它还要求在每个账户中重复部署和维护 Lambda/EventBridge 基础设施，而不是使用 AWS Config 的组织级合规性功能。

### D

每小时运行一次 Automation 文档，会在安全组发生更改后造成最长一小时的暴露时间。因此，它无法尽快修复该问题。由配置更改触发的 AWS Config 规则会对相关资源更改作出响应，而非等待计划扫描。

## 考试要点

使用**由配置更改触发的 AWS Config 规则**快速检测被禁止的资源配置。优先采用 SSH 专用的 `restricted-ssh` 逻辑，在整个组织中部署该控制措施，并关联可撤销无限制入站权限的自动修复操作。

en.question: A company's DevOps engineer must install a software package on 30 on-premises VMs and 15 Amazon EC2 instances. The DevOps engineer needs to ensure that all VMs receive the package in a process that is auditable and that any configuration drift on the VMs is automatically identified and alerted on. The company uses AWS Direct Connect to connect its on-premises data center to AWS. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Write a script that iterates through the list of VMs once a week. Configure the script to check for the package and install the package if the package is not found. Configure the script to send an email message notification to the system administrator if the package is not found.
options.B: Install the AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent) on all VMs. Use the SSM Agent to install the package. Use AWS Config to monitor for configuration drift. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to notify the system administrator if any drift is found.
options.C: Write a script that checks if the package is installed across the environment. Configure the script to create a list of all VMs that are noncompliant. Configure the script to send the list to the system administrator, who will install the package on the noncompliant VMs.
options.D: Log in to each VM. Use a local package manager to install the package. Use AWS Config to monitor the AWS resources for configuration changes. Write a script to monitor the on-premises resources.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs one centrally managed process that can:

1. Install a package across both 30 on-premises VMs and 15 EC2 instances.
2. Provide an audit trail of the installation activity.
3. Detect when the required software configuration drifts from the desired state.
4. Automatically notify an administrator.
5. Minimize custom scripting and manual operations.

## Correct answer: B

AWS Systems Manager can manage EC2 instances and non-EC2 machines, including on-premises servers and VMs, as managed nodes. On-premises VMs can be registered by using a hybrid activation and installing SSM Agent. After registration, they support the same Systems Manager management capabilities used for EC2 instances. Systems Manager also centralizes auditing through AWS CloudTrail. See [Managing nodes in hybrid and multicloud environments with Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-hybrid-multicloud.html).

The engineer can use Systems Manager Run Command, executed through SSM Agent, to install the package across the managed nodes. Run Command retains command execution history for up to 30 days and can also store logs in Amazon S3 and provide an API audit trail through CloudTrail, satisfying the auditability requirement. See [Running commands on managed nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/running-commands.html).

For drift detection, Systems Manager Inventory can collect installed-application information from both EC2 and on-premises managed nodes. AWS Config can record this software inventory and evaluate a Config rule that checks whether the required application is installed. A node that no longer has the package can therefore be marked noncompliant. See [Recording Software Configuration for Managed Instances with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/recording-managed-instance-inventory.html).

Finally, AWS Config can publish configuration-change and compliance-state notifications to an SNS topic, which can notify the system administrator. See [Notifications that AWS Config Sends to an Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/notifications-for-AWS-Config.html).

Thus, **B** provides centralized package deployment, auditing, compliance monitoring, and automatic notification with the least custom operational effort.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A:** A weekly custom script provides only periodic checking and creates a custom maintenance burden. It does not provide the centralized managed-node inventory, Config compliance evaluation, and robust execution audit trail available through Systems Manager, AWS Config, and CloudTrail. Its email also reports only that a package was missing, rather than using managed compliance-state notifications.

- **C:** This option detects missing packages but requires an administrator to install them manually. It does not meet the requirement to ensure that all VMs receive the package with the most operational efficiency, and it lacks a managed, auditable remediation workflow.

- **D:** Logging in to 45 machines individually is operationally inefficient and error-prone. Although AWS Config can monitor supported AWS resource configurations, monitoring the on-premises package state requires registering the machines with Systems Manager and collecting software inventory. A separate custom monitoring script does not provide the unified hybrid management and compliance approach offered by option B.

zh.question: 某公司的 DevOps 工程师必须在 30 台本地 VM 和 15 个 Amazon EC2 实例上安装一个软件包。DevOps 工程师需要确保所有 VM 都能通过一个可审计的流程获得该软件包，并且能够自动识别并针对 VM 上的任何配置漂移发出告警。该公司使用 AWS Direct Connect 将其本地数据中心连接到 AWS。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 编写一个脚本，每周遍历一次 VM 列表。将脚本配置为检查该软件包；如果未找到该软件包，则安装该软件包。如果未找到该软件包，则将脚本配置为向系统管理员发送电子邮件通知。
options.B: 在所有 VM 上安装 AWS Systems Manager Agent (SSM Agent)。使用 SSM Agent 安装该软件包。使用 AWS Config 监控配置漂移。如果发现任何漂移，则使用 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 通知系统管理员。
options.C: 编写一个脚本来检查整个环境中是否已安装该软件包。将脚本配置为创建所有不合规 VM 的列表。将该列表发送给系统管理员，由系统管理员在不合规 VM 上安装该软件包。
options.D: 登录到每个 VM。使用本地软件包管理器安装该软件包。使用 AWS Config 监控 AWS 资源的配置更改。编写一个脚本来监控本地资源。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

公司需要一个集中管理的流程，能够：

1. 在 30 台本地 VM 和 15 个 EC2 实例上安装软件包。
2. 提供安装活动的审计追踪。
3. 检测所需软件配置何时偏离期望状态。
4. 自动通知管理员。
5. 最大限度地减少自定义脚本和手动操作。

## 正确答案：B

AWS Systems Manager 可以将 EC2 实例和非 EC2 计算机（包括本地服务器和 VM）作为托管节点进行管理。可通过使用混合激活并安装 SSM Agent 来注册本地 VM。注册后，它们支持与 EC2 实例相同的 Systems Manager 管理功能。Systems Manager 还通过 AWS CloudTrail 集中进行审计。请参阅 [Managing nodes in hybrid and multicloud environments with Systems Manager](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-hybrid-multicloud.html)。

工程师可以使用通过 SSM Agent 执行的 Systems Manager Run Command，在托管节点上安装该软件包。Run Command 会保留长达 30 天的命令执行历史记录，还可以将日志存储在 Amazon S3 中，并通过 CloudTrail 提供 API 审计追踪，从而满足可审计性要求。请参阅 [Running commands on managed nodes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/running-commands.html)。

对于漂移检测，Systems Manager Inventory 可以从 EC2 和本地托管节点收集已安装应用程序的信息。AWS Config 可以记录此软件清单，并评估用于检查是否已安装所需应用程序的 Config 规则。因此，不再具有该软件包的节点可以被标记为不合规。请参阅 [Recording Software Configuration for Managed Instances with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/recording-managed-instance-inventory.html)。

最后，AWS Config 可以将配置更改和合规状态通知发布到 SNS 主题，该主题能够通知系统管理员。请参阅 [Notifications that AWS Config Sends to an Amazon SNS topic](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/notifications-for-AWS-Config.html)。

因此，**B** 以最少的自定义运营工作量提供集中式软件包部署、审计、合规性监控和自动通知。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A：** 每周运行一次的自定义脚本只能提供定期检查，并会带来自定义维护负担。它无法提供 Systems Manager、AWS Config 和 CloudTrail 所提供的集中式托管节点清单、Config 合规性评估及可靠的执行审计追踪。其电子邮件也只是报告缺少软件包，而不是使用托管的合规状态通知。

- **C：** 此选项能够检测缺失的软件包，但需要管理员手动安装。它无法以最高运营效率确保所有 VM 都获得软件包，并且缺少受管理且可审计的修复工作流。

- **D：** 逐一登录 45 台计算机在运营上效率低且容易出错。虽然 AWS Config 可以监控受支持的 AWS 资源配置，但监控本地软件包状态需要使用 Systems Manager 注册计算机并收集软件清单。单独的自定义监控脚本无法提供选项 B 所提供的统一混合管理和合规性方法。

en.question: A company has an AWS CodePipeline pipeline in the eu-west-1 Region. The pipeline stores the build artifacts in an Amazon S3 bucket. The pipeline builds and deploys an AWS Lambda function by using an AWS CloudFormation deploy action. A DevOps engineer needs to update the existing pipeline to also deploy the Lambda function to the us-east-1 Region. The pipeline has already been updated to create an additional artifact to deploy to us-east-1. Which combination of steps should the DevOps engineer take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Modify the CloudFormation template to include a parameter for the Lambda function code's .zip file location. Create a new CloudFormation deploy action for us-east-1 in the pipeline. Configure the new deploy action to pass in the us-east-1 artifact location as a parameter override.
options.B: Create a new CloudFormation deploy action for us-east-1 in the pipeline. Configure the new deploy action to use the CloudFormation template from the additional artifact that was created for us-east-1.
options.C: Create an S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure the S3 bucket policy to allow CodePipeline to have read and write access.
options.D: Create an S3 bucket in us-east-1. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) from the S3 bucket in eu-west-1 to the S3 bucket in us-east-1.
options.E: Modify the pipeline to include the S3 bucket for us-east-1 as an artifact store. Create a new CloudFormation deploy action for us-east-1 in the pipeline. Configure the new deploy action to use the CloudFormation template from the us-east-1 artifact.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The pipeline is hosted in `eu-west-1`, but the new CloudFormation deploy action will run in `us-east-1`. This is a **cross-Region action**. CodePipeline requires a separate S3 artifact store in every Region in which pipeline actions run, and the pipeline definition must map each Region to its artifact bucket.

AWS also states that CodePipeline automatically copies the input artifacts needed by a cross-Region action into that Region's artifact store. Therefore, S3 Cross-Region Replication is not required. See [Add a cross-Region action in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-create-cross-region.html) and the [`artifactStore` or `artifactStores` pipeline requirement](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipeline-requirements.html).

## Correct answers: C and E

### C. Create and authorize an S3 bucket in `us-east-1`

A cross-Region action requires an artifact bucket in the action's Region. AWS specifically states that the artifact bucket must be in the same Region as the cross-Region action and in the same account as the pipeline. The bucket must permit the pipeline's service role to read and write the required artifacts.

The documented CodePipeline service-role permissions include S3 bucket metadata operations and object operations such as `s3:GetObject`, `s3:GetObjectVersion`, and `s3:PutObject`. See [CodePipeline service role policy](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/how-to-custom-role.html).

Thus, the engineer needs the `us-east-1` bucket and appropriate access for CodePipeline. In practice, the permissions should identify the CodePipeline service role as the authorized principal and the service role's IAM policy must also allow access as applicable.

### E. Add the `us-east-1` bucket as a regional artifact store and add the deploy action

Because the pipeline now has actions in multiple Regions, its definition must use `artifactStores`, with an entry for both `eu-west-1` and `us-east-1`. The new CloudFormation deploy action must specify `us-east-1` and consume the appropriate template artifact that the pipeline already produces.

AWS documents that a cross-Region pipeline must have one artifact bucket per action Region and that the `artifactStores` mapping must list each Region's bucket. CodePipeline then copies the action's input artifact to the target Region automatically.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Parameterize the Lambda ZIP location

Parameterizing the Lambda code location can be a valid CloudFormation design in some circumstances, but it does not satisfy the fundamental CodePipeline cross-Region requirement: the pipeline must have a regional artifact store configured for `us-east-1`. This option creates the action but does not add the required `us-east-1` bucket to the pipeline's `artifactStores` mapping. It is also unnecessary because the question says that the pipeline already creates an additional artifact for the `us-east-1` deployment.

### B. Add only the deploy action and select the additional artifact

Selecting the correct input artifact is necessary, but this option omits configuring the `us-east-1` S3 bucket in the pipeline's `artifactStores` mapping. Merely creating the bucket in option C would not connect that bucket to the pipeline, so **B + C** is incomplete.

### D. Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication

CRR is unnecessary. CodePipeline itself copies the input artifacts required by a cross-Region action from the pipeline Region into the artifact store in the action's Region. CRR would add unrelated replication configuration and would not replace the required `artifactStores` mapping.

Therefore, the required combination is **C and E**.

zh.question: 一家公司的 AWS CodePipeline 管道位于 eu-west-1 区域。该管道将构建工件存储在一个 Amazon S3 存储桶中。该管道通过 AWS CloudFormation 部署操作来构建和部署 AWS Lambda 函数。一名 DevOps 工程师需要更新现有管道，使其也能将 Lambda 函数部署到 us-east-1 区域。该管道已经更新为创建额外的工件以部署到 us-east-1。DevOps 工程师应采取哪种步骤组合来满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 修改 CloudFormation 模板，以包含 Lambda 函数代码 .zip 文件位置的参数。在管道中为 us-east-1 创建新的 CloudFormation 部署操作。配置新的部署操作，以将 us-east-1 工件位置作为参数覆盖值传入。
options.B: 在管道中为 us-east-1 创建新的 CloudFormation 部署操作。配置新的部署操作，以使用为 us-east-1 创建的额外工件中的 CloudFormation 模板。
options.C: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 S3 存储桶。配置 S3 存储桶策略，以允许 CodePipeline 具有读取和写入访问权限。
options.D: 在 us-east-1 中创建一个 S3 存储桶。配置从 eu-west-1 中的 S3 存储桶到 us-east-1 中 S3 存储桶的 S3 跨区域复制 (CRR)。
options.E: 修改管道，将 us-east-1 的 S3 存储桶包含为工件存储。为管道中的 us-east-1 创建新的 CloudFormation 部署操作。配置新的部署操作，以使用 us-east-1 工件中的 CloudFormation 模板。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查的内容

该管道托管在 `eu-west-1`，但新的 CloudFormation 部署操作将在 `us-east-1` 中运行。这是一个**跨区域操作**。CodePipeline 要求在管道操作运行的每个区域中都有独立的 S3 工件存储，并且管道定义必须将每个区域映射到其工件存储桶。

AWS 还说明，CodePipeline 会自动将跨区域操作所需的输入工件复制到该区域的工件存储中。因此，不需要 S3 跨区域复制。请参阅 [在 CodePipeline 中添加跨区域操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-create-cross-region.html) 和 [`artifactStore` 或 `artifactStores` 管道要求](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipeline-requirements.html)。

## 正确答案：C 和 E

### C. 在 `us-east-1` 中创建并授权一个 S3 存储桶

跨区域操作需要在该操作所在区域中有一个工件存储桶。AWS 明确说明，工件存储桶必须与跨区域操作位于同一区域，并且与管道属于同一账户。该存储桶必须允许管道的服务角色读取和写入所需的工件。

文档中列出的 CodePipeline 服务角色权限包括 S3 存储桶元数据操作，以及诸如 `s3:GetObject`、`s3:GetObjectVersion` 和 `s3:PutObject` 的对象操作。请参阅 [CodePipeline 服务角色策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/how-to-custom-role.html)。

因此，工程师需要 `us-east-1` 存储桶以及 CodePipeline 的适当访问权限。在实践中，权限应将 CodePipeline 服务角色指定为获授权主体，并且服务角色的 IAM 策略也必须在适用时允许访问。

### E. 将 `us-east-1` 存储桶添加为区域工件存储，并添加部署操作

由于该管道现在具有多个区域中的操作，其定义必须使用 `artifactStores`，并同时包含 `eu-west-1` 和 `us-east-1` 的条目。新的 CloudFormation 部署操作必须指定 `us-east-1`，并使用管道已生成的相应模板工件。

AWS 文档说明，跨区域管道必须在每个操作区域中拥有一个工件存储桶，并且 `artifactStores` 映射必须列出每个区域的存储桶。随后，CodePipeline 会自动将操作的输入工件复制到目标区域。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 将 Lambda ZIP 位置参数化

在某些情况下，将 Lambda 代码位置参数化可以是有效的 CloudFormation 设计，但这并不能满足 CodePipeline 的基本跨区域要求：管道必须为 `us-east-1` 配置区域工件存储。该选项创建了操作，但未将所需的 `us-east-1` 存储桶添加到管道的 `artifactStores` 映射中。此外，这也是不必要的，因为题目说明该管道已经为 `us-east-1` 部署创建了额外工件。

### B. 仅添加部署操作并选择额外工件

选择正确的输入工件是必要的，但该选项没有在管道的 `artifactStores` 映射中配置 `us-east-1` S3 存储桶。仅创建选项 C 中的存储桶并不会将该存储桶连接到管道，因此 **B + C** 并不完整。

### D. 配置 S3 跨区域复制

不需要 CRR。CodePipeline 本身会将跨区域操作所需的输入工件从管道区域复制到操作所在区域的工件存储中。CRR 会增加不相关的复制配置，并且不能替代必需的 `artifactStores` 映射。

因此，所需的组合是 **C 和 E**。

en.question: A company uses an AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) application for its infrastructure. The AWS CDK application creates AWS Lambda functions and the IAM roles that are attached to the functions. The company also uses AWS Organizations. The company's developers can assume the AWS CDK application deployment role. The company's security team discovered that the developers and the role used to deploy the AWS CDK application have more permissions than necessary. The security team also discovered that the roles attached to the Lambda functions that the CDK application creates have more permissions than necessary. The developers must not have the ability to grant additional permissions. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Create an SCP that denies the iam:CreateRole action and the iam:UpdateRole action for the developer role and the AWS CDK application deployment role. Centrally create new IAM roles to attach to the Lambda functions for the developers to use to provision Lambda functions.
options.B: Create an IAM permission boundary policy. Define the maximum actions that the AWS CDK application requires in the policy. Update the account's AWS CDK bootstrapping to use the permission boundary. Update the configuration in the AWS CDK application for the default permissions boundary to use the policy.
options.C: Create an IAM permission boundary policy. Define the maximum actions that the AWS CDK application requires in the policy. Instruct the developers to use the permission boundary policy name when they create a role in the AWS CDK application code.
options.D: Create an SCP that denies the iam:CreateRole action and the iam:UpdateRole action for the developer role. Give the AWS CDK deployment role access to create roles associated with Lambda functions. Run AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer to verify that the Lambda functions role does not have permissions.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a preventive guardrail that limits both:

1. The permissions available to the roles used by the CDK deployment workflow.
2. The permissions of IAM roles that the CDK application creates for Lambda functions.

The solution must also prevent developers from bypassing the limit and should avoid centrally creating and maintaining every Lambda execution role.

## Correct answer: B

Create a customer-managed IAM permissions boundary that defines the maximum permitted actions, apply it to the CDK bootstrap environment, and configure the CDK application to apply the same boundary by default to the IAM roles it creates.

A permissions boundary does not grant permissions; it limits the maximum permissions that identity-based policies can grant. AWS specifically recommends permissions boundaries when permissions management is delegated to developers who create roles for their workloads. This lets the developers and CDK continue to create workload roles without allowing those roles to exceed the approved ceiling ([IAM security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

For the deployment path, CDK supports `cdk bootstrap --custom-permissions-boundary`.
