AWS documents that this boundary is attached to the bootstrap `CloudFormationExecutionRole`, setting the maximum permissions available to developers when deploying through CDK. This is important because the default CloudFormation execution role otherwise has `AdministratorAccess` and no permissions boundary ([Create and apply permissions boundaries for the AWS CDK](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/customize-permissions-boundaries.html), [`cdk bootstrap` reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/ref-cli-cmd-bootstrap.html)).

Configuring the application's default permissions boundary then applies the guardrail to the Lambda execution roles synthesized by the application. Thus, adding broader identity policies to those roles cannot increase their effective permissions beyond the boundary. This is preventive, remains integrated with the normal CDK workflow, and has less operational overhead than centrally provisioning every role. AWS also recommends permissions boundaries or SCPs to prevent privilege escalation while continuing to let CDK create workload roles ([AWS CDK security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/best-practices-security.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A
Denying only `iam:CreateRole` and `iam:UpdateRole` does not comprehensively prevent permission changes. Permissions can be granted through other IAM operations, such as attaching managed policies or adding inline policies. In addition, denying role creation for the CDK deployment role prevents the normal automatic creation of Lambda execution roles.

Centrally creating every Lambda role introduces ongoing manual provisioning and coordination. AWS notes that manually created roles slow application development, can encourage role reuse and wildcard permissions, and interfere with continuous delivery ([AWS CDK security best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/best-practices-security.html)). Therefore, this is neither a complete guardrail nor the least-operational-overhead solution.

### C
This depends on developers remembering—or choosing—to specify the permissions boundary in every role definition. A developer could omit the boundary, so it does not satisfy the requirement that developers must not be able to grant additional permissions. It also does not apply a boundary to the CDK bootstrap deployment role. The control must be enforced centrally through bootstrapping and an application-wide default, not implemented as an optional coding instruction.

### D
The developers can assume the CDK deployment role. Giving that role permission to create roles without an enforced boundary leaves a privilege-escalation path: deployments can create Lambda roles with excessive permissions.

IAM Access Analyzer is an analysis and validation mechanism, not the preventive maximum-permissions control described in the requirements. Running it after roles are created does not inherently stop a deployment from creating an overprivileged role. This option also leaves operational work for repeated analysis and remediation, whereas a permissions boundary enforces the ceiling during creation and update.

**Answer: B**

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) 应用程序来管理其基础设施。该 AWS CDK 应用程序会创建 AWS Lambda 函数以及附加到这些函数的 IAM 角色。该公司还使用 AWS Organizations。公司的开发人员可以担任 AWS CDK 应用程序部署角色。公司的安全团队发现，开发人员和用于部署 AWS CDK 应用程序的角色拥有超出必要范围的权限。安全团队还发现，该 CDK 应用程序创建的、附加到 Lambda 函数的角色拥有超出必要范围的权限。开发人员不得能够授予额外权限。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 SCP，拒绝开发人员角色和 AWS CDK 应用程序部署角色执行 `iam:CreateRole` 操作和 `iam:UpdateRole` 操作。集中创建新的 IAM 角色以附加到 Lambda 函数，供开发人员用于预置 Lambda 函数。
options.B: 创建一个 IAM permissions boundary 策略。在策略中定义 AWS CDK 应用程序所需的最大操作权限。更新账户的 AWS CDK bootstrapping 以使用该 permissions boundary。更新 AWS CDK 应用程序中的配置，使默认 permissions boundary 使用该策略。
options.C: 创建一个 IAM permissions boundary 策略。在策略中定义 AWS CDK 应用程序所需的最大操作权限。指示开发人员在 AWS CDK 应用程序代码中创建角色时使用该 permissions boundary 策略名称。
options.D: 创建一个 SCP，拒绝开发人员角色执行 `iam:CreateRole` 操作和 `iam:UpdateRole` 操作。授予 AWS CDK 部署角色创建与 Lambda 函数关联的角色的权限。运行 AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer，以验证 Lambda 函数角色不具有相应权限。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一个预防性防护机制，同时限制以下两项：

1. CDK 部署工作流程所使用角色可获得的权限。
2. CDK 应用程序为 Lambda 函数创建的 IAM 角色的权限。

该解决方案还必须防止开发人员绕过此限制，并且应避免集中创建和维护每一个 Lambda 执行角色。

## 正确答案：B

创建一个客户自主管理的 IAM permissions boundary，用于定义允许的最大操作权限；将其应用于 CDK bootstrap 环境，并配置 CDK 应用程序，使其默认将同一个 boundary 应用于所创建的 IAM 角色。

permissions boundary 不会授予权限；它限制基于身份的策略所能授予的最大权限。当权限管理被委托给为其工作负载创建角色的开发人员时，AWS 明确建议使用 permissions boundary。这样，开发人员和 CDK 可以继续创建工作负载角色，同时不会允许这些角色超出已批准的权限上限（[IAM 安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

对于部署路径，CDK 支持 `cdk bootstrap --custom-permissions-boundary`。AWS 文档指出，此 boundary 会附加到 bootstrap `CloudFormationExecutionRole`，从而设置开发人员通过 CDK 部署时可用的最大权限。这一点很重要，因为默认的 CloudFormation 执行角色具有 `AdministratorAccess` 且没有 permissions boundary（[为 AWS CDK 创建和应用 permissions boundary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/customize-permissions-boundaries.html)，[`cdk bootstrap` 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/ref-cli-cmd-bootstrap.html)）。

随后配置应用程序的默认 permissions boundary，会将该防护机制应用于由应用程序合成的 Lambda 执行角色。因此，向这些角色添加更宽泛的基于身份的策略，也无法使其有效权限超过该 boundary。这是一种预防性控制，可保持与常规 CDK 工作流程的集成，其运维开销低于集中预置每个角色。AWS 还建议使用 permissions boundary 或 SCP 来防止权限提升，同时继续允许 CDK 创建工作负载角色（[AWS CDK 安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/best-practices-security.html)）。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A
仅拒绝 `iam:CreateRole` 和 `iam:UpdateRole` 并不能全面阻止权限变更。可以通过其他 IAM 操作授予权限，例如附加托管策略或添加内联策略。此外，拒绝 CDK 部署角色创建角色会阻止正常自动创建 Lambda 执行角色。

集中创建每个 Lambda 角色会引入持续的手动预置和协调工作。AWS 指出，手动创建角色会减缓应用程序开发，可能促使角色复用和使用通配符权限，并会干扰持续交付（[AWS CDK 安全最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cdk/v2/guide/best-practices-security.html)）。因此，这既不是完整的防护机制，也不是运维开销最低的解决方案。

### C
此选项依赖开发人员记住——或选择——在每个角色定义中指定 permissions boundary。开发人员可能省略该 boundary，因此无法满足“开发人员不得能够授予额外权限”的要求。它也不会对 CDK bootstrap 部署角色应用 boundary。该控制必须通过 bootstrapping 和应用程序范围的默认设置集中强制执行，而不是作为可选的编码指示来实施。

### D
开发人员可以担任 CDK 部署角色。若授予该角色创建角色的权限却没有强制执行的 boundary，就会留下权限提升路径：部署可以创建拥有过多权限的 Lambda 角色。

IAM Access Analyzer 是一种分析和验证机制，而不是题目要求中所述的预防性最大权限控制措施。在角色创建后运行它，并不能从根本上阻止部署创建权限过高的角色。此选项还需要反复进行分析和修正的运维工作；而 permissions boundary 会在创建和更新期间强制实施权限上限。

**答案：B**

en.question: A company uses Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) private registries to store container images. A DevOps team needs to ensure that the container images are regularly scanned for software package vulnerabilities. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Enable enhanced scanning for private registries in Amazon ECR.
options.B: Enable basic continuous scanning for private registries in Amazon ECR.
options.C: Create an AWS System Manager Automation document to scan images by using the AWS SDK. Configure the Automation document to run when a new image is pushed to an ECR registry.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function that scans all images in Amazon ECR by using the AWS SDK. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke the Lambda function each day.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to ensure that container images in Amazon ECR private registries are **regularly re-evaluated for software package vulnerabilities**, including vulnerabilities that become known after an image was initially pushed.

## Correct answer: A. Enable enhanced scanning for private registries in Amazon ECR.

Amazon ECR enhanced scanning integrates with Amazon Inspector and scans container images for both **operating system packages and programming-language packages**. It supports **automatic, continuous scanning**, so images can be reassessed as vulnerability intelligence changes. AWS states that newly pushed images are continually scanned for the configured duration.

When enhanced scanning is enabled without custom rules, ECR defaults to continuous scanning for all repositories. This is the AWS-managed solution that directly satisfies the requirement without custom automation. See [Amazon ECR enhanced scanning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced.html) and [Configuring enhanced scanning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced-enabling.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. Enable basic continuous scanning for private registries in Amazon ECR.**  
  Basic scanning does not provide a `CONTINUOUS_SCAN` mode. Basic scanning supports manual scanning and optional **scan on push** filters. Continuous scanning is an enhanced-scanning capability, so “basic continuous scanning” is not a valid ECR configuration. See [Configuring basic scanning](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html).

- **C. Create a Systems Manager Automation document that scans an image when it is pushed.**  
  This duplicates ECR's native scan-on-push functionality and scans only when a new image is pushed. It does not continuously reassess existing images as new vulnerabilities are discovered. It also introduces unnecessary custom automation.

- **D. Create a daily Lambda function that scans all images by using the AWS SDK.**  
  This introduces custom enumeration, scheduling, permissions, retry, and error-handling logic when ECR enhanced scanning already provides managed continuous monitoring through Amazon Inspector. SDK-triggered manual scans are also limited to one scan per image per 24-hour period and do not provide the native continuous-scanning behavior of enhanced scanning. See [Manually scanning an image in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/manual-scan.html).

Therefore, **A** is the intended managed and operationally efficient solution.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 私有注册表来存储容器镜像。一个 DevOps 团队需要确保定期扫描容器镜像中的软件包漏洞。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 为 Amazon ECR 中的私有注册表启用增强扫描。
options.B: 为 Amazon ECR 中的私有注册表启用基本持续扫描。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS System Manager Automation 文档，使用 AWS SDK 扫描镜像。将该 Automation 文档配置为在新镜像被推送到 ECR 注册表时运行。
options.D: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，使用 AWS SDK 扫描 Amazon ECR 中的所有镜像。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则以每天调用该 Lambda 函数。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该要求是确保 Amazon ECR 私有注册表中的容器镜像能够**定期针对软件包漏洞重新评估**，包括在镜像最初被推送后才被发现的漏洞。

## 正确答案：A. 为 Amazon ECR 中的私有注册表启用增强扫描。

Amazon ECR 增强扫描与 Amazon Inspector 集成，可扫描容器镜像中的**操作系统软件包和编程语言软件包**。它支持**自动持续扫描**，因此可以随着漏洞情报的变化重新评估镜像。AWS 表示，新推送的镜像会在配置的持续时间内不断接受扫描。

在未使用自定义规则的情况下启用增强扫描时，ECR 默认会对所有存储库启用持续扫描。这是一种 AWS 托管解决方案，无需自定义自动化即可直接满足要求。请参阅 [Amazon ECR 增强扫描](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced.html) 和 [配置增强扫描](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced-enabling.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. 为 Amazon ECR 中的私有注册表启用基本持续扫描。**  
  基本扫描不提供 `CONTINUOUS_SCAN` 模式。基本扫描支持手动扫描和可选的**推送时扫描**筛选条件。持续扫描是增强扫描的功能，因此“基本持续扫描”不是有效的 ECR 配置。请参阅 [配置基本扫描](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html)。

- **C. 创建一个 Systems Manager Automation 文档，以便在镜像被推送时扫描该镜像。**  
  这会重复 ECR 的原生推送时扫描功能，并且仅在新镜像被推送时进行扫描。它不会在发现新漏洞时持续重新评估现有镜像。此外，它还会引入不必要的自定义自动化。

- **D. 创建一个每日运行的 Lambda 函数，使用 AWS SDK 扫描所有镜像。**  
  在 ECR 增强扫描已经通过 Amazon Inspector 提供托管持续监控的情况下，此方案会引入自定义枚举、调度、权限、重试和错误处理逻辑。通过 SDK 触发的手动扫描还限制为每个镜像每 24 小时一次扫描，并且无法提供增强扫描的原生持续扫描行为。请参阅 [在 Amazon ECR 中手动扫描镜像](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/manual-scan.html)。

因此，**A** 是预期的托管且运维效率高的解决方案。

en.question: A security team sets up a workflow that invokes an AWS Step Functions workflow when Amazon EventBridge matches specific events. The events can be generated by several AWS services. AWS CloudTrail records user activities. The security team notices that some important events do not invoke the workflow as expected. The CloudTrail logs do not indicate any direct errors related to the missing events. Which combination of steps will identify the root cause of the missing event invocations? (Choose three.)

options.A: Enable EventBridge schema discovery on the event bus to determine whether the event patterns match the expected schema.
options.B: Configure Amazon CloudWatch to monitor EventBridge metrics and Step Functions metrics. Set up alerts for anomalies in event patterns and workflow invocations.
options.C: Configure an AWS Lambda logging function to monitor and log events from EventBridge to provide more details about the processed events.
options.D: Review the Step Functions execution history for patterns of failures or timeouts that could correlate to the missing event invocations.
options.E: Review metrics for the EventBridge failed invocations to ensure that the IAM execution role that is attached to the rule has sufficient permissions.
options.F: Verify that the Step Functions workflow has the correct permissions to be invoked by EventBridge.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The investigation must distinguish among three possible failure points:

1. The incoming event structure does not match the EventBridge rule's event pattern.
2. The rule matches, but EventBridge fails to invoke the Step Functions target.
3. EventBridge invokes the target, but the workflow then fails or times out.

CloudTrail might not show a direct application-level error for these cases, so EventBridge and Step Functions observability must be used.

## Correct answers: A, B, and E

### A. Enable EventBridge schema discovery

EventBridge schema discovery observes events on an event bus, infers each unique event schema, and stores the schemas in the discovered schema registry. If an event's structure changes, EventBridge creates a new schema version. The team can therefore inspect the actual event structures produced by the different AWS services and compare their fields and values with the rule's event pattern.

This is relevant because EventBridge matches events based on JSON event patterns, including metadata such as `source` and `detail-type` and fields inside `detail`. AWS specifically recommends using `eventName` when matching events delivered through CloudTrail. See [Inferring schemas from event bus events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-schemas-infer.html) and [EventBridge event-pattern best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-patterns-best-practices.html).

### B. Monitor EventBridge and Step Functions metrics in CloudWatch

CloudWatch metrics let the team correlate the stages of the event flow:

- EventBridge `MatchedEvents` shows whether events matched the rule.
- `Invocations` shows target invocations.
- `FailedInvocations` shows permanently failed target invocations.
- Step Functions `ExecutionsStarted` shows whether state-machine executions actually began.
- Step Functions failure and timeout metrics show problems after an execution begins.

Comparing these metrics isolates the failing stage. For example, expected events with no `MatchedEvents` indicate a pattern problem, while matched events with failed or missing target invocations indicate a delivery or authorization problem. Alarms also expose recurring anomalies. See [Monitoring Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-monitoring.html) and [Monitoring Step Functions metrics using CloudWatch](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/procedure-cw-metrics.html).

### E. Review EventBridge failed-invocation metrics and the rule's IAM role

For a Step Functions state machine target, EventBridge uses the IAM role configured for the target. That role must allow:

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "states:StartExecution",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:*:*:stateMachine:*"
}
```

An incorrect trust relationship, missing `states:StartExecution`, or an incorrectly scoped state-machine ARN can cause target delivery failures. EventBridge's `FailedInvocations` metric records invocations that fail permanently. AWS also recommends alarming on this metric when rules fail to deliver events to targets. See [IAM roles for sending events to EventBridge targets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-events-iam-roles.html) and [EventBridge troubleshooting](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-troubleshooting.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### C. Configure a Lambda logging function

A custom Lambda logging target is not necessary for this diagnosis. If Lambda is attached to the same problematic rule, it will receive only events that already matched the rule and therefore will not expose events excluded by the pattern. A separate broad capture rule could be constructed, but that is additional architecture and is less direct than schema inspection and the native EventBridge metrics designed to show matching and invocation behavior.

### D. Review Step Functions execution history

Execution history is useful for troubleshooting a workflow that **started** and then failed or timed out. The primary symptom here is that some events do not invoke the workflow, meaning there may be no execution history for those events. Step Functions metrics in option B are more appropriate for determining whether executions were started and for correlating starts with EventBridge matches and invocations.

### F. Verify that the Step Functions workflow has permissions to be invoked by EventBridge

This places the permission on the wrong side. For a Step Functions target, the relevant authorization is the IAM role specified on the EventBridge target. EventBridge assumes that role, and the role must grant `states:StartExecution` on the state machine. The Step Functions workflow itself is not configured with an invocation permission equivalent to a Lambda resource-based invocation policy.

## Final answer

**A, B, E**

zh.question: 某安全团队设置了一个工作流，当 Amazon EventBridge 匹配特定事件时调用一个 AWS Step Functions 工作流。这些事件可能由多个 AWS 服务生成。AWS CloudTrail 会记录用户活动。安全团队发现，某些重要事件没有按预期调用该工作流。CloudTrail 日志未显示与缺失事件直接相关的错误。哪种步骤组合可以确定缺失事件调用的根本原因？（选择三项。）

options.A: 在事件总线上启用 EventBridge 架构发现，以确定事件模式是否与预期架构匹配。
options.B: 配置 Amazon CloudWatch 来监控 EventBridge 指标和 Step Functions 指标。为事件模式和工作流调用中的异常设置告警。
options.C: 配置 AWS Lambda 日志记录函数来监控并记录来自 EventBridge 的事件，以提供有关已处理事件的更多详细信息。
options.D: 查看 Step Functions 执行历史记录，查找可能与缺失事件调用相关的失败或超时模式。
options.E: 查看 EventBridge 调用失败的指标，以确保附加到规则的 IAM 执行角色具有足够的权限。
options.F: 验证 Step Functions 工作流是否具有可由 EventBridge 调用的正确权限。

zh.explanation:
## 问题所问

调查必须区分以下三种可能的故障点：

1. 传入事件结构不匹配 EventBridge 规则的事件模式。
2. 规则匹配成功，但 EventBridge 无法调用 Step Functions 目标。
3. EventBridge 调用了目标，但工作流随后失败或超时。

CloudTrail 可能不会显示这些情况的直接应用程序级错误，因此必须使用 EventBridge 和 Step Functions 的可观测性功能。

## 正确答案：A、B 和 E

### A. 启用 EventBridge 架构发现

EventBridge 架构发现会观察事件总线上的事件，推断每个唯一事件架构，并将这些架构存储在已发现的架构注册表中。如果事件结构发生变化，EventBridge 会创建新的架构版本。因此，团队可以检查不同 AWS 服务生成的实际事件结构，并将其字段和值与规则的事件模式进行比较。

这很相关，因为 EventBridge 会基于 JSON 事件模式匹配事件，包括 `source` 和 `detail-type` 等元数据，以及 `detail` 中的字段。AWS 特别建议在匹配通过 CloudTrail 传送的事件时使用 `eventName`。请参阅 [从事件总线事件推断架构](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-schemas-infer.html) 和 [EventBridge 事件模式最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-patterns-best-practices.html)。

### B. 在 CloudWatch 中监控 EventBridge 和 Step Functions 指标

CloudWatch 指标使团队能够关联事件流的各个阶段：

- EventBridge `MatchedEvents` 显示事件是否匹配规则。
- `Invocations` 显示目标调用。
- `FailedInvocations` 显示永久失败的目标调用。
- Step Functions `ExecutionsStarted` 显示状态机执行是否实际开始。
- Step Functions 的失败和超时指标显示执行开始后发生的问题。

比较这些指标可以隔离发生故障的阶段。例如，预期事件没有对应的 `MatchedEvents` 表明存在模式问题；而已匹配的事件出现失败或缺失的目标调用，则表明存在传递或授权问题。告警还可以发现反复出现的异常。请参阅 [监控 Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-monitoring.html) 和 [使用 CloudWatch 监控 Step Functions 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/procedure-cw-metrics.html)。

### E. 查看 EventBridge 调用失败指标和规则的 IAM 角色

对于 Step Functions 状态机目标，EventBridge 使用为目标配置的 IAM 角色。该角色必须允许：

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "states:StartExecution",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:states:*:*:stateMachine:*"
}
```

不正确的信任关系、缺少 `states:StartExecution` 权限或状态机 ARN 的范围配置不正确，都可能导致目标传递失败。EventBridge 的 `FailedInvocations` 指标会记录永久失败的调用。当规则无法将事件传递到目标时，AWS 还建议针对该指标设置告警。请参阅 [用于向 EventBridge 目标发送事件的 IAM 角色](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-events-iam-roles.html) 和 [EventBridge 故障排除](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-troubleshooting.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### C. 配置 Lambda 日志记录函数

对此诊断而言，不需要自定义 Lambda 日志记录目标。如果 Lambda 附加到同一个有问题的规则，它只会接收已经匹配该规则的事件，因此无法暴露被模式排除的事件。可以构建一个单独的宽泛捕获规则，但这需要额外的架构，并且不如架构检查和用于显示匹配及调用行为的原生 EventBridge 指标直接。

### D. 查看 Step Functions 执行历史记录

执行历史记录适用于排查已经**开始**、随后失败或超时的工作流。此处的主要症状是某些事件没有调用工作流，这意味着这些事件可能根本没有执行历史记录。选项 B 中的 Step Functions 指标更适合确定执行是否已启动，并将执行启动与 EventBridge 匹配及调用相关联。

### F. 验证 Step Functions 工作流是否具有可由 EventBridge 调用的权限

这将权限放在了错误的一方。对于 Step Functions 目标，相关授权是 EventBridge 目标上指定的 IAM 角色。EventBridge 会担任该角色，该角色必须授予对状态机执行 `states:StartExecution` 的权限。Step Functions 工作流本身不会配置类似 Lambda 基于资源的调用策略的调用权限。

## 最终答案

**A、B、E**

en.question: A company's DevOps engineer uses AWS Systems Manager to perform maintenance tasks. The company has a few Amazon EC2 instances that require a restart after notifications from AWS Health. The DevOps engineer must implement an automated solution that uses Amazon EventBridge to remediate the notifications during the company's scheduled maintenance windows. How should the DevOps engineer configure an EventBridge rule to meet these requirements?

options.A: Configure an event source of AWS Health. Configure event types that indicate scheduled instance termination and retirement. Target the AWS-RestartEC2Instance Systems Manager Automation runbook to restart the EC2 instances.
options.B: Configure an event source of Systems Manager. Configure an event type that indicates a maintenance window. Target the AWS-RestartEC2Instance Systems Manager Automation runbook to restart the EC2 instances.
options.C: Configure an event source of AWS Health. Configure event types that indicate scheduled instance termination and retirement. Target a newly created AWS Lambda function that registers a Systems Manager maintenance window task to restart the EC2 instances.
options.D: Configure an event source of EC2. Configure an event type that indicates instance state notification. Target a newly created AWS Lambda function that registers a Systems Manager maintenance window task to restart the EC2 instances.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The company needs EventBridge to respond to **AWS Health notifications for scheduled EC2 instance termination or retirement** and invoke Systems Manager to restart the affected instances automatically. The native AWS pattern is:

1. Configure **AWS Health** as the EventBridge event source.
2. Match the applicable EC2 scheduled-change events, such as scheduled instance retirement events.
3. Configure **Systems Manager Automation** as the target.
4. Invoke the AWS-managed **`AWS-RestartEC2Instance`** runbook, passing the affected EC2 instance ID from the Health event.

AWS documents this AWS Health → EventBridge → Systems Manager Automation workflow specifically for automatically restarting EC2 instances in response to scheduled Health events. The documented configuration uses scheduled EC2 retirement event codes and targets the `AWS-RestartEC2Instance` runbook. See [Running operations on EC2 instances automatically in response to events in AWS Health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/automating-instance-actions.html). Systems Manager also supports invoking an Automation runbook directly from an EventBridge rule, as described in [Run automations based on EventBridge events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/running-automations-event-bridge.html).

This makes **A** the appropriate configuration: it uses the notification source that identifies the affected instance and the AWS-managed runbook designed to perform the required restart, without introducing custom remediation code.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B — Incorrect.** Systems Manager maintenance-window events describe maintenance-window lifecycle and configuration changes, such as a window or task entering `IN_PROGRESS`, `SUCCESS`, or another state. They are not the originating AWS Health notifications for scheduled EC2 retirement or termination, so this rule would not reliably identify which EC2 instance requires remediation. See [Systems Manager events monitored by EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/reference-eventbridge-events.html).

- **C — Incorrect.** Although AWS Health is the correct event source, inserting a custom Lambda function to register a new maintenance-window task is unnecessary for the required event-driven restart. Systems Manager supports registering Automation runbooks as maintenance-window tasks, but that is a scheduling and task-registration mechanism rather than the direct AWS Health remediation pattern described here. It would also require the function to manage the maintenance-window ID, affected instance parameters, duplicate registrations, permissions, and task cleanup. The direct EventBridge target in A can invoke `AWS-RestartEC2Instance` without this additional custom workflow. For comparison, see [Scheduling Automation runbooks with maintenance windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/scheduling-automations-maintenance-windows.html) and [Registering targetless maintenance-window tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-windows-targetless-tasks.html).

- **D — Incorrect.** An EC2 instance state-change notification reports a transition to a state such as `pending`, `running`, `stopping`, `stopped`, `shutting-down`, or `terminated`. It is not an advance AWS Health notification for scheduled retirement or termination and therefore is the wrong event source for this requirement. See [Amazon EC2 instance state-change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitoring-instance-state-changes.html).

zh.question: 某公司的 DevOps 工程师使用 AWS Systems Manager 执行维护任务。该公司有几台 Amazon EC2 实例在收到 AWS Health 通知后需要重启。DevOps 工程师必须实施一个自动化解决方案，该方案使用 Amazon EventBridge 在公司的计划维护时段内对这些通知进行修复。DevOps 工程师应如何配置 EventBridge 规则以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将事件源配置为 AWS Health。配置指示计划实例终止和实例停用的事件类型。将 AWS-RestartEC2Instance Systems Manager Automation 运行手册作为目标，以重启 EC2 实例。
options.B: 将事件源配置为 Systems Manager。配置指示维护时段的事件类型。将 AWS-RestartEC2Instance Systems Manager Automation 运行手册作为目标，以重启 EC2 实例。
options.C: 将事件源配置为 AWS Health。配置指示计划实例终止和实例停用的事件类型。将新创建的 AWS Lambda 函数作为目标，由该函数注册一个 Systems Manager 维护时段任务来重启 EC2 实例。
options.D: 将事件源配置为 EC2。配置指示实例状态通知的事件类型。将新创建的 AWS Lambda 函数作为目标，由该函数注册一个 Systems Manager 维护时段任务来重启 EC2 实例。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

公司需要 EventBridge 响应 **针对计划 EC2 实例终止或实例停用的 AWS Health 通知**，并调用 Systems Manager 以自动重启受影响的实例。原生 AWS 模式如下：

1. 将 **AWS Health** 配置为 EventBridge 事件源。
2. 匹配适用的 EC2 计划变更事件，例如计划实例停用事件。
3. 将 **Systems Manager Automation** 配置为目标。
4. 调用 AWS 托管的 **`AWS-RestartEC2Instance`** 运行手册，并从 Health 事件传递受影响的 EC2 实例 ID。

AWS 专门针对响应计划 Health 事件自动重启 EC2 实例记录了此 AWS Health → EventBridge → Systems Manager Automation 工作流。文档中的配置使用计划 EC2 实例停用事件代码，并以 `AWS-RestartEC2Instance` 运行手册为目标。请参阅 [Running operations on EC2 instances automatically in response to events in AWS Health](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/health/latest/ug/automating-instance-actions.html)。Systems Manager 还支持从 EventBridge 规则直接调用 Automation 运行手册，如 [Run automations based on EventBridge events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/running-automations-event-bridge.html) 所述。

因此，**A** 是合适的配置：它使用能够识别受影响实例的通知源，并使用专为执行所需重启操作设计的 AWS 托管运行手册，无需引入自定义修复代码。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B — 错误。** Systems Manager 维护时段事件描述维护时段生命周期和配置变更，例如某个时段或任务进入 `IN_PROGRESS`、`SUCCESS` 或其他状态。它们并非计划 EC2 实例停用或终止的源头 AWS Health 通知，因此该规则无法可靠地识别哪台 EC2 实例需要修复。请参阅 [Systems Manager events monitored by EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/reference-eventbridge-events.html)。

- **C — 错误。** 虽然 AWS Health 是正确的事件源，但插入自定义 Lambda 函数来注册新的维护时段任务，对于所需的事件驱动重启而言没有必要。Systems Manager 支持将 Automation 运行手册注册为维护时段任务，但这是一个调度和任务注册机制，而非此处描述的直接 AWS Health 修复模式。它还要求该函数管理维护时段 ID、受影响的实例参数、重复注册、权限和任务清理。A 中的直接 EventBridge 目标无需这类额外的自定义工作流即可调用 `AWS-RestartEC2Instance`。作为对比，请参阅 [Scheduling Automation runbooks with maintenance windows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/scheduling-automations-maintenance-windows.html) 和 [Registering targetless maintenance-window tasks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/maintenance-windows-targetless-tasks.html)。

- **D — 错误。** EC2 实例状态变更通知报告实例转换到某种状态，例如 `pending`、`running`、`stopping`、`stopped`、`shutting-down` 或 `terminated`。它不是针对计划实例停用或终止的预先 AWS Health 通知，因此对于此要求而言是错误的事件源。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 instance state-change events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitoring-instance-state-changes.html)。

en.question: A DevOps engineer manages an AWS CodePipeline pipeline that builds and deploys a web application on AWS. The pipeline has a source stage, a build stage, and a deploy stage. When deployed properly, the web application responds with a 200 OK HTTP response code when the URL of the home page is requested. The home page recently returned a 503 HTTP response code after CodePipeline deployed the application. The DevOps engineer needs to add an automated test into the pipeline. The automated test must ensure that the application returns a 200 OK HTTP response code after the application is deployed. The pipeline must fail if the response code is not present during the test. The DevOps engineer has added a CheckURL stage after the deploy stage in the pipeline. What should the DevOps engineer do next to implement the automated test?

options.A: Configure the CheckURL stage to use an Amazon CloudWatch action. Configure the action to use a canary synthetic monitoring check on the application URL and to report a success or failure to CodePipeline.
options.B: Create an AWS Lambda function to check the response code status of the URL and to report a success or failure to CodePipeline. Configure an action in the CheckURL stage to invoke the Lambda function.
options.C: Configure the CheckURL stage to use an AWS CodeDeploy action. Configure the action with an input artifact that is the URL of the application and to report a success or failure to CodePipeline.
options.D: Deploy an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API that checks the response code status of the URL and that reports success or failure to CodePipeline. Configure the CheckURL stage to use the AWS Device Farm test action and to provide the API Gateway HTTP API as an input artifact.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The pipeline already deploys the web application. The new `CheckURL` stage must perform a post-deployment HTTP health check and cause the pipeline execution to fail unless the home page returns HTTP `200 OK`.

## Correct answer: B

Create a Lambda function that sends an HTTP request to the application URL, verifies that the returned status code is `200`, and then calls CodePipeline to report either success or failure. Add the function to the `CheckURL` stage as an **AWS Lambda invoke action**.

AWS provides an almost exact documented example: a Lambda function receives the URL through the action's `UserParameters`, makes an HTTP GET request, asserts that the response status is `200`, and uses `PutJobSuccessResult` or `PutJobFailureResult` to update the CodePipeline job. The documentation also shows adding the Lambda action in a new stage after deployment. See [Invoke an AWS Lambda function in a pipeline in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-invoke-lambda-function.html) and the [AWS Lambda invoke action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Lambda.html).

The Lambda execution role must permit at least `codepipeline:PutJobSuccessResult` and `codepipeline:PutJobFailureResult`. If the status is not `200`, the function reports job failure, which fails the action and therefore the pipeline stage.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** CloudWatch Synthetics canaries can monitor URLs and APIs, including endpoint availability, and can run once or on a schedule. However, the option assumes a native **CloudWatch action** in CodePipeline that directly runs the canary and reports its result to the pipeline. CodePipeline's documented invoke integrations include Lambda, Step Functions, and Inspector—not a CloudWatch Synthetics action provider. A canary could be incorporated through additional custom orchestration, but not as described. See [Synthetic monitoring with CloudWatch canaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Synthetics_Canaries.html) and [CodePipeline action-type integrations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/integrations-action-type.html).

- **C — Incorrect.** CodeDeploy is a deployment provider, not a general HTTP endpoint testing action. A CodeDeploy action consumes an application revision/AppSpec input artifact to determine what to install and which deployment lifecycle hooks to run. A URL is not the required CodeDeploy input artifact, and this would not implement the specified post-deployment status-code assertion. See the [CodeDeploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html).

- **D — Incorrect.** API Gateway is unnecessary for making the HTTP check, and an API endpoint is not an application artifact that can be supplied to a Device Farm action as described. The Device Farm CodePipeline action requires configuration such as a Device Farm project, application file from an input artifact, device pool, test type, and often test definitions/specifications. It is not used by passing an API Gateway HTTP API as an input artifact merely to report a URL's status code. See the [AWS Device Farm test action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-DeviceFarm.html).

Therefore, **B** is the direct, documented solution.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师管理一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道，该管道在 AWS 上构建和部署 Web 应用程序。该管道包含源阶段、构建阶段和部署阶段。当部署正常时，请求主页 URL 后，Web 应用程序会返回 `200 OK` HTTP 响应代码。CodePipeline 部署应用程序后，主页最近返回了 `503` HTTP 响应代码。DevOps 工程师需要向管道中添加自动化测试。该自动化测试必须确保应用程序部署后返回 `200 OK` HTTP 响应代码。如果测试期间未出现该响应代码，管道必须失败。DevOps 工程师已在管道的部署阶段之后添加了 `CheckURL` 阶段。接下来，DevOps 工程师应如何实施自动化测试？

options.A: 将 `CheckURL` 阶段配置为使用 Amazon CloudWatch 操作。将该操作配置为对应用程序 URL 使用 canary 合成监控检查，并向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。
options.B: 创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来检查 URL 的响应代码状态，并向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。在 `CheckURL` 阶段中配置一个操作来调用该 Lambda 函数。
options.C: 将 `CheckURL` 阶段配置为使用 AWS CodeDeploy 操作。使用作为应用程序 URL 的输入工件配置该操作，并向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。
options.D: 部署一个 Amazon API Gateway HTTP API，用于检查 URL 的响应代码状态并向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。将 `CheckURL` 阶段配置为使用 AWS Device Farm 测试操作，并将 API Gateway HTTP API 作为输入工件提供。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该管道已部署 Web 应用程序。新的 `CheckURL` 阶段必须执行部署后的 HTTP 运行状况检查，并且除非主页返回 HTTP `200 OK`，否则必须导致管道执行失败。

## 正确答案：B

创建一个 Lambda 函数，向应用程序 URL 发送 HTTP 请求，验证返回的状态代码是否为 `200`，然后调用 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。将该函数作为 **AWS Lambda 调用操作** 添加到 `CheckURL` 阶段。

AWS 提供了一个几乎完全相同的文档化示例：Lambda 函数通过操作的 `UserParameters` 接收 URL，发出 HTTP GET 请求，断言响应状态为 `200`，并使用 `PutJobSuccessResult` 或 `PutJobFailureResult` 更新 CodePipeline 作业。该文档还展示了如何在部署后新增阶段并添加 Lambda 操作。请参阅 [在 CodePipeline 的管道中调用 AWS Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-invoke-lambda-function.html) 和 [AWS Lambda 调用操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Lambda.html)。

Lambda 执行角色至少必须允许 `codepipeline:PutJobSuccessResult` 和 `codepipeline:PutJobFailureResult`。如果状态不是 `200`，该函数会报告作业失败，这将使操作失败，进而使管道阶段失败。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A — 不正确。** CloudWatch Synthetics canary 可以监控 URL 和 API，包括端点可用性，并且可以运行一次或按计划运行。但是，该选项假定 CodePipeline 中存在一个原生的 **CloudWatch 操作**，可直接运行 canary 并将结果报告给管道。CodePipeline 已记录的调用集成包括 Lambda、Step Functions 和 Inspector，而不包括 CloudWatch Synthetics 操作提供程序。canary 可以通过额外的自定义编排纳入流程，但无法按题目所述方式实现。请参阅 [使用 CloudWatch canary 进行合成监控](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Synthetics_Canaries.html) 和 [CodePipeline 操作类型集成](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/integrations-action-type.html)。

- **C — 不正确。** CodeDeploy 是部署提供程序，而不是通用 HTTP 端点测试操作。CodeDeploy 操作使用应用程序修订版本/AppSpec 输入工件来确定要安装的内容以及要运行的部署生命周期挂钩。URL 不是 CodeDeploy 所需的输入工件，并且此方案无法实现指定的部署后状态代码断言。请参阅 [CodeDeploy 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeDeploy.html)。

- **D — 不正确。** 无需使用 API Gateway 来执行 HTTP 检查，并且 API 端点不是可以按题目所述提供给 Device Farm 操作的应用程序工件。Device Farm CodePipeline 操作需要配置 Device Farm 项目、输入工件中的应用程序文件、设备池、测试类型，以及通常所需的测试定义/规范。它并非通过将 API Gateway HTTP API 作为输入工件传递，仅用于报告 URL 状态代码。请参阅 [AWS Device Farm 测试操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-DeviceFarm.html)。

因此，**B** 是直接且有文档支持的解决方案。

en.question: A company has an application that uploads access logs to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. The fields in the log lines include the response code and the application name. The company wants to create a CloudWatch metric to track the number of requests by response code in a specific range and with a specific application name. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a CloudWatch Logs log event filter on the CloudWatch Logs log stream to match the response code range. Configure the log event filter to increment a metric. Set the response code and application name as dimensions.
options.B: Create a CloudWatch Logs metric filter on the CloudWatch Logs log group to match the response code range. Configure the metric filter to increment a metric. Set the response code and application name as dimensions.
options.C: Create a CloudWatch Contributor Insights rule on the CloudWatch Logs log stream with a filter to match the response code range. Configure the Contributor Insights rule to increment a CloudWatch metric with the response code and application name as dimensions.
options.D: Create a CloudWatch Logs Insights query on the CloudWatch Logs log group to match the response code range. Configure the Logs Insights query to increment a CloudWatch metric with the response code and application name as dimensions.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to continuously convert matching CloudWatch Logs events into a CloudWatch metric, counting requests while retaining the response code and application name as dimensions. This is the specific purpose of a **CloudWatch Logs metric filter**.

## Correct answer: B

Create the metric filter on the **CloudWatch Logs log group**, define a filter pattern that matches the required response-code range (and, if required, the target application name), and publish a metric value of `1` for every matching event. CloudWatch Logs metric filters inspect incoming log events and convert matches into numerical CloudWatch metrics. AWS also supports assigning extracted fields as dimensions for JSON and space-delimited metric filters, with up to three dimensions. Therefore, the response code and application name can be used as the requested dimensions.

For example, a JSON filter could use numeric comparisons and an application condition, conceptually similar to:

```text
{ ($.responseCode >= 400) && ($.responseCode < 500) && ($.applicationName = "my-app") }
```

The metric transformation would publish `1` for each match, with dimensions derived from `$.responseCode` and `$.applicationName`. AWS documents that numeric operators such as `>`, `<`, `>=`, and `<=`, together with compound `&&` expressions, are supported in JSON filter patterns. See [Creating metrics from log events using filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/MonitoringLogData.html), [filter-pattern syntax](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/FilterAndPatternSyntax.html), and [publishing dimensions with metric filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/FilterAndPatternSyntaxForMetricFilters.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A:** CloudWatch Logs does not use a construct called a **log event filter** attached to an individual log stream for publishing metrics. The applicable construct is a **metric filter**, and AWS creates it by selecting a **log group**. Metric filters evaluate events arriving in the log group, including its log streams.

- **C:** Contributor Insights analyzes log data to identify and rank **top contributors**, using contributor keys, filters, and count or sum aggregation. It is not the standard mechanism for incrementing an arbitrary custom CloudWatch metric and assigning ordinary metric dimensions in the manner described. Contributor Insights rules are also configured against one or more **log groups**, not an individual log stream. See [Create a Contributor Insights rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights-CreateRule.html).

- **D:** CloudWatch Logs Insights is an interactive/query-based log analytics capability. CloudWatch can run a Logs Insights scheduled query for a log alarm and evaluate its aggregated result, but a Logs Insights query is not configured to increment a custom metric for each matching event with extracted CloudWatch metric dimensions. A log-group metric filter is the direct ingestion-time solution for this requirement. See [Alarm data queries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-data-queries.html).

Thus, **B** is the solution that directly satisfies the requirement.

zh.question: 某公司有一个应用程序，将访问日志上传到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组。日志行中的字段包括响应代码和应用程序名称。该公司希望创建一个 CloudWatch 指标，以按特定范围内的响应代码和特定应用程序名称跟踪请求数量。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 CloudWatch Logs 日志流上创建 CloudWatch Logs 日志事件筛选器，以匹配响应代码范围。配置该日志事件筛选器以递增指标。将响应代码和应用程序名称设置为维度。
options.B: 在 CloudWatch Logs 日志组上创建 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器，以匹配响应代码范围。配置该指标筛选器以递增指标。将响应代码和应用程序名称设置为维度。
options.C: 在 CloudWatch Logs 日志流上创建 CloudWatch Contributor Insights 规则，并使用筛选器匹配响应代码范围。配置 Contributor Insights 规则以递增一个 CloudWatch 指标，并将响应代码和应用程序名称设为维度。
options.D: 在 CloudWatch Logs 日志组上创建 CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询，以匹配响应代码范围。配置 Logs Insights 查询以递增一个 CloudWatch 指标，并将响应代码和应用程序名称设为维度。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该要求是将匹配的 CloudWatch Logs 事件持续转换为 CloudWatch 指标，在保留响应代码和应用程序名称作为维度的同时统计请求数量。这正是 **CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器** 的特定用途。

## 正确答案：B

在 **CloudWatch Logs 日志组**上创建指标筛选器，定义一个与所需响应代码范围（以及在需要时与目标应用程序名称）匹配的筛选模式，并为每个匹配事件发布值为 `1` 的指标。CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器会检查传入的日志事件，并将匹配项转换为数值型 CloudWatch 指标。AWS 还支持将提取的字段指定为 JSON 和空格分隔指标筛选器的维度，最多支持三个维度。因此，响应代码和应用程序名称可以用作所请求的维度。

例如，JSON 筛选器可以使用数值比较和应用程序条件，其概念上类似于：

```text
{ ($.responseCode >= 400) && ($.responseCode < 500) && ($.applicationName = "my-app") }
```

指标转换将为每个匹配项发布 `1`，其维度派生自 `$.responseCode` 和 `$.applicationName`。AWS 文档说明，JSON 筛选模式支持 `>`、`<`、`>=` 和 `<=` 等数值运算符，以及复合 `&&` 表达式。请参阅 [使用筛选器从日志事件创建指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/MonitoringLogData.html)、[筛选模式语法](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/FilterAndPatternSyntax.html) 和 [使用指标筛选器发布维度](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/FilterAndPatternSyntaxForMetricFilters.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A：** CloudWatch Logs 不使用一种称为附加到单个日志流的 **日志事件筛选器** 的结构来发布指标。适用的结构是 **指标筛选器**，AWS 会通过选择一个 **日志组** 来创建它。指标筛选器会评估到达该日志组的事件，包括其中的日志流。

- **C：** Contributor Insights 会分析日志数据，通过贡献者键、筛选器以及计数或求和聚合来识别和排名 **主要贡献者**。它并不是用于递增任意自定义 CloudWatch 指标并以所述方式分配常规指标维度的标准机制。Contributor Insights 规则也是针对一个或多个 **日志组** 配置的，而不是单个日志流。请参阅 [创建 Contributor Insights 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights-CreateRule.html)。

- **D：** CloudWatch Logs Insights 是一种交互式、基于查询的日志分析功能。CloudWatch 可以为日志告警运行 Logs Insights 定时查询并评估其聚合结果，但不能将 Logs Insights 查询配置为针对每个匹配事件递增一个自定义指标，同时提取 CloudWatch 指标维度。对于此要求，日志组指标筛选器是直接的摄取时解决方案。请参阅 [告警数据查询](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-data-queries.html)。

因此，**B** 是直接满足该要求的解决方案。

en.question: A DevOps engineer provisioned an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster with managed node groups. The DevOps engineer associated an OpenID Connect (OIDC) issuer with the cluster. The DevOps engineer is configuring Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes for the cluster. The DevOps engineer attempts to initiate a PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) request but is unable to provision a volume. To troubleshoot the issue, the DevOps engineer runs the kubectl describe pyc command. The DevOps engineer receives a failed to provision volume with StorageClass error and a could not create volume in EC2:UnauthorizedOperation error. Which solution will resolve these errors?

options.A: Create a Kubernetes cluster role that allows the persistent volumes to perform get, list, watch, create, and delete operations. Configure the cluster role to allow get, list, and watch operations for storage in the cluster.
options.B: Create an Amazon EBS Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver IAM role that has the required permissions and trust relationships. Attach the IAM role to the Amazon EBS CSI driver add-on in the cluster.
options.C: Add the ebs.csi.aws.com/volumeType:gp3 annotation to the PersistentVolumeClaim object in the cluster.
options.D: Create a Kubernetes storage class object. Set the provisioner value to ebs.csi.aws.com. Set the volumeBindingMode value to WaitForFirstConsumer in the luster.

en.explanation:
## What the scenario is testing

The PVC reached the Amazon EBS CSI provisioner, but the provisioner failed when it called the Amazon EC2 API to create an EBS volume. The decisive message is:

`could not create volume in EC2: UnauthorizedOperation`

This is an **AWS IAM authorization failure**, not a Kubernetes RBAC, gp3-selection, or volume-binding problem. The cluster's associated OIDC provider enables the EBS CSI controller service account to assume a dedicated IAM role through IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA).

## Correct answer: B

**Create an Amazon EBS CSI driver IAM role with the required permissions and trust relationship, and associate that role with the EBS CSI driver add-on.**

AWS states that the EBS CSI plugin requires IAM permissions to call AWS APIs. The EKS documentation even identifies this exact symptom: without the driver IAM role, `kubectl describe pvc` reports both `failed to provision volume with StorageClass` and `could not create volume in EC2: UnauthorizedOperation`. The role must trust the cluster's OIDC provider for the `kube-system:ebs-csi-controller-sa` service account and have the EBS CSI driver policy, such as `AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicyV2`. The add-on is then configured to use that role. See [Use Kubernetes volume storage with Amazon EBS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/ebs-csi.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** A Kubernetes `ClusterRole` controls access to Kubernetes API resources. It does not grant permission to call the Amazon EC2 `CreateVolume` API. Moreover, AWS notes that deploying the EBS CSI add-on with its IAM role creates the `ebs-csi-controller-sa` service account and binds it to the required Kubernetes cluster role. The reported failure is specifically an AWS API `UnauthorizedOperation`, so the missing authorization is IAM, not Kubernetes RBAC.

- **C — Incorrect.** Selecting gp3 does not resolve an EC2 authorization failure. Volume type is normally configured through the applicable EBS CSI `StorageClass` parameters, not by adding the proposed annotation to the PVC. Even a correctly selected gp3 type cannot be provisioned if the CSI controller lacks permission to create EBS volumes.

- **D — Incorrect.** A CSI `StorageClass` using `ebs.csi.aws.com` and `WaitForFirstConsumer` can be a valid configuration for the standard EBS CSI driver, but it does not grant AWS permissions. The message shows that provisioning was attempted and failed at the EC2 API authorization step. Changing the binding mode or recreating the StorageClass would not resolve `UnauthorizedOperation`.

Therefore, **B** directly addresses the root cause.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师使用托管节点组预置了一个 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 集群。该 DevOps 工程师将一个 OpenID Connect (OIDC) 颁发者与该集群关联。该 DevOps 工程师正在为集群配置 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp3) 卷。该 DevOps 工程师尝试发起 PersistentVolumeClaim (PVC) 请求，但无法预置卷。为排查该问题，该 DevOps 工程师运行 `kubectl describe pyc` 命令。该 DevOps 工程师收到 `failed to provision volume with StorageClass` 错误和 `could not create volume in EC2:UnauthorizedOperation` 错误。哪种解决方案可以解决这些错误？

options.A: 创建一个 Kubernetes 集群角色，允许持久卷执行 get、list、watch、create 和 delete 操作。配置该集群角色，以允许对集群中的存储执行 get、list 和 watch 操作。
options.B: 创建一个具有所需权限和信任关系的 Amazon EBS Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver IAM 角色。将该 IAM 角色附加到集群中的 Amazon EBS CSI driver add-on。
options.C: 将 `ebs.csi.aws.com/volumeType:gp3` 注释添加到集群中的 PersistentVolumeClaim 对象。
options.D: 创建一个 Kubernetes storage class 对象。将 provisioner 值设置为 `ebs.csi.aws.com`。将 luster 中的 volumeBindingMode 值设置为 `WaitForFirstConsumer`。

zh.explanation:
## 此场景考查的内容

PVC 已到达 Amazon EBS CSI provisioner，但 provisioner 在调用 Amazon EC2 API 创建 EBS 卷时失败。决定性错误消息是：

`could not create volume in EC2: UnauthorizedOperation`

这是 **AWS IAM 授权失败**，而不是 Kubernetes RBAC、gp3 选择或卷绑定问题。集群关联的 OIDC provider 使 EBS CSI controller service account 能够通过 IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA) 承担专用 IAM 角色。

## 正确答案：B

**创建具有所需权限和信任关系的 Amazon EBS CSI driver IAM 角色，并将该角色关联到 EBS CSI driver add-on。**

AWS 指出，EBS CSI plugin 需要 IAM 权限来调用 AWS API。EKS 文档甚至明确指出了这一确切症状：如果没有 driver IAM 角色，`kubectl describe pvc` 会同时报告 `failed to provision volume with StorageClass` 和 `could not create volume in EC2: UnauthorizedOperation`。该角色必须信任集群的 OIDC provider，以供 `kube-system:ebs-csi-controller-sa` service account 使用，并且必须具有 EBS CSI driver policy，例如 `AmazonEBSCSIDriverPolicyV2`。然后将 add-on 配置为使用该角色。请参阅 [使用 Amazon EBS 的 Kubernetes 卷存储](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/ebs-csi.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A — 错误。** Kubernetes `ClusterRole` 控制对 Kubernetes API 资源的访问。它不会授予调用 Amazon EC2 `CreateVolume` API 的权限。此外，AWS 指出，使用其 IAM 角色部署 EBS CSI add-on 会创建 `ebs-csi-controller-sa` service account，并将其绑定到所需的 Kubernetes cluster role。报告的失败明确是 AWS API `UnauthorizedOperation`，因此缺少的是 IAM 授权，而不是 Kubernetes RBAC。

- **C — 错误。** 选择 gp3 无法解决 EC2 授权失败。卷类型通常通过适用的 EBS CSI `StorageClass` 参数进行配置，而不是通过向 PVC 添加所建议的注释。即使正确选择了 gp3 类型，如果 CSI controller 没有创建 EBS 卷的权限，也无法预置该卷。

- **D — 错误。** 使用 `ebs.csi.aws.com` 和 `WaitForFirstConsumer` 的 CSI `StorageClass` 可以是标准 EBS CSI driver 的有效配置，但它不会授予 AWS 权限。该消息表明已尝试进行预置，但在 EC2 API 授权步骤失败。更改绑定模式或重新创建 StorageClass 都无法解决 `UnauthorizedOperation`。

因此，**B** 直接解决了根本原因。

en.question: A company runs a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC. The company's employees remotely access the EC2 instances by using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The company wants to collect metrics about how many RDP sessions the employees initiate every day. Which combination of steps will meet this requirement? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that reacts to EC2 Instance State-change Notification events.
options.B: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the log group as a target for the EventBridge rule.
options.C: Create a flow log in VPC Flow Logs.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Specify the log group as a destination for the flow log.
options.E: Create a log group metric filter.
options.F: Create a log group subscription filter. Use EventBridge as the destination.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs a network-level mechanism to identify incoming RDP connections to EC2 instances and turn those matching connections into a CloudWatch metric that can be totaled each day.

## Correct answers: C, D, and E

- **C. Create a flow log in VPC Flow Logs.**  
  VPC Flow Logs captures information about IP traffic going to and from VPC network interfaces. Therefore, it can capture traffic to the EC2 instances on the RDP destination port, normally TCP port `3389`. AWS states that flow logs can be created for VPCs, subnets, or network interfaces and can be used to monitor traffic reaching an instance. See [Logging IP traffic using VPC Flow Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html).

- **D. Create an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group and specify it as the destination for the flow log.**  
  Flow log records must be published to a supported destination. CloudWatch Logs is one of the supported destinations, and placing the records in a log group enables CloudWatch Logs filtering and metric extraction. AWS also documents that a destination must be specified when creating a flow log. See [Work with flow logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/working-with-flow-logs.html).

- **E. Create a log group metric filter.**  
  Configure a metric filter for flow log records that match RDP traffic—for example, TCP traffic with `dstport = 3389` and, if the requirement is to count successful connection attempts, `action = ACCEPT`. The default flow log format contains fields such as source address, destination address, source port, destination port, protocol, and action. AWS provides examples of filtering flow records by destination port and action in [Search flow log records](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/search-flow-log-records-cwl.html). A metric filter can publish a value of `1` for each matching log event, allowing the resulting metric to be summed over a one-day period. See [Create a metric filter for a log group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html).

Thus, the intended pipeline is:

`EC2 RDP traffic → VPC Flow Logs → CloudWatch Logs log group → metric filter → daily CloudWatch metric`

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. Create an EventBridge rule for EC2 Instance State-change Notification events — Incorrect.**  
  These events report EC2 lifecycle transitions such as `pending`, `running`, `stopping`, `stopped`, `shutting-down`, and `terminated`. They do not report operating-system login activity or RDP connections. See [State change events for Amazon EC2 instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitoring-instance-state-changes.html).

- **B. Send the EventBridge state-change events to a CloudWatch Logs log group — Incorrect.**  
  Although this would retain the selected EventBridge events, those events contain instance lifecycle changes rather than RDP session information. Sending irrelevant state-change records to CloudWatch Logs cannot produce the required RDP-session metric.

- **F. Create a subscription filter and use EventBridge as the destination — Incorrect.**  
  A subscription filter streams matching log events for downstream processing; it is not the direct CloudWatch Logs mechanism for creating a numerical metric. Additionally, the documented subscription-filter destinations are Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda, Amazon Data Firehose, and OpenSearch Service—not EventBridge. See [CloudWatch Logs subscription filters](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html).

zh.question: 一家公司在 VPC 中运行一组 Amazon EC2 实例。公司的员工使用 Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) 远程访问这些 EC2 实例。该公司希望收集有关员工每天发起多少个 RDP 会话的指标。哪种步骤组合可以满足此要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，以响应 EC2 Instance State-change Notification 事件。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组。将该日志组指定为 EventBridge 规则的目标。
options.C: 在 VPC Flow Logs 中创建流日志。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组。将该日志组指定为流日志的目标位置。
options.E: 创建一个日志组指标筛选器。
options.F: 创建一个日志组订阅筛选器。使用 EventBridge 作为目标位置。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一种网络层面的机制，用于识别传入 EC2 实例的 RDP 连接，并将这些匹配的连接转换为可每天汇总的 CloudWatch 指标。

## 正确答案：C、D 和 E

- **C. 在 VPC Flow Logs 中创建流日志。**  
  VPC Flow Logs 会捕获进出 VPC 网络接口的 IP 流量信息。因此，它可以捕获到达 EC2 实例 RDP 目标端口的流量，该端口通常为 TCP 端口 `3389`。AWS 指出，可为 VPC、子网或网络接口创建流日志，并可使用它来监控到达实例的流量。请参阅 [使用 VPC Flow Logs 记录 IP 流量](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/flow-logs.html)。

- **D. 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组，并将其指定为流日志的目标位置。**  
  流日志记录必须发布到受支持的目标位置。CloudWatch Logs 是受支持的目标位置之一，将记录放入日志组后，便可以使用 CloudWatch Logs 进行筛选和指标提取。AWS 还说明，在创建流日志时必须指定目标位置。请参阅 [使用流日志](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/working-with-flow-logs.html)。

- **E. 创建一个日志组指标筛选器。**  
  为与 RDP 流量匹配的流日志记录配置指标筛选器——例如，使用 `dstport = 3389` 的 TCP 流量；如果要求统计成功的连接尝试，还可使用 `action = ACCEPT`。默认流日志格式包含源地址、目标地址、源端口、目标端口、协议和操作等字段。AWS 在 [搜索流日志记录](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/vpc/latest/userguide/search-flow-log-records-cwl.html) 中提供了按目标端口和操作筛选流记录的示例。指标筛选器可为每个匹配的日志事件发布值 `1`，从而可以将生成的指标在一天内求和。请参阅 [为日志组创建指标筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CreateMetricFilterProcedure.html)。

因此，预期的处理流程为：

`EC2 RDP 流量 → VPC Flow Logs → CloudWatch Logs 日志组 → 指标筛选器 → 每日 CloudWatch 指标`

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A. 为 EC2 Instance State-change Notification 事件创建 EventBridge 规则 — 不正确。**  
  这些事件报告 EC2 生命周期转换，例如 `pending`、`running`、`stopping`、`stopped`、`shutting-down` 和 `terminated`。它们不会报告操作系统登录活动或 RDP 连接。请参阅 [Amazon EC2 实例的状态更改事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/monitoring-instance-state-changes.html)。

- **B. 将 EventBridge 状态更改事件发送到 CloudWatch Logs 日志组 — 不正确。**  
  虽然这会保留所选的 EventBridge 事件，但这些事件包含的是实例生命周期更改，而非 RDP 会话信息。将无关的状态更改记录发送到 CloudWatch Logs 无法生成所需的 RDP 会话指标。

- **F. 创建订阅筛选器并使用 EventBridge 作为目标位置 — 不正确。**  
  订阅筛选器会流式传输匹配的日志事件以供下游处理；它不是用于创建数值指标的直接 CloudWatch Logs 机制。此外，文档中列出的订阅筛选器目标位置为 Kinesis Data Streams、Lambda、Amazon Data Firehose 和 OpenSearch Service，而不是 EventBridge。请参阅 [CloudWatch Logs 订阅筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/SubscriptionFilters.html)。

en.question: A company is using Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) to run its applications. The EKS cluster is successfully running multiple pods. The company stores the pod images in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). The company needs to configure Pod Identity access for the EKS cluster. The company has already updated the node IAM role by using the permissions for Pod Identity access. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for the EKS cluster.
options.B: Ensure that the nodes can reach the EKS Auth API. Add and configure the EKS Pod Identity Agent add-on for the EKS cluster.
options.C: Create an EKS access entry that uses the API_AND-CONFIG_MAP cluster authentication mode.
options.D: Configure the AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) endpoint for the Kubernetes service account that the pods in the EKS cluster use.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company is configuring **Amazon EKS Pod Identity**, not IAM roles for service accounts (IRSA). The node IAM role already has the required Pod Identity permission, so the remaining infrastructure requirement is to deploy the component that obtains credentials for pods and ensure that component can communicate with the appropriate EKS service endpoint.

## Correct answer: B

**B. Ensure that the nodes can reach the EKS Auth API. Add and configure the EKS Pod Identity Agent add-on for the EKS cluster.**

EKS Pod Identity provides credentials through the **EKS Auth API** and the **EKS Pod Identity Agent**, which runs on each node. AWS explicitly lists the following prerequisites and setup actions:

- Nodes running the agent must be able to access the EKS Auth API. Nodes in private subnets can use an AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint for this API.
- The node role must allow `eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity`—the question states that this permission has already been added.
- The EKS Pod Identity Agent add-on must be installed so that it can request temporary credentials and supply them to pod workloads.

AWS also states that the agent uses `AssumeRoleForPodIdentity` against the EKS Auth API and makes the resulting temporary credentials available to AWS SDKs in the pod. Therefore, option B supplies the necessary remaining configuration. See [Set up the Amazon EKS Pod Identity Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-id-agent-setup.html) and [How EKS Pod Identity Agent works with a Pod](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-id-how-it-works.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create an IAM OIDC provider for the EKS cluster

An IAM OIDC provider is required for **IRSA**, not EKS Pod Identity. AWS describes EKS Pod Identity as simpler than IRSA specifically because it **does not use OIDC identity providers**. See [Benefits of EKS Pod Identities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-identities.html).

### C. Create an EKS access entry that uses the API_AND_CONFIG_MAP cluster authentication mode

EKS access entries and the cluster authentication mode control how **IAM principals such as users and roles access Kubernetes objects and the Kubernetes API**. They do not provide AWS credentials to application pods and are not a prerequisite for EKS Pod Identity. See [Associate IAM identities with Kubernetes permissions and set cluster authentication mode](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/grant-k8s-access.html).

Also, an access entry does not itself “use” an authentication mode; the authentication mode is a cluster-level configuration that determines whether access entries, the `aws-auth` ConfigMap, or both are used.

### D. Configure the AWS STS endpoint for the Kubernetes service account

This does not describe the EKS Pod Identity credential flow. With Pod Identity, EKS injects container-credential environment variables and a projected service account token into the pod. The node-local Pod Identity Agent then calls the **EKS Auth API** to retrieve temporary credentials and exposes them to the pod's AWS SDK. The service account is associated with an IAM role through an EKS Pod Identity association; it is not configured with an STS endpoint. See [How EKS Pod Identity Agent works with a Pod](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-id-how-it-works.html).

**Answer: B**

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) 运行其应用程序。EKS 集群已成功运行多个 Pod。该公司将 Pod 镜像存储在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 中。该公司需要为 EKS 集群配置 Pod Identity 访问权限。该公司已使用 Pod Identity 访问权限更新了节点 IAM 角色。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 EKS 集群创建 IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) 提供商。
options.B: 确保节点能够访问 EKS Auth API。为 EKS 集群添加并配置 EKS Pod Identity Agent 插件。
options.C: 创建一个使用 API_AND-CONFIG_MAP 集群身份验证模式的 EKS 访问条目。
options.D: 为 EKS 集群中的 Pod 所使用的 Kubernetes 服务账户配置 AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) 端点。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司正在配置的是 **Amazon EKS Pod Identity**，而不是用于服务账户的 IAM 角色 (IRSA)。节点 IAM 角色已经具备所需的 Pod Identity 权限，因此剩余的基础设施要求是部署用于为 Pod 获取凭证的组件，并确保该组件能够与相应的 EKS 服务端点通信。

## 正确答案：B

**B. 确保节点能够访问 EKS Auth API。为 EKS 集群添加并配置 EKS Pod Identity Agent 插件。**

EKS Pod Identity 通过 **EKS Auth API** 和 **EKS Pod Identity Agent** 提供凭证，该 Agent 在每个节点上运行。AWS 明确列出了以下前提条件和设置操作：

- 运行 Agent 的节点必须能够访问 EKS Auth API。私有子网中的节点可以为此 API 使用 AWS PrivateLink 接口端点。
- 节点角色必须允许 `eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity`——题目说明该权限已经添加。
- 必须安装 EKS Pod Identity Agent 插件，以便其能够请求临时凭证并将凭证提供给 Pod 工作负载。

AWS 还指出，Agent 会针对 EKS Auth API 使用 `AssumeRoleForPodIdentity`，并将生成的临时凭证提供给 Pod 中的 AWS SDK。因此，选项 B 提供了所需的其余配置。请参阅 [设置 Amazon EKS Pod Identity Agent](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-id-agent-setup.html) 和 [EKS Pod Identity Agent 如何与 Pod 配合工作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-id-how-it-works.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 为 EKS 集群创建 IAM OIDC 提供商

IAM OIDC 提供商是 **IRSA** 所必需的，而不是 EKS Pod Identity。AWS 将 EKS Pod Identity 描述为比 IRSA 更简单，具体原因正是它**不使用 OIDC 身份提供商**。请参阅 [EKS Pod Identities 的优势](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-identities.html)。

### C. 创建一个使用 API_AND_CONFIG_MAP 集群身份验证模式的 EKS 访问条目

EKS 访问条目和集群身份验证模式控制的是 **IAM 主体（例如用户和角色）如何访问 Kubernetes 对象及 Kubernetes API**。它们不会向应用程序 Pod 提供 AWS 凭证，也不是 EKS Pod Identity 的前提条件。请参阅 [将 IAM 身份与 Kubernetes 权限关联并设置集群身份验证模式](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/grant-k8s-access.html)。

此外，访问条目本身并不“使用”身份验证模式；身份验证模式是集群级别的配置，用于决定使用访问条目、`aws-auth` ConfigMap，还是两者同时使用。

### D. 为 Kubernetes 服务账户配置 AWS STS 端点

这并不描述 EKS Pod Identity 的凭证流程。使用 Pod Identity 时，EKS 会向 Pod 注入容器凭证环境变量和投影的服务账户令牌。随后，节点本地的 Pod Identity Agent 会调用 **EKS Auth API** 来获取临时凭证，并将其提供给 Pod 的 AWS SDK。服务账户通过 EKS Pod Identity 关联与 IAM 角色关联；不会为其配置 STS 端点。请参阅 [EKS Pod Identity Agent 如何与 Pod 配合工作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/pod-id-how-it-works.html)。

**答案：B**

en.question: A company has multiple AWS accounts in an organization in AWS Organizations that has all features enabled. The company’s DevOps administrator needs to improve security across all the company's AWS accounts. The administrator needs to identify the top users and roles in use across all accounts. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a new organization trail in AWS CloudTrail. Configure the trail to send log events to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Create a CloudWatch Contributor Insights rule for the userIdentity.arn log field. View the results in CloudWatch Contributor Insights.
options.B: Create an unused access analysis for the organization by using AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer. Review the analyzer results and determine if each finding has the intended level of permissions required for the workload.
options.C: Create a new organization trail in AWS CloudTrail. Create a table in Amazon Athena that uses partition projection. Load the Athena table with CloudTrail data. Query the Athena table to find the top users and roles.
options.D: Generate a Service access report for each account by using Organizations. From the results, pull the last accessed date and last accessed by account fields to find the top users and roles.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The company needs a centralized, organization-wide view of which IAM users and roles generate the most AWS activity. Because the question emphasizes **MOST operational efficiency**, the best solution is the one that continuously produces a top-contributors ranking with the least custom querying and ongoing administration.

An AWS CloudTrail **organization trail** records events for the management account and all member accounts in the organization, creating the required centralized activity source. CloudTrail can deliver these events to a CloudWatch Logs log group. See [Creating a trail for an organization](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html) and [Sending CloudTrail events to CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/send-cloudtrail-events-to-cloudwatch-logs.html).

CloudWatch Contributor Insights analyzes structured log data and generates reports showing **top-N contributors**, unique contributors, and usage. CloudTrail logs are supported as an input, and a rule can use a populated JSON field as its contributor key and rank values by occurrence count. Therefore, a rule based on `userIdentity.arn` can continuously rank the principals making API calls across the organization. See [Analyzing high-cardinality data with Contributor Insights](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights.html), [Creating a Contributor Insights rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights-CreateRule.html), and [Contributor Insights rule syntax](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights-RuleSyntax.html).

CloudTrail defines `userIdentity.arn` as the ARN of the principal that made the request. One implementation nuance is that, for assumed-role activity, this ARN includes the role-session name. If session names vary and a strict aggregate by IAM role is required, the rule should use or normalize to a stable role identity, such as the session issuer's ARN. This does not change the selection of A; Contributor Insights remains the purpose-built and most operationally efficient ranking mechanism. See [CloudTrail user identity elements](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. IAM Access Analyzer unused access analysis

Unused access analysis identifies roles, credentials, services, actions, and permissions that have not been used. It supports least-privilege remediation, but it does not rank identities by how often they are used. It therefore answers a different question—**which access is unused** rather than **which users and roles are most active**. See [Using IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html).

### C. Athena with partition projection

Athena can query organization-wide CloudTrail data, and partition projection can avoid manually adding partitions and improve query efficiency. A SQL query could group CloudTrail records by identity and calculate usage counts. See [Using partition projection with CloudTrail logs in Athena](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/create-cloudtrail-table-partition-projection.html).

However, this approach still requires creating and maintaining the external table definition, modeling the organization/account/Region S3 paths, writing the aggregation SQL, and running or scheduling queries and reports. Partition projection reduces partition-management work; it does not eliminate table and query administration. Contributor Insights continuously maintains a top-N report after the rule is configured, so A is more operationally efficient.

### D. Organizations service access reports

Service last-accessed information reports when an allowed AWS service was last accessed and which principal last accessed it. It is intended primarily to help refine permissions and policies. It does not provide event-frequency aggregation or rank the organization's most active users and roles. Generating reports for individual accounts and combining them would also require more operational effort. See [Refining permissions using last-accessed information](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_last-accessed.html).

Therefore, **A** provides the required organization-wide activity collection and a managed, continuously updated top-contributors report with the least operational overhead.

zh.question: 一家公司在启用了所有功能的 AWS Organizations 组织中拥有多个 AWS 账户。该公司的 DevOps 管理员需要提高公司所有 AWS 账户的安全性。管理员需要识别所有账户中使用最多的用户和角色。哪种解决方案能以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建新的组织跟踪。将跟踪配置为把日志事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs。为 `userIdentity.arn` 日志字段创建 CloudWatch Contributor Insights 规则。在 CloudWatch Contributor Insights 中查看结果。
options.B: 使用 AWS Identity and Access Management Access Analyzer 为组织创建未使用访问权限分析。查看分析器结果，并确定每项发现是否具有工作负载所需的预期权限级别。
options.C: 在 AWS CloudTrail 中创建新的组织跟踪。创建一个使用分区投影的 Amazon Athena 表。将 CloudTrail 数据加载到 Athena 表中。查询 Athena 表以查找使用最多的用户和角色。
options.D: 使用 Organizations 为每个账户生成服务访问报告。从结果中提取上次访问日期和上次访问账户字段，以查找使用最多的用户和角色。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

公司需要一个集中式、覆盖整个组织的视图，以了解哪些 IAM 用户和角色产生了最多的 AWS 活动。由于题目强调 **最高的运营效率**，最佳解决方案应当是在最少自定义查询和持续管理工作的情况下，持续生成主要贡献者排名的方案。

AWS CloudTrail **组织跟踪**会记录组织中管理账户和所有成员账户的事件，从而创建所需的集中式活动数据源。CloudTrail 可以将这些事件传送到 CloudWatch Logs 日志组。请参阅 [为组织创建跟踪](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/creating-trail-organization.html) 和 [将 CloudTrail 事件发送到 CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/send-cloudtrail-events-to-cloudwatch-logs.html)。

CloudWatch Contributor Insights 可分析结构化日志数据，并生成显示 **前 N 名贡献者**、唯一贡献者和使用情况的报告。CloudTrail 日志支持作为输入，规则可以使用已填充的 JSON 字段作为贡献者键，并按出现次数对值进行排名。因此，基于 `userIdentity.arn` 的规则可以持续对整个组织中发起 API 调用的主体进行排名。请参阅 [使用 Contributor Insights 分析高基数数据](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights.html)、[创建 Contributor Insights 规则](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights-CreateRule.html) 和 [Contributor Insights 规则语法](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/ContributorInsights-RuleSyntax.html)。

CloudTrail 将 `userIdentity.arn` 定义为发出请求的主体的 ARN。一个实施细节是，对于担任角色的活动，此 ARN 包含角色会话名称。如果会话名称各不相同，并且需要严格按 IAM 角色聚合，则规则应使用或规范化为稳定的角色身份，例如会话颁发者的 ARN。这不会改变选择 A；Contributor Insights 仍然是专门构建且运营效率最高的排名机制。请参阅 [CloudTrail 用户身份元素](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. IAM Access Analyzer 未使用访问权限分析

未使用访问权限分析可识别未被使用的角色、凭证、服务、操作和权限。它支持最小权限修正，但不会根据身份使用频率对其进行排名。因此，它回答的是另一个问题——**哪些访问权限未被使用**，而不是 **哪些用户和角色最活跃**。请参阅 [使用 IAM Access Analyzer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/what-is-access-analyzer.html)。

### C. 使用分区投影的 Athena

Athena 可以查询覆盖整个组织的 CloudTrail 数据，而分区投影可以避免手动添加分区并提高查询效率。SQL 查询可以按身份对 CloudTrail 记录分组，并计算使用次数。请参阅 [在 Athena 中对 CloudTrail 日志使用分区投影](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/create-cloudtrail-table-partition-projection.html)。

但是，此方法仍需要创建和维护外部表定义、对组织/账户/Region S3 路径进行建模、编写聚合 SQL，以及运行或计划查询和报告。分区投影减少了分区管理工作，但并未消除表和查询管理。Contributor Insights 在配置规则后会持续维护前 N 名报告，因此 A 的运营效率更高。

### D. Organizations 服务访问报告

服务上次访问信息会报告何时最后访问了允许的 AWS 服务，以及哪个主体最后访问了该服务。它的主要用途是帮助优化权限和策略。它不提供事件频率聚合，也不会对组织中最活跃的用户和角色进行排名。为各个账户生成报告并将其合并也需要更多运营工作。请参阅 [使用上次访问信息优化权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_last-accessed.html)。

因此，**A** 提供了所需的组织范围活动收集，以及一个托管的、持续更新的主要贡献者报告，且运营开销最低。

en.question: A company has an organization in AWS Organizations with many Oils that contain many AWS accounts. The organization has a dedicated delegated administrator AWS account. The company needs the accounts in one OU to have server-side encryption enforced for all Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues that are created or updated on an AWS CloudFormation stack. Which solution will enforce this policy before a CloudFormation stack operation in the accounts of this OU?

options.A: Activate trusted access to CloudFormation StackSets. Create a CloudFormation Hook that enforces server-side encryption on EBS volumes and SQS queues. Deploy the Hook across the accounts in the OU by using StackSets.
options.B: Set up AWS Config in all the accounts in the OU. Use AWS Systems Manager to deploy AWS Config rules that enforce server-side encryption for EBS volumes and SQS queues across the accounts in the OU.
options.C: Write an SCP to deny the creation of EBS volumes and SQS queues unless the EBS volumes and SQS queues have server-side encryption. Attach the SCP to the OU.
options.D: Create an AWS Lambda function in the delegated administrator account that checks whether server-side encryption is enforced for EBS volumes and SQS queues. Create an IAM role to provide the Lambda function access to the accounts in the OU.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to **block noncompliant EBS volume and SQS queue configurations before CloudFormation provisions or updates them**, and to apply that control consistently to all accounts in a specified OU.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Activate trusted access to CloudFormation StackSets, create a CloudFormation Hook that enforces encryption, and deploy the Hook to the OU by using StackSets.**

CloudFormation Hooks are designed for this exact pre-provisioning use case. A Hook proactively inspects resource, stack, or change-set configurations before provisioning. When configured with failure mode `FAIL`, it can stop the operation if an EBS volume or SQS queue does not have the required server-side encryption configuration. AWS states that Hooks can perform compliance checks before provisioning and can fail and stop a noncompliant operation ([CloudFormation best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)).

Hooks must be activated in the accounts and Regions where they are enforced. AWS documents using CloudFormation StackSets to activate a Hook across multiple organization accounts and Regions, targeting OUs or specific accounts ([Enforce with CloudFormation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/enforce-required-tag-keys-iac.html)). StackSets with service-managed permissions can target specified OUs, and operations can be initiated from a delegated administrator account ([Create StackSets with service-managed permissions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)). This satisfies both the timing requirement and the multi-account OU deployment requirement.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. AWS Config rules with Systems Manager remediation** — AWS Config primarily evaluates compliance and Systems Manager Automation remediates resources that Config has already identified as noncompliant. Even AWS Config proactive evaluation only reports whether proposed properties are compliant; AWS explicitly states that proactive rules **do not prevent resources from being deployed**. Therefore, this does not inherently block the CloudFormation operation before provisioning ([AWS Config concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html); [AWS Config remediation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)).

- **C. Attach an SCP to the OU** — An SCP is an authorization guardrail, not a CloudFormation template/resource validation mechanism. Although an SCP can deny supported API requests—for example, EBS volume creation under suitable request conditions—it cannot generally inspect arbitrary CloudFormation resource properties. Amazon SQS supports only a limited subset of IAM condition keys, so an SCP is not the appropriate comprehensive mechanism for validating both EBS and SQS encryption properties on CloudFormation creates and updates ([Amazon SQS policy limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-limitations-of-custom-policies.html)). It also acts on downstream service API authorization rather than providing the requested CloudFormation pre-operation validation.

- **D. Lambda function in the delegated administrator account** — A standalone Lambda function and cross-account role do not provide an invocation point in the CloudFormation provisioning lifecycle. Nothing in this option causes CloudFormation to call the function before stack creates or updates or causes a failed check to block the operation. A Lambda-backed CloudFormation Hook could supply custom validation logic, but the required Hook registration, activation, failure configuration, and multi-account deployment are absent.

Therefore, **A** is the solution specifically designed to enforce the policy before CloudFormation provisions or updates the resources.

zh.question: 一家公司在 AWS Organizations 中有一个组织，其中包含许多 OU，而这些 OU 包含许多 AWS 账户。该组织有一个专用的委派管理员 AWS 账户。公司需要让一个 OU 中的账户对在 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈上创建或更新的所有 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷和 Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) 队列强制实施服务器端加密。哪种解决方案能够在该 OU 中账户的 CloudFormation 堆栈操作之前强制实施此策略？

options.A: 激活对 CloudFormation StackSets 的可信访问。创建一个 CloudFormation Hook，以对 EBS 卷和 SQS 队列强制实施服务器端加密。使用 StackSets 将该 Hook 部署到 OU 中的各个账户。
options.B: 在 OU 中的所有账户中设置 AWS Config。使用 AWS Systems Manager 部署 AWS Config 规则，以在 OU 中的各个账户内对 EBS 卷和 SQS 队列强制实施服务器端加密。
options.C: 编写一个 SCP，拒绝创建未启用服务器端加密的 EBS 卷和 SQS 队列。将该 SCP 附加到 OU。
options.D: 在委派管理员账户中创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，用于检查是否对 EBS 卷和 SQS 队列强制实施了服务器端加密。创建一个 IAM 角色，为该 Lambda 函数提供对 OU 中账户的访问权限。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是要在 CloudFormation 预置或更新不合规的 EBS 卷和 SQS 队列配置之前**阻止它们**，并将该控制措施一致地应用于指定 OU 中的所有账户。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 激活对 CloudFormation StackSets 的可信访问，创建一个强制实施加密的 CloudFormation Hook，并使用 StackSets 将该 Hook 部署到 OU。**
