CloudFormation Hooks 正是为此类预置前使用场景设计的。Hook 会在预置前主动检查资源、堆栈或变更集配置。当配置为失败模式 `FAIL` 时，如果 EBS 卷或 SQS 队列不具备所需的服务器端加密配置，它可以停止操作。AWS 指出，Hooks 可以在预置前执行合规性检查，并且能够使不合规操作失败并停止该操作（[CloudFormation 最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)）。

必须在实施 Hook 的账户和区域中激活 Hooks。AWS 文档说明，可以使用 CloudFormation StackSets 在多个组织账户和区域中激活 Hook，并以 OU 或特定账户为目标（[使用 CloudFormation 强制实施](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/enforce-required-tag-keys-iac.html)）。具有服务托管权限的 StackSets 可以以指定 OU 为目标，并且可从委派管理员账户发起操作（[使用服务托管权限创建 StackSets](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/stacksets-orgs-associate-stackset-with-org.html)）。这同时满足了时机要求和多账户 OU 部署要求。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. 使用 Systems Manager 的 AWS Config 规则和修复** — AWS Config 主要评估合规性，而 Systems Manager Automation 会修复 Config 已识别为不合规的资源。即使是 AWS Config 主动评估，也只是报告建议的属性是否合规；AWS 明确指出，主动规则**不会阻止资源部署**。因此，该方案本身无法在预置前阻止 CloudFormation 操作（[AWS Config 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/config-concepts.html)；[AWS Config 修复](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)）。

- **C. 将 SCP 附加到 OU** — SCP 是授权防护机制，而不是 CloudFormation 模板/资源验证机制。尽管 SCP 可以拒绝受支持的 API 请求——例如，在适当请求条件下拒绝创建 EBS 卷——但它通常无法检查任意的 CloudFormation 资源属性。Amazon SQS 仅支持有限的一部分 IAM 条件键，因此 SCP 并非适合全面验证 CloudFormation 创建和更新操作中 EBS 与 SQS 加密属性的机制（[Amazon SQS 策略限制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/SQSDeveloperGuide/sqs-limitations-of-custom-policies.html)）。它还对下游服务 API 授权生效，而非提供所要求的 CloudFormation 操作前验证。

- **D. 委派管理员账户中的 Lambda 函数** — 独立的 Lambda 函数和跨账户角色无法在 CloudFormation 预置生命周期中提供调用点。此选项中没有任何内容会使 CloudFormation 在堆栈创建或更新之前调用该函数，也没有任何内容会使失败的检查阻止操作。由 Lambda 支持的 CloudFormation Hook 可以提供自定义验证逻辑，但此选项缺少所需的 Hook 注册、激活、失败配置和多账户部署。

因此，**A** 是专门用于在 CloudFormation 预置或更新资源之前强制实施该策略的解决方案。

en.question: A company is running an internal application in an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster on Amazon EC2. The ECS cluster instances can connect to the public internet. The ECS tasks that run on the cluster instances are configured to use images from both private Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repositories and a public ECR registry repository. A new security policy requires the company to remove the ECS cluster's direct access to the internet. The company must remove any NAT gateways and internet gateways from the VPC that hosts the cluster. A DevOps engineer needs to ensure the ECS cluster can still download images from both the public ECR registry and the private ECR repositories. Images from the public ECR registry must remain up-to-date. New versions of the images must be available to the ECS cluster within 24 hours of publication. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an AWS CodeBuild project and a new private ECR repository for each image that is downloaded from the public ECR registry. Configure each project to pull the image from the public ECR repository and push the image to the new private ECR repository. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes the CodeBuild project once every 24 hours. Update each task definition in the ECS cluster to refer to the new private ECR repository.
options.B: Create a new Amazon ECR pull through cache rule for each image that is downloaded from the public ECR registry. Create an AWS Lambda function that invokes each pull through cache rule. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that invokes the Lambda function once every 24 hours. Update each task definition in the ECS cluster to refer to the image from the pull through cache.
options.C: Create a new Amazon ECR pull through cache rule for the public ECR registry. Update each task definition in the ECS cluster to refer to the image from the pull through cache. Ensure each public image has been downloaded through the pull through cache at least once before removing internet access from the VPC.
options.D: Create an Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoint for the public ECR repositories that are in the VPC.
options.E: Create an Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoint for the private ECR repositories that are in the VPC.
options.F: Create an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint in the VPC.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The ECS container instances must lose all direct internet access, including NAT gateways and internet gateways, but must still be able to:

1. Pull existing private Amazon ECR images.
2. Use images originating in Amazon ECR Public.
3. receive updated public-image versions within 24 hours.
4. Do so with the least operational overhead.

## Correct answers: C, E, and F

### C. Use an Amazon ECR pull through cache rule for Amazon ECR Public

A pull through cache presents the upstream public image through an **Amazon ECR private registry URI**. The ECS task definitions can therefore reference private ECR URLs instead of directly accessing `public.ecr.aws`. AWS documents the corresponding URI format as:

```text
aws_account_id.dkr.ecr.region.amazonaws.com/ecr-public/repository_name/image_name:tag
```

Amazon ECR checks whether a cached image has been validated against the upstream registry during the preceding 24 hours. If not, ECR checks upstream and updates the cache when a newer image exists. This provides the required managed update behavior without CodeBuild, Lambda, or custom synchronization logic.

AWS also states that the **first pull** through a pull through cache can require internet connectivity when ECR is being accessed through PrivateLink; subsequent pulls do not. Therefore, pre-pulling every required public image before removing the NAT and internet gateways is necessary. See [Using pull through cache rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache.html) and [Pulling an image with a pull through cache rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache-working-pulling.html).

### E. Create Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoints

After internet access is removed, ECS container instances need private connectivity to the Amazon ECR private registry. This applies both to the company's original private repositories and to the private repositories populated by the pull through cache.

For ECS tasks hosted on EC2, AWS specifies the ECR interface endpoints used for the registry and API operations—`ecr.dkr` and `ecr.api`. Private DNS should be enabled so standard ECR hostnames resolve to the endpoint's private addresses. See [Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html).

### F. Create an Amazon S3 gateway endpoint

ECR supplies image manifests through Amazon ECR, but the actual container image layers are stored in Amazon S3. AWS explicitly states that ECS tasks hosted on EC2 require both the ECR endpoints and an S3 gateway endpoint to pull private ECR images without internet access. The S3 gateway endpoint therefore completes the private network path for image downloads. See [Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. CodeBuild projects and scheduled synchronization

This could be engineered to copy images into private ECR, but it introduces a CodeBuild project and private repository for every image, scheduled EventBridge rules, build specifications, IAM roles, monitoring, and failure handling. Amazon ECR pull through cache provides the required caching and upstream revalidation as a managed capability, so option A does not have the least operational overhead.

### B. Lambda periodically invokes each pull through cache rule

A pull through cache rule is not a scheduled job that Lambda can directly “invoke.” Cache population and upstream revalidation occur when an image is pulled using the private ECR pull-through-cache URI. Moreover, AWS states that Lambda does not support pulling container images from ECR by using a pull through cache rule. The proposed Lambda/EventBridge mechanism is therefore both unnecessary and incorrectly modeled. See [Using pull through cache rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache.html).

### D. Create an ECR interface endpoint for public ECR repositories

ECS cannot solve private Docker image pulls merely by creating a VPC endpoint aimed at the public registry. Direct public ECR Docker pulls use public registry endpoints such as:

```text
public.ecr.aws/<alias>/<repository>:<tag>
```

The required design is to cache the public image into the account's **private ECR registry**, then pull that cached copy through the private ECR VPC endpoints. AWS documents this private pull-through-cache URI pattern separately from the direct [Amazon ECR Public Docker endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/public/public-ecr-requests.html). Thus D does not replace C, E, and F.

Therefore, the least-operational-overhead combination is **C, E, and F**.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 Amazon EC2 上的 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 集群中运行内部应用程序。ECS 集群实例可以连接到公有互联网。运行在集群实例上的 ECS 任务配置为使用来自私有 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 存储库和公有 ECR 注册表存储库的镜像。一项新的安全策略要求公司移除 ECS 集群对互联网的直接访问。公司必须从托管该集群的 VPC 中移除所有 NAT 网关和互联网网关。DevOps 工程师需要确保 ECS 集群仍然能够从公有 ECR 注册表和私有 ECR 存储库下载镜像。来自公有 ECR 注册表的镜像必须保持最新。镜像的新版本必须在发布后的 24 小时内可供 ECS 集群使用。哪种步骤组合将以最低的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择三项。）

options.A: 为从公有 ECR 注册表下载的每个镜像创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目和一个新的私有 ECR 存储库。配置每个项目从公有 ECR 存储库拉取镜像，并将镜像推送到新的私有 ECR 存储库。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每 24 小时调用一次 CodeBuild 项目。更新 ECS 集群中的每个任务定义，使其引用新的私有 ECR 存储库。
options.B: 为从公有 ECR 注册表下载的每个镜像创建一条新的 Amazon ECR pull through cache 规则。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来调用每条 pull through cache 规则。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则，每 24 小时调用一次 Lambda 函数。更新 ECS 集群中的每个任务定义，使其引用 pull through cache 中的镜像。
options.C: 为公有 ECR 注册表创建一条新的 Amazon ECR pull through cache 规则。更新 ECS 集群中的每个任务定义，使其引用 pull through cache 中的镜像。确保在从 VPC 移除互联网访问之前，每个公有镜像都已至少通过 pull through cache 下载过一次。
options.D: 为 VPC 中的公有 ECR 存储库创建一个 Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoint。
options.E: 为 VPC 中的私有 ECR 存储库创建一个 Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoint。
options.F: 在 VPC 中创建一个 Amazon S3 gateway endpoint。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

ECS 容器实例必须失去所有直接互联网访问能力，包括 NAT gateway 和 internet gateway，但仍必须能够：

1. 拉取现有的私有 Amazon ECR 镜像。
2. 使用源自 Amazon ECR Public 的镜像。
3. 在 24 小时内接收公有镜像的新版本。
4. 以最低的运维开销实现以上目标。

## 正确答案：C、E 和 F

### C. 为 Amazon ECR Public 使用 Amazon ECR pull through cache 规则

pull through cache 会通过一个 **Amazon ECR 私有注册表 URI** 提供上游公有镜像。因此，ECS 任务定义可以引用私有 ECR URL，而不是直接访问 `public.ecr.aws`。AWS 记录的相应 URI 格式为：

```text
aws_account_id.dkr.ecr.region.amazonaws.com/ecr-public/repository_name/image_name:tag
```

Amazon ECR 会检查缓存镜像是否在过去 24 小时内已针对上游注册表完成验证。如果没有，ECR 会检查上游；如果存在更新的镜像，则更新缓存。这在无需 CodeBuild、Lambda 或自定义同步逻辑的情况下，提供所需的托管更新行为。

AWS 还说明，当通过 PrivateLink 访问 ECR 时，通过 pull through cache 进行的**首次拉取**可能需要互联网连接；后续拉取则不需要。因此，在移除 NAT gateway 和 internet gateway 之前，必须预先拉取每个所需的公有镜像。请参阅 [Using pull through cache rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache.html) 和 [Pulling an image with a pull through cache rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache-working-pulling.html)。

### E. 创建 Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoint

移除互联网访问后，ECS 容器实例需要通过私有连接访问 Amazon ECR 私有注册表。这既适用于公司原有的私有存储库，也适用于由 pull through cache 填充的私有存储库。

对于托管在 EC2 上的 ECS 任务，AWS 指定用于注册表和 API 操作的 ECR interface endpoint：`ecr.dkr` 和 `ecr.api`。应启用 Private DNS，以便标准 ECR 主机名解析为 endpoint 的私有地址。请参阅 [Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html)。

### F. 创建 Amazon S3 gateway endpoint

ECR 通过 Amazon ECR 提供镜像清单，但实际的容器镜像层存储在 Amazon S3 中。AWS 明确指出，托管在 EC2 上的 ECS 任务需要同时具备 ECR endpoint 和 S3 gateway endpoint，才能在没有互联网访问的情况下拉取私有 ECR 镜像。因此，S3 gateway endpoint 完成镜像下载所需的私有网络路径。请参阅 [Amazon ECR interface VPC endpoints](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/vpc-endpoints.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. CodeBuild 项目和计划同步

可以通过工程方式将镜像复制到私有 ECR，但这会为每个镜像引入 CodeBuild 项目和私有存储库、计划的 EventBridge 规则、构建规范、IAM 角色、监控和故障处理。Amazon ECR pull through cache 将所需的缓存和上游重新验证作为托管功能提供，因此选项 A 并非运维开销最低的方案。

### B. Lambda 定期调用每条 pull through cache 规则

pull through cache 规则不是 Lambda 可以直接“调用”的计划任务。缓存填充和上游重新验证发生在使用私有 ECR pull-through-cache URI 拉取镜像时。此外，AWS 说明 Lambda 不支持通过 pull through cache 规则从 ECR 拉取容器镜像。因此，所提议的 Lambda/EventBridge 机制既不必要，模型也不正确。请参阅 [Using pull through cache rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache.html)。

### D. 为公有 ECR 存储库创建 ECR interface endpoint

仅创建一个面向公有注册表的 VPC endpoint，无法解决私有 Docker 镜像拉取问题。直接从公有 ECR 拉取 Docker 镜像会使用如下公有注册表 endpoint：

```text
public.ecr.aws/<alias>/<repository>:<tag>
```

所需设计是将公有镜像缓存到该账户的**私有 ECR 注册表**中，然后通过私有 ECR VPC endpoint 拉取该缓存副本。AWS 将这种私有 pull-through-cache URI 模式与直接的 [Amazon ECR Public Docker endpoint](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/public/public-ecr-requests.html) 分别记录。因此，D 不能替代 C、E 和 F。

因此，运维开销最低的组合是 **C、E 和 F**。

en.question: A company has a continuous integration pipeline where the company creates container images by using AWS CodeBuild. The created images are stored in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Checking for and fixing the vulnerabilities in the images takes the company too much time. The company wants to identify the image vulnerabilities quickly and notify the security team of the vulnerabilities. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)

options.A: Activate Amazon Inspector enhanced scanning for Amazon ECR. Configure the enhanced scanning to use continuous scanning. Set up a topic in Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
options.B: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule for Amazon Inspector findings. Set an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the rule target.
options.C: Activate AWS Lambda enhanced scanning for Amazon ECR. Configure the enhanced scanning to use continuous scanning. Set up a topic in Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
options.D: Create a new AWS Lambda function. Invoke the new Lambda function when scan findings are detected.
options.E: Activate default basic scanning for Amazon ECR for all container images. Configure the default basic scanning to use continuous scanning. Set up a topic in Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs two managed capabilities with minimal custom code:

1. **Continuously identify vulnerabilities in ECR images**, including newly disclosed vulnerabilities after an image has already been pushed.
2. **Automatically notify the security team** when Amazon Inspector produces findings.

## Correct answers: A and B

### A. Activate Amazon Inspector enhanced scanning for Amazon ECR, use continuous scanning, and create an SNS topic

Amazon ECR **enhanced scanning** integrates with Amazon Inspector and provides automated, continuous vulnerability scanning for both operating system and programming-language packages. With continuous scanning, findings can be updated as new vulnerabilities become known, rather than scanning the image only when it is pushed. Amazon Inspector then emits finding events to EventBridge. This directly addresses the need to identify vulnerabilities quickly with low operational overhead.

AWS documents that enhanced scanning supports **scan on push and continuous scan**, while basic scanning supports only **manual and scan on push** frequencies: [Scan images for software vulnerabilities in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html).

The SNS topic created in this step provides the notification destination that is connected to EventBridge in option B.

### B. Create an EventBridge rule for Amazon Inspector findings with the SNS topic as its target

Amazon Inspector emits an `Inspector2 Finding` event to EventBridge when an enhanced ECR image-scan finding is created, updated, or closed: [EventBridge events sent for enhanced scanning in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced-events.html).

An EventBridge rule can filter these findings—for example, to include only active HIGH and CRITICAL findings—and send them directly to an SNS topic. AWS specifically documents creating an EventBridge rule for Inspector findings and selecting an **SNS topic** as the target: [Creating custom responses to Amazon Inspector findings with Amazon EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-managing-automating-responses.html).

Together, A and B form a fully managed flow:

**ECR image → Inspector continuous enhanced scanning → EventBridge finding event → SNS notification → security team**

## Why the other options are incorrect

### C. Activate AWS Lambda enhanced scanning and use an SES topic

This combines invalid service concepts. ECR enhanced container-image scanning is powered by **Amazon Inspector**, not AWS Lambda. Additionally, Amazon SES does not provide “topics” equivalent to Amazon SNS topics. SES is an email delivery service, whereas SNS topics are suitable EventBridge notification targets.

### D. Create a Lambda function and invoke it when findings are detected

A Lambda function could implement custom processing, but it is unnecessary for simply notifying the security team. EventBridge can send matched Inspector findings directly to SNS. Adding Lambda introduces code, IAM permissions, deployment, error handling, monitoring, and maintenance, so it does not provide the **least operational overhead**.

### E. Activate default basic scanning and configure it for continuous scanning

ECR basic scanning does **not** support continuous scanning. It supports only manual scans and scan-on-push scans. AWS also notes that basic scanning is configured with manual scanning by default and can optionally use scan-on-push filters: [Configuring basic scanning for images in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html). Continuous scanning is an enhanced-scanning capability powered by Amazon Inspector.

zh.question: 一家公司的持续集成管道使用 AWS CodeBuild 创建容器镜像。创建的镜像存储在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 中。检查并修复镜像中的漏洞耗费了公司太多时间。公司希望快速识别镜像漏洞，并将这些漏洞通知安全团队。哪种步骤组合能够以最低的运维开销满足这些要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 为 Amazon ECR 启用 Amazon Inspector 增强扫描。将增强扫描配置为使用持续扫描。设置一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。
options.B: 为 Amazon Inspector 发现结果创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则。将 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题设置为该规则的目标。
options.C: 为 Amazon ECR 启用 AWS Lambda 增强扫描。将增强扫描配置为使用持续扫描。设置一个 Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) 主题。
options.D: 创建一个新的 AWS Lambda 函数。当检测到扫描发现结果时，调用新的 Lambda 函数。
options.E: 为所有容器镜像启用 Amazon ECR 的默认基本扫描。将默认基本扫描配置为使用持续扫描。设置一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

公司需要两项托管式能力，且自定义代码应尽可能少：

1. **持续识别 ECR 镜像中的漏洞**，包括镜像已推送后新披露的漏洞。
2. 当 Amazon Inspector 产生发现结果时，**自动通知安全团队**。

## 正确答案：A 和 B

### A. 为 Amazon ECR 启用 Amazon Inspector 增强扫描，使用持续扫描，并创建 SNS 主题

Amazon ECR **增强扫描**与 Amazon Inspector 集成，可针对操作系统和编程语言软件包提供自动化、持续的漏洞扫描。通过持续扫描，随着新的漏洞被发现，发现结果可以更新，而不是仅在镜像被推送时扫描镜像。随后，Amazon Inspector 会将发现结果事件发送到 EventBridge。这直接满足了以较低运维开销快速识别漏洞的需求。

AWS 文档说明，增强扫描支持 **推送时扫描和持续扫描**，而基本扫描仅支持 **手动扫描和推送时扫描**频率：[扫描 Amazon ECR 中镜像的软件漏洞](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning.html)。

此步骤中创建的 SNS 主题提供了通知目标，并会在选项 B 中连接到 EventBridge。

### B. 为 Amazon Inspector 发现结果创建 EventBridge 规则，并将 SNS 主题作为其目标

当创建、更新或关闭增强 ECR 镜像扫描发现结果时，Amazon Inspector 会向 EventBridge 发送 `Inspector2 Finding` 事件：[为 Amazon ECR 中的增强扫描发送的 EventBridge 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-enhanced-events.html)。

EventBridge 规则可以筛选这些发现结果——例如，仅包含处于活动状态的 HIGH 和 CRITICAL 发现结果——并将其直接发送到 SNS 主题。AWS 专门说明了如何为 Inspector 发现结果创建 EventBridge 规则，并选择 **SNS 主题**作为目标：[使用 Amazon EventBridge 为 Amazon Inspector 发现结果创建自定义响应](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/inspector/latest/user/findings-managing-automating-responses.html)。

A 和 B 共同构成完全托管的流程：

**ECR 镜像 → Inspector 持续增强扫描 → EventBridge 发现结果事件 → SNS 通知 → 安全团队**

## 其他选项错误的原因

### C. 启用 AWS Lambda 增强扫描并使用 SES 主题

该选项混合了无效的服务概念。ECR 增强容器镜像扫描由 **Amazon Inspector** 提供支持，而不是 AWS Lambda。此外，Amazon SES 不提供等同于 Amazon SNS 主题的“主题”。SES 是电子邮件传送服务，而 SNS 主题适合作为 EventBridge 通知目标。

### D. 创建 Lambda 函数，并在检测到发现结果时调用它

Lambda 函数可以实现自定义处理，但如果只是通知安全团队，则没有必要使用它。EventBridge 可以将匹配的 Inspector 发现结果直接发送到 SNS。添加 Lambda 会引入代码、IAM 权限、部署、错误处理、监控和维护工作，因此无法实现**最低运维开销**。

### E. 启用默认基本扫描并将其配置为持续扫描

ECR 基本扫描**不**支持持续扫描。它仅支持手动扫描和推送时扫描。AWS 还指出，基本扫描默认配置为手动扫描，也可以选择使用推送时扫描筛选器：[为 Amazon ECR 中的镜像配置基本扫描](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html)。持续扫描是由 Amazon Inspector 支持的增强扫描功能。

en.question: A DevOps administrator is configuring a repository to store a company's container images. The administrator needs to configure a lifecycle rule that automatically deletes container images that have a specific tag and that are older than 15 days. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Create a repository in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR). Add a lifecycle policy to the repository to expire images that have the matching tag after 15 days.
options.B: Create a repository in AWS CodeArtifact. Add a repository policy to the CodeArtifact repository to expire old assets that have the matching tag after 15 days.
options.C: Create a bucket in Amazon S3. Add a bucket lifecycle policy to expire old objects that have the matching tag after 15 days
options.D: Create an EC2 Image Builder container recipe. Add a build component to expire the container that has the matching tag after 15 days.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The administrator needs a purpose-built container image repository that can automatically delete images based on both:

1. A matching container image tag.
2. The image's age—more than 15 days since it was pushed.

The solution should require the least custom automation and ongoing operational effort.

## Correct answer: A

**Create an Amazon ECR repository and add an ECR lifecycle policy that expires matching tagged images after 15 days.**

Amazon ECR lifecycle policies natively automate image expiration. A rule can:

- Select tagged images by using `tagPatternList` or `tagPrefixList`.
- Use `countType: sinceImagePushed` with `countUnit: days` and `countNumber: 15`.
- Use the `expire` action to delete matching images.

AWS provides an almost identical documented example that expires images whose tags match `prod*` when they are older than a specified number of days. ECR evaluates the policy automatically and ordinarily expires qualifying images within 24 hours after they meet the criteria. Therefore, this is the most operationally efficient and service-native solution. See [Examples of lifecycle policies in Amazon ECR — Filtering on image age](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/lifecycle_policy_examples.html) and [Amazon ECR lifecycle policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/LifecyclePolicies.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. AWS CodeArtifact repository policy:** CodeArtifact is designed to store supported software package formats and their package-version assets, rather than container images. More importantly, a CodeArtifact repository policy is a resource-based **access-control policy** that defines who can access the repository and which actions they can perform; it is not a lifecycle policy that expires assets by tag and age. See [AWS CodeArtifact concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/codeartifact-concepts.html) and [CodeArtifact repository policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html).

- **C. Amazon S3 bucket lifecycle policy:** S3 Lifecycle can expire S3 **objects** and can filter objects by S3 object tags. However, S3 is not the purpose-built managed container registry requested by the scenario, and an S3 object tag is not an ECR container image tag. Using S3 would require the company to implement and operate container-registry behavior separately, making it less operationally efficient than ECR. See [Adding filters to S3 Lifecycle rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intro-lifecycle-filters.html).

- **D. EC2 Image Builder container recipe:** A container recipe defines the base image and components used to build an output container image. Build components define customization steps performed during image creation; they are not repository retention controls that continuously identify and delete old tagged images. Retention should be implemented on the target ECR repository by using an ECR lifecycle policy. See [EC2 Image Builder concepts](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/what-is-image-builder.html).

Therefore, **A** is the only option that directly and natively satisfies both the container-image tag and age-based deletion requirements with minimal operational overhead.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 管理员正在配置一个存储公司容器镜像的存储库。该管理员需要配置一条生命周期规则，以自动删除具有特定标签且超过 15 天的容器镜像。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 中创建一个存储库。向该存储库添加生命周期策略，以在具有匹配标签的镜像超过 15 天后使其过期。
options.B: 在 AWS CodeArtifact 中创建一个存储库。向 CodeArtifact 存储库添加存储库策略，以在具有匹配标签的旧资产超过 15 天后使其过期。
options.C: 在 Amazon S3 中创建一个存储桶。添加存储桶生命周期策略，以在具有匹配标签的旧对象超过 15 天后使其过期
options.D: 创建一个 EC2 Image Builder 容器配方。添加一个构建组件，以在具有匹配标签的容器超过 15 天后使其过期。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

管理员需要一个专为容器镜像设计的存储库，该存储库可以根据以下两个条件自动删除镜像：

1. 匹配的容器镜像标签。
2. 镜像的年龄——自推送以来超过 15 天。

该解决方案应需要最少的自定义自动化和持续运营工作。

## 正确答案：A

**创建一个 Amazon ECR 存储库，并添加一条 ECR 生命周期策略，以在具有匹配标签的镜像超过 15 天后使其过期。**

Amazon ECR 生命周期策略可以原生自动执行镜像过期处理。规则可以：

- 使用 `tagPatternList` 或 `tagPrefixList` 选择带标签的镜像。
- 使用 `countType: sinceImagePushed`、`countUnit: days` 和 `countNumber: 15`。
- 使用 `expire` 操作删除匹配的镜像。

AWS 提供了一个几乎完全相同的文档示例：当镜像标签匹配 `prod*` 且其年龄超过指定天数时，使该镜像过期。ECR 会自动评估该策略，并且通常会在符合条件的镜像满足条件后的 24 小时内将其过期。因此，这是运营效率最高且服务原生的解决方案。请参阅 [Amazon ECR 中的生命周期策略示例 — 按镜像年龄筛选](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/lifecycle_policy_examples.html) 和 [Amazon ECR 生命周期策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/LifecyclePolicies.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **B. AWS CodeArtifact 存储库策略：**CodeArtifact 旨在存储受支持的软件包格式及其软件包版本资产，而不是容器镜像。更重要的是，CodeArtifact 存储库策略是一种基于资源的**访问控制策略**，用于定义谁可以访问存储库以及他们可以执行哪些操作；它不是一种可根据标签和年龄使资产过期的生命周期策略。请参阅 [AWS CodeArtifact 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/codeartifact-concepts.html) 和 [CodeArtifact 存储库策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-policies.html)。

- **C. Amazon S3 存储桶生命周期策略：**S3 Lifecycle 可以使 S3 **对象**过期，并且可以按 S3 对象标签筛选对象。但是，S3 并不是该场景所要求的专用托管容器注册表，并且 S3 对象标签不是 ECR 容器镜像标签。使用 S3 将要求公司单独实施和运营容器注册表功能，因此其运营效率低于 ECR。请参阅 [向 S3 Lifecycle 规则添加筛选器](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/intro-lifecycle-filters.html)。

- **D. EC2 Image Builder 容器配方：**容器配方定义用于构建输出容器镜像的基础镜像和组件。构建组件定义在镜像创建期间执行的自定义步骤；它们不是可持续识别并删除旧的带标签镜像的存储库保留控制机制。应在目标 ECR 存储库中使用 ECR 生命周期策略实施保留策略。请参阅 [EC2 Image Builder 概念](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/imagebuilder/latest/userguide/what-is-image-builder.html)。

因此，**A** 是唯一能够以最少运营开销直接且原生地同时满足容器镜像标签和基于年龄的删除要求的选项。

en.question: A company uses Amazon Redshift as its data warehouse solution. The company wants to create a dashboard to view changes to the Redshift users and the queries the users perform. Which combination of steps will meet this requirement? (Choose two.)

options.A: Create an Amazon CloudWatch log group. Create an AWS CloudTrail trail that writes to the CloudWatch log group.
options.B: Create a new Amazon S3 bucket. Configure default audit logging on the Redshift cluster. Configure the S3 bucket as the target.
options.C: Configure the Redshift cluster database audit logging to include user activity logs. Configure Amazon CloudWatch as the target.
options.D: Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that has a log widget. Configure the widget to display user details from the Redshift logs.
options.E: Create an AWS Lambda function that uses Amazon Athena to query the Redshift logs. Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that has a custom widget type that uses the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The dashboard must show two different categories of Amazon Redshift database activity:

1. **Changes to database users** — captured by the Redshift **user log**.
2. **SQL queries performed by users** — captured by the Redshift **user activity log**.

AWS documents that the user log records user creation, deletion, alteration, and renaming, while the user activity log records each query before it runs. Redshift can export these audit logs directly to CloudWatch Logs. However, query logging additionally requires the `enable_user_activity_logging` database parameter because it is disabled by default. See [Amazon Redshift database audit logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/db-auditing.html).

## Correct answers: C and D

### C. Configure the Redshift cluster database audit logging to include user activity logs. Configure Amazon CloudWatch as the target.

This captures both required data sets:

- The **user log** records changes to database user definitions.
- The **user activity log** records the SQL queries that users and the system perform.

Exporting the audit logs to CloudWatch places the connection, user, and user-activity data into CloudWatch Logs log groups. Enabling the user activity log is essential because merely turning on audit logging without `enable_user_activity_logging=true` captures the connection and user logs but not the query activity log. See [Amazon Redshift database audit logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/db-auditing.html).

### D. Create an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard that has a log widget. Configure the widget to display user details from the Redshift logs.

After the Redshift audit logs are exported to CloudWatch Logs, CloudWatch Logs Insights can query the user and user-activity log groups. The query results can be added directly to a CloudWatch dashboard as a log widget, and the query reruns whenever the dashboard loads or refreshes. See [Add query results to a CloudWatch dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_ExportQueryResults.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Create a CloudWatch log group and a CloudTrail trail that writes to it.

CloudTrail records AWS API activity for Amazon Redshift, such as Redshift control-plane, Data API, data-sharing, and Query Editor v2 actions. It is not the Redshift database audit mechanism that comprehensively records SQL statements submitted through ordinary database connections or database-user definition changes. Redshift database audit logs are required for this use case. See [Logging Amazon Redshift activity with CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/logging-with-cloudtrail.html).

### B. Configure default audit logging to an S3 bucket.

This is incomplete for the query requirement. Redshift audit logging alone captures the connection and user logs, but the **user activity log is disabled by default** and requires the additional `enable_user_activity_logging` parameter. Therefore, the stated “default audit logging” configuration does not ensure that users' queries are recorded. It also introduces an S3/Athena processing path when Redshift can export the required logs directly to CloudWatch. See [Amazon Redshift database audit logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/db-auditing.html).

### E. Use Lambda and Athena with a CloudWatch custom widget.

This architecture assumes that complete Redshift logs are available in S3 and introduces Lambda, Athena, and custom-widget processing. Paired with option B, it would still lack query records because B does not explicitly enable the user activity log. More importantly, this custom solution is unnecessary: Redshift can export the required audit logs directly to CloudWatch Logs, and CloudWatch can add Logs Insights results directly to a dashboard without Lambda or Athena.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 Amazon Redshift 作为其数据仓库解决方案。该公司希望创建一个控制面板，用于查看 Redshift 用户的变更以及这些用户执行的查询。哪种步骤组合可以满足此要求？（选择两项。）

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch 日志组。创建一个 AWS CloudTrail 跟踪，将日志写入该 CloudWatch 日志组。
options.B: 创建一个新的 Amazon S3 存储桶。在 Redshift 集群上配置默认审计日志记录。将该 S3 存储桶配置为目标位置。
options.C: 配置 Redshift 集群数据库审计日志记录以包含用户活动日志。将 Amazon CloudWatch 配置为目标位置。
options.D: 创建一个包含日志小组件的 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板。配置该小组件以显示 Redshift 日志中的用户详细信息。
options.E: 创建一个使用 Amazon Athena 查询 Redshift 日志的 AWS Lambda 函数。创建一个包含使用该 Lambda 函数的自定义小组件类型的 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该控制面板必须显示两类不同的 Amazon Redshift 数据库活动：

1. **数据库用户的变更** — 由 Redshift 的 **用户日志** 捕获。
2. **用户执行的 SQL 查询** — 由 Redshift 的 **用户活动日志** 捕获。

AWS 文档说明，用户日志记录用户的创建、删除、更改和重命名，而用户活动日志会在每个查询运行之前记录该查询。Redshift 可以将这些审计日志直接导出到 CloudWatch Logs。但是，查询日志记录还需要 `enable_user_activity_logging` 数据库参数，因为该参数默认处于禁用状态。请参阅 [Amazon Redshift database audit logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/db-auditing.html)。

## 正确答案：C 和 D

### C. 配置 Redshift 集群数据库审计日志记录以包含用户活动日志。将 Amazon CloudWatch 配置为目标位置。

这会捕获所需的两类数据：

- **用户日志** 会记录数据库用户定义的变更。
- **用户活动日志** 会记录用户和系统执行的 SQL 查询。

将审计日志导出到 CloudWatch 后，连接、用户和用户活动数据将被放入 CloudWatch Logs 日志组。启用用户活动日志至关重要，因为仅启用审计日志记录而不设置 `enable_user_activity_logging=true`，会捕获连接和用户日志，但不会捕获查询活动日志。请参阅 [Amazon Redshift database audit logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/db-auditing.html)。

### D. 创建一个包含日志小组件的 Amazon CloudWatch 控制面板。配置该小组件以显示 Redshift 日志中的用户详细信息。

在将 Redshift 审计日志导出到 CloudWatch Logs 后，CloudWatch Logs Insights 可以查询用户和用户活动日志组。查询结果可以作为日志小组件直接添加到 CloudWatch 控制面板中，并且每当控制面板加载或刷新时都会重新运行查询。请参阅 [Add query results to a CloudWatch dashboard](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CWL_ExportQueryResults.html)。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

### A. 创建 CloudWatch 日志组以及将日志写入该日志组的 CloudTrail 跟踪。

CloudTrail 会记录 Amazon Redshift 的 AWS API 活动，例如 Redshift 控制平面、Data API、数据共享和 Query Editor v2 操作。它不是能够全面记录通过常规数据库连接提交的 SQL 语句或数据库用户定义变更的 Redshift 数据库审计机制。此用例需要 Redshift 数据库审计日志。请参阅 [Logging Amazon Redshift activity with CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/logging-with-cloudtrail.html)。

### B. 将默认审计日志记录配置到 S3 存储桶。

对于查询需求而言，这并不完整。仅 Redshift 审计日志记录会捕获连接和用户日志，但**用户活动日志默认处于禁用状态**，需要额外的 `enable_user_activity_logging` 参数。因此，所述的“默认审计日志记录”配置无法确保记录用户查询。它还引入了 S3/Athena 处理路径，而 Redshift 可以直接将所需日志导出到 CloudWatch。请参阅 [Amazon Redshift database audit logging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/mgmt/db-auditing.html)。

### E. 将 Lambda 和 Athena 与 CloudWatch 自定义小组件结合使用。

该架构假定完整的 Redshift 日志可在 S3 中获取，并引入了 Lambda、Athena 和自定义小组件处理。即使与选项 B 配对使用，它仍会缺少查询记录，因为 B 未明确启用用户活动日志。更重要的是，此自定义解决方案没有必要：Redshift 可以将所需审计日志直接导出到 CloudWatch Logs，而 CloudWatch 可以直接将 Logs Insights 结果添加到控制面板中，无需 Lambda 或 Athena。

en.question: A company uses an organization in AWS Organizations to manage its 500 AWS accounts. The organization has all features enabled. The AWS accounts are in a single OU. The developers need to use the CostCenter tag key for all resources in the organization's member accounts. Some teams do not use the CostCenter tag key to tag their Amazon EC2 instances. The cloud team wrote a script that scans all EC2 instances in the organization's member accounts. If the EC2 instances do not have a CostCenter tag key, the script will notify AWS account administrators. To avoid this notification, some developers use the CostCenter tag key with an arbitrary string in the tag value. The cloud team needs to ensure that all EC2 instances in the organization use a CostCenter tag key with the appropriate cost center value. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an SCP that prevents the creation of EC2 instances without the CostCenter tag key. Create a tag policy that requires the CostCenter tag to be values from a known list of cost centers for all EC2 instances. Attach the policy to the OU. Update the script to scan the tag keys and tag values. Modify the script to update noncompliant resources with a default approved tag value for the CostCenter tag key.
options.B: Create an SCP that prevents the creation of EC2 instances without the CostCenter tag key. Attach the policy to the OU. Update the script to scan the tag keys and tag values and notify the administrators when the tag values are not valid.
options.C: Create an SCP that prevents the creation of EC2 instances without the CostCenter tag key. Attach the policy to the OU. Create an IAM permission boundary in the organization's member accounts that restricts the CostCenter tag values to a list of valid cost centers.
options.D: Create a tag policy that requires the CostCenter tag to be values from a known list of cost centers for all EC2 instances. Attach the policy to the OU. Configure an AWS Lambda function that adds an empty CostCenter tag key to an EC2 instance. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that matches events to the RunInstances API action with the Lambda function as the target.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs both **preventive** and **corrective** controls across an OU:

1. New EC2 instances must not be created without the `CostCenter` tag key.
2. Developers must not be able to use arbitrary `CostCenter` values.
3. Existing noncompliant EC2 instances must be detected and remediated.

## Correct answer: A

**A** combines the controls needed for all three requirements:

- The **SCP** denies EC2 instance creation when the request does not contain the required `CostCenter` tag. This is necessary because AWS explicitly states that basic tag-policy compliance rules do **not** enforce missing tag keys and recommends SCPs to prevent resource creation when specified tags are absent. See [Enforce tagging consistency](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-enforcement.html) and [Tag policy best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-best-practices.html).
- The **tag policy**, attached to the OU and configured for enforcement on EC2 resources, defines the allowed `CostCenter` values. AWS documents that tag policies can prevent EC2 create operations when a supplied `CostCenter` value is not in the approved list. Tag policies are available in organizations with all features enabled, which the scenario explicitly confirms. See [Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html).
- The updated script handles **existing resources**. Tag policies standardize and optionally block noncompliant tagging operations, but they do not automatically rewrite existing tags. AWS states that noncompliant tags can be corrected through the service, Tag Editor, or the Resource Groups Tagging API. Updating the script to scan tag keys and values and remediate noncompliant instances therefore closes the existing-resource gap.

Thus, the SCP enforces tag presence, the tag policy enforces approved values, and the script detects and corrects resources that already exist.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

The SCP prevents creation without the tag key, but there is no preventive control for the **tag value**. Developers could continue supplying arbitrary strings and merely trigger notifications. Notification alone does not ensure that every EC2 instance uses an approved cost center value.

### C

An IAM permissions boundary limits the maximum permissions of the particular IAM user or role to which it is attached; it is not automatically an organization-wide control over every principal. AWS recommends SCPs for permissions guardrails across multiple accounts, while permissions boundaries are primarily used to delegate permissions management within an individual account. See [Permissions boundaries for IAM entities](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html). This option also does not address existing EC2 instances with invalid values.

### D

This fails for several reasons:

- Basic tag-policy enforcement evaluates tags when they are supplied but does not prevent creation of an otherwise untagged resource.
- The EventBridge/Lambda process is reactive and runs only after the `RunInstances` event rather than preventing noncompliant creation.
- Adding an empty `CostCenter` value does not assign the appropriate approved cost center. AWS treats an omitted tag value as an empty string, so this would not satisfy a policy that allows only known cost center values. See [Tag policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html).

Therefore, **A** is the only option that combines required-key enforcement, allowed-value enforcement, and remediation of existing noncompliant EC2 instances.

zh.question: 某公司使用 AWS Organizations 中的一个组织来管理其 500 个 AWS 账户。该组织已启用所有功能。AWS 账户位于一个 OU 中。开发人员需要对组织成员账户中的所有资源使用 `CostCenter` 标签键。一些团队未使用 `CostCenter` 标签键来标记其 Amazon EC2 实例。云团队编写了一个脚本，用于扫描组织成员账户中的所有 EC2 实例。如果 EC2 实例没有 `CostCenter` 标签键，该脚本将通知 AWS 账户管理员。为了避免此通知，一些开发人员使用 `CostCenter` 标签键，但在标签值中填写任意字符串。云团队需要确保组织中的所有 EC2 实例均使用 `CostCenter` 标签键，并且具有适当的成本中心值。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 SCP，以阻止在未使用 `CostCenter` 标签键的情况下创建 EC2 实例。创建一个标签策略，要求所有 EC2 实例的 `CostCenter` 标签值必须来自已知成本中心列表。将该策略附加到 OU。更新脚本以扫描标签键和标签值。修改脚本，为不合规资源的 `CostCenter` 标签键更新为默认的已批准标签值。
options.B: 创建一个 SCP，以阻止在未使用 `CostCenter` 标签键的情况下创建 EC2 实例。将该策略附加到 OU。更新脚本以扫描标签键和标签值，并在标签值无效时通知管理员。
options.C: 创建一个 SCP，以阻止在未使用 `CostCenter` 标签键的情况下创建 EC2 实例。将该策略附加到 OU。在组织的成员账户中创建 IAM permissions boundary，将 `CostCenter` 标签值限制为有效成本中心列表。
options.D: 创建一个标签策略，要求所有 EC2 实例的 `CostCenter` 标签值必须来自已知成本中心列表。将该策略附加到 OU。配置一个 AWS Lambda 函数，为 EC2 实例添加一个空的 `CostCenter` 标签键。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，用于匹配 `RunInstances` API 操作事件，并将 Lambda 函数作为目标。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

该公司需要在一个 OU 中同时实施**预防性**和**纠正性**控制：

1. 不得在未使用 `CostCenter` 标签键的情况下创建新的 EC2 实例。
2. 开发人员不得使用任意的 `CostCenter` 值。
3. 必须检测并修复现有的不合规 EC2 实例。

## 正确答案：A

**A** 结合了满足全部三个要求所需的控制措施：

- **SCP** 会在请求未包含所需 `CostCenter` 标签时拒绝创建 EC2 实例。这是必要的，因为 AWS 明确指出，基本的标签策略合规规则**不会**强制要求必须存在标签键，并建议使用 SCP 来阻止在缺少指定标签时创建资源。请参阅 [强制执行标签一致性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-enforcement.html) 和 [标签策略最佳实践](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies-best-practices.html)。
- 附加到 OU 并配置为对 EC2 资源强制执行的**标签策略**，定义允许的 `CostCenter` 值。AWS 文档说明，当提供的 `CostCenter` 值不在已批准列表中时，标签策略可以阻止 EC2 创建操作。标签策略可用于已启用所有功能的组织，而题目明确确认了这一点。请参阅 [标签策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)。
- 更新后的脚本可处理**现有资源**。标签策略能够标准化标签，并可选择阻止不合规的标签操作，但不会自动重写现有标签。AWS 指出，可以通过相应服务、Tag Editor 或 Resource Groups Tagging API 修正不合规标签。因此，更新脚本以扫描标签键和值并修复不合规实例，便填补了现有资源的管理缺口。

因此，SCP 强制要求标签存在，标签策略强制要求使用已批准的值，而脚本可检测并修复已存在的资源。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B

SCP 可阻止在没有标签键的情况下创建资源，但没有对**标签值**实施预防性控制。开发人员仍可以继续提供任意字符串，而仅触发通知。仅靠通知无法确保每个 EC2 实例都使用已批准的成本中心值。

### C

IAM permissions boundary 限制的是附加该边界的特定 IAM 用户或角色所能拥有的最大权限；它不会自动成为覆盖每个主体的组织级控制措施。AWS 建议使用 SCP 作为跨多个账户的权限护栏，而 permissions boundary 主要用于在单个账户内委派权限管理。请参阅 [IAM 实体的 permissions boundary](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access_policies_boundaries.html)。此外，此选项也没有处理具有无效值的现有 EC2 实例。

### D

此选项存在以下多个问题：

- 基本标签策略强制执行会在提供标签时评估标签，但不会阻止创建一个完全未标记的资源。
- EventBridge/Lambda 流程是响应式的，仅会在 `RunInstances` 事件发生后运行，而不是阻止不合规资源的创建。
- 添加空的 `CostCenter` 值并不会分配适当且已批准的成本中心。AWS 将省略的标签值视为空字符串，因此这无法满足仅允许已知成本中心值的策略。请参阅 [标签策略](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_tag-policies.html)。

因此，只有 **A** 同时结合了必需键强制执行、允许值强制执行，以及对现有不合规 EC2 实例的修复。

en.question: A DevOps engineer uses a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. The pipeline has a build action and a deploy action for a single-page web application that is delivered to an Amazon S3 bucket. Amazon CloudFront serves the web application. The build action creates an artifact for the web application. The DevOps engineer has created an AWS CloudFormation template that defines the S3 bucket and configures the S3 bucket to host the application. The DevOps engineer has configured a CloudFormation deploy action before the S3 action. The CloudFormation deploy action creates the S3 bucket. The DevOps engineer needs to configure the S3 deploy action to use the S3 bucket from the CloudFormation template. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)

options.A: Add an output named BucketName to the CloudFormation template. Set the output's value to refer to the S3 bucket from the CloudFormation template. Configure the output value to export to an AWS::SSM::Parameter resource named Stackvariables.
options.B: Add an output named BucketName to the CloudFormation template. Set the output's value to refer to the S3 bucket from the CloudFormation template. Set the CloudFormation action's namespace to StackVariables in the pipeline.
options.C: Configure the output artifacts of the CloudFormation action in the pipeline to be an AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store parameter named StackVariables. Name the artifact BucketName.
options.D: Configure the build artifact from the build action as the input to the CodePipeline S3 deploy action. Configure the deploy action to deploy to the S3 bucket by using the StackVariables.BucketName variable.
options.E: Configure the build artifact from the build action and the AWS Systems Manager parameter as the inputs to the deploy action. Configure the deploy action to deploy to the S3 bucket by using the StackVariables.BucketName variable.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The CloudFormation deploy action creates the website bucket, while the later S3 deploy action must upload the single-page application's **build artifact** to that dynamically created bucket. Therefore, the pipeline needs to expose the CloudFormation stack output as a CodePipeline variable and then consume that variable in the S3 action's `BucketName` configuration.

## Correct answers: B and D

### B. Define `BucketName` as a CloudFormation output and assign the action namespace `StackVariables`

A CloudFormation deployment action can produce CodePipeline output variables from values in the template's `Outputs` section. The action must have a namespace for downstream actions to reference those variables. Thus, defining an output such as `BucketName` whose value references the `AWS::S3::Bucket`, and setting the CloudFormation action namespace to `StackVariables`, exposes the output as a downstream variable such as `#{StackVariables.BucketName}`.

AWS documents that CloudFormation action variables come from the stack template's `Outputs` section and require an action namespace to be available downstream: [CloudFormation action output variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CloudFormation.html).

### D. Use the build artifact as the S3 action input and use `StackVariables.BucketName` for the destination

The S3 deploy action must receive the web application's build artifact because that artifact contains the files to upload. Its required `BucketName` configuration can reference the CloudFormation output variable, represented in full CodePipeline syntax as `#{StackVariables.BucketName}`.

AWS specifies that an S3 deploy action takes exactly one input artifact containing the deployment files and requires the `BucketName` parameter: [Amazon S3 deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-S3Deploy.html). AWS also documents that downstream action fields can consume variables using the `#{namespace.variable}` syntax: [Configure actions for variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-variables.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A — Incorrect.** A CloudFormation output `Export` is not a mechanism for writing the value to an `AWS::SSM::Parameter` resource. More importantly, no Parameter Store intermediary is needed: the CloudFormation action can expose stack outputs directly as CodePipeline variables through its namespace.

- **C — Incorrect.** A CloudFormation action's output artifact is a CodePipeline artifact containing a JSON file of stack outputs when `OutputFileName` is configured; it cannot be configured as an SSM Parameter Store parameter. For this use case, `BucketName` should be an output **variable**, not an artifact named `BucketName`. See [CloudFormation action output artifacts and variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CloudFormation.html).

- **E — Incorrect.** An S3 deploy action accepts exactly **one** input artifact—the files to deploy. A Parameter Store parameter is neither a CodePipeline input artifact nor necessary here. The destination bucket is supplied through the S3 action's configuration by referencing the namespaced CloudFormation variable, while the build artifact remains the sole input artifact.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师在 AWS CodePipeline 中使用一个管道。该管道包含一个构建操作和一个部署操作，用于将单页 Web 应用程序交付到 Amazon S3 存储桶。Amazon CloudFront 为该 Web 应用程序提供服务。构建操作会为该 Web 应用程序创建一个构件。该 DevOps 工程师已创建一个 AWS CloudFormation 模板，用于定义 S3 存储桶并将该 S3 存储桶配置为托管该应用程序。该 DevOps 工程师已在 S3 操作之前配置了一个 CloudFormation 部署操作。CloudFormation 部署操作会创建 S3 存储桶。该 DevOps 工程师需要将 S3 部署操作配置为使用 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3 存储桶。哪种步骤组合可以满足这些要求？（选择两个。）

options.A: 向 CloudFormation 模板添加一个名为 BucketName 的输出。将该输出的值设置为引用 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3 存储桶。将该输出值配置为导出到名为 Stackvariables 的 AWS::SSM::Parameter 资源。
options.B: 向 CloudFormation 模板添加一个名为 BucketName 的输出。将该输出的值设置为引用 CloudFormation 模板中的 S3 存储桶。在管道中将 CloudFormation 操作的命名空间设置为 StackVariables。
options.C: 将管道中 CloudFormation 操作的输出构件配置为名为 StackVariables 的 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 参数。将该构件命名为 BucketName。
options.D: 将构建操作产生的构建构件配置为 CodePipeline S3 部署操作的输入。将部署操作配置为使用 StackVariables.BucketName 变量部署到 S3 存储桶。
options.E: 将构建操作产生的构建构件和 AWS Systems Manager 参数配置为部署操作的输入。将部署操作配置为使用 StackVariables.BucketName 变量部署到 S3 存储桶。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

CloudFormation 部署操作会创建网站存储桶，而后续的 S3 部署操作必须将单页应用程序的**构建构件**上传到这个动态创建的存储桶。因此，管道需要将 CloudFormation 堆栈输出公开为 CodePipeline 变量，然后在 S3 操作的 `BucketName` 配置中使用该变量。

## 正确答案：B 和 D

### B. 将 `BucketName` 定义为 CloudFormation 输出，并分配操作命名空间 `StackVariables`

CloudFormation 部署操作可通过模板 `Outputs` 部分中的值生成 CodePipeline 输出变量。该操作必须具有命名空间，下游操作才能引用这些变量。因此，定义一个输出（例如 `BucketName`），使其值引用 `AWS::S3::Bucket`，并将 CloudFormation 操作命名空间设置为 `StackVariables`，即可将该输出作为下游变量公开，例如 `#{StackVariables.BucketName}`。

AWS 文档说明，CloudFormation 操作变量来自堆栈模板的 `Outputs` 部分，并且需要操作命名空间才能在下游使用：[CloudFormation action output variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CloudFormation.html)。

### D. 使用构建构件作为 S3 操作输入，并将 `StackVariables.BucketName` 用作目标位置

S3 部署操作必须接收 Web 应用程序的构建构件，因为该构件包含要上传的文件。其必需的 `BucketName` 配置可以引用 CloudFormation 输出变量，完整的 CodePipeline 语法表示为 `#{StackVariables.BucketName}`。

AWS 指出，S3 部署操作恰好接收一个包含部署文件的输入构件，并要求提供 `BucketName` 参数：[Amazon S3 deploy action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-S3Deploy.html)。AWS 还说明，下游操作字段可使用 `#{namespace.variable}` 语法来使用变量：[Configure actions for variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-variables.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **A — 不正确。** CloudFormation 输出 `Export` 不是将值写入 `AWS::SSM::Parameter` 资源的机制。更重要的是，不需要 Parameter Store 中介：CloudFormation 操作可以通过其命名空间直接将堆栈输出公开为 CodePipeline 变量。

- **C — 不正确。** 当配置 `OutputFileName` 时，CloudFormation 操作的输出构件是一个包含堆栈输出 JSON 文件的 CodePipeline 构件；不能将其配置为 SSM Parameter Store 参数。对于此用例，`BucketName` 应是输出**变量**，而不是名为 `BucketName` 的构件。请参阅 [CloudFormation action output artifacts and variables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CloudFormation.html)。

- **E — 不正确。** S3 部署操作恰好接受**一个**输入构件，即要部署的文件。Parameter Store 参数既不是 CodePipeline 输入构件，在这里也没有必要。目标存储桶通过在 S3 操作配置中引用带命名空间的 CloudFormation 变量提供，而构建构件仍是唯一的输入构件。

en.question: A company used a lift and shift strategy to migrate a workload to AWS. The company has an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances. Each EC2 instance runs a web application, a database, and a Redis cache. Users are experiencing large variations in the web application's response times. Requests to the web application go to a single EC2 instance that is under significant load. The company wants to separate the application components to improve availability and performance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create a Network Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group for the web application. Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Create an Application Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group for the Redis cache.
options.B: Create an Application Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group for the web application. Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora database that has a Multi-AZ deployment. Create a Network Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone for the Redis cache.
options.C: Create a Network Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group for the web application. Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora Serverless database. Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster for the cache. Create a target group that has a DNS target type that contains the ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster hostname.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group for the web application. Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora database that has a Multi-AZ deployment. Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster for the cache.

en.explanation:
## Scenario analysis

The lift-and-shift deployment has placed the web server, relational database, and Redis cache on each EC2 instance. Despite having an Auto Scaling group, requests are reaching one heavily loaded instance, and the stateful database/cache components remain coupled to the web tier. The solution must therefore:

1. Distribute HTTP/HTTPS traffic across a scalable web tier.
2. Move the relational database to a highly available managed database service.
3. Move Redis to a purpose-built managed cache with availability and failover capabilities.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an Application Load Balancer and an Auto Scaling group for the web application. Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora database that has a Multi-AZ deployment. Create an Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) cluster for the cache.**

- An **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** is appropriate for the web tier because it operates at the application layer for HTTP/HTTPS traffic. When integrated with an Auto Scaling group, it distributes requests among the registered EC2 targets rather than sending traffic to one overloaded instance. AWS explicitly distinguishes ALBs as Layer 7 HTTP/HTTPS load balancers, whereas Network Load Balancers operate at Layer 4 for TCP/UDP traffic. See [Elastic Load Balancing types for EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html).
- An **Aurora Multi-AZ architecture** separates the database from the application instances and improves resilience. Aurora synchronously stores data across multiple Availability Zones, and a cluster with Aurora Replicas can automatically promote a replica if the writer fails. AWS recommends placing the writer and readers in multiple AZs to improve availability. See [Fault tolerance for an Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html).
- **Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS** separates caching from EC2 and provides a purpose-built managed Redis service. With replicas and Multi-AZ enabled, ElastiCache can automatically promote a replica after a primary failure, typically allowing writes to resume within seconds. See [ElastiCache automatic failover and Multi-AZ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html).

Together, these components remove the single-instance bottleneck, independently scale the web tier, and improve availability for both the database and cache tiers.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A

- A **Network Load Balancer** can technically forward web traffic, but it operates at Layer 4 and does not provide the HTTP/HTTPS-aware Layer 7 capabilities of an ALB. An ALB is the more appropriate choice for a conventional web application.
- More importantly, placing an **Application Load Balancer in front of Redis instances** is inappropriate. ALBs route application-layer HTTP/HTTPS traffic, while Redis uses its own TCP-based protocol.
- Running Redis in another Auto Scaling group also leaves the company responsible for Redis clustering, replication, failover, persistence, and state-aware scaling. ElastiCache is the purpose-built managed option.
- Merely selecting Aurora Serverless does not, by itself, state the replica and cross-AZ instance configuration required for database failover.

### B

- The ALB and Aurora portions are reasonable.
- However, the Redis tier remains **self-managed on EC2** and is explicitly placed in a **single Availability Zone**. This creates an AZ-level failure domain and does not satisfy the availability requirement.
- A Network Load Balancer distributes TCP connections, but it does not create Redis replication, coordinate primary election, or provide Redis-aware automatic failover. ElastiCache with replicas and Multi-AZ provides those capabilities.

### C

- The Network Load Balancer is less suitable than an ALB for the HTTP/HTTPS web tier because it operates at Layer 4 rather than Layer 7.
- The proposed target group with a **DNS target type** is invalid. Network Load Balancer target groups support `instance`, `ip`, or `alb` target types—not DNS hostnames. Therefore, an ElastiCache hostname cannot be registered as a DNS-type target. See [Network Load Balancer target types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html).
- The application should connect directly to the appropriate ElastiCache endpoint; ElastiCache does not need an Elastic Load Balancing target group in front of it.
- As in option A, Aurora Serverless alone does not explicitly provide the required cross-AZ reader/failover configuration.

Therefore, **D** is the only option that correctly separates all three tiers using the appropriate AWS managed and load-balancing services.

zh.question: 一家公司采用提升和迁移策略将一个工作负载迁移到 AWS。该公司有一个由 Amazon EC2 实例组成的 Auto Scaling 组。每个 EC2 实例都运行一个 Web 应用程序、一个数据库和一个 Redis 缓存。用户发现该 Web 应用程序的响应时间存在较大波动。发往 Web 应用程序的请求会到达一个负载很高的单一 EC2 实例。该公司希望分离应用程序组件，以提高可用性和性能。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 为 Web 应用程序创建一个 Network Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless 数据库。为 Redis 缓存创建一个 Application Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。
options.B: 为 Web 应用程序创建一个 Application Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到具有 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon Aurora 数据库。为 Redis 缓存在单个 Availability Zone 中创建一个 Network Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。
options.C: 为 Web 应用程序创建一个 Network Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Serverless 数据库。为缓存创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 集群。创建一个目标组，该目标组具有包含 ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 集群主机名的 DNS 目标类型。
options.D: 为 Web 应用程序创建一个 Application Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到具有 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon Aurora 数据库。为缓存创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 集群。

zh.explanation:
## 场景分析

提升和迁移部署将 Web 服务器、关系数据库和 Redis 缓存都放置在每个 EC2 实例上。尽管存在 Auto Scaling 组，请求仍会到达一个负载很高的实例，并且有状态的数据库/缓存组件仍与 Web 层耦合。因此，解决方案必须：

1. 将 HTTP/HTTPS 流量分配到可扩展的 Web 层。
2. 将关系数据库迁移到高可用的托管数据库服务。
3. 将 Redis 迁移到专门构建的托管缓存服务，该服务具有可用性和故障转移能力。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 为 Web 应用程序创建一个 Application Load Balancer 和一个 Auto Scaling 组。将数据库迁移到具有 Multi-AZ 部署的 Amazon Aurora 数据库。为缓存创建一个 Amazon ElastiCache (Redis OSS) 集群。**

- **Application Load Balancer (ALB)** 适用于 Web 层，因为它在应用程序层处理 HTTP/HTTPS 流量。与 Auto Scaling 组集成后，它会在已注册的 EC2 目标之间分配请求，而不是将流量发送到一个过载实例。AWS 明确区分了作为第 7 层 HTTP/HTTPS 负载均衡器的 ALB，以及在第 4 层处理 TCP/UDP 流量的 Network Load Balancer。参阅 [Elastic Load Balancing types for EC2 Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/autoscaling-load-balancer.html)。
- **Aurora Multi-AZ 架构**将数据库与应用程序实例分离，并提高了弹性。Aurora 会跨多个 Availability Zone 同步存储数据，如果写入节点发生故障，具有 Aurora Replicas 的集群可以自动提升一个副本。AWS 建议将写入节点和读取节点放置在多个 AZ 中以提高可用性。参阅 [Fault tolerance for an Aurora DB cluster](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)。
- **Amazon ElastiCache for Redis OSS** 将缓存与 EC2 分离，并提供专门构建的托管 Redis 服务。启用副本和 Multi-AZ 后，ElastiCache 可以在主节点故障后自动提升副本，通常可在数秒内恢复写入。参阅 [ElastiCache automatic failover and Multi-AZ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonElastiCache/latest/dg/AutoFailover.html)。

这些组件共同消除了单实例瓶颈，使 Web 层能够独立扩展，并提高数据库层和缓存层的可用性。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A

- **Network Load Balancer** 在技术上可以转发 Web 流量，但它工作在第 4 层，不提供 ALB 针对 HTTP/HTTPS 的第 7 层感知能力。对于常规 Web 应用程序，ALB 是更合适的选择。
- 更重要的是，将 **Application Load Balancer 放在 Redis 实例前面**是不合适的。ALB 路由应用程序层 HTTP/HTTPS 流量，而 Redis 使用自己的基于 TCP 的协议。
- 在另一个 Auto Scaling 组中运行 Redis 也意味着该公司仍需负责 Redis 集群、复制、故障转移、持久化和状态感知扩展。ElastiCache 是专门构建的托管选项。
- 仅选择 Aurora Serverless 本身并未说明数据库故障转移所需的副本和跨 AZ 实例配置。

### B

- ALB 和 Aurora 部分是合理的。
- 但是，Redis 层仍然**在 EC2 上自行管理**，并且明确部署在**单个 Availability Zone** 中。这会造成 AZ 级别的故障域，无法满足可用性要求。
- Network Load Balancer 分配 TCP 连接，但不会创建 Redis 复制、协调主节点选举或提供 Redis 感知的自动故障转移。具有副本和 Multi-AZ 的 ElastiCache 提供这些能力。

### C

- 对于 HTTP/HTTPS Web 层，Network Load Balancer 不如 ALB 适合，因为它工作在第 4 层而不是第 7 层。
- 所提议的具有 **DNS 目标类型**的目标组无效。Network Load Balancer 目标组支持 `instance`、`ip` 或 `alb` 目标类型，而不支持 DNS 主机名。因此，无法将 ElastiCache 主机名注册为 DNS 类型目标。参阅 [Network Load Balancer target types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-target-groups.html)。
- 应用程序应直接连接到相应的 ElastiCache 终端节点；ElastiCache 不需要在其前面设置 Elastic Load Balancing 目标组。
- 与选项 A 一样，Aurora Serverless 本身并未明确提供所需的跨 AZ 读取节点/故障转移配置。

因此，**D** 是唯一一个使用适当的 AWS 托管服务和负载均衡服务，正确分离全部三个层级的选项。

en.question: A company is using AWS Organizations and wants to implement a governance strategy with the following requirements: • AWS resource access is restricted to the same two Regions for all accounts. • AWS services are limited to a specific group of authorized services for all accounts. • Authentication is provided by Active Directory. • Access permissions are organized by job function and are identical in each account. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Establish an organizational unit (OU) with group policies in the management account to restrict Regions and authorized services. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to provision roles with permissions for each job function, including an IAM trust policy for IAM identity provider authentication in each account.
options.B: Establish a permission boundary in the management account to restrict Regions and authorized services. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to provision roles with permissions for each job function, including an IAM trust policy for IAM identity provider authentication in each account.
options.C: Establish a service control policy in the management account to restrict Regions and authorized services. Use AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) to share management account roles with permissions for each job function, including AWS IAM Identity Center for authentication in each account.
options.D: Establish a service control policy in the management account to restrict Regions and authorized services. Use AWS CloudFormation StackSets to provision roles with permissions for each job function, including an IAM trust policy for IAM identity provider authentication in each account.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement mapping

The company needs two distinct layers of control:

1. **Organization-wide governance guardrails** that limit member accounts to two Regions and an approved set of AWS services.
2. **Consistent workforce access** in every account, with Active Directory authentication and identical job-function roles.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Establish an SCP and use CloudFormation StackSets to provision federated IAM roles in each account.**

- **Service control policies (SCPs)** are the appropriate AWS Organizations mechanism for centrally defining the maximum permissions available to IAM users and roles in member accounts. An SCP can deny unapproved services and use conditions such as `aws:RequestedRegion` to deny regional API operations outside the two approved Regions. AWS explicitly recommends SCPs for permissions guardrails across multiple accounts. SCPs do not grant permissions; the IAM roles deployed into each account provide the actual job-function permissions. See [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) and [IAM best practices for multi-account guardrails](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html).
- **AWS CloudFormation StackSets** can create and update the same CloudFormation-defined resources across multiple accounts and Regions. This is suitable for consistently deploying identical IAM roles and permission policies for each job function. See [Use CloudFormation StackSets for multi-account and multi-Region deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html).
- For Active Directory federation, such as through AD FS, each account can contain a SAML identity provider and IAM roles whose trust policies name that provider as the federated principal. Active Directory users or groups can then be mapped to the appropriate job-function roles. AWS documentation also notes that a SAML IdP referenced by a role trust policy must be in the same account as the role, which supports provisioning the federation configuration consistently in each account. See [SAML 2.0 federation with IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_saml.html).

Therefore, **D** combines the correct organization-level guardrail, repeatable per-account role deployment, and Active Directory federation model.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A
An Organizations OU does not use IAM **group policies in the management account** to constrain permissions in all member accounts. IAM groups and their policies are account-local IAM constructs. The appropriate organization-level mechanism is an SCP attached at the organization root, OU, or account level. The StackSets and federation portion is reasonable, but the governance mechanism is wrong.

### B
An IAM permissions boundary applies to a specific IAM user or role and limits the maximum permissions that the identity-based policies attached to that entity can grant. A boundary established only in the management account does not automatically constrain identities in all member accounts. AWS recommends permissions boundaries primarily for delegated permissions management **within an account**, whereas SCPs are the recommended multi-account guardrail. See [IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html).

### C
Although the SCP portion is correct, **AWS RAM cannot be used to share management-account IAM roles as reusable roles in every member account**. AWS RAM shares only supported resource types created by integrated services; IAM roles are not a shareable RAM resource type. Roles needed for account-local access should instead be provisioned into the target accounts, for example with StackSets. See [Shareable AWS resources in AWS RAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html).

IAM Identity Center can integrate with external identity sources such as Active Directory and can provision access into accounts, but that does not make the proposed RAM-based sharing of management-account roles valid.

zh.question: 一家公司正在使用 AWS Organizations，并希望实施一项治理策略，要求如下：• 对所有账户，AWS 资源访问仅限于相同的两个 Region。• 对所有账户，AWS 服务仅限于一组特定的已授权服务。• 通过 Active Directory 提供身份验证。• 访问权限按工作职能进行组织，并且在每个账户中保持一致。哪种解决方案能够满足这些要求？

options.A: 在管理账户中建立一个具有组策略的 organizational unit (OU)，以限制 Region 和已授权服务。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 为每个工作职能预置具有相应权限的角色，并在每个账户中包括用于 IAM identity provider 身份验证的 IAM 信任策略。
options.B: 在管理账户中建立一个 permission boundary，以限制 Region 和已授权服务。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 为每个工作职能预置具有相应权限的角色，并在每个账户中包括用于 IAM identity provider 身份验证的 IAM 信任策略。
options.C: 在管理账户中建立一个 service control policy，以限制 Region 和已授权服务。使用 AWS Resource Access Manager (AWS RAM) 共享具有每个工作职能所需权限的管理账户角色，并在每个账户中使用 AWS IAM Identity Center 进行身份验证。
options.D: 在管理账户中建立一个 service control policy，以限制 Region 和已授权服务。使用 AWS CloudFormation StackSets 为每个工作职能预置具有相应权限的角色，并在每个账户中包括用于 IAM identity provider 身份验证的 IAM 信任策略。

zh.explanation:
## 场景与需求映射

该公司需要两个不同层面的控制：

1. **组织范围的治理护栏**，将成员账户限制为两个 Region 和一组已批准的 AWS 服务。
2. **每个账户中一致的员工访问权限**，具有 Active Directory 身份验证和相同的按工作职能划分的角色。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 建立 SCP，并使用 CloudFormation StackSets 在每个账户中预置联合 IAM 角色。**

- **服务控制策略 (SCPs)** 是适用于 AWS Organizations 的机制，用于集中定义成员账户中 IAM 用户和角色可获得的最大权限。SCP 可以拒绝未经批准的服务，并使用诸如 `aws:RequestedRegion` 之类的条件，拒绝在两个已批准 Region 之外执行的区域性 API 操作。AWS 明确建议使用 SCP 作为跨多个账户的权限护栏。SCP 不授予权限；部署到每个账户中的 IAM 角色提供实际的工作职能权限。参阅 [Service control policies](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps.html) 和 [IAM best practices for multi-account guardrails](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)。
- **AWS CloudFormation StackSets** 可以在多个账户和 Region 中创建和更新相同的、由 CloudFormation 定义的资源。这适合为每项工作职能一致地部署相同的 IAM 角色和权限策略。参阅 [Use CloudFormation StackSets for multi-account and multi-Region deployments](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)。
- 对于 Active Directory 联合身份验证，例如通过 AD FS，每个账户都可以包含一个 SAML identity provider，以及其信任策略中将该提供商指定为联合主体的 IAM 角色。随后，可以将 Active Directory 用户或组映射到相应的工作职能角色。AWS 文档还指出，角色信任策略引用的 SAML IdP 必须与该角色位于同一个账户中，这支持在每个账户中一致地预置联合身份验证配置。参阅 [SAML 2.0 federation with IAM roles](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_providers_saml.html)。

因此，**D** 结合了正确的组织级护栏、可重复的按账户角色部署方式，以及 Active Directory 联合身份验证模型。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A
Organizations OU 不会使用管理账户中的 IAM **组策略** 来约束所有成员账户中的权限。IAM 组及其策略是账户本地的 IAM 构造。适当的组织级机制是附加到组织根、OU 或账户级别的 SCP。StackSets 和联合身份验证部分是合理的，但治理机制错误。

### B
IAM permissions boundary 适用于特定的 IAM 用户或角色，并限制附加到该实体的基于身份的策略所能授予的最大权限。仅在管理账户中建立的边界不会自动约束所有成员账户中的身份。AWS 建议主要将 permissions boundary 用于**账户内部**的委派权限管理，而 SCP 则是推荐的多账户护栏。参阅 [IAM best practices](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html)。

### C
虽然 SCP 部分正确，但**AWS RAM 不能用于将管理账户 IAM 角色作为可重用角色共享到每个成员账户中**。AWS RAM 仅共享由集成服务创建的受支持资源类型；IAM 角色不是可由 RAM 共享的资源类型。账户本地访问所需的角色应预置到目标账户中，例如使用 StackSets。参阅 [Shareable AWS resources in AWS RAM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ram/latest/userguide/shareable.html)。

IAM Identity Center 可以与 Active Directory 等外部身份源集成，并能将访问权限预置到各账户中，但这并不能使所提议的基于 RAM 的管理账户角色共享方式成立。

en.question: A company detects unusual login attempts in many of its AWS accounts. A DevOps engineer must implement a solution that sends a notification to the company's security team when multiple failed login attempts occur. The DevOps engineer has already created an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic and has subscribed the security team to the SNS topic. Which solution will provide the notification with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Configure AWS CloudTrail to send management events to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Create a CloudWatch Logs metric filter to match failed ConsoleLogin events. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is based on the metric filter. Configure an alarm action to send messages to the SNS topic.
options.B: Configure AWS CloudTrail to send management events to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an Amazon Athena query that returns a failure if the query finds failed logins in the logs in the S3 bucket. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to periodically run the query. Create a second EventBridge rule to detect when the query fails and to send a message to the SNS topic.
options.C: Configure AWS CloudTrail to send data events to an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. Create a CloudWatch logs metric filter to match failed ConsoleLogin events. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is based on the metric filter. Configure an alarm action to send messages to the SNS topic.
options.D: Configure AWS CloudTrail to send data events to an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon S3 event notification for the s3:ObjectCreated event type. Filter the event type by ConsoleLogin failed events. Configure the event notification to forward to the SNS topic.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The solution must detect **multiple failed AWS Management Console login attempts**, apply a count/time threshold, and notify the existing SNS topic with the **least operational effort**.

## Correct answer: A

A failed console sign-in is recorded by CloudTrail as a `ConsoleLogin` event with fields such as:

- `eventName`: `ConsoleLogin`
- `errorMessage`: `Failed authentication`
- `managementEvent`: `true`
- `eventCategory`: `Management`

AWS documents an unsuccessful sign-in event with exactly these attributes in the [CloudTrail console sign-in event reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-aws-console-sign-in-events.html). CloudTrail also explicitly states that `ConsoleLogin` is a **management event** in its [management events documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/logging-management-events-with-cloudtrail.html).

Option A uses the standard managed workflow:

1. Send CloudTrail management events to CloudWatch Logs.
2. Create a metric filter such as:
   ```text
   { ($.eventName = ConsoleLogin) && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }
   ```
3. Create a CloudWatch alarm with a threshold representing multiple failures, such as three failures in five minutes.
4. Configure the existing SNS topic as the alarm action.

AWS documents this exact pattern in [Creating CloudWatch alarms for CloudTrail events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-alarms-for-cloudtrail.html). The general CloudTrail integration procedure also states that CloudWatch Logs can filter `ConsoleLogin` events, create metrics and alarms, and send notifications when thresholds are reached: [Monitoring CloudTrail log files with CloudWatch Logs](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/monitor-cloudtrail-log-files-with-cloudwatch-logs.html).

This is near-real-time, threshold-based, and requires no query orchestration or custom processing, so it has the least operational effort.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. CloudTrail to S3, Athena queries, and EventBridge rules

This is unnecessarily complex and introduces scheduled polling, Athena table/query management, query-result interpretation, and multiple EventBridge rules. It would also generally have more notification latency than the CloudWatch Logs metric-filter approach.

Additionally, finding matching rows does not inherently cause an Athena query to enter the `FAILED` state. Athena distinguishes successfully executed queries from queries that fail because of execution errors, as described in [Viewing Athena query history](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/queries-viewing-history.html). Extra processing would be required to inspect the returned rows and decide whether to notify SNS. Therefore, this is not the least-operational-effort solution and is not correctly specified as written.

### C. Configure CloudTrail data events

`ConsoleLogin` is a **management event**, not a data event. Data-event logging therefore does not select the required console sign-in records. The remaining metric-filter and alarm architecture is appropriate, but it is connected to the wrong CloudTrail event category.

### D. CloudTrail data events to S3 with an S3 event notification

This option has two fundamental problems:

1. `ConsoleLogin` is a management event, not a data event.
2. S3 event-notification filters operate on the created object's **key prefix or suffix**; they do not inspect CloudTrail JSON inside an object for `ConsoleLogin` failures. See [S3 event notification object-key filtering](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-filtering.html).

An `s3:ObjectCreated` notification would indicate that a CloudTrail log object was delivered, not that the object contains failed logins. It also would not natively count multiple failures over a time period.

zh.question: 一家公司在其多个 AWS 账户中检测到异常登录尝试。一名 DevOps 工程师必须实施一个解决方案，以便在发生多次登录失败尝试时向公司的安全团队发送通知。该 DevOps 工程师已创建 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，并且已让安全团队订阅该 SNS 主题。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维工作量提供通知？

options.A: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 将管理事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组。创建 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器以匹配失败的 ConsoleLogin 事件。创建基于该指标筛选器的 CloudWatch 告警。配置告警操作以向 SNS 主题发送消息。
options.B: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 将管理事件发送到 Amazon S3 存储桶。创建一个 Amazon Athena 查询，使该查询在 S3 存储桶中的日志里发现登录失败时返回失败。创建一条 Amazon EventBridge 规则以定期运行该查询。创建第二条 EventBridge 规则，以检测查询何时失败并向 SNS 主题发送消息。
options.C: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 将数据事件发送到 Amazon CloudWatch Logs 日志组。创建 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器以匹配失败的 ConsoleLogin 事件。创建基于该指标筛选器的 CloudWatch 告警。配置告警操作以向 SNS 主题发送消息。
options.D: 配置 AWS CloudTrail 将数据事件发送到 Amazon S3 存储桶。为 s3:ObjectCreated 事件类型配置 Amazon S3 事件通知。按 ConsoleLogin 失败事件筛选该事件类型。配置事件通知以转发至 SNS 主题。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该解决方案必须检测**多次失败的 AWS Management Console 登录尝试**，应用计数/时间阈值，并以**最少的运维工作量**通知现有的 SNS 主题。

## 正确答案：A

失败的控制台登录会被 CloudTrail 记录为 `ConsoleLogin` 事件，其中包含以下字段：

- `eventName`：`ConsoleLogin`
- `errorMessage`：`Failed authentication`
- `managementEvent`：`true`
- `eventCategory`：`Management`

AWS 在 [CloudTrail 控制台登录事件参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-aws-console-sign-in-events.html) 中记录了具有这些确切属性的登录失败事件。CloudTrail 还在其[管理事件文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/logging-management-events-with-cloudtrail.html)中明确说明，`ConsoleLogin` 是一种**管理事件**。

选项 A 使用标准的托管工作流程：

1. 将 CloudTrail 管理事件发送到 CloudWatch Logs。
2. 创建如下所示的指标筛选器：
   ```text
   { ($.eventName = ConsoleLogin) && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }
   ```
3. 创建一个 CloudWatch 告警，并设置代表多次失败的阈值，例如五分钟内发生三次失败。
4. 将现有 SNS 主题配置为告警操作。

AWS 在[为 CloudTrail 事件创建 CloudWatch 告警](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudwatch-alarms-for-cloudtrail.html)中记录了这一确切模式。通用 CloudTrail 集成流程还指出，CloudWatch Logs 可以筛选 `ConsoleLogin` 事件、创建指标和告警，并在达到阈值时发送通知：[使用 CloudWatch Logs 监控 CloudTrail 日志文件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/monitor-cloudtrail-log-files-with-cloudwatch-logs.html)。

该方案接近实时、基于阈值，并且不需要查询编排或自定义处理，因此运维工作量最少。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. CloudTrail 到 S3、Athena 查询和 EventBridge 规则

该方案不必要地复杂，会引入定时轮询、Athena 表和查询管理、查询结果解读以及多条 EventBridge 规则。与 CloudWatch Logs 指标筛选器方法相比，它通常还会有更高的通知延迟。

此外，找到匹配的行并不会天然导致 Athena 查询进入 `FAILED` 状态。正如[查看 Athena 查询历史记录](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/athena/latest/ug/queries-viewing-history.html)中所述，Athena 会区分成功执行的查询与因执行错误而失败的查询。需要额外处理来检查返回的行并决定是否通知 SNS。因此，这不是运维工作量最少的解决方案，并且按题目所述其配置也不正确。

### C. 配置 CloudTrail 数据事件

`ConsoleLogin` 是一种**管理事件**，而不是数据事件。因此，数据事件日志记录不会选择所需的控制台登录记录。其余的指标筛选器和告警架构是合适的，但它连接到了错误的 CloudTrail 事件类别。

### D. 将 CloudTrail 数据事件发送到 S3 并使用 S3 事件通知

该选项存在两个根本问题：

1. `ConsoleLogin` 是管理事件，而不是数据事件。
2. S3 事件通知筛选器针对创建对象的**键前缀或后缀**进行操作；它们不会检查对象内的 CloudTrail JSON 来查找 `ConsoleLogin` 失败事件。请参阅 [S3 事件通知对象键筛选](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/notification-how-to-filtering.html)。

` s3:ObjectCreated` 通知会表示 CloudTrail 日志对象已送达，而不是表示该对象包含失败的登录。它也无法原生统计某一时间段内的多次失败。

en.question: A company has deployed a new REST API by using Amazon API Gateway. The company uses the API to access confidential data. The API must be accessed from only specific VPCs in the company. Which solution will meet these requirements?
