options.A: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use ELB health checks. Enable AWS Config. Create an AWS Config rule to ensure that any new Auto Scaling group will use ELB health checks. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to notify the support team if the traffic routing configuration changes. Configure the AWS Config rule to send a notification to the topic.
options.B: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 health checks. Enable AWS Config. Create an AWS Config rule to ensure that any new Auto Scaling group will use EC2 health checks. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to notify the support team if the traffic routing configuration changes. Configure the AWS Config rule to send a notification to the topic.
options.C: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use EC2 health checks. Create an Amazon CloudWatch synthetic canary to monitor the application. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is triggered when the CloudWatch canary fails. Configure the alarm to notify the support team when the alarm state is in alarm.
options.D: Configure the Auto Scaling group to use ELB health checks. Create an Amazon CloudWatch synthetic canary to monitor the application. Create a CloudWatch alarm that is triggered when the CloudWatch canary fails. Configure the alarm to notify the support team when the alarm state is in alarm.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The company needs to address two separate requirements:

1. Detect application-level failures so that the ALB stops sending traffic to affected instances and the Auto Scaling group can replace them.
2. Notify the support team when the relevant health-check or traffic-routing configuration changes.

### Why A is correct

EC2 health checks are not sufficient for this scenario. They primarily verify that an instance is running and that its EC2 system and instance status checks pass. Therefore, an instance can remain healthy from the EC2 perspective even while its application returns errors. EC2 health checks are also the default health-check type for an Auto Scaling group ([Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)).

Configuring the Auto Scaling group to use **ELB health checks** makes EC2 Auto Scaling consider the health information reported by the load balancer. The ALB target group can perform an application-aware HTTP or HTTPS health check against an appropriate path. After a target exceeds the configured consecutive-failure threshold, the ALB takes it out of service; enabling ELB health checks for the Auto Scaling group also allows the group to mark and replace targets that the load balancer reports as unhealthy ([ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html), [Using Elastic Load Balancing health checks with Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/getting-started-elastic-load-balancing.html)).

For configuration governance, AWS Config provides the managed rule **`AUTOSCALING_GROUP_ELB_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIRED`**. The rule evaluates Auto Scaling groups associated with a load balancer and reports them as noncompliant when they are not configured to use ELB health checks. Its trigger type is **configuration changes**, so it can detect both an improper change to an existing group and a newly created group with the wrong health-check configuration ([AWS Config managed rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/autoscaling-group-elb-healthcheck-required.html)). AWS Config can publish resource configuration and rule compliance changes to an SNS topic, providing the required support-team notification ([AWS Config SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/notifications-for-AWS-Config.html)).

Thus, **A** is the only option that combines application-aware load balancer health handling with detection and notification of relevant configuration changes.

A practical qualification is that an ALB **fails open if every registered target in an enabled Availability Zone is unhealthy**, meaning it can still route to unhealthy targets in that exceptional condition. The solution should therefore use a meaningful application health-check path and maintain sufficient healthy capacity. This behavior does not change which option best satisfies the stated requirements ([ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

This option requires **EC2 health checks**, which do not establish that the application is successfully processing requests. It would preserve the exact condition described in the scenario: an instance could pass its EC2 checks while its application returns errors. An AWS Config rule requiring EC2 health checks would govern the wrong setting.

### C

This option also retains EC2-only health checks, so application failures would not cause the Auto Scaling group to use the ALB's target-health result.

A CloudWatch Synthetics canary can run scheduled scripts that monitor an endpoint, API, or customer workflow, but it does not configure the ALB to remove a particular failing target or configure Auto Scaling to replace that target. Its alarm would also notify the support team when the canary detects an application failure—not when the traffic-routing or health-check configuration changes ([CloudWatch Synthetics canaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Synthetics_Canaries.html)).

### D

Using ELB health checks is appropriate and addresses the application-health portion of the scenario. However, the CloudWatch Synthetics alarm monitors application availability or behavior. It does not evaluate whether an Auto Scaling group has been changed from ELB health checks back to EC2 health checks, nor does it provide the requested configuration-compliance control.

For example, the canary could continue succeeding immediately after an improper configuration change while all current instances remain functional. The support team would therefore receive no notification about the configuration change itself. AWS Config, rather than a Synthetics canary, satisfies that explicit requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司的应用程序运行在 Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例上。这些 EC2 实例位于 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 之后。最近，当流量被路由到其中一些 EC2 实例时，用户开始遇到错误。DevOps 工程师发现，尽管存在应用程序错误，Auto Scaling 组仍将有问题的实例报告为运行正常。DevOps 工程师解决有问题实例上的应用程序错误后，用户体验恢复正常。公司希望确保流量仅路由到未出现应用程序错误的正常实例。如果流量路由配置发生更改，公司还希望支持团队收到通知。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用 ELB health checks。启用 AWS Config。创建一条 AWS Config 规则，以确保任何新的 Auto Scaling 组都使用 ELB health checks。创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便在流量路由配置发生更改时通知支持团队。将 AWS Config 规则配置为向该主题发送通知。
options.B: 将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用 EC2 health checks。启用 AWS Config。创建一条 AWS Config 规则，以确保任何新的 Auto Scaling 组都使用 EC2 health checks。创建一个 Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) 主题，以便在流量路由配置发生更改时通知支持团队。将 AWS Config 规则配置为向该主题发送通知。
options.C: 将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用 EC2 health checks。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch synthetic canary 来监控应用程序。创建一个 CloudWatch alarm，在 CloudWatch canary 失败时触发。将该 alarm 配置为在 alarm 状态处于 alarm 时通知支持团队。
options.D: 将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用 ELB health checks。创建一个 Amazon CloudWatch synthetic canary 来监控应用程序。创建一个 CloudWatch alarm，在 CloudWatch canary 失败时触发。将该 alarm 配置为在 alarm 状态处于 alarm 时通知支持团队。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

公司需要解决两项独立的要求：

1. 检测应用程序级别的故障，以便 ALB 停止向受影响的实例发送流量，并使 Auto Scaling 组能够替换这些实例。
2. 当相关的 health check 或流量路由配置发生更改时，通知支持团队。

### 为什么 A 正确

EC2 health checks 不足以满足此场景。它们主要验证实例是否正在运行，以及其实例的 EC2 系统状态检查和实例状态检查是否通过。因此，即使应用程序返回错误，从 EC2 的角度看，实例仍可能保持正常。EC2 health checks 也是 Auto Scaling 组的默认 health check 类型（[Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/health-checks-overview.html)）。

将 Auto Scaling 组配置为使用 **ELB health checks**，会使 EC2 Auto Scaling 考虑由 load balancer 报告的运行状况信息。ALB target group 可以针对适当的路径执行具有应用程序感知能力的 HTTP 或 HTTPS health check。当 target 超过配置的连续失败阈值后，ALB 会将其移出服务；为 Auto Scaling 组启用 ELB health checks 还可以使该组将 load balancer 报告为不正常的 target 标记为不正常并进行替换（[ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)、[Using Elastic Load Balancing health checks with Auto Scaling](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/getting-started-elastic-load-balancing.html)）。

对于配置治理，AWS Config 提供托管规则 **`AUTOSCALING_GROUP_ELB_HEALTHCHECK_REQUIRED`**。该规则会评估与 load balancer 关联的 Auto Scaling 组；如果这些组未配置为使用 ELB health checks，则将其报告为不合规。其触发器类型为 **configuration changes**，因此它既可以检测对现有组的不当更改，也可以检测使用错误 health check 配置新建的组（[AWS Config managed rule](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/autoscaling-group-elb-healthcheck-required.html)）。AWS Config 可以将资源配置和规则合规性更改发布到 SNS topic，从而提供所需的支持团队通知（[AWS Config SNS notifications](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/notifications-for-AWS-Config.html)）。

因此，只有 **A** 同时结合了具有应用程序感知能力的 load balancer 运行状况处理，以及对相关配置更改的检测和通知。

一项实际注意事项是，如果某个已启用 Availability Zone 中的每个已注册 target 都不正常，ALB 会 **fail open**，这意味着在这种特殊情况下它仍可能将流量路由到不正常的 target。因此，该解决方案应使用有意义的应用程序 health check 路径，并保持足够的正常容量。这一行为不影响哪个选项最能满足所述要求（[ALB target group health checks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/target-group-health-checks.html)）。

## 为什么其他选项不正确

### B

此选项要求使用 **EC2 health checks**，但它们无法确认应用程序是否成功处理请求。它会保留场景中描述的完全相同的状况：实例可以通过 EC2 检查，而其应用程序却返回错误。要求 EC2 health checks 的 AWS Config 规则会治理错误的设置。

### C

此选项同样保留了仅使用 EC2 health checks 的做法，因此应用程序故障不会导致 Auto Scaling 组使用 ALB 的 target health 结果。

CloudWatch Synthetics canary 可以运行计划脚本来监控端点、API 或客户工作流程，但它不会配置 ALB 移除某个发生故障的特定 target，也不会配置 Auto Scaling 来替换该 target。其 alarm 还会在 canary 检测到应用程序故障时通知支持团队，而不是在流量路由或 health check 配置发生更改时通知支持团队（[CloudWatch Synthetics canaries](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/CloudWatch_Synthetics_Canaries.html)）。

### D

使用 ELB health checks 是合适的，并且解决了场景中应用程序运行状况的部分。但是，CloudWatch Synthetics alarm 监控的是应用程序可用性或行为。它不会评估 Auto Scaling 组是否已从 ELB health checks 更改回 EC2 health checks，也无法提供所要求的配置合规性控制。

例如，在进行了不当配置更改后，只要所有当前实例仍然正常运行，canary 仍可能继续成功。支持团队因此不会收到有关配置更改本身的通知。AWS Config 而不是 Synthetics canary，才能满足这一明确要求。

en.question: A DevOps engineer needs to troubleshoot a pipeline that uses a GitHub code repository. The pipeline contains a source stage, a build stage, and a deploy stage. The pipeline also has an AWS CodeStar connection to the GitHub code repository. The build stage uses an AWS CodeBuild build project. The build project needs to perform a git clone of the repository as part of the build process. The DevOps engineer validates that the source stage is working properly. However, the build stage fails each time the pipeline runs. What is the reason that the build stage fails in the pipeline?

options.A: The build stage within the pipeline needs to use the AWS CodeStar connection action.
options.B: The AWS CodeStar connection to GitHub contains incorrect credentials.
options.C: The AWS CodePipeline service role does not have permission to use the AWS CodeStar connection.
options.D: The AWS CodeBuild service role does not have permission to use the AWS CodeStar connection.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The source stage succeeds, so CodePipeline can use the GitHub connection and retrieve the source. The failure occurs specifically because the CodeBuild project needs to work with the repository as a Git repository—that is, use the **Full clone** artifact mode rather than merely receive the default ZIP artifact.

AWS states that Full clone mode directly downloads the source into the build environment and that the **CodeBuild environment must have permission to use the connection**. The required `UseConnection` permission must therefore be added to the **CodeBuild service role**. AWS's GitHub full-clone tutorial explicitly notes that the initial pipeline run fails until the CodeBuild service role is updated with this permission. See [Update the CodeBuild service role policy to use connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-github-gitclone.html) and [Add CodeBuild GitClone permissions for connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/troubleshooting.html).

## Correct answer

**D. The AWS CodeBuild service role does not have permission to use the AWS CodeStar connection.**

Because CodeBuild is the service performing the full Git clone, its service role needs `UseConnection` permission scoped to the connection ARN. Depending on the connection's current or legacy service prefix, the action can appear as `codeconnections:UseConnection` or `codestar-connections:UseConnection`.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A. The build stage within the pipeline needs to use the AWS CodeStar connection action.**  
  Incorrect. The connection action belongs in the **source stage**. The build stage remains a CodeBuild action; for Full clone mode, CodeBuild receives connection metadata and uses the connection through its IAM role. It does not require a second connection source action in the build stage.

- **B. The AWS CodeStar connection to GitHub contains incorrect credentials.**  
  Incorrect. The question states that the source stage works properly. Incorrect or unusable GitHub connection authorization would normally prevent the connection-based source action from retrieving the repository. The failure limited to the Full clone build points instead to CodeBuild's IAM permissions.

- **C. The AWS CodePipeline service role does not have permission to use the AWS CodeStar connection.**  
  Incorrect. CodePipeline is already successfully executing the connection-based source stage, indicating that the pipeline role can use the connection for that action. A separate permission is required on the **CodeBuild service role** when CodeBuild performs the full clone.

Therefore, **D** is the best answer.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师需要对使用 GitHub 代码仓库的管道进行故障排除。该管道包含源阶段、构建阶段和部署阶段。该管道还具有到 GitHub 代码仓库的 AWS CodeStar connection。构建阶段使用 AWS CodeBuild 构建项目。该构建项目需要在构建过程中对该仓库执行 git clone。DevOps 工程师确认源阶段运行正常。但是，每次管道运行时构建阶段都会失败。该管道中构建阶段失败的原因是什么？

options.A: 管道中的构建阶段需要使用 AWS CodeStar connection 操作。
options.B: 到 GitHub 的 AWS CodeStar connection 包含不正确的凭证。
options.C: AWS CodePipeline 服务角色没有使用 AWS CodeStar connection 的权限。
options.D: AWS CodeBuild 服务角色没有使用 AWS CodeStar connection 的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

源阶段成功，因此 CodePipeline 可以使用 GitHub connection 并检索源代码。失败的具体原因在于，CodeBuild 项目需要以 Git 仓库的形式处理该仓库——即使用 **Full clone** 工件模式，而不只是接收默认的 ZIP 工件。

AWS 指出，Full clone 模式会将源代码直接下载到构建环境中，并且 **CodeBuild 环境必须具有使用该 connection 的权限**。因此，必须将所需的 `UseConnection` 权限添加到 **CodeBuild 服务角色**。AWS 的 GitHub full-clone 教程明确指出，在使用此权限更新 CodeBuild 服务角色之前，初始管道运行会失败。请参阅 [更新 CodeBuild 服务角色策略以使用 connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/tutorials-github-gitclone.html) 和 [为 connections 添加 CodeBuild GitClone 权限](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/troubleshooting.html)。

## 正确答案

**D. AWS CodeBuild 服务角色没有使用 AWS CodeStar connection 的权限。**

由于 CodeBuild 是执行完整 Git clone 的服务，其服务角色需要针对 connection ARN 范围授予 `UseConnection` 权限。根据 connection 使用的是当前还是旧版服务前缀，该操作可能显示为 `codeconnections:UseConnection` 或 `codestar-connections:UseConnection`。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **A. 管道中的构建阶段需要使用 AWS CodeStar connection 操作。**  
  错误。connection 操作属于 **源阶段**。构建阶段仍然是 CodeBuild 操作；在 Full clone 模式下，CodeBuild 会接收 connection 元数据，并通过其 IAM 角色使用该 connection。构建阶段不需要第二个 connection 源操作。

- **B. 到 GitHub 的 AWS CodeStar connection 包含不正确的凭证。**  
  错误。题目说明源阶段运行正常。不正确或不可用的 GitHub connection 授权通常会导致基于 connection 的源操作无法检索仓库。仅在 Full clone 构建中发生的失败反而表明是 CodeBuild 的 IAM 权限问题。

- **C. AWS CodePipeline 服务角色没有使用 AWS CodeStar connection 的权限。**  
  错误。CodePipeline 已成功执行基于 connection 的源阶段，这表明管道角色可以将该 connection 用于该操作。当 CodeBuild 执行完整 clone 时，**CodeBuild 服务角色**还需要单独的权限。

因此，**D** 是最佳答案。

en.question: A company's DevOps team uses Node Package Manager (NPM) open source libraries to build applications. The DevOps team runs its application build process in an AWS CodeBuild project that downloads the NPM libraries from public NPM repositories. The company wants to host the NPM libraries in private NPM repositories. The company also needs to be able to run checks on new versions of the libraries before the DevOps team uses the libraries. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?

options.A: Create an AWS CodeArtifact repository with an upstream repository named npm-store. Configure the application build process to use the CodeArtifact repository as the default source for NPM. Create an AWS CodePipeline pipeline to perform the required checks on package versions in the CodeArtifact repository. Set the package status to unlisted if a failure occurs.
options.B: Enable Amazon S3 caching in the CodeBuild project configuration. Add a step in the buildspec.yaml config file to perform the required checks on the package versions in the cache.
options.C: Create an AWS CodeCommit repository for each library. Clone the required NPM libraries to the appropriate CodeCommit repository. Modify the CodeBuild appspec.yaml config file to use the private CodeCommit repositories. Add a step to perform the required checks on the package versions.
options.D: Create an AWS CodeCommit repository for each library. Clone the required NPM libraries to the appropriate CodeCommit repository. Modify the CodeBuild buildspec.yaml config file so that NPM uses the private CodeCommit repositories. Add an AWS CodePipeline pipeline that performs the required checks on the package versions for each new commit to the repositories. Configure the pipeline to revert to the most recent commit in the event of a failure.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The company needs two capabilities:

1. A managed **private npm package repository** that can obtain open-source packages from the public npm registry.
2. An automated process to validate new package versions and prevent failed versions from being selected by normal npm dependency resolution, with the **least operational effort**.

## Correct answer: A

AWS CodeArtifact is the AWS-native managed artifact repository and directly supports the npm package format. It can use an upstream CodeArtifact repository that has an external connection to the public npm registry (`public:npmjs`). When npm requests a package that is not already present, CodeArtifact searches the upstream repository, imports the package from npmjs.com, and retains it in CodeArtifact. This avoids manually cloning and maintaining every open-source library. See [CodeArtifact external connections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/external-connection.html) and [requesting packages through upstream repositories](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-upstream-behavior.html).

CodeArtifact package-version events can also start a CodePipeline execution through EventBridge when a package version is published, modified, or deleted. The pipeline can therefore run the required security, license, quality, or compatibility checks. AWS documents this integration in [Use an event to start a CodePipeline execution](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/configure-service-events-codepipeline.html).

If validation fails, the pipeline can change the version's status to **Unlisted**. An Unlisted version does not appear in the version list returned to package managers, so npm's normal dependency-resolution logic will not select it. CodeArtifact supports changing package statuses to `Published`, `Unlisted`, or `Archived` through the CLI/API, as described in [Update package version status](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/update-package-version-status.html). Thus, A uses purpose-built managed services and requires the least ongoing administration.

> Strictly, an Unlisted version can still be installed if it is already pinned in an npm `package-lock.json`; however, it is removed from normal version discovery and dependency selection. If consumption must be blocked completely, `Archived` is the stronger status. Among the presented choices, A is nevertheless the intended and clearly best solution.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. CodeBuild S3 caching

CodeBuild caching only stores reusable parts of a build environment to improve build performance. It is not a private npm registry, does not provide package-repository lifecycle controls, and does not offer a managed approval or package-status mechanism. AWS describes S3/local caching as a way to save time by reusing build-environment components in [Cache builds to improve performance](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-caching.html). Therefore, this option does not satisfy the private-repository requirement.

### C. One CodeCommit repository per library and an `appspec.yaml` file

This requires manually cloning, updating, and maintaining a separate source repository for every third-party library, producing substantial operational overhead. CodeCommit is a source-code repository rather than a purpose-built npm package repository. In addition, CodeBuild executes commands from a **buildspec**, normally `buildspec.yml`; an AppSpec file is not the CodeBuild build definition. See the [CodeBuild build specification reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html). This option is both operationally inefficient and technically misconfigured.

### D. One CodeCommit repository per library, CodePipeline checks, and Git reverts

Although this option correctly refers to a CodeBuild buildspec, it still requires the team to manually mirror and continuously maintain every npm library in CodeCommit. It also attempts to control package versions by reverting source commits rather than using native package-version lifecycle controls. CodeArtifact already provides managed npm repositories, upstream fetching, and version statuses, making the CodeCommit-per-library design much more operationally expensive. Reverting a Git commit is also not equivalent to centrally marking a specific package version unavailable to npm clients.

Therefore, **A** is the solution that meets the requirements with the least operational effort.

zh.question: 某公司的 DevOps 团队使用 Node Package Manager (NPM) 开源库构建应用程序。DevOps 团队在 AWS CodeBuild 项目中运行其应用程序构建流程，该流程从公共 NPM 存储库下载 NPM 库。该公司希望将 NPM 库托管在私有 NPM 存储库中。该公司还需要能够在 DevOps 团队使用这些库之前，对库的新版本运行检查。哪种解决方案能够以最少的运维工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS CodeArtifact 存储库，并配置一个名为 npm-store 的上游存储库。将应用程序构建流程配置为使用该 CodeArtifact 存储库作为 NPM 的默认源。创建一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道，以对 CodeArtifact 存储库中的包版本执行所需的检查。如果发生失败，将包状态设置为 unlisted。
options.B: 在 CodeBuild 项目配置中启用 Amazon S3 缓存。在 buildspec.yaml 配置文件中添加一个步骤，以对缓存中的包版本执行所需检查。
options.C: 为每个库创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 存储库。将所需的 NPM 库克隆到相应的 CodeCommit 存储库中。修改 CodeBuild appspec.yaml 配置文件以使用私有 CodeCommit 存储库。添加一个步骤以对包版本执行所需检查。
options.D: 为每个库创建一个 AWS CodeCommit 存储库。将所需的 NPM 库克隆到相应的 CodeCommit 存储库中。修改 CodeBuild buildspec.yaml 配置文件，使 NPM 使用私有 CodeCommit 存储库。添加一个 AWS CodePipeline 管道，对每次向存储库提交新提交时的包版本执行所需检查。将管道配置为在发生失败时还原到最近一次提交。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该公司需要两项能力：

1. 一个托管式的 **私有 npm 包存储库**，能够从公共 npm 注册表获取开源包。
2. 一个自动化流程，用于验证新包版本，并防止验证失败的版本被正常的 npm 依赖项解析选中，同时具备 **最少的运维工作量**。

## 正确答案：A

AWS CodeArtifact 是 AWS 原生的托管制品存储库，并且直接支持 npm 包格式。它可以使用具有到公共 npm 注册表外部连接的上游 CodeArtifact 存储库（`public:npmjs`）。当 npm 请求尚不存在的包时，CodeArtifact 会搜索上游存储库，从 npmjs.com 导入该包，并将其保留在 CodeArtifact 中。这避免了手动克隆和维护每个开源库。请参阅 [CodeArtifact 外部连接](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/external-connection.html) 和 [通过上游存储库请求软件包](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-upstream-behavior.html)。

当包版本被发布、修改或删除时，CodeArtifact 包版本事件还可以通过 EventBridge 启动 CodePipeline 执行。因此，该管道可以运行所需的安全性、许可证、质量或兼容性检查。AWS 在 [使用事件启动 CodePipeline 执行](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/configure-service-events-codepipeline.html) 中记录了此集成。

如果验证失败，管道可以将该版本的状态更改为 **Unlisted**。Unlisted 版本不会显示在返回给包管理器的版本列表中，因此 npm 的正常依赖项解析逻辑不会选择它。CodeArtifact 支持通过 CLI/API 将包状态更改为 `Published`、`Unlisted` 或 `Archived`，如 [更新包版本状态](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/update-package-version-status.html) 所述。因此，A 使用专门构建的托管服务，且需要最少的持续管理工作。

> 严格来说，如果 Unlisted 版本已经固定在 npm `package-lock.json` 中，仍然可以安装该版本；但是，它会从正常的版本发现和依赖项选择中移除。如果必须完全阻止使用，则 `Archived` 是更强的状态。在给出的选项中，A 仍然是预期且明显最佳的解决方案。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. CodeBuild S3 缓存

CodeBuild 缓存仅存储可重用的构建环境部分，以提高构建性能。它不是私有 npm 注册表，不提供包存储库生命周期控制，也不提供托管式的审批或包状态机制。AWS 在 [缓存构建以提高性能](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-caching.html) 中将 S3/本地缓存描述为通过重用构建环境组件来节省时间的方法。因此，此选项不满足私有存储库要求。

### C. 每个库一个 CodeCommit 存储库以及 `appspec.yaml` 文件

此方案要求手动克隆、更新和维护每个第三方库的独立源代码存储库，会产生大量运维开销。CodeCommit 是源代码存储库，而不是专为 npm 包构建的存储库。此外，CodeBuild 从 **buildspec**（通常为 `buildspec.yml`）执行命令；AppSpec 文件不是 CodeBuild 的构建定义。请参阅 [CodeBuild 构建规范参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。此选项既不具备运维效率，也存在技术配置错误。

### D. 每个库一个 CodeCommit 存储库、CodePipeline 检查和 Git 还原

虽然此选项正确提到了 CodeBuild buildspec，但它仍要求团队手动镜像并持续维护 CodeCommit 中的每个 npm 库。它还试图通过还原源代码提交而不是使用原生包版本生命周期控制来管理包版本。CodeArtifact 已经提供托管式 npm 存储库、上游获取和版本状态，因此每个库使用一个 CodeCommit 存储库的设计在运维成本上高得多。还原 Git 提交也不等同于集中地将特定包版本标记为 npm 客户端不可用。

因此，**A** 是以最少运维工作量满足要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company has a search application that has a web interface. The company uses Amazon CloudFront, Application Load Balancers (ALBs), and Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group with a desired capacity of 3. The company uses prebaked AMIs. The application starts in 1 minute. The application queries an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. The application is deployed to multiple Availability Zones. Because of compliance requirements, the application needs to have a disaster recovery (DR) environment in a separate AWS Region. The company wants to minimize the ongoing cost of the DR environment and requires an RTO and an RPO of under 30 minutes. The company has created an ALB in the DR Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Add the new ALB as an origin in the CloudFront distribution. Configure origin failover functionality. Copy the AMI to the DR Region. Create a launch template and an Auto Scaling group with a desired capacity of 0 in the DR Region. Create a new OpenSearch Service cluster in the DR Region. Set up cross-cluster replication for the cluster.
options.B: Create a new CloudFront distribution in the DR Region and add the new ALB as an origin. Use Amazon Route 53 DNS for Regional failover. Copy the AMI to the DR Region. Create a launch template and an Auto Scaling group with a desired capacity of 0 in the DR Region. Reconfigure the OpenSearch Service cluster as a Multi-AZ with Standby deployment. Ensure that the standby nodes are in the DR Region.
options.C: Create a new CloudFront distribution in the DR Region and add the new ALB as an origin. Use Amazon Route 53 DNS for Regional failover. Copy the AMI to the DR Region. Create a launch template and an Auto Scaling group with a desired capacity of 3 in the DR Region. Reconfigure the OpenSearch Service cluster as a Multi-AZ with Standby deployment. Ensure that the standby nodes are in the DR Region.
options.D: Add the new ALB as an origin in the CloudFront distribution. Configure origin failover functionality. Copy the AMI to the DR Region. Create a launch template and an Auto Scaling group with a desired capacity of 3 in the DR Region. Create a new OpenSearch Service cluster in the DR Region. Set up cross-cluster replication for the cluster.

en.explanation:
## What the question is testing

The company needs a **cross-Region disaster recovery environment** with:

- RTO and RPO below 30 minutes
- Minimal ongoing DR cost
- A reusable, fast-starting EC2 application image
- Continuously available OpenSearch data in the DR Region

This points to a **pilot-light** design for the EC2 application tier, combined with an already-running replicated OpenSearch domain and global traffic failover.

## Correct answer: A

**A. Add the DR ALB as the secondary CloudFront origin, keep the DR Auto Scaling group at zero instances, and replicate OpenSearch data to a DR domain by using cross-cluster replication.**

This meets the requirements for the following reasons:

1. **CloudFront does not require a separate Regional distribution.** CloudFront is a global service. Its origin failover feature uses an origin group containing a primary and secondary origin and automatically routes qualifying requests to the secondary origin when the primary origin fails. Therefore, the existing distribution can use the DR Region's ALB as its secondary origin. See [CloudFront origin failover and resilience](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html) and [Optimize high availability with CloudFront origin failover](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html).

2. **An Auto Scaling group with desired capacity 0 minimizes compute cost.** The copied prebaked AMI and launch template preserve the ability to launch the application quickly without paying for continuously running DR EC2 instances. During DR activation, a runbook or automation can increase the desired capacity; EC2 Auto Scaling then launches instances to reach that capacity. AWS documents that an Auto Scaling group maintains its configured desired capacity and that desired capacity can be resized within the group's minimum and maximum limits. See [Set scaling limits for your Auto Scaling group](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/asg-capacity-limits.html). Given the application's stated one-minute startup time, this pilot-light application tier can reasonably be activated within the 30-minute RTO.

3. **Cross-cluster replication provides the required cross-Region OpenSearch DR copy.** OpenSearch Service cross-cluster replication uses an active-passive leader/follower model and is explicitly intended to help with disaster recovery. AWS also documents that the remote domain can be in another AWS account or Region. This keeps the DR domain's indexes synchronized and supports the required RPO. See [Cross-cluster replication for Amazon OpenSearch Service](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/replication.html).

The OpenSearch DR domain must remain provisioned, but keeping the EC2 Auto Scaling group at zero provides the lowest ongoing cost among the valid cross-Region designs in the options.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

This option incorrectly proposes placing **Multi-AZ with Standby nodes in the DR Region**. Multi-AZ with Standby creates one OpenSearch domain across **three Availability Zones within a Region**; it is protection against infrastructure or Availability Zone failures, not a cross-Region DR mechanism. AWS states that each zone contains a complete copy of the data and one of the three zones contains standby nodes. See [Multi-AZ with Standby](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/managedomains-multiaz.html).

A second CloudFront distribution is also unnecessary because CloudFront is global and the existing distribution can use origin failover.

### C

This has the same fundamental OpenSearch error as B: Multi-AZ with Standby cannot place standby nodes in a separate AWS Region. It also keeps three EC2 instances running continuously in the DR Region, increasing ongoing cost when a zero-capacity pilot-light application tier can satisfy the stated RTO.

### D

The CloudFront and OpenSearch portions are appropriate, but the DR Auto Scaling group has a desired capacity of 3. That is a warm-standby design with three continuously running EC2 instances. Because the application starts in only one minute and the RTO is under 30 minutes, continuously running all three instances is unnecessary and does not minimize ongoing DR cost compared with A.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个带 Web 界面的搜索应用程序。该公司使用 Amazon CloudFront、Application Load Balancers (ALBs) 以及 Auto Scaling 组中的 Amazon EC2 实例，Auto Scaling 组的期望容量为 3。该公司使用预构建 AMI。应用程序可在 1 分钟内启动。该应用程序查询一个 Amazon OpenSearch Service 集群。应用程序部署在多个 Availability Zones 中。由于合规性要求，该应用程序需要在单独的 AWS Region 中拥有灾难恢复 (DR) 环境。公司希望尽量降低 DR 环境的持续成本，并要求 RTO 和 RPO 均低于 30 分钟。该公司已在 DR Region 中创建了一个 ALB。哪种解决方案将满足这些要求？

options.A: 将新的 ALB 添加为 CloudFront 分配中的一个源。配置源故障转移功能。将 AMI 复制到 DR Region。在 DR Region 中创建一个启动模板和一个期望容量为 0 的 Auto Scaling 组。在 DR Region 中创建一个新的 OpenSearch Service 集群。为该集群设置跨集群复制。
options.B: 在 DR Region 中创建一个新的 CloudFront 分配，并将新的 ALB 添加为源。使用 Amazon Route 53 DNS 进行区域故障转移。将 AMI 复制到 DR Region。创建一个启动模板和一个期望容量为 0 的 Auto Scaling 组。将 OpenSearch Service 集群重新配置为带备用节点的 Multi-AZ 部署。确保备用节点位于 DR Region 中。
options.C: 在 DR Region 中创建一个新的 CloudFront 分配，并将新的 ALB 添加为源。使用 Amazon Route 53 DNS 进行区域故障转移。将 AMI 复制到 DR Region。创建一个启动模板和一个期望容量为 3 的 Auto Scaling 组。将 OpenSearch Service 集群重新配置为带备用节点的 Multi-AZ 部署。确保备用节点位于 DR Region 中。
options.D: 将新的 ALB 添加为 CloudFront 分配中的一个源。配置源故障转移功能。将 AMI 复制到 DR Region。在 DR Region 中创建一个启动模板和一个期望容量为 3 的 Auto Scaling 组。在 DR Region 中创建一个新的 OpenSearch Service 集群。为该集群设置跨集群复制。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查的内容

公司需要一个**跨 Region 的灾难恢复环境**，要求如下：

- RTO 和 RPO 低于 30 分钟
- 尽量降低持续的 DR 成本
- 可复用且可快速启动的 EC2 应用程序镜像
- DR Region 中持续可用的 OpenSearch 数据

这表明，EC2 应用程序层应采用**试点灯（pilot-light）**设计，并结合一个已在运行且完成复制的 OpenSearch 域以及全局流量故障转移。

## 正确答案：A

**A. 将 DR ALB 添加为 CloudFront 的辅助源，将 DR Auto Scaling 组保持在零实例，并通过跨集群复制将 OpenSearch 数据复制到 DR 域。**

该方案满足要求，原因如下：

1. **CloudFront 不需要单独的区域分配。** CloudFront 是一项全球服务。其源故障转移功能使用包含主源和辅助源的源组，并在主源发生故障时自动将符合条件的请求路由到辅助源。因此，现有分配可将 DR Region 的 ALB 用作辅助源。请参阅 [CloudFront 源故障转移和弹性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/disaster-recovery-resiliency.html) 和 [使用 CloudFront 源故障转移优化高可用性](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/high_availability_origin_failover.html)。

2. **期望容量为 0 的 Auto Scaling 组可最大限度地降低计算成本。** 已复制的预构建 AMI 和启动模板保留了快速启动应用程序的能力，而无需为持续运行的 DR EC2 实例付费。在激活 DR 期间，运行手册或自动化机制可以增加期望容量；随后 EC2 Auto Scaling 会启动实例以达到该容量。AWS 文档说明，Auto Scaling 组会维持其配置的期望容量，并且可以在组的最小和最大限制内调整期望容量。请参阅 [为您的 Auto Scaling 组设置扩缩限制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/asg-capacity-limits.html)。鉴于应用程序声明的 1 分钟启动时间，此试点灯应用程序层可以合理地在 30 分钟 RTO 内激活。

3. **跨集群复制提供所需的跨 Region OpenSearch DR 副本。** OpenSearch Service 跨集群复制使用主动-被动的领导者/跟随者模型，并且明确旨在帮助实现灾难恢复。AWS 还说明远程域可以位于另一个 AWS 账户或 Region 中。这会使 DR 域的索引保持同步，并支持所需的 RPO。请参阅 [Amazon OpenSearch Service 的跨集群复制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/replication.html)。

OpenSearch DR 域必须保持已预置状态，但将 EC2 Auto Scaling 组保持在零容量，可在选项中有效的跨 Region 设计里提供最低的持续成本。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B

此选项错误地建议将**带备用节点的 Multi-AZ 节点部署在 DR Region 中**。带备用节点的 Multi-AZ 会在**一个 Region 内的三个 Availability Zones** 中创建一个 OpenSearch 域；它用于防范基础设施或 Availability Zone 故障，而不是跨 Region DR 机制。AWS 指出，每个 Zone 都包含完整的数据副本，且三个 Zone 中的一个包含备用节点。请参阅 [带备用节点的 Multi-AZ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/opensearch-service/latest/developerguide/managedomains-multiaz.html)。

此外，由于 CloudFront 是全球服务，且现有分配可以使用源故障转移，因此第二个 CloudFront 分配并非必需。

### C

此选项与 B 存在相同的根本性 OpenSearch 错误：带备用节点的 Multi-AZ 无法将备用节点部署在单独的 AWS Region 中。它还会在 DR Region 中持续运行三个 EC2 实例，从而增加持续成本；而期望容量为零的试点灯应用程序层即可满足规定的 RTO。

### D

CloudFront 和 OpenSearch 部分是合适的，但 DR Auto Scaling 组的期望容量为 3。这是一种温备用设计，需要持续运行三个 EC2 实例。由于应用程序只需 1 分钟即可启动，且 RTO 低于 30 分钟，因此没有必要让这三个实例持续运行；与 A 相比，这无法最大限度地降低持续的 DR 成本。

en.question: A DevOps engineer uses AWS WAF to manage web ACLs across an AWS account. The DevOps engineer must ensure that AWS WAF is enabled for all Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the account. The DevOps engineer uses an AWS CloudFormation template to deploy an individual ALB and AWS WAF as part of each application stack's deployment process. If AWS WAF is removed from the ALB after the ALB is deployed, AWS WAF must be added to the ALB automatically. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?

options.A: Enable AWS Config. Add the alb-waf-enabled managed rule. Create an AWS Systems Manager Automation document to add AWS WAF to an ALB. Edit the rule to automatically remediate. Select the Systems Manager Automation document as the remediation action.
options.B: Enable AWS Config. Add the alb-waf-enabled managed rule. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to send all AWS Config ConfigurationItemChangeNotification notification types to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to call the AWS Config start-resource-evaluation API in detective mode.
options.C: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to periodically call an AWS Lambda function that calls the detect-stack-drift API on the CloudFormation template. Configure the Lambda function to modify the ALB attributes with waf.fail_open.enabled set to true if the AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation resource shows a status of drifted.
options.D: Configure an Amazon EventBridge rule to periodically call an AWS Lambda function that calls the detect-stack-drift API on the CloudFormation template. Configure the Lambda function to delete and redeploy the CloudFormation stack if the AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation resource shows a status of drifted.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

Each application stack initially deploys an ALB with an AWS WAF web ACL association. The required control must continuously detect if that association is removed after deployment and automatically restore it, with the least custom code and operational effort.

## Correct answer: A

The AWS Config managed rule `alb-waf-enabled` is purpose-built for this control. It evaluates `AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer` resources, is triggered by configuration changes, and reports an ALB as noncompliant when WAF is not enabled. It can also be parameterized with allowed web ACL IDs or ARNs. See [alb-waf-enabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/alb-waf-enabled.html).

AWS Config supports remediating resources that its rules mark noncompliant by invoking AWS Systems Manager Automation documents. AWS documents that these can be either managed or custom Automation documents and can be associated with Config rules as remediation actions. Therefore, a custom Automation document can perform the WAF web ACL association, and automatic remediation can invoke it when the ALB becomes noncompliant. See [Remediating Noncompliant Resources with AWS Config](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html).

This is the most operationally efficient solution because it uses a configuration-change-triggered managed compliance rule plus native automatic remediation instead of periodic polling and custom detection logic.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B

This option only initiates another evaluation; it does not restore the WAF association. More importantly, `StartResourceEvaluation` is for on-demand evaluation of supplied resource details, and AWS states that the **only valid evaluation mode for this API is `PROACTIVE`**, not `DETECTIVE`. Thus, the proposed API call is invalid as described and provides no remediation action. See [StartResourceEvaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/APIReference/API_StartResourceEvaluation.html).

### C

CloudFormation drift detection can identify when actual resource configuration differs from the stack template, including deleted resources or properties, but it is a detection mechanism rather than the direct native compliance/remediation workflow required here. See [CloudFormation drift detection](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html).

Additionally, setting `waf.fail_open.enabled` to `true` does **not** associate a web ACL with the ALB. That attribute only permits an already WAF-enabled ALB to route requests to targets when the ALB cannot forward requests to AWS WAF. See [LoadBalancerAttribute — waf.fail_open.enabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/APIReference/API_LoadBalancerAttribute.html). Therefore, this option does not satisfy the requirement.

### D

Although drift detection could identify deletion of a stack-managed association, periodically polling every application stack with Lambda and then deleting and redeploying the entire stack is unnecessarily complex and disruptive. It can replace or interrupt unrelated application resources merely to restore one association. AWS Config's change-triggered managed rule and targeted Systems Manager remediation provide a safer and substantially more operationally efficient solution.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师使用 AWS WAF 管理一个 AWS 账户中的 Web ACL。该 DevOps 工程师必须确保该账户中的所有 Application Load Balancer (ALB) 都启用了 AWS WAF。DevOps 工程师使用 AWS CloudFormation 模板，在每个应用程序堆栈的部署过程中部署单个 ALB 和 AWS WAF。如果在 ALB 部署后从 ALB 中移除了 AWS WAF，则必须自动将 AWS WAF 添加回 ALB。哪种解决方案能够以最高的运营效率满足这些要求？

options.A: 启用 AWS Config。添加 `alb-waf-enabled` 托管规则。创建一个 AWS Systems Manager Automation 文档，将 AWS WAF 添加到 ALB。编辑该规则以自动修复。选择该 Systems Manager Automation 文档作为修复操作。
options.B: 启用 AWS Config。添加 `alb-waf-enabled` 托管规则。创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，将所有 AWS Config `ConfigurationItemChangeNotification` 通知类型发送到 AWS Lambda 函数。配置该 Lambda 函数，以侦测模式调用 AWS Config `start-resource-evaluation` API。
options.C: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，定期调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数对 CloudFormation 模板调用 `detect-stack-drift` API。如果 `AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation` 资源显示的状态为 drifted，则配置该 Lambda 函数将 ALB 属性 `waf.fail_open.enabled` 修改为 true。
options.D: 配置一个 Amazon EventBridge 规则，定期调用一个 AWS Lambda 函数，该函数对 CloudFormation 模板调用 `detect-stack-drift` API。如果 `AWS::WAFv2::WebACLAssociation` 资源显示的状态为 drifted，则配置该 Lambda 函数删除并重新部署 CloudFormation 堆栈。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

每个应用程序堆栈最初都会部署一个带有 AWS WAF Web ACL 关联的 ALB。所需的控制措施必须持续检测该关联是否在部署后被移除，并以最少的自定义代码和运营工作量自动恢复该关联。

## 正确答案：A

AWS Config 托管规则 `alb-waf-enabled` 专门用于实现此控制。它评估 `AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer` 资源，由配置更改触发，并在未启用 WAF 时将 ALB 报告为不合规。它还可以使用允许的 Web ACL ID 或 ARN 进行参数化。请参阅 [alb-waf-enabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/alb-waf-enabled.html)。

AWS Config 支持通过调用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 文档来修复其规则标记为不合规的资源。AWS 文档指出，这些文档可以是托管或自定义的 Automation 文档，并且可以作为修复操作与 Config 规则关联。因此，自定义 Automation 文档可以执行 WAF Web ACL 关联操作，而自动修复可以在 ALB 变为不合规时调用该文档。请参阅 [使用 AWS Config 修复不合规资源](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/remediation.html)。

这是运营效率最高的解决方案，因为它使用由配置更改触发的托管合规规则和原生自动修复，而不是定期轮询和自定义检测逻辑。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B

此选项仅启动另一次评估；它不会恢复 WAF 关联。更重要的是，`StartResourceEvaluation` 用于按需评估所提供的资源详细信息，并且 AWS 指出，**此 API 唯一有效的评估模式是 `PROACTIVE`**，而不是 `DETECTIVE`。因此，所述的 API 调用无效，且不提供任何修复操作。请参阅 [StartResourceEvaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/APIReference/API_StartResourceEvaluation.html)。

### C

CloudFormation 漂移检测可以识别实际资源配置何时与堆栈模板不同，包括已删除的资源或属性，但它是一种检测机制，而不是此处所需的直接原生合规性/修复工作流程。请参阅 [CloudFormation 漂移检测](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/using-cfn-stack-drift.html)。

此外，将 `waf.fail_open.enabled` 设置为 `true` **不会**将 Web ACL 与 ALB 关联。该属性仅允许已启用 WAF 的 ALB 在无法将请求转发到 AWS WAF 时，仍将请求路由到目标。请参阅 [LoadBalancerAttribute — waf.fail_open.enabled](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/APIReference/API_LoadBalancerAttribute.html)。因此，此选项不满足要求。

### D

尽管漂移检测可以识别由堆栈管理的关联被删除的情况，但使用 Lambda 定期轮询每个应用程序堆栈，然后删除并重新部署整个堆栈，既不必要地复杂又具有破坏性。仅为恢复一个关联，它可能替换或中断无关的应用程序资源。AWS Config 的由更改触发的托管规则和针对性的 Systems Manager 修复提供了更安全且运营效率显著更高的解决方案。

en.question: A company is developing an ecommerce application on AWS. The company wants to make sure that the application can handle sudden increases in traffic. The company uses AWS CodePipeline for its CI/CD process. The company must implement a solution to integrate automated load testing into the CI/CD pipeline to validate the application's performance. The solution must perform production deployment only if the performance exceeds a threshold. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.A: Deploy the application by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Enable load balancing. Use Elastic Beanstalk to deploy tools for load tests. Run the tests during each deployment, and roll back the deployment if performance thresholds are unmet. Create an AWS Lambda function to monitor test metrics. Set up alarms for performance thresholds. Configure Amazon EventBridge to return an error if a test fails and to proceed with production deployment if a test passes.
options.B: Implement AWS Fargate tasks to run tools for load tests. Use Amazon Elastic container Service (Amazon ECS) to manage the test containers. Create AWS Lambda functions to analyze the test results. Integrate the functions with CodePipeline by using custom actions to initiate and evaluate the tests. Program the functions to return an error if a test fails and to proceed with production deployment if a test passes.
options.C: Launch Amazon EC2 instances to run tools for load tests. Store test scripts in a GitHub repository. Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the tests and result analysis in the CodePipeline workflow. Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke an AWS Lambda function based on the test results. Program the function to return an error if a test fails and to proceed with production deployment if a test passes.
options.D: Use AWS CodeBuild to run tools for load tests, store the test artifacts in Amazon S3, and configure a CodePipeline stage to invoke the CodeBuild project. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the test metrics and to set up alarms for performance thresholds. Integrate an AWS Lambda function into the pipeline by using a custom action. Program the function to return an error if a test fails and to proceed with production deployment if a test passes.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to add an automated load-test gate to an existing CodePipeline workflow. The test must run before production deployment, evaluate performance against a defined threshold, and stop the pipeline when the threshold is not met. Because the question emphasizes **least operational overhead**, the preferred solution should use managed, natively integrated CI/CD services instead of maintaining test fleets or additional orchestration infrastructure.

## Correct answer: D

**Use CodeBuild to execute the load tests and invoke it as a CodePipeline stage, store results in S3, evaluate performance metrics through CloudWatch, and use Lambda to report success or failure to CodePipeline.**

This is the best choice because:

- CodeBuild is fully managed, automatically scales, and eliminates the need to provision, patch, or manage test servers. AWS explicitly supports adding CodeBuild as a **build or test action** in CodePipeline ([AWS CodeBuild overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/welcome.html)).
- A CodeBuild action can consume pipeline artifacts, run commands from a buildspec, and make generated artifacts available to later actions. CodePipeline stores pipeline artifacts in S3, which fits the requirement to preserve load-test output ([CodeBuild action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)).
- The load-testing tool can publish latency, throughput, error-rate, or other custom metrics to CloudWatch. A CloudWatch metric alarm enters `OK` when the metric is within its defined threshold and `ALARM` when it is outside the threshold ([CloudWatch alarm evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-evaluation.html)).
- A Lambda invoke action can inspect the test results or alarm state and call `PutJobSuccessResult` or `PutJobFailureResult`. The latter causes the action—and therefore the pipeline stage—to fail, preventing the subsequent production deployment ([Lambda action reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Lambda.html)).

Strictly speaking, CodePipeline provides a native AWS Lambda **invoke action**; the option's reference to a Lambda “custom action” is imprecise. However, its intended gating mechanism is valid, and D remains clearly superior to the alternatives. The load-test script could also directly fail the CodeBuild action by returning a nonzero exit status, but that simpler design is not offered as an answer.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Elastic Beanstalk load-test deployment

Elastic Beanstalk is primarily an application deployment and environment-management service, not the most direct managed test runner for a CodePipeline test stage. Deploying and maintaining load-testing tools in an Elastic Beanstalk environment introduces unnecessary environment, deployment, scaling, and rollback configuration compared with a native CodeBuild test action.

The EventBridge portion is also flawed: EventBridge receives and routes CodePipeline pipeline, stage, and action state-change events; it does not itself “return an error” as the completion result of a CodePipeline action ([Monitoring CodePipeline events with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html)). A pipeline-integrated action must explicitly report success or failure.

### B. ECS on Fargate load-test tasks

Fargate avoids managing EC2 worker instances, but this design still requires management of container images, ECS task definitions, clusters, networking, security groups, task execution, result collection, and multiple Lambda/custom-action integrations. AWS's ECS Fargate workflow includes creating or selecting a cluster, registering a task definition, and configuring networking when creating the task or service ([ECS Fargate task workflow](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ECS_AWSCLI_Fargate.html)).

This can be appropriate for unusually large or specialized distributed load tests, but it has more moving parts and operational overhead than running the test tool directly in a managed CodeBuild test action.

### C. EC2 instances with Step Functions and EventBridge

This option has the highest operational burden. The company would need to provision, secure, patch, scale, monitor, and terminate EC2 load-generator instances. It also introduces Step Functions for orchestration and EventBridge plus Lambda for result handling, even though CodePipeline can invoke CodeBuild directly and use the action result as a deployment gate.

As in option A, EventBridge is designed to route events such as CodePipeline state changes, not directly complete a CodePipeline action by “returning an error” ([Monitoring CodePipeline events with EventBridge](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html)).

Therefore, **D** provides the required automated performance gate with the least infrastructure and operational management.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上开发一个电子商务应用程序。该公司希望确保该应用程序能够处理流量的突发增长。该公司使用 AWS CodePipeline 进行其 CI/CD 流程。该公司必须实施一种解决方案，将自动化负载测试集成到 CI/CD 管道中，以验证应用程序的性能。只有当性能超过某个阈值时，该解决方案才必须执行生产部署。哪种解决方案能够以最低的运维开销满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 部署应用程序。启用负载均衡。使用 Elastic Beanstalk 部署负载测试工具。在每次部署期间运行测试，并在未达到性能阈值时回滚部署。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数来监控测试指标。为性能阈值设置告警。配置 Amazon EventBridge，以便在测试失败时返回错误，并在测试通过时继续进行生产部署。
options.B: 实施 AWS Fargate 任务来运行负载测试工具。使用 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 管理测试容器。创建 AWS Lambda 函数来分析测试结果。通过使用自定义操作将这些函数与 CodePipeline 集成，以启动和评估测试。对这些函数进行编程，使其在测试失败时返回错误，并在测试通过时继续进行生产部署。
options.C: 启动 Amazon EC2 实例来运行负载测试工具。将测试脚本存储在 GitHub 存储库中。使用 AWS Step Functions 在 CodePipeline 工作流程中编排测试和结果分析。使用 Amazon EventBridge 根据测试结果调用 AWS Lambda 函数。对该函数进行编程，使其在测试失败时返回错误，并在测试通过时继续进行生产部署。
options.D: 使用 AWS CodeBuild 运行负载测试工具，将测试构件存储在 Amazon S3 中，并配置一个 CodePipeline 阶段来调用 CodeBuild 项目。使用 Amazon CloudWatch 监控测试指标并为性能阈值设置告警。通过使用自定义操作将 AWS Lambda 函数集成到管道中。对该函数进行编程，使其在测试失败时返回错误，并在测试通过时继续进行生产部署。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是在现有 CodePipeline 工作流程中添加一个自动化负载测试门控。测试必须在生产部署之前运行，根据定义的阈值评估性能，并在未达到性能阈值时停止管道。由于题目强调 **最低运维开销**，首选解决方案应使用托管且原生集成的 CI/CD 服务，而不是维护测试集群或额外的编排基础设施。

## 正确答案：D

**使用 CodeBuild 执行负载测试，并将其作为 CodePipeline 阶段调用；将结果存储在 S3 中；通过 CloudWatch 评估性能指标；并使用 Lambda 向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。**

这是最佳选择，原因如下：

- CodeBuild 是完全托管的，可自动扩展，并且无需预置、修补或管理测试服务器。AWS 明确支持在 CodePipeline 中将 CodeBuild 添加为 **构建或测试操作**（[AWS CodeBuild 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/welcome.html)）。
- CodeBuild 操作可以使用管道构件、运行 buildspec 中的命令，并使生成的构件可供后续操作使用。CodePipeline 将管道构件存储在 S3 中，这符合保留负载测试输出的要求（[CodeBuild 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodeBuild.html)）。
- 负载测试工具可以将延迟、吞吐量、错误率或其他自定义指标发布到 CloudWatch。当指标在定义的阈值范围内时，CloudWatch 指标告警会进入 `OK` 状态；当指标超出阈值范围时，则进入 `ALARM` 状态（[CloudWatch 告警评估](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-evaluation.html)）。
- Lambda 调用操作可以检查测试结果或告警状态，并调用 `PutJobSuccessResult` 或 `PutJobFailureResult`。后者会导致该操作——以及管道阶段——失败，从而阻止后续的生产部署（[Lambda 操作参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-Lambda.html)）。

严格来说，CodePipeline 提供原生的 AWS Lambda **调用操作**；选项中提到 Lambda“自定义操作”并不准确。然而，其预期的门控机制是有效的，D 仍然明显优于其他选项。负载测试脚本也可以通过返回非零退出状态直接使 CodeBuild 操作失败，但答案中未提供这一更简单的设计。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. Elastic Beanstalk 负载测试部署

Elastic Beanstalk 主要是一项应用程序部署和环境管理服务，而不是最直接的、用于 CodePipeline 测试阶段的托管测试运行器。与原生 CodeBuild 测试操作相比，在 Elastic Beanstalk 环境中部署和维护负载测试工具会引入不必要的环境、部署、扩展和回滚配置。

EventBridge 部分也存在问题：EventBridge 接收和路由 CodePipeline 的管道、阶段和操作状态变更事件；它本身不能作为 CodePipeline 操作的完成结果来“返回错误”（[使用 EventBridge 监控 CodePipeline 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html)）。与管道集成的操作必须显式报告成功或失败。

### B. 在 Fargate 上运行 ECS 负载测试任务

Fargate 无需管理 EC2 工作实例，但该设计仍需要管理容器映像、ECS 任务定义、集群、网络、安全组、任务执行、结果收集以及多个 Lambda/自定义操作集成。在创建任务或服务时，AWS 的 ECS Fargate 工作流程包括创建或选择集群、注册任务定义以及配置网络（[ECS Fargate 任务工作流程](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/ECS_AWSCLI_Fargate.html)）。

这可能适用于异常大型或专用的分布式负载测试，但与直接在托管 CodeBuild 测试操作中运行测试工具相比，它具有更多组件和更高的运维开销。

### C. 使用 Step Functions 和 EventBridge 的 EC2 实例

该选项具有最高的运维负担。公司需要预置、保护、修补、扩展、监控和终止 EC2 负载生成器实例。它还引入了 Step Functions 进行编排，并使用 EventBridge 和 Lambda 处理结果，而 CodePipeline 可以直接调用 CodeBuild 并将操作结果用作部署门控。

与选项 A 一样，EventBridge 旨在路由诸如 CodePipeline 状态变更之类的事件，而不是通过“返回错误”直接完成 CodePipeline 操作（[使用 EventBridge 监控 CodePipeline 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/detect-state-changes-cloudwatch-events.html)）。

因此，**D** 能够以最低的基础设施和运维管理开销提供所需的自动化性能门控。

en.question: A company needs to update its order processing application to improve resilience and availability. The application requires a stateful database and uses a single-node Amazon RDS DB instance to store customer orders and transaction history. A DevOps engineer must make the database highly available. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB global tables. Configure automatic failover between AWS Regions by using Amazon Route 53 health checks.
options.B: Migrate the database to Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach to connect all the instances to a single EBS volume.
options.C: Use the RDS DB instance as the source instance to create read replicas in multiple Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer to distribute read traffic across the read replicas.
options.D: Modify the RDS DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment. Verify automatic failover to the standby instance if the primary instance becomes unavailable.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The application already stores orders and transaction history in a **single-AZ Amazon RDS DB instance**. The objective is to make this stateful database highly available while preserving its existing RDS architecture and providing automatic recovery if the primary instance or its Availability Zone becomes unavailable.

## Correct answer: D

**Modify the RDS DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment, and verify automatic failover to the standby instance.**

An RDS Multi-AZ DB instance deployment automatically provisions and maintains a **synchronously replicated standby instance in another Availability Zone**. If the primary DB instance or its AZ becomes unavailable, Amazon RDS manages failover to the standby. AWS also explicitly supports converting an existing Single-AZ DB instance into a Multi-AZ deployment by modifying the DB instance and enabling the Multi-AZ option. This directly provides the requested high availability without changing database technologies or requiring the company to manage database replication itself. See [Multi-AZ DB instance deployments for Amazon RDS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html) and [Enabling Multi-AZ for high availability](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/gettingstartedguide/scaling-ha.html).

Testing or verifying failover is appropriate because the application should be able to reconnect after the RDS endpoint is remapped to the new primary.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Migrate to DynamoDB global tables and use Route 53

DynamoDB global tables are a valid **multi-Region, multi-active** design and can serve reads and writes from multiple Regions. However, this option requires replacing the existing relational RDS database with DynamoDB, redesigning the data model and application access patterns, and implementing regional traffic routing. That is an unnecessary and substantially more disruptive migration when RDS already provides the requested database high availability through Multi-AZ. Global tables are primarily a multi-Region DynamoDB architecture, not the standard mechanism for making an existing RDS DB instance highly available. See [DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html).

### B. Run the database on EC2 and use EBS Multi-Attach across AZs

EBS Multi-Attach volumes can be attached to multiple supported EC2 instances only when those instances are in the **same Availability Zone**, so this option cannot attach one volume to database instances across multiple AZs. In addition, applications must provide appropriate clustered-file-system behavior, write ordering, and fencing to maintain data consistency. A problem affecting the shared EBS volume could also make it unavailable to every attached instance. This would introduce substantial self-managed database complexity and would not provide the managed Multi-AZ availability offered by RDS. See [EBS Multi-Attach considerations and limitations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html).

### C. Create read replicas and distribute reads with an ALB

RDS read replicas primarily provide **read scaling**. They use asynchronous replication, accept read-only connections, and do not automatically replace the primary writer. If the primary fails, a read replica must be promoted to a standalone writable DB instance as a disaster recovery operation. Therefore, this design does not provide transparent automatic failover for the application's order and transaction writes. An Application Load Balancer distributing read traffic also does not solve availability of the primary write endpoint. AWS distinguishes read replicas from the synchronously replicated standby used for Multi-AZ high availability. See [Overview of Amazon RDS read replicas](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html).

Therefore, **D** is the solution that directly and correctly meets the high-availability requirement.

zh.question: 一家公司需要更新其订单处理应用程序，以提高弹性和可用性。该应用程序需要一个有状态数据库，并使用单节点 Amazon RDS DB 实例来存储客户订单和交易历史记录。一名 DevOps 工程师必须使该数据库实现高可用性。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB global tables。使用 Amazon Route 53 运行状况检查配置 AWS Regions 之间的自动故障转移。
options.B: 将数据库迁移到多个 Availability Zones 中的 Amazon EC2 实例。使用 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach 将所有实例连接到单个 EBS 卷。
options.C: 使用 RDS DB 实例作为源实例，在多个 Availability Zones 中创建只读副本。部署 Application Load Balancer，以将读取流量分配到各只读副本。
options.D: 将 RDS DB 实例修改为 Multi-AZ 部署。如果主实例不可用，验证是否会自动故障转移到备用实例。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

该应用程序已将订单和交易历史记录存储在一个 **单 AZ Amazon RDS DB 实例** 中。目标是在保留现有 RDS 架构的同时，使这个有状态数据库实现高可用性，并在主实例或其 Availability Zone 不可用时提供自动恢复。

## 正确答案：D

**将 RDS DB 实例修改为 Multi-AZ 部署，并验证会自动故障转移到备用实例。**

RDS Multi-AZ DB 实例部署会自动在另一个 Availability Zone 中预置并维护一个**同步复制的备用实例**。如果主 DB 实例或其 AZ 不可用，Amazon RDS 会管理到备用实例的故障转移。AWS 还明确支持通过修改 DB 实例并启用 Multi-AZ 选项，将现有 Single-AZ DB 实例转换为 Multi-AZ 部署。这样可以直接提供所需的高可用性，无需更换数据库技术，也无需公司自行管理数据库复制。请参阅 [适用于 Amazon RDS 的 Multi-AZ DB 实例部署](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.MultiAZSingleStandby.html) 和 [为高可用性启用 Multi-AZ](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/gettingstartedguide/scaling-ha.html)。

测试或验证故障转移是合适的，因为在 RDS endpoint 重新映射到新的主实例后，应用程序应能够重新连接。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### A. 迁移到 DynamoDB global tables 并使用 Route 53

DynamoDB global tables 是一种有效的 **多 Region、多活** 设计，可以从多个 Regions 提供读取和写入服务。但是，此选项要求以 DynamoDB 替换现有的关系型 RDS 数据库，重新设计数据模型和应用程序访问模式，并实施区域流量路由。当 RDS 已经通过 Multi-AZ 提供所需的数据库高可用性时，这种迁移既不必要，也会造成更大范围的中断。Global tables 主要是一种多 Region DynamoDB 架构，而不是使现有 RDS DB 实例实现高可用性的标准机制。请参阅 [DynamoDB global tables](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/GlobalTables.html)。

### B. 在 EC2 上运行数据库，并跨 AZ 使用 EBS Multi-Attach

EBS Multi-Attach 卷只能附加到位于**同一 Availability Zone** 中的多个受支持 EC2 实例，因此此选项无法将一个卷附加到跨多个 AZ 的数据库实例。此外，应用程序必须提供适当的集群文件系统行为、写入排序和隔离机制，以维护数据一致性。影响共享 EBS 卷的问题也可能导致每个已附加实例都无法使用该卷。这会引入大量自行管理数据库的复杂性，并且无法提供 RDS 所提供的托管式 Multi-AZ 可用性。请参阅 [EBS Multi-Attach 注意事项和限制](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/ebs/latest/userguide/ebs-volumes-multi.html)。

### C. 创建只读副本，并使用 ALB 分配读取流量

RDS read replicas 主要用于提供**读取扩展**。它们使用异步复制，只接受只读连接，且不会自动替代主写入实例。如果主实例发生故障，必须将只读副本提升为独立的可写 DB 实例，这是一种灾难恢复操作。因此，此设计无法为应用程序的订单和交易写入提供透明的自动故障转移。分配读取流量的 Application Load Balancer 也无法解决主写入 endpoint 的可用性问题。AWS 将 read replicas 与用于 Multi-AZ 高可用性的同步复制备用实例明确区分开来。请参阅 [Amazon RDS read replicas 概述](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_ReadRepl.html)。

因此，**D** 是直接且正确满足高可用性要求的解决方案。

en.question: A company has application code in an AWS CodeConnections compatible Git repository. The company wants to configure unit tests to run when pull requests are opened. The company wants to ensure that the test status is visible in pull requests when the tests are completed. The company wants to save output data files that the tests generate to an Amazon S3 bucket after the tests are finished. Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Create an IAM service role to allow access to the resources that are required to run the tests.
options.B: Create a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline that has a test stage. Create a trigger to run the pipeline when pull requests are created or updated. Add a source action to report test results.
options.C: Create an AWS CodeBuild project to run the tests. Enable webhook triggers to run the tests when pull requests are created or updated. Enable build status reporting to report test results.
options.D: Create a buildspec.yml file that has a reports section to upload output files when the tests have finished running.
options.E: Create a buildspec.yml file that has an artifacts section to upload artifacts when the tests have finished running.
options.F: Create an appspec.yml file that has a files section to upload output files when the tests have finished running.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs three capabilities:

1. Run unit tests automatically when a pull request is opened or updated.
2. Publish the completed test/build status back to the repository so that it is visible on the pull request.
3. Save files generated by the tests as output artifacts in Amazon S3.

## Correct answers: A, C, and E

### A. Create an IAM service role

AWS CodeBuild needs a service role to perform operations on the company's behalf. The role must grant the permissions needed by the build, including permission to write the generated output artifacts to the designated S3 bucket. AWS documentation states that a CodeBuild service role is required for CodeBuild to interact with dependent AWS services and includes `s3:PutObject` in its example permissions policy. The policy should be restricted according to least privilege. See [Allow CodeBuild to interact with other AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-service-role.html).

### C. Create a CodeBuild project with pull request webhook triggers and build status reporting

CodeBuild directly supports webhook filters for pull request events. For example, supported Bitbucket events include `PULL_REQUEST_CREATED` and `PULL_REQUEST_UPDATED`, allowing the unit-test build to run when a pull request is opened or revised. See [Bitbucket webhook events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/bitbucket-webhook.html).

CodeBuild also supports reporting build status to the source provider when builds start and finish. For webhook-triggered builds, AWS states that the status is reported to the source provider, which makes the success or failure status visible in the pull request's commit checks/status area. See the **Build status** and webhook settings in [Create a build project in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/create-project.html).

### E. Use the `artifacts` section of `buildspec.yml`

The `artifacts` section identifies the generated build output files and tells CodeBuild how to prepare them for upload to the configured S3 output bucket. The `artifacts/files` field specifies which files from the build environment are included. See [Build specification reference for CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).

Therefore, **A + C + E** provides permissions, pull-request-triggered testing with status reporting, and S3 storage for generated output files.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. CodePipeline source action reports test results — Incorrect

CodePipeline can use pull request triggers for CodeConnections sources, but the proposed source action does not report test results. A `CodeStarSourceConnection` source action retrieves repository content and produces one source artifact plus source-related variables; it is not a test-result reporting action. See [CodeStarSourceConnection action](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodestarConnectionSource.html).

A pipeline could include CodeBuild as a test action, but that is not what this option correctly specifies for publishing status to the pull request. CodeBuild webhook status reporting in option C is the direct solution.

### D. Use the `reports` section to upload output files — Incorrect

The `reports` section is specifically for raw test-result or code-coverage files that CodeBuild processes into report groups, using formats such as JUnit XML, TestNG XML, or Cobertura XML. It is not the general build-output artifact mechanism requested for arbitrary data files. General files that must be saved as build outputs in S3 belong in the `artifacts` section. See [Build specification reference for CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).

### F. Use an AppSpec `files` section — Incorrect

`appspec.yml` belongs to AWS CodeDeploy. Its `files` section tells CodeDeploy which files from an application revision to copy onto EC2 or on-premises deployment instances during deployment. It does not configure CodeBuild to upload test-generated files to S3. See [AppSpec `files` section](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-files.html).

zh.question: 一家公司将应用程序代码存放在一个兼容 AWS CodeConnections 的 Git 存储库中。该公司希望在拉取请求打开时配置运行单元测试。该公司希望确保测试完成后，测试状态在拉取请求中可见。该公司希望在测试完成后，将测试生成的输出数据文件保存到 Amazon S3 存储桶中。哪种解决方案组合可以满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 创建一个 IAM 服务角色，以允许访问运行测试所需的资源。
options.B: 在 AWS CodePipeline 中创建一个包含测试阶段的管道。创建一个触发器，以便在拉取请求创建或更新时运行该管道。添加一个源操作以报告测试结果。
options.C: 创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目来运行测试。启用 webhook 触发器，以便在拉取请求创建或更新时运行测试。启用构建状态报告以报告测试结果。
options.D: 创建一个包含 `reports` 部分的 buildspec.yml 文件，以便在测试完成运行后上传输出文件。
options.E: 创建一个包含 `artifacts` 部分的 buildspec.yml 文件，以便在测试完成运行后上传构件。
options.F: 创建一个包含 `files` 部分的 appspec.yml 文件，以便在测试完成运行后上传输出文件。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要具备三项能力：

1. 在拉取请求打开或更新时自动运行单元测试。
2. 将已完成的测试/构建状态发布回存储库，以便该状态在拉取请求中可见。
3. 将测试生成的文件作为输出构件保存在 Amazon S3 中。

## 正确答案：A、C 和 E

### A. 创建一个 IAM 服务角色

AWS CodeBuild 需要一个服务角色来代表公司执行操作。该角色必须授予构建所需的权限，包括将生成的输出构件写入指定 S3 存储桶的权限。AWS 文档指出，CodeBuild 服务角色是 CodeBuild 与依赖的 AWS 服务交互所必需的，并且其示例权限策略中包含 `s3:PutObject`。应遵循最小权限原则来限制该策略。请参阅 [允许 CodeBuild 与其他 AWS 服务交互](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-service-role.html)。

### C. 创建具有拉取请求 webhook 触发器和构建状态报告功能的 CodeBuild 项目

CodeBuild 直接支持用于拉取请求事件的 webhook 筛选器。例如，支持的 Bitbucket 事件包括 `PULL_REQUEST_CREATED` 和 `PULL_REQUEST_UPDATED`，允许在拉取请求打开或修订时运行单元测试构建。请参阅 [Bitbucket webhook 事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/bitbucket-webhook.html)。

CodeBuild 还支持在构建开始和完成时向源提供商报告构建状态。对于由 webhook 触发的构建，AWS 指出该状态会报告给源提供商，从而使成功或失败状态在拉取请求的提交检查/状态区域中可见。请参阅 [在 AWS CodeBuild 中创建构建项目](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/create-project.html) 中的 **Build status** 和 webhook 设置。

### E. 使用 `buildspec.yml` 的 `artifacts` 部分

`artifacts` 部分用于标识生成的构建输出文件，并告知 CodeBuild 如何准备这些文件以便上传到配置的 S3 输出存储桶。`artifacts/files` 字段指定构建环境中应包含哪些文件。请参阅 [CodeBuild 的构建规范参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。

因此，**A + C + E** 提供了权限、带状态报告的拉取请求触发测试，以及用于存储生成输出文件的 S3。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### B. CodePipeline 源操作报告测试结果 — 错误

CodePipeline 可以对 CodeConnections 源使用拉取请求触发器，但所提议的源操作不会报告测试结果。`CodeStarSourceConnection` 源操作会检索存储库内容，并生成一个源构件和源相关变量；它不是测试结果报告操作。请参阅 [CodeStarSourceConnection 操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-CodestarConnectionSource.html)。

管道可以包含 CodeBuild 作为测试操作，但该选项并未正确指定如何将状态发布到拉取请求。选项 C 中的 CodeBuild webhook 状态报告才是直接解决方案。

### D. 使用 `reports` 部分上传输出文件 — 错误

`reports` 部分专用于原始测试结果或代码覆盖率文件，CodeBuild 会将这些文件处理为报告组，并使用 JUnit XML、TestNG XML 或 Cobertura XML 等格式。它并非用于任意数据文件的通用构建输出构件机制。必须作为构建输出保存在 S3 中的常规文件应放在 `artifacts` 部分。请参阅 [CodeBuild 的构建规范参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。

### F. 使用 AppSpec 的 `files` 部分 — 错误

`appspec.yml` 属于 AWS CodeDeploy。其 `files` 部分告诉 CodeDeploy 在部署期间将应用程序修订版本中的哪些文件复制到 EC2 或本地部署实例。它不会配置 CodeBuild 将测试生成的文件上传到 S3。请参阅 [AppSpec `files` 部分](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/reference-appspec-file-structure-files.html)。

en.question: A software development team is implementing a CI/CD pipeline for its web application. The team is using AWS CodeBuild to compile Java-based source code and to run unit tests. The team needs to store the artifacts that are created by the CodeBuild project. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket as an artifact output location in the project. Add the artifact locations to the project's buildspec file. Configure an S3 bucket policy that allows the CodeBuild project's resource access role to access the S3 bucket.
options.B: Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure the S3 bucket as an artifact output location in the project's buildspec file. Add the artifact locations to the project's buildspec file. Configure an S3 bucket policy that allows the CodeBuild service role to access the S3 bucket.
options.C: Configure an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system as a file system location for the project. Configure the EFS file system as the artifact output location in the project's buildspec file. Configure a file system policy that allows CodeBuild to access the file system.
options.D: Create an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Configure the EBS volume as the artifact output location in the project's buildspec file. Configure an IAM role that allows CodeBuild to access the volume.

en.explanation:
## Correct answer: A

The team needs durable storage for the JAR, WAR, test-report, or other files generated by its CodeBuild build. With CodeBuild, these two artifact settings serve different purposes:

- The **S3 destination bucket** is configured in the CodeBuild **project's Artifacts configuration**.
- The buildspec's **`artifacts` section** identifies which files from the build environment CodeBuild should collect and package, for example `target/*.jar`.

AWS documents Amazon S3 and the output bucket under the project's **Artifacts** settings. The buildspec syntax provides fields such as `files`, `base-directory`, `name`, and `s3-prefix`, but no field for selecting the destination S3 bucket. See [Create a build project in AWS CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/create-project.html) and the [CodeBuild buildspec reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html).

### Why A is correct

Option A correctly configures the S3 bucket as the artifact output location **in the CodeBuild project**, then uses the project's buildspec to identify the generated artifact files. It also provides the required authorization for CodeBuild to access the bucket.

The role wording is context-dependent: CodeBuild normally performs project operations through its **service role**, which can be granted permissions such as `s3:PutObject`. The CodeBuild `Project` API also defines a `resourceAccessRole` used to enable access to CloudWatch Logs and S3 artifacts. Therefore, the important architectural point in A is that the destination bucket is a **project-level setting**, not a buildspec destination field. See [Allow CodeBuild to interact with other AWS services](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-service-role.html) and the [CodeBuild Project API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/APIReference/API_Project.html).

### Why the other options are incorrect

- **B:** The CodeBuild service role terminology is appropriate, but the option incorrectly says to configure the S3 bucket as the artifact output location **in the buildspec**. The buildspec selects the files to package; the project configuration selects the S3 destination. Because the required bucket destination cannot be configured as stated, this option is incorrect.

- **C:** Amazon EFS can be mounted as a CodeBuild project file-system location so build commands can read and write files through the mount. However, EFS is not a CodeBuild artifact output type and cannot be selected as the artifact destination through the buildspec. The EFS integration is a mounted build-time file system, not the project's managed artifact-upload destination. See the [CodeBuild Amazon EFS sample](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-efs.html).

- **D:** Amazon EBS is not a supported CodeBuild artifact destination and cannot be configured as an artifact output location in a buildspec. CodeBuild project artifact outputs support mechanisms such as Amazon S3 or CodePipeline, not an attached EBS volume.

Therefore, **A** is the solution that correctly separates the project-level S3 artifact destination from the buildspec-level selection of artifact files.

zh.question: 某软件开发团队正在为其 Web 应用程序实施 CI/CD 管道。该团队使用 AWS CodeBuild 编译基于 Java 的源代码并运行单元测试。团队需要存储由 CodeBuild 项目创建的构件。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。在项目中将该 S3 存储桶配置为构件输出位置。将构件位置添加到项目的 buildspec 文件中。配置一个 S3 存储桶策略，允许 CodeBuild 项目的资源访问角色访问该 S3 存储桶。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon S3 存储桶。在项目的 buildspec 文件中将该 S3 存储桶配置为构件输出位置。将构件位置添加到项目的 buildspec 文件中。配置一个 S3 存储桶策略，允许 CodeBuild 服务角色访问该 S3 存储桶。
options.C: 将一个 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统配置为该项目的文件系统位置。在项目的 buildspec 文件中将 EFS 文件系统配置为构件输出位置。配置一个文件系统策略，允许 CodeBuild 访问该文件系统。
options.D: 创建一个 Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) 卷。在项目的 buildspec 文件中将该 EBS 卷配置为构件输出位置。配置一个 IAM 角色，允许 CodeBuild 访问该卷。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A

团队需要为其 CodeBuild 构建生成的 JAR、WAR、测试报告或其他文件提供持久存储。对于 CodeBuild，以下两项构件设置具有不同的用途：

- **S3 目标存储桶**在 CodeBuild **项目的 Artifacts 配置**中进行配置。
- buildspec 的 **`artifacts` 部分**用于指定 CodeBuild 应从构建环境中收集并打包哪些文件，例如 `target/*.jar`。

AWS 在项目的 **Artifacts** 设置中记录了 Amazon S3 和输出存储桶。buildspec 语法提供了 `files`、`base-directory`、`name` 和 `s3-prefix` 等字段，但不提供用于选择目标 S3 存储桶的字段。请参阅 [在 AWS CodeBuild 中创建构建项目](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/create-project.html) 和 [CodeBuild buildspec 参考](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/build-spec-ref.html)。

### 为什么 A 正确

选项 A 正确地在 **CodeBuild 项目中**将 S3 存储桶配置为构件输出位置，然后使用项目的 buildspec 来标识生成的构件文件。它还提供了 CodeBuild 访问该存储桶所需的授权。

角色措辞取决于上下文：CodeBuild 通常通过其**服务角色**执行项目操作，该角色可以被授予诸如 `s3:PutObject` 的权限。CodeBuild `Project` API 还定义了一个 `resourceAccessRole`，用于启用对 CloudWatch Logs 和 S3 构件的访问。因此，A 中重要的架构要点是，目标存储桶是一个**项目级别的设置**，而不是 buildspec 目标字段。请参阅 [允许 CodeBuild 与其他 AWS 服务交互](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/setting-up-service-role.html) 和 [CodeBuild Project API](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/APIReference/API_Project.html)。

### 为什么其他选项不正确

- **B：** CodeBuild 服务角色这一术语是恰当的，但该选项错误地指出应在 **buildspec** 中将 S3 存储桶配置为构件输出位置。buildspec 选择要打包的文件；项目配置选择 S3 目标位置。由于无法按所述方式配置所需的目标存储桶，因此该选项不正确。

- **C：** Amazon EFS 可以作为 CodeBuild 项目的文件系统位置进行挂载，因此构建命令可以通过该挂载点读取和写入文件。但是，EFS 不是 CodeBuild 构件输出类型，无法通过 buildspec 被选作构件目标位置。EFS 集成是一个在构建期间挂载的文件系统，而不是项目托管的构件上传目标位置。请参阅 [CodeBuild Amazon EFS 示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codebuild/latest/userguide/sample-efs.html)。

- **D：** Amazon EBS 不是受支持的 CodeBuild 构件目标位置，无法在 buildspec 中配置为构件输出位置。CodeBuild 项目构件输出支持 Amazon S3 或 CodePipeline 等机制，而不支持附加的 EBS 卷。

因此，**A** 是能够正确区分项目级 S3 构件目标位置与 buildspec 级构件文件选择的解决方案。

en.question: A company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts. The accounts are in an OU that has a policy attached to allow all actions. The company is migrating several Git repositories to a specified AWS CodeConnections supported Git provider. The Git repositories manage AWS CloudFormation stacks for application infrastructure that the company deploys across multiple AWS Regions. The company wants a DevOps team to integrate CodeConnections into the CloudFormation stacks. The DevOps team must ensure that company staff members can integrate only with the specified Git provider. The deployment process must be highly available across Regions. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose three.)

options.A: Add a new SCP statement to the OU that denies the CodeConnections CreatingConnections action where the provider type is not the specified Git provider.
options.B: Add a new SCP statement to the OU that allows the CodeConnections CreatingConnections action where the provider type is the specified Git provider.
options.C: Use CodeConnectlons to configure a single CodeConnections connection to each Git repository.
options.D: Use CodeConnections to create a CodeConnections connection from each Region where the company operates to each Git repository.
options.E: Use CodeConnections to create a CodeConnections repository link. Update each CfoudFormation stack to sync from the Git repository.
options.F: For each Git repository, create a pipeline in AWS CodePipefine that has the Git repository set as the source and a CloudFormation deployment stage.

en.explanation:
## Correct answers: A, C, and E

The company needs an organization-level restriction that permits integrations only with the approved Git provider, a highly available multi-Region connection design, and native integration between the Git repositories and AWS CloudFormation stacks.

### A. Deny connection creation for every provider except the approved provider

An SCP with an explicit `Deny` on `codeconnections:CreateConnection`, conditioned on `codeconnections:ProviderType` not matching the approved provider, creates the required organization-wide guardrail.
