CodeConnections supports provider-type conditions for connection creation, and SCP syntax supports conditions in deny statements. Because an explicit deny overrides an allow, staff cannot create connections to unapproved providers even though the OU otherwise allows all actions.

See the [CodeConnections IAM permissions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/security-iam.html), [SCP evaluation rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html), and [SCP syntax](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_syntax.html).

### C. Use a single global CodeConnections connection instead of separate Regional connections

CodeConnections connections are global resources. AWS replicates a connection across Regions, so it needs to be created only once and can then be used in other AWS Regions. If the Region in which the connection was created experiences an issue, the connection can still be used from other Regions. This supports the required multi-Region availability without creating duplicate connections in every deployment Region.

The option's phrase “connection to each Git repository” is technically loose: a connection represents authorization to the provider account, while the repository-specific association is created through a **repository link**. Nevertheless, C correctly identifies the intended architecture—use the global connection rather than creating separate connections in every Region.

See [Global resources in AWS CodeConnections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/welcome-connections-how-it-works-global.html) and [CodeConnections repository links and sync configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/configurations.html).

### E. Create repository links and configure CloudFormation Git sync

A repository link associates a CodeConnections connection with an external Git repository. A sync configuration of type `CFN_STACK_SYNC` then enables CloudFormation Git sync to monitor repository content and update the associated CloudFormation stack. This is the native integration requested by the scenario.

See [CodeConnections sync configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/configurations.html) and [How CloudFormation Git sync works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/git-sync-concepts-terms.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Add an SCP allow for the approved provider

SCPs set the maximum permissions available to accounts; they do not grant permissions by themselves. More importantly, the OU already has broad allow coverage. Adding another conditional `Allow` for the approved provider would not deny connection creation for other providers. The restriction requires the explicit conditional deny in A. See [SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html).

### D. Create a connection in every Region

This is unnecessary because CodeConnections connections are global and replicated across Regions. AWS states that a connection is created once and can be used in any Region, including from other Regions if its creation Region is experiencing issues. Creating duplicate per-Region connections is therefore not the intended availability design. See [Global resources in AWS CodeConnections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/welcome-connections-how-it-works-global.html).

### F. Create a CodePipeline pipeline for every repository

A CodePipeline-based deployment could be designed, but it is not necessary for the requested native CloudFormation integration. Repository links and `CFN_STACK_SYNC` sync configurations directly connect repository changes to CloudFormation Git sync. Adding a separate pipeline for every repository introduces unnecessary components and does not represent the purpose-built approach described in E. See [CodeConnections sync configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/configurations.html).

**Answer: A, C, E**

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS Organizations 管理多个 AWS 账户。这些账户位于一个 OU 中，该 OU 附加了一项允许所有操作的策略。该公司正在将多个 Git 存储库迁移到指定的、受 AWS CodeConnections 支持的 Git 提供商。这些 Git 存储库管理 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈，以支持公司在多个 AWS 区域部署的应用程序基础设施。公司希望一个 DevOps 团队将 CodeConnections 集成到 CloudFormation 堆栈中。DevOps 团队必须确保公司员工只能与指定的 Git 提供商集成。部署过程必须在各区域之间具备高可用性。哪种步骤组合将满足这些要求？（选择三个。）

options.A: 向 OU 添加新的 SCP 语句，拒绝 provider type 不是指定 Git 提供商时的 CodeConnections CreatingConnections 操作。
options.B: 向 OU 添加新的 SCP 语句，允许 provider type 为指定 Git 提供商时的 CodeConnections CreatingConnections 操作。
options.C: 使用 CodeConnectlons 为每个 Git 存储库配置一个 CodeConnections 连接。
options.D: 使用 CodeConnections，从公司运营所在的每个区域为每个 Git 存储库创建一个 CodeConnections 连接。
options.E: 使用 CodeConnections 创建一个 CodeConnections repository link。更新每个 CfoudFormation 堆栈以从 Git 存储库同步。
options.F: 为每个 Git 存储库在 AWS CodePipefine 中创建一个管道，将 Git 存储库设为源，并设置一个 CloudFormation 部署阶段。

zh.explanation:
## 正确答案：A、C 和 E

公司需要一项组织级别的限制，以便仅允许与经批准的 Git 提供商集成；还需要高可用的多区域连接设计，以及 Git 存储库与 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈之间的原生集成。

### A. 拒绝为经批准提供商以外的所有提供商创建连接

对 `codeconnections:CreateConnection` 实施显式 `Deny` 的 SCP，且条件为 `codeconnections:ProviderType` 与经批准提供商不匹配，可创建所需的组织范围防护措施。CodeConnections 支持用于创建连接的提供商类型条件，SCP 语法也支持在拒绝语句中使用条件。由于显式拒绝会覆盖允许，即使 OU 在其他方面允许所有操作，员工也无法为未经批准的提供商创建连接。

请参阅 [CodeConnections IAM permissions reference](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/security-iam.html)、[SCP evaluation rules](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html) 和 [SCP syntax](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_syntax.html)。

### C. 使用单个全局 CodeConnections 连接，而非单独的区域连接

CodeConnections 连接是全局资源。AWS 会在各区域间复制连接，因此只需创建一次，随后即可在其他 AWS 区域中使用。如果创建该连接的区域出现问题，仍可从其他区域使用此连接。这可支持所需的多区域可用性，无需在每个部署区域中创建重复的连接。

该选项中“为每个 Git 存储库建立连接”的表述在技术上并不严谨：连接代表对提供商账户的授权，而特定于存储库的关联通过 **repository link** 创建。不过，C 正确指出了预期架构——使用全局连接，而不是在每个区域中创建单独的连接。

请参阅 [Global resources in AWS CodeConnections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/welcome-connections-how-it-works-global.html) 和 [CodeConnections repository links and sync configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/configurations.html)。

### E. 创建 repository links 并配置 CloudFormation Git sync

Repository link 将 CodeConnections 连接与外部 Git 存储库关联。类型为 `CFN_STACK_SYNC` 的同步配置随后会使 CloudFormation Git sync 能够监视存储库内容，并更新关联的 CloudFormation 堆栈。这是该场景所要求的原生集成。

请参阅 [CodeConnections sync configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/configurations.html) 和 [How CloudFormation Git sync works](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/git-sync-concepts-terms.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. 为经批准的提供商添加 SCP allow

SCP 设置账户可获得的最大权限；它们本身并不授予权限。更重要的是，OU 已具有广泛的允许覆盖范围。为经批准的提供商添加另一个条件 `Allow`，并不会拒绝为其他提供商创建连接。该限制需要 A 中的显式条件拒绝。请参阅 [SCP evaluation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/organizations/latest/userguide/orgs_manage_policies_scps_evaluation.html)。

### D. 在每个区域中创建连接

这并非必需，因为 CodeConnections 连接是全局的，并会在各区域间复制。AWS 指出，一个连接只需创建一次，便可在任意区域中使用；即使其创建区域遇到问题，也可从其他区域使用。因此，创建每区域重复连接并不是预期的可用性设计。请参阅 [Global resources in AWS CodeConnections](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/welcome-connections-how-it-works-global.html)。

### F. 为每个存储库创建 CodePipeline 管道

可以设计基于 CodePipeline 的部署方式，但对于所要求的原生 CloudFormation 集成而言并非必需。Repository links 和 `CFN_STACK_SYNC` 同步配置可将存储库更改直接连接到 CloudFormation Git sync。为每个存储库增加单独的管道会引入不必要的组件，也不符合 E 中所述的专用方法。请参阅 [CodeConnections sync configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dtconsole/latest/userguide/configurations.html)。

**答案：A、C、E**

en.question: A DevOps engineer updates an AWS CloudFormation stack to add a nested stack that includes several Amazon EC2 instances. When the DevOps engineer attempts to deploy the updated stack, the nested stack fails to deploy. What should the DevOps engineer do to determine the cause of the failure?

options.A: Use the CloudFormation detect root cause capability for the failed stack to analyze the failure and return the event that is the most likely cause for the failure.
options.B: Query failed stacks by specifying the root stack as the ParentId property. Examine the StackStatusReason property for all returned stacks to determine the reason the nested stack failed to deploy.
options.C: Activate AWS Systems Manager for the AWS account where the application runs. Use the AWS Systems Manager Automation AWS-SupportTroubleshootCFNCustomResource runbook to determine the reason the nested stack failed to deploy.
options.D: Configure the CloudFormation template to publish logs to Amazon CloudWatch. View the CloudFormation logs for the failed stack in the CloudWatch console to determine the reason the nested stack failed to deploy.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The deployment failure occurred inside a **nested CloudFormation stack**. The engineer needs to trace the failed child stack associated with the root stack and inspect CloudFormation's recorded failure reason.

## Correct answer: B

CloudFormation returns the following fields in a stack description:

- `ParentId`: the stack ID of the nested stack's direct parent. For a first-level nested stack, this is also the root stack.
- `StackStatusReason`: the success or failure message associated with the stack's status.

Therefore, the engineer can retrieve the failed stack descriptions, identify the nested stack whose `ParentId` matches the root stack ID, and inspect its `StackStatusReason`. If that reason points only to a failed resource, the engineer can then drill into the nested stack's events and inspect the relevant `ResourceStatusReason`. AWS documents that stack events provide the sequence of events leading to a deployment failure. See the [`Stack` API data type](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_Stack.html) and [viewing CloudFormation stack events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/view-stack-events.html).

A wording nuance is that `ParentId` is a field returned in a `Stack` object rather than a direct server-side request parameter of `DescribeStacks` or `ListStacks`; in practice, the returned stack descriptions can be filtered programmatically by `ParentId`. `ListStacks` can first narrow results by failed stack status. See [`DescribeStacks`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeStacks.html) and [`ListStacks`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_ListStacks.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Detect root cause

CloudFormation does provide a **Detect root cause** feature that identifies the event most likely to have caused a failure. However, AWS explicitly states that **nested stacks do not support Detect root cause**. Therefore, this capability cannot be used for the failed nested stack in this scenario. See [Determine the cause of a stack failure](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/determine-root-cause-for-stack-failures.html).

### C. Systems Manager custom-resource runbook

`AWSSupport-TroubleshootCFNCustomResource` is specifically designed to diagnose failures involving a **CloudFormation custom resource**, including its service token and returned error message. The question describes a nested stack containing EC2 instances and does not mention a custom resource, so this runbook is not applicable. See [`AWSSupport-TroubleshootCFNCustomResource`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-awssupport-TroubleshootCFNCustomResource.html).

### D. Publish CloudFormation logs to CloudWatch

CloudFormation deployment diagnostics are natively recorded as **stack and resource events**. A template is not configured to publish general CloudFormation service deployment logs to CloudWatch Logs. The engineer should inspect the nested stack's status reason and events instead. AWS documents the Events tab and `describe-stack-events` as the mechanisms for understanding the sequence that led to a stack failure. See [View CloudFormation stack events](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/view-stack-events.html).

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师更新了一个 AWS CloudFormation 堆栈，以添加一个包含多个 Amazon EC2 实例的嵌套堆栈。当该 DevOps 工程师尝试部署更新后的堆栈时，嵌套堆栈部署失败。DevOps 工程师应如何确定失败原因？

options.A: 对失败的堆栈使用 CloudFormation 的 detect root cause 功能来分析失败情况，并返回最可能导致失败的事件。
options.B: 通过将根堆栈指定为 ParentId 属性来查询失败的堆栈。检查所有返回堆栈的 StackStatusReason 属性，以确定嵌套堆栈部署失败的原因。
options.C: 为应用程序运行所在的 AWS 账户激活 AWS Systems Manager。使用 AWS Systems Manager Automation 的 AWS-SupportTroubleshootCFNCustomResource 运行手册来确定嵌套堆栈部署失败的原因。
options.D: 配置 CloudFormation 模板以将日志发布到 Amazon CloudWatch。在 CloudWatch 控制台中查看失败堆栈的 CloudFormation 日志，以确定嵌套堆栈部署失败的原因。

zh.explanation:
## 题目考查内容

部署失败发生在一个**嵌套 CloudFormation 堆栈**内部。工程师需要追踪与根堆栈关联的失败子堆栈，并检查 CloudFormation 记录的失败原因。

## 正确答案：B

CloudFormation 会在堆栈描述中返回以下字段：

- `ParentId`：嵌套堆栈直接父堆栈的堆栈 ID。对于一级嵌套堆栈，该 ID 同时也是根堆栈。
- `StackStatusReason`：与堆栈状态关联的成功或失败消息。

因此，工程师可以检索失败堆栈的描述，识别其 `ParentId` 与根堆栈 ID 匹配的嵌套堆栈，并检查其 `StackStatusReason`。如果该原因仅指向一个失败的资源，工程师随后可以深入查看嵌套堆栈的事件，并检查相关的 `ResourceStatusReason`。AWS 文档指出，堆栈事件提供了导致部署失败的事件序列。请参阅 [`Stack` API 数据类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_Stack.html) 和 [查看 CloudFormation 堆栈事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/view-stack-events.html)。

有一个措辞上的细微差别：`ParentId` 是在 `Stack` 对象中返回的字段，而不是 `DescribeStacks` 或 `ListStacks` 的直接服务端请求参数；在实际操作中，可以按 `ParentId` 以编程方式筛选返回的堆栈描述。`ListStacks` 可以先按失败的堆栈状态缩小结果范围。请参阅 [`DescribeStacks`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeStacks.html) 和 [`ListStacks`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/APIReference/API_ListStacks.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. Detect root cause

CloudFormation 确实提供了 **Detect root cause** 功能，用于识别最可能导致失败的事件。但是，AWS 明确指出，**嵌套堆栈不支持 Detect root cause**。因此，在此场景中，不能对失败的嵌套堆栈使用该功能。请参阅 [确定堆栈失败的原因](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/determine-root-cause-for-stack-failures.html)。

### C. Systems Manager 自定义资源运行手册

`AWSSupport-TroubleshootCFNCustomResource` 专门用于诊断涉及 **CloudFormation 自定义资源**的失败，包括其服务令牌和返回的错误消息。题目描述的是包含 EC2 实例的嵌套堆栈，并未提及自定义资源，因此该运行手册不适用。请参阅 [`AWSSupport-TroubleshootCFNCustomResource`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager-automation-runbooks/latest/userguide/automation-awssupport-TroubleshootCFNCustomResource.html)。

### D. 将 CloudFormation 日志发布到 CloudWatch

CloudFormation 的部署诊断信息会原生记录为**堆栈和资源事件**。不会通过配置模板将通用 CloudFormation 服务部署日志发布到 CloudWatch Logs。工程师应改为检查嵌套堆栈的状态原因和事件。AWS 文档将 Events 选项卡和 `describe-stack-events` 列为了解导致堆栈失败的事件序列的机制。请参阅 [查看 CloudFormation 堆栈事件](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/view-stack-events.html)。

en.question: A DevOps team operates an integration service that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The DevOps team uses Amazon Route 53 to manage the integration service's domain name by using a simple routing record. The integration service is stateful and uses Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for data storage and state storage. The integration service does not support load balancing between multiple nodes. The DevOps team deploys the integration service on a new EC2 instance as a warm standby to reduce the mean time to recovery. The DevOps team wants the integration service to automatically fail over to the standby EC2 instance. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the existing Route 53 DNS record's routing policy to weighted. Set the existing DNS record's weighting to 100. For the same domain, add a new DNS record that points to the standby EC2 instance. Set the new DNS record's weighting to 0. Associate an application health check with each record.
options.B: Update the existing Route 53 DNS record's routing policy to weighted. Set the existing DNS record's weighting to 99. For the same domain, add a new DNS record that points to the standby EC2 instance. Set the new DNS record's weighting to 1. Associate an application health check with each record.
options.C: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Update the existing Route 53 record to point to the ALB. Create a target group for each EC2 instance. Configure an application health check on each target group. Associate both target groups with the same ALB listener. Set the primary target group's weighting to 100. Set the standby target group's weighting to 0.
options.D: Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Update the existing Route 53 record to point to the ALB. Create a target group for each EC2 instance. Configure an application health check on each target group. Associate both target groups with the same ALB listener. Set the primary target group's weighting to 99. Set the standby target group's weighting to 1.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The service requires an **active/warm-standby** design, not active-active load balancing. During normal operation, all client traffic must go to the primary EC2 instance. If the primary application becomes unhealthy, DNS should automatically direct new connections to the standby instance. Because both instances use Amazon EFS for shared data and state storage, the standby can access the required persistent state after failover.

## Correct answer: A

Configure two **Route 53 weighted records** for the same domain and record type:

- Primary EC2 instance: weight **100**
- Standby EC2 instance: weight **0**
- Associate an application health check with each record

AWS documents that when weighted records include both nonzero and zero weights, Route 53 initially considers only the records with nonzero weights. If all nonzero-weight records are unhealthy, Route 53 then considers the zero-weight records. Therefore, the standby receives no traffic while the primary is healthy but becomes eligible when the primary health check fails. This implements automatic DNS-based failover without normally sending traffic to both stateful nodes. See [Health checks and weighted routing](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### B. Route 53 weights 99 and 1

A weight of 1 makes the standby eligible for a portion of normal production traffic. Approximately 1% of DNS responses would select the standby while both records are healthy. That creates active-active traffic distribution, which conflicts with the statement that the stateful service does not support load balancing between multiple nodes.

### C. ALB target-group weights 100 and 0

Although a zero target-group weight prevents normal traffic from reaching the standby, this does **not** provide the required automatic health-based failover. AWS explicitly states that when an ALB listener rule distributes traffic among weighted target groups and one target group is empty or contains only unhealthy targets, the ALB does **not automatically fail over** to a target group containing healthy targets. See [Application Load Balancer forward actions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html).

Thus, if the primary target group becomes unhealthy, the ALB does not automatically transfer its weight to the zero-weight standby target group.

### D. ALB target-group weights 99 and 1

This option has two problems:

1. The standby would receive some normal production traffic, contrary to the service's single-active-node requirement.
2. Weighted ALB target groups do not automatically fail over to another healthy target group when the selected target group has only unhealthy targets.

Therefore, **A** is the only option that provides a true warm-standby configuration with automatic application-health-based traffic failover.

zh.question: 一个 DevOps 团队运营一项运行在 Amazon EC2 实例上的集成服务。该 DevOps 团队使用 Amazon Route 53 通过简单路由记录来管理该集成服务的域名。该集成服务是有状态的，并使用 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 进行数据和状态存储。该集成服务不支持在多个节点之间进行负载均衡。为了缩短平均恢复时间，DevOps 团队将该集成服务部署在一个新的 EC2 实例上，作为热备用。DevOps 团队希望该集成服务能够自动故障转移到备用 EC2 实例。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 将现有 Route 53 DNS 记录的路由策略更新为加权。将现有 DNS 记录的权重设置为 100。对于相同的域名，添加一条指向备用 EC2 实例的新 DNS 记录。将新 DNS 记录的权重设置为 0。为每条记录关联一个应用程序运行状况检查。
options.B: 将现有 Route 53 DNS 记录的路由策略更新为加权。将现有 DNS 记录的权重设置为 99。对于相同的域名，添加一条指向备用 EC2 实例的新 DNS 记录。将新 DNS 记录的权重设置为 1。为每条记录关联一个应用程序运行状况检查。
options.C: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。更新现有 Route 53 记录，使其指向 ALB。为每个 EC2 实例创建一个目标组。在每个目标组上配置应用程序运行状况检查。将两个目标组关联到同一个 ALB 监听器。将主目标组的权重设置为 100。将备用目标组的权重设置为 0。
options.D: 创建一个 Application Load Balancer (ALB)。更新现有 Route 53 记录，使其指向 ALB。为每个 EC2 实例创建一个目标组。在每个目标组上配置应用程序运行状况检查。将两个目标组关联到同一个 ALB 监听器。将主目标组的权重设置为 99。将备用目标组的权重设置为 1。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该服务需要采用 **活动/热备用** 设计，而不是主动-主动负载均衡。在正常运行期间，所有客户端流量都必须流向主 EC2 实例。如果主应用程序变得不健康，DNS 应自动将新连接定向到备用实例。由于两个实例都使用 Amazon EFS 进行共享数据和状态存储，因此备用实例可以在故障转移后访问所需的持久状态。

## 正确答案：A

为相同域名和记录类型配置两条 **Route 53 加权记录**：

- 主 EC2 实例：权重 **100**
- 备用 EC2 实例：权重 **0**
- 为每条记录关联一个应用程序运行状况检查

AWS 文档指出，当加权记录同时包含非零权重和零权重时，Route 53 最初只考虑权重非零的记录。如果所有非零权重记录都不健康，Route 53 随后会考虑零权重记录。因此，主实例处于健康状态时，备用实例不会接收流量；但在主实例的运行状况检查失败时，备用实例将变为可用。这在通常不向两个有状态节点同时发送流量的情况下，实现了基于 DNS 的自动故障转移。请参阅 [运行状况检查和加权路由](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/Route53/latest/DeveloperGuide/routing-policy-weighted.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

### B. Route 53 权重 99 和 1

权重为 1 会使备用实例有资格接收一部分正常生产流量。当两条记录都处于健康状态时，大约 1% 的 DNS 响应会选择备用实例。这会形成主动-主动流量分配，与该有状态服务不支持在多个节点之间进行负载均衡的说明相冲突。

### C. ALB 目标组权重 100 和 0

尽管零目标组权重可以防止正常流量到达备用实例，但这 **不能** 提供所需的基于运行状况的自动故障转移。AWS 明确指出，当 ALB 监听器规则在加权目标组之间分配流量，而其中一个目标组为空或仅包含不健康目标时，ALB **不会自动故障转移** 到包含健康目标的目标组。请参阅 [Application Load Balancer 转发操作](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/rule-action-types.html)。

因此，如果主目标组变得不健康，ALB 不会自动将其权重转移到权重为零的备用目标组。

### D. ALB 目标组权重 99 和 1

此选项存在两个问题：

1. 备用实例会接收一部分正常生产流量，这违背了该服务的单活动节点要求。
2. 当所选目标组仅包含不健康目标时，加权 ALB 目标组不会自动故障转移到另一个健康目标组。

因此，只有 **A** 能够提供具备基于应用程序运行状况自动流量故障转移功能的真正热备用配置。

en.question: A company hosts several applications in an AWS account. Each application sends logs to its own log group in Amazon CloudWatch. The company's CloudWatch costs for ingestion are increasing. A DevOps engineer needs to identify which applications are the source of the increased logging costs. Which solution will meet this requirement in the MOST operationally efficient way?

options.A: Use CloudWatch metrics to create a custom expression that identifies the CloudWatch log groups that receive the most data.
options.B: Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights to create a query for the application log groups to identify the number of log groups that received data during a specific time period.
options.C: Use AWS Cost Explorer to generate a cost report that details costs for CloudWatch usage.
options.D: Use AWS CloudTrail to filter for CreateLogStream events for each application.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The company needs to attribute rising **CloudWatch Logs ingestion** costs to the applications producing the most log data. Because each application writes to a separate log group, the most direct comparison is the amount of data ingested per `LogGroupName`.

## Correct answer: A

CloudWatch Logs automatically publishes the `IncomingBytes` metric in the `AWS/Logs` namespace. With the `LogGroupName` dimension, this metric reports the volume of **uncompressed bytes uploaded to each log group**. Therefore, a CloudWatch metric expression—most precisely, a CloudWatch Metrics Insights query—can rank the log groups by total incoming bytes for the relevant period.

AWS provides the exact pattern for this use case:

```sql
SELECT SUM(IncomingBytes)
FROM SCHEMA("AWS/Logs", LogGroupName)
GROUP BY LogGroupName
ORDER BY SUM() DESC LIMIT 10
```

This returns the log groups receiving the most bytes, directly identifying the applications driving ingestion volume and therefore ingestion cost. It uses metrics that CloudWatch Logs already publishes, so it requires no custom log parsing or additional data collection. See [CloudWatch Metrics Insights query examples](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch-metrics-insights-queryexamples.html) and [CloudWatch Logs metrics](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CloudWatch-Logs-Monitoring-CloudWatch-Metrics.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. CloudWatch Logs Insights query:** Counting how many log groups received data does not determine **how many bytes** each log group ingested. A low-volume and a high-volume application would each count as one active log group. Logs Insights also analyzes stored log events and can itself incur `DataScanned-Bytes` query charges; it is less direct than using the existing per-log-group `IncomingBytes` metric. AWS distinguishes ingestion (`DataProcessing-Bytes`) from Logs Insights analysis (`DataScanned-Bytes`) in its [CloudWatch cost and usage documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch_billing.html).

- **C. AWS Cost Explorer report:** Cost Explorer is useful for analyzing CloudWatch costs by dimensions such as usage type and, when specifically configured, resource. However, the option only proposes a general report detailing CloudWatch usage. That does not as directly or operationally efficiently identify the highest-ingesting application log groups as ranking the already-published `IncomingBytes` metric. Cost Explorer also works from billing data rather than the direct operational ingestion metric.

- **D. CloudTrail `CreateLogStream` events:** `CreateLogStream` indicates that a log stream was created; it does not measure the amount of log data subsequently uploaded. CloudTrail records API requests and their details, not per-log-group ingestion-byte totals. See [Logging CloudWatch Logs API calls with CloudTrail](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/logging_cw_api_calls_cwl.html).

**Answer: A**

zh.question: 一家公司在一个 AWS 账户中托管多个应用程序。每个应用程序将日志发送到 Amazon CloudWatch 中各自的日志组。该公司的 CloudWatch 摄取成本正在增加。DevOps 工程师需要确定哪些应用程序是日志记录成本增加的来源。哪种解决方案能够以运营效率最高的方式满足此要求？

options.A: 使用 CloudWatch 指标创建一个自定义表达式，以识别接收数据最多的 CloudWatch 日志组。
options.B: 使用 Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights 为应用程序日志组创建查询，以确定在特定时间段内接收数据的日志组数量。
options.C: 使用 AWS Cost Explorer 生成一份详细说明 CloudWatch 使用成本的成本报告。
options.D: 使用 AWS CloudTrail 筛选每个应用程序的 `CreateLogStream` 事件。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

公司需要将不断增加的 **CloudWatch Logs 摄取**成本归因于产生最多日志数据的应用程序。由于每个应用程序写入独立的日志组，最直接的比较方式是按 `LogGroupName` 查看摄取的数据量。

## 正确答案：A

CloudWatch Logs 会在 `AWS/Logs` 命名空间中自动发布 `IncomingBytes` 指标。通过 `LogGroupName` 维度，该指标会报告**上传到每个日志组的未压缩字节数**。因此，CloudWatch 指标表达式——更准确地说是 CloudWatch Metrics Insights 查询——可以按照相关时间段内的传入字节总数对日志组进行排序。

AWS 为此使用场景提供了确切的模式：

```sql
SELECT SUM(IncomingBytes)
FROM SCHEMA("AWS/Logs", LogGroupName)
GROUP BY LogGroupName
ORDER BY SUM() DESC LIMIT 10
```

此查询会返回接收字节数最多的日志组，直接识别出推动摄取量以及相应摄取成本的应用程序。它使用 CloudWatch Logs 已发布的指标，因此无需自定义日志解析或额外的数据收集。请参阅 [CloudWatch Metrics Insights 查询示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch-metrics-insights-queryexamples.html) 和 [CloudWatch Logs 指标](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/CloudWatch-Logs-Monitoring-CloudWatch-Metrics.html)。

## 其他选项为何不正确

- **B. CloudWatch Logs Insights 查询：** 统计接收数据的日志组数量，无法确定每个日志组摄取了**多少字节**。低流量和高流量应用程序都会各计为一个活跃日志组。Logs Insights 还会分析已存储的日志事件，并且自身可能产生 `DataScanned-Bytes` 查询费用；与使用现有的按日志组划分的 `IncomingBytes` 指标相比，它不够直接。AWS 在其 [CloudWatch 成本和使用量文档](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch_billing.html) 中区分了摄取 (`DataProcessing-Bytes`) 和 Logs Insights 分析 (`DataScanned-Bytes`)。

- **C. AWS Cost Explorer 报告：** Cost Explorer 可用于按使用类型以及在特定配置下按资源等维度分析 CloudWatch 成本。但是，该选项仅建议生成一份详细说明 CloudWatch 使用情况的通用报告。与对已发布的 `IncomingBytes` 指标进行排序相比，这种方式无法如此直接且高效地识别摄取量最高的应用程序日志组。Cost Explorer 还依赖账单数据，而不是直接的运营摄取指标。

- **D. CloudTrail `CreateLogStream` 事件：** `CreateLogStream` 表示已创建日志流；它并不衡量随后上传的日志数据量。CloudTrail 记录 API 请求及其详细信息，而不记录按日志组划分的摄取字节总量。请参阅 [使用 CloudTrail 记录 CloudWatch Logs API 调用](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/logs/logging_cw_api_calls_cwl.html)。

**答案：A**

en.question: A company has an AWS account named PipelineAccount. The account manages a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline. The account uses an IAM role named CodePipeline_Service_Role and produces an artifact that is stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company uses a customer managed AWS KMS key to encrypt objects in the S3 bucket. A DevOps engineer wants to configure the pipeline to use an AWS CodeDeploy application in an AWS account named CodeDeployAccount to deploy the produced artifact. The DevOps engineer updates the KMS key policy to grant the CodeDeployAccount account permission to use the key. The DevOps engineer configures an IAM role named DevOps_Role in the CodeDeployAccount account that has access to the CodeDeploy resources that the pipeline requires. The DevOps engineer updates an Amazon EC2 instance role that operates within the CodeDeployAccount account to allow access to the S3 bucket and the KMS key that is in the PipelineAccount account. Which additional steps will meet these requirements?

options.A: Update the S3 bucket policy to grant the CodeDeployAccount account access to the S3 bucket. Configure the DevOps_Role IAM role to have an IAM trust policy that allows the PipelineAccount account to assume the role. Update the CodePipeline_Service_Role IAM role to grant permission to assume the DevOps_Role role.
options.B: Update the S3 bucket policy to grant the CodeDeployAccount account access to the S3 bucket. Configure the DevOps_Role IAM role to have an IAM trust policy that allows the PipelineAccount account to assume the role. Update the DevOps_Role IAM role to grant permission to assume CodePipelfne_Service_Role role.
options.C: Update the S3 bucket policy to grant the PipelineAccount account access to the S3 bucket. Configure the DevOps_Role IAM role to have an IAM trust policy that allows the PipelineAccount account to assume the role. Update the CodePipeline_Service_Role IAM to grant permission to assume the DevOps_Role role.
options.D: Update the S3 bucket policy to grant the CodeDeployAccount account access to the S3 bucket. Configure the DevOps_Role IAM role to have an IAM trust policy that allows the CodeDeployAccount account to assume the role. Update the CodePipeline_Service_Role IAM role to grant permission to assume the DevOps_Role role.

en.explanation:
## Scenario and requirement

The pipeline and encrypted S3 artifact are owned by **PipelineAccount**, while the CodeDeploy application and deployment resources are owned by **CodeDeployAccount**. This is a cross-account CodePipeline action. The remaining configuration must establish both:

1. **Resource access** from CodeDeployAccount to the artifact bucket.
2. **Role assumption** from the CodePipeline service role in PipelineAccount to the deployment role in CodeDeployAccount.

AWS documents this exact pattern: the pipeline account must grant the other account access to the artifact bucket and allow its CodePipeline service role to assume the cross-account role; the resource-owning account must configure that role to trust the pipeline account—preferably the specific CodePipeline service role—and grant it the required CodeDeploy and S3 permissions. See [Create a pipeline in CodePipeline that uses resources from another AWS account](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-create-cross-account.html).

## Correct answer: A

- Update the artifact **S3 bucket policy** in PipelineAccount to grant **CodeDeployAccount** access.
- Configure `DevOps_Role` in CodeDeployAccount with a trust policy that permits assumption from PipelineAccount. In a least-privilege implementation, the trusted principal should be scoped specifically to `CodePipeline_Service_Role` rather than the entire account.
- Add `sts:AssumeRole` permission to `CodePipeline_Service_Role`, authorizing it to assume `DevOps_Role` in CodeDeployAccount.

This completes the two sides of cross-account role assumption: the target role trusts the caller, and the caller's identity policy permits `sts:AssumeRole`. The question already states that the KMS key policy, the CodeDeploy permissions on `DevOps_Role`, and the EC2 instance role's S3/KMS permissions have been configured.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B:** The role-assumption permission is attached in the wrong direction. `DevOps_Role` does not need permission to assume `CodePipeline_Service_Role`; CodePipeline's service role must assume `DevOps_Role` so that the pipeline action can operate on the cross-account CodeDeploy resources.

- **C:** The artifact bucket already belongs to PipelineAccount. Granting PipelineAccount access does not provide the required cross-account access to CodeDeployAccount. The bucket policy must grant access to the cross-account principal/account that needs to retrieve the pipeline artifact.

- **D:** `DevOps_Role` is in CodeDeployAccount, so trusting CodeDeployAccount does not establish trust for the caller in PipelineAccount. The target role must trust the PipelineAccount principal—ideally the specific `CodePipeline_Service_Role`—that will assume it.

zh.question: 一家公司有一个名为 PipelineAccount 的 AWS 账户。该账户在 AWS CodePipeline 中管理一个管道。该账户使用一个名为 CodePipeline_Service_Role 的 IAM 角色，并生成一个存储在 Amazon S3 存储桶中的构件。该公司使用客户自主管理的 AWS KMS 密钥对 S3 存储桶中的对象进行加密。一名 DevOps 工程师希望将该管道配置为使用名为 CodeDeployAccount 的 AWS 账户中的 AWS CodeDeploy 应用程序来部署生成的构件。该 DevOps 工程师更新 KMS 密钥策略，以授予 CodeDeployAccount 账户使用该密钥的权限。该 DevOps 工程师在 CodeDeployAccount 账户中配置了一个名为 DevOps_Role 的 IAM 角色，该角色可以访问管道所需的 CodeDeploy 资源。该 DevOps 工程师更新了一个在 CodeDeployAccount 账户中运行的 Amazon EC2 实例角色，以允许其访问位于 PipelineAccount 账户中的 S3 存储桶和 KMS 密钥。还需要执行哪些步骤才能满足这些要求？

options.A: 更新 S3 存储桶策略，以授予 CodeDeployAccount 账户访问该 S3 存储桶的权限。将 DevOps_Role IAM 角色配置为具有允许 PipelineAccount 账户担任该角色的 IAM 信任策略。更新 CodePipeline_Service_Role IAM 角色，以授予其担任 DevOps_Role 角色的权限。
options.B: 更新 S3 存储桶策略，以授予 CodeDeployAccount 账户访问该 S3 存储桶的权限。将 DevOps_Role IAM 角色配置为具有允许 PipelineAccount 账户担任该角色的 IAM 信任策略。更新 DevOps_Role IAM 角色，以授予其担任 CodePipelfne_Service_Role 角色的权限。
options.C: 更新 S3 存储桶策略，以授予 PipelineAccount 账户访问该 S3 存储桶的权限。将 DevOps_Role IAM 角色配置为具有允许 PipelineAccount 账户担任该角色的 IAM 信任策略。更新 CodePipeline_Service_Role IAM，以授予其担任 DevOps_Role 角色的权限。
options.D: 更新 S3 存储桶策略，以授予 CodeDeployAccount 账户访问该 S3 存储桶的权限。将 DevOps_Role IAM 角色配置为具有允许 CodeDeployAccount 账户担任该角色的 IAM 信任策略。更新 CodePipeline_Service_Role IAM 角色，以授予其担任 DevOps_Role 角色的权限。

zh.explanation:
## 场景和要求

管道和加密的 S3 构件归 **PipelineAccount** 所有，而 CodeDeploy 应用程序和部署资源归 **CodeDeployAccount** 所有。这是一个跨账户 CodePipeline 操作。其余配置必须同时建立以下两项：

1. 从 CodeDeployAccount 对构件存储桶的**资源访问权限**。
2. 从 PipelineAccount 中的 CodePipeline 服务角色到 CodeDeployAccount 中部署角色的**角色担任权限**。

AWS 记录了这一确切模式：管道账户必须授予另一个账户对构件存储桶的访问权限，并允许其 CodePipeline 服务角色担任跨账户角色；资源所属账户必须将该角色配置为信任管道账户——最好是特定的 CodePipeline 服务角色——并授予其所需的 CodeDeploy 和 S3 权限。请参阅 [在 CodePipeline 中创建使用其他 AWS 账户资源的管道](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/pipelines-create-cross-account.html)。

## 正确答案：A

- 更新 PipelineAccount 中构件 **S3 存储桶策略**，以授予 **CodeDeployAccount** 访问权限。
- 在 CodeDeployAccount 中为 `DevOps_Role` 配置信任策略，允许由 PipelineAccount 担任该角色。在最小权限实现中，应将受信任主体明确限定为 `CodePipeline_Service_Role`，而不是整个账户。
- 向 `CodePipeline_Service_Role` 添加 `sts:AssumeRole` 权限，授权其担任 CodeDeployAccount 中的 `DevOps_Role`。

这完成了跨账户角色担任的两个方面：目标角色信任调用方，并且调用方的身份策略允许 `sts:AssumeRole`。题目已经说明，KMS 密钥策略、`DevOps_Role` 上的 CodeDeploy 权限，以及 EC2 实例角色的 S3/KMS 权限均已配置完成。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B：** 角色担任权限附加的方向错误。`DevOps_Role` 不需要具有担任 `CodePipeline_Service_Role` 的权限；CodePipeline 的服务角色必须担任 `DevOps_Role`，以便管道操作能够使用跨账户的 CodeDeploy 资源。

- **C：** 构件存储桶已经属于 PipelineAccount。向 PipelineAccount 授予访问权限并不能提供 CodeDeployAccount 所需的跨账户访问权限。存储桶策略必须向需要检索管道构件的跨账户主体或账户授予访问权限。

- **D：** `DevOps_Role` 位于 CodeDeployAccount 中，因此信任 CodeDeployAccount 并不能为位于 PipelineAccount 中的调用方建立信任关系。目标角色必须信任将要担任它的 PipelineAccount 主体——理想情况下是特定的 `CodePipeline_Service_Role`。

en.question: A company has multiple development teams in separate business units that work in a single shared AWS account. All Amazon EC2 resources that users create in the account must include tags that specify which user created the resources. The tagging must occur within the first hour of resource creation. A DevOps engineer needs to add tags to new resources that include the ID of the user that created the resource and the appropriate cost center ID. The DevOps engineer configures an AWS Lambda function to use the cost center mappings to tag the resources. The DevOps engineer also sets up AWS CloudTrail in the shared AWS account. An Amazon S3 bucket stores the CloudTrail event logs. Which solution will meet the tagging requirements?

options.A: Create an S3 event notification on the S3 bucket to invoke the Lambda function for s3:ObjectTagging:Put events. Enable bucket versioning on the S3 bucket.
options.B: Enable server access logging on the S3 bucket. Create an S3 event notification on the S3 bucket for s3:ObjectTagging:* events.
options.C: Enable AWS Config in the account. Configure the required-tags AWS managed rule to check and update the required tags.
options.D: Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that uses Amazon EC2 as the event source. Configure the rule to match events that CloudTrail delivers. Configure the rule to target the Lambda function.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The company needs an event-driven mechanism that detects newly created EC2 resources, identifies the caller, maps that identity to a cost center, and invokes the existing Lambda function quickly enough to add the tags within one hour.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an Amazon EventBridge rule that uses Amazon EC2 as the event source, matches API events delivered through CloudTrail, and targets the Lambda function.**

CloudTrail records EC2 management API activity, such as resource-creation calls. EventBridge can match an **Amazon EC2 — AWS API Call via CloudTrail** event and route the matching event directly to Lambda. AWS documents this exact integration pattern: select EC2 as the source, select **AWS API Call via CloudTrail**, specify the EC2 API operation, and choose Lambda as the target ([EventBridge tutorial](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html)).

The Lambda function can extract the resource identifiers from the creation event and determine the creator from the CloudTrail `userIdentity` data. CloudTrail identity fields include `principalId`, `arn`, `userName`, session information, and, where configured, `sourceIdentity`, which can identify the original user operating through an assumed role ([CloudTrail `userIdentity` fields](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html)). The function can then use the configured identity-to-cost-center mapping and tag the new resources shortly after creation, comfortably meeting the one-hour requirement.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

An `s3:ObjectTagging:Put` notification occurs when tags are added to or changed on an **S3 object**. It does not represent creation of an EC2 resource. CloudTrail delivering log files to the bucket creates S3 objects; it does not perform an S3 object-tagging operation that would make this notification useful. S3 object tagging specifically manages key-value tags associated with S3 objects ([S3 object tagging](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-tagging.html)). Bucket versioning does not change that behavior or help identify EC2 resource creators.

### B. Incorrect

S3 server access logging records requests made to the S3 bucket, not EC2 resource-creation activity. Likewise, S3 object-tagging notifications concern tag operations on S3 objects, not API calls that create EC2 instances, volumes, network interfaces, or other EC2 resources. This option also does not specify the existing Lambda function as a notification destination.

### C. Incorrect

The AWS Config `required-tags` managed rule **checks** whether supported resources have specified tags; it does not itself derive the creator from CloudTrail and add the appropriate creator and cost-center values. AWS explicitly states that the managed `AWS-SetRequiredTags` automation document does not work as remediation for this rule and that custom remediation must be created ([AWS Config `required-tags`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html)). Therefore, merely enabling Config and configuring this rule to “check and update” tags does not implement the required workflow or provide the direct near-real-time response offered by EventBridge and Lambda.

zh.question: 一家公司在单个共享 AWS 账户中拥有多个分属不同业务部门的开发团队。用户在该账户中创建的所有 Amazon EC2 资源都必须包含用于指定资源创建者的标签。必须在资源创建后的第一个小时内完成标记。一名 DevOps 工程师需要为新资源添加标签，其中包括创建资源的用户 ID 和相应的成本中心 ID。该 DevOps 工程师配置了一个 AWS Lambda 函数，使用成本中心映射来为资源添加标签。该 DevOps 工程师还在共享 AWS 账户中设置了 AWS CloudTrail。Amazon S3 存储桶存储 CloudTrail 事件日志。哪种解决方案能够满足标记要求？

options.A: 在 S3 存储桶上创建 S3 事件通知，以便针对 `s3:ObjectTagging:Put` 事件调用 Lambda 函数。在 S3 存储桶上启用存储桶版本控制。
options.B: 在 S3 存储桶上启用服务器访问日志记录。在 S3 存储桶上为 `s3:ObjectTagging:*` 事件创建 S3 事件通知。
options.C: 在账户中启用 AWS Config。配置 `required-tags` AWS 托管规则来检查和更新所需标签。
options.D: 创建一个使用 Amazon EC2 作为事件源的 Amazon EventBridge 规则。配置该规则以匹配 CloudTrail 传送的事件。配置该规则以 Lambda 函数作为目标。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

公司需要一种事件驱动机制，用于检测新创建的 EC2 资源、识别调用方、将该身份映射到成本中心，并足够快速地调用现有 Lambda 函数，以便在一小时内添加标签。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 创建一个使用 Amazon EC2 作为事件源的 Amazon EventBridge 规则，匹配通过 CloudTrail 传送的 API 事件，并以 Lambda 函数作为目标。**

CloudTrail 会记录 EC2 管理 API 活动，例如资源创建调用。EventBridge 可以匹配 **Amazon EC2 — AWS API Call via CloudTrail** 事件，并将匹配的事件直接路由到 Lambda。AWS 记录了这一确切集成模式：选择 EC2 作为源，选择 **AWS API Call via CloudTrail**，指定 EC2 API 操作，并选择 Lambda 作为目标（[EventBridge 教程](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eventbridge/latest/userguide/eb-log-api-call.html)）。

Lambda 函数可以从创建事件中提取资源标识符，并根据 CloudTrail `userIdentity` 数据确定创建者。CloudTrail 身份字段包括 `principalId`、`arn`、`userName`、会话信息，以及在已配置的情况下可标识通过承担角色操作的原始用户的 `sourceIdentity`（[CloudTrail `userIdentity` 字段](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/cloudtrail-event-reference-user-identity.html)）。随后，该函数可以使用已配置的身份到成本中心映射，并在资源创建后不久为新资源添加标签，从容满足一小时的要求。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 错误

当向 **S3 对象** 添加或更改标签时，会发生 `s3:ObjectTagging:Put` 通知。它不表示 EC2 资源的创建。CloudTrail 将日志文件传送到存储桶时会创建 S3 对象；它不会执行能够使此通知有用的 S3 对象标记操作。S3 对象标记专门管理与 S3 对象关联的键值标签（[S3 对象标记](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/object-tagging.html)）。存储桶版本控制不会改变这种行为，也无法帮助识别 EC2 资源创建者。

### B. 错误

S3 服务器访问日志记录的是对 S3 存储桶发出的请求，而不是 EC2 资源创建活动。同样，S3 对象标记通知涉及 S3 对象上的标签操作，而不是创建 EC2 实例、卷、网络接口或其他 EC2 资源的 API 调用。该选项也未将现有 Lambda 函数指定为通知目标。

### C. 错误

AWS Config `required-tags` 托管规则会**检查**受支持资源是否具有指定标签；它本身不会从 CloudTrail 推导创建者，也不会添加适当的创建者和成本中心值。AWS 明确指出，托管 `AWS-SetRequiredTags` 自动化文档不能作为该规则的修复措施，必须创建自定义修复措施（[AWS Config `required-tags`](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/config/latest/developerguide/required-tags.html)）。因此，仅启用 Config 并将该规则配置为“检查和更新”标签，无法实现所需工作流程，也无法提供 EventBridge 和 Lambda 所提供的直接近实时响应。

en.question: A company is developing code and wants to use semantic versioning. The company's DevOps team needs to create a pipeline for compiling the code. The team also needs to manage versions of the compiled code. If the code uses any open source libraries, the libraries must also be cached in the build process. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an AWS CodeArtifact repository and associate the upstream repositories. Create an AWS CodeBuild project that builds the semantic version of the code artifacts. Configure the project to authenticate and connect to the CodeArtifact repository and publish the artifact to the repository.
options.B: Use AWS CodeDeploy to upload the generated semantic version of the artifact to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.
options.C: Use an AWS CodeBuild project to build the code and to publish the generated semantic version of the artifact to AWS Artifact. Configure build caching in the CodeBuild project.
options.D: Create a new AWS CodeArtifact repository. Create an AWS Lambda function that pulls open source packages from the internet and publishes the packages to the repository. Configure AWS CodeDeploy to build semantic versions of the code and publish the versions to the repository.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The solution must provide all three capabilities:

1. Compile/build the application code.
2. store and manage semantically versioned compiled packages.
3. Retrieve and cache open-source dependencies used during builds.

## Correct answer: A

**AWS CodeBuild** is the appropriate managed build service. Its build commands can compile the code, assign the required semantic version through the project's build tooling, and publish the resulting package.

**AWS CodeArtifact** is the appropriate package repository because a CodeArtifact package contains a set of package versions, and supported package-manager tools can publish new versions to a repository. AWS also documents the permissions and authentication needed for a CodeBuild project to read from and publish packages to CodeArtifact. See [Packages overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/packages-overview.html) and [Using Maven packages in CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/using-maven-packages-in-codebuild.html).

For open-source libraries, CodeArtifact can use upstream repositories and external connections to public registries such as Maven Central, npm, NuGet Gallery, PyPI, RubyGems, and crates.io. When a package is requested through this configuration, it is copied into CodeArtifact and retained for subsequent use, providing the required dependency caching behavior. See [Connect a CodeArtifact repository to a public repository](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/external-connection.html) and [Working with upstream repositories](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-upstream-behavior.html).

Thus, option A combines the correct build service with a version-aware package repository and native caching of public dependencies.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **B. CodeDeploy and Amazon EFS:** CodeDeploy automates deployment of already prepared application content; it is not the service that compiles code or manages package versions. An EFS file system can store files, but it does not provide package-manager repository semantics or native upstream dependency caching. AWS defines CodeDeploy specifically as a deployment service in [What is CodeDeploy?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html).

- **C. CodeBuild publishing to AWS Artifact:** CodeBuild is appropriate for compilation, but **AWS Artifact** is not a software artifact repository. It provides AWS security and compliance reports, legal agreements, compliance inquiry features, and related notifications. Therefore, it cannot receive and manage semantically versioned build packages. See [Getting started with AWS Artifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/getting-started.html). CodeBuild caching alone also does not replace a managed versioned package repository.

- **D. Lambda plus CodeDeploy:** The Lambda function unnecessarily reimplements functionality already provided by CodeArtifact external connections and upstream repositories. More importantly, CodeDeploy is a deployment service, not a build service, so it does not compile the code or create semantic package versions. CodeBuild should perform the compilation, while CodeArtifact should store the resulting versions and cache dependencies.

zh.question: 一家公司正在开发代码，并希望使用语义化版本控制。该公司的 DevOps 团队需要创建一个用于编译代码的管道。该团队还需要管理已编译代码的版本。如果代码使用任何开源库，则这些库也必须在构建过程中进行缓存。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 创建一个 AWS CodeArtifact 存储库并关联上游存储库。创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 项目，用于构建代码工件的语义化版本。配置该项目进行身份验证并连接到 CodeArtifact 存储库，然后将工件发布到该存储库。
options.B: 使用 AWS CodeDeploy 将生成的工件语义化版本上传到 Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) 文件系统。
options.C: 使用 AWS CodeBuild 项目构建代码，并将生成的工件语义化版本发布到 AWS Artifact。为 CodeBuild 项目配置构建缓存。
options.D: 创建一个新的 AWS CodeArtifact 存储库。创建一个 AWS Lambda 函数，从互联网拉取开源软件包并将这些软件包发布到该存储库。配置 AWS CodeDeploy 构建代码的语义化版本，并将这些版本发布到该存储库。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该解决方案必须提供以下三种能力：

1. 编译/构建应用程序代码。
2. 存储和管理使用语义化版本控制的已编译软件包。
3. 获取并缓存构建期间使用的开源依赖项。

## 正确答案：A

**AWS CodeBuild** 是合适的托管构建服务。其构建命令可以编译代码，通过项目的构建工具分配所需的语义化版本，并发布生成的软件包。

**AWS CodeArtifact** 是合适的软件包存储库，因为 CodeArtifact 软件包包含一组软件包版本，并且受支持的软件包管理器工具可以将新版本发布到存储库。AWS 还提供了有关 CodeBuild 项目从 CodeArtifact 读取软件包及向其发布软件包所需权限和身份验证的文档。请参阅 [Packages overview](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/packages-overview.html) 和 [Using Maven packages in CodeBuild](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/using-maven-packages-in-codebuild.html)。

对于开源库，CodeArtifact 可以使用上游存储库以及到公共注册表的外部连接，例如 Maven Central、npm、NuGet Gallery、PyPI、RubyGems 和 crates.io。当通过此配置请求软件包时，该软件包会被复制到 CodeArtifact 中并保留以供后续使用，从而提供所需的依赖项缓存行为。请参阅 [Connect a CodeArtifact repository to a public repository](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/external-connection.html) 和 [Working with upstream repositories](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codeartifact/latest/ug/repo-upstream-behavior.html)。

因此，选项 A 将正确的构建服务与支持版本管理的软件包存储库及公共依赖项的原生缓存相结合。

## 其他选项错误的原因

- **B. CodeDeploy 和 Amazon EFS：** CodeDeploy 可自动部署已准备好的应用程序内容；它不是用于编译代码或管理软件包版本的服务。EFS 文件系统可以存储文件，但不提供软件包管理器存储库语义或原生上游依赖项缓存。AWS 在 [What is CodeDeploy?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html) 中将 CodeDeploy 明确定义为部署服务。

- **C. CodeBuild 发布到 AWS Artifact：** CodeBuild 适合用于编译，但 **AWS Artifact** 不是软件工件存储库。它提供 AWS 安全性与合规性报告、法律协议、合规性查询功能及相关通知。因此，它无法接收和管理使用语义化版本控制的构建软件包。请参阅 [Getting started with AWS Artifact](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/artifact/latest/ug/getting-started.html)。仅使用 CodeBuild 缓存也无法替代受管理的版本化软件包存储库。

- **D. Lambda 加 CodeDeploy：** Lambda 函数不必要地重新实现了 CodeArtifact 外部连接和上游存储库已经提供的功能。更重要的是，CodeDeploy 是部署服务而不是构建服务，因此它不会编译代码或创建语义化软件包版本。应由 CodeBuild 执行编译，而 CodeArtifact 应存储生成的版本并缓存依赖项。

en.question: A company uses a pipeline in AWS CodePipeline to deploy an application. The company created an AWS Fault Injection Service (AWS FIS) experiment template to test the resiliency of the application. A DevOps engineer needs to integrate the experiment into the pipeline. Which solution will meet this requirement?

options.A: Configure a new stage in the pipeline that includes an AWS FIS action. Configure the action to reference the AWS FIS experiment template. Grant the pipeline access to start the experiment.
options.B: Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduler. Grant the scheduler permission to start the AWS FIS experiment. Configure a new stage in the pipeline that includes an action to invoke the EventBridge scheduler.
options.C: Create an AWS Lambda function to start the AWS FIS experiment. Grant the Lambda function permission to start the experiment. Create a new stage in the pipeline that has a Lambda action. Set the action to invoke the Lambda function.
options.D: Export the AWS FIS experiment template to an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS CodeBuild unit test project that has a buildspec that starts the AWS FIS experiment. Grant the CodeBuild project access to start the experiment. Configure a new stage in the pipeline that includes an action to run the CodeBuild unit test project.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The requirement is to add execution of an existing AWS Fault Injection Service (AWS FIS) experiment template to an AWS CodePipeline pipeline. The key distinction is that CodePipeline does **not** provide a native AWS FIS action provider, but it does provide an **AWS Lambda invoke action**. The Lambda function can call the AWS FIS `StartExperiment` operation for the specified experiment template.

## Correct answer: C

**Create a Lambda function that starts the FIS experiment, grant it permission to start the experiment, and invoke it from a Lambda action in a new CodePipeline stage.**

AWS documents that Lambda functions can be added as actions in CodePipeline to customize pipeline behavior and specifically shows how to add a Lambda action to a pipeline stage. The CodePipeline service role must be able to invoke the function, while the Lambda execution role must have permissions for the AWS operations performed by the function. See [Invoke an AWS Lambda function in a pipeline in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-invoke-lambda-function.html).

The Lambda function can call AWS FIS with the experiment template ID. AWS FIS supports starting an experiment from an existing template, and the caller can be granted `fis:StartExperiment` permission for the relevant template and experiment resources. See [Start an experiment from a template](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fis/latest/userguide/start-experiment-from-template.html) and the [AWS FIS IAM policy example for starting an experiment](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fis/latest/userguide/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html).

In a complete implementation, the Lambda action should also report success or failure to CodePipeline using `PutJobSuccessResult` or `PutJobFailureResult`, as described in the CodePipeline Lambda integration documentation.

## Why the other options are incorrect

- **A is incorrect:** CodePipeline has no native **AWS FIS action**. The official list of valid action providers includes AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, CodeBuild, and other providers, but not AWS FIS. Therefore, a pipeline action cannot directly reference an FIS experiment template. See [Valid action providers in CodePipeline](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-valid-providers.html).

- **B is incorrect:** EventBridge Scheduler is designed to invoke targets according to a schedule; it is not a native CodePipeline action provider that a pipeline stage can invoke. This also introduces an unnecessary time-based scheduling layer rather than directly running the experiment as part of that specific pipeline execution.

- **D is incorrect:** CodeBuild could technically execute AWS CLI or SDK commands if appropriately configured, but the proposed solution incorrectly requires exporting the FIS experiment template to Amazon S3. AWS FIS starts experiments directly from the existing managed experiment template; no S3 export is required. Using a CodeBuild unit-test project for this simple API invocation is also unnecessarily indirect compared with the supported Lambda invoke action.

Therefore, **C** is the intended and most direct supported solution.

zh.question: 一家公司使用 AWS CodePipeline 中的管道部署应用程序。该公司创建了一个 AWS Fault Injection Service (AWS FIS) 实验模板来测试应用程序的弹性。DevOps 工程师需要将该实验集成到管道中。哪种解决方案可以满足此要求？

options.A: 在管道中配置一个包含 AWS FIS 操作的新阶段。将该操作配置为引用 AWS FIS 实验模板。授予管道启动实验的权限。
options.B: 创建一个 Amazon EventBridge 调度器。授予该调度器启动 AWS FIS 实验的权限。在管道中配置一个新阶段，其中包含一个用于调用 EventBridge 调度器的操作。
options.C: 创建一个用于启动 AWS FIS 实验的 AWS Lambda 函数。授予 Lambda 函数启动实验的权限。在管道中创建一个具有 Lambda 操作的新阶段。将该操作设置为调用 Lambda 函数。
options.D: 将 AWS FIS 实验模板导出到 Amazon S3 存储桶。创建一个 AWS CodeBuild 单元测试项目，该项目具有用于启动 AWS FIS 实验的 buildspec。授予 CodeBuild 项目启动实验的权限。在管道中配置一个包含用于运行 CodeBuild 单元测试项目操作的新阶段。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

要求是在 AWS CodePipeline 管道中添加对现有 AWS Fault Injection Service (AWS FIS) 实验模板的执行。关键区别在于，CodePipeline **不**提供原生 AWS FIS 操作提供程序，但它提供 **AWS Lambda 调用操作**。Lambda 函数可以针对指定的实验模板调用 AWS FIS `StartExperiment` 操作。

## 正确答案：C

**创建一个启动 FIS 实验的 Lambda 函数，授予其启动实验的权限，并通过新 CodePipeline 阶段中的 Lambda 操作调用该函数。**

AWS 文档说明，可以将 Lambda 函数作为操作添加到 CodePipeline 中以自定义管道行为，并且专门展示了如何向管道阶段添加 Lambda 操作。CodePipeline 服务角色必须能够调用该函数，而 Lambda 执行角色必须拥有函数所执行 AWS 操作的权限。请参阅 [在 CodePipeline 的管道中调用 AWS Lambda 函数](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-invoke-lambda-function.html)。

Lambda 函数可以使用实验模板 ID 调用 AWS FIS。AWS FIS 支持从现有模板启动实验，并且可以向调用方授予相关模板和实验资源的 `fis:StartExperiment` 权限。请参阅 [从模板启动实验](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fis/latest/userguide/start-experiment-from-template.html) 和 [用于启动实验的 AWS FIS IAM 策略示例](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fis/latest/userguide/security_iam_id-based-policy-examples.html)。

在完整的实现中，Lambda 操作还应按照 CodePipeline Lambda 集成文档中的说明，使用 `PutJobSuccessResult` 或 `PutJobFailureResult` 向 CodePipeline 报告成功或失败。

## 其他选项为什么不正确

- **A 不正确：**CodePipeline 没有原生的 **AWS FIS 操作**。有效操作提供程序的官方列表包括 AWS Lambda、AWS Step Functions、CodeBuild 和其他提供程序，但不包括 AWS FIS。因此，管道操作无法直接引用 FIS 实验模板。请参阅 [CodePipeline 中有效的操作提供程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/actions-valid-providers.html)。

- **B 不正确：**EventBridge Scheduler 用于根据计划调用目标；它不是管道阶段可以调用的原生 CodePipeline 操作提供程序。此外，这还引入了不必要的基于时间的调度层，而不是作为该特定管道执行的一部分直接运行实验。

- **D 不正确：**如果进行了适当配置，CodeBuild 在技术上可以执行 AWS CLI 或 SDK 命令，但所提方案错误地要求将 FIS 实验模板导出到 Amazon S3。AWS FIS 直接从现有的托管实验模板启动实验，无需导出到 S3。与受支持的 Lambda 调用操作相比，使用 CodeBuild 单元测试项目执行这个简单的 API 调用也过于间接。

因此，**C** 是预期且最直接的受支持解决方案。

en.question: A DevOps engineer is creating a CI/CD pipeline to build container images. The engineer needs to store container images in Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) and scan the images for common vulnerabilities. The CI/CD pipeline must be resilient to outages in upstream source container image repositories. Which solution will meet these requirements?

options.A: Create an ECR private repository in the private registry to store the container images and scan images when images are pushed to the repository. Configure a replication rule in the private registry to replicate images from upstream repositories.
options.B: Create an ECR public repository in the public registry to cache images from upstream source repositories. Create an ECR private repository to store images. Configure the private repository to scan images when images are pushed to the repository.
options.C: Create an ECR public repository in the public registry. Configure a pull through cache rule for the repository. Create an ECR private repository to store images. Configure the ECR private registry to perform basic scanning.
options.D: Create an ECR private repository in the private registry to store the container images. Enable basic scanning for the private registry, and create a pull through cache rule.

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The pipeline needs two Amazon ECR capabilities:

1. **Store and scan container images for common vulnerabilities.**
2. **Continue pulling previously used upstream images when the upstream registry is temporarily unavailable.**

The key ECR feature for the second requirement is a **pull through cache rule**, which synchronizes images from a supported upstream registry into an **Amazon ECR private registry**.

## Correct answer: D

**D. Create an ECR private repository in the private registry to store the container images. Enable basic scanning for the private registry, and create a pull through cache rule.**

This solution satisfies both requirements:

- The private ECR repository stores the pipeline's container images.
- ECR basic scanning detects software vulnerabilities and common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs) in container images. Basic scanning is configured at the private-registry level, with filters determining which repositories are scanned on push; images can also be scanned manually. See [Scan images for OS vulnerabilities in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic.html) and [Configuring basic scanning for images in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html).
- A pull through cache rule pulls and caches upstream images in the ECR private registry. For later pulls, ECR serves the cached image, and AWS explicitly states that if ECR cannot update the image from the upstream registry, **the last cached image is still pulled**. This provides the required resilience to an upstream outage. See [Sync an upstream registry with an Amazon ECR private registry](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache.html).

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Incorrect

ECR replication is not the mechanism for importing and caching images from general upstream registries. ECR private image replication copies private ECR repositories **across AWS Regions or AWS accounts**. It does not replace a pull through cache rule for Docker Hub, ECR Public, Quay, GitHub Container Registry, or other supported upstream registries. See [Private image replication in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/replication.html).

### B. Incorrect

This proposes using an **ECR public repository as the upstream image cache**, but ECR pull through caching synchronizes upstream registries with an **ECR private registry**. Merely creating an ECR public repository does not configure resilient upstream caching. Although the private repository's scan-on-push setting can address scanning, the option does not provide the required valid pull through cache architecture.

### C. Incorrect

A pull through cache rule is not configured for an ECR public repository. AWS documents pull through cache as synchronizing an upstream registry into an **Amazon ECR private registry**, where ECR creates repositories and caches the images. Therefore, the public-repository portion of this design is invalid even though private-registry basic scanning is valid.

Therefore, **D** is the only option that correctly combines private ECR storage and vulnerability scanning with pull through caching for resilience to upstream repository outages.

zh.question: 一名 DevOps 工程师正在创建一个 CI/CD 管道来构建容器镜像。该工程师需要将容器镜像存储在 Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) 中，并扫描镜像以查找常见漏洞。CI/CD 管道必须能够应对上游源容器镜像仓库的中断。哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求？

options.A: 在私有注册表中创建一个 ECR 私有仓库来存储容器镜像，并在镜像推送到该仓库时扫描镜像。在私有注册表中配置复制规则，以从上游仓库复制镜像。
options.B: 在公有注册表中创建一个 ECR 公有仓库，以缓存来自上游源仓库的镜像。创建一个 ECR 私有仓库来存储镜像。将私有仓库配置为在镜像推送到该仓库时扫描镜像。
options.C: 在公有注册表中创建一个 ECR 公有仓库。为该仓库配置 pull through cache rule。创建一个 ECR 私有仓库来存储镜像。将 ECR 私有注册表配置为执行基本扫描。
options.D: 在私有注册表中创建一个 ECR 私有仓库来存储容器镜像。为私有注册表启用基本扫描，并创建一个 pull through cache rule。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

该管道需要两项 Amazon ECR 功能：

1. **存储容器镜像并扫描其中的常见漏洞。**
2. **当上游注册表暂时不可用时，仍可继续拉取之前使用过的上游镜像。**

满足第二项要求的关键 ECR 功能是 **pull through cache rule**，它会将受支持上游注册表中的镜像同步到 **Amazon ECR private registry**。

## 正确答案：D

**D. 在私有注册表中创建一个 ECR 私有仓库来存储容器镜像。为私有注册表启用基本扫描，并创建一个 pull through cache rule。**

此解决方案同时满足两项要求：

- 私有 ECR 仓库存储管道的容器镜像。
- ECR 基本扫描可检测容器镜像中的软件漏洞以及常见漏洞和暴露（CVE）。基本扫描在私有注册表级别进行配置，筛选器决定哪些仓库会在推送时被扫描；也可以手动扫描镜像。请参阅 [Scan images for OS vulnerabilities in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic.html) 和 [Configuring basic scanning for images in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/image-scanning-basic-enabling.html)。
- Pull through cache rule 会在 ECR 私有注册表中拉取并缓存上游镜像。后续拉取时，ECR 会提供缓存的镜像；AWS 明确指出，如果 ECR 无法从上游注册表更新镜像，**仍会拉取上次缓存的镜像**。这提供了应对上游中断所需的韧性。请参阅 [Sync an upstream registry with an Amazon ECR private registry](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/pull-through-cache.html)。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 错误

ECR replication 并非用于从通用上游注册表导入和缓存镜像的机制。ECR 私有镜像复制会在 **AWS Regions 或 AWS accounts 之间**复制私有 ECR 仓库。它不能替代用于 Docker Hub、ECR Public、Quay、GitHub Container Registry 或其他受支持上游注册表的 pull through cache rule。请参阅 [Private image replication in Amazon ECR](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECR/latest/userguide/replication.html)。

### B. 错误

该选项建议使用 **ECR public repository 作为上游镜像缓存**，但 ECR pull through caching 会将上游注册表同步到 **ECR private registry**。仅创建 ECR 公有仓库并不会配置具有韧性的上游缓存。虽然私有仓库的推送时扫描设置可以满足扫描要求，但该选项没有提供所需且有效的 pull through cache 架构。

### C. 错误

无法为 ECR 公有仓库配置 pull through cache rule。AWS 文档说明，pull through cache 会将上游注册表同步到 **Amazon ECR private registry**，ECR 会在其中创建仓库并缓存镜像。因此，尽管私有注册表基本扫描有效，该设计中的公有仓库部分无效。

因此，**D** 是唯一能够正确结合私有 ECR 存储、漏洞扫描以及 pull through caching，从而应对上游仓库中断的选项。

en.question: A company is running its ecommerce website on AWS. The website is currently hosted on a single Amazon EC2 instance in one Availability Zone. A MySQL database runs on the same EC2 instance. The company needs to eliminate single points of failure in the architecture to improve the website's availability and resilience. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST configuration changes to the website?

options.A: Deploy the application by using AWS Fargate containers. Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Use Amazon API Gateway to route requests.
options.B: Deploy the application on EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. Put the EC2 instances into an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora Multi-AZ. Use Amazon CloudFront for content delivery.
options.C: Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to deploy the application across multiple AWS Regions. Migrate the database to Amazon Redshift. Use Amazon ElastiCache for session management.
options.D: Migrate the application to AWS Lambda functions. Use Amazon S3 for static content hosting. Migrate the database to Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility).

en.explanation:
## What the question is asking

The current EC2 instance is a single point of failure for **both** the web/application tier and the MySQL database. The required solution must remove those single points of failure while requiring the **least changes to the existing website**.

## Correct answer: B

**Deploy the application on EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones, place them in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer, and migrate MySQL to an Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ cluster.**

This option preserves the existing architecture and technology choices as much as possible:

- The application remains on **EC2**, avoiding a rewrite for containers or serverless computing.
- An Auto Scaling group and Application Load Balancer distribute the application across multiple instances and Availability Zones. AWS documents that Elastic Load Balancing distributes traffic among healthy EC2 instances and that enabling it across multiple AZs increases application fault tolerance. Auto Scaling also maintains the desired number of instances if an instance fails. See [Set up a scaled and load-balanced application](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/tutorial-ec2-auto-scaling-load-balancer.html) and [What is an Application Load Balancer?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html).
- Aurora is a fully managed relational database engine compatible with MySQL. AWS states that existing MySQL code, tools, and applications can be used with Aurora, making it the lowest-change database choice among the options. See [What is Amazon Aurora?](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html).
- An Aurora cluster volume spans multiple Availability Zones, and Aurora can automatically fail over to a replica in another AZ. AWS recommends placing the writer and reader instances across multiple AZs to withstand an AZ outage. See [High availability and fault tolerance for Aurora](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html).
- CloudFront can improve content delivery and reduce requests reaching the origin. It is not the principal component eliminating the original single points of failure, but it is compatible with the resilient design.

Therefore, **B** provides high availability for both the application and database tiers with the least architectural and application change.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. Fargate, DynamoDB, and API Gateway

This requires substantial rearchitecture:

- The EC2 application must be containerized and adapted for Fargate.
- The relational MySQL database must be redesigned for DynamoDB's nonrelational key-value/document data model.
- The web request path must be redesigned around API Gateway.

AWS explicitly describes DynamoDB as a **NoSQL, nonrelational** database and documents multiple differences from relational MySQL-style databases. See [Learn how to go from SQL to NoSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SQLtoNoSQL.html). This is not the least-change solution.

### C. Elastic Beanstalk across Regions, Redshift, and ElastiCache

Amazon Redshift is a data warehouse optimized for BI, reporting, and large analytic queries—not the appropriate operational transaction database replacement for an ecommerce MySQL database. See [Amazon Redshift architecture](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_redshift_system_overview.html).

In addition, deploying and coordinating the application across multiple Regions introduces significantly more configuration than a Multi-AZ design, and adding ElastiCache-based session management can require application changes. This option is neither the closest architectural match nor the least-change solution.

### D. Lambda, S3, and DocumentDB

This would require rewriting the EC2-based application into Lambda functions and redesigning the database layer. Amazon DocumentDB is compatible with **MongoDB** applications, drivers, and tools—not MySQL. See [What is Amazon DocumentDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/what-is.html).

Although S3 is suitable for static website content, it does not eliminate the need to reimplement the application's dynamic ecommerce logic. Therefore, this option involves major application and data-model changes.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上运行其电子商务网站。该网站当前托管在一个可用区中的单个 Amazon EC2 实例上。一个 MySQL 数据库运行在同一个 EC2 实例上。该公司需要消除架构中的单点故障，以提高网站的可用性和弹性。哪种解决方案能够以对网站进行**最少配置更改**的方式满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS Fargate 容器部署应用程序。将数据库迁移到 Amazon DynamoDB。使用 Amazon API Gateway 路由请求。
options.B: 在多个可用区的 EC2 实例上部署应用程序。将 EC2 实例置于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中。将数据库迁移到 Amazon Aurora Multi-AZ。使用 Amazon CloudFront 进行内容分发。
options.C: 使用 AWS Elastic Beanstalk 在多个 AWS 区域部署应用程序。将数据库迁移到 Amazon Redshift。使用 Amazon ElastiCache 进行会话管理。
options.D: 将应用程序迁移到 AWS Lambda 函数。使用 Amazon S3 托管静态内容。将数据库迁移到 Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility)。

zh.explanation:
## 题目要求

当前的 EC2 实例对于 Web/应用程序层和 MySQL 数据库来说都是单点故障。所需解决方案必须消除这些单点故障，同时要求对**现有网站进行最少的更改**。

## 正确答案：B

**在多个可用区的 EC2 实例上部署应用程序，将其置于 Application Load Balancer 后面的 Auto Scaling 组中，并将 MySQL 迁移到 Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ 集群。**

此选项最大程度地保留了现有架构和技术选择：

- 应用程序仍运行在 **EC2** 上，无需为了容器或无服务器计算而重写。
- Auto Scaling 组和 Application Load Balancer 会将应用程序分布到多个实例和可用区中。AWS 文档说明，Elastic Load Balancing 会在运行正常的 EC2 实例之间分配流量，并且在多个 AZ 中启用它可提高应用程序的容错能力。如果某个实例发生故障，Auto Scaling 还会维持所需的实例数量。请参阅 [设置可扩展且负载均衡的应用程序](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/autoscaling/ec2/userguide/tutorial-ec2-auto-scaling-load-balancer.html) 和 [什么是 Application Load Balancer？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/application/introduction.html)。
- Aurora 是一种与 MySQL 兼容的完全托管关系数据库引擎。AWS 表示，现有的 MySQL 代码、工具和应用程序可与 Aurora 一起使用，因此在这些选项中，它是改动最少的数据库选择。请参阅 [什么是 Amazon Aurora？](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/CHAP_AuroraOverview.html)。
- Aurora 集群存储卷跨多个可用区，Aurora 可以自动故障转移到另一个 AZ 中的副本。AWS 建议将写入器和读取器实例部署在多个 AZ 中，以抵御 AZ 故障。请参阅 [Aurora 的高可用性和容错能力](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/AuroraUserGuide/Concepts.AuroraHighAvailability.html)。
- CloudFront 可以改善内容分发，并减少到达源站的请求。它并非消除原始单点故障的主要组件，但与这种弹性设计兼容。

因此，**B** 为应用程序层和数据库层都提供了高可用性，同时所需的架构和应用程序改动最少。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. Fargate、DynamoDB 和 API Gateway

此选项需要进行大量重新架构：

- EC2 应用程序必须容器化并适配 Fargate。
- 关系型 MySQL 数据库必须针对 DynamoDB 的非关系型键值/文档数据模型进行重新设计。
- Web 请求路径必须围绕 API Gateway 重新设计。

AWS 明确将 DynamoDB 描述为 **NoSQL、非关系型** 数据库，并说明了它与关系型 MySQL 风格数据库之间的多项差异。请参阅 [了解如何从 SQL 迁移到 NoSQL](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/amazondynamodb/latest/developerguide/SQLtoNoSQL.html)。这不是改动最少的解决方案。

### C. 跨区域的 Elastic Beanstalk、Redshift 和 ElastiCache

Amazon Redshift 是针对 BI、报表和大型分析查询优化的数据仓库，而不是适合替代电子商务 MySQL 数据库的运营事务数据库。请参阅 [Amazon Redshift 架构](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/redshift/latest/dg/c_redshift_system_overview.html)。

此外，跨多个区域部署和协调应用程序所需的配置明显多于 Multi-AZ 设计，并且添加基于 ElastiCache 的会话管理可能需要更改应用程序。此选项既不是最接近现有架构的方案，也不是改动最少的解决方案。

### D. Lambda、S3 和 DocumentDB

此选项要求将基于 EC2 的应用程序重写为 Lambda 函数，并重新设计数据库层。Amazon DocumentDB 与 **MongoDB** 应用程序、驱动程序和工具兼容，而不是 MySQL。请参阅 [什么是 Amazon DocumentDB](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/documentdb/latest/devguide/what-is.html)。

尽管 S3 适合静态网站内容，但它无法消除重新实现应用程序动态电子商务逻辑的需求。因此，此选项涉及重大的应用程序和数据模型更改。

en.question: A company is developing a microservices-based application on AWS. The application consists of AWS Lambda functions and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) services that need to be deployed frequently. A DevOps engineer needs to implement a consistent deployment solution across all components of the application. The solution must automate the deployments, minimize downtime during updates, and manage configuration data for the application. Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?

options.A: Use AWS CloudFormation to define and provision the Lambda functions and ECS services. Implement stack updates with resource replacement for all components. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage the configuration data.
options.B: Use AWS CodeDeploy to manage deployments for the Lambda functions and ECS services. Implement canary deployments for the Lambda functions. Implement blue/green deployments for the ECS services. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to manage the configuration data.
options.C: Use AWS Step Functions to orchestrate deployments for the Lambda functions and ECS services. Use canary deployments for the Lambda functions and ECS services in a different AWS Region. Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store to manage the configuration data.
options.D: Use AWS Systems Manager to manage deployments for the Lambda functions and ECS services. Implement all-at-once deployments for the Lambda functions. Implement rolling updates for the ECS services. Use AWS Secrets Manager to manage the configuration data.

en.explanation:
## Analysis

The application contains two different compute models—serverless Lambda functions and containerized Amazon ECS services—but requires one consistent, automated deployment solution that minimizes disruption and also stores application configuration.

## Correct answer: B

**AWS CodeDeploy** is the best fit because it natively supports both required compute platforms:

- For **Lambda**, CodeDeploy shifts traffic between function versions and supports **canary, linear, and all-at-once** configurations. A canary deployment initially sends only a small portion of traffic to the new version, reducing deployment risk.
- For **Amazon ECS**, CodeDeploy performs a **blue/green deployment** by creating a replacement task set and shifting production traffic from the original task set to the replacement. This allows the new version to run alongside the old version and minimizes interruption.
- CodeDeploy fully automates deployments and provides rollback and health-monitoring capabilities, avoiding the custom orchestration that alternative solutions would require. See the [CodeDeploy compute platforms and deployment types](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html) and the [predefined Lambda and ECS deployment configurations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-configurations.html).
- **AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store** is designed for centrally managing application configuration data. It supports hierarchical organization and can be consumed directly by Lambda and injected into ECS tasks as environment variables. See [Parameter Store features](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html).

This combination uses native managed capabilities for both deployment targets and therefore requires the **least development effort**.

## Why the other options are incorrect

### A. CloudFormation replacements for all components

CloudFormation is appropriate for provisioning infrastructure, but forcing resource replacement for every application update is not a consistent progressive-deployment strategy. It does not, by itself, provide Lambda canary traffic shifting across versions. AWS also notes that replacement is a multistep process and that an application might not be fully operational during stack reconfiguration, which conflicts with minimizing downtime. See [CloudFormation availability and update-impact considerations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/updating.stacks.walkthrough.html).

Secrets Manager can store sensitive configuration, but it does not correct the unsuitable deployment approach.

### C. Step Functions and cross-Region canary deployments

Step Functions can define and orchestrate custom workflows, but it is not the native deployment service for progressive Lambda and ECS deployments. The engineer would need to build and maintain state-machine definitions, deployment API calls, health checks, traffic shifting, failure handling, and rollback behavior, resulting in substantially more development effort. See [Defining Step Functions workflows](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/step-functions/latest/dg/developing-workflows.html).

Deploying ECS and Lambda canaries in another Region also introduces unnecessary cross-Region infrastructure and does not provide the direct production traffic-shifting behavior described in the requirement.

### D. Systems Manager deployments with Lambda all-at-once updates

Systems Manager Automation can execute predefined or custom runbooks against AWS resources, but implementing application deployment logic for Lambda and ECS would require custom automation rather than using CodeDeploy's native deployment models. See [Systems Manager Automation runbooks](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-automation.html).

Additionally, an **all-at-once** Lambda deployment immediately shifts all traffic to the new version, providing less risk mitigation than a canary deployment. Although ECS rolling updates can preserve some availability, this option does not provide the same consistent managed deployment solution across Lambda and ECS and requires more custom implementation.

zh.question: 一家公司正在 AWS 上开发基于微服务的应用程序。该应用程序由需要频繁部署的 AWS Lambda 函数和 Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) 服务组成。一名 DevOps 工程师需要为应用程序的所有组件实施一致的部署解决方案。该解决方案必须自动化部署、在更新期间尽量减少停机时间，并管理应用程序的配置数据。哪种解决方案能够以最少的开发工作量满足这些要求？

options.A: 使用 AWS CloudFormation 定义和预置 Lambda 函数及 ECS 服务。通过对所有组件实施资源替换来更新堆栈。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 管理配置数据。
options.B: 使用 AWS CodeDeploy 管理 Lambda 函数和 ECS 服务的部署。为 Lambda 函数实施金丝雀部署。为 ECS 服务实施蓝绿部署。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 管理配置数据。
options.C: 使用 AWS Step Functions 编排 Lambda 函数和 ECS 服务的部署。在不同的 AWS Region 中对 Lambda 函数和 ECS 服务使用金丝雀部署。使用 AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store 管理配置数据。
options.D: 使用 AWS Systems Manager 管理 Lambda 函数和 ECS 服务的部署。为 Lambda 函数实施一次性部署。为 ECS 服务实施滚动更新。使用 AWS Secrets Manager 管理配置数据。

zh.explanation:
## 分析

该应用程序包含两种不同的计算模型：无服务器 Lambda 函数和容器化的 Amazon ECS 服务，但需要一种一致的自动化部署解决方案，以尽量减少中断并存储应用程序配置。

## 正确答案：B

**AWS CodeDeploy** 是最佳选择，因为它原生支持两个所需的计算平台：

- 对于 **Lambda**，CodeDeploy 可在函数版本之间转移流量，并支持 **金丝雀、线性和一次性** 配置。金丝雀部署最初仅将一小部分流量发送到新版本，从而降低部署风险。
- 对于 **Amazon ECS**，CodeDeploy 通过创建替代任务集，并将生产流量从原始任务集转移至替代任务集来执行 **蓝绿部署**。这使新版本能够与旧版本同时运行，并尽量减少中断。
- CodeDeploy 可完全自动化部署，并提供回滚和运行状况监控功能，避免了替代方案所需的自定义编排。请参阅 [CodeDeploy 计算平台和部署类型](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/welcome.html) 以及 [预定义的 Lambda 和 ECS 部署配置](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codedeploy/latest/userguide/deployment-configurations.html)。
- **AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store** 专为集中管理应用程序配置数据而设计。它支持分层组织，并且可由 Lambda 直接使用，或作为环境变量注入 ECS 任务。请参阅 [Parameter Store 功能](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/systems-manager/latest/userguide/systems-manager-parameter-store.html)。

该组合针对两个部署目标使用原生托管功能，因此所需的**开发工作量最少**。

## 其他选项错误的原因

### A. 对所有组件使用 CloudFormation 替换
